title: Spatial Nonlocality from Finite Extinction Ratio in BOTDR over Heterogeneous Fiber Links
summary: Finite extinction ratio in pulse-modulated Brillouin optical time-domain reflectometry (BOTDR) produces residual inter-pulse Brillouin backscatter outside the nominal pulse gate. We model and experimentally quantify this effect as spatial nonlocality in a heterogeneous fiber link and define the spectral contamination ratio (SCR) as the contaminating Brillouin-band power normalized to the local Brillouin-band power. Measurements were performed using a 1.2 km standard single-mode fiber (SMF) followed by 0.1 km of dispersion-compensating fiber (DCF), whose separated Brillouin frequency shifts allow section-to-section leakage to be resolved spectrally. At 20 m spatial resolution, increasing the extinction ratio from 18.5 to 33.0 dB reduced the SMF-band contamination in the DCF gates from -5.3 to -14.8 dB. Over the 16-33 dB range, the SCR showed fitted slopes of -1.064 and -1.246 dB/dB for the two contamination directions. These results quantify finite-ER-induced spatial nonlocality and provide a link-specific metric for extinction-ratio selection in BOTDR.

AI.tldr: 该文建模并实验量化了BOTDR中有限消光比导致脉冲门外残余布里渊背散射的"空间非局域性"，提出光谱污染比（SCR）指标，测得SCR随消光比增大而线性下降。
AI.motivation: 脉冲调制BOTDR中有限消光比会使标称脉冲门之外产生残余脉冲间布里渊背散射，造成异质光纤链路中的空间非局域性污染，但该效应缺乏建模、量化与消光比选型依据。
AI.method: 将有限消光比效应建模为异质链路中的空间非局域性，定义光谱污染比（SCR）为污染布里渊带功率与本地布里渊带功率之比；实验采用1.2 km标准单模光纤（SMF）后接0.1 km色散补偿光纤（DCF），利用二者布里渊频移不同在光谱上分辨段间泄漏，空间分辨率20 m。
AI.result: 消光比从18.5 dB提升至33.0 dB时，DCF门内SMF带污染由-5.3 dB降至-14.8 dB；在16–33 dB范围内，两个污染方向的SCR拟合斜率分别为-1.064和-1.246 dB/dB。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了有限消光比引起的空间非局域性，并提供了面向链路特异的消光比选择度量，可用于BOTDR系统设计与参数优化。

title: Definition of Multi-Parameter Super-Resolution for Optical Telescopes
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures in main text. 5 pages, 1 figure in supplement
summary: Super-resolution techniques in microscopy are opening new frontiers in biology, and super-resolution for telescope imaging may provide similar benefits for astronomy and space domain awareness. Telescope super-resolution techniques such as multi-plane light conversion and photonic lanterns have been inspired by the ability of mode sorting measurements to extract classical Fisher information closer to the quantum bound than standard telescope imaging. Fisher information analyses for super-resolution imaging systems commonly consider the case of imaging point sources, but often only consider estimating a small subset of the parameters. Furthermore, there has been no demonstration of an estimation algorithm with performance that follows the limit set by the Fisher information when all point source parameters are considered. We provide a framework for defining and analyzing super-resolution using the classical and quantum Fisher information for the multi-parameter estimation problem and demonstrate an algorithm that can achieve the classical Fisher information bound for all the parameters simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于经典与量子Fisher信息的多参数超分辨成像分析框架，并给出了可同时达到所有参数经典Fisher信息下界的估计算法。
AI.motivation: 望远镜超分辨技术（如多平面光转换、光子灯笼）受模式排序测量能够逼近量子极限这一现象的启发，但现有Fisher信息分析多局限于点源成像且仅估计少量参数，且尚无估计算法能在考虑全部点源参数时达到Fisher信息所设定的性能极限。
AI.method: 构建了面向多参数估计问题的框架，利用经典Fisher信息和量子Fisher信息来定义并分析超分辨成像，并设计了一种估计算法。
AI.result: 所提出的算法能够同时对所有参数达到经典Fisher信息下界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为望远镜超分辨成像提供了多参数分析工具，并首次展示了在多参数情形下可达到经典Fisher信息极限的估计算法，对天文学和空间态势感知具有潜在价值。

title: Fast local field calculation in cascaded coupled systems
comment: Manuscript: 10 pages, 7 figures; SI: 3 pages, 2 figures
summary: Computing the field within a sub-unit of cascaded systems is a recurring problem in wave physics. It is central to gradient-based inverse design, in situations where only a region of the system is modified while the rest remains fixed. Standard approaches either resimulate the entire cascade at every change, or require a detailed characterization of every surrounding sub-system. Both become impractical when many design iterations are needed. Here, we introduce a hybrid method combining the $S$-matrix approach, which propagates fields through cascaded systems, with the Green's function method, which gives the field generated by a source within a characterized system. In this approach, the sub-systems surrounding the region of interest need only be characterized once, after which the local field can be recomputed rapidly for any new configuration. We validate the method on a disordered lossy waveguide, finding excellent agreement with finite-element simulations. We also demonstrate its efficiency on a disordered multimode cavity, where it achieves a fifty-fold speed-up over full-wave simulation and reduces a wideband focusing calculation from eleven hours to ten minutes. This approach opens the way to fast, iterative field calculations in complex systems coupled to their environment, with direct applications to inverse design and wideband wavefront-shaping.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将S矩阵与格林函数相结合的混合方法，只需对感兴趣区域周围的子系统表征一次，即可快速重算任意新构型下的局部场，在无序多模腔中实现50倍加速。
AI.motivation: 波物理中常需计算级联系统某一子单元内的场，尤其在仅局部修改、其余固定的梯度式逆向设计中。传统方法要么每次改动都重算整个级联，要么要求对所有周边子系统详细表征，在大量设计迭代时均不实用。
AI.method: 将传播级联系统场的S矩阵方法与给出已表征系统内源产生场的格林函数方法相结合。周围子系统只需表征一次，之后对任意新配置可快速重算局部场。
AI.result: 在无序损耗波导上验证，与有限元仿真高度一致；在无序多模腔上实现较全波仿真50倍加速，将宽带聚焦计算从11小时缩短到10分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为复杂系统与其环境耦合时的快速迭代场计算开辟了道路，可直接应用于逆设计与宽带波前整形。

title: Understanding the Power Consumption of Modern High Bandwidth Memory: Experimental Analysis and Modeling Using Real HBM2 DRAM Chips
comment: Extended version of the paper titled "Understanding the Power Consumption of Modern High Bandwidth Memory: Experimental Analysis and Modeling Using Real HBM2 DRAM Chips'' to appear in MICRO 2026
summary:
We perform the first comprehensive experimental characterization of power consumed by real HBM2 DRAM chips. Our extensive characterization yields 1) the empirical basis for developing new, accurate HBM power models or validating existing power models and 2) key insights into structural and data-pattern-dependent variation of power in HBM2 chips. Out of our 13 new findings and 6 key takeaway messages, we highlight: 1) a read operation consumes significantly higher current than any other operation and 2) the toggled data bus signals in a data transfer burst significantly affect current draw where toggling all HBM2-internal bank group bus signals causes 29.4% higher power consumption than keeping them constant. Leveraging our empirical insights into HBM2 power consumption, we engineer an access pattern that yields 23.6% higher power consumption on average across 36 tested HBM2 chips than the highest-power-consuming JEDEC-specified current measurement loop.
  Our results have important implications for HBM-based system design and validation. Relying solely on JEDEC- or vendor-specified test loops to bound HBM power could cause system failures and/or thermal throttling in real-world high-power AI/ML workloads. To improve 3D-stacked DRAM power modeling in open source architectural simulation infrastructures, we develop a new HBM power model. Our model predicts the power of 36 real HBM2 chips across diverse workloads (including a real LLM decode workload) with 7.6 -- 8.1% mean absolute percentage error, substantially more accurately than state-of-the-art HBM power models. The power consumption predicted by our model for a power-intensive microbenchmark closely matches (with 2.4% to 5.3% error across HBM3E's specified supply voltage range) the average HBM3E memory power consumed by three tested NVIDIA H200 GPUs. We publicly release our power model at https://github.com/CMU-SAFARI/HBM-Power.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对真实HBM2 DRAM芯片功耗进行全面实验刻画，提出高精度HBM功耗模型，并揭示JEDEC测试环路无法界定真实高功耗AI/ML负载的问题。
AI.motivation: HBM广泛用于AI/ML等高性能系统，但缺乏对真实HBM2芯片功耗的系统性实验认知，且现有HBM功耗模型（JEDEC/厂商规范或开源仿真器模型）精度不足，仅依赖规范测试环路可能低估实际功耗，导致系统失效或热降频。
AI.method: 对真实HBM2芯片开展全面功耗实验刻画，获得13项新发现与6条关键结论；基于经验洞察构造高功耗访问模式；并据此开发新的HBM功耗模型（开源发布于GitHub）。
AI.result: 发现读操作电流显著高于其他操作；数据突发中总线信号翻转显著影响电流，全部翻转HBM2内部bank group总线信号比保持恒定功耗高29.4%；所构造访问模式在36颗HBM2芯片上平均功耗比JEDEC最高功耗电流测量环路高23.6%；新模型在多样负载（含真实LLM解码）下对36颗HBM2芯片预测MAPE为7.6%–8.1%，显著优于现有模型，且对HBM3E预测与三颗NVIDIA H200 GPU实测平均功耗误差仅2.4%–5.3%。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖JEDEC或厂商测试环路来界定HBM功耗可能导致真实高功耗AI/ML场景下的系统失效与热降频；所提HBM功耗模型显著提升3D堆叠DRAM功耗建模精度，已开源以支撑HBM系统设计与验证。

title: Optimization of Active Reconfigurable Surfaces for Spatiotemporal MU-MIMO Wave Routing in Disordered Media: Application to the Cocktail-Party Problem
summary: We design an active reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) for acoustic multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) communication by solving a large-scale convex optimization problem, so that each emitter's broadband signal focuses in space and time at its intended receivers while crosstalk is suppressed. In acoustic experiments, we show that our approach outperforms existing time-reversal methods by 5.1-7.6 dB in crosstalk suppression, while achieving better temporal focusing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种用于声学多用户MIMO的主动可重构智能表面（RIS），通过求解大规模凸优化问题实现宽带信号在目标接收端的时空聚焦并抑制串扰，实验显示串扰抑制比现有时间反演方法优5.1–7.6 dB。
AI.motivation: 声学多用户MIMO通信中，各发射端信号需在空间与时间上精确聚焦于其目标接收端，同时抑制多用户间串扰。现有时间反演方法在宽带条件下聚焦与串扰抑制性能有限。
AI.method: 设计主动式可重构智能表面（RIS），并将其配置问题建模为大规模凸优化问题并求解，以获得各阵元的调控参数，使每个发射端的宽带信号在目标接收端实现时空聚焦并抑制串扰。
AI.result: 声学实验中，该方法在串扰抑制上比现有时间反演方法提升5.1–7.6 dB，同时获得更好的时间聚焦性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于凸优化的主动RIS设计可有效提升声学多用户MIMO的时空聚焦与串扰抑制性能，验证了主动RIS在声学通信中的可行性。

title: A Portable Optical Frequency Comb with Low Repetition-Rate Drift Based on "Optical Cubes"
summary: We demonstrate a compact, fully stabilized, all-polarization-maintaining (all-PM) Er:fiber optical frequency comb (OFC) implemented on a silica optical-cube platform. The optical comb module, including the oscillator, amplifier, spectral-broadening stage, 780-nm frequency-doubling branch, and f-to-2f interferometer, occupies a volume of 0.88 L. Without active temperature control, the free-running repetition frequency exhibits a peak-to-peak excursion of 75 Hz over 10 h, corresponding to 0.375 ppm. Under the same laboratory conditions, this excursion is 6.2 times smaller than that of a mechanically mounted non-PM reference comb. The amplified pulses are compressed to 94 fs and spectrally broadened in a PM highly nonlinear fiber. A coherent-population-trapping-based chip-scale atomic clock is employed for the first time as the radio-frequency reference for comb locking, thereby reducing the footprint of the microwave-reference subsystem. The resulting in-loop, optical-frequency-normalized tracking instability reaches 6.03E-17 at 1 s and 2.57E-18 at 10,000 s. These results demonstrate a compact comb architecture with reduced sensitivity to environmental perturbations, providing a practical route toward portable optical atomic clocks.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一种基于石英光学立方体平台的小型化全保偏Er:fiber光频梳，体积仅0.88 L，采用CPT芯片级原子钟作为射频参考，1 s处频率不稳定度达6.03E-17。
AI.motivation: 便携式光原子钟需要小型化、对环境扰动不敏感的光频梳架构，传统机械安装的非保偏光频梳体积大、自由运行频率漂移大，且微波参考子系统占据较大空间。
AI.method: 将振荡器、放大器、光谱展宽级、780 nm倍频支路及f-to-2f干涉仪集成于石英光学立方体平台，构建全保偏Er:fiber光频梳；放大脉冲压缩至94 fs并在保偏高非线性光纤中展宽；首次采用基于相干布局囚禁（CPT）的芯片级原子钟作为射频参考进行梳齿锁定。
AI.result: 光梳模块体积0.88 L；无主动温控下自由运行重复频率10小时内峰峰漂移75 Hz（0.375 ppm），比机械安装的非保偏参考梳小6.2倍；环路内光学频率归一化跟踪不稳定度1 s处为6.03E-17，10000 s处为2.57E-18。
AI.conclusion: 该结果验证了一种对环境扰动敏感性低的小型化光频梳架构，为便携式光原子钟提供了切实可行的技术路径。

title: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
comment: Accepted at the 22nd European Conference on Computer Systems (EuroSys '27), April 19-23, 2027, Rabat, Morocco. 14 pages, 8 figures
summary:
Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior.
  In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. DFIT captures high-level, semantically meaningful data that reflect the true dataflow of computation. These data can be exported for visualization and analysis. Our approach demonstrates how instrumentation can be generalized beyond traditional hardware to support heterogeneous architectures, providing portability without modifying tool logic.
  By opening the black box of dataflow execution, DFIT establishes a foundation for new classes of performance analysis tools for AI accelerators. It provides a practical path toward reproducible, architecture-aware introspection across heterogeneous systems, bridging the long-standing visibility gap between compiler design, runtime scheduling, and hardware realization. Evaluation across Cerebras, SambaNova, and TPU shows practical overhead of 3.53%-13.62% across instrumentation modes with robust cross-platform portability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DFIT，一个面向数据流架构的插桩框架，可直接在图IR与后端lowering阶段对算子、区域及编译变换进行插桩，捕获语义级数据流信息并导出用于可视化分析，在Cerebras、SambaNova和TPU上开销为3.53%–13.62%。
AI.motivation: 数据流加速器在机器学习负载上具备高能效与高吞吐，但对开发者高度不透明。相较CPU/GPU有成熟的插桩框架支持细粒度观测，数据流硬件几乎不暴露信息，导致编译器工程师、系统设计者和应用开发者难以分析、调优或调试加速器行为，形成可见性鸿沟。
AI.method: DFIT在编译流程中直接插桩：一是在图IR层面，二是在后端lowering阶段，借助语义程序表示对算子（operations）、区域（regions）与编译变换（compiler transformations）进行插桩，捕获反映真实数据流的高层语义信息，并支持导出以供可视化与分析。该方法将插桩逻辑与具体硬件解耦，实现跨异构架构的可移植性而无需修改工具逻辑。
AI.result: 在Cerebras、SambaNova和TPU上评估显示，各插桩模式下实际开销为3.53%–13.62%，并具备稳健的跨平台可移植性。
AI.conclusion: DFIT打开了数据流执行的黑箱，为AI加速器建立新型性能分析工具的基础，提供了一条在异构系统上实现可复现、架构感知内省（introspection）的实用路径，弥合编译器设计、运行时调度与硬件实现之间长期存在的可见性鸿沟。

title: UV-cured PVA-collagen co-network with staining-free photodynamic activity against chronic wound bacteria
comment: 9 Figures, 1 Table; accepted in European Polymer Journal on 8 October 2026
summary: Chronic wounds affect 1-2% of the global population and represent an unsustainable healthcare, financial and economic burden. Delayed healing is largely associated with bacterial infection and inadequate moisture balance, both of which remain difficult to control due to increasing antimicrobial resistance and the limited exudate management capacity and mechanical performance of current dressings. To address these challenges, we introduce a staining-free photodynamic material with work-light-triggered antibacterial activity, significant water-induced swelling (more than nine-fold increase in dry weight) and tunable wet state compression modulus (Ec: 76+/-34 - 289+/-94 kPa). The material was prepared by UV co-curing of an aqueous solution containing polyvinyl alcohol functionalised with both phenothiazine and methacrylate residues, 4-vinylbenzyl-functionalised type 1 rat tail collagen, and a water-soluble photoinitiator. Fourier Transform Infrared spectroscopy and Differential Scanning Calorimetry of the co-networks indicated the presence of characteristic chemical and thermal features of both components. 96-hour co-network incubation in vitro (pH 7.4, 37 degC) confirmed the significant retention of toluidine blue (> 93 wt.%), suppressed medium colouration, and an average mass retention higher than 98 wt.%. Exposure of the UV-cured samples to 10-min work light resulted in at least 1 log10 reduction in Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa viabilities, in contrast to dark-control conditions, while the metabolic activity of L929 fibroblasts remained above 90%. The antibacterial properties, staining-free photodynamic behaviour, water-induced swelling, and wet-state mechanical properties achieved via network integration with functionalised collagen, make this material appealing for chronic wound healing applications and for on-demand delivery of localised therapies.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种免染色、工作光触发抗菌的光动力水凝胶材料，通过聚乙烯醇（接枝吩噻嗪与甲基丙烯酸酯）与功能化胶原UV共固化制备，兼具高吸水膨胀、可调湿态力学性能及抗菌活性，适用于慢性伤口愈合。
AI.motivation: 慢性伤口影响全球1-2%人口，造成沉重的医疗与经济负担。愈合延迟主要与细菌感染和湿度失衡有关，而现有敷料受限于抗菌耐药性增加、渗液管理能力不足及力学性能差。
AI.method: 将接枝吩噻嗪和甲基丙烯酸酯基团的聚乙烯醇、4-乙烯苄基功能化的1型大鼠尾胶原及水溶性光引发剂组成水溶液，经UV共固化制备共网络材料；采用FTIR和DSC表征化学与热学特征，并通过体外孵育（pH 7.4、37℃）及光照实验评估性能。
AI.result: 材料具免染色光动力抗菌活性、显著水致膨胀（干重增加九倍以上）及可调湿态压缩模量（Ec: 76±34–289±94 kPa）；96小时体外孵育显示甲苯胺蓝保留率>93 wt.%、介质着色受抑制、平均质量保留率>98 wt.%；10分钟工作光照射使金黄色葡萄球菌和铜绿假单胞菌存活率至少降低1 log10，而L929成纤维细胞代谢活性保持90%以上。
AI.conclusion: 该材料结合抗菌性、免染色光动力行为、水致膨胀及湿态力学性能，适用于慢性伤口愈合及局部治疗的原位按需递送。

title: Mutual Coupling and Visibility Effects in 2D Holographic Curvature-Reconfigurable Apertures
summary: Holographic multiple-input multiple-output arrays provide high spatial resolution and flexible wavefront control, but curved or conformal deployments jointly introduce curvature, mutual coupling (MC), and direction-dependent visibility. This paper studies a two-dimensional (2D) holographic curvaturereconfigurable aperture (HoloCuRA). A geometry-based model characterizes element positions, steering, and spatial correlation, while an impedance-based coupling matrix and a visibility vector capture electromagnetic interactions and shadowing. Relative directivity and spectral efficiency are evaluated versus curvature. Results show that MC mainly reshapes local directivity fluctuations, whereas visibility dominates the global pattern and spectral-efficiency variation under both isotropic scattering and CDL-A channels.

AI.tldr: 研究二维全息曲率可重构孔径（HoloCuRA），建立几何与阻抗联合模型，量化曲率、互耦和可见性对方向性与频谱效率的影响。
AI.motivation: 全息MIMO阵列具备高空间分辨率与灵活波前控制能力，但曲面/共形部署同时引入曲率、互耦（MC）和方向相关可见性，需要厘清各因素的相对作用。
AI.method: 构建基于几何的模型描述阵元位置、指向与空间相关性；采用基于阻抗的耦合矩阵刻画电磁互耦，并用可见性向量表征遮挡效应；在不同曲率下评估相对方向性和频谱效率。
AI.result: 互耦主要重塑局部方向性波动；可见性在全局方向图和频谱效率变化中占主导，在同性散射与CDL-A信道下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 曲率可重构全息孔径设计中，可见性（遮挡）而非互耦是决定全局性能的主导因素，为共形全息MIMO的建模与优化提供依据。

title: PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems
summary: Evaluating recommender systems before deployment requires simulators that remain realistic over long, closed-loop interaction cycles. Current LLM-based agents generally function as surface imitators that generate realistic short-term responses but fail to capture the underlying user dynamics such as fatigue, affect, and shifting preferences. We propose PsyBer-Agent, a psychology-inspired simulator that models these dynamics through its Psy-Engine. This engine represents each user with three evolving, model-defined latent states. To calibrate simulated behavior against real interaction logs, we align log-conditioned reference trajectories with simulator-generated latent-state trajectories via Unbalanced Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. This approach provides structured supervision for a lightweight policy without the computational burden of fine-tuning the backbone LLM. We also introduce WebSim and the PsyBer Benchmark, which encompass multimodal scenarios and seven recommender backbones. Our framework evaluates behavioral fidelity, latent-state consistency, robustness, and responses to social-cue perturbations. On the tested horizons, PsyBer-Agent shows lower behavioral discrepancy than the prompt-only simulators while maintaining stable performance under large-scale concurrent simulation for up to 5M queued simulation tasks under bounded concurrency. Code is available in the supplementary material and at: PsyBer-Agent: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CC66F/, WebSim Platform: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D8EAX/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出受心理学启发的推荐系统模拟器 PsyBer-Agent，通过 Psy-Engine 建模用户潜在动态状态，并用非平衡 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输校准，显著降低行为偏差并支持大规模并发仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的智能体多为表面模仿者，只能生成逼真的短期响应，难以捕捉疲劳、情感、偏好漂移等底层用户动态，导致闭环长期交互下的仿真不够真实，从而影响推荐系统部署前的评估可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 PsyBer-Agent，其核心 Psy-Engine 为每个用户定义三个可演化的潜在状态。为将模拟行为对齐真实交互日志，采用非平衡 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输，将日志条件下的参考轨迹与模拟器生成的潜在状态轨迹对齐，为轻量级策略提供结构化监督，避免微调骨干 LLM 的高计算开销。同时构建 WebSim 平台与 PsyBer Benchmark，涵盖多模态场景与七种推荐骨干。
AI.result: 在测试的时间跨度上，PsyBer-Agent 的行为偏差低于纯提示（prompt-only）模拟器；在有界并发下可稳定支持多达 500 万排队仿真任务的大规模并发模拟。评估维度包括行为保真度、潜在状态一致性、鲁棒性及对社会线索扰动的响应。
AI.conclusion: PsyBer-Agent 通过心理学启发的潜在状态建模与最优传输校准，实现了更真实且可扩展的用户模拟，为推荐系统部署前评估提供了有效工具；代码与平台已公开。

title: How Vision Transformers Represent Position: A Mechanistic Comparison of Absolute and Rotary Positional Encodings
summary: Positional embeddings encode the spatial position of each image patch in a Vision Transformer (ViT), allowing the model to distinguish different spatial arrangements of visual content. However, we know little about how the choice of embedding shapes a vision transformer's internal representation. In this work, we show that Absolute Positional Embeddings (APE) and Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) encode spatial position through different internal mechanisms: APE stores position in explicit features, while RoPE builds it inside attention and rebuilds it when it is withheld. Specifically, in APE models, sparse autoencoders recover causal row- and column-specific features, whereas interventions on RoPE reveal distinct rotary components that separately encode row and column information. Additionally, causal interventions selectively disabling RoPE's row or column rotations show that decodable row and column information can be independently removed and, once rotations are restored, partly reconstructed, in part by axis-specialized attention heads. Both mechanisms are causally important for classification: permuting APE's positional features across patches reduces top-1 accuracy by 24--31 points, and ablating the rotations of RoPE's primary rebuilding head reduces it more than ablating those of any other head. Our findings show that the choice of positional encoding fundamentally changes how spatial information is organized and processed inside Vision Transformers. More broadly, our work demonstrates how mechanistic analysis can reveal how models construct, reconstruct, and maintain structured representations, providing a basis for targeted interventions in vision models.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过机制可解释性分析揭示了ViT中绝对位置嵌入(APE)与旋转位置嵌入(RoPE)编码空间位置的不同内部机制，并验证其因果重要性。
AI.motivation: 位置嵌入对Vision Transformer至关重要，但学界对其如何塑造模型内部表征知之甚少。作者旨在揭示不同位置嵌入方式在模型内部组织与处理空间信息上的机制差异。
AI.method: 采用机制可解释性手段：用稀疏自编码器(SAE)从APE模型中提取特征；对RoPE实施干预以识别其旋转分量；通过因果干预选择性禁用RoPE的行/列旋转，考察行列信息的独立移除与重建(涉及轴向专门化的注意力头)。
AI.result: APE将位置存储在显式特征中，SAE可恢复因果性的行/列专属特征；RoPE在注意力内部构建位置，被抑制时可重建，其旋转分量分别编码行与列信息，且解耦后的行列信息可独立移除并部分重建。因果上，置换APE位置特征使top-1准确率下降24–31个百分点；消融RoPE主要重建头的旋转比其他注意力头影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码的选择从根本上改变了ViT内部空间信息的组织与处理方式。该工作展示了机制分析如何揭示模型构建、重建与维持结构化表征的过程，为视觉模型的靶向干预提供了依据。

title: Maximal Axion Optical Chirality Enabled by Degenerate Quasibound States in the Continuum
summary: Axion quasiparticles introduce magnetoelectric coupling in topological materials, yet their optical signatures are intrinsically weak, severely limiting experimental detection and practical exploitation. Here, we demonstrate maximal optical chirality of axion quasiparticles by coupling them with degenerate quasibound states in the continuum (qBICs). By integrating three-dimensional topological insulators (3DTIs) with achiral photonic crystal slabs (PCSs), we reveal that axion quasiparticles induce an effective Zeeman effect that lifts the degeneracy of achiral qBICs in PCSs, splitting them into two nondegenerate high-Q chiral qBICs with maximally opposite chirality. These result in a more than 10^3- and 200-fold increase in the polarization conversion efficiency and Faraday rotation angle, respectively, compared to the intrinsic chiroptical response of bare 3DTI films. Moreover, circular dichroism and nonreciprocal optical responses are revealed as new key signatures for probing axion quasiparticles in 3DTI-PCS coupled systems. Our results provide a definitive route for observing axion quasiparticles and topological physics, while establishing a promising platform for controlling optical polarization, spin, phase, and nonreciprocal responses.

AI.tldr: 通过将3DTI与无手性光子晶体板耦合，利用轴子准粒子诱导的有效塞曼效应解除qBIC简并，实现最大光学手性，使偏振转换效率和法拉第旋转角分别提升逾10^3倍和200倍。
AI.motivation: 轴子准粒子虽在拓扑材料中引入磁电耦合，但其光学信号本征上非常微弱，严重限制了实验探测与实际应用，亟需增强其光学响应。
AI.method: 将三维拓扑绝缘体（3DTI）与无手性光子晶体板（PCS）集成，利用轴子准粒子诱导的有效塞曼效应解除无手性连续域准束缚态（qBIC）的简并，将其劈裂为两个非简并的高Q手性qBIC。
AI.result: 相比裸3DTI薄膜的本征手性光学响应，偏振转换效率提升超过10^3倍，法拉第旋转角提升200倍；并揭示圆二色性和非互易光学响应可作为探测轴子准粒子的新特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为观测轴子准粒子和拓扑物理提供了明确途径，并建立起调控光学偏振、自旋、相位及非互易响应的平台。

title: HADES: A Programmable Processing-Near-Memory Engine for Binary Similarity Search
summary: Moving operands to a processor can cost more than the arithmetic performed on them, and for small binary similarity and search workloads data movement can dominate. We present HADES, a programmable processing-near-memory engine built around one shared 32x32-bit 2R1W register-file macro that holds both data and program. Twelve 16-bit opcodes, three working registers and a 32-slot program express ten search workloads in 8 to 19 slots, and SCANP and SCANSEL shorten dual-row and selected scans. A post-layout 2x2 Tiny Tapeout implementation closes timing at 40 MHz with 26,968 square microns of standard cells beside a 15,744 square microns macro. All HADES results come from RTL or gate-level simulation of this implementation, and HADES energy is estimated. Against ESP8266 and ESP32 microcontrollers running plain C, and with an ideal host, HADES answers a resident query 10x to 32x and 2.2x to 11x faster, respectively. End to end, it wins at the evaluated batch sizes of B = 16 and B = 256 against both boards and loses the single-query (B = 1) runs to the ESP32. An Arduino Nano runs a restricted subset. Kernel power stays within about 2% of a spin loop on all three boards. These results hold for plain-C baselines under the evaluated conditions. At this scale the control and instruction storage fit around a shared memory macro, while the byte-wide interface and the loading path remain significant costs.

AI.tldr: HADES是一个可编程的存内计算（processing-near-memory）引擎，基于共享的32x32位2R1W寄存器堆宏，同时存储数据与程序，面向小型二进制相似性与搜索负载。
AI.motivation: 将操作数移动到处理器上的开销可能超过对其执行的算术运算，对于小型二进制相似性与搜索负载，数据移动会占主导地位。因此需要一种就近计算架构来减少数据搬运开销。
AI.method: HADES围绕一个共享的32x32位2R1W寄存器堆宏构建，该宏同时保存数据与程序。采用12个16位操作码、3个工作寄存器和32槽程序来表达10个工作负载（占用8到19槽），并通过SCANP和SCANSEL缩短双行扫描与选择扫描。采用后布局的2x2 Tiny Tapeout实现，在40 MHz下收敛时序，标准单元面积26,968平方微米，外加15,744平方微米的宏。所有结果来自该实现的RTL或门级仿真，能耗为估算值。
AI.result: 与运行普通C语言的ESP8266和ESP32微控制器相比，在理想主机条件下，HADES对常驻查询分别快10x到32x和2.2x到11x。端到端在B=16和B=256批次规模下均胜过两块开发板，但在单查询（B=1）运行中输给ESP32。Arduino Nano可运行一个受限子集。三块开发板上内核功耗均保持在自旋循环约2%以内。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果适用于所评估条件下的普通C语言基线。在该规模下，控制与指令存储可围绕共享存储宏放置，而字节宽接口与加载路径仍是显著开销。

title: Sub-Micron Gate $β-Ga_{2}O_{3}$ FinFETs with Current Density $>$ 750 mA/mm and Ion/Ioff Ratio $>$ $10^{9}$
summary: In this work, we demonstrate submicron-gate $β-Ga_{2}O_{3}$ FinFETs that integrate Si delta-doped channels with selectively regrown n++ source/drain contacts. The devices employ 100 nm-wide fins to improve electrostatic control of a high sheet charge density channel of $3.3\times 10^{13}$ cm-2. A 150 nm-gate-length FinFET exhibits a maximum drain current density of 764 mA/mm at VGS = 1 V and VDS = 10 V, an on-resistance of 9.1 $Ω$.mm, and an Ion/Ioff ratio exceeding $10^9$. The device also shows a peak transconductance of 43 mS/mm and de-embedded $f_{T}/f_{MAX}$ values of 6.3/2.0 GHz. Pulsed I-V measurements indicate ~20 % current collapse, attributed primarily to trapping at etched fin sidewalls and the $Al_{2} O_{3}$/ $β-Ga_{2}O_{3}$ interface. These results show that delta-doped $β-Ga_{2}O_{3}$ FinFETs can simultaneously achieve high drive current, strong current modulation, and GHz-frequency operation, providing a scalable device platform for future power and RF electronics.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了集成Si delta掺杂沟道与选择性再生长n++源漏接触的亚微米栅β-Ga₂O₃ FinFET，兼具高驱动电流、强电流调制能力与GHz频率特性，为未来功率与射频电子器件提供可扩展平台。
AI.motivation: β-Ga₂O₃作为超宽禁带半导体在功率与射频应用中潜力巨大，但受限于沟道静电控制与源漏接触质量，难以同时实现高驱动电流、强电流调制和高频操作。本文旨在通过器件结构创新解决这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用100 nm宽鳍结构增强静电控制，运用Si delta掺杂沟道获得3.3×10¹³ cm⁻²的高薄层电荷密度，并结合选择性再生长n++源漏接触降低接触电阻；栅长为150 nm，并对器件进行直流、脉冲I-V及高频（f_T/f_MAX）表征。
AI.result: 最大漏电流密度达764 mA/mm（VGS=1 V、VDS=10 V），导通电阻9.1 Ω·mm，Ion/Ioff比超过10⁹，峰值跨导43 mS/mm，去嵌后f_T/f_MAX为6.3/2.0 GHz；脉冲I-V测得约20%电流崩塌，主要归因于刻蚀鳍侧壁及Al₂O₃/β-Ga₂O₃界面处的陷阱。
AI.conclusion: delta掺杂β-Ga₂O₃ FinFET可同时实现高驱动电流、强电流调制与GHz频率操作，是一种面向未来功率与射频电子学的可扩展器件平台；后续需针对侧壁与界面陷阱抑制电流崩塌以进一步优化性能。

title: UAV SAR Imaging via Diffusion Posterior Sampling under Non-Ideal Motion in ISAC Systems
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle-enabled synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers significant potential for providing communication services to ground users while sensing the surrounding environment in low-altitude integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems. However, its practical deployment is challenged by known non-ULM trajectories and unknown position errors, which violate conventional SAR assumptions and cause severe image defocusing. We address these non-ideal impacts by formulating the ISAC SAR imaging as an exact linear inverse problem to accurately model arbitrary trajectories with multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing waveforms. Based on this formulation, we develop a diffusion posterior sampling (DPS)-based super-resolution SAR framework, where a pre-trained diffusion model provides a data-driven image prior and the exact physical model enforces measurement consistency during posterior inference. The inference process is further accelerated for practical implementation. For unknown position errors, we develop a joint iterative DPS and motion compensation (MoCo) optimization algorithm with discrete cosine transform reparameterization and coarse-to-fine spectral scheduling. Simulations demonstrate that our framework achieves high-accuracy reconstruction across diverse trajectories and remarkable super-resolution, maintaining greater than 21.3 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) even under half physical resolution truncation. Under unknown motion errors, the joint DPS and MoCo algorithm achieves 23.65 dB PSNR with a residual position-error estimation error of 0.19 cm.

AI.tldr: 该文针对无人机ISAC-SAR在非理想轨迹与未知位置误差下的成像散焦问题，将成像建模为精确线性逆问题，提出基于扩散后验采样(DPS)的超分辨SAR框架及联合DPS与运动补偿(MoCo)的迭代算法。
AI.motivation: 无人机SAR在低空ISAC中既可通信又可感知，但实际部署存在两类违背传统SAR假设的非理想因素：非匀速直线(non-ULM)轨迹与未知位置误差，导致严重图像散焦，传统成像方法难以适用。
AI.method: 1) 将ISAC-SAR成像表述为精确线性逆问题，用MIMO-OFDM波形精确建模任意轨迹；2) 基于该模型构建DPS超分辨SAR框架：预训练扩散模型提供数据驱动图像先验，精确物理模型保证后验推断中的测量一致性，并加速推断过程；3) 针对未知位置误差，提出DPS与MoCo联合迭代优化算法，采用DCT重参数化与粗到细频谱调度。
AI.result: 仿真表明，该框架在多种轨迹下实现高精度重建与显著超分辨，在仅半物理分辨率截断时PSNR仍大于21.3 dB；在未知运动误差下，联合DPS-MoCo算法达到23.65 dB PSNR，残余位置误差估计为0.19 cm。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散生成先验与精确物理前向模型结合，可在非理想轨迹与未知运动误差条件下实现稳健、高精度的无人机ISAC-SAR超分辨成像，同时完成位置误差估计与补偿，验证了该建模范式的有效性。

title: Loose Lips: Understanding Privacy Leakage in Agentic Dialogue
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes enterprise settings, understanding how they handle sensitive information in agentic dialogue has become critical. Privacy leakage in such settings requires reasoning about whether information flows respect the contextual norms under which they originated. We extend CIMemories to CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE, a benchmark of 4,410 two-agent dialogue instances grounded in Contextual Integrity theory. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate 7 open-weight models from the Qwen3 and Llama 3.1 families across conversation lengths of 1 and 6 turns under three prompting conditions. We find that task capability and privacy leakage are fundamentally coupled: more capable models are systematically leakier, with no model in our evaluation able to decouple the two. Thinking models consistently leak more than their non-thinking counterparts, a pattern we attribute to the extended reasoning surface created by chain-of-thought. Leakage compounds with conversation length, rising up to 3x from 1 to 6 turns. Our results suggest that the coupling between task capability and privacy leakage is not an artifact of misconfiguration but a structural feature of current agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE 基准（4,410 条双智能体对话），基于情境完整性理论系统评估 7 个开源模型的隐私泄露行为，发现任务能力与隐私泄露结构性耦合：能力越强的模型泄露越多，思维模型比非思维模型泄露更多，且泄露随对话轮数增加最多上升 3 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益部署于高风险企业场景，其在对话中如何处理敏感信息成为关键问题。此类场景下的隐私泄露判定需要判断信息流动是否符合其产生时的语境规范，即情境完整性。现有基准多针对单轮或非对话设置，缺乏对智能体对话中隐私泄露的系统评测。
AI.method: 将 CIMemories 扩展为 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE，构建包含 4,410 条双智能体对话实例的基准，以情境完整性理论为理论基础。在此基准上系统评测 Qwen3 与 Llama 3.1 系列的 7 个开放权重模型，控制对话长度为 1 轮与 6 轮，并设置三种提示条件。
AI.result: 任务能力与隐私泄露存在根本性耦合：能力越强的模型系统性泄露越多，评测中无任何模型能解耦二者。思维（推理）模型一致地比其非思维对应版本泄露更多，作者将其归因于思维链带来的扩展推理面。泄露随对话长度累积，从 1 轮增加到 6 轮时最高上升约 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务能力与隐私泄露之间的耦合并非配置失误的产物，而是当前智能体系统的结构性特征。这一发现对高风险企业场景中 LLM 智能体的部署与隐私防护设计具有重要警示意义。

title: SharedSAE: a unified sparse dictionary across u-net blocks and denoising time for diffusion models
summary: Concept representations in diffusion models drift across network depth and denoising time, yet existing sparse autoencoders offer only per-block or per-timestep dictionaries, leaving no single feature dictionary for localization and intervention in the network. We present Shared Sparse Autoencoder (SharedSAE), which learns one sparse dictionary shared across four U-Net attention blocks and all 50 denoising steps of SDXL 1.0. A block-specific low-rank input adapter aligns the residual distribution of each block before the shared encoder, and a temporal conditioning module with a shared timestep branch and a block-timestep correction branch absorbs temporal non-stationarity. Despite spanning both axes, Shared SAE preserves a coherent dictionary structure. Built on the shared dictionary, localized feature suppression reduces the number of NudeNet-positive generations in the I2P detector-positive subset from 139 to 1. Tracing sparse features across the trajectory further reveals that concept representations are redistributed across U-Net blocks during generation, shifting from the earliest downsampling block toward intermediate and later blocks as denoising proceeds. SharedSAE thus provides a unified, interpretable, and intervention-ready representation space for diffusion models, enabling concept analysis and erasure at any covered block and denoising step.

AI.tldr: 提出SharedSAE，在SDXL的四个U-Net注意力块和全部50个去噪步上共享单一稀疏字典，并借助块特定低秩适配器与时序条件模块，实现在任意块与步上的概念定位与抑制。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的概念表征会随网络深度和去噪时间漂移，但现有稀疏自编码器只提供逐块或逐时间步的字典，缺乏可用于网络内定位与干预的单一特征字典。
AI.method: 学习一个跨SDXL 1.0四个U-Net注意力块与50个去噪步共享的稀疏字典；在共享编码器前使用块特定低秩输入适配器对齐各块残差分布；引入时序条件模块（共享时间步分支+块-时间步校正分支）以吸收时间非平稳性。
AI.result: 共享字典在跨两轴条件下仍保持结构一致性；局部特征抑制将I2P检测器阳性子集中NudeNet阳性生成数从139降至1；跨轨迹追踪显示概念表征在生成中于U-Net块间重新分配，随去噪推进由最早下采样块转向中间及更晚块。
AI.conclusion: SharedSAE为扩散模型提供统一、可解释且可干预的表征空间，支持在覆盖的任意块与去噪步进行概念分析与擦除。

title: Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence
comment: Preprint, under review. 63 pages. Code and data at https://github.com/jorallo/ctest-one
summary: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个以LLM作为表示机器的Levin Kt测试，用可计算复杂度度量反问题难度，构建可生成与认证的题项流水线，实现以比特为单位的比率尺度难度校准。
AI.motivation: AI发展加速使以人类或当前AI系统校准难度的基准很快循环化或饱和，无法评估可能超越现有机器与出题者的系统，因此需要难度不依赖解题者、由问题内在机制复杂度决定的评估范式。
AI.method: 以Levin的Kt（Kolmogorov复杂度的可计算变体）为理论基础，将LLM视为通用图灵机，prompt即自然语言程序，从而把先前基于极简UTM的C-test扩展为以LLM为表示机器的测试；形式化该度量，设计轻量级生成与认证流水线，并分析参考机器能力与考官—考生差距的影响。
AI.result: 生成了首批经认证的题项并施测于12个LLM；得到的智能体特征曲线随难度上升而下降，并延伸到此前未探索的高难度区域，即"超智能窗口"——这些题项可被认证，却超出数代前沿智能的解决能力。
AI.conclusion: 用LLM作为表示机器的Levin Kt测试可在解题者能力之外预先标定难度，为评估可能超越当前AI与人类出题者的机器提供了可持续、非饱和的评估路径。

title: MDN-VJEPA: Multimodal Probabilistic Joint-Embedding World Models
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting future representations rather than reconstructing observations. Variational JEPA (VJEPA) gives this prediction probabilistic semantics and permits flexible conditional predictive families. We propose MDN-VJEPA, a multimodal probabilistic JEPA that instantiates the latent predictor as a mixture density network (MDN), representing future states with a Gaussian mixture whose components encode alternative futures, their probabilities, and within-mode uncertainty. For sequential prediction, we address two additional structural requirements: multi-modal futures should remain temporally coherent across a trajectory, and predictive beliefs should remain consistent when propagated to the same horizon through different temporal path compositions, as motivated by the Chapman--Kolmogorov equation. Together, these considerations define a three-level hierarchy of multimodal prediction, coherent multimodal trajectories, and compositionally consistent multimodal dynamics. Controlled experiments show that MDN-VJEPA closely recovers known branching predictive laws, that retaining the complete multimodal belief rather than its conditional mean can lead to materially different and substantially better planning decisions under branching futures, and that trajectory-level coupling and distributional consistency improve temporal coherence and multi-horizon agreement. These results support a simple principle: a probabilistic JEPA should preserve not only how uncertain the future is, but which distinct futures constitute that uncertainty, how they form coherent trajectories, and how those beliefs compose through time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MDN-VJEPA，将多模态概率JEPA的隐预测器实例化为混合密度网络，用高斯混合表示分支未来，并构建"多模态预测—连贯多模态轨迹—组合一致多模态动力学"三层结构。
AI.motivation: JEPA通过预测未来表征（而非重构观测）学习世界模型，VJEPA进一步赋予其概率语义并允许灵活的条件预测族。但现有方法未刻画不确定性由哪些不同未来构成、这些未来如何形成时间上连贯的轨迹，以及信念在不同时间路径组合下是否保持一致。
AI.method: 将隐预测器实例化为混合密度网络（MDN），以高斯混合表示未来状态，混合分量编码备选未来、其概率及模态内不确定性。针对序列预测，引入两项结构约束：轨迹级耦合以保证多模态未来在时间上的连贯性；基于Chapman–Kolmogorov方程的分步性，保证经不同时间路径组成传播到同一视界时预测信念一致。由此形成三层多模态预测层级。
AI.result: 受控实验显示：MDN-VJEPA能较好恢复已知的分支预测规律；在分支未来下，保留完整多模态信念而非仅用条件均值，可带来实质性不同且更优的规划决策；轨迹级耦合与分布一致性提升了时间连贯性和多视界一致性。
AI.conclusion: 概率JEPA不仅应保留未来的不确定性程度，还应保留构成该不确定性的不同未来、它们如何形成连贯轨迹，以及这些信念如何随时间组合。

title: Near-focus intensity evolution of spatiotemporal optical vortex pulses and consequences for their nonlinear upconversion
summary: Spatiotemporal optical vortex (STOV) laser pulses are attracting attention for their puzzling transverse orbital angular momentum (OAM) and propagation properties, which could determine their future applications. While the characteristic reshaping of their space-time envelope upon diffraction from the focal plane to the far-field is now well-established, the evolution of their intensity as they propagate has not been studied quantitatively, despite growing interest for their use in nonlinear optics and strong-field physics. Here, we explore experimentally and analytically the focusing dynamics of STOVs produced by a pulse shaper, and evidence a substantial longitudinal shift between the coordinate at which a circularly-symmetric STOV forms and that at which the pulse reaches its peak intensity. To illustrate some practical consequences for applications, we experimentally demonstrate how the yield of second-harmonic generation can consequently be maximized several Rayleigh lengths beyond the plane where the circular STOV really occurs. These results signal careful characterization of spatiotemporal pulses as a requisite for nonlinear optical experiments, and pave the way for finer control of complex laser drivers for light-matter interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文实验与解析研究了脉冲整形器产生的时空光涡旋（STOV）的聚焦动力学，发现圆形对称 STOV 形成位置与脉冲峰值强度位置之间存在显著纵向偏移，并将此效应用于优化二次谐波产生。
AI.motivation: STOV 具有特殊的横向轨道角动量与传播特性，其在非线性光学与强场物理中应用前景广阔，但其强度随传播的演化尚未被定量研究，这一空白限制了对其实际应用潜力的判断。
AI.method: 结合实验测量与解析分析，研究由脉冲整形器产生的 STOV 的聚焦动力学，对比圆形对称 STOV 形成坐标与脉冲峰值强度坐标，并通过二次谐波产生实验验证其应用后果。
AI.result: 发现圆形对称 STOV 形成位置与脉冲峰值强度位置之间存在显著纵向位移；实验表明，在圆形 STOV 实际出现的平面之外数个瑞利长度处，二次谐波产生产率可被最大化。
AI.conclusion: 对时空脉冲进行细致表征是非线性光学实验的必要前提，该研究为更精细地调控光与物质相互作用的复杂激光驱动源开辟了道路。

title: "Is Low Power Enough?" Rethinking Energy Efficiency in High-Fidelity Sensing
summary: For two decades, long-lived sensor nodes have been built from the lowest-power parts, because their scalar readings take only milliseconds to acquire and send. Scientists now want higher fidelity data from the field, such as images and audio, and these observations break that rule: a low-power microcontroller stays awake for seconds to read, store, and transmit each one, so low power is no longer low energy. We argue that long-lived, high-fidelity nodes should instead be built around a more capable microcontroller, provided the whole board sleeps deeply. We revisit two principles from early sensor networks, "race to sleep" and "talk less", for high-fidelity data and on-device AI, and test them by comparing the STM32N6, which pairs a fast core with a neural accelerator, against the low-power Apollo4 Plus. Although the STM32N6 draws 1.9x more power, it completes an observation (capture, storage, on-board detection, and a LoRa transmission) 9.9x faster and so uses 5.2x less energy. On the same model, it runs inference with 3.2-11.4x less energy, and it fits models over 23 points more accurate. A high-fidelity node lives longest when it finishes quickly, sleeps deeply, and sends only what matters.

AI.tldr: 高保真感知节点应采用更强算力MCU+深度睡眠，而非一味追求低功耗器件，因为"快速完成-深度睡眠"才是长续航关键。
AI.motivation: 过去二十年传感器节点基于最低功耗器件构建，因标量读数仅需毫秒级采集与发送。但科学界现在要求图像、音频等高保真数据，低功耗MCU需持续唤醒数秒来完成读取、存储与传输，"低功耗"不再等于"低能耗"，故需重新审视节点架构原则。
AI.method: 重访早期传感网络的"race to sleep（快速睡眠）"与"talk less（少说话）"两原则，针对高保真数据与端侧AI进行验证。对比STM32N6（高速内核+神经加速器）与低功耗Apollo4 Plus，测量完成一次完整观测（采集、存储、板载检测、LoRa传输）的功耗、时间与能耗，并比较同模型推理能耗及可承载模型精度。
AI.result: STM32N6功耗为Apollo4 Plus的1.9倍，但完成一次观测快9.9倍，因而能耗降低5.2倍；同一模型推理能耗低3.2–11.4倍；可部署的模型精度高出23个点以上。
AI.conclusion: 高保真节点寿命最长化的路径是：快速完成任务、深度睡眠、只发送关键数据，即应围绕更强算力MCU构建而非最低功耗器件。

title: Directivity Estimates and Tolerance Tradeoffs in the Presence of Random Perturbations
summary: The practicality of realizing high-directivity sources is studied using a generalized sensitivity metrics. These measures are based on the error model adopted in previous studies on array tolerance, but account for heterogeneous array characteristics in an arbitrary source-expansion basis, making it applicable to the study of continuous sources, ideal uncoupled arrays, and heterogeneous arrays with mutual coupling. The formulation provides the ensemble average of realized directivity under the selected error model, making it a fast predictor of anticipated directivity reduction due to source perturbation. The data required to compute these predictions are straightforward to obtain via simulation or measurement, with a significant simplification when the system can be approximated as lossless. The directivity and the proposed tolerance measures allow for the formulation of optimization problems illustrating the tradeoff between these measures. Several examples demonstrate these tradeoffs, special cases, comparison to previous estimates of maximum directivity, and the accuracy of sensitivity as a predictor of statistical performance over large ensembles of design realizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于广义灵敏度指标的方法，用于评估高指向性源在误差模型下的可实现性，可预测阵列或连续源的统计指向性下降，并给出优化折衷。
AI.motivation: 传统阵列容差研究中的误差模型和灵敏度指标多针对均匀阵列，难以适用于连续源、理想非耦合阵列以及含互耦的异构阵列。需要一种可处理异构阵列特性、并能快速预测源扰动导致的指向性下降的广义灵敏度度量。
AI.method: 在任意源展开基下建立广义灵敏度指标，该指标基于既有阵列容差误差模型但可容纳异构阵列特性；推导所选误差模型下可实现指向性的集合平均，从而快速预测扰动引起的指向性退化；所需数据可通过仿真或测量获得，系统可近似为无损时显著简化；结合指向性与容差度量构造优化问题以刻画二者折衷。
AI.result: 示例验证了指向性与容差度量之间的折衷关系、若干特殊情形、与既有最大指向性估计的比较，以及灵敏度作为大规模设计实现集合上统计性能预测器的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 广义灵敏度指标为连续源、理想非耦合阵列及异构耦合阵列的高指向性实现提供了统一且快速的统计预测工具，并可支持指向性与容差的优化设计。

title: Performance Evaluation of Mobile Target Sensing and Tracking Across Multiple Sensing Modes
summary: Moving extended-target sensing and tracking are studied in a beamformed PRS/OFDM ISAC framework. The target is modeled as a rigid cluster of scatterers whose Tx--target--Rx echoes coherently combine in a MIMO scattering channel. Delay, azimuth/elevation, and Doppler are estimated using PRS matched filtering with delay centroiding, single-cluster 2D-MUSIC, and FFT-based Doppler estimation, then used for independent localization and EKF-based tracking. The framework is evaluated in monostatic and bistatic modes under target-directed, receiver-directed, and omnidirectional beamforming. Simulation results show that EKF tracking reduces the aggregate 3D RMSE from 1.61 m to 1.38 m relative to independent localization. Target-directed beamforming substantially improves tracking accuracy, achieving 1.38 m RMSE compared with 5.91 m and 8.38 m for omnidirectional and receiver-directed beamforming, respectively. The results highlight the importance of target-aware beam management, delay-angle-Doppler fusion, and sensing geometry for mobile-target tracking in ISAC networks.

AI.tldr: 在波束赋形PRS/OFDM ISAC框架下研究扩展目标感知与跟踪，采用匹配滤波时延质心、单簇2D-MUSIC与FFT多普勒估计，并结合EKF跟踪，评估单/双静态及不同波束赋形策略。
AI.motivation: 面向ISAC网络中移动扩展目标的感知与跟踪需求，探究波束管理、时延-角度-多普勒融合及感知几何对跟踪精度的影响。
AI.method: 将目标建模为刚性散射体簇，在MIMO散射信道中相干合成Tx-目标-Rx回波；通过PRS匹配滤波时延质心、单簇2D-MUSIC、FFT多普勒估计获得时延/方位/俯仰/多普勒，进而独立定位与EKF跟踪；在单静态与双静态、目标指向/接收指向/全向波束赋形下仿真评估。
AI.result: EKF跟踪将聚合3D RMSE从独立定位的1.61 m降至1.38 m；目标指向波束赋形实现1.38 m RMSE，显著优于全向（5.91 m）和接收指向（8.38 m）。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显目标感知波束管理、时延-角度-多普勒融合以及感知几何对ISAC网络移动目标跟踪的重要性。

title: Is the Future Predictable? Modeling Future Predictability for Reliable Temporal Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable when reasoning about the future. Existing models often overlook the difference among future states, committing to specific answers even when the queried facts are inherently volatile. To capture this challenge, we introduce ChronoRegime, a future-oriented temporal reasoning task that requires models to determine whether historical temporal evidence justifies commitment to a future answer. Furthermore, we propose Confidence-Aware Temporal Reasoning (CTR), a framework that estimates future predictability from temporal dynamics and regulates answer commitment accordingly. Rather than performing unconditional forecasting, CTR commits only when the reconstructed evidence supports the target future state. Across multiple LLMs, CTR improves strict overall accuracy by 6.7 percentage points and reduces hallucination rates by 18.4 percentage points on average over the plain QA baseline. These results demonstrate that explicit predictability assessment is an effective mechanism for safer and more reliable temporal reasoning under future uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向未来的时间推理任务 ChronoRegime 与 CTR 框架，通过预测未来可预测性来调控回答承诺，显著提升准确率并降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在涉及未来的推理中并不可靠，常忽视未来状态的差异，即使所查询事实本身具有波动性也会给出确定答案，缺乏对不确定性的辨识与承诺控制。
AI.method: 提出 ChronoRegime 任务，要求模型判断历史时间证据是否足以支撑对某一未来答案的承诺；并提出 Confidence-Aware Temporal Reasoning (CTR) 框架，从时间动态中估计未来可预测性，并据此调节答案承诺，仅在重建证据支持目标未来状态时才作答，而非无条件预测。
AI.result: 在多种大语言模型上，CTR 相比纯问答基线将严格总体准确率平均提升 6.7 个百分点，并将幻觉率平均降低 18.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式的可预测性评估是未来不确定性下实现更安全、更可靠时间推理的有效机制。

title: Pristine Models
summary: Training on broad, unfiltered data enables high-quality image generation, but can also teach models concepts that should not be generated; restricting the training data ensures safety, but reduces quality because examples containing unsafe concepts also provide useful knowledge that is not itself unsafe. Existing approaches largely address this trade-off post hoc through concept unlearning, which can lead to catastrophic forgetting as the number of concepts to remove grows. We instead ask whether unsafe concept knowledge can be compartmentalized during pretraining so that access to it can be disabled at inference. We introduce Pristine Models, a novel text-to-image generation architecture with an attention mechanism that encourages the separation of safe and unsafe knowledge into independently parameterized branches. The branch-specific parameters are learned during training, while the unsafe branch can be detached at inference. On ImageNet, Pristine Models enable safer generation while retaining much of the utility of full-data pretraining, achieving higher image quality and better text alignment than training only on safe data or applying post-hoc concept removal. We further scale our approach to CC12M, demonstrating that it remains effective in a substantially larger and more diverse open-world pretraining setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pristine Models：一种在预训练阶段将不安全概念知识隔离到独立参数分支的文本到图像生成架构，推理时可断开不安全分支，从而在保证安全生成的同时保留全量数据预训练的效用。
AI.motivation: 训练数据的广度与安全性存在权衡：广泛未过滤数据提升生成质量但会引入不应生成的概念；仅用安全数据训练虽安全却损失质量，因为含不安全概念的样本本身也提供非不安全的有用知识。现有方法多采用事后概念遗忘，随移除概念增多易导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出 Pristine Models，一种新的文本到图像生成架构，采用注意力机制鼓励将安全与不安全知识分离到独立参数化的分支中；分支专属参数在训练中学习，推理时可断开不安全分支。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上，Pristine Models 实现更安全的生成，同时保留全量数据预训练的大部分效用，图像质量和文本对齐均优于仅用安全数据训练或事后概念移除方法；进一步扩展到 CC12M，证其在更大规模、更多样的开放世界预训练场景中依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过在预训练阶段对不安全概念知识进行参数隔离，可在推理时禁用其访问，从而缓解安全性与生成质量之间的权衡，且优于事后概念遗忘方法，具备向大规模开放世界预训练扩展的潜力。

title: The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science
summary: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文主张对数据科学智能体（agentic DS）的评估不应局限于预测性能与代码正确性，而应从失败模式、可控测试套件与专家对比三个角度进行方法学与领域知识的评估；结果显示大多数智能体方案至少存在一种失败模式，且数据泄漏与预测性能正相关。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型降低了写代码门槛，催生了可自动完成数据科学任务的数据科学智能体。现有评估只关注下游预测性能和代码正确性，忽视了数据科学的核心原则——方法学与领域知识，从而掩盖了数据泄漏、验证不当等方法学失败，阻碍了稳健智能体系统的开发。
AI.method: 从三个角度评估：1）在220个数据科学任务上对常见agentic DS框架与模型进行大规模失败模式分析；2）构建可复用、可扩展的测试套件，用经过筛选的任务以受控方式检测六类特定失败；3）在Kaggle竞赛上，将agentic DS流程与专家方案进行定性对比。
AI.result: 无论智能体框架或模型能力如何复杂，大多数智能体方案都至少包含一种失败模式；数据泄漏失败的发生与预测性能呈正相关，印证了仅以准确率评估的不足；定性分析显示，与竞赛获胜的数据科学家相比，数据科学智能体普遍缺乏问题求解创造力和领域知识。
AI.conclusion: 原则化的失败模式分析应成为agentic DS评估的固有组成部分，本文揭示的洞见对于构建可信赖的智能体数据科学流程至关重要。

title: LACRM: LLM-Guided Mining of Directed Advertiser Competition Relationships in E-Commerce Advertising
summary: In e-commerce advertising, ad platforms typically fail to model the externalities among advertisers when making optimization decisions: an advertiser's actual performance is largely shaped by rivals competing for the same users; these rivals typically operate in overlapping product categories and at comparable budget scales. However, capturing this rivalry as an explicit, reusable signal is challenging because it is directed, multi-faceted, and partially observable. Existing paradigms such as interaction graphs, taxonomy rules, and single-embedding models do not fully capture these properties. In this paper, we propose LACRM (LLM-driven Advertiser Competition Relationship Mining), a novel framework that constructs directed competition graphs with continuous edge intensities via a three-stage pipeline. LACRM moves beyond symmetric similarity through LLM-driven role-separated profiling, which enables asymmetric multi-route retrieval to uncover both realized and latent rivals. The framework further incorporates listwise learning-to-rank aligned with temporal auction behavior to accurately model directed competition intensity. In offline retrieval experiments on an industrial benchmark, LACRM outperforms strong directed GNN baselines and ablation variants. Multi-LLM and human studies provide complementary evidence that the recovered latent rivals reflect meaningful market competition rather than merely model-generated artifacts. In production A/B tests, LACRM-guided bidding and incentive allocation increase advertising revenue by 1.73% and 1.14%, respectively. The results demonstrate the practical value of explicit competition modeling in large-scale advertising systems.

AI.tldr: 提出LACRM框架，利用LLM驱动的角色分离画像与多路径检索构建有向竞争图，并结合listwise排序学习刻画竞争强度，在工业基准与线上A/B测试中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 电商广告平台在优化决策时通常忽略广告主之间的外部性：广告主的实际表现很大程度上取决于争夺同一批用户的竞争对手，而这些对手往往处于重叠的商品类目、预算规模相当。此类竞争关系具有有向性、多面性和部分可观测性，现有交互图、分类法规则和单一嵌入模型均难以完整刻画，因此需要一种能显式、可复用建模竞争关系的方法。
AI.method: LACRM采用三阶段流水线构建带连续边强度的有向竞争图：(1) LLM驱动的角色分离画像，突破对称相似性假设；(2) 非对称多路径检索，同时挖掘已实现竞争对手与潜在竞争对手；(3) 结合时序竞价行为的listwise learning-to-rank，精确建模有向竞争强度。
AI.result: 在工业基准的离线检索实验中，LACRM优于强有向GNN基线及多个消融变体；多LLM与人工评测表明挖掘出的潜在竞争对手反映真实市场竞争而非模型生成伪影；线上A/B测试中，LACRM引导的竞价与激励分配分别带来1.73%和1.14%的广告收入提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在大规模广告系统中显式建模广告主竞争关系具有切实的实践价值，LACRM为竞争关系挖掘提供了可复用、可落地的建模范式。

title: Selective spatiotemporal mode-locking in multimode Mamyshev oscillators
summary: Spatiotemporal mode-locking (STML) in multimode fibers introduces spatial degrees of freedom for ultrashort pulse generation, yet flexible manipulation of transverse mode compositions within multimode solitons remains challenging. Here, we propose a spectrum-to-mode mapping strategy in multimode Mamyshev oscillators (MOs) to selectively synchronize specific transverse modes through synergistic cross-phase modulation and offset spectral filtering. Meanwhile, four-wave mixing acts to stabilize intermodal phase relationships, facilitating selective STML characterized by diverse mode compositions with matched group velocities. Spatiotemporal solitons containing the pure LP01 mode, degenerate LP11 modes, or LP02+LP21 composite modes are selectively realized and mapped across the parameter space spanned by intracavity gain and filter detuning. Furthermore, intracavity collisions between coexisting mode groups with disparate group velocities are demonstrated to enable dynamic mode selection. Beyond the simulation of six modes in graded-index multimode fibers, selective STML is also demonstrated in MOs based on step-index multimode fibers and fibers supporting more transverse modes, confirming the generality of our approach. This strategy offers a versatile and robust pathway for transverse mode regulation and provides new insights into full dimensional structured light manipulation in multimode ultrafast fiber lasers.

AI.tldr: 提出多模Mamyshev振荡器中的光谱-模式映射策略，通过交叉相位调制与偏移光谱滤波的协同作用选择性地同步特定横模，实现可调控的时空锁模。
AI.motivation: 多模光纤中的时空锁模（STML）为超短脉冲产生引入了空间自由度，但多模孤子内部横模组成难以灵活操控，亟需一种能够选择性调控横模的策略。
AI.method: 在多模Mamyshev振荡器（MO）中提出光谱到模式的映射策略：利用交叉相位调制与偏移光谱滤波的协同作用选择性同步特定横模；借助四波混频稳定模间相位关系，实现群速度匹配的模式选择性STML。通过腔内增益与滤波失谐构成的参数空间进行模式映射，并研究不同群速度模式组间的腔内碰撞。
AI.result: 选择性实现了包含纯LP01模、简并LP11模以及LP02+LP21复合模的时空孤子，并在增益-滤波失谐参数空间中完成映射；演示了不同群速度共存模式组间的腔内碰撞可用于动态模式选择。
AI.conclusion: 在渐变折射率多模光纤六模仿真之外，该策略在基于阶跃折射率多模光纤及支持更多横模的光纤MO中同样有效，验证了方法的通用性，为多模超快光纤激光器中的横模调控与全维度结构光操控提供了灵活稳健的途径。

title: GaborFlow: Hardware-Software Co-Optimization of Gabor Filter Accelerator Design
summary: Brain tumor classification from MRI scans represents a critical challenge in medical imaging, where accuracy directly impacts patient outcomes. This paper introduces GaborFlow, a novel hardware-software co-optimization framework that revolutionizes the design of the Gabor Filter accelerator for generating feature maps to enhance brain tumor detection. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on fixed filter parameters, our method employs trainable Gabor coefficients within a carefully optimized range, integrated with an EfficientNet-B0 backbone CNN architecture. The innovation lies in the synergistic combination of software optimization through Bayesian hyperparameter tuning and hardware efficiency through precision-optimized multipliers. Our GF baseline accelerator achieves remarkable results, with 98.6% classification accuracy, 28.08% power benefits, and 48.83% footprint savings compared to state-of-the-art implementations, demonstrating that medical AI can be both highly accurate and energy-efficient. The hardware design files are made freely available for easy adoption and further usage by the researchers and designers.

AI.tldr: 提出GaborFlow软硬件协同优化框架，用于Gabor滤波器加速器设计以增强脑肿瘤MRI分类，实现高精度与低功耗、小面积。
AI.motivation: MRI脑肿瘤分类对患者诊疗结果至关重要，但传统Gabor滤波器方案采用固定滤波参数，限制了特征表达能力，且难以兼顾精度与能效。
AI.method: 在优化范围内使用可训练Gabor系数，与EfficientNet-B0骨干CNN结合；软件端采用贝叶斯超参数调优，硬件端采用精度优化乘法器，形成软硬件协同优化。
AI.result: GF基线加速器达到98.6%分类准确率，相比最先进实现节省28.08%功耗与48.83%面积。
AI.conclusion: 表明医学AI可同时实现高精度与高能效，且硬件设计文件公开以供研究人员和设计者采用与进一步使用。

title: Acoustic Scattered Field Calculation for a Moving Source Using Time-Dependent Physical Optics
summary: We present a time-dependent physical optics (TDPO) formulation for computing the acoustic scattered field of a stationary object in response to a moving source in three-dimensional space. Due to the motion of the source, which may be fast, the conventional frequency-domain PO method is not employed. Instead, a time-domain variant that explicitly accounts for the motion is formulated. The study focuses on the near-field regime, where source motion induces a complex wave field beyond a simple Doppler effect. The proposed algorithm accommodates arbitrary source trajectories and arbitrary signal bandwidth, as well as high source velocities relative to the speed of sound. Near and beyond the shadow boundary, where PO is least accurate, the formulation is supplemented by a Fock correction of the surface field, extended here to a moving source with a harmonic signal. The method matches or exceeds the accuracy of finite element simulations at a computational cost lower by orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 提出时域物理光学(TDPO)方法，计算三维空间中运动源照射静止目标的声散射场，并引入Fock修正，精度可比或优于有限元，计算量低数个量级。
AI.motivation: 传统频域物理光学(PO)方法难以处理快速运动源引起的时变散射问题；且源运动在近场会激发超出简单多普勒效应的复杂波场，需要显式计入运动的时域建模。
AI.method: 建立时域物理光学(TDPO)公式，显式考虑源运动，支持任意源轨迹、任意信号带宽及高声速比的源速度；针对阴影边界附近PO精度最差的区域，将Fock表场修正推广至运动源谐波信号情形。
AI.result: 该方法在精度上达到或超过有限元仿真，而计算成本低数个量级。
AI.conclusion: TDPO结合Fock修正可高效准确地求解运动源下静止目标的近场声散射，适用于任意轨迹、宽带与大马赫数情形，是频域PO的有效替代。

title: Efficient Multimodal Beam Prediction for Real-World 6G UAV Communications via Image-Position-Synthetic Fusion
summary: Camera-based beam selection can reduce the need for exhaustive channel measurement in highly mobile millimeter-wave UAV links, but the complementary value of visual and position-derived representations and their behavior under modality degradation require further investigation. This paper develops a staged multimodal framework for current-beam prediction using real-world UAV measurements. The proposed 32-beam classifier combines an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B3 visual encoder with two deterministic position-derived representations: an explicit Geometric-Kinematic vector and a nonlinear synthetic feature basis constructed from position. The image and synthetic representations are fused first, followed by late fusion with the geometry representation. Experiments on DeepSense 6G Scenario 23 show that Image-Synthetic fusion achieves 86.92% Top-1, 99.03% Top-3, and 99.56% Top-5 accuracy, improving Top-1 performance by 2.64 percentage points over image-only inference and outperforming the 60.71% Top-1 accuracy of synthetic-only inference. Adding the Geometric-Kinematic branch yields the highest measured performance, reaching 87.14% Top-1, 99.12% Top-3, and 99.60% Top-5 accuracy. Controlled input interventions further demonstrate complementary behavior under visual degradation and strong sensitivity to severe synthetic-input corruption. Position-derived nonlinear features provide complementary information to visual context and improve current-beam prediction in the evaluated real-world UAV setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分阶段多模态框架，利用图像、位置派生的几何-运动学向量与非线性合成特征进行无人机毫米波链路当前波束预测，在 DeepSense 6G Scenario 23 上取得 87.14% Top-1 精度。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的波束选择可减少高机动毫米波无人机链路中穷举信道测量的需求，但视觉与位置派生表示的互补价值及其在模态退化下的行为尚待研究。
AI.method: 构建 32 波束分类器：视觉分支采用 ImageNet 预训练的 EfficientNet-B3，位置派生分支包含显式 Geometric-Kinematic 向量和由位置构造的非线性合成特征基。先融合图像与合成表示，再与几何表示进行晚期融合。基于真实无人机测量数据在 DeepSense 6G Scenario 23 上评估，并进行受控输入干预实验。
AI.result: Image-Synthetic 融合达 86.92% Top-1、99.03% Top-3、99.56% Top-5，较仅图像提升 2.64 个百分点，优于仅合成特征的 60.71% Top-1。加入 Geometric-Kinematic 分支后性能最高，达 87.14% Top-1、99.12% Top-3、99.60% Top-5。受控干预显示视觉退化下具互补性，而严重合成输入损坏时敏感度高。
AI.conclusion: 位置派生非线性特征可为视觉上下文提供互补信息，在所评估的真实无人机场景中提升当前波束预测性能。

title: Fin_Agent at FinEval 2026: Task-Aware Methods for Multilingual Financial NLP
comment: 5 pages, 1 Figure, FinEval 2026: Multilingual Financial Language Understanding, Co-located with EMNLP WORKSHOP, OCT 28 2026, BUDAPEST, HUNGARY
summary: We present Fin_Agent, our submission to the FinEval 2026 shared task on multilingual fi nancial language understanding. Our sys tems address Greek financial named-entity recognition, Japanese implicit communication recognition, and multilingual financial ques tion answering. For Greek NER, we com bine annotation-aware numeric rules with zero shot Qwen2.5-32B classification, achieving 0.9521 public F1 and 0.8884 private F1. For Japanese implicit communication, an inter pretable cue-based ordinal scorer achieves 98.0% test accuracy. For multilingual financial QA, BGE-M3retrieval with Qwen3-32B gen eration achieves 0.3023 and 0.3419 ROUGE-1 F1 on the public and private splits. Key limita tions include dataset-specific rules, handcrafted cues, and limited supervision. Implementa tion code is available https://github.com/ Rashidnira/finagent-fineval-2026.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了 Fin_Agent 系统，参与 FinEval 2026 多语言金融语言理解共享任务，涵盖希腊语金融命名实体识别、日语隐性沟通识别与多语言金融问答三个子任务，均取得可报告的性能指标。
AI.motivation: 面向 FinEval 2026 共享任务，需解决多语言金融场景下的语言理解问题，包括希腊语 NER、日语隐性沟通识别以及多语言金融问答，这些任务缺乏统一且高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 希腊语 NER 采用标注感知的数值规则结合零样本 Qwen2.5-32B 分类；日语隐性沟通识别采用可解释的基于线索的序数评分器；多语言金融 QA 采用 BGE-M3 检索配合 Qwen3-32B 生成。
AI.result: 希腊语 NER 取得公开集 F1 0.9521、私有集 F1 0.8884；日语隐性沟通识别测试准确率 98.0%；多语言金融 QA 公开集与私有集 ROUGE-1 F1 分别为 0.3023 和 0.3419。
AI.conclusion: 系统在三个子任务上均取得较好表现，但存在依赖数据集特定规则、手工线索以及监督数据有限等局限性，代码已开源。

title: Human Pose Estimation by Probabilistic Mixtures of Gaussian and Uniform Distributions
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/santiago-git19/probabilistic-pose-gmm
summary: Despite advancements in sub-pixel decoding, modern Human Pose Estimation (HPE) architectures remain constrained by deterministic coordinate extraction from discrete heatmaps, which systematically fails under dense occlusions and Out-of-Distribution (OoD) ambiguities. To address these limitations, we propose a post-hoc continuous probabilistic framework that intercepts raw heatmaps and models them as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) augmented with a spatially agnostic uniform distribution, requiring no architectural modifications or retraining. This continuous representation allows us to comprehensively explore the distinct contributions of density modeling to HPE. We show that the spatial expectation of our fitted GMM achieves precision parity with leading sub-pixel decoders without heuristic post-processing. Leveraging this continuous space, our test-time augmentation aggregates probability distributions rather than discrete activations, mitigating multi-scale heatmap poisoning. Furthermore, because our multimodal GMM parameterization isolates competing spatial hypotheses, it naturally interfaces with geometric regularizers such as Markov Random Fields. However, our analysis exposes the inherent vulnerabilities of 2D kinematic priors under perspective foreshortening and visual degradation. Crucially, this density formulation yields significant improvements in uncertainty quantification: our calibrated geometric covariance volume outperforms standard peak-intensity heuristics in OoD anomaly detection under severe occlusion. For in-distribution calibration, dynamically fusing our geometric metric via Adaptive Softmax reduces or matches baseline Area Under the Sparsification Error (AUSE) across benchmarks and degradation levels. Finally, we establish that this continuous parameterization is extensible to multi-view 3D architectures, bypassing the $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ voxel memory bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 提出一种事后连续概率框架，将HPE的原始热图建模为带均匀分布的高斯混合模型（GMM），无需改动架构或重训练；在精度、测试时增强、几何正则化与不确定性量化（OoD检测、校准）上取得改进，并可扩展至多视角3D HPE。
AI.motivation: 现代HPE虽在亚像素解码上有所进展，但仍受限于从离散热图中确定性地提取坐标，在密集遮挡和分布外（OoD）歧义下系统性失效。作者希望在不修改架构、不重训练的前提下，用连续概率表示替代离散峰值解码，并系统探究密度建模对HPE的贡献。
AI.method: 提出后处理式连续概率框架：拦截原始热图，将其建模为GMM叠加空间无关均匀分布，无架构改动与重训练。基于此连续表示，采用GMM的空间期望作为坐标估计；测试时增强聚合概率分布而非离散激活；利用多模态GMM参数化隔离竞争性空间假设，与MRF等几何正则器自然衔接；用校准的几何协方差体积做不确定性量化，并通过Adaptive Softmax动态融合；将该参数化扩展至多视角3D架构，规避O(N^3)体素内存瓶颈。
AI.result: GMM空间期望在无需启发式后处理下达到与领先亚像素解码器相当的精度；概率分布聚合的TTA缓解多尺度热图“中毒”；多模态参数化便于接入几何正则化（如MRF），但揭示2D运动学先验在透视缩短与视觉退化下的固有脆弱性；校准的几何协方差体积在严重遮挡下的OoD异常检测优于峰值强度启发式；分布内校准中，经Adaptive Softmax动态融合的几何度量在多个基准与退化级别上降低或持平基线AUSE；连续参数化可扩展至多视角3D HPE。
AI.conclusion: 将热图从离散确定性解码转为连续概率（GMM+均匀分布）表示，是一种无需重训练的通用后处理方案；它在精度持平主流解码器的同时，显著增强不确定性量化、OoD鲁棒性与多尺度/TTA一致性，并能自然耦合几何先验及扩展至3D多视角，规避体素内存瓶颈；同时也揭示了2D先验在视角与退化条件下的局限。

title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, ClawLoop yields consistent improvements on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks are further transferred to smaller-scale Qwen3.5-4B and 9B models with gains across all benchmarks, validating data quality independently of the loop model.

AI.tldr: 提出 ClawLoop，一个无需外部教师模型、最小化先验依赖的自改进框架，通过任务合成—训练—诊断反馈三阶段循环，持续提升基于 harness 环境的 LLM 智能体能力。
AI.motivation: 现有面向工具使用智能体的后训练流水线多为一次性、依赖外部强模型作为教师：由外部模型合成任务并采集轨迹，目标智能体仅训练一次，评估结果仅供人工研究，未回流至训练循环。此类流水线受限于外部模型能力与人类先验范围，缺乏自我改进空间。而面向 harness 环境（沙箱工作区、直接操作文件系统与 Shell）的智能体后训练流水线更为稀缺。
AI.method: ClawLoop 将三阶段组成自维持循环：(1) 任务合成：通过两种互补构建例程生成多样化训练任务池，施加诊断条件化的难度增长，并采用无智能体与基于智能体两种任务验证；(2) 训练：通过 SFT 和/或 RL 更新智能体；(3) 诊断与反馈：分析智能体 rollout 行为，生成能力分析报告，作为下一轮任务合成的反馈。整个流程无需外部教师模型，先验依赖最小。以 Qwen3.6-27B 作为循环模型。
AI.result: 在 SkillsBench、Claw-Eval-Live 和 ClawGym-Bench 上均取得一致提升；迭代精炼后的任务进一步迁移至更小规模模型 Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B，在所有基准上均获得增益，独立于循环模型验证了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: ClawLoop 通过将评估反馈闭环化，实现了无需外部教师的智能体自改进，突破了外部模型能力与人类先验的瓶颈；合成任务具备跨模型可迁移性，表明其数据质量具有通用价值。

title: MRFlow: Mechanism-Structured Residual Flow Matching for Virtual Cell Perturbation Prediction
summary: Predicting cellular responses to chemical and genetic perturbations is a central test for AI virtual cells, yet many single-cell models reduce each condition to an average expression shift. This target is misaligned with perturbation biology: rare states, resistant subpopulations, and context-dependent effect sizes may coexist under the same intervention. MRFlow treats virtual-cell prediction as conditional transport between empirical single-cell measures. Control and perturbed cells are embedded in a variational latent state space, greedy low-cost supervision is constructed over detached minibatch states, and a conditional flow-matching vector field transports control populations toward perturbed populations. The field decomposes into a mechanism-structured affine dictionary, which recombines shared latent response operators with a low-rank condition-specific correction, and a spectrally controlled residual field for nonlinear cell-level variation. Genetic perturbations are encoded through a regulatory-graph GCN, chemical perturbations through Morgan fingerprints, and both enter the same conditional dynamics interface. Across eight gene and drug perturbation benchmarks, MRFlow attains the highest composite score while preserving competitive raw performance on differential-expression and distributional metrics. The results support latent distribution transport as a principled and empirically effective formulation for perturbation-aware virtual cell modeling.

AI.tldr: MRFlow将虚拟细胞预测建模为控制细胞与扰动细胞经验测度之间的条件传输，在8个基因/药物扰动基准上取得最高综合得分。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞扰动预测模型多将每种条件简化为平均表达偏移，这与扰动生物学不符：同一干预下可能共存稀有状态、耐药亚群及依赖上下文（context-dependent）的效应量，因此需要保留分布层面的异质性。
AI.method: 将对照与扰动细胞嵌入变分隐状态空间；在detach后的minibatch状态上构建贪心低代价监督；用条件流匹配（flow-matching）向量场把对照群体传输至扰动群体。该场分解为两部分：机制结构化的仿射字典（共享隐响应算子的重组 + 低秩条件特异校正）与谱受控的残差场（刻画非线性细胞级变异）。基因扰动经调控图GCN编码，化学扰动经Morgan指纹编码，二者共用同一条件动力学接口。
AI.result: 在8个基因与药物扰动基准上，MRFlow取得最高综合得分，同时在差异表达与分布类指标上保持有竞争力的原始性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将隐空间分布传输作为扰动感知虚拟细胞建模的一种有原理依据且经验有效的表述框架。

title: Ultra-low-loss Ta2O5 waveguide for integrated nonlinear photonics
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in Optica
summary: Integrated nonlinear photonics demands waveguides that simultaneously offer ultra-low-loss, relatively strong nonlinearity, and tight mode confinement. Tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) is attractive for this purpose because it combines a broad transparency window, relatively strong third-order nonlinearity, and favorable thick-film growth characteristics. In tightly confined Ta2O5 waveguides, however, enhanced interaction between the optical mode and etched sidewalls makes scattering loss an important limitation for achieving high Q anomalous-dispersion resonators. Here, we mitigate this confinement-scattering trade-off in pure Ta2O5 waveguides using a fabrication flow based on the Damascene concept. The resulting microring resonators (MRRs) with a cross-section of 1.6 μm x 0.85 μm exhibit intrinsic quality factors exceeding 4.0 x 106, corresponding to propagation losses below 10 dB/m, while maintaining anomalous dispersion suitable for bright dissipative Kerr soliton operation. Using these resonators, we generate a coherent bright single-soliton microcomb with a repetition rate of 108.32 GHz. Under optimized dual-pump operating conditions, the platform further exhibits an experimentally accessible single-soliton window spanning 7.5 GHz, indicating a large detuning tolerance for soliton operation; this broad operating window is consistent with the relatively weak thermo-optic response of Ta2O5. Thermal-bistability analysis further indicates that the residual scattering loss is comparable to the material-absorption loss, rather than dominating the loss budget. These results demonstrate that low optical loss, tight mode confinement, and dispersion engineering suitable for soliton formation can be jointly achieved in a pure Ta2O5 platform, providing an ultra-low-loss platform foundation for integrated nonlinear photonic devices and more complex chip-scale nonlinear photonic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文采用Damascene工艺制备纯Ta2O5微环谐振器，兼顾低损耗（<10 dB/m）、强非线性与紧束缚，实现4.0×10^6以上本征Q值及108.32 GHz亮孤子微梳。
AI.motivation: 集成非线性光子学需要波导同时具备超低损耗、较强非线性与紧模式束缚。Ta2O5虽具宽透明窗口与强三阶非线性，但在紧束缚波导中光模与刻蚀侧壁的相互作用增强，散射损耗成为实现高Q反常色散谐振器的主要瓶颈，即存在"束缚—散射"权衡。
AI.method: 采用基于Damascene概念的制备工艺流程，在纯Ta2O5波导中缓解束缚与散射的权衡，制备截面为1.6 μm × 0.85 μm的微环谐振器（MRR），并测试其本征Q值、色散特性；在双泵浦优化条件下进行亮耗散Kerr孤子产生实验，并开展热双稳性分析以评估损耗构成。
AI.result: MRR本征Q值超过4.0×10^6，对应传输损耗低于10 dB/m，同时保持适合亮耗散Kerr孤子的反常色散；实现了重复频率108.32 GHz的相干亮单孤子微梳；优化双泵浦条件下单孤子窗口达7.5 GHz，显示较大的失谐容差，与Ta2O5较弱的热光响应一致；热双稳性分析表明残余散射损耗与材料吸收损耗相当，而非主导损耗预算。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在纯Ta2O5平台上可同时实现低光学损耗、紧模式束缚与适于孤子产生的色散工程，为集成非线性光子器件及更复杂的芯片级非线性光子系统提供了超低损耗平台基础。

title: Programmable Data Layouts via On-The-Fly Data Transformation
summary: The performance of modern computing systems is heavily bottlenecked by the widening gap between processing throughput and main memory latency, a problem exacerbated when an application's logical data access patterns misalign with the physical layout of data in memory. To address this, we propose a hardware-software co-design framework comprising the Data Transformation Language (DTL) and the Data Transformation Unit (DTU). DTL allows programmers to concisely express complex data layout reorganizations, which the compiler translates into efficient hardware routing configurations. The DTU, a hardware engine logically situated between the Last-Level Cache (LLC) and main memory, transparently evaluates these configurations on-the-fly to gather scattered data elements into dense, logically contiguous cache lines. By converting explicit layout transformations into virtual views, this approach eliminates the need for explicit data materialization in software. We evaluate the DTU within a quad-core RISC-V SoC using FireSim, demonstrating substantial improvements in execution speed and memory efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出软硬件协同设计框架DTL+DTU，在LLC与主存之间透明地按需重组数据布局，将显式布局变换转为虚拟视图，免去软件数据实化，在四核RISC-V SoC的FireSim验证中显著提升执行速度与内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现代计算系统性能受限于处理吞吐与主存延迟之间不断扩大的差距；当应用的逻辑数据访问模式与内存物理布局不一致时，这一问题更加严重。
AI.method: 提出软硬件协同设计框架，包含数据变换语言（DTL）与数据变换单元（DTU）。DTL供程序员简洁表达复杂数据布局重组，编译器将其翻译为高效的硬件路由配置；DTU作为逻辑上位于末级缓存（LLC）与主存之间的硬件引擎，透明地在数据通路（on-the-fly）上执行这些配置，将分散的数据元素聚集为稠密、逻辑连续的缓存行。
AI.result: 在基于FireSim的四核RISC-V SoC中对DTU进行评估，结果显示执行速度和内存效率均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过把显式布局变换转化为虚拟视图，该方案消除了软件中显式数据实化的需求，验证了软硬件协同解决内存布局不匹配问题的有效性。

title: Wireless Energy Transfer for Space Applications: A Review of Technologies, Mission Architectures, Energy Routing, and System Integration
summary: Wireless energy transfer (WET) decouples energy generation from energy use, offering strategic advantages for distributed spacecraft, lunar surface networks, mobile assets, and high-power remote loads. This review organizes the field along four axes: physical mechanism, energy reference plane, mission architecture, and evidence maturity. It examines near field inductive and resonant transfer, microwave and millimeter wave power beaming, optical and laser-based transfer, space-based solar power, lunar and cislunar energy delivery, inter-spacecraft power sharing, intraspacecraft contactless interfaces, and reconfigurable or relay assisted routing within a common R0,R7 energy-accounting framework. Three conclusions emerge. First, WET is most valuable when spatial or temporal mismatches separate energy generation from load demand; it does not universally replace local generation or onboard storage. Second, dominant losses vary across system architectures. Beam collection, rectification, receiver output, and useful load efficiencies are therefore not directly comparable without explicitly defined energy reference planes. Third, technological maturity is uneven. High power ground demonstrations and short range flight applications are relatively well established, whereas long-range radiative inter spacecraft transfer, spaceborne routing hardware, lunar energy networks, and deep space applications remain supported primarily by models, simulations, and mission studies rather than hardware demonstrations. Progress requires validated end to end energy budgets under mission realistic constraints, including pointing and tracking, thermal management, environmental exposure, reliability, energy storage, and regulatory compliance.

AI.tldr: 该综述以物理机制、能量参考面、任务架构、证据成熟度四条轴线组织无线能量传输（WET）研究，涵盖近场感应/谐振、微波与毫米波、光学/激光、空间太阳能、月面与地月空间、航天器间与舱内非接触接口及中继路由，并统一在R0–R7能量核算框架下比较；指出WET仅在发电与负载存在时空错配时具优势，各架构主导损耗不同导致效率不可直接比较，且技术成熟度不均，长距离辐射式与深空应用多停留在模型与仿真阶段。
AI.motivation: WET将能量产生与能量使用解耦，对分布式航天器、月面网络、移动资产及高功率远程负载具有战略价值，但该领域术语、效率口径与成熟度判断混乱，缺乏统一的分析与核算框架，因此需要系统梳理。
AI.method: 文献综述与框架化比较：沿四条轴线（物理机制、能量参考面、任务架构、证据成熟度）组织领域；将多种WET技术（近场感应与谐振、微波/毫米波功率波束、光学与激光、空间太阳能、月面与地月空间能量输送、航天器间功率共享、舱内非接触接口、可重构与中继辅助路由）置于统一的R0–R7能量核算框架下进行分析。
AI.result: 得出三点结论：(1) WET的价值集中体现在发电与负载需求存在空间或时间错配的场景，并非普遍替代本地发电或机上储能；(2) 不同系统架构的主导损耗各异，波束收集、整流、接收输出与有用负载效率在未明确能量参考面时不可直接比较；(3) 技术成熟度不均衡，高功率地面演示与短距飞行应用较成熟，而长距离辐射式航天器间传输、星载路由硬件、月面能源网络与深空应用仍主要依赖模型、仿真和任务研究。
AI.conclusion: 该领域进展的关键在于在任务真实约束下建立经验证的端到端能量预算，需涵盖指向与跟踪、热管理、环境暴露、可靠性、储能与法规合规等要素，并以统一的能量参考面支撑跨架构比较与成熟度评估。

title: Adaptive DOA Estimation With KL-Based Kernel Bandwidth Adaptation Under Impulsive Noise
summary: Direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation can degrade markedly in impulsive noise, where methods relying on Gaussian or second-order statistical assumptions are particularly susceptible to large-amplitude outliers. This paper develops an adaptive DOA estimator that employs Gaussian kernel weighting to attenuate the influence of large prediction errors while adjusting the kernel bandwidth online according to a Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence criterion. A sample-based approximation of the KL criterion yields a recursive bandwidth update that adapts the degree of outlier suppression to the observed error statistics rather than prescribing a fixed bandwidth a priori. The spatial-filter coefficients and kernel bandwidth are updated recursively, and the DOAs are recovered from the resulting spatial spectrum.
