Mean and mean-square analyses are developed under standard adaptive-filtering approximations to characterize the coefficient convergence and steady-state behavior. Simulation results under Gaussian-mixture impulsive noise demonstrate stable coefficient adaptation and improved DOA estimation accuracy over representative competing methods in several challenging operating regimes, with the most pronounced gains occurring at low-to-moderate signal-to-noise ratios. The results also indicate reduced sensitivity to the initial kernel bandwidth through online bandwidth adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应波达方向（DOA）估计器，采用高斯核加权抑制脉冲噪声中的大幅值离群点引起的大预测误差，并基于KL散度准则在线调整核带宽，从而自适应地控制离群点抑制程度，仿真表明其在多种挑战场景下优于代表性竞争方法。
AI.motivation: 脉冲噪声中的大幅值离群点会显著恶化DOA估计性能，而依赖高斯假设或二阶统计量的传统方法对此尤为敏感。固定核带宽的核方法需要先验设定带宽，难以适配实际观测到的误差统计特性，因此需要一种能在线自适应调整抑制强度的DOA估计方案。
AI.method: 构建采用高斯核加权的自适应DOA估计器，以衰减大预测误差的影响；基于KL散度准则推导样本近似，得到递归的核带宽更新公式，使离群点抑制程度随观测误差统计自适应变化，而非预先固定带宽。空间滤波系数与核带宽均递归更新，并由所得空间谱恢复DOA；在标准自适应滤波近似下给出均值与均方分析，用以刻画系数收敛性与稳态行为。
AI.result: 在高斯混合脉冲噪声下的仿真表明：系数自适应过程稳定，DOA估计精度在多种挑战性工况下优于若干代表性竞争方法，增益在低至中等信噪比区间最为显著；同时，在线带宽自适应降低了对初始核带宽取值的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 通过高斯核加权与基于KL准则的在线带宽自适应相结合，可有效缓解脉冲噪声对DOA估计的破坏性影响，并提升对初始带宽设定的鲁棒性；理论分析与仿真共同验证了该自适应估计器的收敛与稳态性能优势。

title: Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Pre-registered study; code, pre-registration and all predictions: https://github.com/tnromy/evaluating-system-one-models-for-indonesian-regional-languages
summary: Calibrated typed-decision ("System One") models return a label and a probability in a single forward pass at a small fraction of the cost of large language models (LLMs), yet their evaluation has been almost entirely English. We report a pre-registered evaluation of the commercial Jev model and the open Laya-multilingual model on Indonesian regional languages, using the parallel NusaX sentiment (12 languages) and NusaTranslation sentiment and emotion (7 languages) test sets. Jev is more often correct on sentences that are lexically closer to Indonesian in all three datasets, and presenting the human Indonesian translation instead raises its accuracy by up to 37.2 points, most in languages distant from Indonesian. Its expected calibration error does not grow on regional languages, but its ability to rank its own errors degrades in all three datasets. Retrained classifiers need more than 500 labels per language to match zero-shot Jev in 9 of 10 NusaX regional languages. A confidence-gated cascade that sends Jev's 10-30% least confident decisions to a local IndoBERT classifier matches or exceeds the better of the two systems, and routing to an LLM instead matches that LLM at 24-77% lower API cost. Of six further commercial LLMs (three Claude and three GPT models), five are 4-14 points more accurate than Jev, at several hundred times the API cost where it is reported, while the smallest (Claude Haiku) is less accurate. We release the pre-registration, code and all predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文预注册评估了商用Jev与开源Laya-multilingual模型在印尼地方语言情感/情绪任务上的表现，发现Jev在词汇上更接近印尼语的句子上更准确，翻译成印尼语可提升最高37.2个百分点；其校准误差未恶化但错误排序能力下降；微调分类器需每语言500+标签才能匹配Jev零样本；置信度门控级联可匹配或超越较优系统，路由至LLM可节省24-77% API成本。
AI.motivation: 校准的类型化决策（"System One"）模型以远低于大型语言模型（LLM）的成本在单次前向传播中返回标签与概率，但其评估几乎完全局限于英语。本文旨在填补对印尼地方语言多语言评估的空白，检验这类模型在低资源语言上的准确性与校准表现。
AI.method: 在NusaX情感（12种语言）与NusaTranslation情感及情绪（7种语言）平行测试集上，对商用Jev模型和开源Laya-multilingual模型进行预注册评估；分析词汇距离与准确率关系、替换人类印尼语翻译的效果、预期校准误差（ECE）与错误排序能力；对比重训练分类器所需的标注量；构建置信度门控级联（将Jev最不自信的10-30%决策路由至本地IndoBERT或LLM），并与六个商用LLM（三个Claude、三个GPT）比较准确率与API成本。
AI.result: Jev在三个数据集上对词汇更接近印尼语的句子更常正确，替换为人类印尼语翻译后准确率最高提升37.2个百分点（语言距离越远提升越大）；ECE未在地方语言上增长，但错误排序能力在三个数据集上均下降；重训练分类器需每语言超500标签才能在10种NusaX地方语言中的9种匹配零样本Jev；置信度门控级联匹配或超越较优系统，路由至LLM时以低24-77%的API成本匹配该LLM；六个商用LLM中五个比Jev准确率高4-14个百分点，但API成本高达数百倍（有报告者），最小的Claude Haiku准确率更低。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策模型在印尼地方语言上具备低成本优势，但其准确性依赖于与印尼语的词汇接近度，且错误排序能力下降。置信度门控级联与LLM路由可在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低成本。研究公开了预注册、代码与全部预测结果。

title: Scenes as an Attack Surface: Uncovering Scene-Grounded Safety Failures in MLLMs
summary: Existing jailbreak attacks have exposed serious safety weaknesses in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Most prior attacks rely on specially constructed visual inputs to carry or support harmful intent. In this paper, we uncover a different vulnerability: task-relevant scene semantics alone can shift an MLLM from refusal to compliance, even when the visual input introduces no additional attack instructions and the original task intent remains unchanged. We formalize this failure as a scene-grounded visual safety vulnerability and introduce SceneSafetyBench to investigate it across eight risk categories and nine white- and black-box MLLMs. Our analysis reveals that this failure is associated with how task-relevant visual evidence influences downstream safety representations, suggesting that visual grounding alone cannot fully explain the observed safety shift. Building on this finding, we propose Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA), which preserve the original task while constructing validated scene-grounded queries and combining their independent responses. Across nine target MLLMs, SGA achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 86.17%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.55 percentage points and achieving the highest ASR on eight models. Our results identify scene semantics as an overlooked attack surface in MLLMs and highlight a growing tension between stronger visual grounding and robust multimodal safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了MLLM的一种新安全漏洞：仅凭任务相关场景语义即可使模型由拒绝转为顺从，并提出SceneSafetyBench基准与SGA攻击方法，平均ASR达86.17%。
AI.motivation: 以往多模态越狱攻击多依赖专门构造的视觉输入来携带或支撑有害意图。作者希望探究：在不附加攻击指令、且原始任务意图不变的情况下，单纯的任务相关场景语义是否足以引发安全失效，从而识别被忽视的攻击面。
AI.method: 作者将该失效形式化为"场景锚定的视觉安全漏洞"，构建SceneSafetyBench基准，覆盖八类风险类别与九个白盒/黑盒MLLM。分析任务相关视觉证据对下游安全表征的影响，并据此提出Scene-Grounded Attacks（SGA）：在保持原始任务不变的前提下构造经验证的场景锚定查询，并融合其独立响应。
AI.result: 在九个目标MLLM上，SGA平均攻击成功率（ASR）达86.17%，较最强基线高出8.55个百分点，并在八个模型上取得最高ASR。分析表明该失效与任务相关视觉证据影响下游安全表征有关，说明仅靠视觉锚定无法完全解释安全偏移。
AI.conclusion: 场景语义是MLLM中被忽视的攻击面，且更强视觉锚定与稳健的多模态安全对齐之间存在日益加剧的张力。

title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
summary: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出扩散模型校正器（corrector）以缩小训练-推理差距，在去噪每步迭代精修预测，显著提升无引导/无条件生成质量，效果可比CFG并可蒸馏回基础模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型迭代采样存在误差累积，源于曝光偏差（exposure bias）：去噪器训练时输入为真实图像的加噪插值，而推理时输入来自自身前几步不完美的预测，属于训练时未见过的分布。这可能是扩散模型在缺乏CFG等辅助手段时表现不佳的原因之一。
AI.method: 引入独立校正器：以基础去噪器的预测为输入，以相同ground-truth为目标训练，把"校正"变为显式学习任务，训练输入由基础模型提供。采样时在每个去噪步骤对去噪器的干净样本预测进行迭代精修，纠正中间步骤预测、防止早期伪影延续至最终样本。虽仅在基础去噪器预测上训练，推理时可重复作用于自身输出以进一步提升。框架简洁，可与CFG结合。
AI.result: 在DiT、SiT、JiT上评估：显著优于此前报道的无引导生成及无条件生成的FID，无条件高质量生成尤为困难；性能可与CFG竞争；校正+CFG可进一步提升多样性并缓解CFG特有的过饱和现象。通过把精修预测蒸馏回基础扩散模型，可将额外推理开销摊销，在无额外推理时开销下保留质量增益。
AI.conclusion: 校正器以显式学习方式缓解扩散模型训练-推理差距与误差累积，提升样本质量同时较大程度保留多样性；为无条件/无引导生成提供有效方案，可通过蒸馏消除额外推理成本，具备实用价值。

title: PRIME: Frequency-Aware Unified Pruning and Merging for MoE Compression
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as an effective paradigm for scaling large language models, yet their massive parameter footprint poses severe memory challenges for deployment. Existing compression methods typically treat expert pruning and merging as disjoint operations and rely on greedy heuristics, often leading to irreversible information loss or representational pollution. In this paper, we propose PRIME, a unified optimization framework for MoE compression via adaptive PRunIng and MErging. PRIME casts the discrete prune-merge assignment step as a global Integer Linear Programming over a frequency-weighted surrogate objective, jointly selecting pruning and merging decisions while accounting for expert usage. We motivate the frequency-aware objective through an error-bound analysis under fixed representative assignments, and show that the formulation favors high-frequency experts as centroids, promoting routing stability. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B demonstrate that PRIME achieves strong accuracy retention across knowledge, coding, math, and long-context tasks, while serving benchmarks of merged models quantify the memory and throughput benefits of expert compression in vLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRIME，一个通过自适应剪枝与合并（PRunIng and MErging）进行MoE压缩的统一优化框架，将离散的剪枝-合并分配建模为频率加权的全局整数线性规划，实现专家使用频率感知的联合决策，在Qwen3系列模型上保持精度并提升部署效率。
AI.motivation: MoE模型参数规模庞大，部署时面临严峻的内存挑战。现有压缩方法通常将专家剪枝与合并视为互不相关的操作，并依赖贪心启发式策略，往往导致不可逆的信息损失或表示污染。
AI.method: 提出PRIME统一优化框架。将离散的剪枝-合并分配步骤建模为基于频率加权代理目标的全局整数线性规划（ILP），联合选择剪枝与合并决策并考虑专家使用情况。通过固定代表分配下的误差界分析论证频率感知目标，表明该公式倾向于高频专家作为聚类中心，从而促进路由稳定性。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上的大量实验表明，PRIME在知识、编程、数学和长上下文任务上均保持较强精度；合并模型的服务基准测试量化了在vLLM中专家压缩带来的内存与吞吐收益。
AI.conclusion: PRIME通过统一的剪枝-合并联合优化有效缓解了MoE压缩中的信息损失与表示污染问题，在保持多任务精度的同时改善了内存占用与推理吞吐，为大规模MoE模型的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: Resonant dispersive wave emission: a route toward few-cycle, tunable strong-field drivers in the visible
summary: Intense ultrafast lasers are the backbone of strong-field physics and enable table-top scale applications of coherent high-photon energy radiation through high-harmonic generation (HHG). Using short-wavelength drivers in HHG promises highly efficient conversion into the extreme ultraviolet, but short pulse durations are essential to this approach. We generate multi-GW peak power, sub-10 fs pulses in the visible with broad spectral tunability (220--752 nm) by harnessing soliton dynamics in large-core, gas-filled capillary fibers for high-energy resonant dispersive wave emission. This establishes the potential of resonant dispersive waves as a new class of driving lasers for HHG and strong-field physics in addition to widespread applications in ultrafast spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用大芯径充气毛细管光纤中的孤子动力学产生共振色散波，获得了多GW峰值功率、亚10 fs、且波长在220–752 nm范围内可调谐的可见光脉冲，为HHG和强场物理提供了一类新型驱动激光。
AI.motivation: 强场物理和HHG需要强超快激光驱动源；采用短波长驱动有望高效转换为极紫外辐射，但必须同时具备短脉冲持续时间，现有驱动源难以兼顾高峰值功率、短脉宽与宽光谱可调谐性。
AI.method: 在大芯径、充气毛细管光纤中激发孤子动力学，通过高能共振色散波发射机制产生可见光波段的多GW峰值功率、亚10 fs脉冲，并实现宽光谱调谐。
AI.result: 获得多GW峰值功率、亚10 fs的可见光脉冲，光谱调谐范围覆盖220–752 nm。
AI.conclusion: 共振色散波可作为HHG与强场物理的新型驱动激光，并在超快光谱学等领域具有广泛应用前景。

title: MoSAIC: Learning DAG Scheduling Heuristics from Optimal Schedules through Motif-Aware Recovery and LLM-Guided Reasoning
summary: Efficient task scheduling in heterogeneous computing systems remains a fundamental challenge in embedded and high-level synthesis flows. This paper presents MoSAIC (Motif-aware Scheduling with AI-driven Cognition), a learning-based framework that bridges the gap between exact and heuristic scheduling approaches for DAG-based applications. The system uses the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to learn the relationships between DAG structures and scheduling priority functions. The framework first leverages the OR-Tools CP-SAT solver [4] to generate optimal schedules, which are then used to supervise the learning of compact priority-based scheduling functions through Bayesian Optimization. These learned heuristics capture relationships between scheduling decisions and structural graph features such as rank, depth, and fanout, enabling the construction of a reusable knowledge base across diverse DAG instances. Experimental results across synthetic graph families and real-world benchmarks, including PolyBench and MachSuite, show that the learned heuristics consistently improve over classical approaches such as HEFT [2], while maintaining low runtime overhead. The results indicate that combining optimal supervision with learning-based generalization provides a practical approach for scalable and adaptive task scheduling.

AI.tldr: MoSAIC：结合LLM推理、CP-SAT最优监督与贝叶斯优化的Motif感知学习型DAG调度框架。
AI.motivation: 异构计算系统中的高效任务调度是嵌入式与高层次综合流程的核心难题，精确方法与启发式方法之间存在精度与可扩展性的鸿沟。
AI.method: 利用LLM推理能力学习DAG结构与调度优先级函数间的关系；先用OR-Tools CP-SAT生成最优调度作为监督信号，再通过贝叶斯优化学习紧凑的基于优先级的调度函数；学习到的启发式捕获rank、depth、fanout等结构特征与调度决策的关系，构建可跨DAG实例复用的知识库。
AI.result: 在合成图族及PolyBench、MachSuite等真实基准上，学习到的启发式持续优于HEFT等经典方法，且运行时开销较低。
AI.conclusion: 将最优监督与基于学习的泛化相结合，为可扩展、自适应的任务调度提供了实用途径。

title: Progress in Cavitated Front Gridline Ag Paste for PERC Solar Cell Architecture
summary: This paper reports on the progress made with the cavitated silver paste on passivated emitter rear contact cells (PERC) to reduce the series resistance. Thus, electrical and microscopy characterizations are used to examine these resistive losses. Fifteen 252 cm2 PERC cells were fabricated for this assessment. Under standard test conditions, these cells achieved a mean conversion efficiency of 21.87% and a maximum of 22.07%. The mean measured fill factor was 79.98%, compared with a pseudo-fill factor of 83.60%, giving a mean deficit of 3.62 percentage points. Fill factor decreased with increasing area-normalized series resistance, which ranged from 0.53 to 0.83 ohm-cm2, while open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current remained unvaried. These electrical trends support resistive current extraction as the principal contributor to fill-factor variation. Electroluminescence imaging revealed localized emission nonuniformity. Cross-sectional scanning transmission electron microscopy showed variation in the glass interfacial layer, while scanning electron microscopy identified micrometer and sub micrometer silver particles. Conductive atomic force microscopy after sequential removal of the bulk metal and glass revealed spatially heterogeneous current response. These observations are consistent with nonuniform electrical access at the contact, where restricted conducting pathways may concentrate on current and increase local voltage drops. The combined characterization identifies interfacial heterogeneity and the connectivity of conducting pathways as priorities for understanding and reducing extraction losses in cavitated silver metallization.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过电学与显微表征手段，分析空化银浆在PERC电池中引起的串联电阻与填充因子损失，指出界面非均匀性与导电通路连通性是降低电流提取损耗的关键。
AI.motivation: 空化银浆用于PERC电池以降低串联电阻，但其电阻损耗的来源与微观机理尚不清晰，需要结合电学与显微表征加以厘清。
AI.method: 制备15片252 cm²的PERC电池；在标准测试条件下测其转换效率、填充因子与伪填充因子、归一化串联电阻、开路电压和短路电流；并采用电致发光成像、截面扫描透射电子显微镜、扫描电子显微镜及导电原子力显微镜（依次去除体金属与玻璃层）进行结构与电学表征。
AI.result: 平均转换效率21.87%，最高22.07%；平均填充因子79.98%，伪填充因子83.60%，平均差值为3.62个百分点；归一化串联电阻在0.53–0.83 Ω·cm²范围内，填充因子随其增大而下降，而开路电压与短路电流基本不变。电致发光显示局部发光不均；STEM显示玻璃界面层存在差异；SEM识别出微米及亚微米银颗粒；C-AFM显示去除体金属与玻璃后电流响应呈空间异质性。
AI.conclusion: 填充因子变化主要由电阻性电流提取损耗主导。观测结果与接触处电学通路非均匀一致，受限的导电通路可能集中电流并增大局部电压降。界面异质性与导电通路的连通性应作为理解并降低空化银金属化提取损耗的优先研究方向。

title: UL-Assisted Parametric CSI Feedback and Prediction for FDD Systems
comment: The paper is accepeted in GlobeCom 2026
summary: In frequency-division duplex (FDD) systems, the uplink (UL) and downlink (DL) channels are not fully reciprocal. Therefore, DL channel state information (CSI) estimated by each user equipment (UE) must be fed back to the base station (BS). However, because the channel varies between CSI acquisition and utilization, the feedback CSI may become outdated before it is used at the BS. To address this challenge, this paper proposes an UL-assisted parametric CSI feedback and prediction scheme for multi-user FDD systems with time-varying channel parameters. By exploiting the partial reciprocity between the UL and DL channel parameters, the BS first estimates the UL channel parameters from the sounding reference signals (SRSs) transmitted by the UEs. The BS then broadcasts DL pilots, allowing each UE to obtain observations containing information about its current DL channel. Instead of explicitly estimating the DL channel from these observations, each UE directly encodes them into feedback symbols and transmits the symbols to the BS. The BS decoder combines the feedback symbols with the partially reciprocal UL parameters to predict the future DL channel parameters. Finally, the corresponding DL channel matrix is synthesized from the predicted parameters using an explicit physical channel model. Simulation results on Sionna ray tracing (RT) dataset show that the proposed scheme outperforms the considered baselines in terms of channel prediction performance over different signal-to-noise ratios and prediction lengths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种上行辅助的参数化CSI反馈与预测方案，用于时变参数的多用户FDD系统，通过对部分互易的上行参数与反馈符号联合解码来预测未来下行信道参数，并在Sionna RT数据集上取得优于基线的预测性能。
AI.motivation: FDD系统中上下行信道不完全互易，下行CSI需由UE反馈给基站；但信道在CSI获取与使用之间发生变化，导致反馈CSI在使用前已过时。为应对CSI老化问题，需要有效的反馈与预测机制。
AI.method: 利用上下行信道参数的部分互易性：基站先从UE发送的SRS估计上行信道参数；随后广播下行导频，使各UE获得包含当前下行信道信息的观测。UE不显式估计下行信道，而是将观测直接编码为反馈符号并发送给基站。基站解码器将反馈符号与部分互易的上行参数结合，预测未来的下行信道参数；最后利用显式物理信道模型由预测参数合成下行信道矩阵。
AI.result: 在Sionna射线追踪（RT）数据集上的仿真表明，所提方案在不同信噪比和不同预测长度下，信道预测性能均优于所考虑的基线方案。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过上行辅助与参数化反馈预测，有效缓解了FDD系统中CSI过时问题，并验证了基于部分互易参数进行未来下行信道预测的可行性与优越性。

title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running $21\times$ faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running $10\times$ faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being $31\times$ faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出Next-Concept Modeling(NCM)两阶段由粗到细文本生成框架，通过多尺度残差VQ-VAE构建离散码层次结构，配合Transformer逐层并行预测，在多种任务上以显著更低计算量取得与扩散语言模型相当或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLM)虽支持并行采样、生成速度优于自回归模型，但存在三个缺陷：采样步数减少时质量急剧下降、每步都需处理完整序列、需多次遍历数据集才能达到良好质量。因此本文旨在设计一种既保持并行生成优势、又提升效率与质量的替代方案。
AI.method: NCM是一个两阶段由粗到细框架：(1)多尺度残差VQ-VAE将文本编码为离散码的层次结构；(2)Transformer一次生成一个层级，并并行预测该层级内的所有码。通过层级化的并行预测替代DLM的全序列逐步去噪。
AI.result: 在参数规模匹配条件下，NCM在LM1B上生成困惑度优于最强DLM基线且速度快21倍；在OpenWebText上与最强DLM相当且快10倍；在XSum上ROUGE-L与最强DLM持平且快31倍；在数独(Sudoku)推理任务上，NCM在各难度级别均超越自回归与扩散基线，且所需函数评估次数更少。
AI.conclusion: NCM通过层次化离散表示与逐层并行生成，在保持或提升生成质量的同时大幅降低推理成本，证明其在语言建模与推理任务上对DLM和自回归模型均具效率与性能优势。

title: TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 TrajCFG，利用引导速度方向的历史变化实现 token 级自适应无分类器引导，在多类生成任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 标准 CFG 对所有 latent token 使用统一引导尺度，但各 token 的速度预测在采样过程中演化并不一致，粗粒度缩放限制了引导效果。
AI.method: 面向 flow-matching 模型的免训练方法：以引导速度方向的历史变化作为反馈信号，将其映射为有界尺度，方向变化大的 token 施加强引导、方向一致者减弱引导；融合相邻步反馈与区间归一化的长跨度反馈，复用标准 CFG 预测、无需额外模型评估；并通过受控诊断与消融分析方向反馈、token 级分配及历史跨度融合的作用。
AI.result: 在文生视频、图生视频、文本-音频-视频、文生图、图生 3D 任务及多个骨干上优于基础采样器；文生视频中三个骨干的 VBench Total 分别较最强基线提升 0.30–0.75 分。
AI.conclusion: 历史方向反馈可作为通用信号用于细粒度引导分配，TrajCFG 具备跨任务与跨骨干的广泛适用性。

title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress
summary: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. We also extend the evaluation horizon from 90 minutes to three hours and record verifier checkpoints every 30 minutes, enabling direct measurement of sustained progress within a run. Across 1,145 scored model-task runs from 15 frontier models, GPT-6-astra leads with dense mean reward 0.69 and 37 tasks at R at least 0.95, followed by GPT-5.6-sol with dense mean reward 0.67 and 32 tasks at the same threshold. On the 30 reconstruction tasks, binary verifier scores average 0.221, whereas dense ladder scores average 0.653, showing that outcome-only evaluation discards substantial intermediate progress. LHTB 2.0 provides a broader, hardened, and process-aware testbed for studying reliable agent execution over hours.

AI.tldr: 本文提出长时程终端基准LHTB 2.0，通过修正缺陷、扩展任务与引入过程奖励，构建了覆盖13个领域77个任务的过程感知测试床。
AI.motivation: 长时程终端基准应衡量智能体在扩展工作流中能否持续取得进展（过程奖励），而非仅以最终状态的二值检查为通过标准；原LHTB存在任务与评测基础设施缺陷，且评测视野（90分钟）不足以观测持续进展。
AI.method: 在保留原46个任务的基础上修正缺陷并扩展31个任务，形成含77个任务、13个领域、8种任务类型的LHTB 2.0。扩展任务通过系统化重建任务流水线生成：从可用的科学或工程制品出发，用参数化参考实现生成多场景，公开6个作为行为证据、留出3个用于评测，并采用密集进展阶梯对部分进展给予奖励，防止对公开输出的记忆。评测视野由90分钟延长至3小时，每30分钟记录验证器检查点，从而直接测量单次运行内的持续进展。
AI.result: 在来自15个前沿模型的1,145次已评分模型-任务运行中，GPT-6-astra以密集平均奖励0.69、37个任务R≥0.95领先；GPT-5.6-sol以密集平均奖励0.67、32个任务达到同一阈值紧随其后。在30个重建任务上，二值验证器分数平均为0.221，而密集阶梯分数平均为0.653，表明仅看结果的评测会丢弃大量中间进展。
AI.conclusion: LHTB 2.0提供了更广、更稳健且过程感知的测试床，用于研究智能体在数小时尺度上的可靠执行；密集过程奖励与延长评测视野能揭示被二值评测掩盖的中间进展。

title: DoSA: Dots Sparse Attention
summary: Sparse attention visits few keys, yet finding them can still require scoring every key with every indexer head. We introduce DoSA (Dots Sparse Attention), a lossless method for making this computation conditional while preserving exact token selection. Its central observation is that Top-K selection requires sufficient evidence to reject a candidate, not necessarily its full score. A seed set supplies a lower bound on the winning threshold. Nonnegative head projections and joint residual bounds upper-bound positive contributions, while activation-informed aggregation bounds the magnitude subtracted by negative heads. The certificate directs full scoring toward candidates that remain eligible; exact-score filtering further reduces writeback and selection work. We establish the certificate and its exact-selection conditions, and analyze how geometry and selection margins govern its effectiveness. Our GPU implementation accelerates the complete Indexer by up to 2.74 times over SGLang and 1.69 times over LiteTopK across English, Chinese, and code workloads. End-to-end evaluation on GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V3.2 achieves up to 1.94 times and 1.50 times time-to-first-token speedups over the two baselines, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DoSA（Dots Sparse Attention），一种无损的条件化稀疏注意力方法：仅对可能进入 Top-K 的候选进行完整打分以加速索引器计算，并保持精确的 token 选择。GPU 实现使 Indexer 最高加速 2.74×（相对 SGLang）与 1.69×（相对 LiteTopK），端到端首 token 时延最高加速 1.94× 与 1.50×。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽只访问少量 key，但找到这些 key 仍需对每个 key 与每个 indexer head 逐一打分，评分开销成为瓶颈，亟需在不损失精确性的前提下使该计算条件化。
AI.method: 核心观察是 Top-K 选择只需足够证据来拒绝候选，而非其完整分数。方法用 seed set 给出获胜阈值下界；用非负 head 投影与联合残差界上界正贡献；用激活感知聚合界定负 head 所减幅度的量级。该 certificate 将完整打分定向到仍具资格的候选，并辅以精确分数过滤减少写回与选择开销。文中给出了 certificate 及其精确选择条件的证明，并分析了几何结构与选择裕度对有效性的影响。
AI.result: GPU 实现使完整 Indexer 相对 SGLang 最高加速 2.74×、相对 LiteTopK 最高加速 1.69×，覆盖英文、中文与代码负载；在 GLM-5.2 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 上端到端首 token 时延分别相对两基线最高加速 1.94× 与 1.50×。
AI.conclusion: DoSA 通过“拒绝证据”式的条件化打分，在保证无损精确选择的同时显著降低索引器计算成本，并给出理论条件与几何/裕度层面的有效性分析，具备实际端到端加速收益。

title: Observation of quadrature-dependent unidirectional flow of light
summary: Unidirectional transport of light is a central capability in photonics, enabling critical functionalities such as isolation and routing. Ordinarily, this directionality depends on the mode of light, but not its phase. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate phase-dependent unidirectional transport of light for the first time. Specifically, we realize a system where conjugate quadratures of an optical field decouple and propagate in opposite directions. Our all-optical approach uses multiple pump frequencies in a high-$Q$ nanophotonic micro-resonator to achieve Hamiltonian programming through Kerr nonlinearity. Even though we rely on optical nonlinearity, our approach is not limited to any minimal power requirement on the signal. We demonstrate the ultimate limit of this by measuring the effect of quadrature-dependent transport on vacuum fluctuations. Our approach unlocks a fundamental new capability for controlling light, and can enable previously inaccessible regimes of phase-sensitive directional amplification, sensing, and routing.

AI.tldr: 提出并实验演示了首个相位依赖的光单向传输，利用高Q微谐振腔中的多泵浦频率经由克尔非线性实现哈密顿量编程，使光场的共轭正交分量解耦并反向传播。
AI.motivation: 传统光单向传输（隔离、路由）仅依赖光的模式而不依赖其相位，缺乏相位维度的调控能力。作者希望引入相位敏感的单向传输机制，从而开辟相位敏感方向放大、传感与路由等新功能。
AI.method: 全光方案：在高Q纳米光子微谐振腔中使用多个泵浦频率，借助克尔非线性实现哈密顿量编程，构建使光场的共轭正交分量（quadratures）解耦并在相反方向传播的系统；该方法不要求信号具有最小功率。
AI.result: 实验上首次观测到相位依赖的光单向传输；通过测量正交分量依赖传输对真空涨落的影响，验证了该效应在无最小信号功率要求下的极限表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作解锁了控制光的基本新能力，为相位敏感的方向放大、传感与路由等此前无法实现的调控区域提供了可能。

title: The Era of Vibe Tapeout: Dark Age or Golden Age for Analog Circuit Design?
summary: LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. The agents also identified the causes of post-PEX degradation (CDAC wiring coupling and common-mode-dependent comparator offset) by their own experiments. On the other hand, agents sometimes reported false passes, and verification independent of the design agent was essential. (B) A commercial PDK is under NDA and cannot be given to a cloud LLM. We therefore evaluated local LLMs running on university servers with a six-task benchmark on a commercial 65-nm CMOS PDK. Kimi K3 passed five of the six tasks, while MiniMax M3 passed two. Neither solved the debugging task, which requires finding the cause from symptoms. Finally, we discuss the prospects for extending vibe tapeout from ADCs to entire SoCs, and ask whether vibe tapeout is a dark age or a golden age for analog design. Our answer is that it is a golden age for designers who know what to verify.

AI.tldr: 本文实测“vibe tapeout”（LLM智能体自主完成模拟电路设计流程）的当前能力，涵盖开放PDK上的SAR ADC全流程自主设计与商用PDK上的本地LLM基准测试，结论是“懂验证的设计师迎来黄金时代”。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体已能自行编写原理图与版图生成器、调用EDA工具、读取结果并修复设计，这种“vibe tapeout”对模拟电路也渐趋可行，但缺乏对其实际能力边界的量化评估，本文旨在测量其进展程度。
AI.method: 设置两组实验：(A) 在开放PDK（SKY130）上，由云端LLM智能体从规格出发设计11-bit、5.12-MS/s SAR ADC，包含有无“净化版参考设计”（源自其65-nm设计，即vibe porting）的对照条件；(B) 商用65-nm CMOS PDK受NDA限制无法交给云端LLM，改用大学服务器上的本地LLM，以六任务基准进行评测。
AI.result: (A) 智能体产出DRC/LVS干净的宏单元，经寄生提取（PEX）后仍满足规格；在有净化参考设计的条件下，最短时间产出最佳版图，面积仅为无参考条件的1/1.6至1/2.8，并实现无人干预签核；智能体还通过自主实验定位了PEX后性能退化的原因（CDAC布线耦合与共模相关比较器失调），但有时误报通过，独立验证必不可少。(B) Kimi K3通过6项任务中的5项，MiniMax M3通过2项；两者均未解决需从症状反推原因的调试任务。
AI.conclusion: 本文讨论了将vibe tapeout从ADC扩展到整个SoC的前景，并提出其究竟是模拟设计的黑暗时代还是黄金时代——答案是：对于懂得该验证什么的设计师而言，这是黄金时代。

title: Device Model Linking Singlet and Triplet Spin-State Properties to Organic Photovoltaic Device Characteristics
summary: This work proposes an exciton-kinetics coupled drift-diffusion (EKDD) model that bridges device-level charge transport with singlet and triplet excited-state kinetics. State populations and reversible photophysical transitions are solved self-consistently, enabling transient and steady-state device response calculations. We investigate how LE-CT, CT-CS, and LE-T energy offsets, together with triplet-transfer kinetics, govern charge generation, recombination, voltage loss, and extraction in organic photovoltaics. We identify CT-CS offset as a primary, largely overlooked factor controlling charge generation and voltage loss. A positive offset makes CT3-CS separation exothermic and improves generation, but lowers CS energy and increases voltage loss; a negative offset makes separation endothermic and highly temperature-sensitive. The model reproduces triplet-mediated recombination in PM6:Y6 and material-dependent triplet recycling in D18:NFA blends. We propose design rules for balanced generation and voltage loss via two charge-transfer channels: the LE-CT-CS pathway favors a moderate LE-CT offset of about 0.15-0.20 eV and a weakly exothermic CT-CS offset of about 0.05-0.075 eV; the T-CT3-CS pathway requires the same CT-CS alignment plus a small CT-T offset, no more than about 0.1 eV, corresponding to a recycling factor K greater than about 10^-2, to maintain fast T-to-CT3 recycling. CT-CS alignment is the main determinant of the charge-generation-voltage-loss trade-off, while triplet-recycling kinetics determines whether this balance survives at the device level. This work provides a unified theoretical description from exciton generation to free charge collection, offering a convenient tool for transient and steady-state analysis in organic photovoltaics.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出激子动力学耦合漂移-扩散(EKDD)模型，将器件级电荷输运与单/三线态激子动力学统一求解，揭示CT-CS能级偏移是决定有机光伏电荷产生与电压损失权衡的关键因素，并给出双通道设计规则。
AI.motivation: 有机光伏中电荷产生、复合、电压损失与提取过程涉及激子动力学与器件级电荷输运的耦合，但缺乏统一的理论描述工具；同时CT-CS能级偏移等关键参数的作用被长期忽视，需要明确其对器件性能的调控机制。
AI.method: 建立激子动力学耦合漂移-扩散(EKDD)模型，将器件的电荷输运与单线态、三线态激发态动力学相桥接，自洽求解态布居与可逆光物理跃迁，从而计算瞬态与稳态器件响应；系统研究LE-CT、CT-CS、LE-T能级偏移及三线态转移动力学对电荷产生、复合、电压损失和提取的影响。
AI.result: 识别出CT-CS偏移是控制电荷产生与电压损失的主要且被忽视的因素：正偏移使CT3-CS分离放热并改善产生，但降低CS能量、增大电压损失；负偏移使分离吸热且对温度高度敏感。模型成功复现PM6:Y6中的三线态介导复合及D18:NFA共混物中材料依赖的三线态回收。提出双电荷转移通道设计规则：LE-CT-CS路径需约0.15-0.20 eV的适中LE-CT偏移与约0.05-0.075 eV的弱放热CT-CS偏移；T-CT3-CS路径需相同CT-CS对齐并加上不超过约0.1 eV的小CT-T偏移，对应回收因子K大于约10^-2。
AI.conclusion: CT-CS能级对齐是电荷产生-电压损失权衡的主要决定因素，而三线态回收动力学决定该平衡是否能在器件层面维持。该工作提供了从激子产生到自由电荷收集的统一理论描述，为有机光伏的瞬态与稳态分析提供了便捷工具。

title: A QoE-Driven Framework for O-RAN Network Slicing Based on Empirical Multi-User VR Traffic Modelling
summary: Virtual Reality (VR) requires strict Quality-of-Experience (QoE) guarantees, making radio resource management harder. Static slice allocations are wasteful, while dynamic approaches often rely on heuristic penalty functions lacking an empirical basis. We introduce a QoE-driven network-slicing framework for Open RAN in which resource allocation is guided by empirically derived multi-user VR traffic statistics. Closed-form n-fold convolutions model the aggregate data rate and inter-arrival time of n concurrent users, validated empirically for up to four. The fitted data-rate cumulative distribution function is checked against the measured throughput to give a percentile-based satisfaction indicator; the inter-arrival law sets the slice targets. A near-real-time RIC xApp closes a loop over the E2SM-KPM and E2SM-RC interfaces to apply slice-level Physical Resource Block (PRB) quotas. On an over-the-air testbed it reclaims up to 41% of the cell's committed PRBs from a greedy neighbouring slice while never reducing the protected VR slice. An analytical study then estimates the PRB demand and per-user QoE across user counts and channel qualities, giving the admission boundary beyond which the target QoE is unattainable. A controlled comparison further shows that a fixed-rate synthetic load overstates the VR slice's PRB footprint by 68%, showing the necessity of data-driven slice dimensioning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向Open RAN的QoE驱动网络切片框架，用实测多用户VR流量统计指导PRB资源分配，并在真实测试床上验证其回收邻片资源且保障VR切片的能力。
AI.motivation: VR对QoE要求严格，使无线资源管理更困难；静态切片分配浪费资源，而动态方法多依赖缺乏经验依据的启发式惩罚函数。
AI.method: 基于实测多用户VR流量统计建立闭式n重卷积模型，刻画n个并发用户的聚合速率与到达间隔（最多四用户经验验证）；用拟合的数据速率CDF与实测吞吐对比得到基于百分位的满意度指标，以到达间隔规律设定切片目标；在近实时RIC上部署xApp，通过E2SM-KPM与E2SM-RC接口闭环实施切片级PRB配额。
AI.result: 在空口测试床上，从贪婪邻切片回收最多41%的小区承诺PRB，且从不削减受保护的VR切片；分析性研究给出不同用户数与信道质量下的PRB需求与单用户QoE及准入边界；受控对比显示固定速率合成负载高估VR切片PRB占用达68%。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的切片维度划分对VR QoE保障是必要的，实测统计引导的资源分配可在不牺牲受保护VR切片的前提下显著提升资源利用率，并明确可支持用户数的准入边界。

title: Modeling the Arrival Time of Information-Bearing Events in Natural Language
summary: Understanding how information is distributed over time is fundamental to modeling natural language. While existing empirical studies primarily rely on post-hoc analysis of information-theoretic metrics, such as surprisal, little is known about the generation processes under the surface. We propose a novel approach for addressing this gap using the tool of neural temporal point processes (TPPs) by modeling the key information-bearing events in text sequences with learnable event intensity functions. Our model takes the history of event intervals and the contextual semantic representations from LLMs as input, and predicts the future arrival times for two types of events: new-word and high-surprisal-token. The experimental results reveal an interesting distinction in event intensities: LLMs tend to produce new words at significantly higher rates than humans, while high-surprisal tokens do not exhibit the difference. A decaying pattern of intensity over time is found in new-word events for both humans and LLMs, but not in high-surprisal-token events. Our findings revisit and extend previous studies that use simpler methods; provide supplementary evidence for theories about constrained context representation inherent in human language production; and find a new angle to view human and LLM generation differences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用神经常微分/神经时序点过程（TPP）建模文本中关键信息事件的生成过程，以可学习的事件强度函数刻画新词与高惊奇度词元的到达时序，发现LLM新词产出率显著高于人类，而高惊奇度词元无此差异。
AI.motivation: 现有关于语言信息随时间分布的研究多依赖对surprisal等信息论指标的事后分析，缺乏对表层之下生成过程本身的建模，因此无法揭示事件到达速率随时间的动态机制，也难以刻画人类与LLM生成过程的本质差别。
AI.method: 将文本序列中承载关键信息的事件（新词事件、高surprisal词元事件）视为时序点过程，用可学习的神经强度函数建模。模型输入包括事件间隔历史与来自LLM的上下文语义表示，输出为两类事件的未来到达时间预测，从而估计事件强度随时间的变化。
AI.result: 事件强度呈现两点关键差异：其一，LLM产生新词的速率显著高于人类，而高surprisal词元的事件强度在人类与LLM之间无明显差异；其二，新词事件强度随时间呈衰减模式，人类与LLM均如此，而高surprisal词元事件则不存在该衰减模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究以TPP方法重新审视并拓展了此前依赖更简单方法的研究结论，为人类语言产出中受限上下文表征的理论提供补充证据，并为考察人类与LLM生成差异提供了新的分析视角。

title: Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability
summary: Understanding and tracking a dynamic world are fundamental to visual intelligence. Existing video benchmarks provide limited insight into whether models can maintain a coherent understanding of evolving world state. Building such a benchmark from real-world videos is challenging because the underlying world state is partially observable, making annotations hard to obtain. To close this gap, we introduce Video-Arena, a benchmark that turns competitive games into scalable, verifiable tests of how well models understand evolving world states from videos. Specifically, inspired by how humans understand dynamic events, we evaluate spatiotemporal world state understanding and tracking through three task categories: perceiving critical events, interpreting state updates, and tracking the resulting states. Our pipeline can generate videos and aligned reference labels from game records at scale. To keep evaluation affordable and reproducible, we curate a golden set of 180 tasks across 9 games and run evaluations under two protocols: native visual understanding and tool-assisted agentic analysis. The best-performing systems achieve F1 scores of and under the two protocols, respectively. The result highlights that native models struggle to perceive events reliably, while tool-assisted systems improve event recovery but still struggle to interpret state updates and track the resulting states consistently over time. Our project page is in https://videoarena-bench.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-Arena 基准，将竞技游戏转化为可扩展、可验证的动态世界状态理解测试平台，含 180 任务/9 游戏，在原生视觉理解与工具辅助两种协议下评估。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基准难以判断模型能否对不断演进的世界状态保持连贯理解；而基于真实视频构建此类基准困难，因为底层世界状态仅部分可观测，标注难以获取。
AI.method: 受人类理解动态事件的方式启发，将竞技游戏作为测试场景，设三类任务：感知关键事件、解释状态更新、追踪随之产生的状态；流水线可从游戏记录大规模生成视频及对齐的参考标签；精选 9 款游戏共 180 个任务的黄金集，并在原生视觉理解与工具辅助的智能体式分析两种协议下评测。
AI.result: 最佳系统在两种协议下分别取得相应 F1 分数（原文数值缺失）。
AI.conclusion: 原生模型难以可靠感知事件；工具辅助系统能提升事件恢复能力，但在解释状态更新与持续追踪状态方面仍存在困难。

title: VETNET: Assembling Benchmark Datasets for AI-Driven Veterinary Innovation
summary: VETNET represents an ecosystem of live benchmark datasets and evaluation frameworks designed to accelerate AI-driven innovation in animal science and veterinary medicine through standardized, high-quality datasets and multi-institutional collaboration across academic and non-academic sectors. This framework addresses the gap between AI advances in human medicine and the fragmented state of veterinary AI development.

AI.tldr: VETNET是一个面向动物科学与兽医学的AI基准数据集与评估框架生态系统，通过标准化高质量数据集和跨机构协作推动该领域AI创新。
AI.motivation: 人类医学领域的AI发展迅速，而兽医学AI研究却处于碎片化状态，两者之间存在明显差距，缺乏统一的基准数据集和评估标准，制约了AI在动物科学与兽医学中的应用。
AI.method: 构建VETNET生态系统，整合实时基准数据集（live benchmark datasets）与评估框架，依托标准化、高质量的数据资源，并联合学术与非学术机构开展多机构协作。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或量化指标，仅说明该框架旨在弥合人类医学AI进展与兽医学AI碎片化发展之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: VETNET有望加速AI驱动的动物科学与兽医学创新，通过标准化数据集与跨部门协作解决该领域AI发展碎片化的问题。

title: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可编辑的"改进动力学模型"(IDM)实现预测式自进化：在评估前预测修改的任务级效果并指导修正，评估后利用历史修改-结果数据持续改进IDM，使预测知识跨代累积，系统在四个领域均超越HyperAgents。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体只在代价高昂的评估之后才获得关于修改的反馈，且聚合分数会掩盖需要不同修复方式的失败之间的差异，导致进化效率低、反馈信息利用不充分。
AI.method: 引入通过可编辑改进动力学模型(IDM)实现的预测式自进化：评估前，IDM预测所提修改的任务级结果并指导可选的修正；评估后，用历史修改及其观测结果来改进IDM，使预测知识跨代累积。系统由此可同时改进任务求解、修改提议与效果预测能力。基于HyperAgents框架进行实现与验证。
AI.result: 在多语言编程、论文评审、机器人奖励设计和奥林匹克级数学评分四个领域均优于HyperAgents，跨代平均性能最高提升46%；在包含智能体进化和任务评估的同等token预算下增益依然保持，并迁移到留出任务；IDM演化过程中预测精度提升，学到的预测知识可迁移以改进新领域的进化。
AI.conclusion: 预测式自进化通过IDM将修改效果的预测与反馈结合，可跨代累积预测知识并迁移到新领域，显著提升自进化智能体的性能与效率。

title: Dual deconvolution multifocal fluorescence response matrix microscopy for aberration-free high-throughput super-resolution imaging
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 1 table; includes Supplementary Information (8 figures, 3 tables)
summary: Fluorescence response matrix imaging enables separate computational correction of excitation and emission aberrations through dual deconvolution, but single-focus acquisition requires a large number of camera frames, limiting its practical use. Multifocal excitation can accelerate acquisition by recording many illumination positions in parallel, but denser foci also increase inter-focus crosstalk, which can bias the estimated excitation and emission optical transfer functions and degrade aberration correction. Here, we introduce high-throughput aberration-free fluorescence response matrix imaging with adaptive multifocal illumination, in which the inter-focus spacing of the multifocal lattice is adjusted according to specimen-dependent crosstalk. A programmable digital micromirror device generates multifocal excitation lattices, and the resulting detector-resolved fluorescence responses are assembled into a two-coordinate fluorescence response matrix. Dual deconvolution separately estimates and corrects the excitation and emission optical transfer functions, and the aberration-corrected matrix is then combined in the spatial-frequency domain to reconstruct the aberration-free image. This strategy reduces the number of required camera frames by approximately three orders of magnitude, allowing response matrices with $\sim 10^6$ illumination positions to be acquired within seconds to a few minutes. The accelerated acquisition preserves the aberration-correction capability of dual deconvolution and achieves an estimated lateral resolution of $\sim$100 nm. Applied to heterogeneous mouse brain and kidney tissue, the method enables high-resolution, depth-resolved volumetric imaging while correcting specimen-dependent aberrations. Together, these results establish adaptive multifocal illumination as a practical route to high-throughput aberration-free fluorescence response matrix imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应多焦点照明的荧光响应矩阵成像方法，通过依据样本串扰调节焦点间距，将所需相机帧数减少约三个数量级，同时保持双解卷积像差校正能力，实现约100 nm横向分辨率的免像差高分辨体成像。
AI.motivation: 荧光响应矩阵成像可通过双解卷积分别校正激发与发射像差，但单焦点采集需要大量相机帧，实用受限；多焦点并行采集虽可加速，却因焦点密集导致焦点间串扰增加，使激发与发射光学传递函数估计产生偏差，降低像差校正效果。因此需要一种兼顾高通量与像差校正精度的采集策略。
AI.method: 采用自适应多焦点照明：利用可编程数字微镜器件（DMD）生成多焦点激发阵列，并根据样本依赖的串扰调整多焦点阵列的焦点间距。探测器分辨的荧光响应被组装为双坐标荧光响应矩阵，随后通过双解卷积分别估计并校正激发与发射光学传递函数，最后在空间频域将像差校正后的矩阵组合以重建免像差图像。
AI.result: 该方法使所需相机帧数减少约三个数量级，可在数秒至数分钟内采集约10^6个照明位置的响应矩阵；在加速采集下仍保持双解卷积的像差校正能力，估计横向分辨率约100 nm；应用于异质小鼠脑与肾组织，实现了校正样本依赖像差的高分辨率、深度分辨体积成像。
AI.conclusion: 自适应多焦点照明是实现高通量免像差荧光响应矩阵成像的实用途径。

title: Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design
summary: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. The model is a class-conditional flow-matching image generator, which transforms Gaussian noise into an image of the requested class along a short, deterministic path of four Euler steps; in hardware, these steps are unrolled into a feed-forward pipeline of stochastic bitstream operators, whose output is read out as a time average, as in thermodynamic computing, without any relaxation phase. Each layer of the model is a butterfly-factorized linear map built exclusively from multiplexers that operate on split-unipolar bitstreams. The ReLU activation, which in stochastic computing requires a per-neuron up/down counter (accounting for 60-70% of the JJs in a counter-based design), is replaced by a stateless AND-NOT gate whose one-clock input skew is provided at no cost by SFQ gate-level pipelining. The models are trained directly on the stream representation of the hardware, with a regularizer that bounds the stream gains. Synthesis with an SFQ design flow shows that stochastic streams tolerate relaxed path balancing, which reduces the Josephson-junction (JJ) count of a hard-wired stage by 40-47%.

AI.tldr: 本文在超导单磁通量子（SFQ）逻辑上实现热力学计算，通过生成模型（类条件流匹配图像生成器）与无状态数据通路的协同设计，将四个欧拉步展开为随机比特流算子的前馈流水线，以时间平均读出结果，并以无状态AND-NOT门替代ReLU计数器，显著降低约瑟夫森结数量。
AI.motivation: SFQ逻辑具有极高时钟频率与极低开关能量，但对状态、存储、扇出和反馈的开销极大，而这些恰是传统热力学计算设计中每神经元累加器所依赖的资源，因此需要一种无状态的数据通路设计来适配SFQ。
AI.method: 协同设计生成模型与其电路：(1) 模型为类条件流匹配图像生成器，将高斯噪声沿四个确定性欧拉步转换为指定类别的图像；(2) 硬件上将各步展开为随机比特流算子的前馈流水线，输出以时间平均读出，无需弛豫阶段；(3) 每层采用蝶形分解的线性映射，仅由作用于分裂单极性比特流的多路复用器构成；(4) 用无状态AND-NOT门替代ReLU，其时钟输入偏斜由SFQ门级流水线免费提供；(5) 直接在硬件流表示上训练模型，并加入约束流增益的正则化项。
AI.result: SFQ设计流程综合表明，随机流可容忍松弛的路径平衡，使硬连线级的约瑟夫森结（JJ）数量减少40-47%；无状态AND-NOT门替代了原本占计数器设计60-70% JJ的每神经元上/下计数器。
AI.conclusion: 通过在SFQ逻辑中实现无状态数据通路的热力学计算，并协同设计流匹配生成模型，可在保持时间平均读出的同时大幅降低硬件开销，验证了SFQ逻辑用于此类计算的可行性。

title: Stability and Optimal Design of Adaptive Linear Bus Holding on Open Chains and Loops
summary: Bus holding can suppress bunching, but its stability and performance depend on the feedback structure and on how the bus sequence is bounded. This paper develops a common analytical framework for adaptive linear holding on finite open chains and loops and relates both to the bi-infinite system studied in the literature. Matrix and Fourier methods yield necessary and sufficient stability conditions for current- and leading-bus kernels on open chains and general cyclic kernels on loops, together with computable covariance bounds on open chains and exact variance formulas on loops. The analysis shows when periodic closure changes stability, when coefficient-sum stability tests in the literature are conservative, and why a stable open chain can still accumulate substantial variance before boundary effects arrive. For loops with same-lap feedback, modal analysis links control coefficients to fleet-wide schedule drift and to relative headway patterns, explaining the behavior of existing rules and yielding closed-form Pareto-optimal designs for schedule-holding and headway-holding tradeoffs. Cross-lap output corrections relate these designs to physical headway and holding performance. Numerical experiments show that the analytical design and a three-tap approximation, both obtained from closed-form coefficients and a one-dimensional search, outperform four established controls at the tested moderate and loose headway-variance budgets, with holding variances within 0.35% and 3.5% of the full cyclic numerical frontier across these budgets and other parameter variations. The framework thus provides a tractable design procedure and an explanation of how feedback structure and boundary conditions shape service reliability and holding effort.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限开链与环路上自适应线性驻站控制的统一分析框架，给出稳定性充要条件、协方差界与方差精确公式，并将模态分析与跨圈修正联系起来，导出闭环Pareto最优设计。
AI.motivation: 公交车驻站（bus holding）能抑制串车（bunching），但其稳定性与性能取决于反馈结构以及车序边界的处理方式。既有研究多针对双无限系统，而实际运营是有公开链与环路，缺乏统一框架解释周期性闭合、系数和稳定性判据、边界效应等如何影响稳定性与服务可靠性。
AI.method: 以有限开链与环路为对象建立自适应线性驻站控制的统一框架，并与文献中的双无限系统相联系。采用矩阵方法与Fourier方法，针对开链上的当前车与前车核、环路上的通用循环核，推导稳定性充要条件；给出开链上可计算的协方差界与环路上的精确方差公式。对同圈反馈进行模态分析，将控制系数与车队级时刻表漂移及相对车头时距模式关联，并引入跨圈输出修正以衔接物理车头时距与驻站性能。
AI.result: 分析明确了周期闭合何时改变稳定性、文献中的系数和稳定性检验何时偏保守，以及为何稳定开链在边界效应到达前仍会累积显著方差。对同圈反馈的模态分析给出了时刻表保持与车头时距保持权衡的闭式Pareto最优设计。数值实验表明：闭式系数加一维搜索得到的解析设计及其三抽头近似，在测试的中等与宽松车头时距方差预算下优于四种既有控制，驻站方差在相应预算及其他参数变动下分别处于完整循环数值前沿的0.35%与3.5%以内。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可处理的设计流程，并解释了反馈结构与边界条件如何塑造服务可靠性与驻站努力之间的权衡。

title: Point-Supervised Visual Learning for GNSS Measurement Quality Assessment
summary: Multipath and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation degrade global navigation satellite system (GNSS) positioning accuracy in urban environments. Although fisheye sky segmentation identifies obstructions along satellite directions, binary visibility does not fully characterize observation quality. This study proposes a point-supervised visual framework that predicts GNSS observation faults from fisheye images using supervision derived from GNSS observations. During offline labeling, a vision-assisted differential GNSS procedure selects multiple reference satellites based on sky visibility and elevation constraints. Double-difference pseudorange residuals automatically generate fault labels and sample importance weights at satellite projection locations. A residual-weighted loss is computed only at valid labeled points, enabling learning from sparse supervision without manual pixelwise fault annotations. The trained network generates dense fault probability maps, which are sampled at satellite projection locations to weight observations in weighted least squares positioning, reducing the influence of potentially faulty observations. The framework is evaluated using U-Net, DeepLabv3+, DINOv3, and SAM3 on urban vehicle data collected on a different day from the training data. All four models reduce horizontal root mean square error (RMSE) by 29.51% to 36.07% compared with SAM binary sky segmentation, with U-Net achieving the lowest RMSE of 0.78 m. The framework also provides positioning solutions during some intervals when the segmentation baseline fails. These results demonstrate the framework's generalization ability and show that GNSS-derived point supervision enables fisheye images to provide observation quality information beyond binary sky visibility, supporting GNSS fault detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种点监督视觉框架，利用GNSS观测自动生成故障标签，从鱼眼图像预测GNSS观测故障概率，用于城市环境定位加权，四模型均显著降低水平RMSE。
AI.motivation: 城市环境中多路径与非视距（NLOS）传播降低GNSS定位精度；鱼眼天空分割只能给出二值可见性，无法完整刻画观测质量，需要超越二值可见性的观测质量信息。
AI.method: 离线标注阶段：视觉辅助差分GNSS流程基于天空可见性与高度角约束选取多颗参考卫星，利用双差伪距残差在卫星投影位置自动生成故障标签与样本重要性权重；残差加权损失仅在有效标注点上计算，实现稀疏点监督、免逐像素人工标注。训练网络生成稠密故障概率图，在卫星投影位置采样以加权最小二乘定位中的观测。
AI.result: 在不同于训练日的城市车载数据上，用U-Net、DeepLabv3+、DINOv3、SAM3评估：四者较SAM二值天空分割水平RMSE降低29.51%~36.07%，U-Net最低RMSE 0.78 m；在分割基线失效的部分时段仍能提供定位解。
AI.conclusion: 框架具备泛化能力，表明GNSS导出的点监督可使鱼眼图像提供超越二值天空可见性的观测质量信息，支撑GNSS故障检测。

title: Agentic Data Engineering for LLMs: System Design and a Controlled Empirical Study
summary: LLM data engineering requires iterative experimentation to determine how data selection, rewards, and curricula affect model learning, making it a natural setting for AI-for-AI (AI4AI) research. Can agents use experimental feedback to progressively improve strategies, and do the resulting strategies improve target-model performance on held-out data? We study how agents use experimental feedback to develop data-engineering strategies under fixed training and evaluation protocols. Our Agentic Data Engineering (ADE) framework lets agents pursue, revise, or combine research directions using cumulative findings. Strategies are selected by in-loop scores and evaluated on held-out benchmarks. Across four tasks-math and code data selection, math reward design, and math curriculum learning-selected strategies achieve absolute gains over generic baselines of up to 13.34% on AIME25 Pass@32 and 5.85% averaged across four held-out benchmarks under fixed training conditions. In-loop scores improve over successive experiments, while held-out trajectories show that later in-loop gains do not always improve generalization. Comparisons of research organization and feedback access favor combining evidence analysis with cumulative findings. Research trajectories show how earlier findings inform strategy revisions and combinations across research directions.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic Data Engineering (ADE)框架，让智能体利用实验反馈迭代开发LLM数据工程策略，在四项任务中取得最高13.34%的绝对提升，并揭示在环分数与泛化性能的非一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM数据工程依赖迭代实验来确定数据选择、奖励设计和课程安排对模型学习的影响，因此是AI-for-AI研究的天然场景。核心问题是：智能体能否利用实验反馈逐步改进策略，且这些策略能否提升目标模型在留出数据上的表现。
AI.method: 在固定训练与评测协议下，构建ADE框架，使智能体基于累积发现来推进、修正或组合研究方向；策略依据在环（in-loop）分数进行筛选，并在留出基准上评估。覆盖四项任务：数学与代码数据选择、数学奖励设计、数学课程学习。同时对比不同研究组织方式与反馈获取方式。
AI.result: 选定策略相较通用基线取得显著绝对提升：AIME25 Pass@32最高提升13.34%，四项留出基准平均提升5.85%（固定训练条件下）。在环分数随实验推进持续改善，但留出轨迹显示后期在环增益并不总能转化为泛化提升。研究组织与反馈方式的对比表明，将证据分析与累积发现相结合效果更优。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能够通过实验反馈迭代改进数据工程策略并提升目标模型性能，但在环分数与留出泛化之间存在解耦；轨迹分析显示早期发现可指导跨研究方向的策略修正与组合。研究结果为AI4AI数据工程提供了可复用的实验范式与评估视角。

title: Token-Budgeted Candidate Retrieval for 3D Scene-Grounded VLMs: Category Names vs. Pairwise Geometry
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical World AI (non-archival)
summary: Under a fixed context budget, which objects and relations should a 3D scene-grounded VLM see first? On ScanNet indoor referring benchmarks (Dai et al., 2017), matching the query to object category names outperforms pairwise geometry scoring at every reported K. The gaps are largest at high recall. Analytic pairwise cues beat per-object cue scoring and query-agnostic kNN graphs, including on paraphrases. MiniLM and BGE-small still score higher on those splits. We evaluate token-budgeted candidate retrieval with axis-aligned boxes, a token-ratio metric, training-free baselines, two small encoders that match q to each object's category name, and QCRR (Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval), a deterministic pairwise-geometry scorer. Across ScanRefer gt_val plus a custom 20% scan-id split of Nr3D and Sr3D (35,504 queries; not official ReferIt3D val), additive noun matching reaches R@10 0.864 on ScanRefer against QCRR's 0.626; MiniLM and BGE-small reach 0.911 to 0.913 on ScanRefer and 0.941 to 0.947 on Nr3D. A corrected 3DGraphLLM harness (native Acc@0.25 0.67 on the full graph, n=300 ScanRefer queries) shows that context selection changes downstream accuracy under a matched object budget (Random 0.44, QCRR 0.56, MiniLM 0.67, oracle 0.70). Semantic retrieval beats hand-designed geometry on that harness. We will release the protocol, retriever implementations, and per-query outputs so new selectors can be swapped in without rewriting the analysis.

AI.tldr: 在固定上下文预算下，3D场景VLM应优先检索语义（物体类别名）而非几何关系；语义检索（MiniLM/BGE-small）在检索与下游准确率上均优于手设几何评分器QCRR。
AI.motivation: 在固定token/上下文预算下，3D场景grounded VLM需要决定先看哪些物体与关系。论文旨在系统评估不同候选检索/上下文选择策略（语义匹配 vs 几何评分）在检索召回与下游任务准确率上的表现，明确何种选择器应被优先使用。
AI.method: 在ScanNet室内referring基准（ScanRefer gt_val，及Nr3D/Sr3D的20% scan-id自定义划分，35,504条查询）上，采用token-budgeted候选检索、token-ratio指标、轴对齐框表示与免训练基线；对比两类方案：(1)两个小编码器将查询匹配到物体类别名的加性名词匹配；(2)QCRR（Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval），一种确定性成对几何评分器。另在修正的3DGraphLLM harness（全图原生Acc@0.25，n=300）中，在匹配物体预算下比较Random、QCRR、MiniLM与oracle的上下文选择对下游准确率的影响。
AI.result: 检索层面：加性名词匹配在ScanRefer达R@10 0.864，QCRR仅0.626；MiniLM/BGE-small在ScanRefer达0.911–0.913，在Nr3D达0.941–0.947；高召回处差距最大，且语义方法在改写（paraphrase）上仍占优。下游层面：匹配物体预算下准确率为Random 0.44、QCRR 0.56、MiniLM 0.67、oracle 0.70，语义检索优于几何选择。
AI.conclusion: 在固定上下文预算的3D场景referring任务中，语义检索（物体类别名匹配/小文本编码器）稳定优于手设成对几何评分与查询无关kNN图。上下文选择显著影响下游准确率。作者将公开协议、检索器实现与逐查询输出，以便新选择器可直接替换接入而不需重写分析。

title: Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights
summary: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetry store and judging its outputs against the answer key. Rather than combining them into one more overall reward, we show that different models lead different stages, which suggests routing each stage of the workflow to the model that performs it best rather than choosing a single model by its overall score. We also report how many tokens each model generates, and find that the share of output spent on thinking does not track the reward.

AI.tldr: 本文在CTI-REALM基准上评测26个模型（19个开放权重、7个闭源前沿），发现给予足够轮次时开放权重模型能以不到闭源模型十分之一成本达到其最强水平；基准的智能体消息上限是混淆因素，放宽后最高奖励归开放权重模型。
AI.motivation: 组织在语言模型智能体的安全工作中需在可自行运行与审计的开放权重模型和昂贵得多的闭源前沿模型之间作选择，论文旨在用统一评测揭示该选择的真实依据。
AI.method: 在CTI-REALM（arXiv:2603.13517）上，让智能体将威胁情报报告转化为可用的检测规则，并查询实时遥测存储；在统一的运行框架、评分器和LLM评审小组下评测26个模型（19开放权重、7闭源）。同时引入阶段级指标，通过执行智能体提交的检测查询并对照答案键评判其输出。
AI.result: 公开消息上限下领先开放权重与闭源模型无法区分；放宽上限后，被截断的模型恢复，最高奖励属于开放权重模型；顶尖模型中价格与能力关系弱，奖励相近的模型成本相差一个数量级以上；不同模型在不同阶段领先，输出中思考（reasoning）token占比与奖励不相关。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重模型可在足够轮次下以极低成本匹配最强闭源模型；消息上限是混淆因素，需谨慎解读基准结果；不应把阶段指标合并成单一总分，而应按阶段将工作流路由给该阶段表现最佳的模型；价格不是能力的可靠指引。

title: Posterior Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Posterior Flow Matching (PFM)，一个通用生成建模框架，通过学习条件速度均值与分量方差的高斯后验模型，使同一次模型评估同时输出传输预测与端点不确定性，并支持均值驱动的ODE与后验驱动的自适应SDE。
AI.motivation: Flow matching能学习如何将噪声传输至数据，但其均值预测无法直接反映中间状态处剩余的端点不确定性。作者希望让生成过程中始终可获得端点后验诊断信息，并利用预测的不确定性自适应地调节生成动力学。
AI.method: PFM采用高斯后验模型，同时学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差；单次模型评估即可给出传输预测和端点不确定性。基于学习到的矩，作者构造了均值驱动的ODE和由后验驱动、局部噪声尺度随预测不确定性自适应的SDE。
AI.result: 在图像、点云、分子与动作生成任务上，PFM提升了生成质量，并且能够在整个生成过程中提供端点后验读出。
AI.conclusion: PFM将不确定性建模内嵌于flow matching，使生成与端点后验诊断统一于同一框架，并在多类数据模态上验证了其有效性，为生成过程提供了可解释的实时不确定性信息。

title: Comparative Robustness of Mach-Zehender and Microring Photonic Matrix Multipliers Under Laser RIN and Thermal Drift
summary: Photonic matrix multipliers can accelerate neural-network inference, but their practical utility depends on how optical weight elements respond to source noise, thermal variation, and calibration error. This paper compares Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) and microring-resonator (MRR) implementations under laser relative-intensity noise (RIN), column-wise thermal/phase drift, and their joint action. Two CIFAR-10 classifiers - a compact four-layer CNN and ResNet-8 - are mapped to matched photonic multiply-accumulate chains using common source-distribution, detection, numerical, and calibration assumptions. Both architectures reproduce the same zero-perturbation baseline for each workload: 79.5% classification accuracy for the Small CNN and 70.0% for ResNet-8. Robustness is then evaluated using separate RIN-only and drift-only sweeps and a full two-dimensional RIN-drift grid, with dimensionless RMS perturbation levels extending from 0.5% to 20%. The analysis reports classification accuracy, class normalized confusion matrices, rolling-accuracy traces, one-dimensional robustness curves, and multidimensional response surfaces. Device equations and parameter definitions follow the models implemented in the QPI Labs Photonic Inference Simulator, with shared laser fluctuations propagated as correlated multiplicative noise and slow drift represented as a per-output-column perturbation of calibrated weights. All numerical results are generated from recorded experiment configurations and random seeds. The study provides a controlled system-level framework for comparing interferometric and resonant photonic weight elements while limiting conclusions to the implemented device models, perturbation ranges, calibration policy, and neural-network workloads.

AI.tldr: 该论文在统一仿真框架下对比MZM与MRR两种光子矩阵乘法器在激光RIN、列向热/相位漂移及二者联合作用下的鲁棒性，以CIFAR-10上的Small CNN（79.5%）和ResNet-8（70.0%）为基准，采用RMS扰动0.5%–20%的单因素扫描与二维RIN-漂移网格进行系统级评估。
AI.motivation: 光子矩阵乘法器虽可加速神经网络推理，但其实际可用性取决于光学权重元件对光源噪声、热漂移与校准误差的响应。现有研究缺乏在相同源分布、探测、数值与校准假设下对干涉型（MZM）与谐振型（MRR）权重元件的受控系统级对比。
AI.method: 将Small CNN与ResNet-8映射到匹配的光子乘累加链路，共享源分布、探测、数值与校准假设；器件方程与参数定义遵循QPI Labs光子推理仿真器模型。激光波动作为相关乘性噪声传播，慢漂移建模为每输出列的已校准权重扰动。评估采用独立的RIN单因素扫描、漂移单因素扫描以及完整的RIN-漂移二维网格，无量纲RMS扰动水平为0.5%至20%。
AI.result: 两种架构在零扰动下分别复现79.5%（Small CNN）与70.0%（ResNet-8）的分类准确率。分析输出包括分类准确率、类别归一化混淆矩阵、滚动准确率轨迹、一维鲁棒性曲线与多维响应曲面。所有数值结果均基于记录的实验配置与随机种子生成。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个受控的系统级框架，用于比较干涉型与谐振型光子权重元件在RIN、热/相位漂移及联合扰动下的鲁棒性；结论限定于所实现的器件模型、扰动范围、校准策略与神经网络工作负载。

title: Integration, Enhancements and Evaluation of Memory Simulators
summary: Currently, there is no common methodology or set of practices for evaluating memory-system performance in integrated simulation infrastructures. As a result, studies adopt different evaluation approaches, which can lead to conflicting conclusions even for the same simulation infrastructure. We propose a validation methodology that evaluates memory-system performance from three complementary views: the memory simulator, the CPU--memory interface and the simulated application. We use these views to detect, understand and correct memory-simulation inaccuracies arising from simulator integration and simplified modeling of microarchitectural features. The methodology reveals that the application's perception of memory performance can become effectively decoupled from the detailed memory simulation. Most importantly, we identify and correct a fundamental memory-model mismatch between delayed-response cycle-accurate memory simulators and ZSim, a representative parallel CPU simulator. We demonstrate the broader applicability of these enhancements by applying them to ZSim integrations with Ramulator 2, DRAMsim3 and DRAMSys 4, covering all major public cycle-accurate memory simulators. After the corrections and enhancements, all integrations reproduce the main bandwidth--latency trends and key characteristics of the actual system. Across the evaluated simulators, STREAM bandwidth differs from actual-hardware measurements by less than 5% in most experiments, while pointer-chase latency remains 15--18% lower than on actual hardware. All simulator enhancements are released as open source.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种从内存模拟器、CPU-内存接口和模拟应用三个互补视角评估内存系统性能的验证方法，用于发现并修正集成仿真基础设施中的内存模拟不准确问题。
AI.motivation: 当前集成仿真基础设施缺乏通用的内存系统性能评估方法与实践，不同研究采用不同评估方式，即使基于同一仿真基础设施也可能得出相互矛盾的结论。
AI.method: 提出一种验证方法，从内存模拟器、CPU-内存接口和模拟应用三个互补视角评估内存系统性能，用以检测、理解并修正由模拟器集成及微架构特征简化建模引起的内存模拟不准确。将该方法应用于ZSim与Ramulator 2、DRAMsim3、DRAMSys 4的集成，覆盖主要公开的周期精确内存模拟器。
AI.result: 该方法揭示应用对内存性能的感知可能与详细内存模拟有效解耦；识别并修正了延迟响应周期精确内存模拟器与ZSim之间的根本性内存模型不匹配。修正与增强后，各集成均能复现实际系统的主要带宽-延迟趋势和关键特征：多数实验中STREAM带宽与实际硬件测量偏差小于5%，指针追逐延迟比实际硬件低15-18%。所有模拟器增强均已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: 该验证方法可有效诊断并修正集成仿真中的内存模拟误差，且适用于多种主流周期精确内存模拟器，显著提升仿真结果与实际系统的一致性。

title: Active Neural Matter: A Finite-Window Response Framework for Physical Systems and Distributed AI Workflows
summary: Physical systems and distributed AI workflows can retain past information, receive delayed feedback and combine conflicting signals. These features pose a common modeling problem: determining what information about past interactions a state must retain to account for future responses. Active Neural Matter (ANM) addresses this problem through a finite-window response framework. Forward analysis uses each system's dynamics to predict state and output responses to perturbations, separating propagation from output sensitivity. Inverse analysis tests whether a candidate state retains enough information for these responses. With the system and future inputs or interaction rules fixed, distinguishable responses from histories assigned the same state identify distinctions the representation must preserve. Their distributional separation gives a lower bound on the worst-case error of approximating behavior from that state. Uncertainty bounds distinguish rejection, support within a fixed tolerance on tested comparisons, and unresolved cases. Delayed-consensus simulations check analytical predictions of response amplitude and phase over a narrow range of delays; flocking illustrates dependence on the chosen observable. An exact delayed-return construction establishes a sufficient state for a specified program. The AI studies identify distinctions in interaction history and evidence order that a representation must preserve to reproduce observed response distributions. Tests on new histories in a controlled feedback task provide bounded support for a state specified by the task instructions; the instructed rule predicts every observed action. ANM connects response prediction to measurable information requirements, separating behavioral fidelity from task correctness and initial-state adequacy from a closed evolution law for that state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Active Neural Matter (ANM)有限窗口响应框架，用于判定状态须保留哪些过去交互信息以解释未来响应。
AI.motivation: 物理系统与分布式AI工作流会保留历史信息、接收延迟反馈并融合冲突信号，其共同建模难题是：确定状态需保留哪些关于过去交互的信息，才能解释未来响应。
AI.method: ANM采用有限窗口响应框架：正向分析利用系统动力学预测状态与输出对扰动的响应，将传播与输出敏感性分离；逆向分析检验候选状态是否保留足够信息。在系统及未来输入或交互规则固定时，同一状态下的可区分响应揭示表示必须保留的区分。其分布分离度给出从该状态近似行为的最坏情况误差下界，并以不确定性界限区分拒绝、固定容差内支持与未决情形。结合延迟共识仿真、集群行为示例及精确延迟返回构造进行验证。
AI.result: 延迟共识仿真在窄延迟范围内验证了响应幅度与相位的解析预测；集群行为体现对所选可观测量的依赖；精确延迟返回构造给出指定程序的充分状态。AI研究识别出交互历史与证据顺序中表示必须保留的区分；在受控反馈任务中，对由任务指令指定的状态提供了有界支持，且指令规则预测了所有观测动作。
AI.conclusion: ANM将响应预测与可度量的信息需求相联系，区分行为保真度与任务正确性，并区分初始状态充分性与该状态的封闭演化律。

title: Optimally Setting RMS Energy Bands for Detecting Oscillations
summary: Oscillation monitors have root-mean-square (RMS) energy detectors at their core. These detect oscillation in a predefined frequency band by comparing the signal power in that band with a threshold (usually set empirically). A key design decision is the choice of frequency bands. Traditionally, for monitoring the stability of wide-area electromechanical modes, finer bands were set below 1 Hz, while higher frequencies were covered by wider bands. However, this approach can yield poor detection in modern power systems with fast and largely unknown local dynamics. This letter proposes an algorithm to set frequency bands from the ambient noise spectrum to maximize the average detection performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于环境噪声频谱来设定振荡监测器频带的方法，以提升平均检测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统振荡监测器的频带设置依赖经验：1 Hz 以下采用较窄频带监测广域机电模式，高频段则用较宽频带覆盖。该方法在现代电力系统中，由于存在快速且大多未知的局部动态，检测效果不佳。
AI.method: 基于RMS能量检测器机制，从环境噪声频谱出发，设计一种频带设定算法，以最大化平均检测性能为目标进行频带划分。
AI.result: 提出了一种可从环境噪声频谱自动确定频带的算法，用于优化振荡检测的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 以数据驱动的频带设定替代传统经验规则，可更好适应现代电力系统中的快速局部动态，提升振荡监测的检测能力。

title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
summary: Hybrid reasoning models such as the Qwen3 series switch between a THINK mode and a NO-THINK mode through a few chat-template tokens. A popular recipe trains such models with reinforcement learning in NO-THINK mode and reports improved reasoning performance. We provide evidence that much of this gain can be explained by thinking leakage: the gain comes largely from partially reactivating the reasoning abilities of the original model's THINK mode instead of learning enhanced reasoning behavior. We train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B with GRPO in NO-THINK mode. As accuracy improves, responses become longer and more reflective, are increasingly judged by the original model to resemble its own thinking, and the model's internal activations shift toward its THINK mode. We then investigate at the level of weights, activations, and attention heads: scaling the RL update further elicits THINK-mode behavior and approaches THINK-mode accuracy but does not exceed it; in Qwen3-8B, replacing a low-dimensional THINK-related activation subspace of the RL-trained model with its original-model value removes most of the RL gain, and the reverse exchange transfers a considerable fraction of the gain to the original model; and the RL-induced shift passes through the attention heads that read the empty think block. We further identify a possible mechanism in the GRPO training signal: responses favored by the advantage-weighted update are more THINK-like, and a gradient step computed from this signal moves the model toward its THINK state. Thus, gains in NO-THINK mode can largely reflect reactivation of reasoning abilities already present in the original model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出证据表明，混合推理模型（如Qwen3）在NO-THINK模式下用RL训练所得的推理性能提升，很大程度上源于"思维泄漏"——即部分重新激活了原模型THINK模式的推理能力，而非学习到新的推理行为。
AI.motivation: 混合推理模型可通过少量chat-template token在THINK与NO-THINK模式间切换。一种流行做法是在NO-THINK模式下用强化学习训练并报告推理性能提升。作者质疑这种提升是否真正代表推理能力增强，试图厘清其来源。
AI.method: 对Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B在NO-THINK模式下用GRPO训练，从行为、激活、权重与注意力头多个层面进行分析：观察响应长度与反思性变化、原模型对其"像思考"的判定、内部激活向THINK模式偏移；通过低维THINK相关激活子空间的替换实验（RL模型↔原模型）检验因果性；追踪经过读取空think block的注意力头的偏移；并从GRPO训练信号（advantage加权更新偏好THINK-like响应、梯度步推动模型向THINK状态移动）分析机制。
AI.result: 随准确率提升，响应变长且更具反思性，被原模型判定为更像其自身思考，内部激活向THINK模式偏移；进一步放大RL更新会引出THINK模式行为并逼近但不超过THINK模式准确率；在Qwen3-8B中，用原模型值替换RL模型的低维THINK相关激活子空间可消除大部分RL增益，反向交换可将相当比例增益转移给原模型；偏移经由读取空think block的注意力头传递；GRPO信号中advantage加权偏好的响应更THINK-like，其梯度步推动模型朝THINK状态移动。
AI.conclusion: NO-THINK模式下的RL训练增益在很大程度上反映的是对原模型已有推理能力的重新激活，而非习得增强的推理行为。

title: CAPTOR: a vision-language foundation model for Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis Oncologic CT
summary:
Purpose : To develop and evaluate CAPTOR, a deep-learning vision-language foundation model for oncologic chest-abdomen-pelvis (CAP) CT interpretation.
  Materials & Methods : CAPTOR (Chest-Abdomen-Pelvis foundaTion model for Oncologic Radiology) is a contrastive vision-language model, trained using a pretraining strategy for oncologic CAP CT (in single- or multiple-series acquisitions), on a multicenter retrospective dataset from North America, Europe and Asia, predominantly from tumor lesion examinations. CAPTOR was compared with state-of-the-art CT foundation models on three downstream tasks: disease detection, survival prediction using TumorImagingBench and image retrieval. Classification and retrieval were both evaluated on held-out internal and public test sets, stratified by anatomical coverage and indication. Bootstrap resampling was used to estimate confidence intervals, and pairwise comparisons were performed using permutation tests.
  Results : CAPTOR was trained and tested on 25,512 and 10,794 CT-report pairs respectively. TumorImagingBench datasets comprised between 134 and 421 studies each. CAPTOR outperformed all baseline models, on the classification task, on the CAP subset (AUC 0.767, 95%CI: 0.734-0.793, vs. 0.695, 95%CI: 0.645-0.736 for the next-best, p<0.001) and oncologic subset (AUC 0.784, 95%CI: 0.759-0.805, vs. 0.734, 95%CI: 0.703-0.767 p<0.001), ranked first on three of the four oncologic prognostic benchmarks, and achieved superior retrieval performance on CAP and oncologic subsets.
  Conclusion : A foundation model trained on oncology-enriched CAP CT data outperformed relevant state-of-the-art models in its target clinical context, underscoring the importance of clinically aligned pretraining.
  We release our preprocessing, training and inference code : https://github.com/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR and model weights : https://huggingface.co/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR

AI.tldr: CAPTOR是一个基于对比视觉-语言预训练的胸腹盆（CAP）CT肿瘤影像基础模型，在多中心数据上训练后在分类、生存预测和检索任务上超越现有CT基础模型，凸显临床对齐预训练的重要性。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤患者胸腹盆CT解读需求大，但现有CT基础模型缺乏针对肿瘤影像临床场景的预训练，需要开发与目标临床情境对齐的视觉-语言基础模型。
AI.method: CAPTOR为对比式视觉-语言模型，采用针对肿瘤CAP CT（单序列或多序列采集）的预训练策略，在来自北美、欧洲和亚洲的多中心回顾性数据集（以肿瘤病灶检查为主）上训练。在三项下游任务上与最先进CT基础模型比较：疾病检测、基于TumorImagingBench的生存预测、图像检索。分类与检索在内部及公开留出测试集上评估，并按解剖覆盖范围和适应证分层；采用Bootstrap重采样估计置信区间，置换检验进行成对比较。
AI.result: CAPTOR分别用25,512和10,794对CT-报告配对进行训练和测试，TumorImagingBench各数据集含134至421例研究。CAPTOR在分类任务上全面超过所有基线模型：CAP子集AUC 0.767（95%CI: 0.734-0.793）对次优模型0.695（95%CI: 0.645-0.736），p<0.001；肿瘤子集AUC 0.784（95%CI: 0.759-0.805）对0.734（95%CI: 0.703-0.767），p<0.001。在四项肿瘤预后基准中排名第一的有三项，并在CAP与肿瘤子集上取得更优检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 在肿瘤富集的CAP CT数据上训练的基础模型，在其目标临床情境中优于相关最先进模型，说明临床对齐预训练十分关键。研究开源了预处理、训练与推理代码（https://github.com/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR）及模型权重（https://huggingface.co/Guerbet-AI/CAPTOR）。

title: Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function
summary: Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more. Finally, we discuss the safety implications of our visualizations and some shortcomings of current reinforcement learning agents that will prevent us from building truly advanced machine intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对状态进行反事实干预，验证了PPO智能体的价值函数实际上隐式习得了Crafter环境的"世界模型"，涵盖了可收集规则、生命值影响因素、库存启发式等概念。
AI.motivation: 探究无模型强化学习算法是否实际上在学习环境模型，即价值函数中是否编码了关于环境动力学的知识。
AI.method: 采用反事实干预方法，在保持状态其余部分不变的前提下对特定目标变量进行修改，以此来探查PPO智能体价值函数在Crafter环境中所编码的概念。
AI.result: 尽管智能体仅以优化奖励为目标进行训练，其价值函数却学习到了诸如钻石可收集性的规则、水与食物对生命值的影响、以及库存相关的启发式等多种概念。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了可视化结果的安全启示，并指出了当前强化学习智能体存在的一些缺陷，这些缺陷将阻碍构建真正先进的机器智能。

title: GameSmith: Scaling Zero-Sum Self-Play with Synthesised Games
summary: Post-training large language models (LLMs) on two-player zero-sum games provides a verifiable reward, and the gains have been shown to transfer to general reasoning. Existing pipelines, however, rely on a handful of hand-written games and on advantage estimators tied to them, so both the supply of games and the advantage estimate on a large corpus limit scaling. We present GameSmith, which scales both. An LLM synthesises games inside templates whose reward, observation, and hidden-information code is fixed. Each game is verified by seed-paired replay and by an independent re-implementation of its specification, then expanded into encoding, rule, and size variants, giving 26 new games in 29 families and 336 verified variants from the three SPIRAL templates. The model is distilled from the self-play of a larger teacher (Qwen3-32B) on these games and then trained by self-play reinforcement learning with CRAB, an advantage estimator that credits each decision against a shrinkage estimate of the expected return of its position and is defined on every variant. On Qwen3-4B-Base, distillation raises the 13-benchmark mean pass@1 from 45.5 to 62.5, above the three SPIRAL games at the same budget, and self-play with CRAB reaches 64.9. The ordering holds across models, and transfer grows with the number of game families.

AI.tldr: 提出 GameSmith 框架：用 LLM 在固定模板内合成并严格验证双人零和博弈，配合能在所有变体上定义的优势估计器 CRAB，实现博弈供给与优势估计的双重规模化，从而提升 LLM 通用推理能力。
AI.motivation: 在双人零和博弈上对 LLM 做后训练可提供可验证奖励，且收益能迁移到通用推理。但现有流程依赖少量手工编写的博弈及其绑定的优势估计器，博弈供给与大规模语料上的优势估计均成为规模化瓶颈。
AI.method: 让 LLM 在奖励、观测与隐藏信息代码固定的模板内合成博弈；每个博弈经种子配对重放和独立重新实现规格两项验证，再扩展为编码、规则、规模三类变体（三个 SPIRAL 模板产出 29 个家族中的 26 个新博弈、336 个已验证变体）。模型先从更大教师（Qwen3-32B）在这些博弈上的自博弈中蒸馏，再用 CRAB 做自博弈强化学习。CRAB 将每个决策归因于其局面期望回报的收缩估计，且在每个变体上都有定义。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上，蒸馏将 13 个基准的平均 pass@1 从 45.5 提升至 62.5，高于同预算下三个 SPIRAL 博弈的效果；加入 CRAB 自博弈后达到 64.9。该排序在不同模型间保持稳定，且迁移效果随博弈家族数量增加而增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过可验证的博弈合成与通用优势估计器，GameSmith 同时突破了博弈供给与优势估计两大瓶颈，验证了零和博弈后训练对通用推理的可扩展迁移，并表明博弈家族多样性是迁移增益的关键驱动因素。

title: From Microresonator to Packaged Microcomb System: Fiber-Coupled Module and System Integration
summary: We demonstrate a compact and robust soliton microcomb source designed for field-deployable operation. A directly fiber-coupled SiN microresonator was integrated with precise thermal control into a palm-sized module, reducing the footprint and volume by 16- and 81-fold, respectively. The module, together with the laser sources and optical amplifiers required for microcomb generation, was further integrated into a 19-inch rack-mounted enclosure, achieving system-level footprint and volume reductions of 2.3- and 3.7-fold, respectively. The packaged system achieved a 90% manual startup success rate and maintained continuous soliton operation for 18.8 days, while remaining operational under substantial temperature variations. A state-based automated startup scheme using discrete microcomb-state evaluation achieved single-soliton generation without manual intervention with success rates of 50% within 2 min and 60% within 3 min. Moreover, automated soliton initiation and sustained operation were demonstrated while the packaged microresonator module was directly subjected to random mechanical vibration.
