These results provide a practical platform for compact, robust, and field-deployable microcomb sources.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种面向现场部署的紧凑稳健孤子微梳光源，将光纤耦合SiN微谐振器与热控集成于手掌大小模块，并进一步集成至19英寸机架系统，实现高成功率与长时稳定运行及自动化启动。
AI.motivation: 孤子微梳在实验室已成熟，但要实现现场部署仍需解决体积大、启动依赖人工、对环境温度与机械振动敏感、长期稳定性不足等工程化问题，因此需要构建紧凑、稳健、可现场使用的微梳光源系统。
AI.method: 采用直接光纤耦合的SiN微谐振器，集成精密热控形成手掌大小模块；再将模块与微梳产生所需激光源和光放大器集成到19英寸机架式机箱中。提出基于离散微梳状态评估的状态型自动化启动方案，实现无需人工干预的单孤子生成，并在随机机械振动下测试自动启动与持续运行。
AI.result: 模块级占地面积和体积分别缩小16倍和81倍；系统级分别缩小2.3倍和3.7倍。封装系统手动启动成功率达90%，连续孤子运行18.8天，并在显著温度变化下保持运行。自动启动方案2分钟内成功率为50%，3分钟内为60%；在微谐振器模块直接承受随机机械振动时仍实现自动孤子启动与持续运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为紧凑、稳健、可现场部署的微梳光源提供了实用化平台，表明通过模块化集成、热控与自动化启动策略，孤子微梳可从实验室系统推进到现场应用。

title: GarageWorks: A Shared Testbench Abstraction for Software Simulation and FPGA Testing
summary: GarageWorks is a lightweight FPGA testing framework that enables the same cocotb testbench to be used for both software RTL simulation and FPGA-accelerated hardware simulation. A shared abstraction hides backend-specific interfaces, while synthesizable Advanced eXtensible Interface (AXI) dispatchers provide design-under-test (DUT)-specific control and test operations on the FPGA. GarageWorks is intended for rapid bare-metal testing of standalone designs and on-chip processing logic for scientific sensors, rather than full SoC-level prototyping. The framework has been validated on AMD Alveo V80 FPGAs with several internal designs and provides initial support for AI-assisted generation of DUT-specific test components.

AI.tldr: GarageWorks是一个轻量级FPGA测试框架，使同一cocotb测试平台既能用于软件RTL仿真，也能用于FPGA硬件加速仿真。
AI.motivation: 针对独立设计及科学传感器片上处理逻辑的快速裸机测试需求，而非完整的SoC级原型验证。
AI.method: 通过共享抽象层隐藏后端专用接口，并采用可综合的AXI分发器在FPGA上实现针对被测设计（DUT）的控制与测试操作；同时初步支持AI辅助生成DUT专用测试组件。
AI.result: 已在AMD Alveo V80 FPGA上结合多个内部设计完成验证。
AI.conclusion: GarageWorks为独立设计与片上处理逻辑提供了一种轻量、可复用的FPGA加速测试方案，并具备AI辅助测试生成能力。

title: CKM-Based Predictive Beamforming for Energy-Efficient Mobile Tracking in ISCAP System
summary: This paper proposes a channel-knowledge-map (CKM)-based predictive beamforming framework for integrated sensing, communication, and powering (ISCAP) of a mobile energy-constrained node in non-line-of-sight (NLoS) multipath environments. The CKM provides location-dependent channel information for both predictive beamforming and EKF-based tracking, while resolved path parameters estimated from the sensing echoes are used as observations. Based on the predicted node location, the transmit covariance and power-splitting ratio are jointly optimized to maximize wireless power-transfer efficiency subject to communication, sensing, transmit-power, and tracking-quality constraints. A finite-battery model and an adaptive inter-frame energy-management policy are further introduced to balance decoding energy consumption and battery preservation. The resulting non-convex fractional problem is solved using Dinkelbach's method, alternating optimization, and semidefinite relaxation. Numerical results show that the proposed framework maintains reliable tracking, satisfies the prescribed position-uncertainty requirement, achieves near-oracle wireless power-transfer performance after the initial tracking transient, and preserves more battery energy while meeting the required communication quality of service.

AI.tldr: 面向NLoS多径环境中移动能量受限节点的通感传一体化(ISCAP)，提出基于信道知识地图(CKM)的预测波束赋形框架，联合优化传输协方差与功率分割比以最大化无线传能效率。
AI.motivation: 移动且能量受限的节点在NLoS多径环境下进行通感传一体化时，波束对准与能量供给面临挑战：需要位置相关信道信息支撑预测波束赋形与跟踪，同时需平衡解码能耗与电池续航，现有方法难以同时满足通信、感知、跟踪质量与传能效率的多重约束。
AI.method: 1) 利用CKM提供位置相关信道信息，用于预测波束赋形与EKF跟踪；2) 将感知回波中解算的路径参数作为观测；3) 基于预测位置联合优化发射协方差与功率分割比，在通信、感知、发射功率与跟踪质量约束下最大化无线传能效率；4) 引入有限电池模型与自适应帧间能量管理策略；5) 针对非凸分式问题，采用Dinkelbach方法、交替优化与半定松弛求解。
AI.result: 数值结果表明：该框架保持可靠跟踪，满足预设位置不确定度要求；在初始跟踪暂态后达到近似oracle的无线传能性能；在满足通信QoS的同时节省更多电池能量。
AI.conclusion: CKM辅助的预测波束赋形与联合资源优化可有效支撑NLoS多径下移动能量受限节点的ISCAP，兼顾跟踪、传能与通信QoS并提升能量效率。

title: ASSET: Adaptive Speech Segmentation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Speech large language models (LLMs) are often built using pretrained acoustic encoders as an audio interface to an LLM decoder. However, LLMs scale poorly with input sequence length, while acoustic encoders tend to produce substantially longer sequences than typical textual inputs. This motivates learning to compress encoder outputs while preserving task-oriented information. To this end, we introduce ASSET, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework that learns to adaptively compress encoder outputs by first partitioning them into variable-duration segments and then pooling each segment into a continuous audio token. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to train a segmenter with task performance feedback and a token-rate penalty. In automatic speech recognition (ASR) experiments, ASSET achieves performance comparable to a transcript-assisted character-boundary oracle with approximately 25% fewer audio tokens on English LibriSpeech, while improving on a phone-boundary oracle at a similar token rate on Mandarin AISHELL. Exploratory experiments on non-ASR tasks further illustrate how learned segmentation changes when the framework is adapted to tasks beyond transcription.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ASSET，一个基于强化学习的自适应压缩框架：先将声学编码器输出划分为变长片段，再将每个片段池化为一个连续音频 token，从而在保持任务性能的同时减少输入序列长度。
AI.motivation: 语音大语言模型通常以预训练声学编码器作为音频接口接入 LLM 解码器。但 LLM 对输入序列长度的扩展性较差，而声学编码器产生的序列往往远长于典型文本输入，因此需要在不损失任务相关信息的前提下压缩编码器输出。现有压缩方式多为固定速率或依赖外部边界标注，难以自适应地保留任务导向信息。
AI.method: ASSET 将编码器输出自适应切分为时长可变的片段（segment），并对每个片段做池化，得到单个连续音频 token。使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练一个 segmenter，奖励信号由任务性能反馈与 token 速率惩罚共同构成，从而在压缩率与任务表现之间进行权衡。
AI.result: 在 ASR 实验中，英语 LibriSpeech 上 ASSET 在约减少 25% 音频 token 的情况下，性能与使用转写辅助的字符边界 oracle 相当；在中文 AISHELL 上，在相近 token 速率下优于音素边界 oracle。在非 ASR 任务的探索性实验中，作者进一步展示了框架适配到转写以外任务时，所学到的分段方式会随之变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于 RL 的变长分段与池化能够实现任务导向的音频 token 压缩，在降低序列长度与 token 速率的同时保持甚至超越基于边界标注的 oracle 基线；且该分段策略会随任务类型自适应变化，具备向非转写任务推广的潜力。

title: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
summary: Pixel-space world models have recently emerged as a promising approach for GUI agents, predicting future screens prior to execution and subsequently re-perceiving them for action selection. However, this two-stage paradigm faces two key challenges in GUI environments: (L1) the high computational cost of pixel reconstruction and (L2) the need to reconstruct large and diverse appearance-level details beyond what is required for action selection. In practice, this screen-generation objective can induce an identity shortcut problem, where future-state prediction largely preserves the current state rather than capturing action-induced changes. In this work, we reformulate GUI world modeling by shifting the prediction target from full-screen reconstruction to action-induced future information in latent space. Concretely, we leverage a large multimodal model as the latent world model, whose shared representations support two dedicated heads for both action selection and predictive transition modeling. The action head directly translates these latent representations into action selection, while the transition head captures action-conditioned future information. To mitigate the identity shortcut, we further introduce an action-aware contrastive objective that encourages the transition representations to capture discriminative action-induced changes. Extensive experiments across offline and online GUI settings show that our method achieves up to 31.9% and 40.6% relative gains in success rate over pixel-space world models, respectively, while substantially reducing inference latency by up to 98.9%. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/latent2world.

AI.tldr: 该工作将GUI世界建模的预测目标从像素级全屏重建转为潜在空间中的动作诱导未来信息，用大模型共享表示配合动作头与转移头，并引入动作感知对比目标缓解身份捷径问题，成功率相对像素空间世界模型最高提升31.9%（离线）与40.6%（在线），推理延迟降低最多98.9%。
AI.motivation: 像素空间世界模型采用"预测未来屏幕再重新感知以选择动作"的两阶段范式，在GUI环境中存在两大问题：(L1) 像素重建计算开销高；(L2) 需要重建大量与动作选择无关的外观级细节。这种屏幕生成目标易导致身份捷径（identity shortcut）问题，即未来状态预测倾向于保留当前状态而非捕捉动作诱导的变化。
AI.method: 将GUI世界建模的预测目标从全屏像素重建改为潜在空间中动作诱导的未来信息。具体使用大型多模态模型作为潜在世界模型，其共享表示支撑两个专用头：动作头将潜在表示直接映射为动作选择，转移头捕捉动作条件下的未来信息。同时引入动作感知对比目标（action-aware contrastive objective），促使转移表示捕捉具有判别性的动作诱导变化，以缓解身份捷径问题。
AI.result: 在离线与在线GUI设置下的大量实验表明，相比像素空间世界模型，本方法成功率分别取得最高31.9%与40.6%的相对提升，同时推理延迟最高降低98.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜在空间中建模动作诱导的未来信息，并配合动作感知对比学习，可有效规避像素重建的高成本与身份捷径问题，显著提升GUI智能体的成功率并大幅降低推理延迟；代码已开源。

title: Cross-Modal Latent Influence: Patch-Level Training Sample Attribution for Vision-Language Models
summary: Explaining a vision--language model (VLM) prediction requires tracing training-example influence to the multimodal evidence that mediates it, yet existing attribution methods largely operate only at the sample level. Recent latent-mediated influence methods provide feature-level attribution in language models, but lack the multimodal and spatial structure needed to ground influence in VLMs. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orthogonalized Sparse Autoencoders for Influence Characterization). It learns a shared sparse image--text latent space whose concepts are 1) sparse within each modality, 2) supported on contiguous image regions, 3) aligned to the phrases that describe them, and 4) approximately decorrelated. It then applies EK-FAC to decompose training-example influence through these concepts and localize their contributions to specific text phrases and image regions. We evaluate MOSAIC on Qwen and Gemma across captioning, chest X-ray understanding, and visual question answering. The learned features are more localized and coherent without degrading task behavior, and ablating influence-ranked latents changes model outputs more than ablating latents ranked by activation or frequency. We find that visual evidence can substantially reorganize training-data attribution while preserving more of the shared latent structure. MOSAIC thus connects where model behavior comes from with what multimodal evidence carries that influence.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC提出一种多模态正交化稀疏自编码器，学习共享的图像-文本稀疏隐空间，并通过EK-FAC将训练样本影响力分解到概念级并定位到具体文本短语和图像区域，实现VLM预测的细粒度多模态归因。
AI.motivation: 解释视觉-语言模型（VLM）的预测需要将训练样本影响力追溯到中介它的多模态证据，但现有归因方法大多只在样本级别操作。近期潜在中介影响力方法虽在语言模型中提供了特征级归因，却缺乏VLM所需的多模态与空间结构，无法将影响力锚定到具体图像区域和文本短语。
AI.method: 提出MOSAIC，学习一个共享的稀疏图像-文本隐空间，其概念满足四个约束：1）各模态内稀疏；2）支撑于连续图像区域；3）与描述它们的短语对齐；4）近似去相关。随后应用EK-FAC沿这些概念分解训练样本影响力，并将其贡献定位到具体文本短语和图像区域。在Qwen和Gemma上针对图像描述、胸部X光理解和视觉问答任务进行评估。
AI.result: 所学特征更具局部性和连贯性，且不损害任务行为；消融按影响力排序的潜在特征比按激活或频率排序的潜在特征更能改变模型输出。研究发现视觉证据能显著重组训练数据归因，同时保留更多共享潜在结构。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC将"模型行为来自何处"与"何种多模态证据承载该影响力"连接起来，为VLM提供了概念级、空间与文本可定位的影响力归因框架。

title: Splicing Hints into Reasoning Traces: Learning from Demonstrator Failures
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves mathematical reasoning when a final answer can be checked, but a correct answer does not certify the derivation behind it, and proof problems offer no answer to check. Replacing the check with a reasoning model as an in-loop verifier faces a fundamental obstacle: the policy must already produce occasional correct attempts for any reward to exist, which it may never do at olympiad level. We instead move verification and repair out of the training loop and into offline data generation with SPLICE, a workflow in which a second model, given only a reference solution, edits a reasoning model's traces as they are generated: it verifies progress, truncates a failed trace at its last verified step, and splices in an adaptively strengthened hint until progress resumes. The resulting dataset includes repaired examples whose sampled unaided trajectory failed, with failed continuations removed and progress repeatedly checked against the reference solution. A model finetuned on SPLICE traces outperforms the same model distilled from the reasoning model's unedited traces on AIME and, under a grading protocol validated against human grades, on olympiad proofs. The trained model's own traces show a corresponding behavioral signature: at difficult points it announces a branch in the style of the spliced hints and takes riskier steps, with predictive entropy rising there and just after, a pattern absent from the model trained on unedited traces.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPLICE 离线数据生成流程，用第二模型仅凭参考解对推理轨迹进行验证、截断与提示拼接，生成含"修复样本"的数据集，从而绕开在环验证器对策略已有正确尝试的依赖。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习依赖最终答案可校验，但答案正确不等于推导正确，证明题更无可校验答案；若改用在环推理模型作验证器，又要求策略本身已能偶尔产生正确尝试，而奥赛级别任务中这种尝试可能从不出现，导致奖励信号始终缺失。
AI.method: 将验证与修复移出训练循环，置于离线数据生成阶段。第二模型仅接收参考解，在推理模型生成轨迹的同时进行编辑：验证当前进展，在被验证失败处截断轨迹，并拼接自适应增强的提示，直至进展恢复。最终数据集包含采样无辅助轨迹失败但被修复的样本，已删除失败续写，并对进展反复对照参考解校验。
AI.result: 在 SPLICE 轨迹上微调的模型，在 AIME 上优于由同一推理模型未编辑轨迹蒸馏的模型；在经人类评分验证的评分协议下，奥赛证明题上同样更优。训练后模型自身轨迹呈现相应行为特征：在困难处会以拼接提示的风格宣告分支并采取更高风险步骤，预测熵在该处及之后升高，而未编辑轨迹训练模型无此模式。
AI.conclusion: 离线验证与修复可作为在环验证的替代路径，使策略无需预先具备正确尝试即可获得有效监督；修复式数据不仅提升答案与证明表现，还在模型轨迹中留下可辨识的分支宣告与熵升高的行为印记。

title: Tornado Wave-Encoded Point Spread Functions for Multi-Period Three-Dimensional Localization Imaging
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) localization microscopy using rotational point spread functions (PSFs) is fundamentally challenged by limited axial range, poor PSF compactness, and depth-decoding ambiguity -- particularly in dense specimens with heavy PSF overlap. To address these limitations, we introduce a 3D localization approach based on tornado wave (ToW)-PSFs, combined with a convolutional neural network (CNN) designed to decode continuous rotational patterns and resolve multi-period axial ambiguity. Our engineered PSF encodes the 3D position of each nanoparticle into a compact double-lobe pattern whose orientation rotates with axial position. This design yields a clean, well-defined structural evolution across an unprecedented 15 um axial range, with an average rotation rate of 21.8 degrees/um, ensuring robust long-range depth encoding. To recover coordinates from overlapping emitters, we systematically benchmark a conventional matching-pursuit (MP) algorithm against our CNN. While MP performs adequately in sparse scenes, the CNN demonstrates exceptional robustness in dense fields, achieving a 70.24% localization accuracy at 20 particles per image-substantially outperforming MP's 22.52% -- while also significantly suppressing axial period-jump errors. Experimental validation on nanoparticles confirms reliable single- and multi-particle localization throughout the entire working range. Our results establish ToW-PSFs as a powerful and practical optical encoding strategy for high-density, extended-range 3D localization imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出基于tornado波点扩散函数(ToW-PSF)的三维定位方法，结合CNN解码连续旋转模式并消除多周期轴向模糊，实现15 μm超大轴向范围、21.8°/μm旋转率的高密度三维单分子/纳米粒子定位。
AI.motivation: 基于旋转PSF的三维定位显微存在轴向范围有限、PSF紧凑性差、深度解码存在模糊等问题，尤其在高密度样本中PSF严重重叠时表现不佳。需要一种兼具长轴向范围、紧凑编码与抗重叠解码能力的光学编码策略。
AI.method: 设计ToW-PSF，将纳米粒子的三维位置编码为紧凑双瓣图案，其取向随轴向位置连续旋转；采用CNN解码连续旋转模式并解决多周期轴向歧义；系统对比传统匹配追踪(MP)算法与CNN在多粒子重叠场景下的定位性能。
AI.result: ToW-PSF在15 μm轴向范围内呈现清晰、定义明确的结构演化，平均旋转率21.8°/μm；在每幅图像20个粒子的密集场景下，CNN定位准确率达70.24%，显著优于MP的22.52%，并大幅抑制轴向周期跳变误差；纳米粒子实验验证了全工作范围内可靠的单粒子和多粒子定位。
AI.conclusion: ToW-PSF是一种强大且实用的光学编码策略，适用于高密度、扩展轴向范围的三维定位成像，CNN解码在密集重叠场景中相较传统MP具有显著优势。

title: LizTail: Unifying Shape Adaptation and Spatial Parallelism with Segment-Reconfigurable Systolic Arrays
summary: Systolic arrays are widely used to accelerate neural-network inference, yet fixed two-dimensional arrays struggle with the substantial diversity in both matrix geometry and available parallelism across CNNs and Transformer-based large language models. This mismatch is particularly severe for skinny matrices, small-batch autoregressive decoding, and operators containing multiple independent partitions, leading to low processing-element (PE) utilization and repeated spatial folding. Existing reconfigurable arrays typically improve either shape adaptation or distributed execution, whereas supporting both through fine-grained routing incurs considerable interconnect, buffering, and control overheads. We present LizTail (named after lizard tail autotomy, where predefined fracture planes allow segments to detach and remain independently active, analogous to LizTail's predefined reconfiguration boundaries), a multi-mode systolic array that enables constrained segment-level reconfiguration by partitioning a $128\times128$ array into 32 regular $128\times4$ segments and adding connectivity only at predefined endpoints. The resulting substrate supports trimming, long-path extension through $180^\circ$ turn-back connections, and distributed execution in which each subarray can itself be trimmed or extended. Differentiated PE datapaths and segment-aware CEB/SIB buffers provide the required compute and data-delivery flexibility without unrestricted PE-level routing. A hardware-constrained mapper selects the execution organization, dataflow, task partition, and tiling. Across representative workloads, LizTail achieves geometric-mean speedups of $5.02\times$ on CNN inference and $25.67\times$ on LLM decoding over a TPU-like array, while reducing EDP by up to $38.23\times$. LizTail is open-sourced at https://github.com/kmjbwxa/LizTail.

AI.tldr: LizTail 通过将 128×128 脉动阵列划分为 32 个 128×4 段并在预定义端点增加连接，实现段级多模式重构，以低成本同时支持形状适配与分布式执行，在 CNN 推理和 LLM 解码上相对类 TPU 阵列获得显著加速与能效提升。
AI.motivation: 固定二维脉动阵列难以适应 CNN 与 Transformer 大模型在矩阵几何形状和可用并行度上的巨大差异，尤其对瘦长矩阵、小批量自回归解码及多独立分区算子，易导致 PE 利用率低和反复空间折叠。现有可重构阵列通常只能改善形状适配或分布式执行之一，若用细粒度路由同时支持二者，则会带来较高的互连、缓存与控制开销。
AI.method: LizTail 将 128×128 阵列划分为 32 个规则的 128×4 段，仅在预定义端点增加连接，形成受约束的段级重构基板。该基板支持三种模式：裁剪、通过 180° 折返连接实现长路径扩展，以及分布式执行（每个子阵列可独立裁剪或扩展）。配合差异化 PE 数据通路和段感知 CEB/SIB 缓冲，在不引入无约束 PE 级路由的前提下提供计算与数据供给灵活性。硬件约束映射器负责选择执行组织、数据流、任务划分与分块策略。
AI.result: 在代表性工作负载上，LizTail 相对类 TPU 阵列在 CNN 推理上取得 5.02× 几何平均加速，在 LLM 解码上取得 25.67× 几何平均加速，并将 EDP 最多降低 38.23×。项目已开源于 https://github.com/kmjbwxa/LizTail。
AI.conclusion: 受蜥蜴断尾（预定义断裂面使段可分离并独立活动）启发，LizTail 用预定义重构边界的段级多模式脉动阵列，以有限互连开销同时实现形状适配与分布式执行，显著提升异构神经网络负载下的 PE 利用率和能效。

title: Transfer learning-aided, artificial intelligence approach to evaluate optical properties of materials for classical and quantum photonic applications
summary: In this study, an artificial intelligence-assisted evaluation of the refractive indices of different materials is performed. The evaluation of the refractive index is necessary to design photonic devices for various classical and quantum photonic applications, and to theoretically analyse experimental results. The refractive index is one of the crucial parameters that affect the interaction of light with matter. Although the refractive index can be measured experimentally, its estimation via computational means provide the advantage of not requiring costly instrumentation, trained researchers and could avoid potential laboratory-based uncertainties. Therefore, in this study, artificial intelligence is implemented to estimate the optical constants of two types of materials, i.e., noble metals, and semiconductors. To this end, an artificial neural network is used to estimate the real and the imaginary parts of the refractive index of a specific material for various wavelengths of light. Then, the knowledge of the trained neural network is employed to initiate and train new neural networks to estimate the refractive indices of other materials. For the training of a neural network, various methods can be deployed. However, the application of the training can be a time-consuming process. A transfer learning approach is here implemented to provide a faster training solution for the problem under study. The implementation of transfer learning allows training the neural networks for a new material with higher speed or accuracy when compared to non-knowledge transfer-based training. Our results show the efficiency of the proposed technique in accurately evaluating the real and imaginary parts of the refractive index of different materials.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于人工神经网络与迁移学习的方法，用于快速、准确地估算贵金属与半导体等材料的折射率实部和虚部，避免昂贵实验测量。
AI.motivation: 折射率是影响光与物质相互作用的关键参数，对光子器件设计和实验结果理论分析至关重要。虽然可实验测量，但需昂贵仪器与专业人员，且存在实验室不确定性，因此希望以计算方式估算。
AI.method: 采用人工神经网络估算特定材料在不同波长下的折射率实部与虚部；再将已训练网络的知识用于初始化并训练新网络，以估算其他材料。引入迁移学习以加速训练，并比较知识迁移与非知识迁移训练的效果。
AI.result: 迁移学习可使新材料的神经网络训练在速度或精度上优于非知识迁移训练；结果证明该方法能准确估算不同材料的折射率实部与虚部。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能，特别是结合迁移学习的神经网络方法，可高效、准确地评估多种材料的光学常数，为光子器件设计与理论分析提供无需昂贵实验仪器的替代方案。

title: UAV-Mounted Hybrid RIS-Assisted ISAC-RSMA: Performance Analysis with Imperfect CSI and SIC
summary: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, strict sensing requirements can substantially constrain the transmit power available for communication. A hybrid reconfigurable intelligent surface (HRIS) with passive reflection and active amplification capabilities mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can enhance coverage and strengthen communication links in such power-limited regimes. Meanwhile, rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) provides an effective transmission strategy for managing inter-user interference, particularly in dense multiuser wireless scenarios. Motivated by this, we analyze the performance of a UAV-mounted HRIS-assisted monostatic ISAC system employing RSMA scheme. We consider the imperfections in the channel state information and successive interference cancellation in the RSMA, which are inevitable in practical system implementations. We then derive highly accurate expressions for outage probability, ergodic rate, and throughput to evaluate communication performance over Nakagami-$m$ fading channels. These expressions reveal key insights into the diversity order and coding gain of the system in the high signal-to-noise ratio regime. To characterize the sensing performance, we derive expressions for the probability of detection, the probability of false alarm, and the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Numerical results validate the theoretical findings and highlight the performance gains of the proposed system over conventional multiple-access schemes and RIS-based systems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了一种无人机搭载混合可重构智能表面（HRIS）辅助的单站ISAC系统，采用速率分割多址（RSMA）方案，在考虑CSI与SIC不完美的情况下，推导了Nakagami-m衰落信道下的通信与感知性能指标。
AI.motivation: ISAC系统中严格的感知需求会显著限制通信可用发射功率；无人机搭载兼具无源反射与有源放大能力的HRIS可增强覆盖并强化链路，而RSMA能有效管理多用户干扰，二者结合有望在功率受限场景下提升性能，故需对其性能进行理论分析。
AI.method: 构建无人机搭载HRIS辅助的单站ISAC系统模型并采用RSMA传输方案，考虑信道状态信息与连续干扰消除的不完美性，在Nakagami-m衰落信道下推导中断概率、遍历速率、吞吐量的高精度表达式，并推导检测概率、虚警概率及克拉美-罗下界以刻画感知性能，最后通过数值仿真验证。
AI.result: 所得表达式揭示了高信噪比区间系统的分集阶数与编码增益等关键特性；数值结果验证了理论推导的正确性，并表明所提系统相较传统多址方案与基于RIS的系统具有性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 无人机搭载HRIS辅助的RSMA-ISAC系统在功率受限的多用户场景下可同时改善通信与感知性能，且优于传统多址和RIS方案，为实际系统设计提供了理论依据。

title: Evaluating LLMs as Agentic Workflow Executors in Real-World Customer Support Skills
summary: Enterprise customer-support agents increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to execute bounded, tool-using workflows. We study this problem through the lens of Skill LLMs: specialized executors that operate within a selected skill context and must complete a narrow, stateful workflow under policy and tool constraints. We present a benchmark construction pipeline that mines recurrent workflows from real-world transcripts, converts them into structured skill descriptions, maps them to tool requirements, simulates environment state with Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible mocks, and generates multi-turn tool-using dialogues. Using this benchmark, we conduct a large-scale zero-shot evaluation of 17 language models spanning closed model families and deployment-oriented open-weight models from 1.7B to 14B parameters, each judged independently by five strong LLM judges, plus a deterministic rule-based evaluator that checks tool coverage, hallucinated tool use, and unsupported claims. We find a consistent ranking in which GPT-5.4 leads by a wide margin and QWEN3.5-9B is the strongest open-weight model (below 20B), outperforming several closed baselines under every judge. We also find that judge choice is not a negligible methodological detail: pairwise judge agreement on the pass/fail verdict averages Kappa=0.524 across 10 judge pairs. These results suggest that comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of skill execution requires judge reliability as carefully as model capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Skill LLMs 概念与基准构建流水线，从真实客服对话中挖掘工作流并生成多轮工具调用评测集，对 17 个模型做零样本评测，发现 GPT-5.4 大幅领先、QWEN3.5-9B 为最强开源模型，且评审者一致性仅为中等水平（平均 Kappa=0.524）。
AI.motivation: 企业客服智能体日益依赖大模型在受限的工具化工作流中执行任务，但缺乏针对"技能执行"这一窄域、有状态流程的系统评测手段。现有评测多关注通用能力，未同时覆盖策略约束、工具覆盖、幻觉工具调用与无依据断言等维度；此外，多评审者评分的可靠性问题常被当作可忽略的细节。
AI.method: 构建基准生成流水线：从真实对话记录中挖掘高频复现工作流→转化为结构化技能描述→映射到工具需求→用兼容 MCP 的 mock 模拟环境状态→生成多轮工具调用对话。基于该基准，对 17 个语言模型（覆盖闭源家族与 1.7B–14B 面向部署的开源权重模型）进行大规模零样本评测，采用 5 个强 LLM 评审独立打分，并辅以确定性规则评估器检查工具覆盖、幻觉工具使用和无依据断言。
AI.result: 评测呈现一致排名：GPT-5.4 大幅领先；QWEN3.5-9B 是 20B 以下最强开源权重模型，在所有评审者下均优于若干闭源基线。同时，评审者选择并非可忽略的方法学细节：10 组评审者对中，pass/fail 判定的一致率平均仅 Kappa=0.524。
AI.conclusion: 技能执行的零样本评测不仅要关注模型能力，还需同等重视评审者可靠性；中等水平的评审一致性表明，单一评审或单一指标可能高估评测结论的稳定性，未来工作应引入更稳健的评审机制与规则化校验相结合。

title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
summary: Slider-based control aims to give users continuous, fine-grained control over the intensity of individual edits in instruction-based image editing. However, existing approaches fail to deliver reliable continuous controllability: traversing a slider can produce abrupt visual jumps and non-monotonic changes, while jointly controlled sliders can interfere with one another. To systematically study these limitations, we introduce SlideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for continuous image editing spanning diverse editing categories and equipped with a unified suite of metrics quantifying monotonic progression, perceptual continuity, and inter-slider disentanglement. Building on these observations, we propose SliderEdit++, which explicitly regularizes the intermediate editing trajectory rather than supervising only its endpoints. Our method combines velocity- and semantic-space trajectory regularization with spectral control to encourage smooth, predictable slider traversal, together with a disentanglement objective that reduces interference between independently controlled edits. On SlideBench, SliderEdit++ achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the overall score by 18.5% relative to the strongest baseline. At the same time, using a few-step editing backbone makes our method approximately 3x to 20x faster than existing slider-based approaches, enabling substantially more responsive interactive editing.

AI.tldr: 提出连续图像编辑基准SlideBench与轨迹正则化方法SliderEdit++，实现平滑、单调、可解耦的滑块控制，并提速3–20倍。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的图像编辑中，滑块控制旨在让用户对单次编辑强度进行连续、细粒度调节，但现有方法难以提供可靠的连续可控性：滑动滑块会出现突兀的视觉跳变与非单调变化，多个滑块联合控制时还会相互干扰。作者希望系统性地研究并解决这些局限。
AI.method: 首先构建SlideBench基准，覆盖多种编辑类别，并提供统一指标集，量化单调递进性、感知连续性与滑块间解耦度。在此基础上提出SliderEdit++：不再只监督编辑轨迹的端点，而是显式正则化中间编辑轨迹；方法结合速度空间与语义空间的轨迹正则化以及谱控制，促使滑块遍历平滑可预测，并引入解耦目标以减少独立编辑之间的干扰。
AI.result: 在SlideBench上，SliderEdit++取得最优性能，总体得分相对最强基线提升18.5%。同时，借助少步（few-step）编辑骨干网络，方法比现有基于滑块的方法快约3倍至20倍，使交互式编辑响应更为迅捷。
AI.conclusion: 通过基准构建与中间轨迹正则化，可实现可靠、平滑且相互解耦的连续滑块编辑，并在效果与效率上同时显著优于现有方法，为响应式交互图像编辑提供了可行方案。

title: Should SLMs be in the Driver's Seat? A Study of Local Models as Interpreters in Cloud-Written Agent Programs
comment: Accepted at SLM-Agents: 1st Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems, NeurIPS 2026
summary: The most accurate agents executing user-provided tasks are driven by large, cloud-hosted models, which solve them by reading the private data of the user. Agents powered by models small enough to run on edge devices keep that data local, but yield far worse results. A third option is to have cloud models write a program that devices execute: the data stays local, but as the program is written before any data is seen, it fails whenever a step depends on interpreting content that appears only at run time. We explore an intermediate architecture, in which the cloud-written program defers bounded questions over user data to a small local model through an ordinary function call. On AppWorld this improves the success rate of a code-only agent in all six combinations of backbone model and test partition we evaluate, by up to 14.9pp, recovering a substantial part of the gap to a cloud-hosted ReAct loop while keeping user data on the device.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种混合架构：云端模型编写程序，程序在运行时就用户数据的限定问题通过函数调用委托给本地小模型处理。在AppWorld上，该方法在全部六种骨干模型与测试划分组合中均提升了纯代码智能体的成功率，最高提升14.9个百分点，在保持数据本地化的同时显著缩小了与云端ReAct循环的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有方案存在三方权衡困境：云端大模型智能体准确率高但需读取用户私有数据，存在隐私风险；本地边缘小模型保证数据本地化但效果差；云端模型编写程序供设备执行虽能保护数据，但程序在见到数据前就已写完，无法处理依赖运行时内容解释的步骤，因而失败。
AI.method: 提出一种介于纯云端与纯本地之间的中间架构：由云端模型编写程序，程序在执行过程中将针对用户数据的"有界问题（bounded questions）"通过普通函数调用，动态委托给部署在设备上的小模型来解答，从而兼顾本地数据隐私与运行时内容理解能力。
AI.result: 在AppWorld基准上，该方法在所评估的全部六种骨干模型与测试划分组合中，均提升了纯代码智能体的成功率，最高提升14.9个百分点，并恢复了相对于云端ReAct循环差距的相当一部分，同时保持用户数据留存于设备端。
AI.conclusion: 通过在云端程序与本地小模型之间引入函数调用式的有界问题委托机制，可在保护用户数据隐私的前提下显著提升智能体任务执行成功率，为兼顾隐私与性能的智能体架构提供了可行方向。

title: Enhanced Trading Systems with Intelligent Market Analysis
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 algorithms, 1 table. Accepted at ICAIA 2026 (proceedings pending)
summary: This paper proposes a hybrid reinforcement learning trading framework integrating intraday market data with transformer-based financial sentiment signals. The system extracts sentiment dynamics and semantic event clusters from financial news and incorporates them into a PPO-based trading agent. Experiments on intraday NSE data demonstrate improved risk-adjusted returns compared to price-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合强化学习交易框架，将日内行情与基于Transformer的金融情绪信号融合，通过PPO智能体提升风险调整后收益。
AI.motivation: 传统交易智能体多依赖价格等数值型行情数据，忽略金融新闻中的情绪动态与语义事件信息，导致决策信号不完备、风险调整后表现受限。本文旨在把非结构化文本信息有效引入强化学习交易决策。
AI.method: 构建混合强化学习框架：先用Transformer模型从金融新闻中提取情绪动态与语义事件聚类特征，再与日内市场数据融合，作为PPO（近端策略优化）交易智能体的状态输入进行策略学习。
AI.result: 在NSE日内数据上的实验表明，该框架相较仅使用价格信息的基线方法在风险调整后收益上有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将Transformer金融情绪信号与日内行情结合可有效增强强化学习交易智能体的决策质量，验证了多模态信号融合在量化交易中的价值。

title: Intrinsic Orbital Nernst Effect in Real Photonic Bands
summary: We predict an intrinsic orbital Nernst effect in reciprocal photonic lattices with real Bloch modes. In the collisionless regime, a thermal gradient generates a transverse angular-displacement response although band angular moments and ordinary Berry curvatures vanish. The response is carried by angular-density dipoles formed through virtual mixing of distinct spatial modes. Their correlation with band velocity survives thermal averaging and is independently recovered from the angular-density readout of unitarily evolved wave packets. Two controls expose the mechanism: a fixed-generator two-level system has zero antisymmetric intrinsic response, and flattening the dispersion suppresses transport without changing the eigenstates. A canonical scalar Maxwell calculation realizes the effect through symmetry-selected virtual channels, even when one band dominates the thermal population. These findings establish an orbital-dipole mechanism for intrinsic thermal angular transport in real photonic bands.

AI.tldr: 该文预测了具有实布洛赫模的互易光子晶格中存在本征轨道能斯特效应：在无碰撞区，热梯度可激发横向角位移响应，该响应由角密度偶极子承载，并与能带速度相关，可通过波包幺正演化的角密度读出独立恢复。
AI.motivation: 在角动量矩与常规贝里曲率均为零的情形下，是否存在本征的热致横向角输运机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示一种由角密度偶极子驱动、可在实光子能带中实现的本征轨道能斯特效应。
AI.method: 在具有实布洛赫模的互易光子晶格中，于无碰撞区分析热梯度下的横向角位移响应；通过不同空间模式的虚混合构建角密度偶极子，并考察其与能带速度的关联；利用幺正演化波包的角密度读出独立验证。采用两类对照：固定生成元的两能级系统（反对称本征响应为零）与色散平坦化（不改变本征态而抑制输运）。并以典型标量麦克斯韦计算，通过对称性选择的虚通道实现该效应。
AI.result: 在角动量矩与常规贝里曲率均为零的条件下，热梯度产生了非零的横向角位移响应；角密度偶极子与能带速度的相关性在热平均后依然存在，并可由波包角密度读出独立恢复；两能级对照系统呈现零反对称本征响应，色散平坦化在不改变本征态的前提下抑制了输运；标量麦克斯韦计算通过对称性选择的虚通道实现了该效应，即使单一能带主导热布居时亦然。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了实光子能带中本征热致角输运的轨道偶极子机制，表明角密度偶极子可作为独立于贝里曲率的角输运载体，为光子晶格中热-角输运调控提供了新原理。

title: SafeDSE: Joint Exploration of Safety Architecture Patterns, Mapping, and Scheduling for Dataflow Applications With Safety Arguments (Extended Version)
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures, 29 tables. Extended version of a paper submitted for publication; tool and data at github.com/SBU-CPS-Lab/SafeDSE
summary: Embedded platforms increasingly host safety-related streaming functions next to less critical ones. Whether a safety architecture pattern, such as a doer/checker pair, protects a function depends on the cores that run its components. Their schedule must meet the throughput requirement, and mixing safety integrity levels (SILs) on one core raises development cost. This report presents SafeDSE, a design space exploration framework for synchronous dataflow applications. One declarative constraint model decides the pattern of each actor, the placement that the fault model requires, the static-order schedule, and the platform, and prices SIL promotion. Guards activate the chosen patterns in a fixed graph that holds all of them, and node potentials encode throughput. An independent verifier re-checks every solution, and a generator turns its checks into evidence of a safety argument in Goal Structuring Notation. On 9 benchmark instances under period bounds, no rule that fixes patterns before mapping was both always feasible and never more expensive under conservative pricing, while joint exploration was. In the generated arguments, 49 to 62% of the leaves cite verifier checks; the rest are claims a mapping cannot discharge. Optimality within the model was proven for all synthetic graphs with up to 16 actors. This extended version adds the full model, the verifier and generator in detail, the complete catalog and parameters, and a proof of the potential characterization. It also reports every experiment per instance, a mutation analysis of the verifier, and the negative results of the development.

AI.tldr: 提出 SafeDSE，一个面向同步数据流应用的设计空间探索框架，用统一声明式约束模型联合决定 actor 模式、映射、静态调度与平台，并对 SIL 提升定价，在 9 个基准实例上优于先定模式再映射的规则。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式平台常在同一系统中混合托管安全相关与非关键流式功能。安全架构模式（如 doer/checker 对）能否保护某功能取决于运行其组件的核心；调度须满足吞吐要求，而在同一核心上混合不同安全完整性等级会推高开发成本。因此需要将模式选择、映射、调度和平台选择联合考虑。
AI.method: SafeDSE 使用一个声明式约束模型统一决定每个 actor 的模式、故障模型要求的放置、静态顺序调度以及平台，并对 SIL 提升定价。采用包含所有模式的固定图，由 guard 激活所选模式，以节点势能编码吞吐。独立验证器复核每个解，生成器将其检查转换为 GSN 安全论证证据。实验覆盖 9 个基准实例（周期约束下），并包含验证器的变异分析。
AI.result: 在周期约束下的 9 个基准实例中，任何先固定模式再映射的规则都无法同时做到始终可行且在保守定价下不更昂贵；联合探索可以。生成的论证中 49%–62% 的叶子引用验证器检查，其余为映射无法完成的声明。对最多 16 个 actor 的合成图均证明了模型内最优性。
AI.conclusion: 联合设计空间探索在安全关键流式应用上优于分阶段决策，并能自动生成具备可验证证据的安全论证。扩展版补充了完整模型、验证器与生成器细节、完整目录与参数、势能刻画证明，以及逐实例实验、验证器变异分析和开发过程中的负面结果。

title: Chiral Vector Beams for Topological Enantio-Sensitive Imaging
summary: Molecular chiral discrimination is vital across chemistry and life sciences, yet optical approaches remain highly inefficient for small organic molecules. Here we turn vector beams, whose polarization carries a topological charge, into an efficient probe of molecular handedness. We show that the combination of a tightly focused radially polarized beam at the fundamental frequency ω and an azimuthally polarized beam at 2ω creates chiral vector beams, a locally chiral field with structured handedness. Using state-of-the-art computational modeling in the chiral molecule carvone, we show that the nonlinear response (notably sum-frequency generation) of randomly oriented chiral molecules to this chiral vector beam captures the fields' local handedness and is highly enantio-sensitive. The two enantiomers emit light at frequency 3ω with topological ring structures of different divergence, and thus the molecular handedness can be read out directly from the ring radius. The signal inherits the Poincaré index of the driving field, opening up new ways to robust, ultrafast, and and all-optical chiral discrimination.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出利用"手性矢量光束"（ω径向偏振光与2ω方位角偏振光组合）作为高效探针，通过非线性求和频率产生实现对随机取向手性分子的高对映选择性识别，信号以3ω环状结构的半径差异直接读出分子手性。
AI.motivation: 分子手性识别在化学与生命科学中至关重要，但现有光学方法对小分子有机物的识别效率很低，亟需一种高效的全光学手性探测手段。
AI.method: 构建由紧聚焦径向偏振光束（基频ω）与方位角偏振光束（2ω）叠加形成的手性矢量光束，即具有结构化手性的局域手性场；以手性分子香芹酮为对象，采用先进计算建模研究随机取向手性分子对该场的非线性响应（主要是求和频率产生）。
AI.result: 手性矢量光束的非线性响应可捕捉场的局域手性，表现出高度对映敏感性；两种对映体在3ω频率发射具有不同发散度的拓扑环结构，可通过环半径直接读出分子手性；信号继承驱动场的庞加莱指数。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为稳健、超快、全光学的手性识别开辟了新途径。

title: Physics-Informed Unsupervised Learning for Reliable Beamforming in Cluttered MIMO-ISAC
summary: In this paper, we consider joint beamforming and power allocation for a mobile multiuser MIMO integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) network with clutter, residual self-interference, and outdated channel state information, under per-user rate and sensing signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) constraints that must hold on every realization. The design must be recomputed every block, and distant or weak targets can make the sensing constraint unmeetable. We propose a physics-informed unsupervised learning (PI-UnSL) network that corrects the analytical design, meets the power and norm constraints exactly by construction, and is conditioned on closed-form interference statistics, spanning the whole tradeoff in one pass. We derive a closed-form sensing SINR at the interference-aware combiner, yielding a necessary range-radar-cross-section-power condition and a priority-independent analytic violation floor, so the problem is intermittently infeasible. We then show that a dual targeting below the attainable floor has no fixed point, and calibrate the label-free objective against the measured floor. Numerical results confirm the floor and the bounded calibrated dual, and show that PI-UnSL substantially raises per-realization joint quality of service over the closed-form baseline, delivers more rate than time-division ISAC at matched detection over most of the tradeoff, and exceeds the reliability of an uncalibrated alternating-optimization solver at a fraction of its latency. More broadly, the physical knowledge given to the network, not its architecture, makes such problems learnable without labels: five architectures fail alike from scratch and perform alike when started from the closed-form design and conditioned on its interference statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含杂波、残余自干扰和过时CSI的移动多用户MIMO ISAC网络联合波束成形与功率分配问题，提出物理信息无监督学习（PI-UnSL）方法，在逐块严格满足约束的前提下跨越整个性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 该设计需每块重算，且远处或弱目标可能导致感知约束不可满足，问题间歇性不可行；传统解析设计与交替优化在时延和可靠性上受限，且缺乏标签。
AI.method: 推导干扰感知合并器下的闭式感知SINR，给出必要距离-雷达截面积-功率条件与优先级无关的解析违反下界；证明低于可达下界的对偶目标无不动点，并据此校准无标签目标；构建PI-UnSL网络，按构造严格满足功率与范数约束，以闭式干扰统计为条件，一次前向覆盖全部权衡。
AI.result: 数值结果验证违反下界与有界校准对偶；PI-UnSL在各次实现上显著提升联合QoS、在匹配检测下多数权衡区间优于时分ISAC的速率，且以远低于交替优化的时延超过其可靠性；五种架构从零训练均失败，而从闭式设计出发并以干扰统计为条件时表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 使问题可无标签学习的是注入网络的物理知识而非网络架构。

title: Multimodal Co-Generation With Continuous Bitstream Diffusion
summary: We show that continuous bitstream diffusion (CoBit), originally developed for language modeling, provides a unified framework for joint and conditional multimodal generation using the same training and sampling protocol. Across image-text, speech-text and protein sequence-structure modeling, models are trained separately from scratch, but each uses a single input projection, transformer backbone, bitwise prediction head and binary score-matching objective shared across its modalities. Within each setting, a single checkpoint supports joint generation and the conditional directions included in training by changing which parts of the bitstream are observed. We first validate the approach on MNIST-Sum, a controlled image-text task pairing raw binary images with equations encoded as text, achieving near-perfect conditional accuracy and high joint consistency without learned tokenizers. We then apply the same protocol at larger scale to speech-text and protein sequence-structure modeling. Trained without text pretraining, a single speech-text model performs speech synthesis, recognition, continuation, and unconditional co-generation. Jointly generated speech and text achieve 3.5% word error rate between the generated text and automatic transcriptions of the generated speech. In protein modeling, a single CoBit checkpoint supports forward folding, inverse folding, and joint sequence-structure generation. For jointly generated proteins spanning 100-500 residues, computational refolding of CoBit's sequences yields structures that agree with the generated backbones at a mean self-consistency TM-score of 0.911. Together, these results show that CoBit provides a common generative framework for substantially different modalities and forms of cross-modal dependence, without introducing a domain-specific objective or sampling procedure.

AI.tldr: 连续比特流扩散(CoBit)可作为统一的联合与条件多模态生成框架,在图像-文本、语音-文本、蛋白质序列-结构三类任务中以同一训练/采样协议达成跨模态生成。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态生成通常依赖模态专属的分词器、目标函数与采样流程,难以统一;作者希望验证语言建模中提出的连续比特流扩散能否作为通用框架,以单一目标同时处理差异极大的模态组合与跨模态依赖形式。
AI.method: 模型在每个场景下从零单独训练,但各模态共用同一输入投影、Transformer骨干、逐比特预测头与二值分数匹配目标。单检查点通过改变比特流中被观测的部分,即可实现联合生成与训练中包含的各条件方向。先在 MNIST-Sum(原始二值图像配文本编码方程)验证,再推广到语音-文本与蛋白质序列-结构建模,全程不使用学习式分词器。
AI.result: MNIST-Sum 上取得近乎完美的条件准确率与高联合一致性。未做文本预训练的单一语音-文本模型可完成语音合成、识别、续写与无条件协同生成,生成语音与生成文本间词错误率为3.5%。单一蛋白质检查点支持正向折叠、反向折叠与联合生成;对100–500残基的联合生成蛋白,计算重折叠结构与生成骨架的平均自一致性TM-score为0.911。
AI.conclusion: CoBit 在不引入领域专属目标或采样流程的前提下,为显著不同模态及不同跨模态依赖形式提供了通用生成框架。

title: Image Diffusion Models Are Good 3D Human Motion Generators
comment: 16 pages; under review. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Text-to-motion generation typically relies on dataset-specific skeletal representations, with models trained separately for benchmarks with different joint layouts. We investigate whether image diffusion architectures can model 3D human motion through a common image-compatible representation that accommodates heterogeneous skeletal layouts while preserving motion-specific kinematic structure. To this end, we organize root-centered joint trajectories into topology-informed joint--time images and model global root dynamics through a complementary latent stream. A motion autoencoder conditions local-motion decoding on the root latent, while a text-conditioned Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) jointly generates both latent streams, with supervision on decoded 3D joint positions further constraining generation in motion space. In addition to dataset-specific models, we train a single motion autoencoder on HumanML3D and KIT-ML, followed by a single text-conditioned SiT shared across both datasets, preserving their respective skeletal definitions without skeleton retargeting to a common joint layout. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show that our dataset-specific models achieve state-of-the-art performance, while shared training yields further gains on both benchmarks, demonstrating the benefits of shared modeling across heterogeneous skeletal layouts.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将根中心关节轨迹组织为拓扑感知的关节-时间图像，并用互补隐流建模根动态；以图像扩散架构（SiT）联合生成潜变量，在HumanML3D与KIT-ML上取得最优结果，且单一共享模型可跨异构骨架布局训练而无需重定向。
AI.motivation: 文本到动作生成通常依赖数据集专属的骨架表示，不同关节布局需分别训练模型，缺乏通用性。作者希望验证图像扩散架构能否通过一种与图像兼容、且保留运动学结构的统一表示来建模异构骨架的3D人体动作。
AI.method: 将根中心关节轨迹组织为拓扑感知的joint–time图像，并用互补的潜变量流建模全局根动态；运动自编码器以根潜变量为条件解码局部运动；文本条件Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT)联合生成两条潜流，并对解码的3D关节位置施加监督以在运动空间约束生成。除数据集专属模型外，还在HumanML3D与KIT-ML上训练单一自编码器与单一共享SiT。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上，数据集专属模型达到state-of-the-art性能；共享训练在两个基准上均带来进一步提升，且保留各自骨架定义、无需重定向到统一关节布局。
AI.conclusion: 图像扩散架构可借助图像兼容的关节-时间表示有效建模3D人体动作，跨异构骨架布局的共享建模具有明确收益。

title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
summary: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.

AI.tldr: 提出 Harness^2 递归式智能体框架，通过任务级与 harness 级两层递归，在无真值验证器条件下实现执行 harness 的自动进化与跨任务泛化，在三个专业基准上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体的能力不仅取决于底层模型，也取决于其执行 harness。递归自我改进（RSI）可自动进化 harness，但在开放世界部署面临两大挑战：(1) 开放世界任务在 harness 设计阶段未见、测试时新颖，缺乏可靠的真值验证器来指导在线 harness 编辑；(2) RSI 过程高度任务特定，难以泛化到新场景。
AI.method: 提出 Harness^2，一个即插即用的递归智能体 harness 框架，包含两层相连递归：任务级递归采用对比式 Propose-Probe-Compose 步骤，在无真值验证器的情况下可靠引导对当前任务 harness 的编辑，并可通过并行或串行递归进一步扩展；harness 级递归则从这些编辑中提取经验，更新持续改进 harness，使智能体能更好地适应未来任务。
AI.result: 在三个专业基准与四种“模型-harness”配置上，单步改进即可稳定提升 GLM-5 与 Gemini 3.5 Flash 相对于其基础 harness 的表现：WorkBuddy-Bench 最高提升 11.5 分，JobBench 提升 4.5 分，LAB 提升 11.8 个百分点；随任务级递归预算增加，增益进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 两层递归机制有效解决了无验证器条件下 harness 在线编辑与跨任务泛化的难题，验证了递归智能体 harnessing 在开放世界任务中的有效性与可扩展性。

title: SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions
summary: Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per case, on par with asking the same judge for the final label (68.23%); an earlier tree compiled for a different judge scores 47.87% when executed by this judge, while a new tree compiled on this judge's answers to a 12-question initial pool already scores 64.39%. Node-level repair raises BANKING77 accuracy from 82.04% to 86.16%, an explicit exemption node cuts the false positives of a Chinese e-commerce moderation clause from 24 to 5, and a trained editor raises the development accuracy of edited trees from 64.47% to 73.35%.

AI.tldr: SemTree将规则决策表示为语义决策树：节点为带Yes/No/Unknown判据的自然语言问题，由可插拔语义判别器作答，分支依据判别器实际回答编译生成，执行路径即为决策理由，支持节点级修复与闭环优化。
AI.motivation: 内容审核、广告合规、资格校验等规则决策涉及多条件、豁免与信息缺失情形，出错时需定位到具体失败条件才能修复；现有做法缺乏可解释的推理路径与细粒度纠错机制。
AI.method: SemTree框架：1) 构建语义决策树，每个节点为自然语言问题并明确Yes/No/Unknown判据；2) 语义判别器回答节点问题，并基于该判别器真实答案编译分支结构（而非预设结构）；3) 执行路径作为决策依据，审查者修正单个节点并重放规则；4) 修正节点作为判别器的训练标签；5) 引入工具调用的LLM编辑器，在观察执行结果的同时修订问题与子树。
AI.result: 在ShARC全部8,276条测试样例上，托管判别器执行树达67.70%准确率、每例2.99个问题，与直接让同判别器输出最终标签的68.23%相当；为其它判别器编译的旧树由该判别器执行仅47.87%，而基于该判别器对12问题初始池回答新编译的树已达64.39%。节点级修复将BANKING77准确率由82.04%提升至86.16%；显式豁免节点使某中文电商审核条款误报由24降至5；训练后的编辑器将编辑树开发集准确率由64.47%提升至73.35%。
AI.conclusion: 语义决策树可作为规则决策的可解释、可修复载体：执行路径提供推理依据，节点级修复与标注闭环能持续提升准确率，且树结构与判别器需匹配编译方可发挥性能。

title: Nonperturbative optomechanics with thin, weakly reflective intracavity dielectrics
comment: Main text: 5 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental Material: 5 pages, 6 figures. Comments welcome
summary: Levitated dielectric sensors are often treated as perturbative probes of a pre-existing optical field. We show that this picture fails for a novel sensor geometry: a dielectric plate whose transverse extent captures the full optical mode. Even an optically thin sensor with modest refractive index can heavily restructure the intracavity fields, effectively partitioning a cavity into two subcavities with substantial cross-coupling and producing new optical resonances and trapping sites with properties which deviate from the standard intuition. Conventional perturbative expressions for the cavity frequency shift and optomechanical coupling depart from the exact solution at thicknesses as small as $\simλ/(10n)$. Furthermore, cavity locking decreases the coupling and increases the trap stiffness by orders of magnitude, and the coupled subcavity structure permits appreciable optical cooling at zero detuning, a distinct behavior unique to this nonperturbative regime. These effects, sharing a common origin, establish a distinct regime of cavity optomechanics in which the sensor is no longer merely a probe of the cavity field, but an element that helps define it.

AI.tldr: 该文指出当介电板横向尺寸覆盖整个光学模式时，悬浮传感器不再是对预存光场的微扰探针，而会显著重构腔内场，形成耦合双腔结构，进入非微扰腔光力学新区域。
AI.motivation: 传统悬浮介电传感器通常被视为对已有光场的微扰探针，这一图像在传感器横向尺寸覆盖整个光学模式的新几何构型下失效，需要重新审视腔场与传感器的相互作用。
AI.method: 作者针对横向尺寸可捕获完整光学模式的介电板传感器几何，进行精确求解，并与传统微扰表达式进行对比，分析其对腔内场、腔频移和光机械耦合的影响。
AI.result: 即使光学薄、折射率适中的传感器也能强烈重构腔内场，将腔有效分割为两个强交叉耦合的子腔，产生新的光学共振与捕获位点；当厚度小至约 λ/(10n) 时，传统微扰公式已偏离精确解。腔锁定会降低耦合并使陷阱刚度提高数个量级，且耦合子腔结构可在零失谐下实现显著光学冷却。
AI.conclusion: 这些效应共同确立了腔光力学的一个独特区域：传感器不再只是腔场的探针，而是参与定义腔场的组成元素。

title: FORGE: Procedural Weight Generation for Sparse MoE Inference
summary: We introduce FORGE (Fast On-chip Rotor Generation for Experts), a procedural weight generation system for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference. Rather than storing and loading every expert weight tensor from HBM, we show how a compact accelerator inside each Streaming Multiprocessor can regenerate them on-the-fly from $O(\log^2 d)$ rotor parameters per projection. Per replaced layer, gigabytes of stored expert weights are approximated with under a megabyte of seeds. This addresses the dual memory bottleneck of autoregressive Sparse MoE decode, where per-expert FFN operations are HBM-bandwidth-bound at small routed-token counts and the aggregate expert footprint forces multi-node Expert Parallelism (EP) with all-to-all traffic. We realize the approach as the Rotor Generation Unit (RGU), a fixed-function datapath that generates FFN weight tiles without competing with Tensor Core execution. With 30% of the MoE FFN layers replaced across five Sparse MoE models, we estimate 1.3-2.8x higher system throughput at matched GPU count and 1.10-1.15x lower per-user decode latency at short context. In exchange, downstream accuracy on three model families falls below that of the same model fine-tuned without rotor replacement, and the replacement ratio controls this tradeoff. FORGE also expands KV cache capacity by 1.2-2.6x. It is agnostic to the bit width at which weights are stored, so it can compose with quantization. The RGU is fully implemented/verified in SystemVerilog at ~0.9% SM area overhead (0.032 mm^2/SM, 7nm).

AI.tldr: FORGE 提出一种面向稀疏 MoE 推理的片上权重生成系统，通过每个 SM 内的固定功能 Rotor Generation Unit 用 $O(\log^2 d)$ 转子参数在线重建专家权重，替代 HBM 加载，实现吞吐提升并扩展 KV cache。
AI.motivation: 自回归稀疏 MoE 解码存在双重内存瓶颈：小 routed-token 数下专家 FFN 操作受 HBM 带宽限制；专家总量庞大迫使采用多节点 Expert Parallelism 并产生 all-to-all 通信开销。
AI.method: 引入 FORGE 程序化权重生成系统，用每个投影 $O(\log^2 d)$ 个转子参数、以不到 1MB 种子近似原先 GB 级专家权重；实现为 SM 内固定功能数据通路 Rotor Generation Unit（RGU），在 SystemVerilog 中完成设计验证，与 Tensor Core 执行并行生成 FFN 权重 tile。
AI.result: 替换五个稀疏 MoE 模型 30% 的 MoE FFN 层后，估计同等 GPU 数量下系统吞吐提升 1.3–2.8 倍，短上下文下每用户解码延迟降低 1.10–1.15 倍；KV cache 容量扩大 1.2–2.6 倍；RGU 面积开销约 0.9% SM（0.032 mm²/SM，7nm）。代价是三个模型族下游精度低于未替换而微调的模型，替换比例控制该权衡。
AI.conclusion: FORGE 以极低硬件面积代价缓解稀疏 MoE 推理的 HBM 带宽与专家并行通信瓶颈，并在吞吐和 KV cache 上获益；其主要代价是精度损失，可通过替换比例调节，且与量化方案兼容。

title: Non-contact lens metrology from optical flow and differentiable ray tracing
comment: 40 pages, 25 figures, including supplementary material. Main manuscript: 11 pages, 5 figures; supplement: 29 pages, 20 figures
summary: Accurate lens surface metrology is essential to determine the manufactured geometry of refractive optical elements and their deviation from the specified design. We demonstrate a transmission metrology method that reconstructs refractive lens surfaces from the displacement of a wavelet-noise-patterned mask. Lens-induced distortion is represented by a dense displacement field. A differentiable ray tracer fits the lens geometry using a calibrated near-telecentric camera model with an effective finite ray origin. We validate the method on commercial lenses. The recovered geometries agree with nominal specifications, and the plano-aspheric reconstruction is compared with chromatic confocal profilometry.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于小波噪声图案掩模位移的透射式测量方法，通过可微光线追踪重建折射透镜表面。
AI.motivation: 精确的透镜表面计量对于确定折射光学元件的制造几何及其与设计规格的偏差至关重要。
AI.method: 利用小波噪声图案化掩模的位移表示透镜致畸变（密集位移场），采用标定的近远心相机模型（含有效有限光线原点）驱动可微光线追踪来拟合透镜几何。
AI.result: 在商用透镜上验证，重建几何与标称规格一致；平-非球面重建结果与色度共聚焦轮廓术进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效重建折射透镜表面几何，与标称规格及参考测量手段吻合。

title: CSI-Aging-Aware Functional Split Optimization and KAN-LSTM Prediction for Open-RAN NTN
summary: In this paper, we study functional-split selection for an Open radio access network (RAN) deployed as a non-terrestrial network (NTN), in which a low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite hosts the radio unit, so that each candidate split (7.2x, 6, 2) places the RAN at a distinct point of the transparent-to-regenerative axis. We capture the space-ground geometry exactly through an instantaneous link plane, which yields closed-form slant range, elevation, delay, and Doppler for an inclined orbit and a rotating Earth. On this geometry we derive the received-SNR density of the elevation-driven LOS/NLOS mixture channel and, through a split-dependent channel state information (CSI) aging mechanism, an uncoded bit-error-rate (BER) law for each split, establishing that what separates the splits is the freshness of the CSI each brings to its adaptation loops: a loop closed on the ground pays the feeder round-trip and incurs an aging-induced error floor. We formulate split selection as a prefer-centralized feasibility problem over reliability, aging, and fronthaul-capacity constraints, and we show that its exact solution is a closed-form region rule in four state coordinates, validated against exhaustive enumeration without a single mismatch. Because this solution is reactive whereas a split change must be initiated ahead of time, we propose a compact Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN)-LSTM, sized for an edge xApp/rApp, that predicts the split schedule seconds ahead; we show that it attains high schedule accuracy at a sub-percent BER-violation probability and delivers nearly all of the ground-truth policy's goodput, outperforming naive and reactive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LEO卫星承载无线单元的Open RAN非地面网络中的功能切分选择问题，建立精确空地基几何与分裂相关的CSI老化误码模型，将切分选择化为偏好集中式的可行性问题并给出四状态坐标下的闭式区域解，进而提出面向边缘xApp/rApp的KAN-LSTM预测器提前数秒预测切分调度。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星作为无线单元的Open RAN NTN中，不同功能切分（7.2x、6、2）对应透明-再生轴上的不同位置，其适应环路对CSI时效性要求不同；地面闭环需承受馈线往返时延并产生老化导致的误码率地板，因此需要刻画几何、信道与CSI老化，并提前决策切分以兼顾可靠性、老化与前传容量约束。
AI.method: 通过瞬时链路平面对倾斜轨道与自转地球建模，得到斜距、仰角、时延和多普勒的闭式表达；推导仰角驱动的LOS/NLOS混合信道接收SNR密度，并借助切分相关的CSI老化机制得到各切分的未编码BER律。将切分选择表述为偏好集中式的可行性问题，在可靠性、老化与前传容量约束下求解，得到四状态坐标下的闭式区域规则（经穷举验证无误）；由于该解具有反应性，进一步设计紧凑的KAN-LSTM网络用于边缘xApp/rApp，提前数秒预测切分调度。
AI.result: 闭式区域规则与穷举枚举结果完全一致，无一处不匹配；KAN-LSTM预测器在低于百分之一的BER违规概率下达到高调度准确度，获得接近真实策略的goodput，并优于朴素基线与反应式基线。
AI.conclusion: 切分之间的本质差异在于其适应环路所获CSI的新鲜度，地面闭环需付出馈线往返代价并承受老化误差地板；所提闭式切分选择规则精确且可解释，配合轻量KAN-LSTM提前预测调度，可在边缘设备上以极低BER违规代价实现接近最优的goodput。

title: SciCurateBench: Curating Experimental Data from Heterogeneous Scientific Literature with Verbal-Action Agents
summary: Scientific research increasingly depends on curating experimental data from literature. Scientific data curation requires verifying exact experimental conditions (e.g., specific assays, clinical outcomes, and data availability) across long, heterogeneous files, which is a highly time-consuming process. Existing benchmarks evaluate only broad relevance on short queries, failing to capture this complexity. We introduce SciCurateBench, a benchmark of 200 expert-annotated papers from major life-science journals that challenges systems to verify conjunctive biological experimental criteria from raw, unprocessed scientific literature. We show that plain LLMs and popular reasoning, tool-using, and feedback-based agents all struggle with this task. To study what makes the task tractable, we further propose LangPoli, an integrative system in which a policy agent generates natural language action guidelines that actor agents convert into executable tools. LangPoli showed strong performance on both Paper Classification (83.16% F1 vs. 58.22% for its base LLM) and Structured Information Retrieval, and also improves re-ranking on the public benchmarks of LitSearch, BEIR, and TREC. We further explore curriculum transfer, a method that distills generalizable strategies from solved tasks to accelerate the solving of related problems. We hope this work facilitates research in truly practical scientific AI assistance. The anonymized pre-release can be found from https://anonymous.4open. science/r/scicuratebench-D885/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SciCurateBench基准与LangPoli系统，用于从原始科学文献中验证复合实验条件，显著优于基座LLM及各类推理/工具智能体。
AI.motivation: 科研日益依赖从文献中整理实验数据，但数据整理需在冗长异构文件中核验具体实验条件（如特定检测、临床结局、数据可用性），过程极为耗时。现有基准仅在短查询上评估宽泛相关性，无法刻画这一复杂性。
AI.method: 构建SciCurateBench：包含200篇来自主要生命科学期刊、经专家标注的论文，要求系统从原始未处理文献中验证合取式生物学实验标准。进一步提出LangPoli集成系统：由策略智能体生成自然语言行动指南，演员智能体将其转化为可执行工具。并探索课程迁移，从已解决任务中蒸馏可泛化策略以加速相关问题求解。
AI.result: 普通LLM以及流行的推理型、工具使用型和反馈型智能体在该任务上均表现不佳。LangPoli在论文分类上达到83.16% F1（其基座LLM为58.22%），在结构化信息检索上表现强劲，并在LitSearch、BEIR、TREC公开基准上改善重排序。
AI.conclusion: SciCurateBench与LangPoli为真正实用的科学AI辅助研究提供了基准与方法，有望推动该方向的发展。匿名预发布版本已公开。

title: BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images
summary: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel-scale digital scans of histopathology tissue and serve as the primary basis for cancer diagnosis. Existing histopathology generative models operate at the patch scale, producing fixed-size tiles of at most 1024$\times$1024 pixels which encompass only a small fraction of the WSI. In contrast, text reports for clinical diagnoses and slide-level diagnostic labels -- the supervision that exists at scale -- operate at the whole-slide level. We present BigCell, the first approach to generate coherent whole-slide histopathology images at native gigapixel resolution. BigCell trains a flow-matching transformer at 2048$\times$2048 pixels on over 120,000 publicly available WSIs spanning multiple organ types. Conditioning on embeddings from pathology foundation models and using an inference-time sliding-window pipeline, BigCell generates coherent images of up to 32,768$\times$32,768 pixels, outperforming prior tile generators on both tile-level and slide-level fidelity metrics. To make gigapixel synthesis practical, we introduce an adaptive scheduling strategy that prioritizes important slide regions, speeding up image generation by over 3\ttimes with minimal quality degradation. Furthermore, we propose the first text-to-image synthesis at 8k resolution by training a separate model that produces dense conditioning grids directly from pathology text reports. We demonstrate that augmenting with synthetic samples improves slide-level few-shot classification performance by up to $18 \%$ over baselines trained on real data.

AI.tldr: BigCell 是首个能在原生十亿像素级分辨率下生成连贯全切片病理图像的生成框架，通过在 2048×2048 像素上训练流匹配 Transformer，并结合有病理基础模型嵌入条件、推理时滑动窗口管线与自适应调度策略，实现最高 32768×32768 像素的连贯图像合成，并进一步提出 8k 分辨率文本到图像生成，将合成样本用于少样本分类任务可提升最高 18%。
AI.motivation: 现有病理生成模型仅工作在图像块（patch）尺度，最多生成 1024×1024 像素的固定尺寸瓦片，只能覆盖全切片图像（WSI）的极小部分；而临床诊断报告和切片级诊断标签等大规模可得的监督信号都处于全切片级别。这种尺度不匹配限制了生成模型在临床诊断相关任务上的实用价值，因此需要能够在原生十亿像素分辨率下生成连贯全切片图像的方法。
AI.method: 提出 BigCell，在来自多器官类型的超过 120,000 张公开 WSI 上以 2048×2048 像素训练流匹配 Transformer；以病理基础模型嵌入作为条件，并在推理阶段采用滑动窗口管线以生成最高 32768×32768 像素的连贯图像。为提升十亿像素合成的效率，引入自适应调度策略，优先处理重要切片区域。此外，另行训练一个模型直接从病理文本报告生成稠密条件网格，实现首个 8k 分辨率的文本到图像合成。
AI.result: BigCell 在图像块级和切片级保真度指标上均优于先前的瓦片生成器；自适应调度策略在质量损失极小的情况下将图像生成速度提升超过 3 倍；使用合成样本进行数据增强，可使切片级少样本分类性能相比仅用真实数据训练的基线最高提升 18%。
AI.conclusion: BigCell 首次实现了原生十亿像素分辨率的连贯全切片病理图像生成，将病理生成模型的尺度从图像块级推进到全切片级，并支持 8k 分辨率文本到图像合成；其合成样本可有效用于少样本分类数据增强，表明全切片级生成模型在病理诊断相关任务中具有实用价值。

title: Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference
summary: Tensor parallelism ends every layer with an all-reduce that sits between two dependent matrix multiplications, so its cost cannot be hidden and grows as compute outpaces interconnect bandwidth. Sending 4-bit instead of 16-bit values would cut this cost by nearly 4x, but the all-reduce must add the values it carries, and rounding the sum injects an error at every call. Model quality depends on how these errors accumulate over layers, yet existing methods treat each call on its own. We present Echo, a 4-bit all-reduce for training and inference that controls the accumulated error. Echo moves data in 4 bits and sums in high precision, so each value is quantized at most twice per call for any number of GPUs. The summation reveals each injected error, and Echo feeds it back into later calls, so old errors cancel instead of accumulating. We prove that the accumulated error stays bounded independently of depth. On A100 GPUs, Echo is 2.09x faster than the 16-bit NCCL all-reduce on 1 GB messages. It speeds up the time to first token by up to 1.16x and the training step by up to 1.09x on an idle interconnect, and by up to 1.44x and 1.38x as background traffic grows. It keeps the average accuracy over seven benchmarks within 0.4 points of 16-bit inference on Qwen3-8B. In 10B-token pretraining, its final loss is less than 0.9% above that of 16-bit training. Echo needs no FP8 or FP4 hardware.

AI.tldr: Echo 提出一种 4-bit all-reduce 通信方案，将误差反馈到后续调用中以抵消累积误差，并在理论上证明累积误差与深度无关有界。
AI.motivation: 张量并行的 all-reduce 位于两个相互依赖的矩阵乘法之间，无法被隐藏，且随计算增速超过互连带宽而成本上升。使用 4-bit 替代 16-bit 可降约 4 倍成本，但 all-reduce 需对数值求和，舍入会在每次调用中注入误差，模型质量取决于误差跨层累积，而现有方法仅孤立处理单次调用。
AI.method: Echo 以 4-bit 传输数据、以高精度求和，使任意 GPU 数量下每个值每次调用至多被量化两次；求和过程可暴露每次注入的误差，Echo 将其反馈到后续调用，使旧误差相互抵消而非累积，无需 FP8/FP4 硬件。
AI.result: 理论上证明累积误差独立于深度有界。A100 上 1 GB 消息比 16-bit NCCL all-reduce 快 2.09x；空载互连下首 token 时间提速至多 1.16x、训练步提速至多 1.09x，背景流量增大时分别达 1.44x 和 1.38x。Qwen3-8B 上七项基准平均精度与 16-bit 推理相差 0.4 分以内；10B token 预训练最终损失比 16-bit 高不足 0.9%。
AI.conclusion: Echo 通过跨调用误差反馈实现有界累积误差的 4-bit all-reduce，在保持接近 16-bit 精度的同时显著降低通信开销，且不依赖低精度硬件。

title: VH-GPO: Verified Handoff for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. When every trajectory in a group fails with the same reward, relative advantages collapse toward zero, leaving no useful learning signal. A frozen teacher can recover from a student-visited state, but letting it complete the task makes the recovered suffix entirely teacher-generated. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search budget. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, VH-GPO increases success rates over GRPO from 59.38% to 94.79% on ALFWorld and from 71.62% to 77.34% on WebShop. Improvements also hold with the 7B student, for which additional teacher and student output tokens amount to 1.77% and 2.61% of regular student rollout output tokens on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the key components. These results support using verified teacher assistance to repair failures while reinforcing the student's ability to complete tasks independently.

AI.tldr: 提出VH-GPO：在组相对强化学习中，借助环境验证的教师恢复失败轨迹后，尽早把控制权交回学生，使成功经验仍由学生生成，从而避免相对优势塌缩。
AI.motivation: GRPO等方法通过比较同一任务的多次rollout计算相对优势；当组内所有轨迹以相同奖励失败时，相对优势趋近于零，学习信号消失。冻结教师虽可从学生访问过的状态恢复，但若由教师完成任务，成功后缀完全由教师生成，削弱学生自身能力的强化。
AI.method: 提出“结果验证的师生交接”，并实例化为VH-GPO。给定环境验证的教师恢复轨迹，在有界搜索预算内选择最早被独立确认的交接点：教师仅提供足够支持到达学生能够成功的状态，随后交回控制权，使成功经验重新由学生生成。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-1.5B下，ALFWorld成功率由GRPO的59.38%提升至94.79%，WebShop由71.62%提升至77.34%；7B学生同样有效。额外教师与学生输出token分别仅占常规学生rollout输出token的1.77%（ALFWorld）和2.61%（WebShop）。消融实验验证了关键组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 验证式教师辅助可在修复失败的同时强化学生独立完成任务的能力，是一种低成本且有效的组策略优化改进方案。

title: Direct growth of crack-free stoichiometric silicon nitride on sapphire for wide-band photonics
summary: Low-loss stoichiometric silicon nitride on oxidized silicon has emerged as the major wide-band photonics platform for nonlinear and quantum photonics. These films, deposited by low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD), are well known to have around 1000 MPa of residual tensile stress, which often leads to cracking when film thickness exceeds 400 nm. Although various stress-mitigation approaches can isolate or prevent cracking, this stress issue remains a major fabrication challenge. Low-residual-stress LPCVD stoichiometric silicon nitride on sapphire has also been reported and recently explored for photonics at telecommunication wavelengths. Here, we advance its development through systematic characterization, including thin-film stress analysis, ellipsometry and prism-coupling measurements of refractive index and loss, and swept-wavelength spectroscopy of fabricated photonic devices across a broad range of wavelengths. We demonstrate the direct growth of crack-free stoichiometric silicon nitride up to 2 μm thick with only 200 MPa of stress. Our fabricated devices show propagation losses of 0.35 dB/cm around 780 nm, 0.37 dB/cm around 1064 nm, and 0.25 dB/cm around 1630 nm. In addition, prism-coupling measurements indicate film losses below 1 dB/cm at wavelengths down to 500 nm. Our work highlights stoichiometric silicon nitride on sapphire as a promising wide-band photonics platform.

AI.tldr: 该工作系统表征了蓝宝石衬底上低应力LPCVD化学计量比氮化硅薄膜，实现2 μm无裂纹生长与宽波段低损耗光子器件。
AI.motivation: 传统氧化硅衬底上LPCVD化学计量比氮化硅存在约1000 MPa残余拉应力，膜厚超过400 nm易开裂；虽有多种应力缓解方案，但应力问题仍是主要制造挑战。蓝宝石衬底上的低应力氮化硅此前已有报道并被用于通信波段光子学，但缺乏系统表征与宽波段器件验证。
AI.method: 在蓝宝石衬底上直接生长化学计量比氮化硅，进行系统表征：薄膜应力分析、椭偏与棱镜耦合测量折射率和损耗，以及跨宽波长范围的扫频光谱表征所制备光子器件。
AI.result: 实现厚度达2 μm、应力仅200 MPa的无裂纹化学计量比氮化硅；器件传播损耗约为780 nm处0.35 dB/cm、1064 nm处0.37 dB/cm、1630 nm处0.25 dB/cm；棱镜耦合测得低至500 nm波长处薄膜损耗低于1 dB/cm。
AI.conclusion: 蓝宝石衬底上的化学计量比氮化硅是一种有前景的宽波段光子学平台。

title: LocalTrain: Integer-Only Local Learning for Energy-Efficient CNN Training on Edge FPGAs
summary: Local learning reduces cross-layer training dependencies, but an efficient accelerator must still retain operands, accumulate gradients, and select quantization scales. We present an FPGA system that trains a CNN and its regional auxiliary classifiers using a shared integer matrix engine. Compact errors are expanded on chip, gradients are folded tile by tile, and historical scales permit direct output conversion. At 200 MHz, the KV260 prototype achieves 76.57% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 91.85% on SVHN at approximately 4.20 W mean module power. Effective matrix throughput is 31.22 and 31.57 GMAC/s, respectively. Against the same integer method on Jetson Orin Nano, measured training energy is 40.4% and 42.1% lower, with $1.86\times$ and $1.82\times$ longer runtime; measurements use the respective platform power domains. Selected state checks and matching complete-run prediction counts support functional agreement with the software reference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种FPGA系统，用共享整数矩阵引擎训练CNN及其区域辅助分类器，KV260原型在CIFAR-10/SVHN上分别达76.57%/91.85%精度，功耗约4.20 W，矩阵吞吐率31.22/31.57 GMAC/s，训练能耗较Jetson Orin Nano同整数方法低40.4%/42.1%，但运行时长为其1.86×/1.82×。
AI.motivation: 局部学习虽可降低跨层训练依赖，但加速器仍需处理操作数保留、梯度累加与量化尺度选择等开销，需要高效硬件方案。
AI.method: 采用共享整数矩阵引擎的FPGA系统：片内扩展紧凑误差，逐tile折叠梯度，并利用历史尺度实现直接输出转换；训练CNN及区域辅助分类器。
AI.result: 200 MHz KV260原型：CIFAR-10 76.57%、SVHN 91.85%精度，平均模块功耗约4.20 W，有效矩阵吞吐率分别为31.22与31.57 GMAC/s；相比Jetson Orin Nano同整数方法，训练能耗低40.4%与42.1%，运行时长长1.86×与1.82×；通过状态检查与完整运行预测数比对验证与软件参考功能一致。
AI.conclusion: 该FPGA设计在能效上优于Jetson平台，代价是运行时间延长，且功能与软件参考一致。

title: Engineering Color and Angular Stability in Building-Integrated Photovoltaics Using Metal-Oxide Photonic Glasses
summary: Coloring building-integrated photovoltaics poses a dilemma: absorptive pigments cost photocurrent, while ordered photonic structures are iridescent. Amorphous photonic glasses, disordered packings of high-index nanospheres, are proposed to avoid both, yet their angle-independent color has rarely been quantified on a realistic module stack. A non-absorbing scatterer needs a high index with visible transparency, which the Moss rule caps near 2.35. Coupling Mie scattering, the Percus-Yevick structure factor, the exact phase function, and two-flux transfer with absorption and refraction at the front glass, we fix four target colors that a crowd-sourced naming survey calls unambiguously blue, green, gold, and terracotta, and map the recipes reaching them across four metal oxides, four encapsulants, two cell technologies, and wide ranges of particle size, packing fraction, and layer number. All four are reached in a laminated three-layer coating, to within DeltaE00 of 0.8 to 2.5, but not from one oxide: transparent TiO2 renders the blue and only pale warm tones; the green, gold, and terracotta require the blue-band absorption of V2O5, and the low-contrast oxides turn grey at the warm end. The encapsulant governs the color, and the cell technology does not. Disorder does not confer angle independence: the colors hold for an observer moving under a fixed sun but drift by DeltaE00 of 5 to 18 over the day, terracotta least, and a facade lit from above and viewed from below shifts every color towards the blue. Oxide, layer number, and facade geometry must therefore be designed together.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了非晶光子玻璃在真实光伏组件叠层上的角色度色彩，确定了四种目标颜色的配方，发现氧化物、封装材料、层数与立面几何需协同设计。
AI.motivation: 建筑一体化光伏的着色存在两难：吸收型颜料损失光电流，有序光子结构产生虹彩。非晶光子玻璃（高折射率纳米球的无序堆积）被提出可同时避免这两个问题，但其角度无关的颜色很少在真实组件叠层上被量化。
AI.method: 耦合Mie散射、Percus-Yevick结构因子、精确相函数，以及含前玻璃吸收与折射的双通量传输模型；固定四种经众包命名调查确认的颜色（蓝、绿、金、赤陶），在四种金属氧化物、四种封装材料、两种电池技术以及颗粒尺寸、堆积分数、层数的广泛范围中映射可达配方。非吸收散射体需高折射率且可见光透明，Moss规则将其上限限制在约2.35。
AI.result: 四种颜色均可在层压三层涂层中实现，DeltaE00为0.8至2.5，但无法由单一氧化物实现：透明TiO2只能呈现蓝色和浅暖色调；绿、金、赤陶需要V2O5的蓝带吸收，低对比度氧化物在暖色端变灰。封装材料决定颜色，电池技术则不影响。无序并不带来角度无关性：固定太阳下观察者移动时颜色保持，但全天漂移DeltaE00为5至18，赤陶最小；自上而下照明的立面从下往上看时所有颜色偏向蓝色。
AI.conclusion: 氧化物、层数和立面几何必须协同设计，才能在建筑一体化光伏中实现角度稳定的非虹彩结构色。

title: Load Disaggregation under Incomplete Inventory with Structured Unclaimed Demand
summary: An incomplete inventory creates a specific attribution ambiguity in load disaggregation: unclaimed demand can offset changes in claimed loads without altering meter reconstruction. We study how the allowed target and nuisance trajectories govern this ambiguity. A bounded ordered Markov chain represents unclaimed demand, while an unweighted acceptor removes commissioning-inconsistent paths from one target without reweighting surviving paths; exact factorial MAP jointly decodes all paths. At two fully instrumented commercial buildings, restricting exterior-lighting support improves agreement on the count of rooftop compressors although no compressor chain is constrained; the gain depends on the nuisance representation. A synthetic experiment identifies the boundary: the effect persists under support-preserving changes but reverses when the true path violates commissioned support or the commissioned level is miscalibrated. Attribution therefore depends on joint target-nuisance path geometry, not reconstruction error alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究负荷分解中"不完整清单"导致的归因歧义问题，提出用有界有序马尔可夫链建模未认领需求、用无权接受器剔除违背调试一致性的路径，并通过精确因子MAP联合解码目标与干扰路径，揭示归因取决于目标-干扰路径的联合几何结构而非重构误差。
AI.motivation: 实际建筑负荷分解中，清单（inventory）往往不完整：未登记/未认领的需求变化可以在不改变总表重构（meter reconstruction）的情况下，抵消已认领负荷的变化，由此产生归因歧义。作者希望厘清"允许的目标轨迹与干扰轨迹"如何决定这种歧义，从而澄清归因可靠性的边界条件。
AI.method: 用有界有序马尔可夫链（bounded ordered Markov chain）表示未认领需求；用无权接受器（unweighted acceptor）从单一目标中剔除与调试不一致的路径，且不对存活路径重新加权；采用精确因子MAP（exact factorial MAP）对所有路径进行联合解码。在两栋全仪表化商业建筑上做实证，并进行合成实验以确定归因增益的边界。
AI.result: 在两栋全仪表化商业建筑中，收窄外部照明支持的取值范围，可在未对任何压缩机组链施加约束的情况下，改善屋顶压缩机组数量的一致性，且该增益依赖于干扰项的表示方式；合成实验表明，该效应在保持支持的变换下持续存在，但当真实路径违背调试支持或调试水平标定错误时则发生反转。
AI.conclusion: 归因结果取决于目标与干扰路径的联合几何结构，而不仅仅取决于重构误差；因此不完整清单下的归因稳健性必须结合支持约束与调试一致性来评估。

title: Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures
comment: Accepted as a spotlight in NeurIPS 2026
summary: Frontier AI systems are increasingly natively multimodal, jointly pretrained on multiple modalities, such as text, vision, and audio. However, the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix, and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. In this work, we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities: text, vision, and audio. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, as MoEs scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. We therefore use MoEs to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457M to 8.3B parameters, on up to 150 billion tokens. Our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training MLLMs. First, compute optima are modality-specific: audio modality is model-heavy, favoring scaling parameters over tokens, while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. Second, repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. Finally, cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric: vision strongly interferes with audio, whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. Overall, we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过268个MoE实验（457M–8.3B参数、最多150B token），推导了文本、视觉、音频三模态的数据混合缩放定律，为前沿多模态大模型预训练的数据配比提供原则性基础。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI系统已原生多模态（文本、视觉、音频联合预训练），但关于多模态数据混合（各模态混合多少、对其他模态的干扰代价）的科学理解仍缺失或被封闭，导致预训练配比缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 针对文本、视觉、音频三种模态推导数据混合缩放定律；采用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构（因其扩展高效且能部分限制跨模态干扰），共进行268次实验，规模涵盖457M至8.3B参数、最多150B tokens。
AI.result: 1）计算最优配比具有模态特异性：音频是"模型重"模态，倾向于扩大参数而非数据量；文本和视觉则需模型规模与数据量均衡扩展。2）视觉或音频数据重复超过2倍收益甚微。3）跨模态交互高度不对称：视觉对音频干扰强烈，而音频对文本和视觉学习的干扰可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解训练前沿多模态大模型所需的多模态数据混合提供了有原则的基础，并给出多条可落地的数据配比洞见。

title: Thinking with Images without Coordinates
summary: Recent advances in multi-modal large language models have shifted toward the "thinking with images" paradigm to improve reasoning faithfulness, yet existing methods rely heavily on explicit coordinate- based grounding. We identify two fundamental limitations in this approach, i.e., a semantic gap where sparse regressions miss high-dimensional latent structures, and a resolution gap due to the granularity mismatch between patch-level tokens and pixel-level coordinates. To address these, we propose TiCO (Thinking with images without COordinates). It reformulates visual reasoning as a semantic evidence discovery process within the latent space, and evidence is injected as token-level regions without pixel coordinates. Specifically, TiCO utilizes a dedicated probe token to estimate similarity distributions and performs importance sampling over spatially connected components to generate diverse, semantically dominant evidence rollouts. Extensive experiments across multiple high-resolution and general visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our TiCO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art coordinate-based methods with significantly improved inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出TiCO框架，将"用图像思考"从显式坐标回归重构为潜在空间的语义证据发现，用token级区域注入证据以避免像素坐标，在多个高分辨率与通用视觉推理基准上超越SOTA坐标方法并提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型"用图像思考"范式高度依赖显式坐标定位，存在两个根本缺陷：一是语义鸿沟，稀疏坐标回归难以刻画高维潜在结构；二是分辨率鸿沟，patch级token与像素级坐标之间粒度不匹配。
AI.method: TiCO将视觉推理重塑为潜在空间中的语义证据发现过程：使用专用probe token估计相似度分布，并对空间连通分量进行重要性采样，从而生成多样且语义主导的证据rollout；证据以token级区域形式注入，不涉及像素坐标。
AI.result: 在多个高分辨率及通用视觉推理基准上，TiCO一致优于当前最先进的基于坐标的方法，且推理效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 无需坐标的潜在空间证据发现范式可有效缓解语义与分辨率双重鸿沟，在性能与效率上同时超越坐标依赖方案，为"用图像思考"提供了新的实现路径。

title: Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions
comment: Accepted at the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练方法，利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射的局部拉回几何，识别输出最敏感方向，沿此方向引导采样轨迹以在保持条件一致性的同时提升生成多样性。
AI.motivation: 条件扩散模型虽能生成高质量且贴合提示的图像，但不同随机种子生成的样本视觉上仍高度相似，限制了创意探索。现有方法提升多样性时往往需要额外优化或采样开销，而更强的扰动又会引入畸变，损害图像质量或提示对齐。
AI.method: 免训练方法。利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射所诱导的局部拉回几何，识别输出敏感度最大的方向；将不同采样轨迹沿这些方向进行引导（steering），从而在保持与条件信号一致的前提下促使生成结果多样化。
AI.result: 在 MS-COCO 与 BrushNet 上的实验表明，该方法能有效提升提示条件图像生成与图像修复（inpainting）的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需训练即可在保持条件一致性与图像质量的同时提升条件扩散生成的多样性，适用于生成与修复任务。

title: PreSO: Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a self-teacher conditioned on privileged information to turn the sparse outcome signal of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) into dense token-level supervision. Yet the teacher's advantage may depend on information unavailable to the student at inference, raising a central question: which privileged changes are worth distilling? We use cross-problem recurrence as an empirical cue for potentially reusable guidance. Comparing the representation shifts induced by full solutions and compact hints, we find that hint-induced shifts are more concentrated and directionally consistent across problems, and yield more sustained downstream gains despite revealing less information. Motivated by this association, we propose Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation (PreSO). At the source, PreSO uses compact hints to limit the solution-specific detail entering the privileged shift. At the target, it estimates a leading low-rank subspace from shifts pooled across related problems, projects the privilege-induced correction onto this subspace, and adds it to the student's unprivileged representation to form the representation-level distillation target. The selected subspace serves as an operational proxy for recurring structure, rather than a guaranteed separation of transferable and instance-specific information. On five competition-level mathematics benchmarks, PreSO consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, improving average accuracy over the base model by 6.8, 9.0, and 10.0 points. Beyond peak accuracy, PreSO attains the highest final-checkpoint average at every model scale, with improvements that persist through the end of training.

AI.tldr: PreSO通过紧凑提示限制特权信息、并在低秩子空间上投影特权修正后加回学生表征，在五个竞赛数学基准上于1.7B/4B/8B模型上分别较基线平均提升6.8/9.0/10.0分，且末端checkpoint表现持续最优。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏用带特权信息的自我教师把稀疏结果奖励转为稠密token监督，但教师优势可能依赖学生推理时不可得的信息。核心问题是：哪些特权变化值得蒸馏？
AI.method: 以跨问题复现作为可复用指导的经验线索，比较完整解答与紧凑提示引起的表征偏移，发现提示诱导的偏移更集中、跨问题方向一致且下游增益更持久。据此提出PreSO：源端用紧凑提示限制解答特定细节进入特权偏移；目标端从相关问题池化偏移中估计主导低秩子空间，将特权诱导修正投影到该子空间并加回学生无特权表征，形成表征级蒸馏目标。该子空间作为长期结构的操作代理而非可迁移/实例特定信息的严格分离。
AI.result: 在五个竞赛级数学基准上，PreSO在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B上均优于强基线，平均准确率较基模型分别提升6.8、9.0、10.0分；并且所有模型规模下末端checkpoint平均表现最优，增益持续到训练结束。
AI.conclusion: 选择紧凑提示诱导的表征偏移并投影到跨问题共享的低秩子空间，可作为可复用指导的有效代理，实现更稳定、更持久的蒸馏增益。

title: Photon-efficient readout of optical cavity arrays via spatial heterodyne
