Within this framework, we focus on Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) for sequential position prediction on curved manifolds after comparisons with alternative recurrent architectures. We evaluate our GRU models, trained with pertinent custom loss functions, against both a standard MSE loss function and a naive vector-addition baseline. We evaluate our approach on both analytically (and numerically) defined manifolds, as well as a surface reconstructed from a LiDAR point cloud. Our results show that recurrent models can learn to approximate manifold-constrained dynamics from velocity sequences and consistently outperform Euclidean baselines. Our results demonstrate that certain custom loss functions significantly improve long-horizon prediction accuracy compared to conventional point-wise loss functions.

AI.tldr: 该文将流形导航形式化为速度驱动的跟踪任务，提出基于坐标卡的学习框架，在欧氏表示中训练GRU，并通过浸入映射将轨迹投回流形以计算几何一致的误差；在解析/数值流形及LiDAR重建曲面上，循环模型优于欧氏基线，定制损失显著提升长时程预测精度。
AI.motivation: 位置跟踪在欧氏导航中研究充分，但一般流形上的导航（运动受空间内在几何支配）关注较少；需要一种无需在学习中显式施加流形约束、又能保证几何一致性的建模方式。
AI.method: 将流形导航建模为速度驱动的跟踪任务；采用基于坐标卡的学习框架，使模型完全在欧氏表示中运算；预测轨迹先经浸入函数（immersion）映射到流形，再进行误差计算，从而在不显式约束流形的前提下评估几何一致性。经与多种循环架构比较后选用GRU进行序列位置预测，并设计定制损失函数，与标准MSE损失及朴素向量相加基线对比。
AI.result: 在解析定义与数值定义的流形以及由LiDAR点云重建的曲面上进行评估：循环模型能从速度序列学习并逼近受流形约束的动力学，持续优于欧氏基线；部分定制损失函数相比传统逐点损失函数显著提升长时程预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 坐标卡+浸入映射的框架可在纯欧氏表示中学习流形导航；GRU配合恰当的定制损失能在曲面上实现几何一致且长时程更准确的位置跟踪，优于欧氏基线。

title: ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Design Science Research (DSR) study
summary: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

AI.tldr: 本文将 ANASSA 高层架构（HLA）细化为面向实现的低层架构（LLA），产出 47 个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、能力驱动智能体选择、类型化契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证、治理控制、失败恢复路径与溯源记录，并通过端到端执行轨迹演示和四项分析评估。
AI.motivation: 地理空间数据上的智能体 AI 不仅需要自主推理与工具调用，还需显式编排、空间验证、治理、溯源、失败处理与人类决策权。已有 ANASSA 框架虽确立了高层组件与责任边界，但未说明这些高层责任如何系统化分解为面向实现的低层架构，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）方法，将 ANASSA 框架从高层架构（HLA）责任精化为低层架构（LLA），在保留原责任边界的前提下将其转化为可执行的架构结构。
AI.result: 产出包含 47 个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、基于能力的智能体选择、类型化契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、失败与恢复路径及溯源记录的 LLA；通过端到端执行轨迹进行演示，并从需求可追溯性、内部一致性、责任保持性与技术独立性四方面进行解析评估。
AI.conclusion: 该 HLA 到 LLA 的设计为 ANASSA 框架与未来系统实现之间提供了面向实现的桥梁，使受治理的空间智能体工作流可被审查、可重构、可测试，且不绑定于特定 AI 模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境。

title: SIRNET: Causal Adaptation of Pretrained Embeddings for Semiparametric Treatment-Effect Estimation Under Surrogacy
summary: Modern experiments increasingly produce rich post-treatment objects---such as text, images, and video---that may provide early surrogate signals for outcomes that are delayed, expensive, or observed only for a subset of participants. A pretrained encoder can turn such an object into a strong generic embedding, but the embedding is not trained for the estimation tasks required by a causal estimator and may emphasize information irrelevant to the causal target. We propose SIRNET, a Surrogate-Informed Representation adaptation framework for neural-NETwork-based causal estimation in the presence of unstructured post-treatment surrogates. Starting from pretrained surrogate embeddings, SIRNET learns a shared adapter jointly for outcome prediction, treatment propensity, and arm-specific surrogate marginalization, beyond the generic pretraining objective. The resulting covariate and surrogate representations provide a common interface for these nuisance tasks. The final treatment-effect estimate and confidence interval are obtained from cross-fitted orthogonal scores that attain the semiparametric efficiency bound under the stated nuisance-rate conditions. We also validate SIRNET's performance in synthetic and semisynthetic experiments, as well as the Anti-Amyloid in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease (A4) trial, using frozen pretrained brain-MRI embeddings as surrogates for a long-term outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIRNET，一种面向神经网路因果估计的代理信息表征适配框架，利用预训练编码器产生的非结构化治疗后代理信号，通过共享适配器联合学习结果预测、倾向得分与分臂代理边缘化任务，最终基于交叉拟合正交得分给出达到半参数效率界的处理效应估计与置信区间，并在合成、半合成实验及A4试验中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现代实验常产生文本、图像、视频等丰富的治疗后对象，它们可能为延迟、昂贵或仅对部分参与者观测的结果提供早期代理信号。预训练编码器可将此类对象转为强通用嵌入，但该嵌入并非针对因果估计任务训练，可能强调与因果目标无关的信息，因此需要对其进行面向因果估计的表征适配。
AI.method: 提出SIRNET（Surrogate-Informed Representation adaptation framework for neural-NETwork-based causal estimation）。方法从预训练代理嵌入出发，学习一个共享适配器，联合优化结果预测、处理倾向（propensity）以及分臂代理边缘化（arm-specific surrogate marginalization）三个 nuisance 任务，超越原始通用预训练目标，使协变量与代理表征为这些任务提供共同接口；最终通过交叉拟合的正交得分获得处理效应估计与置信区间。
AI.result: 在合成与半合成实验中验证了SIRNET的性能；并在抗淀粉样蛋白无症状阿尔茨海默病（A4）试验中，以冻结的预训练脑MRI嵌入作为长期结果的代理进行验证。所提估计量在给定的 nuisance 收敛速率条件下达到半参数效率界。
AI.conclusion: SIRNET通过代理信息驱动的表征适配，将通用预训练嵌入转化为适用于因果估计的表征，统一服务于多个 nuisance 任务，并在理论上具备半参数效率保证，在仿真与真实临床试验场景中均展现出有效性，为利用非结构化治疗后代理信号进行因果推断提供了可行框架。

title: Asynchronous Terahertz-field sampling with soliton microcombs
summary: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy records the electric field of terahertz transients and underpins applications from materials science to non-destructive testing. Asynchronous optical sampling enables systems without moving parts, but its acquisition rate remains fundamentally limited by the repetition-rate of the driving femtosecond lasers. Here, we demonstrate asynchronous terahertz-field sampling with two chip-based soliton microcombs. Their ultrahigh 25 GHz pulse repetition-rate drastically reduces dead-time during acquisition, and stabilization via sideband injection-locking enables coherent averaging without active feedback loops. At 10 kHz acquisition rate, we achieve a dynamic range of 74 dB in a single 100 $μ$s scan, and 100 dB after 50 ms of coherent averaging with a 1.6 THz bandwidth. Acquisition rates of up to 100 kHz are demonstrated, limited only by detection electronics. Together with a proof-of-concept silicon wafer thickness measurement, these results establish soliton microcombs as compact sources for rapid terahertz-field sampling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于两个芯片级孤子微梳的异步太赫兹场采样方案，利用25 GHz超高脉冲重复率大幅缩短采集死区，并通过边带注入锁定实现无需主动反馈的相干平均。在10 kHz采集率下实现单次100 μs扫描74 dB动态范围和50 ms相干平均100 dB动态范围（带宽1.6 THz），最高采集率达100 kHz，仅受探测电子学限制，并完成硅片厚度测量的概念验证。
AI.motivation: 传统太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）及异步光学采样（ASOPS）系统的采集率受驱动飞秒激光器重复率根本性限制，存在较大采集死区，且相干平均通常依赖主动反馈环路，系统复杂、体积大。因此需要一种紧凑、高速、无需主动反馈的太赫兹场采样方案。
AI.method: 采用两个芯片级孤子微梳作为异步采样的驱动源，其脉冲重复率达25 GHz；通过边带注入锁定实现梳间稳定，从而在无主动反馈环路条件下实现相干平均；利用异步采样方式对太赫兹瞬态电场进行记录。
AI.result: 在10 kHz采集率下，单次100 μs扫描获得74 dB动态范围；经50 ms相干平均后动态范围达100 dB，带宽1.6 THz；最高采集率可达100 kHz，仅受探测电子学带宽限制；并完成硅片厚度测量的概念验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，孤子微梳可作为紧凑型快速太赫兹场采样光源，兼具超高重复率、紧凑芯片化、无需主动反馈的相干平均能力及高动态范围，为材料科学到无损检测等领域提供实用化高速太赫兹采样方案。

title: Inter-Cell Interference Suppression for Channel Estimation and Data Detection in MIMO-OFDM Systems via Score-Based Variational Inference
summary: In multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems, conventional receivers based on linear channel estimation and subband-averaged interference covariance reconstruction suffer serious performance degradation under strong interference. To address this issue, we propose a probabilistic framework for joint channel estimation and interference suppression using score-based prior learning. Specifically, we formulate a variational inference problem that exploits the bilinear structure of the interference by explicitly separating the interference channels from the interference symbols. To solve the resulting highly nonconvex bilinear inference problem, we develop a score-based variational inference algorithm that combines score-based turbo message passing for target-channel estimation with a reverse mean propagation framework for interference-channel inference, while the interference symbols are updated via linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) estimation. We further design an interference rejection combining (IRC) detector with subcarrier-level covariance reconstruction based on the estimated interference channels, thereby avoiding the performance loss caused by conventional subband averaging. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is able to effectively suppress the interference in channel estimation, as well as to accurately reconstruct the interference subspace for interference rejection in data detection, and thus significantly outperforms existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于分数先验学习的联合信道估计与干扰抑制概率框架，用于MIMO-OFDM系统强干扰场景，通过双线性变分推断与子载波级协方差重建显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统MIMO-OFDM接收机依赖线性信道估计与子带平均干扰协方差重建，在强干扰下性能严重退化，需要一种能同时精确估计信道并有效抑制干扰的方法。
AI.method: 构建变分推断问题，利用干扰的双线性结构将干扰信道与干扰符号显式分离；提出基于分数的变分推断算法，结合基于分数的涡轮消息传递进行目标信道估计、反向均值传播框架进行干扰信道推断，并用LMMSE更新干扰符号；进一步设计基于估计干扰信道的子载波级协方差重建IRC检测器。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提算法能在信道估计中有效抑制干扰，并准确重建用于数据检测干扰抑制的干扰子空间，性能显著优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 该概率框架通过分数先验学习与双线性变分推断，实现了信道估计与干扰抑制的联合优化，并借助子载波级协方差重建避免了子带平均带来的性能损失。

title: LongHisDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Long Historical Document Understanding
summary: Chinese historical documents are invaluable cultural treasures, but their complexity poses significant comprehension challenges for non-specialists. Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding. LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document. It spans 10 categories and features four QA types: single-page, cross-page, multi-hop, and unanswerable. Answering these questions requires integrating multimodal evidence from text, layout, and visual elements. Our evaluation reveals that the top-performing LVLM and LLM achieve only 62.9% and 69.9% accuracy, respectively, highlighting a substantial performance gap. Furthermore, we assess various modal retrievers and the end-to-end RAG performance to provide references for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. We believe that LongHisDoc serves as a comprehensive benchmark to catalyze future research in full-book historical document understanding. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc and https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向长篇（整本书）历史文档理解的基准 LongHisDoc，含1012个专家标注QA对，覆盖101份PDF、10类与4种QA类型，揭示现有LVLM/LLM与RAG系统的显著性能差距。
AI.motivation: 中国历史文献是重要文化瑰宝，但其复杂性给非专业读者带来巨大理解障碍。尽管LLM与LVLM在现代文档任务中表现出色，其在长篇（整本书）历史文档理解上的能力尚未被系统探索，缺乏相应评测基准。
AI.method: 构建LongHisDoc基准：从101份PDF文档中由专家标注1012个QA对，平均每份文档85.1页、42,776.4 tokens；涵盖10个类别与单页、跨页、多跳、不可回答四类QA；回答需融合文本、版面与视觉元素的多模态证据。评测涵盖主流LVLM与LLM，并评估多种模态检索器及端到端RAG性能。
AI.result: 表现最佳的LVLM与LLM准确率仅为62.9%与69.9%，凸显显著性能差距；同时给出模态检索器与端到端RAG的评测结果，为RAG系统提供参考。
AI.conclusion: LongHisDoc是一个综合性基准，可推动整本历史文档理解的未来研究；基准与评测代码已公开。

title: Real-Time Traffic Density Estimation: A Hybrid Computer Vision and Predictive Machine Learning Pipeline
summary: Traffic density estimation from camera feeds requires connecting visual perception with short-horizon forecasting. We present a two-stage pipeline that combines vehicle detection and tracking with a spatial logic layer, followed by a temporal estimator. The spatial layer filters bounding boxes by their overlap with a precomputed road mask and extracts per-frame traffic features. LSTM, GRU, and Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) estimators use these features to predict five future steps from a ten-frame input window. We benchmark ten detector variants from six families on a dataset of 5,716 annotated frames using a single NVIDIA GPU. YOLOv5l achieves the highest mAP@50:95 of 0.524 at 56 frames per second, while YOLOv8n reaches 258 frames per second at 0.487 mAP@50:95; these rates measure detector inference without tracking or spatial filtering. Temporal evaluation on 29,243 held-out windows yields aggregate R-squared values of 0.858 for GRU, 0.856 for LSTM, and 0.840 for TCN. These metrics measure forecasts of detector-derived telemetry and are dominated by direction variance, rather than establishing absolute traffic-density accuracy. No road mask was available for the evaluation stream, limiting validation of the spatial filtering component. A live run on a third camera stream examines forecasting behavior within the complete pipeline. The results characterize detector speed-accuracy trade-offs and the limitations of short-window traffic telemetry forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段车流密度估计流程：先用检测跟踪加空间逻辑层（道路掩码过滤）提取逐帧交通特征，再用LSTM、GRU、TCN基于10帧输入预测未来5步；基准测试了6个家族10个检测器变体，YOLOv5l的mAP@50:95最高（0.524，56 FPS），YOLOv8n最快（258 FPS，0.487），时序预测聚合R²为GRU 0.858、LSTM 0.856、TCN 0.840。
AI.motivation: 从摄像头视频估计交通密度需要将视觉感知与短时预测相连接，现有工作往往只关注检测或预测单一方面，缺少端到端流程以及检测器速度-精度权衡与短窗口时序预测局限性的系统评估。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：空间层用预计算道路掩码按重叠度过滤边界框并提取逐帧交通特征；时序层用LSTM、GRU、TCN三种估计器，以10帧输入窗口预测未来5步。在5,716帧标注数据、单张NVIDIA GPU上对比6个家族共10个检测器变体；时序评估使用29,243个留出窗口；并在第三个摄像头流上做完整流程的实时运行观察。
AI.result: 检测方面：YOLOv5l取得最高mAP@50:95 0.524、56 FPS；YOLOv8n达258 FPS、mAP@50:95 0.487（速率仅含检测推理，不含跟踪与空间过滤）。时序方面：GRU R²=0.858、LSTM 0.856、TCN 0.840。这些指标衡量的是检测器派生遥测的预测，且由方向方差主导，并不代表绝对交通密度的准确度；评估流缺少道路掩码，空间过滤组件未能验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了检测器的速度-精度权衡，并揭示了短窗口交通遥测预测的局限性；空间过滤缺乏验证数据、指标受方向方差主导，尚不能支撑绝对交通密度精度结论，需后续补充道路掩码与更全面的评估。

title: Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware
summary: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score, while changing hardware largely rescales energy without changing the relative ranking of models. These results show that capability alone gives an incomplete picture of efficiency. We argue that benchmark scores should be reported together with measured energy consumption under a specified serving regime and output budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文对86个开放权重模型检查点、7个基准与6个硬件平台直接测量能耗-能力权衡，发现多数配置远离得分-能耗帕累托前沿，能耗中位数多用2.6–4.8倍（最高27倍），开启推理平均增耗约3.7倍，生成token数为能耗的不完美代理，FP8可降耗约四分之一且得分基本不变，硬件更换主要缩放能耗而不改变模型排序。
AI.motivation: 现有基准分数只反映LLM“能做什么”，却无法说明交付该能力所需能耗，缺少对能力-能耗权衡的系统实测，导致效率评估不完整、部署选型缺乏依据。
AI.method: 对86个开放权重模型检查点，在7个基准和6类硬件平台（从消费级GPU到八卡服务器）上进行直接能耗测量，对比同能力模型的能效差异、帕累托前沿偏离程度、推理（thinking）模式影响、生成token数与能耗的关系，以及FP8量化与硬件更换的作用。
AI.result: 同能力模型间能效差异显著；多数配置处于非帕累托最优，中位数多耗能2.6–4.8倍，最大达27倍；开启推理平均增耗约3.7倍，收益依模型族与输出预算而异；生成token数预测能耗会错序18–24%的模型对；FP8降耗约四分之一且得分变化小；更换硬件主要整体缩放能耗、不改变模型相对排序。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭能力得分无法完整刻画效率；应在指定服务配置与输出预算下，将基准分数与实测能耗一并报告。

title: Perfect Reconstruction Cannot Show Whether Two Codebooks on a VAE's Latent Space Agree
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material (per-run results, precommit documents and verification scripts) is provided as ancillary files
summary: Many systems read the latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) as discrete codes, and rely on each latent being read back as the code it was written as. Shannon (1948) took such a shared codebook as given; inside a VAE nothing enforces it. We prove that no item of a standard training report can reveal whether the written and read codes agree on encoded data. We construct two VAEs that reconstruct every input perfectly, infer exactly, and match on every per-example ELBO and every code histogram, yet agreement is one in the first and zero in the second. We then show that the ELBO's own terms bound how far a measured agreement can move: the variational gap bounds the shift to exact inference, and the rate bounds the shift to generation from the prior. For Gaussian posteriors, a mean-field encoder pays an exact price in the gap that depends on its choice of axes. On probabilistic PCA the gap certifies a trained encoder in all 75 settings we test, at agreement between 0.76 and 0.97. On 240 trained VAEs, a floor set by the rate and the dataset size rules out rate-side certification in advance for 66 models, and none of them certifies. The results yield a simple protocol, Certify-or-Measure, for any pipeline that reads a VAE as codes.

AI.tldr: 论文证明标准VAE训练报告无法揭示潜在编码写入与读取是否一致，并提出Certify-or-Measure协议来验证或测量该一致性。
AI.motivation: 许多系统将VAE的潜在空间视为离散编码，并假定写入的编码能被读回为同一编码。然而Shannon将共享码本视为给定前提，VAE内部并没有机制保证这一点。因此需要研究训练报告能否揭示写入与读取编码是否一致。
AI.method: 构造两个VAE，它们在重构、推断、每样本ELBO和编码直方图上完全一致，但一致率分别为1和0，证明标准报告无法揭示一致性。进一步用ELBO各项约束可测一致性的移动范围：变分间隙约束向精确推断的偏移，rate约束从先验生成的偏移。对高斯后验，均值场编码器在间隙中付出与坐标轴选择相关的精确代价。
AI.result: 在概率PCA上，间隙在全部75个测试设置中认证了训练编码器，一致率在0.76到0.97之间。在240个训练VAE中，由rate和数据集规模设定的下限提前排除了66个模型的rate侧认证，且它们均未被认证。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了Certify-or-Measure协议，适用于任何将VAE作为编码读取的流程。

title: Finite-event modulation transfer through forward-scattering media
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental Material is available as an ancillary file
summary: How spatial structure is transferred through a forward-scattering medium depends jointly on pattern scale and propagation distance. Starting from photon exit displacements, we derive modulation transfer while retaining the number, depths, and projected angles of individual deflections, with event occurrences described by a homogeneous Poisson process along the propagation path. The second angular moment yields a leading low-frequency loss proportional to $k^2z^3$, where $k$ is angular spatial frequency and $z$ is thickness. At finite frequency, the model predicts two coupled departures: loss bends below its low-frequency quadratic extrapolation at fixed thickness, and transfer curves separate by thickness at fixed $k^2z^3$. The leading corrections to both effects arise from the same fourth angular moment. For symmetric, nondegenerate projected-angle distributions, the full response further establishes increasing loss with thickness in the same medium at fixed joint variable. Binary-pattern measurements through TiO$_2$ suspensions span five nominal loadings, seven thicknesses, and 20 spatial frequencies, supporting the approximate low-frequency scaling and showing both departures. A Gaussian effective-angle response calibrated only on lower-frequency data predicts the held-out higher-frequency band without refitting, with a logarithmic root-mean-square error of 0.0181 compared with 0.1021 for quadratic extrapolation. The results show that finite-event statistics provide a common physical origin for spectral bending and thickness-dependent departure from low-frequency scaling, linking coarse-pattern transport to finer spatial structure.

AI.tldr: 从光子出射位移出发推导前向散射介质的调制传递函数，保留偏折的次数、深度和投影角，发现有限事件统计导致的谱弯曲与厚度偏离低频标度的共同物理起源，并用TiO₂悬浮液实验验证。
AI.motivation: 空间结构经前向散射介质传输的保真度同时依赖图案尺度与传播距离，但低频标度律在有限频率和有限厚度下的偏离机制尚不明确，缺乏统一的物理图像。
AI.method: 以光子出射位移为起点推导调制传递函数，保留单次偏折的数目、深度与投影角，事件发生由沿传播路径的齐次泊松过程描述；利用二阶角矩给出低频损耗∝k²z³，并用四阶角矩分析两个耦合偏离效应；通过TiO₂悬浮液二值图案测量（5种负载、7种厚度、20个空间频率）进行验证。
AI.result: 模型预测低频损耗正比于k²z³；在有限频率下出现两种耦合偏离：固定厚度时损耗低于其低频二次外推、固定k²z³时传递曲线随厚度分离，二者领头修正均来自同一四阶角矩；对称非退化投影角分布下，固定联合变量时损耗随厚度增大。实验支持低频标度律并观测到两种偏离；仅用低频数据校准的高斯有效角响应模型以对数RMSE 0.0181预测留出的高频段，优于二次外推的0.1021。
AI.conclusion: 有限事件统计为谱弯曲和厚度相关偏离低频标度提供了共同物理起源，将粗图案传输与更精细空间结构联系起来。

title: RF Fingerprinting of DSP Implementations using Machine Learning: An Over-the-Air Case Study
summary: Radio frequency fingerprinting aims to identify transmitters by exploiting small differences in the emitted signal waveform. Common approaches exploit hardware-dependent imperfections for that purpose. This work instead investigates whether differences between digital signal processing implementations of a transmitter can be identified from their radiated signals. As a practical case study, five different software-based DSP implementations for generating a 2-FSK RTTY communication waveform are considered. In a monitoring receiver, a classifier can identify these DSP implementations using convolutional neural networks that are trained on augmented software-generated signals represented as raw IQ, power spectrum or instantaneous frequency. The trained networks are evaluated on over-the-air recordings obtained using a shortwave transceiver and a software-defined radio receiver. The best neural network combines IQ and the power spectrum representation and achieves an accuracy of up to 90%. The study further examines the influence of the signal SNR and the observation bandwidth on the classification accuracy. The results demonstrate that DSP implementations leave distinguishable characteristics in the transmitted signals and suggest that DSP-dependent fingerprinting can provide complementary information for specific emitter identification systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字信号处理（DSP）实现差异是否会在发射信号中留下可识别的射频指纹。以五种软件 2-FSK RTTY 波形生成实现为例，用 CNN 对原始 IQ、功率谱和瞬时频率进行分类，最佳网络融合 IQ 与功率谱，在实测空口数据上最高达 90% 准确率，并分析了 SNR 与观测带宽的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统射频指纹主要利用发射机硬件缺陷进行识别，本文转而探究发射机数字信号处理（DSP）实现之间的差异能否从辐射信号中识别出来，以验证 DSP 实现是否可提供互补的指纹特征。
AI.method: 以五种不同的软件 DSP 实现生成 2-FSK RTTY 通信波形作为案例；在监测接收端使用卷积神经网络，基于增强的软件生成信号进行训练，输入表示包括原始 IQ、功率谱和瞬时频率；随后在短波收发信机与软件定义无线电接收机采集的空口录音上评估。最佳网络融合 IQ 与功率谱表示。
AI.result: 最佳神经网络（融合 IQ 与功率谱）在空口实测数据上准确率最高可达 90%；研究还考察了信号 SNR 与观测带宽对分类准确率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 DSP 实现会在发射信号中留下可区分的特征，说明基于 DSP 的指纹可为特定发射机识别系统提供补充信息。

title: Uniform Information Density-Based Preference Optimization
summary: To enable large language models to generate outputs that align with human preferences, optimization algorithms based on the comparison between chosen and rejected output pairs have been developed and been proven effective. Some recent endeavors have utilized certain linguistically-derived assumptions about the preference pairs to guide the design of more precise optimization directions. However, human preferences are complex and hard to measure by simplistic criteria, and it is important to incorporate broader and more sophisticated insights about preferred vs. not-preferred language. In this study, we adopt a well-established psycholinguistic theory, Uniform Information Density, to develop a novel preference optimization algorithm, UIDPO. The basic assumption is that humans prefer to produce language in which information is uniformly distributed, because uniformity induces less cognitive processing effort. To implement this idea into the algorithm, we derive a compound metric for information uniformity by combining the global standard deviation and the local second-order difference, and integrate it to the objective of preference optimization. We compare UIDPO with SimPO, a previous state-of-the-art method, obtaining comparable and sometimes better performance on AlpacaEval2, ArenaHard, and MT-Bench. Additional linguistic analysis on complement clauses also shows that UIDPO can better reflect the tendencies of keeping information uniform in natural language than baselines. Our results show that the subtle human preference over the information rate in language is a helpful source for achieving better human alignment for LLMs. The code repository is published here: https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UIDPO，一种基于心理语言学中"均匀信息密度"理论的新型偏好优化算法，通过复合度量（全局标准差 + 局部二阶差分）将信息均匀性融入偏好优化目标，在 AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard 和 MT-Bench 上取得与 SimPO 相当甚至更优的表现。
AI.motivation: 使大语言模型输出与人类偏好对齐的优化算法（基于 chosen/rejected 输出对的比较）已被证明有效，近期研究利用语言学假设来指导更精确的优化方向。但人类偏好复杂，难以用简单标准衡量，需要引入更广泛、更复杂的关于"偏好/非偏好语言"的洞见。
AI.method: 采用成熟的心理语言学理论——均匀信息密度（Uniform Information Density），假设人类偏好信息均匀分布的语言，因为均匀性带来更低的认知处理成本。为此推导出信息均匀性的复合度量：结合全局标准差与局部二阶差分，并将其整合进偏好优化目标，形成新算法 UIDPO。
AI.result: 在 AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard 和 MT-Bench 三个基准上，UIDPO 与先前最优方法 SimPO 相比表现相当，有时更优；对补充从句的语言学分析也显示，UIDPO 比基线更能反映自然语言中保持信息均匀的倾向。
AI.conclusion: 语言信息速率上微妙的人类偏好是帮助 LLM 实现更好人类对齐的有效来源。代码仓库已发布：https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO。

title: TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling
summary: Accurate sampling from continuous-time generative models can require many model evaluations. Low-step sampling reduces cost, but coarse updates introduce endpoint errors that can accumulate and degrade generation quality. We introduce TraceSampler, a post-training method that corrects these errors without modifying the pretrained model. Rather than optimising low-step updates directly, TraceSampler models endpoint error as a sample-specific prediction problem. A higher-step reference integration over the same interval provides the supervised target, while a compact representation makes high-dimensional error predictable from the sampling trace. This representation combines shared residual structure, trace-derived directions, and a low-rank remainder, so shallow per-step MLP heads predict sample-dependent coefficients. These coefficients drive a two-stage learned residual correction: the first stage predicts the full endpoint residual, while an intermediate backbone evaluation provides new trace information to predict the remaining residual; this evaluation is reused by the following step. TraceSampler is evaluated with Rectified Flow on CIFAR-10, SiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, and SD3.5 Medium for text-to-image generation. At 10 steps, it reduces trajectory MSE relative to matched-step Euler by 90.5% on CIFAR-10 and 85.6% on ImageNet-256, while achieving FID scores of 2.692 and 2.189, close to 120-step Heun references of 2.601 and 2.056 with 24$\times$ fewer backbone evaluations. On SD3.5 Medium, TraceSampler improves image quality and prompt following; at 10 steps, ImageReward rises from 0.752 to 0.906 while trajectory MSE falls by 70.7%. These gains preserve Euler's backbone-evaluation budget, add less than 0.4% inference FLOPs, and incur negligible wall-clock overhead, showing that coarse-step sampling error can be made predictable from the sampling trace and efficiently corrected.

AI.tldr: TraceSampler是一种后训练纠错方法，通过将少步采样的端点误差建模为样本级预测问题，用轻量MLP头预测残差系数并进行两阶段残差校正，在不修改预训练模型、几乎不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升少步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 连续时间生成模型要获得准确采样通常需要大量模型评估；少步采样虽降低成本，但粗粒度更新引入的端点误差会累积并损害生成质量。现有做法难以在不改动预训练模型的情况下高效纠正这类误差。
AI.method: 提出TraceSampler后训练方法：不直接优化少步更新，而是将端点误差视为样本特定预测问题。用同区间的高步参考积分作为监督目标；设计紧凑表示（共享残差结构、轨迹导出方向、低秩余项），使高维误差可由采样轨迹预测；由浅层每步MLP头预测样本相关系数，驱动两阶段学习残差校正：第一阶段预测完整端点残差，中间主干评估提供新轨迹信息以预测剩余残差，且该评估被下一步复用。
AI.result: 在Rectified Flow/CIFAR-10、SiT-XL/2/ImageNet-256及SD3.5 Medium文本生图上验证。10步时轨迹MSE较同部数Euler分别降低90.5%和85.6%，FID为2.692和2.189，接近120步Heun参考的2.601和2.056，主干评估减少24倍；SD3.5 Medium上10步ImageReward由0.752升至0.906，轨迹MSE降70.7%。同时保持Euler主干评估预算，推理FLOPs增加不足0.4%，墙钟开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 粗步采样误差可从采样轨迹中被预测并高效校正，TraceSampler以极低开销显著缩小少步与多步采样的质量差距。

title: SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

AI.tldr: SAT-RL 是一个强化学习框架，训练 LLM 通过多轮工具调用与符号求解器（如 Z3）交互，结合合成数据、监督预热和求解器接地的 RL 奖励，显著提升符号推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 在数学与逻辑推理上表现强劲，但随约束交互数量增加和搜索空间扩大，面临"复杂性诅咒"，难以应对高难度问题；而 Z3 等可满足性求解器虽具备可扩展、可验证的形式化推理能力，却无法灵活理解自然语言描述。因此需要一种方法融合两者的优势。
AI.method: 提出 SAT-RL 强化学习框架，训练 LLM 通过多轮工具执行与符号求解器交互。方法包含三部分：(1) 带可验证解的合成数据生成；(2) 求解器增强轨迹上的监督预热；(3) 基于求解器接地的强化学习，使用工具感知奖励。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAT-RL 在域内和域外逻辑任务上均显著提升了借助工具的符号推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 与符号求解器通过 RL 结合可有效缓解复杂性瓶颈，代码已开源。

title: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
summary: Accurate day-ahead photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting requires both strong temporal modeling and adherence to physical PV system constraints. Purely data-driven models often ignore the underlying PV conversion process and may produce predictions that are outside the operational range of a PV system. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed state space framework that combines a differentiable PV conversion model with a selective state space backbone (PowerMamba). Our approach follows a physics-residual decomposition. The physics module provides a structured baseline based on solar geometry, irradiance, temperature effects, and inverter limits, while the state space model learns residual corrections from numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs over a 24-hour horizon. Experiments on one year of utility-scale PV data show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting accuracy, reducing RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8% compared to a physics-only baseline, and outperforming a purely data-driven model. Results further show that incorporating system-level physics provides the largest performance gains, while additional refinements offer only marginal improvements. Beyond accuracy, the model improves robustness by constraining predictions toward physical feasibility, reducing unrealistic predictions under corrupted measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出物理信息状态空间框架，将可微光伏转换模型与选择性状态空间骨干(PowerMamba)结合，通过物理-残差分解实现日前光伏功率预测。
AI.motivation: 准确的日前光伏功率预测既需要强时序建模，又需遵循光伏系统的物理约束。纯数据驱动模型忽略光伏转换过程，可能产生超出系统运行范围的预测。因此需要将物理知识与数据驱动方法结合。
AI.method: 采用物理-残差分解：物理模块基于太阳几何、辐照度、温度效应和逆变器限制提供结构化基线；状态空间模型(PowerMamba)从NWP输入学习24小时时域上的残差修正，二者结合为物理信息状态空间框架。
AI.result: 基于一年公用事业规模光伏数据的实验表明：相比纯物理基线，RMSE降低38.5%，MAE降低45.8%，并优于纯数据驱动模型；系统级物理带来最大性能增益，额外细化仅带来边际提升；模型通过向物理可行性约束预测，在测量数据损坏时减少不合理预测，提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将可微物理模型与选择性状态空间模型结合的物理信息框架能显著提升日前光伏预测精度，并增强预测的物理可行性与鲁棒性，系统级物理建模是性能提升的关键。

title: Image Priors for Single-Shot Coded Diffraction Phase Retrieval
summary: Phase retrieval recovers complex-valued objects from intensity-only measurements. In its classical Fourier form, reconstruction suffers from twin-image stagnation. Coded diffraction imaging, which adds a random phase mask before the Fourier transform, has so far required several masks. We show that an image prior makes single-shot coded diffraction imaging possible, with a single random mask followed by a Fourier transform. We validate this claim in simulation and in an optical experiment, in which a spatial light modulator displays the phase object together with the random mask. Our experimental validation covers five test signals and 530 images from the public Brno quantitative phase microscopy dataset of five adherent cell lines. With no image prior or with Fourier-only measurements, reconstruction of complex-valued objects from a single diffraction pattern consistently fails. An out-of-the-box pretrained image denoiser enables accurate reconstruction, in simulation even with fewer measurements than unknowns. Five regularization frameworks built on the same denoiser and one learned weakly convex regularizer all reconstruct the experimental images with peak signal-to-noise ratios within one decibel of each other. A single random phase mask and image priors thus turn coded diffraction imaging into a practical single-shot modality for quantitative phase imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，引入图像先验后，仅需单个随机相位掩模加傅里叶变换即可实现单次曝光编码衍射成像，并在仿真与光学实验中完成复值相位物体的重建。
AI.motivation: 经典傅里叶相位恢复存在孪生像停滞问题；编码衍射成像此前需要多个掩模才能获得较好重建，因此希望减少掩模数量以实现单次曝光成像。
AI.method: 在傅里叶变换前加入单个随机相位掩模进行编码衍射成像；利用现成预训练图像去噪器作为图像先验，并比较五种基于同一去噪器的正则化框架及一个学习型弱凸正则化器。实验中使用空间光调制器同时显示相位物体与随机掩模。
AI.result: 在仿真与光学实验中验证了该方案的可行性；实验涵盖五个测试信号以及来自公开Brno定量相位显微数据集的530幅图像（五种贴壁细胞系）。无图像先验或仅用傅里叶测量时单幅衍射图重建持续失败。预训练去噪器可实现精确重建，仿真中即使测量数少于未知数也有效；五种正则化框架与一个学习型弱凸正则化器的重建峰值信噪比相差在1 dB以内。
AI.conclusion: 单个随机相位掩模结合图像先验，使编码衍射成像成为实用的单次曝光定量相位成像模态。

title: Physical Layer Security for Movable Antenna-Aided Mixed-Field ISAC
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Communications
summary: Movable antenna (MA) can enhance the physical layer security (PLS) performance of integrated sensing and communications (ISAC). However, most existing works assume either near-field (NF) or far-field (FF) propagation models for both communication users (CUs) and targets. This paper considers a more practical scenario where multiple CUs, an eavesdropper (Eve), and multiple targets are in a mixed near- and far-field environment due to the changes in the propagation field caused by antenna position updates in MA with a unified array response and continuous NF/FF weights. To evaluate the PLS performance of MA-aided ISAC in mixed-field environments, we formulate an optimization problem to maximize the sum secrecy rate (SSR) of CUs by jointly designing the transmit beamforming and antenna positions at the transmitter. The problem is highly non-convex, so a two-layer algorithm is proposed to iteratively solve the problem using the projected gradient ascent (PGA) method and the Lagrangian dual transform. Since the abrupt switch between the NF and the FF models during antenna movement can cause the objective function to oscillate during iteration, the unified array response is combined with the Barzilai-Borwein step, Armijo line search, and precise projection to ensure that the SSR does not decrease during the iteration and the objective function is differentiable on the Rayleigh boundary. Numerical results show that the MA-ISAC using the mixed-field model achieves almost identical PLS performance to that of using the full NF model in terms of SSR, and both outperform the FF model. Using the mismatched FF model during antenna position updates results in a loss of MA gain, potentially making MA inferior to the FA-based system using the correct model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合近-远场环境下可移动天线（MA）辅助的集成感知与通信（ISAC）物理层安全（PLS）问题，通过联合优化发射波束成形与天线位置最大化通信用户（CU）的和保密速率（SSR），并提出两层迭代算法有效抑制近/远场模型切换引起的目标函数振荡。
AI.motivation: MA可提升ISAC的PLS性能，但现有工作通常假设CU与目标均处于单一近场（NF）或远场（FF）模型。由于MA天线位置更新会改变传播场，实际中CU、窃听者与多目标可能共处于近-远场混合环境；且近/远场模型间的突变切换会导致迭代过程中目标函数振荡，因此需要研究更符合实际的混合场PLS优化问题。
AI.method: 面向多CU、一个窃听者与多目标的混合近-远场环境，采用统一阵列响应及连续NF/FF权重刻画信道；构建以最大化SSR为目标的联合波束成形与天线位置优化问题。该问题高度非凸，采用两层算法迭代求解，结合投影梯度上升（PGA）方法与拉格朗日对偶变换；针对近/远场模型突变切换导致的目标振荡，将统一阵列响应与Barzilai-Borwein步长、Armijo线搜索及精确投影相结合，保证SSR迭代不下降且目标函数在瑞利边界处可微。
AI.result: 数值结果表明：采用混合场模型的MA-ISAC在SSR上几乎达到与全NF模型相同的PLS性能，且二者均优于FF模型；若在天线位置更新中采用不匹配的FF模型，会造成MA增益损失，甚至可能使MA性能劣于使用正确模型的FA系统。
AI.conclusion: 在MA辅助ISAC的PLS设计中，采用混合场模型既能贴近实际传播场景，又能获得接近全NF模型的保密性能；忽视传播场变化而误用FF模型将显著削弱MA优势。所提出的统一阵列响应结合稳健步长与投影的两层算法可有效保证迭代收敛与性能不退化。

title: PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究了大型视觉语言模型中的一种新幻觉失败模式——前提诱导的视觉固着幻觉（PVFH），并构建了 PVFH-Bench 基准进行系统评测。
AI.motivation: 对象幻觉持续损害 LVLM 在视觉问答、具身智能体和人机决策支持等应用中的可靠性。作者受认知科学中知觉偏差研究启发，希望探究一种此前未被充分关注的幻觉失败模式。
AI.method: 定义了 PVFH，即模型因前提诱导的推理错误而固着于视觉上易混淆的证据，接受错误的文本前提，并生成关于不存在但视觉上合理的对象的回答。为此提出 PVFH-Bench，自动构造视觉上易混淆但实际缺席的目标，并将核心幻觉设定与诊断性子集配对，以追踪模型从对象识别到 PVFH 的过程。在 10 个先进 LVLM 上进行实验。
AI.result: 所有被评估的模型都极易受到 PVFH 影响；此外，显式的思维链推理会进一步加剧该失败模式，促使模型将微弱的视觉线索过度解读为幻觉对象的支持证据。
AI.conclusion: PVFH 是 LVLM 中普遍且严重的幻觉失败模式，思维链推理可能放大该问题，提示需要针对前提诱导的视觉固着进行专门缓解。

title: Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos
summary: World-action models inherit broad visual and physical priors from video pre-training. However, standard within-video next-frame prediction allows them to rely on appearance shared between the context and future, rather than learning interactions that transfer across scenes and embodiments. We introduce WATCH, a cross-video pre-training that learns from task-paired human demonstrations collected across diverse environments. Conditioned on the video and actions of one demonstration, the model jointly predicts another demonstration's actions and future frames from its current observation. Predicting one demonstration from another encourages the model to learn task-relevant interactions that transfer across scenes and demonstrators. Our pre-training shows that these capabilities can be learned from readily scalable human-human pairs alone, without requiring matched human-robot demonstrations. Analyses before robot post-training show improved motion alignment across embodiments and better action and video prediction on unseen robots, with representations closer to those learned from robot pairs. After robot post-training, WATCH improves MimicDroid in-context success from 40.9% to 68.3% with Cosmos Policy and from 59.8% to 77.7% with Cosmos3, with the largest gains on the unseen levels. Gains persist under context-free post-training across robot embodiments. WATCH outperforms within-video pre-training and co-training baselines, supporting cross-video prediction as a scalable approach to learning transferable world-action representations.

AI.tldr: 提出跨视频预训练方法WATCH，通过任务配对的人类演示互相预测动作与未来帧，学习可跨场景与本体迁移的世界-动作表征，显著提升机器人后训练成功率。
AI.motivation: 标准的视频内下一帧预测使世界-动作模型依赖上下文与未来之间共享的外观信息，而非学习可跨场景、跨本体迁移的任务交互规律。因此需要一种能促使模型学到任务相关、可迁移交互的预训练方式，并避免对昂贵的配对"人类-机器人"演示数据的依赖。
AI.method: WATCH采用跨视频预训练范式：利用在多样环境中采集的任务配对人类演示数据。给定其中一条演示的视频与动作作为条件，模型同时预测另一条演示的动作及其从当前观测出发的未来帧。用一条演示预测另一条，迫使模型关注任务相关的交互而非共享外观。该方法仅依赖可扩展的"人类-人类"配对，无需配对的"人类-机器人"演示。
AI.result: 机器人后训练前的分析显示：跨本体的运动对齐改善，在未见机器人上的动作与视频预测更优，且表征更接近由机器人配对学到的表征。机器人后训练后，WATCH将MimicDroid的上下文成功率由40.9%提升至68.3%（Cosmos Policy），由59.8%提升至77.7%（Cosmos3），在未见层级上增益最大。该增益在跨机器人本体的无上下文后训练下依然保持，且优于视频内预训练与联合训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 跨视频预测是一种可扩展的学习可迁移世界-动作表征的有效途径。WATCH证明仅凭可规模化的人类-人类配对数据即可习得跨场景与跨本体的任务交互能力，并在机器人后训练中带来显著且稳健的性能提升。

title: Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 15 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables
summary:
Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agentic RAG approach is straightforward to implement (1-2 engineer days), portable across capable agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code), and performs strongly on the challenging task of CS resolution workflow generation, achieving 99.2% procedural equivalence to human-approved ground truth and 83.3% evidence sufficiency. It is also roughly an order of magnitude slower per case than our deployed production assistant (~90 s vs. ~8-9 s), so we claim no latency advantage. Our claim is scoped to that setting: a mature, well-curated corpus, a latency-tolerant workflow, and human review of every case. There, the skill did the work of a complex RAG stack, and maintenance became a matter of editing text and data rather than retraining models.

AI.tldr: 本文报告一个企业客户支持场景的部署案例：用"自然语言指令+轻量工具+LLM生成的Wikipedia式导航层语料"组成的可移植skill，替代复杂的RAG流水线完成解决流程生成，达到99.2%流程等价性与83.3%证据充分性，但每案例约90秒、比生产助手慢约一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 企业工作流自动化（如客服案件）需要从SOP、政策文档等大规模运营语料中检索出完整且准确的相关信息，以实现对政策的精确grounding。生产级达标通常依赖复杂的文档分块、索引、检索流水线，并叠加学习式重排序器、查询改写与定制化agentic RAG基础设施，成本与维护负担高，作者希望探索更简单且可移植的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一种"便携skill"方案，由三部分构成：(1) 自然语言指令；(2) 轻量工具（检索API、格式检查脚本）；(3) 经过增强的语料库——在其上叠加LLM生成的导航层，即对底层文档构建结构化"Wikipedia式"索引。实现仅需1–2名工程师天，可移植于具备能力的agentic harness（如Claude Code）。
AI.result: 在客服解决流程生成这一困难任务上，该方法达到99.2%与人工认可ground truth的流程等价性（procedural equivalence）与83.3%的证据充分性（evidence sufficiency）。延迟方面，每案例约90秒，而部署的生产助手约8–9秒，即慢约一个数量级，作者明确不主张延迟优势。
AI.conclusion: 该方案的结论有明确适用范围：成熟且精心策展的语料、对延迟容忍的工作流、以及每案例均有人工审核。在此设定下，该skill完成了复杂RAG栈的工作，且维护从"重训模型"转变为"编辑文本与数据"。作者不声称普遍优越性，仅在此部署场景内主张其有效性。

title: DShuttleNet: A Badminton Doubles Dataset for Evaluating Team Coordination
summary: Most existing sports datasets are individual-centric or ball-centric, focusing on individual player actions while ignoring interactions among teammates. In badminton doubles, tactical success is governed by rapid team formation and coordination, yet standard resources for modeling these player interactions are scarce. To bridge this gap, we present DShuttleNet, a comprehensive dataset for badminton doubles curated from elite BWF World Tour tournaments. Beyond trajectory data, DShuttleNet uniquely incorporates expert-labeled "Loss Reasons," transforming the dataset into a diagnostic tool for causal tactical evaluation. We formally define two geometry-driven representations, Teammate-Relative Angle (TRA) and Vertical Shot Angle (VSA), to characterize coordination and shot aggressiveness. To quantify interpersonal synergy, we introduce novel metrics, Court Coverage Efficacy Index (CCEI) and Threat Load Asymmetry Index (TLAI), which evaluate the often-overlooked non-hitting partner's role and defensive coordination. Experimental results demonstrate that conventional models suffer from underfitting when failing to incorporate these coordination-centric features, highlighting the critical importance and potential impact of releasing DShuttleNet. Dataset is available at: https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/16097938.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了DShuttleNet——一个面向羽毛球双打的综合数据集，涵盖精英BWF世界巡回赛轨迹数据并附带专家标注的"失分原因"，同时提出两套几何表征与两项协同指标，以推动双打团队交互与战术因果分析研究。
AI.motivation: 现有体育数据集多为个体中心或球中心，聚焦单个球员动作，忽视队友间交互；而羽毛球双打的战术成功依赖快速阵型形成与协同配合，相关建模资源稀缺，因此需要构建面向双打交互的数据集。
AI.method: 构建DShuttleNet数据集（源自精英BWF世界巡回赛的双打轨迹数据，含专家标注"失分原因"）；形式化定义两种几何驱动表征——队友相对角度（TRA）与垂直击球角度（VSA），分别刻画协同性与击球攻击性；提出两项量化人际协同的指标——场地覆盖效率指数（CCEI）与威胁负载不对称指数（TLAI），用于评估非击球搭档角色与防守协同。
AI.result: 实验表明，传统模型在未引入这些协同中心特征时会出现欠拟合，说明该类特征对双打战术建模至关重要。
AI.conclusion: DShuttleNet将数据集拓展为因果战术评估的诊断工具，凸显双打协同特征的必要性，并为体育交互建模提供新资源与量化框架，数据集已公开。

title: Bistatic Delay-Doppler Sensing for 3D Target Localization in Distributed Wi-Fi Systems
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 1st IEEE Conference on Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC), Lisbon, Portugal, November 2026
summary: This paper investigates how bistatic delay information improves the observability and localization performance of 3D moving targets in distributed Wi-Fi sensing. Motivated by emerging IEEE 802.11bf WLAN sensing, we consider one transmitter, multiple distributed receivers, and a single target with unknown position and velocity. We compare Doppler-only sensing with delay-Doppler sensing, in which delay-capable receivers provide additional bistatic path-length information for target localization. We derive the Fisher information matrix (FIM) and the position equivalent FIM (EFIM) for both sensing formulations. The resulting observability analysis shows that Doppler-only localization generically requires six receivers, whereas delay-Doppler localization can become locally identifiable with three receivers under non-degenerate geometry. We further study mixed receiver architectures in which only a subset of receivers provides delay estimates. Simulations with Wi-Fi-like bandwidths confirm the transition and quantify the roles of bandwidth, Doppler noise, receiver geometry, and delay-capable receiver availability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双基地时延信息对分布式Wi-Fi感知中3D运动目标可观测性与定位性能的提升，推导了多普勒与联合时延-多普勒两种感知体制下的FIM与位置EFIM，并给出可观测性条件与仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 面向新兴IEEE 802.11bf WLAN感知需求，探索单发射机、多分布式接收机、单个未知位置与速度目标场景下，双基地时延信息如何改善3D运动目标的可观测性与定位性能。
AI.method: 考虑单发射机、多分布式接收机与单个位置速度未知目标，对比仅多普勒感知与时延-多普勒感知（具备时延能力的接收机提供额外双基地路径长度信息）；推导两种体制的Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）与位置等效FIM（EFIM），并进行可观测性分析；进一步研究仅部分接收机提供时延估计的混合接收机架构，并以类Wi-Fi带宽开展仿真。
AI.result: 可观测性分析表明，仅多普勒定位一般需要六个接收机，而时延-多普勒定位在非退化几何下三个接收机即可实现局部可辨识；仿真在类Wi-Fi带宽下确认了该转变，并量化了带宽、多普勒噪声、接收机几何以及具备时延能力接收机可用性的作用。
AI.conclusion: 引入双基地时延信息可显著降低3D运动目标定位所需接收机数量并提升可观测性，混合接收机架构为实际分布式Wi-Fi感知系统提供了灵活的配置依据。

title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
summary: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. The engineering application is TCM clinical decision support, particularly herbal prescription recommendation. We evaluate the models on a public benchmark containing 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 TCM knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks and on a private retrospective dataset of 4,348 spleen and stomach disease prescription cases. The 14 billion parameter reinforcement aligned model achieves a prescription generation F1 of 37.0 on the public benchmark, compared with 32.3 for DeepSeek-R1 with 671 billion total parameters, and a herb-level F1 of 52.8 on the clinical dataset with improved dosage agreement. Reinforcement post-training consistently improves prescription recommendation across all scales, while physician-source analysis shows that expert heterogeneity affects reward stability. These findings demonstrate a scalable pathway from domain grounding and reasoning supervision to clinically oriented prescription decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向中医临床决策的中医语言模型家族（4B/8B/14B参数），通过分阶段临床对齐框架（中医继续预训练、互补推理监督、以处方为中心的强化学习）将中药处方生成形式化为结构化强化学习问题，14B对齐模型在公开基准上处方生成F1达37.0（优于DeepSeek-R1的32.3），临床数据集药味级F1达52.8。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医学推理上已有进展，但中医临床推理仍具挑战：处方决策需整合领域知识、辨证、治法、方剂配伍与剂量确定。作者希望构建可规模化的路径，实现从领域知识落地与推理监督到临床导向的处方决策支持。
AI.method: 开发含4B、8B、14B参数的中医语言模型家族；构建分阶段临床对齐框架，包括大规模中医与临床病历继续预训练、互补推理监督、以处方为中心的强化学习；并将中药处方生成建模为带处方级反馈的结构化强化学习问题，直接优化临床决策输出而非知识复述或通用指令遵循。
AI.result: 在含25,620条专家核验题目、覆盖13项中医知识与临床推理任务的公开基准上，14B强化对齐模型处方生成F1为37.0，高于671B总参数的DeepSeek-R1的32.3；在4,348例脾胃病处方回顾性私有数据集上，药味级F1为52.8，剂量一致性亦有提升。强化后训练在各参数规模上均提升处方推荐效果，医师来源分析显示专家异质性影响奖励稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了从领域落地与推理监督到临床导向处方决策支持的可扩展路径；强化后训练可稳定提升处方推荐性能，同时提示奖励设计需考虑专家标注异质性带来的稳定性问题。

title: RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work
summary: Augmenting worker capabilities in the physical world through guidance has been a decades-long goal for AI agents. One key supporting capability is to understand what the worker is doing, seeing through the human's camera or smart glasses, and assist them in documentation. Despite advances in vision language models, their capabilities in these settings remain uncertain and are challenging to benchmark because most physical work data is proprietary, and involves too much variability to study in a principled manner. Unlike structured settings such as kitchens and warehouses that have predictable lighting, geometry, and objects, field-facing tasks such as rooftop solar installation and vehicle repair are unconstrained and high variance. Here, we model real-world physical work in Blender across eleven environments, incorporating variants in both image acceptability and documentation. The acceptability task asks whether a particular view would be suitable proof-of-work and documentation asks whether an agent can understand the task-relevant state of the environment from that view. Across 26 vision-language models, we find that top models largely solve documentation when the answer is text in frame, but are weak at reading measurements and at judging small parts and spatial relations, such as whether a tape measure leans. Acceptability is harder to pin down because human raters disagree with each other. Measured against a scorer that agrees with the raters' majority about as often as a single rater does, the best models cannot be distinguished from a single non-author rater, at a cost within the range of a human pass. In the three environments where we can trace acceptability errors, most wrong rejections come from misreading the scene rather than the requirement. On the three documentation questions for which we have real images, model rankings on rendered frames transfer to real images.

AI.tldr: 该研究用Blender构建了11类真实物理工作场景基准，评估26个视觉语言模型在"可接受性判定"与"文档理解"两项任务上的表现，发现模型能处理画面内文本但弱于测量读数与空间关系判断，可接受性判定仅相当于单个人类评审水平。
AI.motivation: 通过智能眼镜/相机辅助一线物理工作者（如屋顶光伏安装、车辆维修）进行工作记录，是AI智能体数十年目标。但此类现场任务光照、几何、物体高度多变，且真实工作数据多为专有，难以用原则化方式研究，导致视觉语言模型在此类场景中的能力尚不明确、缺乏基准。
AI.method: 在Blender中对真实物理工作进行建模，覆盖11种环境，并对"图像可接受性"与"文档记录"引入多种变体。可接受性任务判断某视角是否适合作为工作证明；文档任务判断智能体能否从该视角理解任务相关的环境状态。共评测26个视觉语言模型，并引入与人类多数意见一致率相当于单个人类评审的评分器作为对照。
AI.result: 顶级模型在答案为画面内文本时基本能解决文档任务，但在读取测量数值、判断小部件与空间关系（如卷尺是否倾斜）方面较弱。可接受性更难度量，因人类评审相互间存在分歧；以多数一致率约等于单个人类评审的评分器为基准，最佳模型与单个非作者人类评审无法区分，且成本处于人类通过所需范围内。在可追溯错误的三类环境中，多数错误拒绝源于对场景的误读而非对要求的误读。在三个有真实图像的文档问题上，渲染帧上的模型排名可迁移至真实图像。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型在真实物理工作辅助场景中仍存在明显短板，尤其是测量读数与精细空间关系判断；可接受性判定任务上模型表现未超越单个人类评审。渲染基准可作为真实图像的可靠代理，为后续研究提供可原则化、可扩展的评测框架。

title: AlignPoison: Conditional Targeted Poisoning of Generative Recommenders via Decoding-Aligned Prefixes
summary: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. While their modeling flexibility has been widely studied, their resilience to data poisoning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we ask: how susceptible are generative recommenders to conditional targeted poisoning? Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. We observe that short, context-aligned prefixes that are both common under the model's induced transition dynamics and strongly linked to a frequent trigger consistently amplify targeted promotion. Motivated by this analysis, we develop AlignPoison, a black-box framework that discovers and samples context-aligned prefixes from API outputs. We conduct experiments on benchmarks in unimodal and multimodal generative recommendation settings. Results show that these prefixes outperform competitive baselines, improving ASR lift by up to 16.3 percentage points and highlighting a decoding-dependent, context-sensitive poisoning vulnerability in generative recommendation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式推荐模型在面对条件定向投毒攻击时的脆弱性，提出黑盒框架 AlignPoison，通过挖掘上下文对齐前缀注入少于 1% 的合成交互，显著提升恶意目标的推广概率。
AI.motivation: 基于自回归解码的生成式推荐模型正逐步替代传统排序系统，其建模灵活性已被广泛研究，但其对数据投毒的鲁棒性尚缺乏探索。作者关注在攻击者仅能注入有限恶意交互并以黑盒方式查询推荐 API 的现实设定下，生成式推荐模型是否易受条件定向投毒攻击。
AI.method: 作者从两个角度分析恶意交互的合成：(i) 解码对齐（decoding alignment）与 (ii) 前缀流行度（prefix popularity）。基于此分析提出 AlignPoison：一个从 API 输出中发现并采样上下文对齐前缀的黑盒框架。
AI.result: 实验表明，注入少于 1% 的合成交互即可显著提升触发条件下恶意目标的推广概率。在单模态与多模态生成式推荐基准上，AlignPoison 发现的前缀优于竞争基线，ASR 提升最高达 16.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 生成式推荐模型存在依赖解码过程、对上下文敏感的条件定向投毒脆弱性；短小、上下文对齐且与高频触发词强关联的前缀会稳定放大定向推广效果。

title: Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging
summary: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

AI.tldr: 提出重心锚定搜索（Barycentric Anchored Search），一种无需梯度训练、不增加推理开销的事后权重空间方法，仅用两个微调检查点即可提升分布偏移下的视觉模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 微调视觉模型在分布偏移（OOD）下性能下降；Model Soup 依赖大量微调检查点，Model Stock 使用固定几何合并规则，均缺乏对 OOD 验证反馈的自适应利用。作者希望以更轻量的方式在权重空间中自适应优化合并权重，兼顾鲁棒性与精度。
AI.method: 给定预训练初始化和两个源数据集微调检查点，构造重心候选权重，并沿每个候选到预训练模型的方向进行小规模无导数搜索；受 Nelder-Mead 和 Torczon 多方向搜索等单纯形无导数优化启发，但针对神经网络权重合并的几何特性做了专门设计；用少量 OOD 数据集验证子集选择候选权重，并在保留部分及其他 OOD 基准与 ImageNet 验证集上评估鲁棒性-精度权衡。
AI.result: CLIP ViT-B/32 实验中，搜索显著提升保留 OOD 数据（ImageNet-A、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-Sketch）性能，同时 ImageNet 精度保持竞争力；所得权重在未参与候选选择的 OOD 数据集上也优于原始微调检查点、朴素 Model Soup 和 Model Stock。
AI.conclusion: 在锚定权重空间中做轻量优化，是替代固定权重平均规则、几何合并或单模型选择的一种实用方案。

title: Programmable Hard-X-Ray Spectral Comb Generation via Laser-Compton Scattering
summary: Independent control of line spacing and offset underpins programmable frequency-comb spectroscopy, yet it has not been established for hard-X-ray sources based on inverse Compton scattering after electron transport and angular collection. Self-consistent multi-particle tracking and Li'enard-Wiechert radiation calculations model a transported 10 pC beam and its angle-integrated spectrum near 11 keV. Laser pulse separation programs the comb spacing, while pulse-to-pulse phase translates the entire line grid at fixed spacing. The spacing model agrees within 0.52%, while transport and optics change the phase-transfer slope by less than 0.2%. At fixed electron spot size, the largest resolvable separation scales as the inverse square of normalized emittance; subnanometer bunches also produce a mode-locked train with 13.9 as spacing. This two-coordinate programmability enables phase-stepped multicolor measurements and offers routes to hard-X-ray Ramsey interferometry, coherent control of core and nuclear excitations, and attosecond nonlinear spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过自洽多粒子追踪与Liénard-Wiechert辐射计算，证明基于逆康普顿散射的硬X射线源可独立编程频率梳的线间距与偏移。
AI.motivation: 频率梳光谱依赖线间距与偏移的独立控制，但该能力在经历电子输运与角度收集后的逆康普顿散射硬X射线源中尚未建立。
AI.method: 耦合自洽多粒子追踪与Liénard-Wiechert辐射计算，对输运后的10 pC电子束及其在11 keV附近的角度积分谱进行建模；以激光脉冲间隔设定梳间距，以脉冲间相位平移整个谱线网格（间距固定）。
AI.result: 间距模型误差在0.52%以内；输运与光学导致相位传递斜率变化小于0.2%；固定电子斑尺寸时，最大可分辨间距按归一化发射度的平方反比缩放；亚纳米束团还可产生间距为13.9 as的锁模脉冲序列。
AI.conclusion: 该双坐标可编程性支持相位步进多色测量，并为硬X射线Ramsey干涉、核与芯能级激发的相干控制以及阿秒非线性光谱提供路径。

title: Theoretical Investigation of Nonclassical Directional Emission in 1D and 2D Quantum-Dot Antenna Arrays and Quantum DoA Estimation
summary: A quantum-dot array prepared in a timed Dicke state exhibits directional radiation asymmetry, which has often been interpreted as evidence of reciprocity breaking through quantum-state preparation. We show that this interpretation is incorrect: reciprocity concerns transmit-receive response, not necessarily pattern symmetry. Moreover, the first-order coherence of any single-excitation state is exactly equivalent to the power pattern of a classical phased array driven by conjugate weights, making the observed asymmetry classically reproducible. The genuine quantum signature instead appears in second-order correlations, where a single-excitation state violates the classical lower bound on photon coincidences. We therefore propose a quantum-antenna certificate combining nonzero directional asymmetry with photon antibunching at the beam peak. We further derive a tight asymmetry bound, establish the correct mirror operation for planar arrays, correct the collective decay rate with dipole-dipole coupling, and derive a saturation law for direction-finding precision. All theoretical results are validated through independent numerical implementations.

AI.tldr: 该文指出量子点阵列定向辐射不对称并非互易性破缺的证据，而可由经典相控阵复现；真正的量子签名在二阶关联（单激发态违反光子符合的经典下界），据此提出结合定向不对称与光束峰值处反聚束的"量子天线证书"。
AI.motivation: 文献中常把 timed Dicke 态量子点阵列的定向辐射不对称解读为通过量子态制备实现互易性破缺。作者认为这一解读混淆了"收发响应互易性"与"辐射方向图对称性"，且未区分一阶相干（经典可复现）与二阶相干（真正量子效应），因此需要澄清概念并给出可判别的量子认证方案。
AI.method: 概念辨析与理论推导相结合：论证互易性针对透射-接收响应而非方向图对称性；证明任意单激发态的一阶相干严格等价于共轭加权驱动的经典相控阵功率方向图；转而分析二阶关联，指出单激发态违反光子符合的经典下界；提出量子天线证书（定向不对称非零 + 光束峰值处光子反聚束）；推导紧致不对称上界、平面阵列的正确镜像操作、含偶极-偶极耦合的集体衰减率修正，以及测向精度的饱和律；并用独立数值实现验证全部理论结果。
AI.result: 定向辐射不对称可由经典相控阵完全复现，故不能作为互易性破缺的证据；单激发态的一阶相干与经典共轭加权相控阵功率方向图严格等价；二阶关联中单激发态违反经典光子符合下界，构成真正量子签名；给出紧致不对称上界、平面阵列镜像操作、修正的集体衰减率及测向精度饱和律，均通过独立数值实现验证。
AI.conclusion: 量子态制备导致的定向辐射不对称本身不具备量子优越性判据价值；量子天线的认证需同时满足定向不对称与峰值处反聚束；该工作澄清了互易性概念误用，并为量子天线提供了可操作证书及若干修正性理论结果。

title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出以真实用户行为作为监督信号，构建Vela框架，将匿名行为记录转化为可训练任务与轨迹，微调后显著提升用户相关任务及通用基准表现。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM多用于需要理解用户长期行为的应用（个人助理、推荐、广告），需推断用户偏好、意图与未来行为。但现有模型训练依赖静态文本或合成数据，无法刻画用户行为随时间的演化，而真实行为数据规模庞大却未被有效利用。
AI.method: 提出以用户行为为监督的Vela框架，将真实用户行为数据转化为可训练任务与轨迹。基于10万用户的匿名行为记录，覆盖91个真实任务模板生成10万任务；通过难度过滤与轨迹接受标准保留约7.5万任务及选定训练轨迹。以Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行微调，并进一步开展强化学习对比实验。
AI.result: 微调后在用户相关任务上较基座模型提升最高11.5分，通用基准平均提升4分；使用更多用户行为数据可进一步提升用户相关表现；微调后强化学习较从基座直接强化学习最高提升7.7分。
AI.conclusion: 真实用户行为是面向用户中心能力乃至LLM更广泛智能的可扩展监督来源。

title: VisualCoding: Learning Executable Skills for Reliable Visual Reasoning
summary: Learning reusable skills can improve visual reasoning agents, yet applying a skill still requires the agent to implement or invoke a procedure and produce the final answer. Errors and hallucinations at these steps can prevent acquired experience from translating into reliable single-run performance. We propose VisualCoding, which combines execution-guided acquisition of reusable visual programs with direct adoption of their answers on applicable inputs. Execution-Guided Program Acquisition composes visual primitives and additional code into family-level solvers, then iteratively tests and revises them on labeled training instances. Scope-Aware Direct Execution runs a retained solver and returns its valid in-scope answer. We evaluate VisualCoding on four models across four benchmarks spanning 69 task families. VisualCoding exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in mean accuracy by 4.45 percentage points with Gemini-3.1-Pro and by 14.78 points when reusing the frozen Pro-acquired artifacts with Flash-Lite. Ablations support execution-guided acquisition and show that direct execution outperforms textual or callable reuse of the same programs. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaq-liu/VisualCoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisualCoding，将「执行引导的可复用视觉程序获取」与「作用域感知的直接执行」结合，用已验证的家族级求解器直接输出答案，在 69 个任务家族上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能虽能提升视觉推理智能体，但技能应用阶段仍需智能体自行实现或调用流程并生成最终答案，此过程中的错误与幻觉会削弱已获取经验在单次运行中的可靠收益。
AI.method: 方法含两部分：一是 Execution-Guided Program Acquisition，将视觉原语与附加代码组合为家族级求解器，并在带标注训练实例上迭代测试与修订；二是 Scope-Aware Direct Execution，运行保留的求解器并在适用输入上返回其有效的域内答案。
AI.result: 在 4 个模型、4 个基准、69 个任务家族上评估：Gemini-3.1-Pro 上平均准确率超最强基线 4.45 个百分点；将冻结的 Pro 获取产物复用于 Flash-Lite 时提升 14.78 个百分点。消融实验支持执行引导获取的有效性，并表明直接执行优于对同一程序的文本式或可调用式复用。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行引导获取并经作用域感知直接执行已保留的可复用视觉程序，可绕过答案生成环节的误差，将习得经验稳定转化为单次运行的可靠性能，且具备跨模型复用价值。

title: HiPPT: Physiology-Grounded Wearable PPG Representation Learning via Multi-Scope Text Alignment
summary: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. Waveform-guided text modeling further recovers masked contextual concepts from PPG patch representations, providing fine-grained waveform-text supervision. Across six downstream tasks spanning blood pressure, vascular stiffness, physiological attributes, and cross-dataset heart-rate estimation, HiPPT achieves the best result on the primary linear-probing metrics. The aligned space also supports zero-shot profiling of age group, sex, and BMI category, individually and jointly, with performance improving as more recordings are aggregated. These results show that evidence-scope matching yields transferable and semantically accessible wearable PPG representations. Code and pretrained weights will be released.

AI.tldr: HiPPT是一个生理学驱动的可穿戴PPG预训练框架，通过将不同监督信号匹配到恰当的证据范围（记录级形态对齐、跨记录上下文对齐、波形引导文本建模），在6项下游任务上取得最佳线性探测结果，并支持零样本生理属性分析。
AI.motivation: 可复用的可穿戴PPG表征应同时刻画局部脉搏形态与更广泛的生理规律，但现有预训练目标通常在记录级或样本对级施加监督，忽略了不同概念依赖不同范围的波形证据才可靠这一事实。
AI.method: 构建包含202K用户、超400万条腕戴记录的PPG-Text语料，将记录与波形衍生的形态描述及元数据衍生的上下文描述配对；提出HiPPT框架，组合记录级形态对齐（将单条记录锚定于脉搏特征）、跨记录上下文对齐（聚合共享同一元数据元组的记录以捕获上下文一致规律）以及波形引导的文本建模（从PPG片段表征恢复被掩码的上下文概念，提供细粒度波形-文本监督）。
AI.result: 在覆盖血压、血管僵硬度、生理属性与跨数据集心率估计的六个下游任务上，HiPPT在主要线性探测指标上均取得最佳结果；对齐后的表征空间支持年龄组、性别、BMI类别的单独与联合零样本画像，且聚合记录越多性能越好。
AI.conclusion: 证据范围匹配能够产生可迁移且语义可及的可穿戴PPG表征。代码与预训练权重将开源。

title: CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection
summary: Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. With identical training tasks, decision-record counts, and updates, perturbation-enriched judge training improves ACPBench-Hard success from 35.38% to 42.12% (+6.73 points). SWE verifier training gains 7.60-9.40 points over interface-matched untrained references. Workflow and post-training evaluations preserve task-solving topology with unperturbed inputs and no private-reference guidance. These results support designing collection conditions to obtain corrective supervision that improves collaborative decisions with frozen solving agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoEvoke 跨域框架，通过受控扰动与受限参考引导在轨迹采集阶段诱发“检查—反馈—修复”交互，构建 4,567 条可重建轨迹数据集，并验证其作为校正性监督信号可提升协作决策与验证器性能。
AI.motivation: 训练多智能体协作需要检查、反馈与修复的轨迹，但常规任务求解 rollout 往往以直接通过或重复失败告终，缺乏有效纠错信号，导致难以获得协作决策所需的监督数据。
AI.method: 提出 CoEvoke 跨域框架：在轨迹采集过程中注入受控扰动以制造可恢复的困难，并用受限的基于参考的引导来指导排查；据此构建覆盖 4,130 个软件工程与推理任务、4,567 条可重建轨迹的数据集，将公开交互与证据、决策及任务原生结果关联。训练与评测保持训练任务、决策记录数量与更新次数一致，并以无扰动输入、无私有参考引导的方式检验工作流与后训练表现。
AI.result: 在 2,287 组同任务配对上，七个扰动组的反馈提升达 47.72–100 个百分点，引导效果较小且依赖模型；相同训练条件下，扰动增强的 judge 训练将 ACPBench-Hard 成功率由 35.38% 提升至 42.12%（+6.73 点），SWE verifier 训练较接口匹配的未训练基线提升 7.60–9.40 点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过设计采集条件可以获得校正性监督信号，在求解智能体冻结的情况下提升协作决策质量，且不依赖采集期的扰动与私有参考引导。

title: Observation of Photon Bunching in Broadband Multimode Thermal Light Enabled by Temporal Imaging
summary: Photons emitted by incoherent sources exhibit temporal bunching, a fundamental manifestation of Bose-Einstein statistics first observed by Hanbury Brown and Twiss (HBT). While intensity correlation measurements originated in astronomy and are now central across quantum technologies, biophysics, and spectroscopy, observing temporal bunching in broadband thermal light remains limited by detector temporal resolution. Conventional approaches - such as streak cameras or optical upconversion - introduce severe trade-offs in efficiency, bandwidth, or setup versatility. Here, we propose and demonstrate a third route: pre-detection temporal magnification of the optical field prior to measuring its intensity autocorrelation function in a conventional HBT setup. Using an electro-optic time lens with a temporal magnification of 660, we resolve the temporal intensity autocorrelation of broadband thermal light generated via non-degenerate spontaneous parametric down-conversion with a bandwidth of 250 GHz. This enables direct observation of thermal photon bunching on sub-3.5 picosecond timescales without narrow spectral filtering, establishing pre-detection temporal imaging as a general platform for broadband statistical optics, with applications spanning ultrafast quantum optics, biophysical imaging, and potentially stellar intensity interferometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并演示了在HBT装置中测量强度自相关前对光场进行预探测时间放大（电光时间透镜，放大倍率660），从而分辨250 GHz带宽热光的时间强度自相关，实现亚3.5皮秒尺度的热光聚束观测。
AI.motivation: 光子的时间聚束是Bose-Einstein统计的基本表现，但宽带热光的时间聚束观测受限于探测器时间分辨率；传统方法（条纹相机、光学上转换）在效率、带宽或装置通用性上存在严重折衷，因此需要一种新的观测途径。
AI.method: 提出"第三路线"：在传统HBT装置测量强度自相关函数之前，先对光场进行预探测时间放大。采用时间放大倍率为660的电光时间透镜，对非简并自发参量下转换产生的250 GHz带宽宽带热光进行时间强度自相关测量，无需窄带光谱滤波。
AI.result: 在660倍时间放大下成功分辨了250 GHz带宽热光的时间强度自相关，直接观测到亚3.5皮秒时间尺度上的热光聚束现象，且未使用窄带光谱滤波。
AI.conclusion: 预探测时间成像可作为宽带统计光学的一般性平台，应用于超快量子光学、生物物理成像，并有望用于恒星强度干涉测量。

title: The Role of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Testing and Automation of Open RAN Systems: GNG-OTA Framework
comment: This paper has been pubblished in 2025 IEEE International Conference on Omni-layer Intelligent Systems (COINS)
summary: Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) empower operators with choice and customization through their disaggregated and interoperable architecture. However, ensuring interoperability in O-RAN presents challenges due to complex testing environments and evolving specifications. This paper addresses these challenges by proposing the Generative AI and Graph Neural Network-based Open RAN Testing and Automation (GNG-OTA) framework. GNG-OTA utilizes state-of-the-art AI techniques including generative AI, natural language processing, and graph neural networks to enable accurate, reliable, efficient, and automatic O-RAN interoperability and performance testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GNG-OTA框架，利用生成式AI、自然语言处理和图神经网络实现O-RAN互操作性与性能测试的自动化、高效化。
AI.motivation: O-RAN以解耦和互操作架构为运营商带来选择与定制能力，但其互操作性保障面临测试环境复杂、规范持续演进的挑战，亟需更高效可靠的测试手段。
AI.method: GNG-OTA框架综合运用生成式AI、自然语言处理与图神经网络等先进AI技术，面向O-RAN的互操作性与性能测试进行设计与实现。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或量化结果，仅说明该框架旨在实现准确、可靠、高效且自动化的O-RAN互操作性与性能测试。
AI.conclusion: GNG-OTA为应对O-RAN互操作性测试难题提供了AI驱动的自动化框架，有望提升测试的准确性与效率，适应规范演进的动态需求。

title: Amharic-English Cross-Language Question Answering Using Statistical Machine Translation, Named Entity Recognition, and Semantic Indexing
summary: The predominance of English-language Web content creates an information-access barrier for speakers of low-resource languages such as Amharic. This paper presents the design, imple-mentation, and evaluation of a bidirectional Amharic-English cross-language question answering (CLQA) system that allows a user to formulate a natural-language question in either Amharic or English and retrieve an answer from documents written in the other language. The system integrates a statistical machine translation (SMT) component for query translation, a maximum-entropy named entity recognition (NER) component for Amharic text processing, semantic-based indexing, question analysis, passage retrieval, and answer extraction. A domain-diverse Amharic-English parallel corpus was used to train the SMT component, while monolingual cor-pora supported language modeling. Documents were normalized, tokenized, stemmed, indexed, and semantically enriched before retrieval. The original evaluation used precision and recall as the principal effectiveness measures. For Amharic-to-English retrieval, the system achieved 72% precision and 79% recall; for English-to-Amharic retrieval, it achieved 65% precision and 70% recall. These findings show that a modular translation-and-retrieval architecture can provide useful cross-language access even under low-resource conditions. This revised article preserves the original experimental claims while situating them in the context of subsequent multilingual transformer and Amharic QA research.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并评估了一个双向阿姆哈拉语-英语跨语言问答系统，融合统计机器翻译、最大熵命名实体识别与语义索引，在低资源条件下实现了可用的跨语言检索：阿→英精确率72%、召回率79%，英→阿精确率65%、召回率70%。
AI.motivation: 英语网络内容占主导，为阿姆哈拉语等低资源语言使用者造成信息获取障碍；需要一种能在低资源条件下实现跨语言问答访问的方案。
AI.method: 系统采用模块化"翻译＋检索"架构：以统计机器翻译（SMT）完成查询翻译，以最大熵命名实体识别（NER）处理阿姆哈拉语文本，并集成基于语义的索引、问题分析、段落检索与答案抽取；用领域多样的阿姆哈拉语-英语平行语料训练SMT，用单语语料支持语言建模；文档经归一化、分词、词干化、索引及语义增强后用于检索。
AI.result: 阿姆哈拉语→英语检索达72%精确率、79%召回率；英语→阿姆哈拉语检索达65%精确率、70%召回率，评价以精确率和召回率为主要指标。
AI.conclusion: 模块化翻译-检索架构在低资源条件下仍能提供有用的跨语言访问；本文保留原有实验结论，并将其置于后续多语言Transformer与阿姆哈拉语问答研究的背景中。

title: SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) need to understand how entities move and interact as a scene develops. This requires following the same entities over time and relating their observed motion to subsequent changes. We formulate Scene Evolution Understanding (SEU), a task for predicting and interpreting this change. Given observed video, a model estimates entity histories and predicts one scene continuation through future trajectories and Events, accompanied by Visual Evidence from observed motion and a scene description. We construct SceneForesee, a benchmark for evaluating entity continuity and scene evolution reasoning through paired observed and future scenes with shared entity identities. It contains 144.57K temporal pairs, 1.05M entity correspondences, and 272.49K Events paired with observed evidence. We propose a spatiotemporal reasoning framework, EvoSee, that learns future geometry and Event semantics through shared candidate states and joint assignment. It selects one continuation per entity from observation and uses the selected changes for entity refinement, retention, and scene representation. On SceneForesee, EvoSee outperforms Qwen3.5-9B by 10.45 points in Combined Point-F1 and 17.24 points in Event Global F1. On the 4D reasoning benchmark Dyn-Bench, it improves question answering accuracy and grounding J&F by 4.8 and 3.58 points over their respective base systems. These results support scene evolution as both a prediction target and a dynamic representation that brings predicted entity changes into spatiotemporal reasoning.The project is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/SceneForesee-Spatiotemporal-Reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"场景演化理解"（SEU）任务与SceneForesee基准，并设计EvoSee时空推理框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配学习未来几何与事件语义，在多个基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型需要理解场景演化过程中实体的运动与交互，这要求跨时间追踪同一实体并将其观测运动与后续变化关联。然而现有工作缺少对"实体连续性"和"场景演化推理"进行系统评估的任务定义与基准。
AI.method: 1) 形式化SEU任务：给定观测视频，估计实体历史并预测一个场景延续（未来轨迹与事件），同时给出观测运动证据与场景描述；2) 构建SceneForesee基准，包含成对的观测/未来场景且共享实体身份；3) 提出EvoSee框架，通过共享候选状态和联合分配学习未来几何与事件语义，为每个实体从候选中选择一个延续，并利用所选变化进行实体精炼、保留与场景表示。
AI.result: SceneForesee含144.57K时序对、1.05M实体对应关系、272.49K事件及其观测证据。EvoSee相比Qwen3.5-9B在Combined Point-F1上提升10.45分，在Event Global F1上提升17.24分；在Dyn-Bench上，问答准确率与grounding J&F分别较各自基线提升4.8与3.58分。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将场景演化既作为预测目标、又作为动态表示，把预测的实体变化纳入时空推理之中。项目已开源。

title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code, rules, lessons, data and evolve reports: https://github.com/agentic-loops-x/Reels-RSI
summary: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft.
