We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

AI.tldr: 该论文把解释类视频视为可读、可测、可审计的"程序"（脚本+分镜+逐帧动画代码）而非像素视频，提出开源卷轴导演器 Reels-RSI，在程序层面而非权重/提示层面进行自我改进，并以 111 条视频的实地研究验证规则记忆、经验教训与偏好信号的效用及失效模式。
AI.motivation: 像素视频只能"观看"而无法"阅读、diff、测试与审计"；解释类视频（几何题、天空为何蓝、王朝兴衰）本质上是确定性渲染器生成的程序产物。作者希望将自我改进从权重或提示层面转移到可验证的程序层面，从而获得可追溯、可单元测试、可复用的记忆机制。
AI.method: Reels-RSI：每一次修订都记录带代码快照的日志；复盘将检查发现与修复 diff 配对并提出经验教训；可由静态检查捕获的教训被编译为带"必失败/必通过"示例的规则，使记忆可单元测试；新规则回跑所有历史作品。通过有界、基准门控的步骤允许智能体改写导演手册，仅在留出主题上的盲评成对判断偏好时保留；任何内容进入记忆都需人工决策。
AI.result: 在 111 条视频（实地研究、两次手册演化、2×2 记忆消融、较弱导演器、48 条学习曲线、评委可靠性研究）中：实地学到的规则在规则诞生前创作的帧中捕获 4 个潜在缺陷，之后为 0；规则对强导演器是审计（8 条未防护视频无违规），对弱导演器是护栏（未防护 30 次违规 vs 防护 5 次）；教训缩短修订循环但不产生复利、也不改变评委判断；首次改写的 11–1 判决实为投票设计中的位置偏差（评委 62–81% 选择第二个展示的视频），掩盖了以 13 条事实换取技巧的脚本。论文还记录了偏好信号的四种失效模式、各自由哪项检查捕获及修复方案。
AI.conclusion: 解释类视频应被当作可审计的程序制品，其自我改进可在程序层面以规则、教训与人工门控的方式实现；规则对强导演器是审计、对弱导演器是护栏，教训能缩短循环但效果不累积，且偏好信号存在系统性偏差，需相应检查与修复。代码、规则、教训与数据均已公开。

title: OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model by supervising a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy, but its supervision remains confined to the output space. Consequently, OPD transfers what a teacher predicts without supervising the intermediate computation that produces those predictions. Simply distilling intermediate representations like representation matching is insufficient since teacher and student representations may differ geometrically, and even well-aligned hidden states need not be usable by the student's subsequent computation. We introduce On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD), which transfers teacher-derived intermediate computation while explicitly accounting for its compatibility with the student. OPMD first constructs a student-compatible teacher that transforms teacher representations into intermediate states usable by the student's downstream computation, then it internalizes these states from on-policy trajectories. OPMD achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated distillation baselines in all three teacher--student settings, and generalizes to multi-teacher distillation and cross-family supervised fine-tuning. Further analyses show that mechanism supervision yields more effective reasoning and meaningfully alters the student's intermediate computation and solution strategies, supporting that it transfers information beyond output supervision alone. Together, these results establish mechanism-level supervision as an effective way to move on-policy distillation beyond output supervision, enabling students to learn inner mechanisms they can use and internalize.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"在策略机制蒸馏"(OPMD)，将蒸馏从输出空间扩展到中间计算机制，并显式考虑机制与学生下游计算的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 现有在策略蒸馏(OPD)仅监督学生自身策略采样前缀上的输出空间，只传递教师预测的结果，而不监督产生这些预测的中间计算；而简单的表征匹配也不足，因为师生表征在几何上可能不一致，且对齐后的隐状态未必能被学生后续计算所使用。
AI.method: OPMD分两步：(1)构造"学生兼容教师"，把教师表征变换为学生下游计算可用的中间状态；(2)在在策略轨迹上将这些状态内化到学生中。
AI.result: 在全部三组师生设定中，OPMD的平均准确率在所有被评估的蒸馏基线中最高，并可泛化到多教师蒸馏与跨家族监督微调。进一步分析表明，机制监督带来更有效的推理，并显著改变学生的中间计算与解题策略，说明其传递了超出输出监督的信息。
AI.conclusion: 机制级监督是使在策略蒸馏超越输出监督的有效途径，能让学生学习并内化可用的内部机制。

title: Zeptosecond-level timing-noise floor in optical-to-terahertz photomixing
summary: Optical generation of terahertz (0.1 to 10\,THz) carriers can, in principle, preserve the spectral purity of an optical reference without the noise penalty associated with electronic frequency multiplication. Here, we identify and suppress the dominant excess-noise mechanisms that limit this conversion in high-power uni-travelling-carrier photodiodes. We characterize amplitude-to-phase conversion as functions of photocurrent and reverse bias and identify operating parameters to minimize the effect. We quantify the white phase noise introduced by optical amplification and show that this contribution can be eliminated by directly driving the photodiode with a high-power optical source. With the excess noise mitigated, we use cross-correlation phase-noise measurements to observe a white phase-noise floor of $-161.0$~dBc/Hz at 263.2~GHz, corresponding to a timing-noise floor of 7.6~zs/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$. The remaining floor follows the photocurrent dependence expected from shot noise. Extending the measurement across the full WR-3.4 band, from 220 to 330~GHz, yields timing-noise floors below 10~zs/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ throughout, with a minimum of 6.0~zs/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$. These results establish direct photomixing as a route to sub-10-zs/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ white timing-noise floors for continuous-wave sources at terahertz frequencies and identify the noise processes that must be controlled to reach this regime.

AI.tldr: 通过识别并抑制高功率UTC-PD中的主要过量噪声机制，将本振THz载波的定时噪声降至sub-10 zs/√Hz水平。
AI.motivation: 光学生成THz载波原则上可保持光学参考的频谱纯度，避免电子倍频带来的噪声恶化。但实际转换中高功率单行载流子光电二极管存在过量噪声，限制了性能，需要明确并控制这些机制。
AI.method: 表征幅相转换随光电流与反向偏压的变化以寻找最小化工作点；量化光放大引入的白相位噪声并证明用高功率光源直接驱动可消除；采用互相关相位噪声测量表征噪声底。
AI.result: 在263.2 GHz获得白相位噪声底-161.0 dBc/Hz，对应7.6 zs/√Hz定时噪声；残余噪声底随光电流的变化符合散粒噪声预期；在220–330 GHz全WR-3.4波段，定时噪声底均低于10 zs/√Hz，最低6.0 zs/√Hz。
AI.conclusion: 直接光混频是实现THz连续波源sub-10 zs/√Hz白定时噪声底的可行途径，并明确了达到该水平需控制的噪声过程。

title: Completing Radio Map Tensors via Factor Diffusion Posterior Sampling
comment: 19 pages (14 pages of main text and 5 pages of appendix)
summary: Radio map estimation (RME), also known as spectrum cartography, aims to recover radio signal strength across multiple domains (e.g., spatial and spectral domains) from sparse measurements, naturally leading to a tensor completion problem. Recent advances show that deep learning-based generative models can provide data-driven structural constraints for RME, yielding substantial performance improvements over traditional model-based approaches. Diffusion models (DMs) represent the current state of the art in generative modeling and hold strong promise for advancing RME. However, existing diffusion-based RME methods often require extensive training data, necessitate retraining when scenarios or measurement formats change, and lack recoverability guarantees. This paper proposes a latent factor diffusion framework for spatio-spectral radio map tensor completion. By training two independent DMs on single-emitter's spatial loss field and spectral signature and embedding them into the factors of the radio map tensor, the proposed approach enables diffusion posterior sampling-based recovery with reduced training complexity as well as enhanced measurement format/sensing pattern flexibility. Recoverability and sample complexity guarantees under the proposed approach are also established. Numerical experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, showing strong generalization across city environments unseen in training data.

AI.tldr: 提出潜因子扩散框架用于空谱无线电地图张量补全，在单发射源的路径损耗场与频谱特征上分别训练两个扩散模型并嵌入张量因子，实现扩散后验采样恢复，兼具低训练复杂度、格式灵活性与可恢复性保证。
AI.motivation: 无线电地图估计（RME/频谱制图）需从稀疏测量恢复多域（空间、频谱）信号强度，本质是张量补全问题。现有扩散模型方法虽性能优越，但需大量训练数据、场景或测量格式变化时须重训练，且缺乏可恢复性保证。
AI.method: 提出面向空谱无线电地图张量补全的潜因子扩散框架：在单发射源的空间路径损耗场与频谱特征上分别训练两个独立的扩散模型，并将其嵌入无线电地图张量的因子中，从而支持基于扩散后验采样的恢复；同时建立可恢复性与样本复杂度理论保证。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了方法的有效性，在训练中未见过的城市环境中表现出强泛化能力；训练复杂度降低，且对测量格式与感知模式具有更强灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扩散先验分解到张量潜因子，可在保证可恢复性的前提下降低训练成本并提升跨场景泛化，为扩散模型驱动的RME提供了更实用的方案。

title: The Constitution Speaks Nheengatu: An Open MT System and Reproducible Corpus Pipeline for the Amazonian Língua Geral
summary:
Nheengatu (yrl), the Amazonian Língua Geral, has 6--10 thousand speakers and is co-official in São Gabriel da Cachoeira (Brazil), yet remains poorly served by evaluated Portuguese--Nheengatu MT resources. We present the largest parallel corpus assembled for the language (14.5k Portuguese--Nheengatu pairs), anchored by the 2023 official translation of the Brazilian Federal Constitution; the first MT evaluation set built from transcribed spontaneous speech; and, to our knowledge, the first open-weight MT models dedicated to bidirectional Portuguese--Nheengatu translation.
  Three findings organize the paper. First, translation into Nheengatu on held-out constitutional articles plateaus on development data regardless of training length or model size, and much of the remaining error sits in conventional legal terms that the written sources do not attest consistently; a terminology success rate over a frozen lexicon shows that glossary mechanisms at training time and lexical constraints at decoding each raise term realization, the latter at a cost in repetitive output that chrF++ barely registers. Second, a corpus expansion that adds transcribed conversation raises speech chrF++ by 24--27 points while leaving written domains unchanged, a register gap that written-only benchmarks cannot see. Third, a larger NLLB model helps translation into Portuguese but not into Nheengatu on legal or speech text. For Portuguese-to-Nheengatu translation, our final systems reach 31.7--32.8 chrF++ on article-disjoint constitutional text, 64.1--64.5 on the near-domain set (62.1 after removing items with target-side content overlap), and 45.2--47.5 on speech.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了迄今最大的葡萄牙语--Nheengatu语平行语料（14.5k对）、首个基于转录口语的机器翻译评测集，以及首个面向该语言双向翻译的开源权重MT模型，并揭示了三项关键发现。
AI.motivation: Nheengatu语使用人口仅6--10千，虽为巴西官方共同语言，但葡萄牙语--Nheengatu语的机器翻译资源稀缺且缺乏系统评测。研究旨在填补该低资源语言的平行语料、评测集与开源模型空白。
AI.method: 1）构建14.5k对平行语料，以2023年巴西联邦宪法官方译本为锚点；2）从转录的自发口语中构建首个MT评测集；3）训练首个开放权重双向葡萄牙语--Nheengatu语翻译模型；4）在训练时引入术语表机制、解码时施加词汇约束，并以冻结词表上的术语成功率评估；5）通过加入口语转录的语料扩展做域外泛化测试。
AI.result: 1）译入Nheengatu语在留出宪法条款上无论训练时长或模型规模均在开发集上停滞，剩余错误多集中于书面源未一致见证的惯用法律术语；术语表机制与解码词汇约束均提升术语实现率，但后者带来chrF++难以捕捉的重复输出成本。2）加入口语会话的语料扩展使口语chrF++提升24--27点，而书面领域不变，暴露书面基准无法反映的语体鸿沟。3）更大的NLLB模型有助于译入葡萄牙语，但在法律或口语文本上无助于译入Nheengatu语。最终系统在条款不相交宪法文本上达31.7--32.8 chrF++，近域集64.1--64.5（去除目标侧内容重叠后62.1），口语45.2--47.5。
AI.conclusion: 低资源语言MT的进展受制于术语一致性与语体覆盖，而非单纯模型规模；术语表与解码约束是有效的术语实现手段但需权衡输出重复；口语语料对口语域收益显著而对书面域无迁移；模型规模增益具有方向不对称性。

title: FreeCHROMA: Generative Chroma Keying from Unaligned Background References
summary: In film production, chroma keying composites an approved foreground performance into a new environment, but conventional workflows require coordinated background plates and dedicated harmonization. Recent generative methods often require pre-aligned backgrounds, focus on background-conditioned foreground relighting, or represent the environment only through an edited first frame. These restrictions limit background selection, scene composition, and camera motion while adding preparation or editing effort. We present FreeCHROMA, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion model in a parameter-efficient manner for generative video compositing from one to three unaligned background references. The model integrates the foreground into the referenced environment, preserving foreground identity, motion, and fine visual details while generating a spatiotemporally coherent background. Foreground-background harmonization occurs within the same generation process, without a separate relighting stage. Optional text instructions help disambiguate complex spatial relationships and camera behavior. To train the model, we construct pseudo-paired data from readily available real monocular videos through foreground-background separation and augmentation with existing foundation models. The original videos serve as training targets, while automated processing and quality verification enable scalable data construction. Across reference fidelity, foreground preservation, scene integration, harmonization, and overall video quality, FreeCHROMA consistently outperforms recent compositing and conditional video-generation baselines, with particularly clear gains under camera motion. FreeCHROMA relaxes the constraints of existing tools to enable end-to-end generative chroma keying from unaligned inputs, with exploratory experiments demonstrating its potential in robotics.

AI.tldr: FreeCHROMA 通过参数高效地适配预训练视频扩散模型，实现从 1–3 张未对齐背景参考图出发的端到端生成式视频抠像合成，无需独立的重光照阶段，在参考保真度、前景保持、场景融合与整体视频质量上超越现有基线，并在相机运动场景下提升尤为明显。
AI.motivation: 传统 chroma keying 工作流需要协调一致的背景素材板与专门的颜色/光照和谐化处理；现有生成式方法则多要求预对齐背景、仅做背景条件下的前景重光照，或只用编辑后的首帧表示环境。这些限制约束了背景选择、场景构图与相机运动，并增加准备或编辑成本。论文旨在放宽这些约束，实现从未对齐输入直接进行端到端生成式抠像合成。
AI.method: 提出 FreeCHROMA：以参数高效方式适配预训练视频扩散模型，输入为 1–3 张未对齐背景参考图。模型将前景融入参考环境，在保持前景身份、运动与细粒度视觉细节的同时生成时空一致的背景；前景-背景和谐化在同一生成过程中完成，无需独立重光照阶段。可选文本指令用于消解复杂空间关系与相机行为。训练数据由易获取的真实单目视频经前景-背景分离与基础模型增强构建伪配对数据，原始视频作为训练目标，自动化处理与质量验证保证数据构建的可扩展性。
AI.result: 在参考保真度、前景保持、场景融合、和谐化以及整体视频质量等指标上，FreeCHROMA 一致优于近期合成方法与条件视频生成基线，在存在相机运动时增益尤为显著。探索性实验还显示其在机器人领域的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: FreeCHROMA 放宽了现有工具的约束，支持从未对齐输入进行端到端生成式 chroma keying，并展示了跨领域应用潜力。

title: MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation
summary: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For generation, this vector is drawn from a prior fitted in latent space. Across 3 large-scale benchmarks, our model improves TS-FID by 1.6-3.6$\times$ over the closest rival while ensuring validity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前EEG生成模型普遍违反通道间由蒙太奇决定的精确线性恒等式，并提出MontageFlow——一种将输出约束在满足这些恒等式的信号子空间内的流匹配模型，同时引入生理状态向量条件以保留脑电特征。实验表明，保证合法性还带来保真度提升，在3个大规模基准上TS-FID相比最强对手改善1.6–3.6倍。
AI.motivation: 临床EEG数据受严格隐私约束而稀缺，生成建模是有前景的解决方案；但现有生成模型虽报告保真度大幅提升，却掩盖了一个关键缺陷——EEG并非任意多通道信号，每个通道记录两个头皮电极间的电压差，因此真实记录满足通道间精确的线性恒等式，而现有生成器无一例外地违反这些恒等式且未被察觉。
AI.method: 提出MontageFlow，一种流匹配（flow-matching）模型，通过将输出限制在满足蒙太奇线性恒等式的信号子空间中来强制满足这些恒等式；同时为保留被过度平滑抹去的EEG特征，以从整个EEG窗口编码得到的生理状态向量作为条件，生成时该向量从潜空间中拟合的先验分布中采样。
AI.result: 在3个大规模基准上，模型在保证合法性的同时，将TS-FID相比最接近的对手改善1.6–3.6倍；此外发现强制合法性同时也提升了生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: 将EEG的蒙太奇结构先验（通道间线性恒等式）显式嵌入生成模型是必要且有益的：它既修复了现有方法被忽视的合法性缺陷，又意外地提升了保真度；MontageFlow为隐私约束下的临床EEG数据增强提供了兼顾合法性与高质量的有效方案。

title: Historical Anchors for Scientific Forecasting on Human-Aware Knowledge Graphs
summary: Predicting which scientific connections will form next can point researchers toward the most promising leads. One successful approach learns representations by sampling paths through publication networks, represented by a hypergraph, that connect scientific entities, concepts, and researchers, approximating how knowledge and expertise move through the literature. Sampled paths are then used to train an embedding model to forecast scientific connections such as a property of a material. Performance, however, depends strongly on how many paths are sampled: too little sampling yields incomplete representations, while further sampling can eventually weaken prediction quality. The best sampling budget is therefore often identifiable only after future discoveries are known. We introduce Query--Anchor Agreement (QAA), a diagnostic requiring no future labels or separately trained model. QAA can be used to select a sampling budget, and refine or re-rank the resulting forecast to improve forecasting scientific connections. QAA compares the candidates a model predicts for a target with those most similar to the target's known historical examples, and identifies when these two views converge. Across thermoelectric-material and COVID-19 drug-repurposing benchmarks, repeated random-seed runs, and three sampling policies, QAA-selected budgets fall on average 1.86 percentage points below hindsight-optimal selection for broad candidate recovery. Further, promoting candidates supported by both views, under a capped fusion that bounds the anchor contribution, improves broad recovery across all six benchmark-policy settings, which define the types of network walks used for sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出查询-锚点一致性(QAA)诊断指标，无需未来标签或额外模型即可选择路径采样预算并优化科学连接预测。
AI.motivation: 文献网络路径采样训练嵌入模型预测科学连接时，性能强依赖采样路径数量：过少表示不完整，过多反而降低质量，而最优预算通常只有在未来发现已知后才可确定。
AI.method: QAA比较模型对目标预测的候选与目标已知历史示例最相似的候选，在两种视角收敛时识别一致性，用于选择采样预算，并在受限融合(限制锚点贡献)下细化或重排预测。
AI.result: 在热电材料与COVID-19药物重定位基准、多次随机种子运行及三种采样策略下，QAA选出的预算平均比事后最优选择低1.86个百分点；双视角支持的候选提升在所有六个基准-策略设置下均改善广义恢复。
AI.conclusion: QAA可作为无需未来信息的诊断工具，有效选择采样预算并改预测，为科学连接预测提供实用且稳健的方案。

title: Short-Range Microwave Interprobe Coupling in a Brain-Mimicking Phantom and Ex-Vivo Brain
summary: A printed tapered-slot coupling probe with a partially inserted 12-mm wire element is characterized for short-range microwave coupling through a brain-mimicking agar--gelatin--saline phantom and \textit{ex vivo} brain. Simulated and measured free-space $S_{11}$ responses agree over a measured $-10$-dB band spanning 5.78 to 6.86~GHz, corresponding to a 1.08-GHz bandwidth and approximately 17.1~percent fractional bandwidth. In a controlled two-probe experiment, the phantom was introduced and removed while the probe arrangement and measurement conditions were retained. This comparison was repeated under the same retained arrangement, with the same general $S_{21}$ differential behavior observed across repetitions. Near 6.3~GHz, measured $S_{21}$ was approximately $-25$~dB with the phantom present and approximately $-40$~dB in air, corresponding to an $\approx 16~\mathrm dB$. \textit{Ex vivo} goat brain measurements repeated more than five times showed reproducible behavior. Across 5.78--6.86~GHz, the \textit{ex vivo} goat-brain $S_{21}$ response closely followed that of the phantom, with an approximately figure-derived maximum operating-band difference of about 1.5~dB. The observed increase in $|S_{21}|$ is interpreted as a property of the complete probe--medium--probe system, including loading, mutual coupling, interfaces, geometry, propagation, and material loss. The measurement does not uniquely identify a tissue-intrinsic mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文表征了一种印刷锥形缝隙耦合探头，通过仿脑琼脂-明胶-盐水体模与离体脑组织进行短距离微波耦合测量，验证了S11与S21响应的可重复性及其与体模的一致性。
AI.motivation: 研究短距离微波耦合在脑组织模拟介质中的行为，为微波耦合测量提供可控、可重复的实验验证，并明确观测现象属于完整探头-介质-探头系统特性而非组织内在机制。
AI.method: 采用印刷锥形缝隙耦合探头，部分插入12 mm导线元件，分别在自由空间、仿脑琼脂-明胶-盐水体模及离体羊脑中进行S11与S21测量；在保持探头排列与测量条件不变的前提下，进行体模取出/放入的对照实验并重复测量。
AI.result: 自由空间S11仿真与实测在5.78–6.86 GHz内一致（-10 dB带宽1.08 GHz，约17.1%相对带宽）；6.3 GHz附近体模存在时S21约-25 dB，空气中约-40 dB，差约16 dB；离体羊脑测量重复五次以上结果可重复，其S21与体模响应接近，最大工作频带差异约1.5 dB。
AI.conclusion: |S21|的增大被解释为完整探头-介质-探头系统的综合特性，涉及加载、互耦、界面、几何、传播与材料损耗，测量结果并不唯一指向某种组织内在机制。

title: Who Receives Respect? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Honorific Allocation Bias in Bengali
summary: Bengali has no grammatical gender, but honorificity is obligatory: every third-person reference must choose ordinary or respectful register. English has no such signal, so the system must choose a level of deference that the source never specified. We use this property to measure how large language models (LLMs) allocate respect in English--Bengali translation. Our evaluation set contains 2{,}016 sentences across 72 occupations. Each appears in seven sentence frames under four pronoun conditions. Masculine and feminine versions differ by one word, forming counterfactual pairs. We report a single Honorific Bias Score (HBS) for each model on a 0--100 scale, covering both the gender and occupation axes. A lower score means that respect is allocated more evenly. For the occupation analysis, we compute each occupation's honorific rate across the seven no-pronoun sentence frames. The standard deviation of these 72 occupation-level rates ranges from 17.2 to 35.5 percentage points across models, showing substantial variation in how honorifics are allocated across occupations. Occupation is associated with 3.2\% to 51.5\% of the variance in register choice, compared with at most 1.2\% for gender. Gender effects are much smaller overall: only two of the nine models show significant directional gender gaps, and they favor opposite genders. HBS ranges from 19.9 to 70.1 across the nine models, showing substantial variation in how evenly the models allocate respect.

AI.tldr: 本文利用孟加拉语第三人称强制敬语标记这一特性，构建英译孟加拉语评测集（2016句、72种职业），提出Honorific Bias Score（HBS）量化9个LLM的敬语分配偏见，发现职业维度差异远大于性别维度。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语无语法性别，但第三人称指代必须选择普通或尊敬语域；英语缺乏该信号，模型需自行决定源文本未指定的尊敬程度。作者借此把"敬语分配"作为可测量的偏见窗口，考察LLM在性别与职业两轴上的差别对待。
AI.method: 构建含2016句、覆盖72种职业的评测集；每句出现在7种句式框架×4种代词条件下，仅一词之差的男性/女性版本构成反事实对。为每个模型计算0–100的单一HBS，同时覆盖性别与职业两轴；职业分析基于7个无代词句式框架计算各职业敬语率，并通过方差分解衡量职业、性别对语域选择的解释比例。
AI.result: 72个职业级敬语率的标准差在模型间为17.2–35.5个百分点，显示职业间敬语分配差异显著。职业可解释语域选择方差的3.2%–51.5%，性别至多1.2%；仅9个模型中的2个出现显著方向性性别差距，且方向相反。HBS跨模型为19.9–70.1，表明各模型敬语分配均衡程度差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 强制敬语语言可作为探测LLM社会偏见的高灵敏度探针：模型在英语—孟加拉语翻译中的尊重分配主要受职业驱动而非性别驱动，且不同模型间差异悬殊。HBS提供了跨模型、跨偏置轴的统一可比指标。

title: DSR-Net: Learning Dynamic Skeletal Relations for 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: 3D human pose estimation requires accurate modeling of motion-dependent skeletal structures and inter-joint dependencies. Existing methods typically rely on fixed skeletal topologies in Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) or implicitly capture joint relations through attention mechanisms, limiting their adaptability to diverse motion patterns. To address this issue,we proposeDSR-Net, a dynamic structural representation learning framework for 3D human pose estimation. Specifically, a Dynamic Skeletal Relation (DSR) module is introduced to learn adaptive inter-joint dependencies beyond predefined skeletal connections. Based on the learned relations, a hierarchical relation-aware fusion strategy is developed to facilitate effective interaction between structural and temporal representations. In addition, a lightweight Residual Skeletal Recalibration Module (RSRM) is designed to enhance the stability of structure-aware features with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP demonstrate that DSR-Net achieves MPJPEs of 37.9 mm and 14.9 mm, respectively, consistently improving over strong baselines. The results validate the effectiveness of dynamic skeletal relation modeling for robust 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出DSR-Net框架，通过动态骨骼关系建模与层次化关系感知融合提升3D人体姿态估计精度，在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上分别达到37.9 mm和14.9 mm的MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖GCN中固定的骨骼拓扑结构，或通过注意力机制隐式捕捉关节关系，难以适应多样化的运动模式，缺乏对运动相关骨骼结构与关节间依赖的自适应性建模能力。
AI.method: 提出DSR-Net：引入动态骨骼关系（DSR）模块，学习超越预定义骨骼连接的关节间自适应依赖；基于所学关系设计层次化关系感知融合策略，促进结构与时间表示的交互；设计轻量级残差骨骼重校准模块（RSRM），以极小计算开销增强结构感知特征的稳定性。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M与MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上，DSR-Net分别取得37.9 mm和14.9 mm的MPJPE，持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了动态骨骼关系建模对鲁棒3D人体姿态估计的有效性。

title: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
comment: 17 pages, 17 figures, 19 references. Public-data component audit; recursive improvement is specified as a protocol and not experimentally demonstrated
summary: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

AI.tldr: 该研究将 ScienceBuddy 的递归设计适配为泛血管介入研究框架，但对其中固定组件（共享任务掩码卷积模型+启发式支持门控）进行了公开数据审计，而非验证完整智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 泛血管介入研究需要可测量的证据支撑与弃权机制，而完整递归智能体系统的改进效果尚未验证；因此先对可独立评估的固定组件开展可复现审计，为后续协作式智能体研究提供协议基础。
AI.method: 构建结构化证据账本、器械-血管本体、弃权契约与留存的失败库；在 ARCADE 语法与狭窄两项任务上各使用 1,000 训练、200 验证、300 测试图像；每类表征设置仅训练一次共享任务掩码卷积模型，随后固定参数与启发式支持门控，狭窄阈值在验证集上选取，并在锁定测试集上评估。
AI.result: 锁定测试集上语法 Dice 为 0.475（95% CI 0.459-0.490），狭窄 Dice 为 0.231（95% CI 0.214-0.249）；狭窄像素 AUROC 0.957，AUPRC 0.180（患病率 0.00975）；门控接受了 76.7% 的狭窄帧输出，而仅评分对照为 100%；构造掩码审计中接受 44.3%、拒绝 55.7% 的参考候选，量化了弃权代价。
AI.conclusion: 该组件审计使支持度与弃权行为可测量，并提供了可复现协议，但受接受率不等于正确性、缺乏患者层面效度、未执行递归优化与强化学习等限制，不能证明递归改进或临床安全性。

title: Beyond a Better Score: Long-Horizon Agentic ML Development and Evaluation Protocol for Physics Time Series
summary: Physics time-series data are central to fundamental discoveries involving dark matter, neutrinos, and gravitational waves. Machine learning has shown strong potential to recover weak scientific signals buried in complex noise. Recent LLM-agent systems further automate ML development, but existing approaches are often driven primarily by one or a few numerical scores. In pursuit of a better score, agents may exploit shortcuts, trigger mode collapse, or game the evaluation procedure, producing models that achieve high scores but are scientifically invalid. We introduce SIDERIUS, an LLM agent system designed to move beyond a better score toward scientifically valid, long-horizon ML development. SIDERIUS combines contract-defined composable capabilities for flexible orchestration and human-in-the-loop, a multi-layer scientific evaluation protocol that distinguishes valid models from unhealthy or gaming models, and resource-aware exploration for computationally expensive scientific ML. In our TIDMAD benchmark, SIDERIUS with a GPT-based orchestrator achieves the highest Valid-model proposal rate of 63.8% and the best valid denoising score of 2.744, compared with 1.6% and -0.647, respectively, for the same GPT model using the general-purpose Codex coding agent. We further benchmark SIDERIUS on three additional physics time-series datasets, demonstrating its reuse and performance across different tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in agentic scientific ML should be measured beyond a better score, by how an agent explores and by whether the models it produces can be trusted as science.

AI.tldr: 提出 SIDERIUS——一个面向物理时间序列科学机器学习的 LLM 智能体系统，通过契约化能力编排、多层科学评估协议与资源感知探索，避免"刷分"式失效，实现科学有效的长程 ML 开发。
AI.motivation: 物理时间序列数据（暗物质、中微子、引力波）中的弱信号提取高度依赖机器学习，而现有 LLM 智能体系统多以单个或少数数值指标为驱动。为追求更高分数，智能体可能利用捷径、触发模式坍缩或博弈评估流程，产出"高分但科学上无效"的模型，因此需要从"更好的分数"转向"科学有效"的开发范式。
AI.method: SIDERIUS 由三部分构成：(1) 契约定义的可组合能力，支持灵活编排与人机协同（human-in-the-loop）；(2) 多层科学评估协议，用于区分有效模型与不健康或博弈型模型；(3) 资源感知探索，适配计算代价高昂的科学 ML 场景。
AI.result: 在 TIDMAD 基准上，使用 GPT 编排器的 SIDERIUS 取得 63.8% 的最高有效模型提案率与 2.744 的最佳有效去噪分数；相同 GPT 模型搭载通用 Codex 编码智能体时分别为 1.6% 与 −0.647。在另外三个物理时间序列数据集上的评测进一步证明了其可复用性与跨任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 智能体化科学 ML 的进展不应仅以分数衡量，还应考察智能体的探索方式及其产出模型是否可作为可信科学成果。

title: Inverse design of poles and zeros: tailoring phase control in metasurfaces
summary: We develop a physically interpretable inverse-design framework for generalized Huygens metasurfaces, using prescribed scattering poles and zeros to engineer resonance interference and transmission-phase control. Compared with direct optimization of transmission or reflection coefficients, this approach offers a physically transparent route to rationally controlling resonance properties, including linewidth and group delay, while reducing computational cost. The resulting designs demonstrate how near-unity transmission and $2π$ phase excursion can arise from resonance interference. These signatures of the Kerker effect extend beyond the conventional alignment of electric and magnetic dipole resonances to other mechanisms, including guided-mode resonances and quasi-bound states in the continuum. We further optimize the Kerker condition across a continuum of refractive-index states in a reconfigurable phase change material metasurface, enabling high-transmission $2π$ phase tuning. Our results establish a versatile and practical approach to metasurface phase control through the targeted design of scattering poles and zeros.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于散射极点与零点的广义Huygens超表面逆向设计框架，通过调控共振干涉实现近单位透射与2π相位覆盖，并推广了Kerker效应的物理机制。
AI.motivation: 传统方法直接优化透射或反射系数，物理可解释性差、计算成本高，且难以理性调控线宽与群延迟等共振特性，因此需要一种物理透明的逆向设计途径。
AI.method: 以指定的散射极点与零点为设计变量，构建物理可解释的逆向设计框架，用其工程化共振干涉与透射相位控制；并将该框架用于可重构相变材料超表面，在连续折射率态下优化Kerker条件。
AI.result: 设计结果展示了近单位透射与2π相位变化可由共振干涉产生；这些Kerker效应特征不仅源于电、磁偶极共振的传统对齐，还扩展至导模共振和连续域准束缚态等机制；在相变材料超表面中实现了高透射的2π相位调谐。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一种通用且实用的超表面相位控制方法，即通过散射极点与零点的定向设计来调控共振特性与相位响应。

title: A Novel Coexistence Scheme for OFDM and OTFS Waveforms for Uplink in 6G Networks
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Communications, Date 2025/7/10, Volume 73, Isse 11, Page range 12008-12022
summary: The upcoming sixth generation (6G) wireless networks are designed to support advanced applications that the current air interface based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) cannot accommodate, necessitating innovations in waveform design. Orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) has emerged as a promising alternative, offering enhanced performance particularly in high-mobility channel environments. However, deploying fundamentally different waveforms over the same frequencies fails to exploit the mutual relationships between them. In this paper, a forward-compatible yet backward-compatible coexistence framework is proposed, where various OFDM waveform options are incorporated while seamlessly integrating OTFS within the same network. The proposed coexistence paradigm involves utilizing a specially designed spreading matrix in the delay-Doppler (DD) domain to process OTFS data. The matrix is tailored to establish orthogonality between OTFS and OFDM waveforms, effectively reducing cross-interference when both coexist within the same time-frequency (TF) resources. Our results demonstrate up to a 6 dB improvement in bit error rate (BER) performance for the OTFS waveform compared to other coexistence schemes. The proposed approach also shows greater interference resilience and approaches the upper bounds of achievable rates. By utilizing the full bandwidth and time duration, it enhances range and velocity resolutions, leading to improved sensing performance. These findings are supported by mathematical analysis and extensive simulations for uplink scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种OFDM与OTFS波形共存框架，通过在时延-多普勒域设计扩展矩阵，实现两种波形的正交性，降低交叉干扰，提升BER、速率与感知性能。
AI.motivation: 6G需支持OFDM难以承载的先进应用，OTFS在高移动性场景表现优异，但在同一频段部署根本不同的波形未能利用波形间的相互关系，因此需要一种前后向兼容的共存方案。
AI.method: 提出前后向兼容的共存框架，在同一网络内集成多种OFDM波形选项并无缝嵌入OTFS；在时延-多普勒（DD）域使用专门设计的扩展矩阵处理OTFS数据，使OTFS与OFDM波形在相同时间-频率（TF）资源上建立正交性，从而降低交叉干扰。
AI.result: 相比其他共存方案，OTFS波形的BER性能最多提升6 dB；所提方法具有更强的抗干扰能力，接近可达速率上界；利用全带宽与全时长提升距离与速度分辨率，改善感知性能。结论由数学分析和上行场景的大量仿真支撑。
AI.conclusion: 该共存框架可实现OFDM与OTFS的前后向兼容共存，在提升OTFS链路可靠性与抗干扰能力的同时改善感知性能，为6G波形设计提供可行路径。

title: Training-Free BioNEL-RAG: Advancing Biomedical Entity Linking through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model
summary: Biomedical Named Entity Linking (BioNEL) is the task of mapping mentions extracted from biomedical texts to canonical entities or concepts in the standardized knowledge base. Although existing methods have achieved remarkable performance in mapping accuracy, most rely on training with domain-specific datasets, which fundamentally limits their cross-domain adaptability. To address this limitation, we propose BioNEL-RAG, a novel training-free framework that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs). Within this framework, the RAG module focuses on retrieving candidate entities, while the large language model module plays the role of selecting the most appropriate candidate for entity normalization, which is based on the analysis of the mention's context, with the aid of its remarkable text comprehension capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that BioNEL-RAG achieves performance comparable to existing methods without requiring training on subdomain datasets, whereas these methods necessitate fine-tuning on specific subdomains such as genes, diseases, or chemical compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BioNEL-RAG，一种无需训练的检索增强生成框架，将 RAG 与大语言模型结合用于生物医学命名实体链接（BioNEL），在无需子领域数据集训练的情况下取得与现有方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 BioNEL 方法虽在映射准确率上表现优异，但大多依赖领域专用数据集训练，需针对基因、疾病、化合物等特定子领域微调，从根本上限制了跨领域适应能力。
AI.method: 提出 BioNEL-RAG 框架：RAG 模块负责检索候选实体；大语言模型模块借助其文本理解能力，通过分析提及的上下文，从候选中选择最合适的实体以完成归一化。整个框架无需训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，BioNEL-RAG 无需在子领域数据集上训练即可达到与现有方法相当的性能，而对比方法均需在特定子领域（基因、疾病、化合物）上微调。
AI.conclusion: BioNEL-RAG 验证了免训练 RAG+LLM 范式在生物医学实体链接中的有效性，缓解了对领域专用训练数据的依赖，提升了跨领域适应性。

title: Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry
summary: Objective. To evaluate whether spatial context and temporal modeling improve tissue recognition during optical trocar entry, where multiple abdominal-wall tissues may be visible simultaneously. Methods. We retrospectively analyzed 71 recordings with 1,516 annotated keyframes and 29,151 clinician-annotated sectors. Each frame was divided into 28 polar-grid sectors assigned to nine tissue classes. Color, neighboring-sector, and positional features were used by a gradient-boosted emission classifier. The full pipeline added learned temporal smoothing, spatial regularization, an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model, and posterior blending. Five-fold cross-validation was grouped by recording, with cross-fitting to prevent within-recording leakage. Primary evaluation used clinician-derived targets; ablations assessed classification, probability quality, spatial consistency, and peritoneum-or-deeper onset timing. Results. The complete pipeline achieved accuracy 0.646, macro-F1 0.507, and macro-AUROC 0.882, versus 0.600, 0.440, and 0.861 for emissions alone. Macro-F1 improved by 0.066 across all five folds. Label changes decreased from 66.2 to 19.5 per sector-minute, and median onset error decreased from 15.58 to 2.45 seconds. Frames with a tissue-depth-code span of at least three decreased from 53% to 26%, versus 22% for clinician annotations. Performance remained limited for preperitoneal fat and bowel, and the full model retained a 44% premature-onset proportion. Conclusions. Combining appearance, spatial context, and temporal constraints improved retrospective tissue recognition and onset localization. Tissue-specific limitations, residual timing errors, and reliance on future observations warrant external validation and prospective evaluation of causal models before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过极化网格扇区建模、梯度提升发射分类器以及隐马尔可夫模型等时空约束，提升光学套管针穿刺入腹过程中腹壁组织的识别准确性与组织深度起始定位精度。
AI.motivation: 光学套管针穿刺入腹时，多个腹壁组织可能同时可见，单纯基于外观的识别难以区分组织层次。研究旨在评估引入空间上下文与时序建模是否能改善组织识别与组织深度起始（如腹膜或更深层）的定位。
AI.method: 回顾性分析71段录像，含1,516个标注关键帧和29,151个临床医生标注扇区。每帧划分为28个极坐标网格扇区，归为9类组织。采用颜色、邻域扇区与位置特征训练梯度提升发射分类器，完整流程加入学习型时序平滑、空间正则化、解剖有序隐马尔可夫模型及后验融合。采用按录像分组的五折交叉验证并进行交叉拟合以防录像内泄漏；主要评估以临床医生标注为目标，并通过消融实验评估分类、概率质量、空间一致性及腹膜或更深层起始时间。
AI.result: 完整流程达到准确率0.646、宏F1 0.507、宏AUROC 0.882，而仅用发射分类器为0.600、0.440、0.861。宏F1在全部五折中提升0.066。标签变化从每扇区分钟66.2降至19.5，起始时间中位误差从15.58秒降至2.45秒。组织深度编码跨度≥3的帧从53%降至26%（临床医生标注为22%）。腹膜前脂肪与肠管表现仍受限，完整模型仍有44%的过早起始比例。
AI.conclusion: 结合外观、空间上下文与时序约束可改善回顾性组织识别与起始定位。组织特异性局限、残余时间误差及对未来观测的依赖，需在临床使用前进行外部验证与因果模型的前瞻性评估。

title: Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery
summary: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental results show that Energy Ring significantly improves TTD performance against existing TTD methods.

AI.tldr: 本文从能量视角重新审视测试时发现（TTD）问题，发现已知类与未知类之间的能量间隔不稳定且易崩塌，提出 Energy Ring 方法，通过将两类锚定在不同能量环上来稳定该间隔，显著提升 TTD 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTD 方法过于保守，导致已知与未知特征在测试时自适应过程中坍缩在一起、难以区分。作者发现已知类与未知类之间自然存在的能量间隔不稳定、容易崩塌，因此需要对该间隔进行稳定化处理。
AI.method: 提出 Energy Ring 框架，将两类样本锚定在互不相同的能量环上。具体包括：一个轻量级适配器扩大基于范数的间隔，同时保持已知类方向不变；一个扰动一致性模块为未知类形成紧凑簇；测试阶段采用能量引导的置信度加权改善预测，并利用基于稳定性的校正机制修正不可靠的更新。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Energy Ring 相较现有 TTD 方法在性能上有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 从能量视角出发、通过锚定不同能量环来稳定已知与未知类间间隔的思路有效，Energy Ring 能显著改进测试时发现任务的性能。

title: Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emotion where we outperform the next strongest steering baseline by $48$ to $70\%$ and $13$ to $27\%$, respectively. Furthermore, CCS outperforms naive difference-of-means steering by up to $151\%$, showcasing the importance of deconfounding concepts. A toy experiment verifies our motivation on why: planting a topic nuisance into the training data reduces unprojected steering by $46\%$, whereas CCS loses only $12\%$ and recovers most of the gap to an oracle that explicitly deletes the planted direction. A human study with $23$ raters on $296$ generations reproduces the LLM judge's ranking. Our extensive ablation verifies the importance of our method's components and robustness to the number of nuisance classes. Finally, we extend our method to multi-turn conversations, where CCS sustains both concept expression and fluency, matching system prompt performance as other steering methods drift.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的对比协方差引导（CCS），通过闭式求解对比方差目标，将引导向量投影到低维子空间以去除混淆变量，在12个模型-领域设置中全面超越基线方法。
AI.motivation: 激活引导通过在隐藏激活上添加方向来控制大语言模型行为，但该方向若与目标概念纠缠了无关的混淆因素（如附带主题或写作风格），这些混淆会随概念一起注入残差流，从而降低生成文本质量。因此需要消除引导向量中的混淆变异。
AI.method: 提出对比协方差引导（CCS），一种无需训练的方法。CCS将引导向量投影到一个低维子空间，该子空间通过求解对比方差目标以闭式解获得，从而保留目标概念变化的方向，同时抑制与其他类别共享的方向。
AI.result: 在3个模型和4个引导领域共12个设置中，CCS均优于所有基线引导方法。在AxBench和Emotion上相比次强基线分别提升48%–70%和13%–27%；相比朴素的均值差引导最高提升151%。玩具实验表明：向训练数据中植入主题干扰会使未投影引导下降46%，而CCS仅损失12%并恢复了大部分与显式删除该方向的oracle的差距。23名评分者对296个生成结果的人工研究复现了LLM评判的排序。消融实验验证了各组件的重要性及对干扰类别数量的鲁棒性。方法扩展到多轮对话后，CCS能持续保持概念表达与流畅性，而其他引导方法会漂移，系统提示亦可匹配其表现。
AI.conclusion: CCS通过对比协方差投影有效去除概念引导中的混淆因素，无需训练即在多种模型与领域中一致取得最优表现，并适用于多轮对话场景，验证了去混淆概念的重要性。

title: Practical Mid-infrared Dual-comb Spectroscopy with Absolute Frequency Referencing Based on a Single-cavity Dual-comb Fiber Laser
summary: We demonstrate a practical mid-infrared (MIR) dual-comb spectroscopy (DCS) method based on a bidirectional dual-comb fiber laser. By exploiting the inherently high relative stability and mutual coherence of the dual-comb laser, we stabilize the MIR dual-comb modes with sufficient precision using only piezoelectric control of the repetition frequencies. This simple configuration enables correction of residual timing jitter and phase noise in interferograms while preserving the absolute optical frequency scale defined by the experimentally obtained comb parameters, without requiring an external continuous-wave laser reference or tight phase-locking. Importantly, the proposed method does not merely produce apparently clean interferograms through signal processing, but enables coherent averaging while retaining both the physically meaningful interferometric waveforms and well-defined absolute frequency information. The proposed system is experimentally validated through MIR spectroscopy of N$_2$O around 3.9 $μ$m, achieving a signal-to-noise ratio of approximately 690 through coherent averaging of 10,000 interferograms over 65 s, along with the acquisition of an absorption spectrum consistent with the reference data. These results demonstrate a simple and practical approach to absolute-frequency-referenced MIR-DCS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于双向双梳光纤激光器的实用中红外双梳光谱方法，仅用压电控制重复频率即可稳定中红外双梳模式，实现无需外部连续激光参考的相干平均与绝对频率标定，并在3.9 μm处N₂O光谱测量中获得约690的信噪比。
AI.motivation: 中红外双梳光谱通常依赖外部连续波激光参考和严格锁相来校正干涉图中的时间抖动与相位噪声并保持绝对频率精度，系统复杂、实用性受限。本文旨在利用双向双梳激光器自身的相对稳定性和互相干性，实现简单且具绝对频率参考的MIR-DCS。
AI.method: 采用双向双梳光纤激光器作为光源，利用其固有的高相对稳定度与互相干性，仅通过压电控制重复频率即可将中红外双梳模式稳定到足够精度；据此校正干涉图中的残余时间抖动与相位噪声，同时保留由实验获得的梳参数所定义的绝对光学频率标尺。该方法不依赖外部连续波激光参考，也无需严格锁相。
AI.result: 在约3.9 μm处对N₂O开展中红外光谱实验验证，通过对10,000个干涉图在65 s内进行相干平均，获得约690的信噪比，并取得与参考数据一致的吸收光谱。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该方法并非仅通过信号处理产生表面干净的干涉图，而是能够在保留具有物理意义的干涉波形和明确定义的绝对频率信息的同时实现相干平均，为绝对频率参考的中红外双梳光谱提供了一种简单、实用的实现途径。

title: Grouped Sparse Bayesian Estimation for Near-Field Massive MIMO Channels
summary: This paper studies near-field massive MIMO channel estimation based on an electromagnetic channel model with limited pilots. Starting from Maxwell's equations, we derive the homogeneous background response and the scattering response in the spatial and wavenumber domains. It is found that a compact scattering cluster produces a localized receive--transmit transverse-wavenumber block across finite apertures, thereby yields a block-sparse NLOS channel coefficient matrix in the wavenumber domain. Considering the spatial non-stationarity of large-scale antenna arrays, we introduce visibility factors at the transmit and receive sides of the channel model. To solve the non-stationary sparse channel estimation problem in the wavenumber domain, we propose a visibility-aware block-sparse Bayesian channel estimation algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves lower channel-estimation NMSE than benchmark schemes.

AI.tldr: 该论文从麦克斯韦方程出发推导近场大规模MIMO电磁信道模型，揭示散射簇在波数域形成块稀疏NLOS系数矩阵，并考虑阵列空间非平稳性引入可见性因子，提出可见性感知块稀疏贝叶斯信道估计算法，在有限导频下取得更低的NMSE。
AI.motivation: 有限导频条件下近场大规模MIMO信道估计面临挑战，需要更贴近物理的信道模型与稀疏估计方法支撑高精度估计。
AI.method: 基于麦克斯韦方程推导均匀背景响应与散射响应，并在空间域和波数域分解；分析紧凑散射簇在有限孔径下产生局部化的收发横向波数块，从而形成波数域块稀疏NLOS信道系数矩阵；针对大规模阵列空间非平稳性，在信道模型的收发两端引入可见性因子；提出可见性感知的块稀疏贝叶斯信道估计算法求解该非平稳稀疏估计问题。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提算法相比基准方案可获得更低的信道估计NMSE。
AI.conclusion: 电磁信道模型下的波数域块稀疏结构与可见性建模能够有效刻画近场非平稳信道，所提可见性感知块稀疏贝叶斯算法在有限导频下具有更优的估计性能。

title: Dependency Reasoning for Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction
summary: Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction (ASQP) is fundamentally a relational reasoning problem: identifying aspect-opinion-category-sentiment quadruples requires modeling structured dependencies, not merely sequential co-occurrence. Existing LLM-based approaches incorporate syntactic information indirectly, via retrieval-based demonstration selection or multi-stage training, rather than as unified, single-pass generation-time context. We present DRIFT, which linearizes dependency parse trees and injects them directly into LLM prompts as explicit relational context, enabling the model to reason over aspect-opinion dependencies rather than infer them from token proximity alone. DRIFT further integrates retrieval-augmented in-context learning and a syntax-aware LLM-based adjudication mechanism that complements exact-match evaluation under span-boundary variation. On SemEval Rest15, Rest16, and ACOS, DRIFT achieves the strongest performance among compared generative ASQP methods, reaching 54.47% and 64.10% F1 on Rest15 and Rest16, with consistent gains across short- and medium-distance aspect-opinion configurations; adjudication further shows exact-match metrics systematically underestimate semantically correct predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRIFT，将依存句法树线性化后直接注入 LLM 提示，作为显式关系上下文，并结合检索增强上下文学习与句法感知的 LLM 裁定机制，在 ASQP 任务上取得生成式方法中的最优性能。
AI.motivation: ASQP 本质是关系推理问题，需要建模 aspect-opinion-category-sentiment 四元组间的结构化依赖，而非仅依赖序列共现。现有 LLM 方法仅通过检索式示例选择或多阶段训练间接引入句法信息，未将其作为统一的、单次生成时的上下文。
AI.method: DRIFT 将依存句法树线性化并直接注入 LLM 提示，作为显式关系上下文，使模型基于 aspect-opinion 依赖进行推理，而非仅靠 token 邻近性推断；同时整合检索增强的上下文学习（retrieval-augmented ICL）与句法感知的 LLM 裁定机制，用于补充精确匹配评估在 span 边界变化下的不足。
AI.result: 在 SemEval Rest15、Rest16 与 ACOS 上，DRIFT 在对比的生成式 ASQP 方法中性能最强，Rest15 与 Rest16 的 F1 分别达 54.47% 与 64.10%，在短距离与中距离 aspect-opinion 配置下均有稳定增益；裁定机制进一步表明精确匹配指标会系统性低估语义正确的预测。
AI.conclusion: 将依存句法结构作为显式关系上下文直接注入提示，可有效提升生成式 ASQP 的关系推理能力；同时现有精确匹配评估低估了语义正确性，需引入句法感知的裁定机制予以补充。

title: TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities
summary: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

AI.tldr: TartanMatch是统一的稠密对应模型，覆盖RGB、event、thermal、depth、LiDAR投影五种模态的全部25种有序模态对，通过轻量模态适配与真实/合成数据混合，在零样本真实基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密对应方法多局限于RGB-RGB或少量模态对，为每个模态对单独训练模型随传感器数量增长而难以扩展，且无法利用模态对之间的正向迁移。
AI.method: 将RGB预训练的对应模型适配到所有模态对，共享一个网络；采用轻量模态适配（modality adaptation）以及真实数据与合成数据混合训练，实现25种有序模态对的联合训练。
AI.result: 在零样本真实世界基准上，相比最强基线，跨模态匹配EPE降低61.9%，同模态匹配EPE降低49.6%；且联合训练在所有模态对上的平均匹配精度优于逐对独立训练，在困难的跨模态对上提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 单一模型即可实现广泛的多模态覆盖并达到当前最优的匹配精度，验证了跨模态对联合训练与共享适配的有效性。

title: FDE-Bench: Evaluating End-to-End Delivery from Underspecified Real-World Business Requests
summary: Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. The benchmark project page is available at https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FDE-Bench，首个基于真实客户项目构建的基准，用于评估智能体在需求不明确场景下的端到端交付能力，涵盖交互式需求澄清与迭代优化。49 个案例横跨组合优化与机器学习；18 种智能体配置中最高平均交付分仅 0.5510，最高交付成功率仅 6.12%。
AI.motivation: 真实业务需求常因一线从业者难以清晰表述经验性规则而存在关键需求缺失，FDE 需通过对话挖掘需求并迭代优化以满足客户验收标准。现有优化基准通常从明确目标出发，而澄清类基准多是在已有任务上人为制造信息缺口，缺乏对端到端真实交付流程的评估。
AI.method: 构建 FDE-Bench：来源于 49 个真实客户项目，覆盖组合优化与机器学习。澄清目标从一线从业者与 FDE 的讨论中提炼；智能体需向模拟客户主动引出缺失需求，随后由案例专属评估器依据验收标准打分，并以客户认可的 FDE 解决方案作为质量参照。共评测 18 种智能体配置，指标包括平均交付分与交付成功率（DSR，即达到参照质量水平的计划运行比例）。
AI.result: 18 种配置中最高平均交付分仅 0.5510（FDE 参照为 1.0），最高交付成功率仅 6.12%。
AI.conclusion: 在需求描述不充分的真实业务任务上，可靠的 FDE 级端到端交付对当前智能体仍不可达；FDE-Bench 为交互式需求澄清与迭代交付提供了可复现的评测平台。

title: Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs
summary: Data selection for LLM fine-tuning faces two facts about real training: data pools draw from many distinct domains, and evaluation spans diverse tasks. As a result, the same sample helps different tasks differently, and samples interact during training so that a subset's value is not the sum of its parts. Current data-selection methods leave these realities largely unaddressed. We formalize them as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), a framework that separates attribution (how samples are scored) from selection (which subset to pick) and models the non-additive interactions among samples. On a real instruction-tuning data pool, we find substantial cross-domain complementarity (joint utility exceeds the sum of singletons), alongside redundancy within domains. Inspired by this, we propose Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first decides how many samples to take from each domain, then ranks samples within each domain by attribution score. Theoretically, the gap to the optimal subset is linear in the selection size and independent of data pool size. Empirically, Mixture-then-Select outperforms strong baselines by 20 to 54%, is robust across attribution methods, and works across different models and data pool sizes. The framework also extends to the data purchasing problem under a budget constraint when sample prices vary. Our findings suggest that allocating selection across domains offers a promising path toward more efficient and effective data selection for modern LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出组合数据选择（CDS）框架，将样本归因与子集选择分离并建模样本间非加性交互，进而提出 Mixture-then-Select 两阶段算法，在指令微调数据池上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现实中的 LLM 微调数据选择面临两个事实：数据池来自多个不同领域，而评估覆盖多样任务。因此同一样本对不同任务的贡献不同，且样本在训练中相互交互，使得子集价值不等于各样本价值之和。现有数据选择方法基本未处理这些现实问题。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为组合数据选择（CDS），把归因（如何给样本打分）与选择（选哪个子集）分离，并建模样本间的非加性交互。基于在真实指令微调数据池上观察到的跨域互补性（联合效用超过单样本之和）与域内冗余性，提出 Mixture-then-Select 两阶段算法：先决定每个领域抽取多少样本，再按归因分数在域内排序选取样本。该框架还可扩展到样本价格变化、预算约束下的数据购买问题。
AI.result: 在真实指令微调数据池上，发现显著的跨域互补性与域内冗余。理论上，与最优子集的差距随选择规模线性增长，且与数据池规模无关。实验上，Mixture-then-Select 比强基线高出 20%–54%，对归因方法具有鲁棒性，并可跨不同模型和数据池规模使用。
AI.conclusion: 跨领域分配选择预算为现代 LLM 更高效、更有效的数据选择提供了有前景的路径。

title: Theory of deeply subwavelength electromagnetic structuring of semiconductors due to thermal-ionization instability
summary: We develop a theory of ionization-assisted instability that governs the reflection of intense electromagnetic pulses from a semiconductor surface. Local overheating of the material increases the free-carrier density and conductivity, which in turn enhances the absorption of the incident radiation and further amplifies local heating and avalanche ionization. At high pump repetition rates, the overheating accumulates from pulse to pulse, leading to a gradual rise of the local material temperature and free carrier density - a positive feedback loop that drives thermal runaway. However, this effect competes with diffraction of the pump field on the emerging perturbation of the dielectric permittivity or on the surface relief, which reduces the local electric field amplitude in the overheated regions, thus providing negative feedback. We show that the competition between heat diffusion and diffraction near-field weakening creates conditions for the exponential growth of temperature perturbations with a certain wavenumber determined by the pulse repetition rate, pump field, thermal conductivity and other material parameters. The derived analytical expressions accurately describe the spatial period of deeply subwavelength structures observed in recent experiments on silicon structuring by intense terahertz radiation, and reproduce qualitatively dependencies of their period on the pump intensity, the incident wavelength and the number of pump pulses.

AI.tldr: 本文建立"电离辅助不稳定性"理论，解释强电磁脉冲在半导体表面的反射行为，揭示热失控正反馈与衍射负反馈的竞争导致亚波长周期结构形成，并成功解释硅在强太赫兹辐射下的实验观测。
AI.motivation: 强电磁脉冲（如太赫兹辐射）辐照半导体时会在表面形成深亚波长周期结构，其物理机制此前缺乏统一的理论解释。作者希望阐明材料局部过热、自由载流子密度与电导率变化之间的耦合反馈如何驱动结构的自组织形成。
AI.method: 构建以电离辅助不稳定性为核心的理论框架：分析局部过热→自由载流子密度与电导率升高→吸收增强→加热与雪崩电离进一步放大的正反馈回路；考虑高重复频率下脉冲间过热累积导致热失控；同时引入泵浦场在介电常数扰动或表面起伏上的衍射造成过热点电场减弱这一负反馈机制。通过解析推导得出温度扰动指数增长的条件及其特征波数，该波数与脉冲重复频率、泵浦场强度、热导率等材料参数相关。
AI.result: 解析表达式准确描述了近期硅在强太赫兹辐射结构化实验中观测到的深亚波长结构空间周期，并定性重现了周期随泵浦强度、入射波长和泵浦脉冲数量的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 热扩散与衍射近场减弱之间的竞争为温度扰动的指数增长创造了条件，其特征波数由脉冲重复频率、泵浦场及材料参数共同决定；该理论为半导体表面脉冲激光/太赫兹诱导亚波长结构提供了自洽的定量解释。

title: Electromagnetic Singularity-Aware MIMO Channels: Scattering-Based Channel Modeling and Physics-Aware Power Allocation
summary: Electromagnetic information theory (EIT) brings electromagnetic physics into wireless channel analysis and offers a physical view of channel structures hidden by conventional models. This paper studies channel instability near electromag- netic singular states, where small environmental perturbations can cause large variations in the end-to-end channel. Using resolvent-based spectral analysis, we develop an electromag- netic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channel model that decomposes the end-to-end channel into a smooth regular component and singularity-associated components. The analysis shows that the singularity-associated components become more sensitive to environmental perturbations near singular states. The proposed model also reveals a limitation of conventional water filling (WF): power allocation based only on instan- taneous channel gains does not account for such instability. We therefore estimate singularity information from broadband MIMO channel state information (CSI) and develop a singularity- aware transmit covariance optimization method. Simulations demonstrate numerical stability of the estimated pole frequencies and illustrate the environmental sensitivity of pole-associated channel components. The proposed allocation reduces weighted singular-channel exposure by 90.32% while retaining 95% of the nominal WF rate.

AI.tldr: 本文基于分解谱的谱分析构建电磁MIMO信道模型，将端到端信道分解为平滑正则分量与奇异态关联分量，揭示奇异态附近的信道不稳定性，并提出奇异态感知的发射协方差优化方法。
AI.motivation: 传统信道模型掩盖了信道的物理结构，且在电磁奇异态附近，环境微扰可能引起端到端信道剧烈变化；而传统注水（WF）功率分配仅依据瞬时信道增益，未考虑这种不稳定性。
AI.method: 采用基于分解式（resolvent）的谱分析，建立电磁MIMO信道模型，将信道分解为正则分量与奇异态关联分量；从宽带MIMO CSI中估计奇异态信息（极点频率），并设计奇异态感知的发射协方差优化方法。
AI.result: 仿真验证了估计极点频率的数值稳定性，并展示了极点关联信道分量的环境敏感性；所提分配方法将加权奇异信道暴露度降低90.32%，同时保留95%的标称WF速率。
AI.conclusion: 在奇异态附近，仅基于瞬时信道增益的WF存在局限；通过从宽带CSI中提取奇异态信息并进行奇异态感知的协方差优化，可在几乎不损失速率的前提下显著降低信道不稳定性暴露。

title: Social Bias in Chinese Large Language Models under Social Media Expressions
summary: Existing Chinese social-bias benchmarks for large language models largely rely on normalized or template-based expressions, leaving the influence of internet slang, emoji, and sarcasm insufficiently examined. Safety alignment may further compress conventional plausibility ratings toward the lower end of the scale. This study constructs 73 paired probes across gender, region, and occupation. Each probe contains a neutral expression, a social-media-style expression, and a reversed-identity control. The task is reframed from direct plausibility judgment to social consensus estimation. Social-media expressions are divided into stylistic packaging, which preserves semantic polarity, and sarcastic packaging, which reverses surface polarity. Six Chinese-capable large language models are evaluated through paired differences measuring identity bias, stylistic packaging, and sarcasm shift. All models show significant identity-bias effects; five show significantly negative stylistic-packaging effects; and sarcasm shifts display a clear cross-model gradient. These findings demonstrate that expression form is not a transparent carrier in bias evaluation and that lower scores under sarcasm should not be interpreted directly as bias mitigation. The proposed paired design offers a measurement approach for Chinese social-media contexts while also revealing the construct boundary and prompt sensitivity of social consensus estimation.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建73组配对探针，将社会偏见评估从"合理性判断"重构为"社会共识估计"，考察网络用语、表情符号和反讽对中文大模型偏见测量的影响，发现表达形式并非透明载体。
AI.motivation: 现有中文社会偏见基准多依赖规范化或模板化表达，网络俚语、表情符号与反讽的影响未被充分检验；同时安全对齐可能将常规合理性评分压缩至量表低端，导致测量失真。
AI.method: 构建覆盖性别、地域、职业的73组配对探针，每组包含中性表达、社交媒体风格表达与反转身份控制条件。任务从直接合理性判断改为社会共识估计。社交媒体表达分为保持语义极性的"风格包装"与反转表层极性的"反讽包装"。对6个具备中文能力的大模型，通过配对差异量化身份偏见、风格包装效应与反讽偏移。
AI.result: 所有模型均呈现显著的身份偏见效应；5个模型呈现显著为负的风格包装效应；反讽偏移呈现明显的跨模型梯度。说明反讽条件下的低分不能直接解读为偏见缓解。
AI.conclusion: 表达形式在偏见评估中并非透明载体。所提出的配对设计为中文社交媒体语境提供了测量路径，同时揭示了社会共识估计的构念边界与提示词敏感性。

title: Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning
summary: Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. As a lightweight estimating representation of an object, DMU enables selective unlearning of domain-specific components in a specific object while preserving other semantic representations, thereby significantly enhancing robustness in multiple combination unlearning scenarios. Extensive experiments show that DMU significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods of batch unlearning and sequential unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU)，利用从扩散中间特征提取的EMA更新特征代理表示目标物体方向，实现物体-风格组合场景下的选择性遗忘，缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型存在生成非法内容与侵犯版权的风险，需要机器遗忘技术删除有害概念或受版权保护的风格，同时不损害模型通用性能。但已有方法主要针对物体级或风格级删除，无法处理物体-风格组合遗忘，且多遗忘请求易导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU)，使用从扩散中间特征中提取的EMA更新特征代理（feature proxy）来表示待保留的目标物体方向；该代理作为物体的轻量估计表示，支持对特定物体中领域特异成分的选择性遗忘，同时保留其他语义表示。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DMU显著缓解灾难性遗忘，在批量遗忘与顺序遗忘任务上均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DMU通过轻量EMA特征代理实现物体-风格组合的细粒度选择性遗忘，在多请求遗忘场景下具备更强鲁棒性，为扩散模型安全合规提供有效遗忘方案。

title: Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, including appendices
summary: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SRCoD，一个结构-响应协同校准的模态依赖性项目级诊断框架，用于诊断多模态基准中样本是否只依赖单一模态或答案选项规律，实验表明其优于现有基准诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基准可能包含捷径样本，即仅凭单一模态或答案选项规律即可作答，无法真实反映模型的跨模态推理能力；而现有基准评估方法要么只依赖项目内在结构，要么只依赖模型外在响应行为，难以进行全面诊断。
AI.method: SRCoD 从基准内容与目标答案中估计样本级多模态信息结构，并将其作为软结构锚点，用于模态条件下的项目响应建模；学习到的模型生成校准后的项目级诊断画像，反映项目对不同模态证据的依赖强度，并提供可解释的归因。
AI.result: 在基准精炼导向验证与人工标注项目验证两种互补协议下的大量实验表明，SRCoD 优于当前最先进的基准诊断方法。
AI.conclusion: SRCoD 通过结构-响应协同校准实现了多模态基准的项目级模态依赖诊断，可支持超越总体准确率的细粒度基准分析，并提供可解释归因。

title: Can We Trust This Evaluation? Instance-Level Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation commonly aggregates multiple judges' decisions into a majority vote, yet this panel decision process does not guarantee that the evaluation of an individual item is reliable. We propose Structured Cross-fitted Uncertainty Risk (SCUR), a label-free approach for estimating instance-level evaluation reliability based on the judge panel's behavior. A latent measurement model serves as the backbone for measurement system analysis, from which SCUR derives three complementary signals capturing panel uncertainty, measurement cross-entropy, and perturbation sensitivity. These three sources of evidence are combined into a risk score. We evaluate the SCUR approach on five real-world benchmarks using majority-vote error ranking, selective trust, and risk stratification. Furthermore, we show our approach to be more effective at detecting high-consensus risk items, which are the blind spots for many other LLM-as-a-judge evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SCUR方法，无需标签，基于评审团行为估计样本级评估可靠性，融合面板不确定性、测量交叉熵与扰动敏感性三类信号生成风险分数。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge常用多数投票聚合多个评审的决定，但面板决策过程并不能保证单个样本的评估可靠，缺乏对实例级可靠性的无标签估计手段。
AI.method: 以潜在测量模型作为测量系统分析的骨干，从评审团行为中导出三类互补信号：面板不确定性、测量交叉熵、扰动敏感性，并将三者组合为风险分数。
AI.result: 在五个真实基准上，通过多数投票误差排序、选择性信任与风险分层进行评估。
AI.conclusion: SCUR能更有效地检测高共识风险样本，这是许多其他LLM-as-a-judge评估方法的盲区。

title: On-chip optical isolators
summary: Optical isolation suppresses back-reflections that destabilize lasers, produce parasitic interference, and increase crosstalk in photonic systems. Although free-space and fibre-optic isolators are mature, no broadly adopted on-chip technology yet combines strong isolation, low insertion loss, broad bandwidth, compact footprint, and scalable fabrication. The difficulty is twofold: Lorentz reciprocity must be broken, and every relevant backward spatial, spectral, and polarization channel must be suppressed. This Review develops a common framework for assessing proposed solutions. We first distinguish pairwise nonreciprocity from intensity-asymmetric transmission and from true isolation using the constitutive relations and scattering matrix. We then compare three physical routes to an integrated nonreciprocal response: magneto-optical bias, externally driven space-time modulation, and nonlinear optical processes. Topological and non-Hermitian systems are treated as cross-cutting design frameworks that can route, protect, or enhance an underlying nonreciprocal response, but do not by themselves break reciprocity. Finally, we examine fundamental constraints and practical trade-offs among isolation, insertion loss, bandwidth, footprint, modal coverage, drive requirements, and fabrication compatibility. The resulting mechanism-based perspective connects reciprocity-breaking physics to the requirements of scalable photonic integrated circuits.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出统一框架评估片上光隔离方案：以本构关系和散射矩阵区分成对非互易性、强度非对称传输与真正的隔离，比较磁光偏置、外部驱动时空调制、非线性光学三种物理路径，并将拓扑与非厄米体系视为可路由、保护或增强非互易响应的交叉设计框架，最终分析隔离度、插损、带宽、尺寸、模式覆盖、驱动要求与工艺兼容性之间的根本约束与权衡。
AI.motivation: 自由空间与光纤隔离器已成熟，但尚无被广泛采用的片上技术能同时兼顾强隔离、低插损、宽带宽、紧凑尺寸与可规模化制造。其难点在于既要打破洛伦兹互易性，又要抑制所有相关的后向空间、光谱与偏振通道。学界缺乏对各类候选方案的共同评判标准，因此需要建立机制导向的评估框架。
AI.method: 本综述以本构关系和散射矩阵为工具，首先区分成对非互易性、强度非对称传输与真正隔离；随后比较实现集成非互易响应的三条物理路径——磁光偏置、外部驱动时空调制、非线性光学过程；并将拓扑与非厄米体系作为跨领域设计框架加以讨论，指出其本身并不打破互易性；最后梳理隔离度、插损、带宽、尺寸、模式覆盖、驱动需求和制造兼容性等基本约束与实际权衡。
AI.result: 建立了基于物理机制的对比体系：明确互易性破缺的必要条件，澄清拓扑与非厄米结构仅能路由、保护或增强底层非互易响应而非替代互易破缺，并系统梳理了各方案在性能指标与工艺兼容性上的取舍关系。
AI.conclusion: 该综述提供了从打破互易性的物理机制到可规模化光子集成回路需求的连贯视角，为片上光隔离器的方案选择与设计提供了统一判据和权衡参考。

title: Analysis of Integrated Communication and Sensing in Cylindrical Aerial Corridors
summary: In unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks, integrated communication and sensing (ISAC) is emerging as a key enabler to support extended and continuous communication and sensing capabilities for sixth-generation (6G) services among UAVs operating in swarms. In this paper, a comprehensive framework is presented to investigate the ISAC coverage probability of a reference UAV-base station (BS) in a UAV network. A fixed number of UAV user equipment (UAVUEs) and UAV-BSs are deployed in an aerial corridor modeled as a finite cylinder. The three-dimensional (3D) binomial point process (BPP) is used to model both the 3D spatial locations of the UAV-UEs and the UAV-BSs. By adopting realistic 3D third generation partnership project (3GPP) antenna patterns for both the UAV-UEs and UAV-BSs, the UAVs' boresight direction of the maximum antenna gain is modeled as a random unit vector. All UAV-BSs have sensing capabilities, so an arbitrary yet fixed reference UAV-BS acts as a monostatic radar to acquire sensing measurements associated with a target UAV-UE at a given time snapshot while the target UAVUE communicates with the reference UAV-BS. Consequently, considering both clutter and communication interference, exact analytical expressions for ISAC coverage probability are derived. Low complexity baseline analytical expressions are also derived by ignoring clutter interference and directional characteristics of the UAV-UEs. Finally, motivated by the vision for intelligent UAV networks, a DeepSets-based model is developed and trained to estimate the optimal location of the reference UAV-BS that maximizes ISAC performance given a spatial deployment of the UAVs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to rigorously investigate ISAC performance in UAV networks while incorporating the directionality characteristics of the UAV antennas.

AI.tldr: 该文在有限圆柱形空中走廊中，用3D BPP建模UAV-UE与UAV-BS位置，结合3GPP 3D天线方向图与随机波束指向，推导含杂波与通信干扰的ISAC覆盖概率精确及低复杂度表达式，并用DeepSets模型估计最优参考UAV-BS位置。
AI.motivation: UAV集群中通感一体化(ISAC)是支撑6G连续通信与感知的关键使能技术，但现有工作缺乏对UAV网络ISAC覆盖性能的严格建模，尤其未纳入UAV天线的方向性特征与三维空间部署的影响。
AI.method: 将UAV-UE与UAV-BS部署于有限圆柱形空中走廊，用三维二项点过程(BPP)建模其空间位置；采用3GPP 3D天线方向图，最大天线增益的视轴方向建模为随机单位向量；参考UAV-BS作为单站雷达在目标UAV-UE通信的同时进行感知测量。在此模型下，兼顾杂波与通信干扰推导ISAC覆盖概率的精确解析表达式，并给出忽略杂波干扰及UAV-UE方向性特征的低复杂度基线表达式。进一步构建并训练DeepSets模型，根据UAV空间部署估计使ISAC性能最优的参考UAV-BS位置。
AI.result: 得到含杂波与通信干扰条件下ISAC覆盖概率的精确解析表达式及低复杂度基线表达式；训练后的DeepSets模型可基于UAV空间部署估计最优参考UAV-BS位置；据作者所述，这是首个在纳入UAV天线方向性特征下严格研究UAV网络ISAC性能的工作。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为UAV网络中带方向性天线的ISAC覆盖性能提供了严谨的解析框架，并结合深度学习实现参考UAV-BS位置优化，为智能UAV网络的通感一体化部署提供了理论与方法支撑。

title: Agent-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction
summary: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction (ECPE) requires identifying the causes associated with emotions expressed in a conversation. Accurate extraction can depend on evidence that is not initially available, making it important to decide when further information is worth acquiring. We study agent-guided evidence acquisition for ECPE, where a student agent selectively accesses expert judgments for borderline relations on both sides of its validation-selected F1 decision boundary and revises only queried predictions. Through controlled comparisons under different information-access conditions, we examine how delegation granularity, query selection, and response integration affect prediction quality. At a nominal 10% query rate, selective fusion improves mean pair F1 by 2.64-3.88 points over the student in our main experiments, reaching 65.14 on ECF and 49.74 on MEC4 across model families. Our analysis suggests that greater access does not always translate into better cause identification. These findings motivate acquisition strategies that consider both the relevance of newly available evidence and its effect on prediction revision, providing an empirical basis for more effective and efficient evidence acquisition in ECPE.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话情感-原因对抽取（ECPE）中的智能体引导证据获取，让学生智能体在验证集选定的F1决策边界两侧选择性查询专家判断并仅修订被查询预测。在名义10%查询率下，选择性融合使平均对F1较学生模型提升2.64–3.88分（ECF 65.14、MEC4 49.74）。
AI.motivation: ECPE需识别对话中情感对应的原因，而准确抽取常依赖初始不可得的证据，因此"何时值得获取更多信息"成为关键问题。
AI.method: 提出智能体引导的证据获取框架：学生智能体在验证集选定的F1决策边界两侧，对边界样本的关系选择性访问专家判断，并仅对查询过的预测进行修订；通过受控实验比较不同信息访问条件，考察委托粒度、查询选择与响应整合对预测质量的影响。
AI.result: 在名义10%查询率下，选择性融合使平均对F1较学生模型提升2.64–3.88分，跨模型族在ECF上达65.14、MEC4上达49.74；分析表明更多访问并不总能带来更好的原因识别。
AI.conclusion: 证据获取策略应同时考虑新增证据的相关性及其对预测修订的影响，为ECPE中更有效、更高效的证据获取提供实证依据。

title: We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong
summary: During a network forward call, diffusion backbones naturally produce many intermediate activations. If we evaluate each activation against an identical downstream benchmarking protocol, we can plot an inverted-U-shaped curve as the depth profile: the activation's performance goes up first and then down as we go into deeper layers. This is common knowledge in the diffusion model community, which inspires many applications including the widely-adopted REPA. However, the common interpretation of this depth profile may be inaccurate and incomplete: (i) The cause of this curve has long been treated as signal granularity changing from coarse to fine, but there has been little evidence in DiT backbones. (ii) The community has been mainly studying this phenomenon in a static way, without investigating how it changes across different training setups. In this work, we show a different mechanism picture for the profile, where the prediction target (e.g., $ε$, $u$, $x_0$) sits at the center. The semantically meaningful signal is only an intermediate by-product for predicting the target, while the prediction target is the real goal for the backbone. Furthermore, the choice of prediction targets as part of the training setup can predictably affect the curve's shape. With this updated interpretation, many applications of this depth profile can be better grounded and predicted. As an example, we show how to predict the near-optimal placement of REPA based on the prediction target of the training setup. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解释扩散骨干网络中激活层性能随深度呈倒U型曲线的机制，指出预测目标（ε、u、x₀）才是核心，语义信号只是预测目标的中间副产物，且训练设置的预测目标可预测地影响曲线形状。
AI.motivation: 社区普遍观察到扩散骨干网络中间激活在深度上呈现"先升后降"的倒U型曲线，并广泛用于REPA等应用。但现有解释存在两点不足：(i) 将该曲线归因于信号粒度由粗到细，然而在DiT骨干中缺乏证据；(ii) 研究多为静态视角，未考察其在不同训练设置下的变化。作者希望提出更准确的机制解释。
AI.method: 在DiT骨干上，对每个中间激活采用相同的下游评测协议，绘制随深度变化的性能曲线；围绕预测目标（ε、u、x₀）分析曲线成因，并考察不同训练设置（预测目标选择）对曲线形状的影响。
AI.result: 提出以预测目标为中心的新机制：语义信号仅是预测目标的中间副产物，预测目标才是骨干的真正目标；训练设置中预测目标的选择可预测地改变倒U型曲线的形状；基于该解释，可预测REPA的近似最优插入位置。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为深度剖面曲线提供了更新且更可操作的机制解释，使得众多依赖该现象的应用（如REPA放置）能够被更好地解释和预测。代码已开源。

title: PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. We introduce PsyMemBehav, which maps psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to target-first platform behavior through two-level identity-to-action reasoning. To support this approach with comprehensive behavioral traces, we construct a dataset PsyMemBehav-bench from 5.57M observed behaviors of 5,862 real users (approximately 950 per user) across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter. Each recorded engagement is modeled as target selection followed by Comment, Like, or Repost and optional response generation. PsyMemBehav combines 41-dimensional user descriptors, top-5 BM25 memories, reverse-CoT supervision, and rubric-guided DPO over complete reasoning-action trajectories. Experiments show that PsyMemBehav 27B ranks first in 11 of 12 reported individual-level metrics, improving average response quality over GPT-5.4 from 54.28 to 59.68 (9.95% relative), and obtains the lowest group-level MAE (0.081) and MSE (0.009) among simulated systems. These results support evidence-grounded user modeling for observed-thread continuation; the benchmark remains conditional on recorded engagement and does not model no-action decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 PsyMemBehav：将心理学画像与检索记忆映射到"目标优先"平台行为的两级身份到行动推理框架，并构建基于 5 平台真实用户行为的数据集 PsyMemBehav-bench，实现证据驱动的用户建模与观察线程续写。
AI.motivation: 大模型虽可用于社会模拟，但要忠实复现真实用户，需同时刻画结构化的平台决策与语言表达，且要立足于稀疏、含噪的行为证据。现有工作难以在有限行为痕迹下兼顾"选谁互动"与"说什么"。
AI.method: 构建 PsyMemBehav 方法：以心理学启发式用户画像与检索到的记忆为输入，通过两级"身份→行动"推理，先做目标选择（target-first），再决定 Comment/Like/Repost 及可选的回复生成。数据侧构建 PsyMemBehav-bench：从 Reddit、Bluesky、Twitter 采集 5,862 名真实用户、共 5.57M 条观测行为（人均约 950 条）。训练上融合 41 维用户描述符、Top-5 BM25 记忆、反向思维链（reverse-CoT）监督，以及对完整推理-行动轨迹的 rubric 引导 DPO。
AI.result: PsyMemBehav 27B 在 12 项个体级指标中的 11 项排名第一，平均回复质量由 GPT-5.4 的 54.28 提升至 59.68（相对提升 9.95%）；在群体级指标上取得模拟系统中最低的 MAE（0.081）与 MSE（0.009）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持面向"观察线程续写"任务的证据接地用户建模。局限在于基准仍依赖于已记录的用户参与行为，不建模"不采取行动"的决策。

title: Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training"
summary: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers. Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps. We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it. Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.

AI.tldr: We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it.
AI.motivation: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers.
AI.method: Whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it.
AI.result: Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.
AI.conclusion: Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps.

title: A Photonic Integrated Light Generation, Control, and Delivery Engine for Creating Cold Atoms
summary: The creation of cold atoms underpins quantum sensing and precision metrology, computing, timekeeping, and fundamental science experiments. Miniaturizing the lasers and optical infrastructure, which occupy over 80% of the volume of these experiments, through photonic integration could improve robustness, reliability, and manufacturability while reducing cost and enabling portable space-based precision measurements and quantum tools for non-experts. Yet, there has been limited progress towards integration of the laser and optical infrastructure required to generate cold atoms onto a single chip. We demonstrate a photonic engine that generates, controls, and delivers precision light to create cold atoms in a rubidium 3-dimensional magneto-optical trap (3D-MOT). We integrate on a single chip two frequency-agile self-injection-locked lasers, laser frequency and intensity control, passive beam combining and splitting, signal monitoring, and high-efficiency beam delivery to a rubidium vapor cell. The integrated engine is shown to support multiple functions required for generating cold atoms including stable generation of low-noise cooling and repump light, frequency control for atom spectroscopy and stabilization, real-time laser monitoring, routing for laser offset locking, optical power modulation, and large-area three-beam delivery of 3 mW to the physics package. Fully electrically controlled, the engine enables sustained 3D-MOT operation, trapping more than 1 million atoms at an average temperature of 350 uK and supporting atom-number and temperature measurements. These results demonstrate the first single-chip integration of light generation, control, and delivery for cold-atom generation, offering a path toward smaller, more robust, and manufacturable cold-atom systems for applications including cold-atom clocks and sensors.

AI.tldr: 该工作首次在单芯片上集成了产生冷原子所需的光生成、控制与传输全套光学基础设施，成功实现铷三维磁光阱（3D-MOT）运行。
AI.motivation: 冷原子是量子传感、精密计量、计算与授时等应用的核心，但实验中激光与光学基础设施占据超过80%的体积，且长期以来难以集成到单芯片上，限制了系统的鲁棒性、便携性与可制造性。因此亟需将冷原子所需的光学基础设施单片集成。
AI.method: 提出一种光子引擎（photonic engine），在单芯片上集成两个频率捷变的自注入锁定激光器、激光频率与强度控制、无源合束/分束、信号监测以及向铷蒸气池的高效光束传输，并实现全电学控制。
AI.result: 该引擎支持冷原子生成所需的多项功能：稳定产生低噪声冷却光与再泵浦光、用于原子光谱与稳频的频率控制、实时光监测、激光偏频锁定路由、光功率调制，以及向物理封装输送3 mW的大面积三光束。器件实现持续3D-MOT运行，捕获超过100万个原子，平均温度约350 µK，并支持原子数与温度测量。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个面向冷原子生成的单芯片光生成、控制与传输集成方案，为更小、更鲁棒、可批量制造的冷原子系统（如冷原子钟与传感器）开辟了道路。

title: A Reduced Greedy Minimum Distance Phase Shift Design for Quantized RIS-Assisted Spatial Modulation
summary: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) have emerged as a key enabler for next-generation wireless networks, offering control over the propagation environment through nearly passive reflecting elements.
