To comprehensively assess Earth system multimodal representations, we introduce three downstream tasks: cross-modal retrieval, weather-condition classification, and physical variable estimation. Our experiments show that MeteoLIP improves upon the corresponding CLIP and SigLIP baselines across these tasks. Further analyses highlight the importance of meteorological input, temporal and geospatial conditioning, and multi-style supervision for meteorology-language alignment. Thus, EarthAlign and MeteoLIP provide a foundation for learning and evaluating language-aligned representations of Earth system data. Our code, dataset, and weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/EarthAlign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EarthAlign大规模数据集与MeteoLIP双编码器框架，实现地球系统数据与语言的通用对齐，并在三个下游任务上优于CLIP和SigLIP基线。
AI.motivation: 现有气象多模态系统主要面向特定任务的预测、生成或问答，缺乏地球系统数据与语言之间的通用对齐，其根本原因在于缺少以气象条件为依托的多样化语言监督数据。地球系统状态解读对环境风险理解和气象、气候敏感部门决策至关重要，因此亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建EarthAlign数据集，覆盖2000-2024年广泛地理范围，融合10个专家整理的自然事件与灾害数据源及气候学推导的正常天气样本，每个样本包含时空信息和四种与63变量ERA5气象数据对齐的标注字幕风格。基于该数据集提出MeteoLIP双编码器框架，其中MetTok组件使用地理与时间条件化的query，将变量特定的patch嵌入聚合为紧凑的气象token序列。
AI.result: 在跨模态检索、天气状况分类和物理变量估计三个下游任务上，MeteoLIP均优于对应的CLIP和SigLIP基线。分析进一步表明气象输入、时空条件化以及多风格监督对气象-语言对齐具有重要作用。
AI.conclusion: EarthAlign和MeteoLIP为地球系统数据的语言对齐表示学习与评估提供了基础，代码、数据集和权重已公开。

title: AegisVox: Factorized Privacy and Clinical Preservation for Long-Form Speech
summary: Clinical speech reveals identity through both spoken identifiers and voice, yet its pauses, delivery, and speaker roles can also carry useful clinical evidence. Protecting that speech therefore requires more than preserving its words. We present AegisVox, a factorized framework that assigns consistent surrogate voices and edits identifier-bearing turns using document-consistent replacements. Across 390 public simulated or non-patient conversations totaling 63.6 hours, a matched comparison of two speech renderers separates replacement realization from retained identifiers, speaker linkage, and clinical preservation. Text-to-speech rendering realizes 535/601 planned replacements versus 453/601 for the codec-based speech editor. However, similar aggregate clinical preservation conceals more model-labeled contradictions, and conversation-wide speaker scores conceal greater edited-speech linkage under a score-direction sensitivity analysis. Fresh transcription of original audio provides a reference for interpreting the clinical measurement chain; an independent judge tests sensitivity to model-based assessment. Better replacement realization can therefore coexist with worse clinical or speaker-linkage measurements. AegisVox supports use-specific evaluation of those tradeoffs, not a guarantee of identifier removal or clinical safety.

AI.tldr: 提出AegisVox因子化框架，通过一致代理语音与文档级一致替换编辑含标识符话轮，在保留临床信息的同时保护临床语音中的身份信息。
AI.motivation: 临床语音不仅通过口述标识符和嗓音泄露身份，其停顿、表达方式与说话人角色本身也承载临床证据，因此隐私保护不能只关注文字内容，需要在去除身份标识的同时保留临床证据。
AI.method: AegisVox采用因子化设计：为说话人分配一致的代理语音，并对含标识符的话轮进行文档一致的替换编辑。在390段公开模拟或非患者对话（共63.6小时）上，对两种语音渲染器进行匹配比较，将"替换实现"与"保留标识符、说话人关联、临床保留"分离评估；并用原始音频的重新转录作为参考，以及独立评判者检验对模型化评估的敏感性。
AI.result: TTS渲染实现535/601次计划替换，而基于编解码器的语音编辑器仅453/601；但相近的总体临床保留度掩盖了更多模型标注的矛盾，且对话级说话人分数在分数方向敏感性分析下掩盖了更强的编辑语音关联。更好的替换实现可能与更差的临床或说话人关联测量并存。
AI.conclusion: AegisVox支持针对具体用途评估上述权衡，而非保证标识符移除或临床安全；替换实现质量与临床及说话人关联指标并不一致，需分项评估。

title: ULPack: Reference-Conditioned Lossless Compression of Checkpoint Trajectories
summary: Studying model training requires checkpoint trajectories, whose storage cost limits temporal resolution. Although adjacent checkpoints are numerically close, existing lossless codecs either operate on XOR bit patterns or ignore trajectory-specific conditional structure. We show that a reference weight's exponent predicts the bit length of its displacement in ordered floating-point space without side information. We introduce \textbf{ULPack}, a lossless codec which exploits this dependence by conditioning entropy models of ordered-integer residuals on the reference exponent. Across bfloat16, float16, and float32 trajectories, ULPack reduces storage by up to 27\% against ZipNN, 21\% against zstd-19, and 11.5\% against FM-Delta. Across two dense trajectories, compression improves as updates shrink and reference conditioning strengthens, while near uniform low-order bits set the remaining compression floor and earlier checkpoints add little information.

AI.tldr: ULPack：一种利用参考权重指数预测位移比特长度、对有序整数残差熵模型进行条件化的无损检查点压缩编解码器。
AI.motivation: 研究模型训练需要检查点轨迹，但存储成本限制了时间分辨率。相邻检查点数值接近，但现有无损编解码器要么基于XOR位模式，要么忽略轨迹特有的条件结构。
AI.method: 发现参考权重在有序浮点空间中的指数可无辅助信息地预测其位移的比特长度；据此提出ULPack，将有序整数残差的熵模型以参考指数为条件进行条件化编码。
AI.result: 在bfloat16、float16和float32轨迹上，ULPack相比ZipNN最多减少27%存储，相比zstd-19减少21%，相比FM-Delta减少11.5%。在两条稠密轨迹上，更新变小时压缩率提升、参考条件化增强；低位近似均匀比特构成剩余压缩下限，更早的检查点提供的信息很少。
AI.conclusion: 利用参考指数预测位移比特长度并对有序整数残差熵模型进行条件化，可显著提升检查点轨迹的无损压缩效率。

title: Orbital Angular Momentum Transfer and Beam-Quality Limits in Fork-Grating Electron Diffraction
summary: We analyze fork-grating generation of electron vortex beams beyond the ideal single-mode approximation. The incident beam is described as a paraxial Gaussian ensemble with finite transverse momentum spread and a first electromagnetic Hartree phase accumulated before the grating. Within Fresnel propagation we derive an analytical expression for each diffraction order and determine the corresponding orbital-angular-momentum statistics. The mean OAM of a selected order remains fixed by the topological rule, $\langle L_z\rangle_m=mp\hbar$, while its variance is set by the residual transverse momentum spread of the beam prepared at the grating. For the Gaussian mixture, the transverse purity is $\mathcal P_{\perp,m}=[1+2(ΔL_{z,m}/\hbar)^2]^{-1}$. The observed annular profile is governed by a separate propagation-dependent blurring scale, so a beam can retain well-defined mean OAM while having low transverse purity or a partially filled vortex minimum. Within the radial phase-screen approximation, the Hartree self-field modifies the propagated profile while preserving the full-plane OAM moments and transverse purity.

AI.tldr: 本文在超越理想单模近似下分析叉形光栅产生电子涡旋束，给出各衍射级的解析表达式与轨道角动量统计，指出平均OAM由拓扑规则固定、方差由残余横向动量展宽决定，并区分横向纯度与传播模糊尺度。
AI.motivation: 理想单模近似忽略了入射电子束的有限横向动量展宽及光栅前的电磁Hartree相位积累，可能导致对OAM统计和涡旋束质量的不完整描述，因此需要建立更真实的模型。
AI.method: 将入射束描述为具有有限横向动量展宽和首个电磁Hartree相位的近轴高斯系综，在Fresnel传播框架内推导每一衍射级的解析表达式，并计算相应的轨道角动量统计。
AI.result: 选定衍射级的平均OAM仍由拓扑规则⟨L_z⟩_m=mpℏ固定；其方差由光栅处制备束的残余横向动量展宽决定。对高斯混合，横向纯度为P_{⊥,m}=[1+2(ΔL_{z,m}/ℏ)^2]^{-1}。观测到的环形轮廓由独立的传播依赖模糊尺度控制，故束可保持良好定义的平均OAM但具有低横向纯度或部分填充的涡旋极小值。在径向相位屏近似中，Hartree自场改变传播轮廓但保持全平面OAM矩和横向纯度。
AI.conclusion: 电子涡旋束的平均OAM和横向纯度可解耦：平均OAM稳健，而纯度及涡旋极小值填充受横向动量展宽与传播模糊影响。Hartree自场主要改变径向轮廓而不破坏OAM统计。

title: Practical Hardware-Efficient ISAC: Enabling Multi-Target Sensing With Few RF Chains
summary: Hybrid analog--digital arrays reduce hardware cost in integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), but spatial compression and beam-dependent scan responses complicate multi-target estimation with few radio-frequency (RF) chains. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a burst beam-scanning multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) framework that reuses downlink reference signals for joint range, radial-velocity, elevation, and azimuth estimation. Specifically, a structured global--local dual-tensor estimator separates targets by using scanning observations and refines their parameters from selected-beam RF-chain responses, with delay--Doppler signatures maintaining cross-stage target correspondence. The recovered subarray responses yield closed-form elevation and azimuth estimates through exact sum--difference relations, avoiding small-angle approximations and fine angular grid searches. To further improve Doppler accuracy, spatial-mask-aided weighted least squares exploits the longer inter-burst temporal aperture while resolving phase ambiguity using intra-burst estimates. The joint multi-target Cramér--Rao lower bound (CRLB) and corresponding three-dimensional (3D) positioning bound are also derived to characterize estimation performance. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme achieves near-CRLB estimation accuracy at high transmit powers and centimeter- to millimeter-level 3D positioning with only four RF chains, while maintaining low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对混合模拟-数字阵列在ISAC中因空间压缩和波束相关扫描响应导致的多目标估计难题，提出一种突发波束扫描MIMO-OFDM框架，复用下行参考信号实现距离、径向速度、俯仰角与方位角的联合估计，并达到近CRLB精度与厘米至毫米级3D定位。
AI.motivation: 混合模拟-数字阵列可降低ISAC硬件成本，但射频链路少带来的空间压缩与波束相关扫描响应使多目标估计复杂化，现有方法难以在少RF链路下实现高精度多维参数估计。
AI.method: 提出突发波束扫描MIMO-OFDM框架，复用下行参考信号；采用结构化全局-局部双张量估计器，先以扫描观测分离目标，再从选定波束RF链路响应精化参数，并用时延-多普勒特征维持跨阶段目标对应；由恢复的子阵响应通过精确和差关系给出俯仰角与方位角闭式解，避免小角近似和细角度网格搜索；采用空间掩膜辅助加权最小二乘，利用较长突发间时间孔径提升多普勒精度，并用突发内估计解决相位模糊；同时推导多目标联合CRLB及3D定位界。
AI.result: 仿真表明，该方案在高发射功率下达到近CRLB估计精度；仅用四条RF链路即可实现厘米至毫米级3D定位，并保持低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 所提突发波束扫描MIMO-OFDM与双张量估计框架能在少量RF链路条件下实现高精度联合多维感知与3D定位，兼顾精度与计算效率。

title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
comment: Accepted and to be published in the Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Knowledge Management (EKAW 2026)
summary:
Argument structures represent how individual arguments interact within a discourse. However, leveraging these structures to infer meaningful knowledge remains challenging, as it requires a formal representation of how argumentative influence propagates across the structure. We propose Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) for performing persuasiveness detection directly from online discussions. The neural component employs retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract bipolar argument structures, while the symbolic component applies gradual argumentation semantics to propagate argumentative influence over the structure.
  Using the Webis-CMV-20 corpus, we construct CMV2BAS, a dataset of long, multi-threaded ChangeMyView discussions annotated with LLM-derived bipolar argument structures and labeled with delta events (view change vs.\ no change). We investigate whether gradual argumentation semantics can effectively detect persuasiveness, whether augmenting them with argument quality and graph-based centrality improves performance, and whether symbolic reasoning remains necessary in the presence of modern LLMs. NARS achieves F1=0.57 and AUC=0.56 under its best configuration, outperforming zero-shot Qwen3.6:27B and GPT-oss:20B. We identify support-dominant discussions and long argumentative chains as key failure modes limiting attack influence propagation. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of operationalizing formal gradual argumentation semantics over noisy real-world discourse for scalable macro-level persuasion analysis, while highlighting key challenges and directions for future research in neuro-symbolic argumentation reasoning. We release both CMV2BAS dataset and the NARS framework for public use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经符号论证推理系统NARS，用检索增强的LLM抽取双极论证结构，再用渐进论证语义传播论证影响力，直接对在线讨论进行说服性检测；并构建CMV2BAS数据集，验证了符号推理在现代LLM场景下仍有必要性。
AI.motivation: 论证结构刻画了话语中个体论证之间的交互关系，但如何利用这些结构推断有意义的知识仍具挑战，关键在于需要对"论证影响力如何沿结构传播"建立形式化表示。
AI.method: NARS包含两个组件：神经部分采用检索增强的迭代LLM推理抽取双极（支持/攻击）论证结构；符号部分应用渐进论证语义（gradual argumentation semantics）在结构上传播论证影响力。作者基于Webis-CMV-20语料构建CMV2BAS数据集——长篇幅、多线程的ChangeMyView讨论，标注LLM导出的双极论证结构，并以delta事件（观点改变 vs. 未改变）为标签。研究进一步检验三个问题：渐进论证语义能否有效检测说服性、引入论证质量与图中心性是否提升性能、以及在现代LLM条件下符号推理是否仍属必要。
AI.result: NARS在最优配置下取得F1=0.57、AUC=0.56，优于零样本Qwen3.6:27B和GPT-oss:20B。作者识别出支持占主导的讨论和长论证链是限制攻击影响力传播的关键失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在嘈杂真实话语上操作化形式化渐进论证语义、进行可扩展的宏观层面说服分析的可行性，同时指出关键挑战与未来研究方向，并公开CMV2BAS数据集与NARS框架供公众使用。

title: DuSRFlow: Dual-Lens Super-Resolution via Parallax-Aware Flow Estimation and Complementary Reference Warping
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
summary: Dual-lens super-resolution (DuSR) aims to enhance a wide-angle low-resolution (LR) image by exploiting a telephoto reference (Ref) image. A central challenge in DuSR is reliable reference utilization under large parallax, occlusion, and cross-camera imaging discrepancies. Existing methods often employ off-the-shelf monocular optical flow models to provide geometric priors. However, their assumptions of photometric consistency and smooth motion are violated in dual-lens scenarios, leading to unreliable alignment and degraded reference-based reconstruction. To address these issues, we propose DuSRFlow, a dual-lens super-resolution framework that improves reference utilization from both correspondence learning and reference aggregation. First, we introduce DuFlowNet, a dedicated dual-lens flow estimator for robust cross-view alignment. To train DuFlowNet without ground-truth flow annotations, we develop a real--synthetic data fusion strategy that composites synthetic foreground objects onto real dual-lens image pairs, generating controllable large-parallax samples while preserving realistic cross-camera imaging characteristics. Second, we observe that reference reliability is highly spatially uneven in DuSR, where unreliable local reference responses may suppress the utilization of reliable cues. We therefore propose a Complementary Reference Warping strategy that coordinates patch-based warping and kernel-free-guided deformable warping according to local reference reliability, producing a more reliable reference representation before LR--Ref fusion. In addition, we construct DuSR-RealV2, a challenging real-world benchmark with complex depth variations, large parallax, and occlusion. Extensive experiments on multiple DuSR benchmarks demonstrate that DuSRFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction quality, perceptual quality, and cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出DuSRFlow双镜头超分框架，通过专用光流估计器DuFlowNet与互补参考变形策略提升参考利用率，并构建DuSR-RealV2基准，取得SOTA重建与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 双镜头超分（DuSR）需借助长焦参考图增强广角低分辨率图像，但大视差、遮挡与跨相机成像差异使参考利用困难。现有多数方法直接套用单目光流模型，其光度一致性与平滑运动假设在双镜头场景下不成立，导致对齐不可靠、参考重建质量下降。
AI.method: 1) 提出DuFlowNet专用双镜头光流估计器，实现鲁棒跨视角对齐；采用真实—合成数据融合策略，将合成前景目标叠加到真实双镜头图像对上，在保留真实跨相机成像特性的同时生成可控大视差样本，无需真值光流标注。2) 观察到DuSR中参考可靠性在空间上高度不均，不可靠的局部响应会抑制可靠线索；提出互补参考变形策略，依据局部参考可靠性协调基于patch的变形与无核引导的可变形变形，在LR-Ref融合前生成更可靠的参考表示。3) 构建DuSR-RealV2真实世界基准，包含复杂深度变化、大视差与遮挡。
AI.result: 在多个DuSR基准上的大量实验表明，DuSRFlow在重建质量、感知质量与跨数据集泛化方面均达到当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从对应学习与参考聚合两个层面改进双镜头超分的参考利用，验证了专用光流估计与可靠性感知变形策略的有效性，并提供更具挑战性的真实基准，推动DuSR研究发展。

title: Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation
summary: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. Compared with layer-homogeneous baselines, our ID-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. These results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for MoEs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LatentMoE，将专家计算移至低维空间，使专家形状（输入维度与中间宽度）成为显式设计变量，并证明近方形专家最优、逐层内在维度引导的容量分配优于逐层同构基线。
AI.motivation: 细粒度MoE通常通过缩小单个专家来增加专家数量，把专家形状视为路由粒度的副产品，忽视了专家形状本身的设计价值。作者希望把专家形状与逐层容量分配提升为独立且实用的设计维度。
AI.method: 提出LatentMoE，在低维潜在空间执行专家计算，从而显式暴露每个专家的输入维度与中间宽度两个设计参数；理论分析表明专家局部Jacobian秩受这两个维度共同约束，固定单专家参数量下二者平衡可最大化秩上限；在不同模型规模与路由粒度上做受控形状扫描；并利用逐层内在维度（ID）指导跨深度容量分配，在保持每层参数量、激活FLOPs与通信量不变的前提下协同变化专家数量与形状。
AI.result: 受控形状扫描一致表明近方形专家（两维度平衡）表现最佳；相比逐层同构基线，ID引导的容量分配在固定预算下取得更低的验证损失和更强的下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 专家形状与逐层容量分配可作为MoE的实用设计轴，二者协同优化能有效提升模型质量。

title: Refined Grid Sampling for Efficient Implicit Neural Representations of Large-Scale Scientific Data
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional physical fields, but their training remains inefficient because evaluating dense coordinate grids is computationally expensive. Existing coordinate-pruning strategies rely on local error functions that can oversample correlated points and incur substantial overhead from full-grid error evaluation. We introduce Refined Grid Sampling (RGS), which combines stratified grid sampling, error-based refinement, and dynamic grid-resolution adjustment. This design reduces spatial redundancy without evaluating errors over the full grid. On high-resolution Navier--Stokes fields, RGS achieves higher reconstruction accuracy within a fixed wall-clock budget and reaches the accuracy of full-grid training up to $6\times$ faster than the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出细网格采样(RGS)，结合分层网格采样、误差精化与动态网格分辨率调整，在不评估全网格误差的前提下减少空间冗余，使INR在高分辨率Navier-Stokes场重建中于固定时间内获得更高精度，最高比基线快6倍达到全网格训练精度。
AI.motivation: 隐式神经表示(INR)训练低效，因为评估稠密坐标网格计算代价高昂；现有坐标剪枝策略依赖局部误差函数，易过采样相关点，且全网格误差评估带来大量开销。
AI.method: 提出Refined Grid Sampling (RGS)，融合三种机制：分层网格采样(stratified grid sampling)、基于误差的精化(error-based refinement)和动态网格分辨率调整(dynamic grid-resolution adjustment)，从而在不进行全网格误差评估的情况下降低空间冗余。
AI.result: 在高分辨率Navier-Stokes场实验中，RGS在固定墙钟时间预算内取得更高的重建精度，并以最高6倍于所评估基线的速度达到全网格训练的精度水平。
AI.conclusion: RGS通过精细化的采样与分辨率调度有效缓解INR训练中的坐标冗余与误差评估开销问题，在保持精度的同时显著提升训练效率。

title: Continuous-wave 148.4-nm generation in strontium tetraborate for nuclear absorption spectroscopy
summary: Continuous-wave light near 148.4 nm enables direct absorption spectroscopy of the thorium-229 nuclear transition. We demonstrate single-pass frequency doubling in strontium tetraborate, delivering an estimated 8.1 nW at 920 mW pump power. At this power, oxygen admission leaves a background of 1.22 kHz, corresponding to an estimated signal-to-background ratio of 3.8 x 10^4 after current-integration calibration. Several crystals grown by top-seeded solution growth produce polarization-dependent VUV signals. Temperature scans reveal distinct maxima among specimens cut from one boule and among positions within a specimen. The source sustains operation over 33.3 h. In a separate 3-h record acquired with 1-ms gates, local referencing achieves near-Poisson averaging, reaching a fractional Allan deviation of 3.5 x 10^-5 at 1000 s. These results establish a practical VUV source for stable, long-duration spectroscopy of weak nuclear absorption.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证一种近148.4 nm连续波真空紫外光源，用于钍-229核跃迁的直接吸收光谱，具备长期稳定性和接近泊松极限的测量能力。
AI.motivation: 钍-229核跃迁（约148.4 nm）是极窄核钟跃迁，直接吸收光谱需要高稳定、长时运行的真空紫外（VUV）连续波光源；现有光源在功率、长期稳定性和背景控制方面不足。
AI.method: 采用四硼酸锶（SrB4O7）晶体进行单程倍频，将泵浦光转换为近148.4 nm的连续波VUV；在通入氧气的条件下测量背景，并通过电流积分进行标定；对顶端籽晶溶液法生长的多块晶体开展偏振相关VUV信号与温度扫描表征；另以1 ms门宽采集3小时数据，采用局部参考实现近泊松平均。
AI.result: 在920 mW泵浦功率下获得约8.1 nW的148.4 nm输出；通氧后背景为1.22 kHz，经电流积分标定估计信噪比为3.8×10^4；不同晶体及同一晶锭不同切割位置的VUV信号随偏振和温度呈明显极大值；光源连续运行33.3 h；3 h记录中局部参考使平均接近泊松极限，1000 s处分数Allan偏差为3.5×10^-5。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个可用于钍-229微弱核吸收长期稳定光谱测量的实用VUV连续波光源，为核钟及相关精密光谱实验提供了可行光源方案。

title: Scattering-Mediated NLOS Ultraviolet Communication: Channel Characterization, Modeling, and Data Transmission
summary: Solar-blind ultraviolet (UV) optical wireless communication (OWC) enables non-line-of-sight (NLOS) transmission through atmospheric scattering. This work presents a comprehensive experimental and simulation study of a 100 m outdoor UVC link with comparative measurements under LOS-blocked and open-field conditions. The results show that LOS-blocked scattering-mediated links exhibit substantially higher path loss and narrower bandwidth than corresponding open-field measurements, highlighting the impact of residual LOS components in practical diffused beam UVC experiments. A photon-tracing Monte Carlo (MC) framework incorporating realistic transmitter/receiver characteristics and obstacle geometry is further developed to reproduce the measured channel characteristics with high accuracy. Despite the severe path loss and pulse broadening effects, reliable 20-200 kbps transmission is experimentally demonstrated over the 100 m LOS-blocked link using on-off keying (OOK) and pulse-position modulation (PPM), representing the longest-distance and highest-data-rate experimental demonstration of an explicitly LOS-blocked scattering-mediated UVC link reported to date.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验与仿真研究了100米室外UVC链路的NLOS散射通信特性，揭示了遮挡条件下LOS残余分量对信道的影响，并实现了20-200 kbps的可靠传输，为迄今最远距离、最高速率的显式遮挡散射UVC链路实验。
AI.motivation: 太阳盲紫外（UVC）光无线通信可借助大气散射实现非视距（NLOS）传输，但实际漫射光束实验中往往存在残余视距（LOS）分量，可能高估散射链路的真实性能。因此有必要在显式遮挡LOS的条件下，系统评估真实散射介导信道的路径损耗与带宽特性。
AI.method: 开展100米室外UVC链路的实验与仿真对比研究，分别在LOS被遮挡和开阔场条件下进行测量；并构建了光子追踪蒙特卡洛（MC）框架，融入真实的收发端特性和障碍物几何信息以复现信道特性；实验采用开关键控（OOK）和脉冲位置调制（PPM）进行传输验证。
AI.result: LOS被遮挡的散射介导链路相比开阔场测量表现出显著更高的路径损耗和更窄的带宽，凸显了实际漫射光束UVC实验中残余LOS分量的影响；所提出的光子追踪MC框架能够高精度复现实测信道特性；在严重路径损耗和脉冲展宽条件下，仍实现100米遮挡链路上20-200 kbps的可靠传输。
AI.conclusion: 该工作报道了迄今最远距离、最高数据速率的显式LOS遮挡散射介导UVC链路实验演示，验证了UVC NLOS散射通信在实际遮挡场景下的可行性，同时强调了残余LOS分量对实测结果的影响以及精确信道建模的必要性。

title: RegExtract: A Benchmark for PFAS Regulatory Information Extraction with LLMs
comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Extracting structured information from regulatory documents is a critical but challenging task. Relevant facts are scattered across long, legally dense texts, and traceability of extracted facts to their source is essential for verification. With increasing awareness of the environmental and health impacts of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), regulatory documents have expanded significantly, varying in scope and product relevance, making interpretation challenging for manufacturers and policymakers. We introduce RegExtract, a benchmark for structured information extraction from PFAS regulatory documents, comprising 488 human-annotated field instances across 20 US state documents and 46 regulations. Each field instance includes a value and a provenance entry, yielding 976 entries in total. We define a typed, multi-field schema targeting key elements such as material definitions, permitted uses, and product exemptions, and propose provenance-aware evaluation metrics tailored to regulatory text. Through experiments with open- and closed-source LLMs across prompting strategies, document condensing methods, and schema partitioning approaches, we find that document identification fields remain challenging, and that field-specific few-shot examples improve extraction. This work lays the groundwork for AI tools for hazardous substance identification, question answering, and compliance monitoring. The code and data are available at https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了RegExtract，一个面向PFAS法规文档结构化信息抽取的基准，包含488个人工标注字段实例及出处信息，并配套出处感知评估指标。
AI.motivation: PFAS法规文档篇幅长、法律术语密集、范围与产品相关性各异，关键事实分散且需可溯源验证，制造商与政策制定者理解困难，缺乏专用抽取基准。
AI.method: 构建RegExtract基准：涵盖20份美国州级文档、46项法规，488个字段实例，每例含值+出处，共976条记录；定义类型化多字段schema（材料定义、允许用途、产品豁免等），提出面向法规文本的出处感知评估指标；用开源与闭源LLM测试不同提示策略、文档压缩方法与schema划分。
AI.result: 文档识别类字段仍具挑战性；字段特定的小样本示例可提升抽取效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为有害物质识别、问答与合规监测的AI工具奠定基础，代码与数据已公开。

title: Automatic assembly modeling through attention-based assembly feature mate prediction and assembly feature pattern recognition
summary:
Assembly modeling plays an important role in constructing product models, yet it is still mainly performed via interactive operations that are experience-dependent and labor-intensive. Data-driven strategies hold promise for automating this process; however, existing approaches either predict poses that cannot directly generate editable B-Rep assembly constraints or require prescribed part pairs or predefined assembly faces.
  To reduce the large candidate space of constraint prediction without predefined assembly faces, we propose a data-driven framework based on assembly feature mate prediction. The framework performs automatic assembly modeling from unassembled B-Rep parts, using assembly features to group the geometric entities of local mating interfaces and restrict candidate formation. Given the lack of suitable assembly feature annotations in existing datasets, we construct a large-scale dataset through an automatic annotation pipeline. Using the annotated dataset, we train an attention-based network to predict assembly feature mates, with Engineering Compatibility Fusion (ECF) incorporating explicit engineering compatibility into learned matching scores. To improve the accuracy of automatic assembly modeling, we use assembly feature patterns (AFPs) to guide the matching process. Finally, a post-processing search selects assembly feature mate and AFP mate candidates, whose associated constraints are generated and solved to complete assembly modeling.
  Experimental results show that the framework achieves assembly constraint accuracies of 74.79% on the six-assembly comparison set and 64.09% on the extended test set of 16 assemblies, which includes the comparison set. With ground-truth face labels supplied as additional input, the corresponding accuracies increase to 81.78% and 80.93%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出基于装配特征配合预测的数据驱动框架，实现从非装配B-Rep零件自动建模，并通过工程兼容性融合与装配特征模式引导提升约束预测精度。
AI.motivation: 装配建模目前主要依赖人工交互，经验依赖强、劳动密集；现有数据驱动方法要么预测的位姿无法直接生成可编辑的B-Rep装配约束，要么需要预先指定零件对或装配面。
AI.method: 在无预定义装配面条件下，用装配特征对局部配合界面的几何实体进行分组以限制候选空间；因缺乏标注，构建自动标注流水线生成大规模数据集；训练基于注意力的网络预测装配特征配合，并引入Engineering Compatibility Fusion（ECF）将显式工程兼容性融入学习匹配分数；用装配特征模式（AFPs）引导匹配；最后通过后处理搜索选择装配特征配合与AFP配合候选，生成并求解相应约束完成装配建模。
AI.result: 在六装配对比集上装配约束准确率为74.79%，在包含该对比集的16装配扩展测试集上为64.09%；当额外输入真实装配面标签时，准确率分别提升至81.78%和80.93%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在无需预定义装配面的情况下有效缩减约束预测候选空间并自动生成可解装配约束，验证了装配特征配合预测与工程兼容性融合在自动装配建模中的有效性。

title: RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution
summary: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

AI.tldr: 提出 Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG)，在流式语音助手中联合控制工具启动与取消，先以三次连续一致参数触发启动，再基于参数失效风险与执行代价决定取消，从而降低"陈旧执行"率。
AI.motivation: 流式语音助手可在用户说完前启动工具，以重叠执行减少等待；但用户的自我更正可能使看似稳定的参数失效，导致陈旧执行，且其不可逆副作用在最终调用被更正后仍持续存在。因此需同时管控启动与取消时机。
AI.method: RASSG：当连续三次语音识别结果返回相同且非空的参数时启动工具；随后将标定后的参数失效风险与执行代价结合，在最晚可行时机（效果变为不可逆之前）决定是否取消执行。
AI.result: 在 ReCAST、FDB-v3、Audio2Tool 上以固定工具运行时与取消参数的受控执行时钟评估。在 ReCAST 前瞻性更正子集上，陈旧执行率由 LocalAgreement-2 的 50.00% 降至 3.15%，成功轨迹平均延迟 3.676s；在两个公开语音数据集上相对各早期执行基线均保持降低。相同初始启动条件下的消融验证了主动取消的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在效果不可逆前主动控制进行中的调用可显著减少陈旧执行；RASSG 为流式语音助手的工具启动与取消提供了联合门控方案，代码与数据已开源。

title: Agreement versus Softmax under Spatial Disambiguation
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Embodied Spatial Reasoning (non-archival)
summary: ScanRefer Multiple queries require spatial disambiguation: several instances of the target class are present, and the referencer must pick one. When per-query logits were never logged, a common substitute is cross-epoch agreement. On the full ScanRefer validation set (9,508 queries; GeoClassifier with ground-truth proposals), object-level softmax is similarly miscalibrated on Unique and Multiple (ECE 0.068 vs. 0.102; the scene-bootstrap gap interval includes zero). Fixed-final agreement on the same checkpoints reports ECE 0.041 vs. 0.272 (gap +0.231). Modal-vote agreement is 0.045 vs. 0.318. Most Multiple errors are same-class wrong-instance (45.6%); geometric miss (H2) is 59.6%, and wrong-category (H1) is 16.7%. A non-monotone H1 pattern does not appear under the default fixed-final protocol, and we retract it. Logit-free thresholds rank spatially hard queries poorly. If only agreement was logged, calibrate abstention on Multiple and report wrong-instance rates with H1.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析ScanRefer三维视觉指代任务中"多实例查询"的空间消歧问题，指出跨epoch一致性（cross-epoch agreement）作为per-query logits替代指标时，在Unique与Multiple子集上存在显著校准差异，并给出相应的校准与报告建议。
AI.motivation: 指代任务中多个同类实例同时存在时，模型需借助空间信息消歧（spatial disambiguation）。当逐查询logits未被记录时，研究者常以跨epoch一致性作为替代。但该替代指标在Unique与Multiple查询上的校准特性尚不明确，可能导致错误的可靠性结论与弃权（abstention）决策。
AI.method: 在ScanRefer完整验证集（9,508条查询，GeoClassifier＋真值候选框）上：1）比较目标级softmax在Unique与Multiple上的ECE；2）采用scene-bootstrap估计差距区间；3）比较fixed-final一致性与modal-vote一致性两种协议的ECE；4）统计Multiple错误的类型构成（同类错实例、几何缺失H2、错误类别H1）。
AI.result: 目标级softmax校准不佳且两类子集差异不显著（ECE 0.068 vs. 0.102，bootstrap区间含零）。fixed-final一致性ECE为0.041 vs. 0.272（差距+0.231），modal-vote为0.045 vs. 0.318，Multiple显著失准。Multiple错误中同类错实例占45.6%，几何缺失H2占59.6%，错误类别H1占16.7%。
AI.conclusion: 默认fixed-final协议下不存在非单调H1模式，作者撤回该先前结论。仅依赖logit-free阈值难以有效排序空间困难查询。建议：若仅记录了一致性，应在Multiple子集上校准弃权阈值，并同时报告错实例率与H1指标。

title: Continuous-wave 148.4 nm Generation in Quasi-phase Matched BaMgF4
summary: We report continuous-wave (CW) vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) generation at 148.4 nm by second-harmonic generation of 296.8-nm fundamental light in quasi-phase matched (QPM) BaMgF4 (BMF). At the incident power of 170 mW, a VUV output power of approximately 31 pW can be obtained. The quadratic dependence of the signal on the incident power in the QPM region and its attenuation in the ambient environment support the identification of VUV generation. The polarization dependence shows a sine-function shape with a 15% output attenuation from the maximum to the minimum. These results highlight the potential of BMF as a nonlinear medium for CW VUV generation.

AI.tldr: 利用准相位匹配BaMgF4晶体，通过296.8 nm基频光的倍频实现了148.4 nm连续波真空紫外输出。
AI.motivation: 探索可用于连续波真空紫外产生的非线性介质，验证准相位匹配BaMgF4晶体在VUV波段的倍频性能。
AI.method: 在准相位匹配（QPM）BaMgF4（BMF）晶体中对296.8 nm基频光进行倍频，获得148.4 nm连续波（CW）真空紫外（VUV）输出；通过信号对入射功率的二次依赖关系、环境衰减特性及偏振依赖关系进行验证。
AI.result: 在170 mW入射功率下，获得约31 pW的VUV输出；信号在QPM区呈二次依赖关系，在大气环境中发生衰减；偏振依赖呈正弦函数形，从最大值到最小值输出衰减约15%。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果证实了VUV产生的有效性，表明BMF是一种有潜力的连续波真空紫外产生的非线性介质。

title: Solar-Blind Ultraviolet Communication: Taxonomy and Experimental Characterization
summary: Solar-blind ultraviolet communication (UVC) exploits near-zero solar background radiation and strong atmospheric scattering in the 200-280 nm band, enabling photon-level daytime communication and propagation modes beyond conventional line-of-sight (LOS) links. However, existing studies mainly focus on individual channel types, and a unified channel classification is still lacking. This paper presents a taxonomy of all four fundamental solar-blind UVC channels together with representative experimental validations and a comparative performance analysis. The proposed framework provides practical guidelines for selecting appropriate channel architectures for future solar-blind UVC systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对日盲紫外（UVC）通信缺乏统一信道分类的问题，提出了涵盖四种基本信道的分类体系，并结合代表性实验验证与对比性能分析，为未来日盲UVC系统的信道架构选择提供实用指南。
AI.motivation: 日盲紫外通信利用200-280 nm波段近乎为零的太阳背景辐射和强大气散射，可实现光子级日间通信及超越传统视距链路的传播模式。然而现有研究多聚焦于单一信道类型，尚缺乏统一的信道分类框架，制约了信道架构的系统化比较与选择。
AI.method: 提出一种针对全部四种基本日盲UVC信道的分类学（taxonomy），并配套开展代表性实验验证，同时进行对比性能分析。
AI.result: 给出了覆盖四种基本信道的统一分类框架，并通过代表性实验验证了各类信道的可行性，同时提供了信道间的性能对比结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分类框架可为未来日盲UVC系统的信道架构选择提供实用指南。

title: Lumen-bench: Cross-Lingual Safety Gaps and the Say-Do Problem in Tool-Calling Large Language Models
summary: When a large language model refuses an unethical request, what does refusal mean? In conversation, refusal is bounded by what the model says; once the model is equipped with executable tools, what it does can diverge from what it says, a failure mode that English-only evaluations cannot fully reveal. We introduce Lumen-bench, a behavioral benchmark of tool-calling ethics spanning 30 models, five languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi), 108 Portuguese-authored scenarios, six social-pressure conditions, two system prompts (ethical and neutral), and 21 generic tools. The evaluation comprises 194,400 trials. Judgments come from a reasoning-model judge (o4-mini), calibrated against one Portuguese-speaking author ($n=83$; harmful/non-harmful $κ=0.78$), compared with two other provider judges (Fleiss' $κ=0.78$, $n=607$), and complemented by retrospective sandbox replay. Four findings emerge. (i) Within-model comparisons support higher harmful-action rates in Hindi and Portuguese than English under the ethical prompt, and Hindi and Spanish under the neutral prompt, after multiple-testing correction. (ii) Premium models have lower median violation rates, although price does not guarantee safety or competence. (iii) Replacing the ethical system prompt with a neutral one raises pooled violation rates from 2.76\% to 13.64\%. (iv) In 8.57\% of substantive-call cases, refusal or ethical objection accompanies a harmful tool call: the judges consistently identify the say-do gap, although they differ in how many responses they assign to this category. Matched benign controls demonstrate legitimate task completion in 82.8\% of 3,300 trials. Code and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/lumen.

AI.tldr: Lumen-bench是一个跨30个模型、五种语言、108个葡萄牙语场景的工具调用伦理行为基准，共194,400次试验，揭示了“言行不一”（拒绝却执行有害工具调用）、语言差异、系统提示影响等四类发现。
AI.motivation: 当大语言模型拒绝不道德请求时，其“拒绝”在对话中仅由文本界定；但一旦模型具备可执行工具，其行为可能与言辞背离。这种“言行不一致”的失败模式是仅限英语的评估无法充分揭示的，因此需要一个跨语言、包含工具调用的行为基准来刻画模型伦理表现。
AI.method: 提出Lumen-bench行为基准：覆盖30个模型、五种语言（葡萄牙语、英语、西班牙语、中文普通话、印地语）、108个葡萄牙语作者编写的场景、六种社会压力条件、两种系统提示（伦理与中立）、21个通用工具，共194,400次试验。评判由推理模型裁判（o4-mini）完成，并与一名葡语作者校准（n=83；有害/无害κ=0.78）、与另外两个厂商裁判比对（Fleiss' κ=0.78，n=607），辅以回溯式沙盒重放。并设置匹配的良性对照。
AI.result: 四项发现：(i) 模型内比较显示，伦理提示下印地语和葡萄牙语的有害行动率高于英语，中立提示下印地语和西班牙语高于英语（经多重检验校正）。(ii) 高端模型违规率中位数较低，但价格并不保证安全性或能力。(iii) 将伦理系统提示替换为中立提示，合并违规率从2.76%升至13.64%。(iv) 在8.57%的实质性调用案例中，拒绝或伦理异议与有害工具调用同时出现，即“言行差距”；裁判一致识别该差距，但归类数量不同。匹配良性对照在3,300次试验中82.8%完成合法任务。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭文本层面的拒绝评估无法捕捉工具调用场景下的伦理风险；Lumen-bench表明存在显著的“言行差距”与跨语言差异，系统提示对违规率影响巨大。模型定价与安全性不必然相关，需结合工具执行行为、多语言与提示设计进行伦理评估。代码与复现脚本已公开。

title: Can Synthetic UAV Benchmarks Be Trusted? Real-Synthetic Validation for UAV Model Selection
summary: Synthetic UAV imagery can expand pre-deployment test evidence when task-specific Real data are scarce, but visual plausibility or semantic label alignment alone does not establish validity for model selection. We study when Synthetic evaluation preserves the model-selection conclusions obtained from Real UAV data through two complementary cases under fixed evaluation protocols. In a requirement-specific road-debris benchmark, four language-conditioned perception systems obtain lower absolute F1 on Synthetic data, yet the point-estimate ordering and top-ranked model are preserved; bootstrap analysis yields no supported pairwise reversal, and size-matched resampling preserves the top-model decision. In contrast, a closed-set stress test on a separately materialized business corpus, using four VisDrone-compatible detectors over eight empirically supported classes, changes the point-estimate top-ranked detector and reverses three of six pairwise point-estimate preference directions. A complementary audit of five UAV business scenarios further reveals substantial Real-Synthetic mismatch in class composition, object density, and target scale, including systematic under-representation of small targets. These results show that Synthetic UAV benchmark trust is conditional: semantic coverage is insufficient, and validity must be established empirically for the task, operating regime, and model panel of interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合成无人机图像评估能否保持真实数据下的模型选择结论，发现这种可信度是有条件的：在特定任务中合成数据可保持排序，但在另一压力测试中会改变首选模型并反转部分成对偏好方向。
AI.motivation: 任务专用真实无人机数据稀缺时，合成图像可扩充部署前测试证据，但视觉逼真或语义标签对齐本身不足以证明其用于模型选择的有效性，因此需明确合成评估在何种条件下可替代真实评估。
AI.method: 在固定评估协议下开展两个互补案例研究：(1) 需求特定的道路碎片基准，评测四个语言条件感知系统；(2) 在单独构建的业务语料上进行闭集压力测试，使用四个兼容VisDrone的检测器覆盖八个经验支持的类别；并辅以五个无人机业务场景的审核，比较真实与合成数据在类别组成、目标密度和目标尺度上的差异。
AI.result: 道路碎片基准中，合成数据上绝对F1较低，但点估计排序与最优模型保持一致；bootstrap分析未支持任何成对反转，规模匹配重采样同样保持最优模型决策。闭集压力测试中，点估计最优检测器发生改变，六个成对点估计偏好方向中有三个被反转。场景审核显示真实与合成数据在类别组成、目标密度和目标尺度上存在显著失配，小目标被系统性低估。
AI.conclusion: 合成无人机基准的可信度依赖具体条件，语义覆盖并不充分；其有效性必须针对任务、运行工况和所关注的模型集合进行实证检验，不能仅凭视觉合理性或标签对齐推断。

title: A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition
summary: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结构感知的混合框架用于印度手语（ISL）孤立词识别，通过熵驱动SVD采样、连续双位置编码、弹性Transformer与运动学条件自适应GCN，并构建120类9453视频数据集，达到89.8%准确率。
AI.motivation: 印度手语（ISL）识别面临手语速度多变、空间结构复杂、双手性建模困难等问题，同时受限于大规模词汇基准数据稀缺，以及标准模型难以处理不规则的打手语速度。
AI.method: 提出结构感知混合框架：1）熵驱动SVD采样器动态提取信息量大的关键帧以减少计算冗余；2）针对子采样带来的不规则物理时间间隔，采用连续双位置编码结合距离感知弹性Transformer以保留自然打手语节奏；3）空间上使用运动学条件自适应GCN，通过统一骨骼-关节特征显式建模双手几何；4）引入物理节点Dropout与ArcFace优化以缓解受试者特定记忆问题。
AI.result: 构建了包含120类、9453个视频的印度手语原生数据集；在该数据集上框架取得89.8%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为复杂手语建模建立了强有力的基线，验证了结构感知与时间弹性建模在ISL识别中的有效性。

title: Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE): Fine-grained Hallucination Detection for LLMs from Embeddings
summary: Hallucination detection is critical for ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world deployments. While recent works, such as Semantic Entropy (SE) and Kernel Language Entropy (KLE), identify hallucinations by measuring semantic disagreement across multiple generated responses using Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, these methods depend on separately loaded NLI classifiers to estimate pairwise semantic similarity, introducing significant computational overhead. We propose Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE), a variant of Kernel Language Entropy (KLE) that replaces its NLI-derived semantic graph with a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel applied to dense sentence embeddings generated by a BGE embedding model, while retaining KLE's graph Laplacian, heat kernel, and von Neumann entropy formulation unchanged. By computing similarities directly in a continuous embedding space, the proposed method provides a symmetric and computationally efficient alternative to NLI-based semantic comparison. We evaluate our approach across 30 experimental setups (covering multiple question-answer datasets and open-weight LLM families) using both AUROC and AUARC, and demonstrate that this RBF-based method achieves competitive hallucination detection performance against state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE)，用BGE稠密句嵌入上的RBF核替代KLE中的NLI语义图，保留图拉普拉斯、热核与冯·诺依曼熵框架，实现对称且高效的幻觉检测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语义熵（SE）与核语言熵（KLE）的幻觉检测方法依赖单独加载的NLI分类器估计成对语义相似度，带来显著的额外计算开销。
AI.method: EGKE作为KLE的变体，将原本由NLI导出的语义图替换为对BGE嵌入模型生成的稠密句嵌入施加RBF核所构建的相似度图，同时保持KLE的图拉普拉斯、热核与冯·诺依曼熵公式不变；在连续嵌入空间中直接计算相似度，替代基于NLI的语义比较。
AI.result: 在30个实验设置（涵盖多个问答数据集与开放权重LLM系列）上，使用AUROC与AUARC两项指标评估，基于RBF的方法在幻觉检测性能上与现有最先进方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以RBF核嵌入图替代NLI语义图可在保持竞争性幻觉检测性能的同时，提供对称且计算更高效的语义比较方案。

title: Mode locking by phase-sensitive amplification
summary: Mode locking is the mechanism by which lasers organize many optical modes into stable trains of ultrashort pulses. It underpins optical frequency combs, precision timing and spectroscopy, and provides the phase-coherent waveforms required for applications ranging from strong-field physics to optical frequency metrology. Conventional pulse-forming mechanisms select pulse amplitude without fixing its phase relative to an external optical reference, leaving pulse formation and optical-phase stabilization as separate functions. Phase-sensitive amplification offers a different possibility: the optical reference can participate directly in pulse formation. Here we demonstrate this principle in a continuously pumped oscillator. Kerr-induced phase evolution and cavity detuning turn pump-referenced parametric gain into a power-dependent discriminator that supports stable single-soliton operation. Roundtrip-resolved interferometry reveals that the soliton optical phase remains referenced to the master laser modulo $π$. These results establish phase-sensitive mode locking, in which pulse-amplitude selection and optical-phase referencing arise from the same coherent nonlinear feedback.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并实验演示"相位敏感锁模"：在连续泵浦振荡器中，利用Kerr效应相位演化与腔失谐，将泵浦参考的参量增益转化为功率相关判别器，实现稳定单孤子运转，并使孤子光相位参考锁定于主激光（模π）。
AI.motivation: 传统脉冲形成机制只选择脉冲幅度，不固定其相对于外部光参考的相位，导致脉冲形成与光相位稳定是两个独立功能；作者希望让光参考直接参与脉冲形成，从而统一幅度选择与相位参考。
AI.method: 在连续泵浦振荡器中，利用Kerr诱导的相位演化与腔失谐，把泵浦参考的参量（相位敏感）增益转变为功率相关的判别器，以支持稳定单孤子运转；采用往返分辨干涉测量（roundtrip-resolved interferometry）表征孤子光相位。
AI.result: 实现了稳定单孤子运转；往返分辨干涉测量显示孤子光相位相对于主激光保持参考，模π。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了相位敏感锁模机制：脉冲幅度选择与光相位参考源自同一相干非线性反馈，从而将脉冲形成与光相位稳定合并为单一过程。

title: On the CSIT-Limited Delay Robustness of IR-HARQ in Finite Blocklength RSMA Networks
summary: This letter studies the throughput and reliability of power-constrained rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) with variable-length incremental-redundancy hybrid automatic repeat request (IR-HARQ) under finite blocklength (FBL) transmission and imperfect channel state information at the transmitter (CSIT). While perfect-CSIT feedback-delay tolerance approaches a natural ceiling as signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) grows, we show imperfect CSIT imposes a strictly lower, finite ceiling set solely by CSIT quality, one that transmit power cannot overcome. We derive analytical expressions and tight approximations for common- and private-stream decoding failure probabilities, capturing FBL and CSIT uncertainty via a unified CSIT-degradation factor. Also, we show that residual interference saturates effective stream power at high SNR, limiting reliability and producing this delay-tolerance ceiling. Simulations validate the analysis and quantify the ceiling, offering design insights for delay-robust RSMA under imperfect CSIT.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限码长(FBL)与非理想CSIT下，功率受限RSMA结合可变长增量冗余HARQ(IR-HARQ)的吞吐量与可靠性，揭示非理想CSIT造成的时延容忍天花板上限。
AI.motivation: 在FBL传输与非理想信道状态信息(CSIT)条件下，RSMA结合IR-HARQ的吞吐量与可靠性行为尚不明确；需要厘清时延容忍、发射功率与CSIT质量之间的制约关系，以支撑鲁棒RSMA设计。
AI.method: 面向功率受限RSMA的可变长IR-HARQ系统，在FBL与非理想CSIT下推导公共流与私有流的译码失败概率解析表达式及紧近似，并引入统一的CSIT退化因子同时刻画FBL与CSIT不确定性；通过仿真验证分析结果。
AI.result: 完美CSIT下的反馈时延容忍随SNR增长趋于自然上限；非理想CSIT则施加一个严格更低且有限、仅由CSIT质量决定的天花板，发射功率无法突破。残差干扰在高SNR下使有效流功率饱和，从而限制可靠性并产生该时延容忍天花板。仿真验证了分析并量化了该天花板。
AI.conclusion: 非理想CSIT将RSMA-IR-HARQ的时延容忍限制在一个由CSIT质量决定的有限天花板上，且无法通过增大发射功率改善；所得解析与近似为功率受限、非理想CSIT下的时延鲁棒RSMA设计提供了量化依据与设计洞见。

title: Where Did We Go Wrong? Localizing Errors to Repair Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly used in multi-turn conversations, where the user's intent is often unclear at first and revealed only gradually over time. The assistant must therefore interpret each exchange and form inferences about the user's intent, using them to update its working state. These updates usually refine the assistant's understanding, but a misinterpretation can instead corrupt its working state by ruling out the true intent, influencing subsequent turns and ultimately causing the conversation to fail. Efficient recovery then requires locating and revising the misinterpretation without discarding information that remains valid. We introduce Loci (Localization Of Corrupted Inferences), a framework for probabilistically localizing misinterpretations and selectively repairing the assistant's working state. Given an observed failure, Loci reasons over possible user intents and assigns each update a probability of having excluded the true intent. These probabilities rank suspected updates and quantify the model's confidence in the localization of the underlying misinterpretations. Loci then uses this information in a repair policy that decides whether to retain, verify, or remove suspected updates, enabling recovery from corrupted inferences while preserving useful information. To evaluate Loci's ability to identify misinterpretations, we first test it in a controlled setup with injected errors. We find that Loci improves localization over the baselines, with its advantage becoming larger when multiple errors occur. We then evaluate it in free-form conversations, where misinterpretations arise naturally, and measure the interactions needed to complete the task after an initial failure. Using localization confidence to guide repair, Loci reduces mean recovery cost by 46-79% relative to the strongest baseline across multiple domains.

AI.tldr: Loci框架通过概率化定位对话中的误解性推断，并选择性修复助手工作状态，显著降低多轮对话失败后的恢复成本。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话中用户意图往往逐步显现，助手需持续推断并更新工作状态。误解会污染状态（排除真实意图），导致后续对话失败；高效恢复需定位并修正误解，同时保留仍有效的信息，现有方法难以做到这一点。
AI.method: Loci（Localization Of Corrupted Inferences）在给定观测到的失败后，对所有可能的用户意图进行推理，为每次状态更新分配"排除了真实意图"的概率；据此对可疑更新进行排序，并量化定位置信度；随后用于修复策略，决定对可疑更新采取保留、验证或删除操作。
AI.result: 在注入错误的受控实验中，Loci的定位能力优于基线，且错误数量增多时优势更明显；在自然产生误解的自由对话中，以定位置信度指导修复，Loci在多个领域将平均恢复成本相对最强基线降低46%-79%。
AI.conclusion: 概率化定位误解性推断并据此选择性修复工作状态，是一种有效且可推广的多轮对话失败恢复方案。

title: TAG: Calibrating SAM3 for Universal Image Segmentation without Dense Supervision
summary: The recent Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) extends powerful promptable segmentation from spatial cues to concepts, raising the prospect of a single foundation model for universal image segmentation. However, this promise often fails to translate into reliable performance on downstream segmentation tasks. In this work, we empirically identify concept recognition, rather than mask quality, as the primary bottleneck: SAM3 accurately delineates the objects it recognizes yet struggles to robustly determine which concepts are present. Driven by this, we present \textit{\underline{T}ext \underline{A}nchor re-\underline{G}rounding (\TAG{})}, a simple yet effective framework that rectifies the concept recognition of SAM3 on the target domain without dense annotations. Specifically, \TAG{} introduces an \textit{Anchor Residual Pathway} comprising image-conditioned, low-rank adapters to re-ground text anchors in the target distribution and modulate subsequent text-conditioned interactions. Guided solely by image-level category labels, \TAG{} jointly optimizes binary cross-entropy with \textit{Soft Boundary Ranking} objectives to calibrate presence confidence and distinguish present concepts from confusable negatives. Building upon this, we devise \textit{Confidence-Weighted Distillation} to couple rich semantic context of a multimodal large language model with fine-grained spatial priors of SAM3, thereby achieving effective calibration in the absence of manual annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \TAG{} unlocks SAM3's segmentation potential with only 3.1M trainable parameters, achieving impressive performance across diverse scenarios, and notably, even surpassing leading mask-supervised methods on several metrics. \href{https://github.com/MiSsU-HH/TAG_SAM3}{Our code will be publicly available at GitHub \faGithub}.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示SAM3在下游分割任务中的瓶颈在于概念识别而非掩码质量，并提出TAG框架，通过文本锚点重定位与置信度加权蒸馏，在仅用图像级标签、3.1M可训练参数下显著提升SAM3性能，部分指标超越全监督方法。
AI.motivation: SAM3将可提示分割从空间线索扩展到概念层面，被视为通用图像分割的基础模型，但其在下游任务中表现不够可靠。作者实证发现瓶颈并非掩码质量，而是概念识别能力：SAM3能准确勾勒已识别的对象，却难以稳健判断目标域中哪些概念存在。
AI.method: 提出TAG（Text Anchor re-Grounding）框架，在无稠密标注条件下校正SAM3的概念识别。核心为Anchor Residual Pathway：由图像条件的低秩适配器构成，将文本锚点重新定位到目标分布并调制后续文本条件交互。仅以图像级类别标签为监督，联合优化二值交叉熵与Soft Boundary Ranking目标，以校准存在置信度并区分存在概念与易混淆负类。进一步设计Confidence-Weighted Distillation，将多模态大语言模型的丰富语义上下文与SAM3的细粒度空间先验耦合，实现无人工标注下的有效校准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TAG仅需3.1M可训练参数即释放SAM3的分割潜力，在多样场景中取得优异性能，并在若干指标上超越领先的掩码全监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 概念识别是SAM3下游落地的关键瓶颈；通过文本锚点重定位与置信度加权蒸馏，可在弱监督（仅图像级标签）条件下高效校正概念识别，以极小参数代价显著提升通用分割性能，为SAM3的实用化提供了轻量而有效的方案。

title: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
summary: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

AI.tldr: 提出ACROSSVAM2.0，在5.01B文生视频扩散Transformer上以冲突感知方式注入显式点对应，改善对应一致性且不引起广泛感知退化。
AI.motivation: 显式点对应能描述可见表面的运动，有利于视频生成器适配，但会覆盖大规模预训练模型已学到的外观先验；论文旨在研究并对冲这一张力。
AI.method: ACROSSVAM2.0包含三部分：置信度加权的轨迹与可见性预测头；零初始化残差反馈，使生成器在初始化时与原始模型完全一致；非对称PCGrad，仅在共享LoRA参数上移除与主flow-matching梯度相冲突的辅助分量，从而保护主更新。
AI.result: 四路消融、1000步、3个独立种子：完整方法在全部3个种子上降低KLT前向-后向循环误差（种子级平均差-0.00711，SD 0.00505），鲁棒锐度均为正。24提示词、216视频的扩展评测中，CoTracker3聚合循环误差比匹配对照低9.7%，六个VBench维度接近持平；但种子级跟踪效应异质，I3D-FVD由0.1824退化至0.2022。
AI.conclusion: 结论为有界主张：冲突感知适配可提升对应一致性且不造成广泛感知退化，但并不能一致地提升视频质量；论文公开公式、伪代码、匹配输出、源表与工件来源。

title: Learnable Low-Rank Polynomial Sketch for Effective Linear Attention
summary: Softmax attention in Transformers suffers from quadratic complexity in sequence length, making it impractical for long-context applications. Linear attention alleviates this issue by replacing the exponential kernel with alternative functions that enable linear-time computation. Among existing linear attention approaches, recent studies have shown that polynomial kernels are particularly effective, as they exhibit sparse and spiky behavior similar to softmax attention, which emphasizes large dot products while suppressing irrelevant interactions. However, the exact computation of high-degree polynomial kernels is infeasible for high-dimensional representations. As a result, prior work relies on approximate polynomial kernels. This introduces a non-negligible approximation error. In this paper, we show that, from the perspective of polynomial kernel approximation, existing linear attention methods are still suboptimal. We propose \textbf{L}earnable \textbf{Lo}w-Rank \textbf{P}olynomial \textbf{S}ketch (LLoPS), a principled and flexible framework for approximating polynomial kernels with linear attention. Our method learns a low-rank polynomial sketch that provably achieves a strictly smaller approximation error than existing approaches. Experiment results show that LLoPS achieves the highest performance across extensive benchmarks, comparing with various linear attention baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLoPS，一种可学习的低秩多项式草图框架，用于线性注意力中的多项式核近似，在理论上实现更小的近似误差，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: Softmax注意力因序列长度的二次复杂度难以用于长上下文；线性注意力通过替换指数核实现线性复杂度。近期研究表明多项式核因具有类似softmax的稀疏、尖峰特性而尤为有效，但高次多项式核在高维表示下无法精确计算，现有工作只能依赖近似多项式核，从而引入不可忽略的近似误差。作者指出，从多项式核近似角度看，现有线性注意力方法仍是次优的。
AI.method: 提出可学习低秩多项式草图（Learnable Low-Rank Polynomial Sketch, LLoPS），一个原理化且灵活的框架，通过为线性注意力学习一个低秩多项式草图来近似多项式核。
AI.result: 理论上证明LLoPS能实现严格小于现有方法的近似误差；实验表明，在广泛基准上与多种线性注意力基线相比，LLoPS取得了最高性能。
AI.conclusion: 从多项式核近似视角出发，LLoPS通过学习低秩多项式草图，在保证线性复杂度的同时降低近似误差，兼顾理论保证与实证效果，优于现有线性注意力方法。

title: Probing topological edge states in multilayer dielectric photonic nanostructures
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures + 1 TOC figure, submitted to Nano Letters
summary: Topological photonics has recently attracted a significant attention, leading to many theoretical studies and predictions. However, direct experimental demonstrations of topology-driven effects, particularly in nanostructures, are rarely proven. In this work, we experimentally investigate multilayer photonic nanostructures composed of alternating subwavelength dielectric layers, arranged according to the topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model. By engineering different edge truncations, we probe different supported topological phases. Our theoretical predictions and experimental measurements reveal strong field confinement at the surface exclusively in the configuration supporting topological edge states, providing their localized character and topological origin. First, we demonstrate enhanced absorption in an ultrathin absorbing overlayer deposited on the surface when the topological surface mode is present, highlighting the potential for surface-sensing applications. Second, we observe enhanced second-harmonic generation in reflection from the surface, demonstrating the potential of topological states for surface enhanced nonlinear optics enabled by the strong localization of the electromagnetic field at the interface.

AI.tldr: 该工作基于Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型，在由交替亚波长介质层构成的多层光子纳米结构中实验验证了拓扑边缘态，并展示了其在表面传感和表面增强非线性光学中的潜在应用。
AI.motivation: 拓扑光子学虽在理论与预测方面发展迅速，但在实验上直接验证拓扑驱动效应、尤其是在纳米结构中，仍少有确证，因此需要实验层面的直接证据。
AI.method: 构建由交替亚波长介质层组成、按Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型排列的多层光子纳米结构，通过设计不同的边缘截断以激发不同拓扑相；结合理论预测与实验测量，探测拓扑边缘态，并分别在表面沉积超薄吸收层测量增强吸收、以及测量表面反射的增强二次谐波产生。
AI.result: 理论预测与实验测量均显示，仅在支持拓扑边缘态的构型中，表面出现强烈的场局域；据此观察到超薄吸收层的吸收增强，以及表面反射二次谐波产生的增强。
AI.conclusion: 实验证实了多层光子纳米结构中拓扑边缘态的局域特性及其拓扑起源，并表明其在表面传感与表面增强非线性光学方面具有应用潜力。

title: Colored Graph Signal Diffusion Models
summary: Standard diffusion processes with isotropic noise corruption are not spectrally neutral. They inherit a coarse-to-fine generation hierarchy from the nonuniform data spectrum, because each frequency band loses signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at its own rate. For signals on a graph, the relevant spectrum is that of the graph shift operator (GSO). A natural construction, therefore, builds both the diffusion dynamics and the denoiser from graph filters of the GSO, and any such design also takes a position on this hierarchy. We expose this hierarchy as a tunable axis through a family of colored score-based diffusions. Fixing the terminal prior to a Gaussian colored by the GSO couples the drift and diffusion through a positive spectral rate, which acts as a clock for each graph-frequency band. The clock sets when a band loses and recovers information, and the forward processes of standard and certain graph-aware diffusions appear as members of this family. A GSO-valued EDM preconditioning splits the denoiser into an analytic Wiener head that carries the Gaussian second-order structure and a graph neural network (GNN) that learns the remaining non-Gaussian dependencies. Numerical experiments show that colored diffusions reach a given generation quality in far fewer sampling steps than standard diffusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一类"着色"分数扩散模型族，通过将终止先验设为由图位移算子（GSO）着色的高斯分布，把扩散过程的粗到细生成层级显式参数化为可调轴，并据此将去噪器分解为解析Wiener头与GNN两部分。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散过程采用各向同性噪声，并非"谱中性"：由于各频带信噪比（SNR）下降速率不同，模型继承了非均匀数据谱所决定的粗到细生成层级。在图信号上，相关谱由GSO决定，因此任何基于GSO图滤波器的扩散/去噪设计都隐含地对该层级做出选择，作者希望将其显式暴露为可控维度。
AI.method: 构建一族着色分数扩散：将终止先验固定为经GSO着色的高斯，使漂移与扩散通过一个正谱率耦合，该谱率充当各图频带的"时钟"，决定其在何时丢失与恢复信息；标准扩散及若干图感知扩散的前向过程均为该族特例。采用GSO取值的EDM预条件，将去噪器拆分为承载高斯二阶结构的解析Wiener头与学习剩余非高斯依赖的GNN。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，着色扩散相比标准扩散能在显著更少的采样步数下达到相同的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一了标准与若干图感知扩散，并提供以谱率（每频带时钟）为旋钮的粗到细生成层级调控机制；Wiener头+GNN的分解有效分离高斯结构与残差非高斯依赖，带来采样效率的明显提升。

title: Learning Proposition-Level Links from Sentence-Level Supervision for Neuro-Symbolic NLI
summary: We study neuro-symbolic natural language inference (NLI) with independently translated propositional representations of the premise and hypothesis. Before symbolic reasoning, the system must infer semantic links between their proposition-level units (atoms). Existing systems based on Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) and Boolean satisfiability (SAT) identify these links using fixed embedding-based source selection and pretrained sentence-level NLI models not trained for atom-level linking. We introduce a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type. Without atom-pair training annotations, we treat cross-formula link structures as latent and train the linker from sentence-level NLI labels, keeping the translator and SAT reasoner fixed. We evaluate on the full public test splits of Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) and Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge (SICK), and the matched and mismatched validation splits of Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI). Our system improves accuracy by 11.40-27.09 percentage points over a baseline applying sentence-trained NLI models unchanged to atom pairs within the same SAT pipeline. It also improves over the prior fixed-linker AMR-to-SAT system by 8.14-26.32 percentage points on SNLI and both MNLI splits, with a smaller gain on SICK.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可训练的原子链接器，联合预测链接存在、源选择和关系类型，并利用句级NLI标签以隐变量方式训练，在AMR-SAT神经符号推理框架中显著提升NLI准确率。
AI.motivation: 神经符号NLI中，前提与假设使用独立翻译的命题表示，符号推理前需推断其命题级单元（原子）间的语义链接。现有基于AMR与SAT的系统采用固定的嵌入式源选择，并使用未针对原子级链接训练的句级预训练NLI模型，链接质量受限。
AI.method: 提出可训练的原子链接器，联合预测：链接是否存在、源选择、关系类型。在缺少原子对训练标注的情况下，将跨公式链接结构视为隐变量，仅使用句级NLI标签进行训练，同时保持翻译器与SAT推理器固定。在SNLI、SICK完整公开测试集及MNLI匹配/不匹配验证集上评估。
AI.result: 相比将句级NLI模型原样应用于原子对的基线（同一SAT流程），准确率提升11.40–27.09个百分点；相比此前的固定链接器AMR-to-SAT系统，在SNLI和MNLI两个划分上提升8.14–26.32个百分点，在SICK上提升较小。
AI.conclusion: 可训练原子链接器在无原子级标注条件下，通过句级监督与隐链接结构建模，能有效提升AMR-SAT神经符号NLI系统的整体推理性能。

title: Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. At inference time, we accelerate sampling by using accepted future-chunk predictions to skip full-window backbone executions. We equip the head with learnable embeddings to generate multiple candidates for the next chunk, and a learned verifier either selects a candidate or rejects all and falls back to standard autoregressive generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prospective Forcing（前瞻性强制），一种多头预测框架，通过在自回归视频生成的共享历史表示中注入长程预测信号，缓解因仅预测紧邻未来而导致的长期视频质量退化问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成器通过分块（chunk-wise）滚动方式合成视频，但通常仅训练预测紧邻的下一块。这种有限的预测视野（prediction horizon）难以在长时间滚动中维持视频质量。
AI.method: 基于滚动窗口生成器，Prospective Forcing 附加多个轻量、针对不同时间偏移（offset-specific）的预测头。这些头共享相同的条件信息，并各自独立预测未来不同时间偏移处的视频块。通过将监督信号扩展到下一块之外，促使共享的历史表示保留对更长视野预测有用的信息。推理阶段，利用被接受的未来块预测跳过完整窗口的主干（backbone）执行以加速采样；同时为预测头配备可学习嵌入以生成下一块的多个候选项，并由一个学习得到的验证器（verifier）选择某一候选，或全部拒绝回退到标准自回归生成。
AI.result: 通过扩展监督至多时间偏移未来块，共享历史表示保留更长程预测所需信息，支持时间一致的生成；推理时可利用被接受的未来块预测跳过完整窗口主干执行以实现采样加速。
AI.conclusion: Prospective Forcing 以多头、多偏移预测与候选-验证机制，将长程预测信号注入自回归视频表示，在提升长期生成时间一致性的同时实现推理加速。

title: Joint Discrete and SE(3) Diffusion for Protein Interface Design
summary: The design of high-affinity, target-specific protein binders is central to the development of modern therapeutics. However, existing protein-generation methods remain limited in this setting, as many generated designs fail to simultaneously achieve geometric and physicochemical complementarity at binding interfaces. To address this challenge, we introduce PIDiff, a physicochemically enhanced multimodal diffusion framework for protein-protein complex design. PIDiff jointly designs target-conditioned protein sequences and structures by coupling diffusion in discrete sequence space with diffusion on the continuous (SE(3)) structural manifold. At its core, PIDiff employs PIFormer, a novel architecture that interleaves geometry-aware invariant point attention with global sequence self-attention. We further curate PIBench, a protein-protein complex dataset with diverse target scaffolds derived from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We first pretrain PIDiff on PIBench and subsequently fine-tune it for two therapeutically relevant applications: minibinder design and antibody design. PPFrame consistently outperforms baseline methods across sequence design success rate, structure binding energy, and sequence-structure co-designability on all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIDiff，一个物理化学增强的多模态扩散框架，用于设计靶点条件化的蛋白质序列与结构，并构建PIBench数据集，在微结合蛋白与抗体设计任务上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 高亲和力、靶点特异性的蛋白质结合剂设计是现代疗法的核心，但现有生成方法难以同时在结合界面实现几何互补与物理化学互补，导致大量设计失败。
AI.method: PIDiff将离散序列空间扩散与连续SE(3)结构流形上的扩散耦合，实现序列-结构联合生成；核心架构PIFormer交替堆叠几何感知的不变点注意力与全局序列自注意力。同时构建PIBench数据集（源自PDB的多样靶点支架），先在PIBench上预训练，再针对微结合蛋白设计与抗体设计两个治疗相关任务微调。
AI.result: 在序列设计成功率、结构结合能以及序列-结构协同设计能力三项指标上，该方法在所有任务中一致优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理化学增强的多模态扩散与序列-结构协同建模，PIDiff提升了靶点条件化蛋白质结合剂设计的界面互补性与整体可设计性，适用于微结合蛋白与抗体设计等治疗场景。

title: Learning Non-Gaussian SEMs with Conditional Risk, and Why the Direction of Recursion Matters
summary: Variance-based methods recover a Gaussian linear structural equation model (SEM) with equal or suitably constrained error variances, either by recursively identifying the source nodes with smallest conditional variance (top-down method) or sink nodes with highest conditional variance (bottom-up method). We show that the use of conditional variance is incidental: replacing it with the conditional risk, i.e., the minimal expected loss of linear prediction under the negative log-likelihood of the noise distribution, extends both methods to non-Gaussian noise. Existing methods are the least-squares special case. This yields two main results. First, exploiting the noise distribution improves structure recovery: the matched-loss procedures recover the SEM more accurately than their least-squares counterparts and the LiNGAM methods, which are designed for non-Gaussianity. Second, the two methods, interchangeable in the Gaussian setting, separate under non-Gaussian noise: the top-down method is correct for every noise density with finite differential entropy, whereas the bottom-up method requires a regularity condition and can fail without it, for instance under mean-zero exponential or Cauchy noise. Simulations confirm both results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以条件风险替代条件方差，将基于方差的线性结构方程模型（SEM）结构恢复方法推广至非高斯噪声，并揭示匹配损失方法优于最小二乘及LiNGAM，同时指出自上而下与自下而上方法在非高斯情形下分离。
AI.motivation: 经典基于方差的方法仅适用于误差方差相等或受约束的高斯线性结构方程模型，且已有方法依赖高斯性或最小二乘假设，在非高斯噪声下结构恢复能力受限。作者希望揭示条件方差的作用本质并拓展适用范围。
AI.method: 将条件方差替换为条件风险，即在噪声分布的负对数似然下线性预测的最小期望损失；在此框架下推广自上而下（递归识别最小条件风险源节点）与自下而上（递归识别最大条件风险汇聚节点）两种方法。最小二乘方法成为其在特定损失下的特例。
AI.result: 利用噪声分布可提升结构恢复精度：匹配损失方法比最小二乘对应方法及面向非高斯性的LiNGAM方法恢复更准确。此外，两种方法在高斯情形下可互换，但在非高斯噪声下发生分离：自上而下方法对任意有限微分熵噪声密度均正确，而自下而上方法需要正则条件，否则可能失效（如零均值指数或柯西噪声）。仿真验证了上述结论。
AI.conclusion: 条件方差并非本质，条件风险是其自然推广；该推广统一并扩展了线性SEM的结构恢复理论，明确了两种方法的适用边界，为高斯与非高斯噪声下的因果结构学习提供了更一般且更有效的准则。

title: On the Geometry of Radar Waveform Design with Constraints
comment: 8 Pages, 10 figures; To be published in IEEE Transactions on Radar Systems
summary: Many optimization problems that arise in signal processing applications are based around optimizing vectors/matrices of numeric sequences. These problems are often inherently non-convex due to non-linear constraints. Such problems are frequently solved through convex relaxations of the original problem to allow for computationally simple algorithms to be leveraged, albeit with the potential for appreciable performance costs in the solution space. When the constraints of a problem can be implicitly satisfied through the structure of a Riemannian manifold, optimizing directly on said manifold affords the opportunity to solve the problem in an unconstrained fashion. Therefore, when feasible, recasting the constrained optimization problem in Euclidean space as an unconstrained optimization over a Riemannian manifold offers greater flexibility and improved efficiency over convex relaxation based approaches. This paper introduces the minimal smooth optimization theory required and adapts the notation to a radar signal design context. In addition, we apply our approach to two different problems in direct parallel to contemporary convex relaxation-based signal design literature.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍最小必要的黎曼光滑优化理论，将其记法适配于雷达信号设计语境，并针对两个信号设计问题，与当代凸松弛方法并行地应用黎曼流形上的无约束优化，作为凸松弛的替代思路。
AI.motivation: 信号处理中的许多优化问题基于数值序列构成的向量/矩阵，常因非线性约束而本质非凸。通常借助凸松弛以便使用计算简单的算法，但可能在解空间上带来明显性能损失。若问题约束能由黎曼流形的结构隐式满足，则可直接在该流形上以无约束方式求解，从而在可行时比凸松弛方法更灵活、更高效。
AI.method: 论文引入所需的最小黎曼光滑优化理论，并将相关记法适配到雷达信号设计场景；把欧氏空间中的约束优化问题重铸为黎曼流形上的无约束优化，并针对两个不同的信号设计问题，与当代凸松弛类信号设计文献直接对应地进行应用。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量或实验性结果，仅说明方法被应用于两个信号设计问题，并与现有凸松弛方法形成直接对照。
AI.conclusion: 当约束可由黎曼流形结构隐式满足时，将约束优化重铸为流形上的无约束优化是凸松弛的有效替代，具备更好的灵活性与效率；作者据此为雷达信号设计提供了一个流形优化的理论入口与两个应用示例。

title: Sanzaru: Benchmarking Protocol Formation under Epistemic & Communication Asymmetry
summary: A language model's ability to solve a task individually does not ensure that a team can solve it under unequal access to information and communication. SANZARU examines this gap through cooperative bomb-defusal puzzles adapted from BOMBANANA! (Lefto Studio, 2026). Task information and action authority are divided among three agents: one cannot hear, another cannot speak, and the third cannot see. The benchmark contains 120 puzzle instances across seven families, each targeting a distinct coordination ability. Across 1512 episodes, 7 models achieve an overall success rate of 49%, ranging from 20% to 86% under the evaluated configurations. Teams develop or adopt diverse communication protocols, from simple gesture codes to Morse and encodings of entire manuals. Yet trace analysis attributes about 60% of 771 team losses to communication, and agents attempt to use channels unavailable to their teammates despite explicit role instructions. Together, task outcomes and interaction traces enable evaluation of both collaborative performance and perspective taking throughout cooperation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/markli404/sanzaru-benchmark.

AI.tldr: SANZARU是一个多智能体协作基准，通过三人非对称信息与通信的拆弹任务考察语言模型在个体能力之外的合作与视角采择能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能独立完成任务并不意味着团队在信息与通信不对等条件下也能合作成功，现有评估缺少对这种协作差距的系统检验。
AI.method: 将任务信息与行动权限分给三个角色：一人听不见、一人说不出、一人看不见；构建120个谜题实例、覆盖七类协作能力家族的基准，评估7个模型共1512个回合。
AI.result: 整体成功率为49%，不同配置下介于20%至86%；团队发展出从简单手势码到摩尔斯码和整本手册编码的多种通信协议；轨迹分析将771次团队失败中约60%归因于通信，且智能体常尝试使用队友无法接收的通道。
AI.conclusion: 任务结果与交互轨迹相结合，可同时评估协作表现和合作过程中的视角采择能力。

title: TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance
summary: Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance. Building on this insight, we introduce TGuide, a framework that accelerates autoregressive video diffusion through a lightweight Anchor-Transport-Correct (ATC) predictor guided by historical sampling trajectories. Our ATC combines two complementary references: the current chunk's preceding-step features preserve its spatial structure, while the previous chunk's same-timestep features provide information at the target denoising stage. By integrating these references through spatial retrieval and adaptive correction, ATC improves velocity prediction accuracy despite the large gaps between denoising steps. To mitigate error accumulation across both denoising steps and video chunks, we train the predictor on its own autoregressive rollouts, allowing it to adapt to states shaped by its own earlier predictions. An optional confidence-aware scheduler further adjusts the quality-efficiency trade-off. Experiments on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and HY-WorldPlay show that TGuide preserves generation quality while achieving denoising speedups of up to $1.89\times$ over the original 4-step generators. On Self Forcing, TGuide generalizes from 81-frame training videos to 333-frame generation, approximately four times the training length, while exceeding the original model's VBench score.

AI.tldr: TGuide：一种面向少步（4步）自回归视频扩散的加速框架，利用跨视频块在相同去噪时间步的特征强相关性，通过轻量Anchor-Transport-Correct预测器提升速度预测精度，最高实现1.89倍去噪加速且保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 当自回归视频扩散仅剩四步去噪时，现有特征缓存方法失效：去噪时间步之间特征变化过大，直接复用与轻量预测器均不可靠。作者观察到跨视频块在相同去噪时间步上特征仍强相关，可作为额外引导信息。
AI.method: 提出TGuide框架，核心是轻量Anchor-Transport-Correct（ATC）预测器，由历史采样轨迹引导。ATC融合两类参考：当前块前一步特征（保留空间结构）与上一块同时间步特征（提供目标去噪阶段信息），通过空间检索与自适应校正整合二者，提升大去噪间隔下的速度预测精度。为缓解去噪步与视频块双重的误差累积，预测器在其自身自回归展开轨迹上训练以适配自身早期预测形成的状态；并提供可选的置信度感知调度器调节质量-效率权衡。
AI.result: 在Self Forcing、Causal Forcing和HY-WorldPlay上，TGuide保持生成质量，相比原始4步生成器去噪最高加速1.89倍。在Self Forcing上，从81帧训练视频泛化到333帧生成（约训练长度4倍），VBench分数超过原模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨块同时间步特征相关性为少步自回归视频扩散加速提供了有效的互补引导；ATC结合空间检索与自适应校正、并配合自回归轨迹训练与置信度调度，可在几乎不损质量的前提下显著加速，并具备长视频外推泛化能力。

title: DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents
summary: Most text-to-SQL benchmarks provide the target database. In a large data catalog, however, choosing the sources is part of the problem: an agent must find every database needed for a request, determine how their results fit together, and execute the resulting workflow. We present DSABench to evaluate these capabilities jointly. Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. The gap becomes more pronounced when execution is required. Across four backends, median non-privileged Route+Exec-Graph success ranges from 6.69% to 7.98% without clarification and from 11.44% to 13.25% with one clarification; the best observed clarified configuration reaches 16.99%. On ambiguous tasks, clarification improves exact branch-source recovery by 39.8-43.2 percentage points. These findings illustrate why retrieving plausible databases or producing correct local SQL is not enough: an agent must carry the right information through the entire multi-database workflow.

AI.tldr: DSABench 是一个评估多数据库文本到SQL智能体能力的基准，包含815个任务，重点考察源检索、跨源依赖与工作流执行。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL基准大多直接提供目标数据库，忽略了在大型数据目录中选择数据源这一关键问题。真实场景中，智能体需要自行找到请求所需的每个数据库、确定其结果如何关联，并执行相应工作流。因此需要一个能联合评估这些能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建DSABench，包含815个经人工审阅的任务，数据来源于Spider、BIRD和LiveSQLBench，其中618个任务需要多个数据库共同参与，105个任务允许对所需数据源有多种解读。使用可执行契约定义源参与、跨源依赖和源本地执行；通过RouteEnv让智能体在不暴露金标注的情况下检查公开目录证据。开展仅路由研究和路由+执行研究，覆盖多个模型后端，并设置澄清（clarification）条件。
AI.result: 在七个模型后端的仅路由研究中，最高RA-Set得分为60.55%，而包含协调要求的最高RA-Graph得分仅为34.66%。需要执行时差距更明显：四个后端的中位非特权Route+Exec-Graph成功率在无澄清时为6.69%至7.98%，一次澄清后为11.44%至13.25%，最佳澄清配置达到16.99%。在模糊任务上，澄清使精确分支源恢复率提升39.8至43.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 检索出看似合理的数据库或生成正确的局部SQL并不足够，智能体必须在整个多数据库工作流中正确传递信息。

title: Adaptive-Depth Is a Finishing Stage
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the AXIOM Workshop (Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning) at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 8 figures
summary: Looped transformers reuse the same layer multiple times, allowing inference compute to be adjusted without changing the model. Recent adaptive-depth methods train the model across multiple loop depths from the beginning of training. We introduce fixed-first training, which varies model depth only during a short final phase of training. At 200M parameters, training a model of fixed-depth 2 for the first 67% of the run reduces modeled training compute by 45% while keeping mean negative log-likelihood (NLL) across inference depths within 0.5% of training across depths throughout. At 1B parameters, training initially at depth 4 reduces modeled compute by 31% to 37% and wall-clock time by 32% to 39%, while keeping final NLL within 0.8% and downstream differences within the observed seed variation. These results show that training over the full range of depths can be reserved for a short finishing phase with only small changes in performance.

AI.tldr: 提出固定起始训练（fixed-first training），仅在训练末段短暂变化循环Transformer的深度，从而大幅降低训练计算量而几乎不损失性能。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer可复用同一层并灵活调整推理计算量，但现有自适应深度方法需从头到尾在整个深度范围内训练，训练成本高。作者希望找到一种更省算力的深度训练策略。
AI.method: 固定起始训练：训练前期将模型深度固定为某一较小值，仅在训练最后一段短阶段才在多个深度上训练。在200M和1B参数规模上分别以固定深度2（前67%）和固定深度4进行实验验证。
AI.result: 200M参数下，前67%以固定深度2训练使建模训练算力降低45%，各推理深度的平均NLL与全深度训练相差在0.5%以内；1B参数下，初始深度4使建模算力降低31%–37%、墙钟时间降低32%–39%，最终NLL差距在0.8%以内，下游任务差异处于种子波动范围内。
AI.conclusion: 全深度范围的训练可压缩到仅一个短暂收尾阶段，同时性能仅有微小变化，为循环Transformer的高效训练提供了可行方案。

title: Optimal Gating for Dead-Time-Constrained Single-Photon Detectors
summary: We develop a Fisher-information framework for optimizing single-photon detector gating in periodic experiments, in contrast to previous more empirical or heuristic gating choices. After each photon detection, such a detector is insensitive for a dead time, so that an early background detection can obscure a later signal. Gating preserves availability for informative photons by selectively deactivating the detector. In our high-pile-up simulation of distance-attenuated lidar, our practical data-independent gating design reduces the worst-case asymptotic range variance by more than half relative to the free-running acquisition (which does not use any gating). More generally, we characterize achievable detector-active frequencies as a convex polytope and construct an adaptive rule that asymptotically attains an optimal "oracle" design without prior knowledge of the physical parameters. We also derive practical criteria that quantify the potential gains of gating and/or photon attenuation over unattenuated free-running acquisition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于Fisher信息的门控优化框架，用于周期实验中的单光子探测器，显著降低激光雷达测距方差，并给出自适应最优门控规则。
AI.motivation: 以往单光子探测器的门控选择多基于经验或启发式方法，缺乏理论优化依据；探测器死时间会导致早期背景探测遮蔽后续信号光子，因此需要系统性地优化门控以保留高信息量光子。
AI.method: 建立Fisher信息框架来优化周期实验中的单光子探测器门控；将可实现的探测器激活频率刻画为凸多面体；设计数据无关的实际门控方案，并构造自适应规则以在无物理参数先验知识下渐近逼近最优"oracle"设计；推导量化门控和/或光子衰减相对无衰减自由运行采集潜在增益的实用准则。
AI.result: 在距离衰减激光雷达的高堆积仿真中，所提数据无关门控设计将最坏情况渐近测距方差较自由运行采集降低一半以上；自适应规则可在无先验知识下渐近达到最优oracle设计性能。
AI.conclusion: 该Fisher信息框架为单光子探测器门控提供了理论优化方法，证明门控能显著提升测距精度，并可自适应实现最优性能，同时给出评估门控与光子衰减增益的实用判据。

title: Active Learning for Finding a Needle in a Haystack
summary: Training a classifier to find a rare class of documents, such as hate speech directed at a particular religious group, requires labelled examples that are expensive to obtain when the class makes up only a small fraction of a corpus. Active learning reduces this cost, but it must start from an initial labelled set that contains examples of the target class. Random sampling cannot supply these at reasonable cost, so they must be selected in some other way, such as keyword search, and any such selection biases the initial set towards part of the target class. We evaluate whether active learning can correct this bias. On AG News and Measuring Hate Speech, at a prevalence of around 1%, we compare random sampling with eight active learning strategies, starting from initial sets that cover or omit known subgroups of the target class, and measure recall on the omitted subgroups as well as F1. On AG News, almost every strategy recovers the omitted subgroup. On Measuring Hate Speech, uncertainty-based strategies recover less of the omitted subgroups than random sampling, whereas discriminative active learning recovers 55% of them without a significant loss of F1. Aggregate metrics conceal these differences.

AI.tldr: 本文研究主动学习能否纠正因关键词搜索等方式构建初始标注集所引入的类别内偏置，并在AG News与Measuring Hate Speech两个低流行率数据集上比较随机采样与八种主动学习策略对被遗漏子群的召回表现。
AI.motivation: 稀有类别（如针对特定群体的仇恨言论）标注样本获取成本高昂，且需从含目标类样本的初始集出发。随机采样难以在合理成本下提供这些样本，故通常采用关键词搜索等方式，但这会使初始集偏向目标类的某一部分，从而遗漏已知子群。
AI.method: 在AG News与Measuring Hate Speech上，以约1%的类别流行率为设定，构建覆盖或遗漏目标类已知子群的初始集，对比随机采样与八种主动学习策略；评价指标包括被遗漏子群上的召回率以及整体F1。
AI.result: 在AG News上，几乎所有策略都能恢复被遗漏的子群。在Measuring Hate Speech上，基于不确定性的策略对被遗漏子群的恢复不及随机采样，而判别式主动学习在F1无显著损失的情况下恢复了其中55%的子群。聚合指标掩盖了这些子群间的差异。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习纠正初始集偏置的能力依赖于数据集与策略类型：并非所有主动学习策略都能弥补关键词搜索造成的子群遗漏，判别式主动学习在部分场景下表现更优，且需以子群层面的指标而非仅聚合指标来评估。

title: TETRIS-4DGS: Efficient Post-Training Compression of 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has emerged as a powerful dynamic scene representation, supporting real-time high quality rendering but suffers from prohibitive storage overhead. Existing methods typically attempt to solve this by treating compression as a per-scene optimization problem, limiting generalizability and applicability where low-latency compression is required. In this work, we leverage existing image and video codecs and propose a generalized post-training compression framework for 4DGS to address these issues. Specifically, we apply importance-based adaptive quantization to Gaussians according to their importance levels, effectively refining bitrate allocation while remaining fully compatible with existing codecs. To further improve compression efficiency, we utilize the statistical properties of 4DGS and propose motion- and importance-aware packing to reorganize attributes into codec-friendly 2D maps.
