Our approach can achieve over 40x compression rate in seconds while maintaining high quality, facilitating the practical deployment of 4DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向4DGS的通用训练后压缩框架，利用现有图像/视频编解码器，在秒级实现40倍以上压缩并保持高质量。
AI.motivation: 4DGS支持实时高质量渲染，但存储开销过大。现有方法多将压缩视为逐场景优化问题，导致泛化性差，难以满足低延迟压缩需求。
AI.method: 1）基于重要性的自适应量化：依据高斯的重要性等级分配比特率，与现有编解码器完全兼容；2）运动与重要性感知打包：利用4DGS统计特性，将属性重排为编解码器友好的2D图。
AI.result: 可在数秒内实现超过40倍的压缩率，同时保持高质量。
AI.conclusion: 该通用训练后压缩框架缓解了4DGS存储瓶颈，兼顾泛化性与低延迟，利于4DGS的实际部署。

title: How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste
summary: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

AI.tldr: 提出 TasteBench——一个专家对齐的成对“好 vs 坏”品味评测基准（覆盖视觉、品牌、图书、科技），并配套控制协议以区分工艺判断与应试博弈；在 Round-1 试点中量化并（部分）修复了三类效度威胁。
AI.motivation: 现有品味/审美评测容易被测试博弈（位置偏置、线索泄漏、难度天花板）污染，分数虚高且无法反映真实的“工艺判断（craft judgment）”能力；因此需要专家对齐的基准与可分离作弊路径的控制协议。
AI.method: 冻结评分细则、仅用专家金标（panel n≥3，主阈值 percent agreement ≥0.60；弱参与标签仅用于训练/分析）、成对 good-vs-bad 设计；控制协议包含专家唯一金标、弱标签防火墙、构造期侧随机化（eval_assignment_seed7）、文件名清洗与难样本过滤；Round-1 试点为 three biological human experts、n=250 pairs，并用五张 VLM 卡验证。
AI.result: 揭示三类效度威胁：(1) 位置偏置——偏好项位于 A 槽概率 0.956，always_item_a 策略得 0.956；(2) 词法泄漏——文件名 token 线索得 0.912；(3) 难度天花板——craft 域人类一致性近天花板（book/brand/tech 为 1.0），侧随机化（gold_side_A≈0.47）下五张 VLM 卡 craft 全为 1.0，仅 visual 有区分度（约0.84–0.91；事后难子集 n=107 时 craft 仍为 1.0）。侧随机化工具可将位置偏置从 0.916 降至 0.495/0.505。
AI.conclusion: 位置与泄漏属可修复的构造伪影，craft 域天花板是配对难度限制、需 Round-2 解决；本文不评估 engagement、era/circle conditioning 或 calibration，也不宣称通用品味 SOTA。基准给出了“测什么/尚未测什么”的校准视图。

title: Do Artificial Neural Networks Need Dendritic Nanotubes? Two Reasons for Shrinking Importance Estimates in Continual Learning
comment: Github: https://github.com/Saurav-K-Aryal/Do-Artificial-Neural-Networks-Need-Dendritic-Nanotubes-.git 21 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Simulation and figure scripts are included as ancillary files
summary: Regularization-based continual learning protects each parameter in proportion to an estimate of its importance, yet these estimates come from finite samples and heuristics and are used as if they were exact. We report four studies that start from a biologically inspired mechanism and end with a statistical explanation of it. Motivated by dendritic nanotubes, we let transient lateral links diffuse importance tags between hidden units. Links between co-active units gave no significant gain, but random links with lifetimes of 25 or 200 steps raised final accuracy on 20-task Permuted MNIST by 1.5 to 2.6 points. We show that random diffusion implements linear shrinkage of importance toward the layer mean in expectation. A simulation of the link process alone predicts shrinkage weights of 0.23 and 0.52 for these lifetimes, and graph-free shrinkage at 0.25 and 0.5 reproduces both the accuracy and the dispersion of the consolidated importance, while every activity-dependent rule did worse than random links. A five-seed screen across EWC, SI, and MAS found nominal gains for SI and MAS on Permuted MNIST and losses on task-incremental Split CIFAR-100, where forgetting was small and shrinkage cost plasticity. Varying the number of importance samples then separates two mechanisms on Permuted MNIST. For EWC, the gain fell by about ten points per tenfold increase in samples, from 19.6 points with 10 samples to -0.4 with 1000, a variance effect. For MAS, a gain of about one point persisted at 1000 samples, consistent with a bias in the importance measure rather than noise. Shrinkage had no detectable effect for MAS on a domain-incremental CIFAR-100 benchmark. Finally, we show that a standard heteroscedastic empirical Bayes rule shrinks the largest Fisher-type estimates most, which may explain its poor results, and point to a log-scale alternative.

AI.tldr: 随机扩散以线性收缩降低重要性估计方差，可提升持续学习精度；其效果随样本量衰减，需区分方差效应与偏置。
AI.motivation: 正则化持续学习把有限样本得到的参数重要性估计当作精确值使用。作者希望从生物启发机制出发，给出其统计学解释，并澄清随机扩散收益的来源。
AI.method: 受树突纳米管启发，在隐藏单元间用寿命为25或200步的瞬时横向连接扩散重要性标签；用模拟与无图收缩对比；在20任务Permuted MNIST、任务增量Split CIFAR-100与领域增量CIFAR-100上跨EWC/SI/MAS做五种子筛选，并改变重要性样本数。
AI.result: 共激活连接无显著增益，随机连接提升Permuted MNIST最终精度1.5–2.6点；随机扩散等价于向层均值线性收缩，模拟收缩权重0.23/0.52，无图收缩0.25/0.5可复现精度与离散度，活动依赖规则均劣于随机连接。SI/MAS在Permuted MNIST有名义增益、在Split CIFAR-100有损失。EWC增益随样本增多约每十倍降10点（10样本19.6点，1000样本-0.4），属方差效应；MAS约1点增益在1000样本仍存在，属偏置。异方差经验贝叶斯规则对最大Fisher估计收缩最强，或解释其欠佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 随机扩散的增益主要来自对重要性估计的线性收缩（方差降低），而非活动依赖机制；收益在遗忘小、可塑性受限时可能转为代价，并随样本量变化。需区分方差效应与偏置，并考虑对数尺度替代方案。

title: Energy-Efficient RF Chain Activation for Uplink mmWave Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems: A Minimum-Cost Maximum-Flow Approach
comment: Accepted for presentation at 2026 IEEE Globecom Workshops (GC Wkshps)
summary: With the incessant demand for green and sustainable communications, energy efficiency (EE) has become a cornerstone of sixth-generation (6G) network design, especially for cell-free millimeter-wave (mmWave) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, which can achieve significant throughput gains by leveraging large-scale antenna arrays. Adaptive radio frequency (RF) chain activation (ARFA) is a key technique for reducing power consumption without severely degrading the achievable rate, thereby enhancing the total EE of 6G MIMO systems. In this paper, we propose a minimum-cost maximum-flow (MCMF)-based ARFA scheme to reduce unnecessary power consumption and maximize the total EE of uplink mmWave cell-free massive MIMO systems. Simulation results indicate that the proposed approach can significantly improve the total EE while maintaining a relatively high achievable rate and acceptable computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对上行无蜂窝毫米波大规模MIMO系统，提出基于最小费用最大流（MCMF）的自适应射频链激活（ARFA）方案，以降低功耗并最大化总能效。
AI.motivation: 面向绿色可持续通信需求，能效成为6G网络设计核心；无蜂窝毫米波大规模MIMO虽可借助大规模天线阵列提升吞吐量，但射频链功耗高。ARFA可在不严重损失速率的前提下降低功耗，从而提升系统总能效，故需设计有效的ARFA方案。
AI.method: 将自适应射频链激活问题建模为最小费用最大流（MCMF）问题，并据此提出MCMF-based ARFA方案，用于上行无蜂窝毫米波大规模MIMO系统，减少不必要功耗并最大化总能效。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提方案在保持相对较高可达速率和可接受计算复杂度的同时，能显著提升系统总能效。
AI.conclusion: 基于MCMF的ARFA方案可作为提升6G无蜂窝毫米波大规模MIMO上行系统能效的有效手段，在能效、速率与复杂度之间取得良好折中。

title: UDHRBench: Benchmarking Human Rights in Large Language Models
comment: Alak Raad and Noreldin Morssy contributed equally to this work
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring adherence to ethical and legal norms, yet their alignment with internationally recognized human rights standards remains underexplored. We introduce UDHRBench, a large-scale benchmark for operationalising the evaluation of large language model compliance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The dataset comprises 1,124 human rights confronting questions covering all 30 articles and 4,496 responses from four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Fanar), manually annotated by experts for alignment, with high inter-annotator agreement ($κ= 0.801$). Our analysis reveals systematic and non-trivial misalignments, showing that violations typically arise through seemingly rational reasoning: appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality, rather than explicit rejection of rights. We further propose an LLM-as-a-Judge framework for automated evaluation using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, achieving 89.8\% weighted F1-score in detecting human-rights misalignment, alongside a novel Alignment Leniency Score that quantifies how judge models resolve ambiguous cases. The dataset, annotations, and code will be released as open-source resources (https://sina.birzeit.edu/UDHRBench).

AI.tldr: 论文提出UDHRBench基准，用于评估大语言模型对《世界人权宣言》的合规程度，发现模型存在系统性错位，并构建了自动评判框架。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益应用于需遵守伦理与法律规范的场景，但其与国际公认人权标准的一致性尚未被充分研究，缺乏可操作化的评估工具。
AI.method: 构建UDHRBench基准，包含1,124个涉及人权冲突的问题，覆盖全部30条条款，以及来自ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini和Fanar四个模型的4,496条回答，由专家人工标注对齐情况（标注者间一致性κ=0.801）；并提出基于零样本与少样本提示的LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估框架，以及量化歧义案例判定倾向的Alignment Leniency Score。
AI.result: 分析揭示了系统且非平凡的错位现象：违规通常源于看似理性的推理（如诉诸效率、风险管理或科学中立），而非明确否定人权；自动评判框架在检测人权错位方面达到89.8%的加权F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可操作的人权合规评估基准与方法，数据集、标注和代码将作为开源资源发布。

title: SPARE: Shared Perception and Adaptive Retrieval of Evidence for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions from the observed video, with evidence drawn from recent observations or earlier events. Historical context can improve recall but may interfere with judgments based on recent frames. Its usefulness depends on both when it is introduced and which clips are selected, while relevance alone does not guarantee sufficient evidence for an answer. We propose SPARE, a framework that combines adaptive historical retrieval with visual encoder sharing. A lightweight gate predicts whether recent observations provide sufficient evidence to answer the question. When additional evidence is predicted to be necessary, a multimodal embedding model retrieves relevant historical clips to supplement the current context. LoRA instruction tuning trains the understanding model to use recent observations and retrieved history jointly and abstain when the evidence remains insufficient. To reduce redundant visual parameters, the understanding and retrieval branches share a visual encoder while retaining separate language backbones. Four linear adapters align the shared features with the retrieval model through distillation at the visual token and final retrieval embedding levels. With visual-only inputs, SPARE achieves 77.78% on the evaluated Real-time and Backward task groups of OVO-Bench and 73.31% on StreamingBench. Compared with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluated at 2 fps, SPARE improves accuracy by 20.68 percentage points on OVO-Bench and 14.15 percentage points on StreamingBench.

AI.tldr: SPARE：结合自适应历史检索与视觉编码器共享的流式视频理解框架，在OVO-Bench与StreamingBench上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需基于近期帧作答，历史上下文虽有助于回忆但可能干扰近期证据判断；其价值取决于引入时机与所选片段，且仅靠相关性不保证证据充分。
AI.method: 轻量门控预测近期观测是否足够；不足时用多模态嵌入模型检索相关历史片段；LoRA指令微调使模型联合利用近期观测与检索历史，并在证据不足时弃答；理解与检索分支共享视觉编码器但保留独立语言骨干，通过视觉token级与最终检索嵌入级的蒸馏，用四个线性适配器对齐共享特征。
AI.result: 仅视觉输入下，OVO-Bench的Real-time与Backward任务组达77.78%，StreamingBench达73.31%；相比2 fps评测的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，分别提升20.68与14.15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应历史检索与视觉编码器共享，SPARE在保持参数高效的同时显著增强流式视频问答能力。

title: Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery
summary: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. The selected concept is further used for confidence-guided test-time semantic stabilization. By coupling attribute-level semantic alignment with relational concept grounding, SEGA transforms anonymous test-time clusters into interpretable semantic concepts. Experiments show that SEGA improves TTD baselines with the promise of semantic grounding for open-world.

AI.tldr: SEGA 提出属性语义锚定的视觉-语义空间与关系语义 grounding 机制，将测试时发现的新类从匿名的聚类标签转化为可解释的语义概念。
AI.motivation: 现有 Test-Time Discovery (TTD) 方法依赖视觉聚类或原型比较，只能为发现的新类分配匿名标签，在开放世界应用中缺乏可解释性。论文旨在为测试时发现的新类赋予可理解的语义概念。
AI.method: SEGA 框架：1) 利用大语言模型为已知类生成属性丰富的描述，训练时构建属性锚定的视觉-语义空间；2) 测试时提出关系语义 Grounding (RSG)，用相似与不相似的已知类锚点对未知样本进行 grounding，提示 LLM 生成候选概念并在学习到的语义空间中重排序；3) 将选定概念用于置信度引导的测试时语义稳定化。整体耦合属性级语义对齐与关系概念 grounding。
AI.result: 实验表明 SEGA 在 TTD 基线上取得提升，并展现了语义 grounding 在开放世界场景中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 通过属性级语义对齐与关系概念 grounding 的结合，SEGA 将测试时匿名聚类转化为可解释的语义概念，为开放世界 TTD 提供了语义 grounding 的新范式。

title: Variance Fingerprints: Component-Wise Identification of Content Factors by Augmentation Design
summary: Augmentation-based self-supervised learning can recover the content shared across views without separating its underlying factors into individual coordinates. We ask whether augmentations can be designed to make those factors identifiable. Our approach allows content factors to fluctuate across augmented views while preserving their mean for each source instance. Each instance receives a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths that controls how much its factors fluctuate. When factors respond differently to changes in these strengths, their patterns of variation provide information that distinguishes them. Under suitable decoder and support assumptions, we prove that these differences identify individual factors in a conditional Gaussian model, up to permutation, scaling, and translation. We then develop a learner that uses the recorded strengths to estimate these patterns jointly across instances, enabling learning from few views per instance. Synthetic experiments demonstrate near-perfect factor recovery through nonlinear mixing. Controlled dSprites experiments show improved coordinate alignment using augmentations that target known factors, even without telling the learner which augmentation corresponds to which representation coordinate. These results suggest a route to component identification in self-supervised learning: augmentation design can supply identifying information beyond shared content alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否通过设计数据增强使自监督学习中的潜在因子可辨识，提出让因子在各增强视图间波动但保持均值不变，并记录增强强度以提供辨识信息，理论证明了条件高斯模型下因子可辨识，实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 基于增强的自监督学习通常只能恢复跨视图共享的内容，而无法将其潜在因子分解到各个独立坐标，即因子不可辨识。作者希望探究能否通过精心设计的数据增强，使这些潜在因子变得可辨识，从而突破仅靠共享内容无法辨识单个因子的局限。
AI.method: 提出一种增强方案：允许内容因子在各增强视图间波动，但保持每个源实例的因子均值不变。每个实例分配一组固定且被记录的增强强度，用以控制其因子的波动幅度；当因子对这些强度变化有不同响应时，其变化模式即可区分不同因子。在合适的解码器与支撑集假设下，于条件高斯模型中对因子可辨识性（至多排列、缩放和平移）进行理论证明；并开发了一个学习器，利用记录的增强强度跨实例联合估计这些变化模式，从而支持每个实例仅需少量视图的学习。
AI.result: 合成实验展示了通过非线性混合实现近乎完美的因子恢复；在受控的 dSprites 实验中，即使不告知学习器哪种增强对应哪个表示坐标，使用针对已知因子的增强也能改善坐标对齐。
AI.conclusion: 增强设计能够提供超越共享内容之外的辨识信息，为自监督学习中的分量辨识提供了一条可行路径。

title: Timing Misalignment and Its Impact on OTFS and Other Delay-Based Waveforms
comment: Published in: IEEE Transactions on Communications. Date of Publication: 01 September 2026. Volume: 74. Page(s): 13657 - 13671. no ISSUE number is shown yet
summary: The shift towards 6G wireless networks calls for advanced waveforms to support emerging applications such as ultra-reliable and massive machine-type communications. Among the proposed candidates, OTFS, ODDM, OTSM, and OCDM share the common feature of exploiting the delay domain for data transmission. While these waveforms offer significant advantages in high-mobility and sensing scenarios, their integration into multi-user uplink systems reveals a critical challenge: timing misalignment (TM). Unlike OFDM, where residual timing offsets translate into phase rotations, delay-based waveforms experience actual shifts of resources, whose impact we investigate in this work. We show that the aforementioned waveforms can be unified under a time-invariant setup through a common input--output relation, which enables a unified analysis of TM in uplink resource allocation. The results reveal a fundamental trade-off between interference mitigation and guard overhead in the presence of TM. We further benchmark the observed behavior against OFDM under Doppler spread as a reference impairment and highlight the analogy between TM in delay-based allocation and Doppler spread in frequency-based allocation. The results show that delay-based waveforms can maintain a net performance advantage over OFDM in the considered setup. Beyond this unified Doppler-free analysis, we evaluate the joint impact of Doppler spread and TM on each waveform individually. We also investigate BER performance and show how coding can mitigate the resulting interference. This study therefore establishes a problem framework that motivates the development of future compensation and scheduling strategies for practical multi-user operation of delay-based waveforms.

AI.tldr: 该文研究6G候选延迟域波形（OTFS、ODDM、OTSM、OCDM）在多用户上行系统中的定时失配（TM）问题，通过统一输入输出关系分析TM影响，揭示干扰抑制与保护开销的权衡，并表明延迟域波形相对OFDM具有净性能优势。
AI.motivation: 6G需支持超可靠与大规模机器类通信，OTFS、ODDM、OTSM、OCDM等延迟域波形在高移动性与感知场景具优势，但其多用户上行集成面临定时失配（TM）这一关键挑战。与OFDM中残余定时偏移仅表现为相位旋转不同，延迟域波形中TM会导致资源的实际移位，其影响尚待深入研究。
AI.method: 将上述波形统一到时不变框架下，通过共同的输入-输出关系实现上行资源分配中TM的统一分析；以OFDM在多普勒扩展下的表现为参考基准进行对比；在无多普勒的统一分析之外，逐一评估多普勒扩展与TM对各波形的联合影响，并考察BER性能及编码对干扰的缓解作用。
AI.result: 揭示了TM存在时干扰抑制与保护开销之间的根本权衡；发现延迟域分配中的TM与频域分配中的多普勒扩展具有类比关系；在所考虑的设置下，延迟域波形相对OFDM可保持净性能优势；编码能够缓解由此产生的干扰。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个问题框架，为延迟域波形实际多用户运行中的未来补偿与调度策略开发提供了动机与基础。

title: SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 36 pages, 5 figures, 33 tables. Code: https://github.com/XingjianZhang-dev/safe-kv
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.

AI.tldr: 该论文将非前缀KV缓存复用形式化为行为保持问题，提出SAFE-KV方法通过重编码因果后缀修复组合缓存，实验证明其可将答案保持率恢复至98-100%，并确立了非前缀复用的因果状态契约。
AI.motivation: RAG在多请求间复用相同文档，使得非前缀KV缓存复用具有吸引力。但缓存的文档状态并非可直接复用的文本，而是上下文条件化的因果状态，其键和值依赖于计算时的前缀、位置及前序文档，因此直接复用组合缓存会导致行为偏离完整预填充的参考结果。
AI.method: 将非前缀KV复用形式化为以精确提示的完整预填充为参考的行为保持问题，提出SAFE-KV：通过从选定的起始文档重新编码因果后缀来修复组合缓存，并采用风险引导的K2选择策略进行修复起点选择。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，前缀条件化组合仅保留47.2%的HotpotQA-500和37.8%的2Wiki-500完整预填充答案；SAFE-KV配合风险引导K2选择在donor-copy协议下恢复99.8%/98.4%，使用实际后缀前向时达100.0%/98.4%。仅文档修复和固定窗口修复恢复率远低，因为修复区域之后的文档状态仍遗漏该区域历史。无修复复用至四文档时精确，十六文档时退化，而后缀修复可恢复98-100%。
AI.conclusion: 忠实修复需重编码大部分上下文，因此在单请求L40S研究中SAFE-KV的操作规则对所有工作负载均采用完整预填充。SAFE-KV确立了非前缀复用的因果状态契约，并提供了满足该契约的经验证修复机制。

title: Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.

AI.tldr: 提出 EG-Sparse：一种免训练稀疏注意力框架，依据注意力头熵值动态调整竞争域——低熵头使用跨头分组池，高熵头保留逐行局部选择。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练稀疏注意力方法在每个查询行上固定竞争域，未考虑注意力头异质性；已有工作只关注固定域内的token重要性估计，而"域本身是否应随头自适应"这一设计维度尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: EG-Sparse 免训练框架：利用稀疏管线已计算的分数，将低熵注意力头路由至跨头分组池（grouped cross-head pool），高熵头则保留逐行局部选择（per-row local selection）。通过控制变量诊断实验，固定排序分数、仅改变竞争规则进行验证。
AI.result: 诊断实验：分组跨头选择使低熵头重构误差降低 9.8%；而强制高熵头进入全头全局池则使误差上升 7.9%。在四种配置下，EG-Sparse 相比强基线实现更高视频质量，同时降低注意力密度与 GPU 去噪延迟。机制消融显示选择性域自适应优于均匀、随机和固定域分配策略。
AI.conclusion: 竞争域自适应是质心引导免训练稀疏注意力中的一个独立设计轴，按头熵值进行选择性域分配能有效提升效率与质量。

title: MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

AI.tldr: 提出多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型MHWA，通过跨步高层上下文通道与上下文感知路由抑制自回归世界模型开环推演中的漂移累积，在参数量和计算量更少的情况下超越匹配基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归世界模型虽在样本高效决策中表现强大，但其开环推演存在随预测步数增长的漂移，导致即使规划时域较小也会出现误差累积。分层时间抽象通过缩短有效预测时域是自然可行的缓解思路，但现有分层设计引入额外的结构与概念复杂度，难以控制，且相对扁平基线的增益有限。
AI.method: MHWA（Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model）包含两个关键设计：一是跨步（strided）高层上下文通道，降低全局上下文更新频率，从而抑制复合漂移的传播；二是上下文感知路由，门控网络同时利用全局上下文与当前观测，动态重构低层专家混合（MoE）结构，实现灵活的高低层协调，缓解静态分层中常见的相互干扰。
AI.result: 在14款Atari游戏子集、仅使用10%下采样离线数据、三个训练种子的设定下，采用RLiable的seed-by-game聚合方式，MHWA（77M参数）取得IQM人类归一化分数（HNS）0.884，优于同规模JOWA-70M基线（0.529），并在参数量约为一半、每序列训练FLOPs减少70.88%的条件下，达到与JOWA-150M数值相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: MHWA以更精简的结构缓解了自回归世界模型的开环漂移问题，在性能、参数效率与计算效率之间取得更优权衡，表明多时间尺度分层与动态路由是替代静态分层、实现高效决策的有效方案。

title: The RNN Homunculus: Learning to Gate Long-Term Memory
summary: Learning long-range dependencies with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is difficult because of the vanishing gradient problem. Gated recurrent neural networks like GRUs and LSTMs address this problem and are commonly explained by their ability to create additive copy paths through time. This explanation is correct, but incomplete: useful RNN gate values must themselves be learned, which is typically done with another RNN. We study this gate-learning problem through carefully controlled sequence classification tasks. Our analysis shows that gated architectures struggle when all training samples require long-range memory and thus equally suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. We intervene by adding short-dependency samples which let gated models learn solutions that capture long-dependency samples, but also generalize across different class labels. When properly learned, gated RNNs match or even exceed the test accuracy of modern architectures like Mamba and xLSTM. Overall, our results highlight gate learning as a central part of learning long-range memory and show how training data can support this process by exposing the same task over shorter dependencies.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究门控RNN（GRU/LSTM）的"门学习"问题，指出仅靠加法拷贝路径的解释不完整；通过受控序列分类任务发现，当所有训练样本都要求长程记忆时门控结构同样受梯度消失困扰。加入短依赖样本可帮助门控模型学到可泛化的长依赖解，学好后其测试精度可匹配甚至超越Mamba、xLSTM。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为门控RNN（GRU/LSTM）通过时间上的加法拷贝路径缓解梯度消失，从而具备长程记忆能力；但该解释并不完整：有用的门值本身也需要被学习，而门的学习通常又依赖另一个RNN，因此门学习本身仍可能面临长程信用分配难题。论文旨在厘清门控结构何时真正有效、何时仍然失败。
AI.method: 采用精心控制的序列分类任务进行实验分析：构造所有训练样本均需长程记忆的场景，考察门控架构的表现；随后引入短依赖样本作为干预手段，检验其是否能帮助模型学到捕获长依赖样本的解法，并评估跨不同类别标签的泛化能力。最后将学好的门控RNN与现代架构（Mamba、xLSTM）进行测试精度对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，当全部训练样本都要求长程记忆时，门控架构仍然遭遇梯度消失问题，表现不佳；加入短依赖样本后，门控模型能够学得既能处理长依赖样本、又能跨类别标签泛化的解；在门学习充分的情况下，门控RNN的测试精度可匹配甚至超过Mamba和xLSTM。
AI.conclusion: 门学习是学习长程记忆的核心环节，而不仅是加法拷贝路径的副产物；训练数据的依赖长度分布会显著影响门能否被有效学习，通过在同一任务上暴露更短的依赖形式可以支持这一过程。该发现为理解门控RNN的能力边界及现代序列模型的设计与数据构造提供了新视角。

title: Learning or Modeling? Virtual XL-RIS Observation Reconstruction for Near-Field Sensing
summary: A passive extremely large-scale reconfigurable intelligent surface (XL-RIS) offers a position-sensitive aperture for near-field sensing, but its element-wise signals are not directly observed. Recovering this virtual RIS observation (VOR) from fewer base-station measurements requires prior information. This paper investigates when calibrated propagation geometry or paired training data provides the more effective reconstruction prior. For a common sensing operator and target signal, we develop off-grid near-field sparse parametric reconstruction (OG-NF-SPR) and compare it with compact and DenseNet-based deep reconstructors. OG-NF-SPR uses reflected-path projection for position initialization, followed by Bayesian estimation of all path gains and continuous position refinement. A causal extension incorporates temporal correlation without trajectory labels. Controlled simulations use near-field UAV tracking as an illustration and separately examine noise, position-distribution shift, calibration error, and propagation mismatch. Under matched propagation at 20 dB, OG-NF-SPR achieves approximately 67% lower reconstruction NMSE than the two nominal deep networks. At low SNR, statistical averaging is more effective than selecting a single geometric explanation. Under sufficiently strong repeatable mismatch, a same-size network trained on the mismatch family outperforms the nominal physical estimator, whereas nominal training does not provide this benefit. Temporal regularization also reduces position RMSE from 0.653 m to 0.225 m on a shared trajectory. The results relate reconstruction performance to measurement quality, calibration accuracy, and training coverage, providing guidance on when geometry can replace supervised labels and when additional data are useful.

AI.tldr: 该文研究近场XL-RIS虚拟观测(VOR)重建中，标定传播几何与配对训练数据哪种先验更有效，提出OG-NF-SPR方法并与深度重建器对比。
AI.motivation: 无源超大规模可重构智能表面(XL-RIS)提供位置敏感的孔径用于近场感知，但其逐阵元信号无法直接观测；需借助先验从较少的基站测量中恢复虚拟RIS观测(VOR)，核心问题是标定几何与配对数据哪个先验更有效。
AI.method: 面向统一感知算子与目标信号，提出离格近场稀疏参数化重建(OG-NF-SPR)：先用反射路径投影做位置初始化，再用贝叶斯估计全部路径增益并连续细化位置；并加入无需轨迹标签、利用时间相关性的因果扩展；对比紧凑网络与DenseNet深度重建器。仿真以近场无人机跟踪为例，分别考察噪声、位置分布偏移、标定误差与传播失配。
AI.result: 20 dB传播匹配下，OG-NF-SPR的重建NMSE比两个标称深度网络低约67%；低SNR时统计平均优于选取单一几何解释；在足够强的可重复失配下，用失配族训练的同等规模网络优于标称物理估计器，而标称训练无此增益；时间正则将共享轨迹上的位置RMSE从0.653 m降至0.225 m。
AI.conclusion: 重建性能与测量质量、标定精度和训练覆盖度密切相关，据此可判断何时几何可替代监督标签、何时额外数据更有用。

title: Do LLMs differentiate linguistic traits internally?: A layer-wise analysis
summary: Large language models often produce judgments that resemble human responses, but it remains unclear whether they internally capture linguistic nuances such as conventional versus idiomatic meaning. A layer-wise representational analysis was conducted on two equal-sized pre-trained models, Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-3-1B-PT, to examine whether and where these models differentiate linguistic traits from input. The analysis combined layer-wise probing with geometric distance measures, using the top embedding dimensions ranked by principal component loadings for each layer. The results show that even with equal capacity, models organize linguistic information in fundamentally different ways, suggesting the need to analyze internal representational geometry, examining not just behavioral outputs but semantic space alignment when evaluating how closely human and model language interpretation correspond.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过逐层表征分析比较Llama-3.2-1B与Gemma-3-1B-PT，发现同等规模模型以不同方式组织语言信息，指出评估人机语言理解对应性需考察内部表征几何而非仅行为输出。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常产生与人类相似的判断，但其内部是否真正捕捉了字面义与习语义等语言细微差别尚不明确。
AI.method: 对两个参数量相同的预训练模型（Llama-3.2-1B与Gemma-3-1B-PT）进行逐层表征分析，结合逐层探针（layer-wise probing）与几何距离度量，并使用按主成分载荷排序的各层top嵌入维度。
AI.result: 即使容量相同，两个模型组织语言信息的方式存在根本差异。
AI.conclusion: 评估人类与模型语言解释的对应程度时，需分析内部表征几何，不仅看行为输出，还要考察语义空间对齐。

title: CAST-ASD: Causal Attention over Speakers and Time for Online Active Speaker Detection
summary: We present CAST-ASD (Causal Attention over Speakers and Time), a causal joint model for active speaker detection (ASD). Recent ASD models improve performance by jointly processing all faces in a scene, but operate offline, with the full clip available before any frame is labelled. Low-latency causal detectors instead process each face independently. CAST-ASD combines joint face reasoning with fully causal inference. It applies scene-level attention across faces within the current frame and causal temporal attention over each face's history, enabling information sharing across speakers with zero lookahead. Its parameter count does not grow with the number of faces. On MSDWild, where most negative face-frames contain a visible competing speaker, CAST-ASD reduces competing-speaker false alarms by 32% relative to the causal per-face detector it extends, with larger gains as scene occupancy increases. It outperforms all causal baselines on both validation splits while using only one-tenth the inter-speaker parameters of a three-block fixed-roster convolution. Code and models are available at https://github.com/prathamg007/CAST-ASD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST-ASD，一种用于主动说话人检测（ASD）的因果联合模型，将场景级联合人脸推理与完全因果（无前瞻）推理结合，在低延迟约束下显著降低竞争说话人误报。
AI.motivation: 现有ASD模型通过联合处理场景中所有人脸来提升性能，但需离线运行，须在标注任何帧前获得完整片段；而低延迟因果检测器则独立处理每张人脸，牺牲了跨说话人的信息共享。因此需要一种兼顾联合推理与完全因果（零前瞻）推理的方法。
AI.method: CAST-ASD在当前帧内对人脸施加场景级注意力，并对每张人脸的历史施加因果时序注意力，实现跨说话人信息共享且零前瞻。其参数数量不随人脸数增长。
AI.result: 在MSDWild上（多数负样本人脸帧含可见的竞争说话人），相比其所扩展的因果逐人脸检测器，CAST-ASD将竞争说话人误报降低32%，且随场景占用率增加增益更大。在两个验证划分上均优于所有因果基线，而说话人间参数仅为三块固定名册卷积的十分之一。
AI.conclusion: CAST-ASD证明了在完全因果、低延迟约束下也能实现场景级联合人脸推理，在不随人脸数增长参数的前提下有效降低竞争说话人误报，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems
summary: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

AI.tldr: 提出工具增强策略智能体（TASA），通过总结并利用优化轨迹提升LLM优化质量。
AI.motivation: OPRO直接利用大语言模型以自然语言提示生成候选解，但其优化过程难以追踪，导致LLM无法捕获历史迭代中累积的有用信息，从而限制了最终解的质量。
AI.method: TASA基于优化轨迹规划每一步策略，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择；利用LLM构建问题专用工具，并引入策略引导的自适应工具规划器，高效利用轨迹信息更新解。同时建立了持续探索下的局部收敛性分析。
AI.result: 在共享的候选-评估预算下评估完整框架，结果验证了其解质量以及策略引导搜索的可追踪性。
AI.conclusion: TASA通过轨迹总结与策略化分解，克服OPRO过程不可追踪的局限，在同等预算下兼具更优解质量与可追踪搜索。

title: Layer-wise Input Recoverability in Deep Neural Networks
summary: The inner workings of deep neural networks are still not well understood. The information bottleneck framework, which characterizes deep networks by the mutual information between their hidden representations and the network's input, has been used to identify compression of input information with respect to an input image and output labels. We instead study how much of a layer's own input is recoverable from the layer's output in convolutional neural networks (CNNs). A convolutional layer applies its filters to one input patch at a time, so we evaluate recoverability on sampled input patches with a reconstruction-based probe and not on the entire feature map. The probe's size thus depends on channels and kernel size and not on feature map size, which lets our method scale to deep CNNs with wide feature maps. For each layer, we compare pretrained, random, and reconstruction-optimized encoders, using linear and linear-plus-residual-MLP decoders. We measure recoverability as $R^2$ between input patches and their reconstructions on a held-out set. Across nine ImageNet CNNs, recoverability generally decreases with depth but is more consistently predicted by the compression of the layer. Learning-attributed recoverability, the difference between pretrained and random encoders, is not uniform across architectures. We introduce single-property random controls, which transfer one pretrained property onto a random encoder, and find that each control changes recoverability with a consistent sign across models: copying pretrained singular vectors tends to raise recoverability, while copying the pretrained singular-value spectrum or activation sparsity lowers it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究CNN中单层输出对其自身输入的可恢复性，提出基于采样的输入块重建探针，发现可恢复性随深度下降，且与层的压缩程度更一致相关，并揭示不同单属性随机控制对可恢复性有方向一致的影响。
AI.motivation: 深层网络的内部机制尚不清楚。信息瓶颈框架通常用隐藏表示与网络输入/输出标签的互信息来刻画网络，但本文希望换一个角度：研究CNN中某一层输出能在多大程度上恢复该层自身的输入，从而更直接地理解层内信息保留与压缩。
AI.method: 由于卷积层逐块应用滤波器，作者在采样的输入块上评估可恢复性，而非整张特征图，因此探针规模只依赖通道数与核大小，不依赖特征图尺寸，可扩展到宽特征图的深层CNN。对每一层，比较预训练、随机和重建优化的编码器，并使用线性与线性加残差MLP解码器，以留出集上输入块与其重建之间的R²衡量可恢复性。还引入单属性随机控制，将预训练的一个属性迁移到随机编码器上以分离各因素的影响。
AI.result: 在九个ImageNet CNN上，可恢复性总体随深度增加而下降，但由层的压缩程度预测得更一致；学习相关可恢复性（预训练与随机编码器之差）在不同架构间并不均匀。单属性随机控制显示，各控制对可恢复性的影响符号在模型间一致：复制预训练奇异向量倾向于提高可恢复性，而复制预训练奇异值谱或激活稀疏性则降低可恢复性。
AI.conclusion: 卷积层的自输入可恢复性可被高效测量并随深度下降，且与压缩关系更稳定；学习带来的可恢复性变化依赖架构，而奇异向量、奇异值谱和激活稀疏性等单属性对可恢复性具有方向一致的作用，为理解CNN内部信息处理提供了新的剖析视角。

title: Shuf-Scatter: Permutation-Based DLI Suppression for OFDM Ambient Backscatter
summary: Direct Link Interference (DLI) remains a major bottleneck in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM)-based Ambient Backscatter Communication (AmBC) systems. This letter proposes Shuf-Scatter, a scheme that applies a deterministic permutation to the reflected OFDM waveform to create a distinct correlation-domain signature. By exploiting the quasi-orthogonality between the reshuffled backscatter signal and the direct-link component, the proposed receiver effectively mitigates DLI and enables reliable detection without requiring dedicated spectral resources, or instantaneous Backscatter-Link (BL) Channel State Information (CSI). Analytical and simulation results demonstrate that Shuf-Scatter achieves superior Bit Error Rate (BER) performance under strong DLI while preserving the integrity of the legacy OFDM transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Shuf-Scatter 方案，通过对反射 OFDM 波形施加确定性置换，在相关域构造独特签名，利用其与直连链路的准正交性抑制直连干扰（DLI），无需专用频谱资源或瞬时反向散射链路 CSI 即可实现可靠检测，并在强 DLI 下获得更优 BER 性能。
AI.motivation: 在基于 OFDM 的环境反向散射通信（AmBC）系统中，直连干扰（DLI）是主要瓶颈，严重制约反向散射信号的可靠检测。
AI.method: Shuf-Scatter 对反射的 OFDM 波形施加确定性置换（deterministic permutation），从而在相关域生成区别于直连分量的唯一签名；接收端利用重排后反向散射信号与直连分量之间的准正交性来抑制 DLI。该方案不需要专用频谱资源，也不依赖瞬时反向散射链路（BL）信道状态信息（CSI）。
AI.result: 解析与仿真结果表明，Shuf-Scatter 在强 DLI 条件下取得更优的误比特率（BER）性能，同时保持原有 OFDM 传输的完整性。
AI.conclusion: Shuf-Scatter 通过置换与相关域准正交机制有效缓解 DLI，为 AmBC 系统提供了一种低开销（无需专用频谱与瞬时 BL CSI）、高可靠且对传统 OFDM 传输友好的检测方案。

title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 37 pages, 1 figure, 22 tables. M. Yigit Turali and Shreyas Rajesh contributed equally
summary: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PANINI-DR，一个将"整体调查协调"与"子问题研究与验证"分离的多智能体框架，借助基于生成语义工作区（Generative Semantic Workspace）的共享工作区记录子问题、依赖、发现与证据，并由独立验证智能体对答案进行核查；在 BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES、MoNaCo 上以统一骨干与冻结语料评测，取得最佳平均表现，BrowseComp-Plus 达 73.3% 准确率，领先次优框架 16.0 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 深度研究需要串联搜索、推理与计算的多个步骤，并由中间发现引导后续调查。随着调查规模扩大，智能体必须在多次模型调用间维持研究状态，并在错误传播到下游之前对发现进行核查，而现有框架在状态保持与证据验证方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出 PANINI-DR 多智能体 harness：将整体调查协调与单个子问题的研究/验证解耦。构建基于 Generative Semantic Workspace 表示的共享工作区，记录子问题、其依赖关系、发现及支撑证据。研究者智能体负责具体子问题调查，独立的验证智能体依据子问题及其证据检查所提答案；验证反馈引导进一步调查，已记录的发现用于指导后续任务分配。在 BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES、MoNaCo 上，与七种先进深度研究 harness 在共享语言模型骨干与冻结语料下对比，并进行消融分析及证据保留/可恢复性分析。
AI.result: 在三项基准上取得最强平均性能。BrowseComp-Plus 上准确率 73.3%，超出次优 harness 16.0 个百分点，且在困难问题上优势最大，回答量接近次优 harness 的两倍。消融实验表明结构化规划、持久状态以及"复用前对每条发现与其引用证据进行核查"均带来性能提升。PANINI-DR 在三项基准上从保存证据中获得最高的答案可恢复性，互补的主张—支持审计显示其答案具有更强的证据支撑；将证据因素纳入考量后，各 harness 的相对比较发生变化，PANINI-DR 的优势进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 分离协调与子问题研究/验证、并以结构化共享工作区维持持久研究状态和证据核查，是提升深度研究智能体性能与可验证性的有效设计；其增益在困难问题和证据可追溯性方面尤为显著。

title: HumanPhys: A Human-Centric Physical-World Perception Benchmark for Real-World Visual Reasoning
summary: We introduce HumanPhys, a human-centric benchmark for real-world physical perception, and a training corpus emitted by the same pipeline. Each question targets a physically grounded quantity related to people, including depth, inter-person distance, gaze angle, displacement, velocity, heading-step trajectory, blink count, and contact-deformation strength. The rendered probes additionally test illumination inference from body and face cues and camera ego-motion, both with and without a person in the frame. All labels are derived programmatically from sensor calibration, source metadata, or renderer state, rather than written by annotators or produced by estimators on the benchmark frames. HumanPhys systematically probes six dimensions of human-centric physical perception: spatial state, kinematics, blink events, deformation, illumination, and camera pose. To the best of our knowledge, no existing MLLM benchmark-and-training corpus jointly supervises this set of human-centered physical quantities under direct metadata- or renderer-derived labels. The six dimensions appear only partially dissociable across the tested MLLMs. We benchmark a range of open- and closed-source MLLMs on HumanPhys and find that all six capability dimensions remain challenging for current models. We hope HumanPhys will support future research on multimodal systems that perceive and reason about people in the physical world.

AI.tldr: HumanPhys是一个以人为中心的真实物理感知基准及配套训练语料，覆盖六个物理感知维度，标签全部由传感器标定、元数据或渲染器状态程序化生成而非人工标注，实验表明现有MLLM在全部六个维度上仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM缺乏针对"人在物理世界中"的物理量感知评测；已有基准既未联合监督这一组以人为中心的物理量，也缺少由元数据/渲染器直接导出的、非标注者或估计器生成的标签。
AI.method: 构建HumanPhys基准与同管线生成的训练语料，问题针对深度、人际距离、注视角度、位移、速度、朝向-步态轨迹、眨眼次数、接触形变强度等物理量，并测试基于身体与面部线索的光照推断及相机自运动（有/无人在画面）。标签通过传感器标定、源元数据或渲染器状态程序化导出。系统探测六个维度：空间状态、运动学、眨眼事件、形变、光照、相机位姿。随后对多种开源与闭源MLLM进行基准测试。
AI.result: 六个能力维度在受测MLLM间仅部分可分离；所有六个维度对当前模型仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: HumanPhys为多模态系统感知与推理物理世界中的人提供支持，推动相关未来研究。

title: SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability
summary: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE（能量分层分组与自适应比特拆分）的低比特权重量化方法，用于大语言模型部署。方法包含能量分层分组（ESG）与自适应比特拆分（ABS）两个组件，在2比特设置下达到最优性能，并在Qwen3-30B-A3B上保留BF16平均分数的95.3%，配合定制CUDA核实现最高2.55倍加速。
AI.motivation: 极端低比特权重量化可降低大语言模型部署成本。在低于3比特时，标量量化精度损失严重，而向量量化（VQ）通过更具表达力的联合编码更好保持精度。但现有VQ方法在真实任务上仍存在明显退化，且有两个设计问题未被充分探索：（1）如何在联合编码的向量内保护敏感的权重通道；（2）如何在固定比特预算下，在方向与半径等表示分量之间分配比特，以适配不同权重矩阵。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy）仅权重量化向量量化方法。第一，能量分层分组（ESG）将通道分组与激活加权拟合相结合，在每个子向量中纳入来自不同能量层的通道，以优先保护敏感通道。第二，自适应比特拆分（ABS）在固定预算下按矩阵平衡方向码本容量与半径精度，选择激活加权重构误差最低的拆分方案。此外设计了定制CUDA核以支持推理加速。
AI.result: 在涵盖知识、数学、代码生成、指令跟随与工具使用的多个基准上，SAGE在2比特量化设置下取得最先进性能。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，保留了BF16模型平均基准分数的95.3%。配合定制CUDA核，SAGE相较FP16实现了最高2.55倍的非流式端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过能量分层分组与自适应比特拆分，有效缓解了极低比特下向量量化的敏感通道保护与比特分配问题，在2比特设定下达到SOTA精度并保持较高部署效率，代码已开源。

title: Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots
summary: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出DySCOVER自监督框架，让机器人通过"好奇心"驱动的主动交互采集经验来提升视觉学习，实验证明在视觉好奇心基础上加入预测好奇心能持续改善视觉表征学习。
AI.motivation: 人类和动物并非从固定数据集学习视觉，而是通过移动、交互并从自身动作的视觉后果中学习。作者受此发展性观点启发，探究机器人能否通过好奇心驱动的主动交互收集经验来改进视觉学习。
AI.method: DySCOVER包含三个组件：(1)视觉自编码器，对RGB帧进行编码与重构；(2)循环世界模型，以当前状态和动作为条件预测下一视觉潜状态；(3)策略仅用内在奖励训练——重构误差鼓励视觉新颖的观察，世界模型预测误差鼓励后果尚不可预测的转移。该预测误差使策略偏向更复杂、更丰富的轨迹，从而获得超越单纯视觉新颖性的经验。
AI.result: 以机械臂作为具身智能体的实验表明，在视觉好奇心之外加入预测好奇心可提升视觉模型性能。在初始条件、经验容量、具身形态和场景内容等多种变化下，加入预测好奇心均能持续改善视觉学习。
AI.conclusion: 预测好奇心能够超越仅基于重构的好奇心，进一步促进主动视觉学习，验证了主动交互式视觉学习的有效性。

title: Link Both Views: Cross-Image Routing Attention for Dual-Endpoint V2I Beam-Pair Power Prediction
summary: For sensing-aided communications, single-endpoint sensing offers only a partial view of propagation, motivating link-centric sensing across both endpoints. We propose cross-image routing attention (CIRA) for sparse association and mutual enhancement of propagation-relevant features from dual-endpoint RGB images. Building on CIRA, CiFormer predicts millimeter-wave (mmWave) beam-pair power matrices for vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communications. Experiments show that CiFormer reduces mean absolute error and improves top-1 beam-pair selection accuracy by 3.15 percentage points over the strongest baseline. Visualizations and ablation studies support dual-endpoint sensing and selective cross-view interaction in capturing propagation-relevant dependencies, suggesting broader applications in wireless tasks beyond beam prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出跨图像路由注意力CIRA及CiFormer，利用双端RGB图像进行V2I毫米波波束对功率矩阵预测。
AI.motivation: 单端感知只能获得传播环境的局部视图，因此需要在通信链路两端进行链路中心感知，以更全面刻画传播特性。
AI.method: 提出跨图像路由注意力（CIRA），用于双端RGB图像中传播相关特征的稀疏关联与相互增强；基于CIRA构建CiFormer，预测V2I毫米波波束对功率矩阵。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，CiFormer降低平均绝对误差，并将Top-1波束对选择准确率提升3.15个百分点；可视化与消融实验验证了双端感知和选择性跨视角交互的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双端感知与选择性跨视角交互有助于捕捉传播相关依赖关系，并可拓展至波束预测之外的更广泛无线任务。

title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
summary: We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%. It also reduces average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k. Sequent-Prover agents give answers backed by executable formal artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出Sequent-Prover智能体家族及其训练框架，智能体在可执行SMT-LIB草稿本中推理并调用Z3求解器，采用验证器条件轨迹蒸馏进行后训练，在37个基准上大幅提升准确率与可靠性，同时降低求解调用与token消耗。
AI.motivation: 使语言模型智能体能够给出有可执行形式化产物支撑的答案，提高推理的正确性、可靠性与语义忠实度，同时降低求解调用与token开销。
AI.method: 1) 智能体在可执行的SMT-LIB scratchpad中推理，编写完整SMT-LIB程序、多轮查询Z3、检查求解器反馈、修复形式化并以明确答案终止；2) 提出"验证器条件轨迹蒸馏"训练方法：从含噪教师策略采样多轮轨迹，保留正确、非平凡、有依据且可执行的"成功尾部"，再进行监督微调与轨迹级偏好优化；3) 评估任务准确率、k样本可靠性与SMT程序质量。
AI.result: 在37个基准、每个模型族7,254道题上，后训练使4B模型的单次尝试准确率从85.6%提升至97.0%，四次采样全对可靠性（pass^4）从64.1%提升至91.7%，平均SMT调用从4.10降至2.52，每次尝试token从18.97k降至12.72k。
AI.conclusion: Sequent-Prover智能体能够提供由可执行形式化产物支撑的答案，验证器条件轨迹蒸馏在提升准确率与可靠性的同时降低推理开销。

title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.

AI.tldr: Demiurge：基于动态4D点云记忆缓存的自回归视频重渲染管线，实现跨轨迹一致的4D世界生成。
AI.motivation: 现有单视频新视角合成方法独立处理相机轨迹，缺乏跨轨迹一致性，难以构建连贯、可导航的4D世界，限制了在世界建模、具身智能与机器人仿真中的应用。
AI.method: 四项组件：(1) 外观视频扩散模型，以4D记忆为条件合成逼真新视角视频；(2) 记忆一致的视频深度补全模型，对齐已知区域深度与缓存几何并补全缺失区域，缓解尺度歧义与不连续；(3) 记忆感知双流warping，提供高保真视觉引导与遮挡线索；(4) 几何感知视频精修，提升感知质量。
AI.result: 实验达到SOTA，并具备三项能力：在密集多视角轨迹上构建连贯时空晶格；在困难相机运动（含180度旋转、无输入视角重叠）下实现大视差重渲染；输出几何保真，可直接优化为高质量3D高斯泼溅表示且伪影极少。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态4D点云记忆缓存与记忆一致的自回归流程，Demiurge有效提升跨轨迹一致性，为可导航4D世界建模与下游3D表示优化提供可行方案。

title: Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning
summary: Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出一个评估模块化金融强化学习中信用分配的框架，结合等信息重构控制、固定效用比较与预设下游护栏，在三个控制研究中识别出三类评估失败。
AI.motivation: 模块化金融强化学习中的信用分配难以评估：归因信号可能改善组件损失，却未增加决策相关信息或改善经济结果，因此需要一套严格的评估方法来区分真实改进与虚假归因。
AI.method: 构建评估框架，包含等信息重构控制、固定效用比较和预设下游护栏；将该框架实例化于归因引导的模块化交易架构，开展三个控制研究：更新分配、监督目标表示与组合风险控制。
AI.result: 1）在披露接口下，基于残差的分配被普通损失预算控制在数值上完全复现；2）直接缺口监督提升组件预测，但无法保持解码后结果；3）在固定效用下，组件级批评者监督相对标量监督恶化风险条件确定性等价与回撤。另有一个保留的历史工程案例说明模块级学习主张需运行级溯源。
AI.conclusion: 识别出三类评估失败：冗余归因信号、表示导致的预测权衡、组件监督与下游风险结果错位。贡献在于为部分可观测、延迟反馈与经济风险约束下的专家系统信用分配评估提供可复用方法。

title: Decentralized Bandit Learning of Markov Perfect Equilibria
summary: We study decentralized bandit learning in discounted infinite-horizon, general-sum Markov games with continuous actions. Agents observe the public state, but only their own realized rewards, and use simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation to update their actions. Under strong monotonicity of the negative running-reward gradients and sufficiently small time steps, we prove that the fully decentralized procedure converges almost surely to the unique stationary Markov perfect equilibrium. We obtain an $O(n^{-1/2})$ convergence rate and present a natural extension to episodic finite-horizon learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究折扣无限时域、一般和、连续动作马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化bandit学习，证明在强单调条件下，基于SPSA的完全去中心化算法几乎必然收敛到唯一的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，收敛率为O(n^{-1/2})，并可扩展到分段有限时域学习。
AI.motivation: 现有博弈学习多依赖中心化协调或离散动作假设；本文关注连续动作、一般和马尔可夫博弈中仅能观测自身奖励的去中心化学习问题，旨在实现无需中心协调的均衡收敛。
AI.method: 智能体观测公共状态与自身实现奖励，采用同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）同时更新动作；在负运行奖励梯度强单调且时间步足够小的条件下进行分析，并自然扩展到分段有限时域学习。
AI.result: 证明完全去中心化过程几乎必然收敛到唯一的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，得到O(n^{-1/2})的收敛速率，并给出分段有限时域学习的扩展。
AI.conclusion: 在强单调性与小步长假设下，连续动作一般和马尔可夫博弈可通过完全去中心化的SPSA型bandit学习收敛到唯一平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，速率达O(n^{-1/2})，且框架可延伸至有限时域情节式设定。

title: Overcoming Catastrophic Forgetting: Continual Learning for Radar Waveform Classification
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems
summary: Automated radar waveform recognition classifies the waveform and modulation type of a received signal. As new waveform variants appear over time, a deployed classifier must learn them without retraining from scratch. Catastrophic Forgetting occurs when learning new waveforms overwrites prior knowledge. Continual Learning (CL) methods tackle this challenge, but prior radar studies only evaluate a few methods on narrow benchmarks. Practitioners lack evidence on which method to deploy or which mechanisms are effective. This work presents the first large-scale benchmark of continual learning for radar waveform recognition. Eighteen CL methods are evaluated on a sequential ten-task problem, drawn from four public datasets spanning 54 waveforms, under task- and class-incremental (TIL, CIL) settings and single- and multi-epoch regimes. Methods that retain data from old tasks lead both TIL and CIL settings. Plain replay alone closes 77-88% of the gap between the lower and upper practical limits under TIL, but only 46-55% under CIL. The internal mechanisms of the leading methods are ablated and statistically tested to identify effective mechanisms. Each ablation is paired against its full method over n=6 training seeds, topped up to n=12 when inconclusive, and p-values are Holm-Bonferroni corrected within each method's family. Ablation results show that several mechanisms confer smaller but statistically significant gains. Combining these mechanisms improves the leading F1 score by 3.4-5.5% and 2.7-4.9% under TIL and CIL, respectively, and the combined models exceed every benchmarked method in both settings for all SNRs. These results give researchers of radar waveform classification systems a mechanism-level basis for design.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对雷达波形识别中的持续学习方法进行大规模基准评测：在10任务序列、4个公开数据集、54种波形上评测18种CL方法（TIL/CIL、单/多epoch），并做机制消融与统计检验，提出机制组合使F1提升2.7-5.5%。
AI.motivation: 雷达波形识别需持续学习新波形变体，否则从头重训成本高，而新波形学习会覆盖旧知识导致灾难性遗忘。已有雷达领域研究仅在狭窄基准上评测少量CL方法，实践者缺乏"该部署哪种方法、哪些机制有效"的证据。
AI.method: 构建首个面向雷达波形识别的持续学习大规模基准：18种CL方法，10任务顺序问题，4个公开数据集共54种波形；覆盖任务增量(TIL)与类别增量(CIL)两种设置，以及单epoch与多epoch训练机制；对领先方法的内部机制进行消融，每个消融与其完整方法在n=6个训练种子（不确定时增至n=12）下配对比较，并在每个方法族内做Holm-Bonferroni多重检验校正。
AI.result: 保留旧任务数据的方法在TIL和CIL中均领先。纯replay在TIL下可弥合实际下界与上界差距的77-88%，但在CIL下仅46-55%。消融显示若干机制带来较小但统计显著的增益；组合这些机制在TIL和CIL下分别将最优F1提升3.4-5.5%和2.7-4.9%，且组合模型在所有SNR上、两种设置下均超越全部基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为雷达波形识别系统的研究者提供了机制层面的设计依据，明确了有效机制并验证了机制组合可稳定超越现有CL方法。

title: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
summary: Large language models are typically evaluated in terms of the correctness of their output. However, output correctness alone does not confirm whether the latent knowledge supporting an answer has stable internal representations. We therefore propose latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) to investigate the stability of individual knowledge states and their relational structure, respectively. Specifically, we first separately average the model's internal representations of the same knowledge under each elicitation condition. Using the mean representation under the baseline condition as a reference, we remove shared shifts to obtain corrected representations. We then formulate LSS as the distance between each corrected representation and its reference representation, normalized against the typical distance between knowledge items of the same type. We formulate KTS as the cross-condition consistency of the ordered pairwise representation distances among knowledge items of the same type. Next, we construct EpiStableBench, which comprises 4,411 items spanning factual knowledge and mathematical reasoning, with 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs from four families, representation stability varies substantially even among items answered correctly under the base condition. Within models, higher stability generally corresponds to higher accuracy under held-out elicitation conditions; across models, stability does not consistently increase with model size or overall accuracy. Meanwhile, we present LatentDPO to learn a knowledge-editing policy that accounts for the stability of latent knowledge. Experimental results show that integrating LatentDPO with multiple existing editing methods consistently improves editing success and generalization across different expressions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出潜状态稳定性（LSS）与知识拓扑稳定性（KTS）两项指标，构建EpiStableBench基准（4,411个知识项、76,766条受控查询），在16个LLM上揭示"答对≠内部表征稳定"的现象，并提出LatentDPO以提升知识编辑的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估多只看输出正确性，但答案正确并不能保证支撑该答案的潜在知识具有稳定的内部表征。因此需要刻画单个知识状态的稳定性及其知识间关系结构的稳定性，并据此改进知识编辑。
AI.method: 1) 对同一知识在各诱导条件下的内部表征分别取平均；以基线条件的均值表示为参考，去除共享偏移得到校正表征。2) LSS定义为各校正表征与其参考表征之间的距离，并用同类型知识项间的典型距离做归一化。3) KTS定义为同类型知识项之间有序成对表征距离在跨条件下的排序一致性。4) 构建EpiStableBench基准（4,411项，覆盖事实知识与数学推理，76,766条受控查询）。5) 提出LatentDPO，学习考虑潜在知识稳定性的知识编辑策略。
AI.result: 在4个模型家族的16个LLM上，即便在基线条件下答对的知识项，其表征稳定性也差异显著；模型内稳定性越高通常对应留出诱导条件下准确率越高；跨模型看，稳定性并不随模型规模或总体准确率单调提升。将LatentDPO与多种现有编辑方法结合，能一致地提升编辑成功率及在不同表述间的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 输出正确性不足以反映潜在知识的内部稳定性；LSS与KTS提供了可量化的稳定性视角，EpiStableBench支撑系统评测，而LatentDPO表明将稳定性纳入知识编辑策略可有效改善编辑效果与泛化。

title: PURE: Refining Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction with Unlabeled Post-training
comment: Accepted by ACMMM 2026. Project Page: https://funnyguy525.github.io/PURE-Page/ Github: https://github.com/jiah-cloud/PURE
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved remarkable progress through large-scale training and strong learned priors. However, they remain fragile when applied to dynamic in-the-wild videos, where non-rigid motion, occlusions, and illumination changes are prevalent. A key limitation lies in their reliance on expensive depth and camera pose annotations, which hinders scaling to diverse real-world dynamic data and restricts generalization. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PURE}, an unlabeled post-training refinement framework that improves depth and camera estimation without requiring ground-truth supervision. Instead of relying on annotations, PURE elegantly distills robust structural knowledge from state-of-the-art 2D priors into 4D feed-forward architectures. PURE leverages relative depth constraints, affine-invariant geometry distillation, and pose refinement based on feature correspondences to stabilize geometric predictions under challenging dynamic conditions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world dynamic benchmarks demonstrate that PURE delivers consistent improvements across multiple state-of-the-art architectures. Furthermore, our data-efficient paradigm effectively mitigates domain shifts, successfully unlocking the architectural limits of these base models in challenging, in-the-wild dynamic scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出PURE，一种无需标注的后训练精修框架，通过从2D先验蒸馏几何知识来提升前馈4D重建模型在动态场景下的深度与相机估计能力。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型虽有大规模训练和先验加持，但在动态真实视频中表现脆弱（非刚性运动、遮挡、光照变化），其核心瓶颈是依赖昂贵的深度与相机位姿标注，难以扩展到多样化的真实动态数据，泛化性受限。
AI.method: PURE是一种无标注后训练精修框架。它不依赖真值监督，而是将先进2D先验中的鲁棒结构知识蒸馏进4D前馈架构，具体包括：相对深度约束、仿射不变的几何蒸馏，以及基于特征对应关系的位姿精修，以在挑战性动态条件下稳定几何预测。
AI.result: 在合成与真实动态基准上的大量实验表明，PURE在多种先进架构上均取得一致的性能提升，并能有效缓解域偏移，在复杂的野外动态场景中释放基础模型的架构潜力。
AI.conclusion: PURE提供了一种数据高效、无需标注的后训练范式，可通用地增强现有前馈重建模型的动态场景鲁棒性与泛化能力，为扩展到真实动态数据提供了可行路径。

title: GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs
summary: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GateSight：利用混合语言模型中GDN层预填充阶段产生的门控/衰减/写入幅度信号预测KV条目未来效用，进而决定各注意力层保留哪些KV条目、保留多少由原生注意力输出门决定；服务时预填充后一次性打分并物理释放被丢弃KV，在十分之一KV缓存下于多个模型-基准组合中取得领先精度且开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型（GDN层与全注意力层交替）中，全注意力的KV缓存随上下文增长并主导服务显存。作者提出核心疑问：递归记忆是否已经"知道"注意力记忆将会需要什么？若成立，则可用廉价的递归层信号来指导KV缓存的裁剪，从而在不依赖查询的前提下降低服务显存。
AI.method: 1) 先验证Qwen3.8-27B中哪些GDN头保持长记忆是由权重决定而非由文档决定；2) 将KV条目的"未来效用"定义为：在模型自身续写上移除该条目对注意力输出造成的改变量；3) 发现预填充阶段GDN层的写门、衰减与写入幅度在读入任何查询前即可预见该效用；4) 因该关系分散于多个GDN头与层中，且线性映射只能恢复其趋势、对高效用尾部恢复较弱，故提出GateSight：用轻量级逐头MLP读取这些信号（不使用注意力分数）学习该关系；5) 预测效用决定每层保留哪些条目，每层保留量由模型原生注意力输出门设定（其均值跨层相差一个数量级以上）；6) 服务时在预填充后对缓存打分一次，并物理释放被丢弃的KV条目。
AI.result: 在SCBench与RULER-4096上，使用Qwen3.8-27B及同一方案的稀疏注意力模型Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，覆盖至模型262K token上限：在十分之一注意力KV缓存下，GateSight在四组模型-基准配对中的三组上为五种查询无关方法中最准确者，并在四组中均优于KVzip，提升9.5至47.2个百分点；且在完整长度上下文上的打分开销相对预填充可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 递归记忆（GDN层预填充信号）确实携带了注意力记忆未来所需的信息，可被非线性轻量MLP有效读出并用于查询无关的KV缓存选择与物理释放；结合原生注意力输出门控制保留预算，GateSight在极低KV预算下实现高精度且低开销，可作为混合/稀疏注意力模型的高效长上下文服务方案。

title: Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs
summary: We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

AI.tldr: ContinuousCloth：将弹簧-质量ODE嵌入神经轨迹模型的连续时间、物理信息神经求解器，支持任意时刻查询与自动微分求位移/速度/加速度。
AI.motivation: 经典时间步进模拟器仅在离散积分网格上返回轨迹，无法在任意时间戳查询，且在高精度求解时计算开销大；同时纯数据神经基线在稀疏、噪声观测下的插值与参数估计鲁棒性不足。因此作者希望构建兼具高精度、低运行时与强物理归纳偏置的连续时间布料动力学求解器。
AI.method: 提出 ContinuousCloth，一种连续时间、物理信息神经求解器：在神经轨迹模型中显式约束弹簧-质量ODE，从而将物理先验嵌入神经表示；通过自动微分在任意时间戳计算位移、速度与加速度。评估分两维度：纯物理设置下与高精度求解器对比轨迹精度与运行时；在与稀疏、含噪观测融合时，将弹簧-质量ODE作为归纳偏置用于插值与参数估计，并与纯数据神经基线及可微求解器基线比较。
AI.result: 纯物理设置：在六种不同边界条件场景下轨迹精度与高精度求解器相当，运行时最多减少17.4倍。融合稀疏含噪观测：插值误差相比纯数据神经基线在仿真中降低7.3倍，在真实布料序列上降低2.4倍；高噪声条件下参数误差比可微求解器基线低2.6倍，在真实测量缺陷下表现出一致鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ContinuousCloth验证了将弹簧-质量ODE嵌入连续时间神经轨迹模型可在保持高精度轨迹的同时显著降低运行时，并在稀疏含噪观测下作为强归纳偏置提升插值与参数估计的鲁棒性，适用于真实测量不完美的场景。

title: A Three-Axis Rydberg Atomic Receiver Model for Polarization-Based Direction-of-Arrival Sensing
summary: This paper develops a three-axis Rydberg atomic receiver model for direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation of the radio frequency (RF) signal source. Three nominally orthogonal RF local oscillators (LOs), each assigned a distinct frequency offset, project the weak incident RF field into resolvable complex beat coefficients in the optical readout. A beat-vector observation is obtained by adopting a response calibration mechanism that maps the coefficients onto the three axes of the Cartesian coordinate system. For a known circularly polarised RF signal, this observation induces a direction-dependent Rydberg steering vector, enabling maximum-likelihood DoA estimation. The pro posed procedure translates the Rydberg beat-vector front end into a highly sensitive RF field DoA sensor. Simulation results show that trace-level beat extraction supports the proposed DoA sensing workflow and provides a basis for comparison with a traditional vector antenna (VA) benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文构建三轴里德堡原子接收机模型，通过三正交且带频偏的射频本振将微弱入射场映射为可分辨复拍频系数，经响应校准得到拍频矢量观测，实现基于最大似然的来波方向估计。
AI.motivation: 里德堡原子具有高灵敏度，可作射频场前端；但将其用于来波方向（DoA）估计仍需解决多轴探测与矢量观测构建问题，故提出三轴接收机模型以将拍频前端转化为高灵敏DoA传感器。
AI.method: 设置三个标称正交的射频本振，各赋不同频偏，将弱入射射频场投影为光学读出中可分辨的复拍频系数；采用响应校准机制将系数映射到笛卡尔坐标三轴，形成拍频矢量观测。对已知圆极化射频信号，该观测产生方向相关的里德堡导向矢量，进而用最大似然法估计DoA。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，痕量级拍频提取可支撑所提DoA感知流程，并与传统矢量天线（VA）基准进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 该三轴里德堡原子接收机模型可将拍频前端转化为高灵敏射频场DoA传感器，仿真验证了痕量级拍频提取下DoA估计流程的可行性，并提供与矢量天线的对比基础。

title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 19 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project liberal-democratic assumptions, or rely on coarse stereotypes. Our results demonstrate that linguistic similarity alone does not guarantee sociocultural or domain-specific understanding, highlighting the critical need for grounded evaluation resources for underrepresented cultural and political contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出LENS基准（1765题，三维度：语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域知识），以朝鲜为低资源社会语言学测试场景评估LLM，发现语言差距小、视角对齐差距大、领域知识严重不足。
AI.motivation: LLM多语言问答进展显著，但对低资源社会语言学语境的理解能力仍缺乏探究；朝鲜与韩国因长期分隔在词汇、正字法、规范与意识形态话语上形成显著差异，是独特且未被充分评估的测试场景。
AI.method: 构建人工校验的LENS（Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society）基准，含1765个问题，覆盖语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域特定知识三个维度；对多个近期LLM进行评测并结合定性分析。
AI.result: 在北韩语言输入上性能仅有小幅下降；社会文化视角对齐存在更大差距；领域特定知识表现严重受限。定性分析显示模型常混淆正式制度与生活现实、投射自由民主预设、依赖粗粒度刻板印象。
AI.conclusion: 语言相似性并不保证社会文化或领域特定理解，凸显为代表性不足的文化与政治语境构建有据可依的评测资源的必要性。

title: PixARG: Pixel-Asynchronous Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion for Fast and Realistic Image Generation
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26) as a poster presentation
summary: While diffusion models achieve impressive image generation capabilities, they suffer from high computational costs, implausible artifacts, and limited adaptability to dynamic or private data due to static, centralized training. To address these, we propose PixARG, a novel retrieval-augmented generative framework that integrates dynamic real-world image retrieval into the diffusion pipeline to simultaneously enhance efficiency and visual realism. Specifically, PixARG constructs a pixel-level affinity map between the user's text prompt and the retrieved image to guide a heterogeneous noise initialization. By modulating noise intensity across spatial regions, this mechanism preserves semantically relevant structural priors while perturbing less relevant areas, thereby significantly accelerating convergence. To accommodate this spatially non-uniform noise and ensure synchronized generation, we introduce a pixel-wise asynchronous denoising scheduler and a spatiotemporal denoiser conditioned on the affinity map. Furthermore, we derive an affinity-adaptive training objective that elegantly balances deterministic restoration with stochastic regeneration across pixels. Experiments on LAION and COYO datasets across offline, online, and user-specific settings show PixARG enhances realism and semantic alignment while drastically reducing diffusion steps.

AI.tldr: PixARG是一个检索增强的扩散生成框架，通过将动态真实图像检索整合进扩散流程，利用像素级亲和图引导异构噪声初始化，并配套异步去噪调度器与亲和自适应训练目标，在提升真实感与语义对齐的同时大幅减少扩散步数。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型存在计算成本高、易产生不合理伪影，且因静态集中式训练而难以适应动态或私有数据的问题。本文希望同时提升效率与视觉真实感。
AI.method: PixARG在用户文本提示与检索图像之间构建像素级亲和图（affinity map），用于引导异构噪声初始化：通过跨空间区域调制噪声强度，保留语义相关的结构先验，扰动弱相关区域以加速收敛。为适配这种空间非均匀噪声并保证生成同步，提出像素级异步去噪调度器（pixel-wise asynchronous denoising scheduler）和以亲和图为条件的时空去噪器（spatiotemporal denoiser）。此外推导了亲和自适应训练目标，在像素层面平衡确定性恢复与随机再生成。
AI.result: 在LAION和COYO数据集上，涵盖离线、在线和用户特定设置，PixARG在提升真实感与语义对齐的同时大幅减少了扩散步数。
AI.conclusion: 将动态真实图像检索融入扩散流程可作为一种有效手段，兼顾生成效率与视觉真实感，并适配动态或私有数据场景。

title: CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: CUSE：基于反事实引导与在策略自蒸馏的多模态大模型遗忘框架，实现细粒度token级遗忘与保留的联合优化。
AI.motivation: MLLMs可能复现训练数据中的敏感、受版权保护或不安全信息。有效遗忘需在去除目标信息的同时保留非目标内容，甚至在同一响应内部也要区分。现有方法对完整响应施加统一的遗忘目标，依赖固定的离策略监督，导致token级控制粗糙，且与模型当前行为不一致。
AI.method: 提出CUSE框架。首先通过移除目标相关证据构建反事实输入，利用token概率的变化识别需要更强遗忘的token；然后在当前策略采样的响应上进行token级遗忘与保留目标的蒸馏，以冻结的原始模型作为教师，并辅以相应的遗忘导向和保留导向的特权上下文，从而联合决定遗忘什么与保留什么。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench上，CUSE使遗忘集ROUGE-L降低33.6%，同时保留集ROUGE-L比最强基线高1.2%。
AI.conclusion: CUSE通过反事实引导与在策略自蒸馏实现了细粒度的token级遗忘控制，在显著增强遗忘效果的同时更好地保持非目标内容。

title: On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness
summary: Scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. Establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models, avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. Existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic: hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks, and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics, a specific initialization, and feature-learning criteria. Building on $L$-smoothness framework of Xu et al. (2026), we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the Lipschitz and $L$-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth $K$? We show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling $α=Θ(1/K)$ is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width, uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary $p\to q$ geometries. Because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its Lipschitz and smoothness constants, the argument applies to general residual networks (including branches of block depth $\geq 2$ such as transformer and ResNet blocks) without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. Since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality, our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. This provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with AdamW, Muon, and MOGA. Learning-rate sweeps on GPT-2 (depths 2--128) and CIFAR-100 ResNets (8--32 residual blocks) confirm that Muon and MOGA exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions, with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 L-光滑性框架，证明逆深度残差分支缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 可使损失的 Lipschitz 与 L-光滑常数在固定宽度下与深度无关，从而为深度方向的超参数迁移提供几何解释，并在 GPT-2 与 ResNet 上验证了学习率迁移。
AI.motivation: 大规模深度模型训练需要可预测的性能迁移，以便在低成本代理模型上确定最优训练动态与结构选择，避免大规模训练的灾难性失败。然而现有的深度迁移分析多为架构特定的启发式方法：仅通过玩具模块论证超参数迁移，且依赖无限深度动态、特定初始化与特征学习准则，缺乏一般性。
AI.method: 作者沿用 Xu 等（2026）的 L-光滑性框架，将超参数迁移问题形式化为：损失的 Lipschitz 常数与 L-光滑常数如何随深度 K 缩放。在此基础上证明，采用逆深度残差分支缩放 α=Θ(1/K)，可在固定宽度下使上述两个常数与深度无关，且该结论在有界参数域上一致成立，并适用于任意 p→q 几何。由于界仅通过各残差分支自身的 Lipschitz 与光滑常数依赖该分支，论证可推广至一般残差网络（包括块深度≥2 的 Transformer 与 ResNet 块），无需初始化假设或层间权重相关性假设。进一步结合下降不等式中的曲率惩罚，导出学习率缩放规律，并应用到 AdamW、Muon、MOGA 对应的算子范数几何。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，光滑常数控制下降不等式中的曲率惩罚，因此在更新量按指定范数有界的条件下，学习率缩放无需额外的深度相关曲率修正，从而为逆深度残差缩放及 AdamW、Muon、MOGA 的算子范数几何提供了统一的几何解释。实验上，在 GPT-2（深度 2–128）与 CIFAR-100 ResNet（8–32 个残差块）上进行学习率扫描，结果显示 Muon 与 MOGA 在上述缩放下表现出稳定的学习率迁移，在深度增加 64 倍的情况下仍存在共同的最优学习率。
AI.conclusion: 逆深度残差分支缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 足以在固定宽度下使损失的 Lipschitz 与 L-光滑常数对深度保持不变，这一几何性质解释了深度方向超参数迁移的可行性；理论不依赖特定初始化或权重相关性，适用于一般残差网络，并得到 GPT-2 与 CIFAR-100 ResNet 学习率扫描实验的支持。该工作将深度迁移分析从架构特定启发式提升为更一般的光滑性理论刻画。

title: Task-evoked eye movements as candidate digital biomarkers of depression severity in adolescents and young adults
summary: Objective digital measures of depression severity could complement conventional symptom assessments and facilitate more timely clinical evaluation. Here, we investigated whether task-evoked eye movements provide interpretable behavioral markers of depression severity in adolescents and young adults. In this single-center, cross-sectional study, 155 participants aged 14--20 years completed emotional-spatial free-viewing and memory-guided recall tasks and were stratified by 17-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale scores.
