We examined 19 prespecified eye-movement features across six task-informed domains using covariate-adjusted ordinal-trend models. Greater depression severity was associated with lower gaze-allocation entropy (standardized $β=-0.599$), fewer inter-area switches ($β=-0.526$), longer first target-entry latency ($β=0.572$), and lower target dwell proportion ($β=-0.678$; all false-discovery-rate-adjusted $q<0.001$). Emotion-specific attentional-bias measures were not associated with severity, whereas associations involving fixation dispersion weakened after adjustment for anxiety symptoms. In a complementary machine-learning analysis incorporating 44 candidate eye-movement features and demographic covariates, a three-stage cascade classifier achieved the highest four-class stratification performance (accuracy, 0.665; macro-F1, 0.670; area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, 0.869), outperforming single-stage and two-stage approaches. Together, these findings identify altered visual exploration and memory-guided gaze control as candidate digital biomarkers of depression severity, rather than generalized negative attentional bias. These results support further prospective evaluation of task-evoked eye tracking as a complementary approach for timely severity assessment and clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 一项155名14–20岁青少年的横断面研究显示，任务诱发的眼动特征（注视分配熵、区域切换次数、首次目标进入潜伏期、目标注视比例）与抑郁严重度显著相关，且三阶段级联分类器可较好地实现四分类分层。
AI.motivation: 抑郁严重度的客观数字化测量可补充传统症状评估，支持更及时的临床评估；作者希望验证任务诱发眼动是否可作为青少年和青年抑郁严重度可解释的行为标记。
AI.method: 单中心横断面研究，155名14–20岁受试者完成情绪-空间自由观看与记忆引导回忆任务，按17项汉密尔顿抑郁量表分层；采用协变量校正的序数趋势模型检验6个任务相关域下19个预设眼动特征；另用包含44个候选眼动特征和人口学协变量的机器学习分析。
AI.result: 抑郁严重度越高，注视分配熵越低（标准化β=-0.599）、区域间切换越少（β=-0.526）、首次目标进入潜伏期越长（β=0.572）、目标注视比例越低（β=-0.678；均FDR校正q<0.001）；情绪特异性注意偏向指标与严重度无关联，注视离散度相关关联在校正焦虑症状后减弱。三阶段级联分类器四分类性能最佳（准确率0.665，宏F1 0.670，AUC 0.869），优于单阶段和两阶段方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出视觉探索改变和记忆引导注视控制异常是抑郁严重度的候选数字生物标志物，而非泛化的负性注意偏向；结果支持进一步前瞻性评估任务诱发眼动追踪作为及时严重度评估与临床决策支持的补充手段。

title: A Sovereign, Indic-First, Reasoning Model
summary:
Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B is a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for reasoning, instruction following, and tool use in English and eight Indian languages. Starting from NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint, it retains the 52-layer backbone and changes the vocabulary, training data, and post-training objectives. An in-place expansion from 131,072 to 163,072 tokens reduces mean Indian-language fertility by 38.6%. The new embedding rows are initialized from their upstream decompositions and warmed before the backbone is updated. Continual pretraining then adds broad English-Indic data, high-quality annealing, and direct training at a 131,072-token sequence length.
  The central result appears after post-training. Reinforcement learning across four verifiable task environments improves mathematics, graduate-level science, and instruction following, but degrades Indic extractive question answering because the rewards do not require an answer in the requested language. The share of Indic extraction items answered in English rises from 8.7% to 91.7%. Accuracy conditional on answering in the target script roughly doubles, which is consistent with preserved reading ability but is measured on a self-selected subset.
  Two unreleased studies test repairs. A scoped Indic reward restores the language convention. A 26B-A4B generative judge outperforms a 235B-parameter model on RM-Bench, and distillation restores 81% of the capabilities displaced by optimizing against it.
  Relative to the architecture-identical starting checkpoint, the released model gains 5.2 points on an Indic aggregate while giving up 1.7 points of English retention. The unreleased Indic-aware branch trades further, gaining 14.6 Indic points at a cost of 5.4 in English. A planned FP8 release reduces the artifact to 32GB with near-zero mean change across 32 paired benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍 Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B：一个面向英语与八种印度语言的长上下文混合 Mamba-Transformer MoE 模型，从 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 扩展词表并持续预训练，但发现强化学习虽提升数学、科学推理与指令遵循，却因奖励未约束目标语言而导致印度语言抽取式问答答案语言漂移，并给出多种修复方案与效果权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在多语言（尤其印度语言）推理、指令遵循与工具使用上能力不足，印度语言分词效率低（fertility 高），且后训练阶段容易出现语言一致性退化。作者希望在保留英语能力的前提下，构建一个覆盖英语与八种印度语言的长上下文 MoE 模型，并系统研究多语言强化学习中的语言漂移及其修复。
AI.method: 1) 以 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 为起点，保留 52 层骨干，改造词表、训练数据与后训练目标；2) 词表从 131,072 就地扩展至 163,072，新增嵌入行用上游分解初始化并在骨干更新前进行预热（warm-up）；3) 持续预训练：加入广泛英印双语数据、高质量退火（annealing），并直接在 131,072 上下文长度上训练；4) 后训练：在四个可验证任务环境中进行强化学习；5) 修复研究：范围受限的印度语言奖励（scoped Indic reward）、26B-A4B 生成式评判模型，以及针对评判模型的蒸馏。
AI.result: 词表就地扩展使印度语言平均 fertility 下降 38.6%。强化学习提升了数学、研究生级科学与指令遵循能力，但印度语言抽取式问答退化：用英语作答的比例从 8.7% 升至 91.7%；在目标文字作答条件下的准确率约翻倍（但基于自选择子集）。修复方面：范围受限的印度语言奖励可恢复语言约定；26B-A4B 生成式评判模型在 RM-Bench 上优于 235B 参数模型；蒸馏可恢复因优化该评判模型而损失能力的 81%。相对同架构起点模型，发布版印度语言综合指标提升 5.2 分，英语保留损失 1.7 分；未发布的印度语言感知分支进一步以 5.4 英语分换取 14.6 印度语言分。计划中的 FP8 版本将产物压缩至 32GB，32 个配对基准平均变化接近零。
AI.conclusion: 词表扩展与持续预训练可显著提升印度语言效率与综合表现，但标准多语言强化学习的奖励设计若缺少语言约束，会引发严重的语言漂移（答案转为英语），说明奖励规范需要显式覆盖目标语言。通过范围受限奖励、生成式评判模型与蒸馏，可在语言一致性与能力保持间取得平衡；同时存在明确的英印能力权衡，FP8 量化则可近乎无损地减小模型体积。

title: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
comment: 24 pages, code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE
summary: Latent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but video VAE encoding and decoding remain computationally expensive. Existing methods use stage-specific lightweight operators, yet either constrain spatial and temporal computation jointly or remove temporal computation altogether, without distinguishing their compression sensitivities in pretrained Conv3D. To address these limitations, we present LightVAE, a compression framework that exploits redundancy in temporal modeling and network depth. LightVAE exactly reparameterizes eligible causal Conv3D layers into an aggregate spatial response and a difference-driven temporal correction. Based on their distinct compression sensitivities, temporal low-rank compression (TLR) keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies layer-specific low-rank approximation only to the temporal correction. An algebraically equivalent folded implementation converts the arithmetic savings into practical acceleration. LightVAE further uses width-preserving block pruning to reduce depth and probe-guided feature alignment, guided by feedback from a frozen teacher suffix, to recover quality after compression. The framework also extends to video encoders. Across three video VAE backbones and two GPU platforms, LightVAE consistently accelerates decoding. For the Wan VAE family, it achieves up to $2.24\times$ and $1.11\times$ the decoding throughput of state-of-the-art efficient VAE decoders on NVIDIA H100 and RTX~5090, respectively, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, it achieves up to $2.97\times$ the original decoding throughput while retaining 99.51\% of the original model's overall VBench-2.0 score. Our code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE.

AI.tldr: LightVAE通过区分预训练Conv3D中空间与时间维度的压缩敏感度，对时间修正项做低秩压缩并配合宽度保持块剪枝与探针引导特征对齐，在多个视频VAE骨干上实现解码加速且质量基本无损。
AI.motivation: 视频VAE的编解码计算开销大；现有轻量化方法要么对空间与时间计算联合约束，要么完全移除时间计算，未区分二者在预训练Conv3D中的压缩敏感度差异，导致加速受限或质量下降。
AI.method: 将符合条件的因果Conv3D精确重参数化为聚合空间响应与差分驱动的时间修正；基于不同压缩敏感度提出时间低秩压缩（TLR），对聚合空间核保持稠密、仅对时间修正做层特定低秩近似，并通过代数等价折叠实现实际加速；再采用宽度保持块剪枝降低深度，并用冻结教师后缀反馈的探针引导特征对齐恢复质量；框架可扩展至视频编码器。
AI.result: 在三种视频VAE骨干和两种GPU平台上一致加速解码。Wan VAE上在H100与RTX 5090分别达SOTA高效VAE解码器最高2.24倍与1.11倍吞吐，且DAVIS PSNR更高、LPIPS更低；MiniMax-H3上达原始解码吞吐2.97倍并保留原模型99.51%的VBench-2.0总分。
AI.conclusion: 区分空间与时间压缩敏感度并对时间修正项单独低秩压缩，结合深度剪枝与特征对齐，可在基本不损失生成质量的前提下显著提升视频VAE解码效率，且方法具备跨骨干、跨平台与向编码器扩展的通用性。

title: How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Position/contract paper on time-critical camera-first agents (systems/timing).Primary cs.AI;
summary: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"相机优先智能体"的核心瓶颈是时间而非识别能力，将问题形式化为"短暂目标交互（ETI）"与"感知截止契约"，并提出快慢双路径架构以保证证据不被错过。
AI.motivation: 相机优先智能体需在视觉世界展开过程中即时行动。许多视觉目标转瞬即逝：出现、与查询相关、又在短窗口内消失。若将记忆与推理绑定在同一条端到端路径上，等单体式流水线完成时证据已消失。因此核心障碍不是识别能力（多模态模型在语义推理上表现良好），而是时间。
AI.method: 形式化定义"短暂目标交互（ETI）"与"感知截止契约"，将硬性记忆截止与软性推理截止分离，依据感觉记忆与工作记忆的有界、被动特性。提出双截止架构：(1) 常开、有界、非语义的快路径；(2) 主动记忆机制，在被覆盖前将瞬间写入持久记忆（v1 为事件驱动）；(3) 延迟审议层（多模态模型 + 工具）。
AI.result: 在真实 MOT17 轨迹窗口上实例化该契约，进行一致性检查，并基于实测前沿模型延迟校准单路径基线：即使是短回答也需 1.2–9.3 秒，而智能体式"识别并搜索"耗时更长。
AI.conclusion: 回答可以迟到，但证据不能被错过。双截止架构通过将记忆与推理解耦，确保短暂视觉证据在推理完成前被持久化保存。

title: Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction for Signal Temporal Logic Inference with Many Classes
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference provides interpretable formulas for time series classification. For multiclass classification, however, accurate predictions do not necessarily ensure that the inferred formulas are satisfied consistently with the true class. We introduce the positive satisfaction rate and codeword satisfaction rate to quantify satisfaction of required formulas and consistency with the complete class codeword, respectively. We develop a two-stage procedure that first learns discriminative formulas using a margin-based objective and then refines predicate thresholds toward a small positive robustness target while fixing the formula structure and temporal intervals. Satisfaction and ranking penalties discourage violations of required formulas and loss of class separation. The decoding loss is used as a nonconformity score and calibrated separately for each class, providing finite-sample class-conditional coverage under intra-class exchangeability. Experiments on naval, synthetic, and robot manipulation trajectories demonstrate discrepancies between classification accuracy and formula satisfaction. The results further reveal a data-dependent tradeoff between robustness tightness and satisfaction, while class-conditional calibration mitigates undercoverage that can be hidden by pooled calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多类时间序列分类中STL推断公式与真实类不一致的问题，提出正满意度率与码字满意度率两个指标，并设计两阶段流程提升公式满足度与类条件覆盖。
AI.motivation: 多类分类中，分类准确率高并不保证推断出的STL公式被一致地满足（与真实类相一致）。现有STL推断缺乏对公式满足度和与完整类码字一致性的量化，且分类精度可能掩盖公式违反与类条件欠覆盖问题。
AI.method: 提出正满意度率与码字满意度率作为量化指标。采用两阶段流程：第一阶段用基于margin的目标学习判别性公式；第二阶段固定公式结构与时间区间，将谓词阈值细化至一个小的正鲁棒性目标。引入满足度与排序惩罚以抑制必需公式被违反和类分离度损失。将解码损失作为非一致性分数，按类分别校准，在类内可交换性假设下提供有限样本的类条件覆盖。
AI.result: 在naval、合成数据及机器人操作轨迹上的实验表明，分类准确率与公式满足度之间存在明显差异；结果揭示鲁棒性紧度与满足度之间存在依赖数据的权衡；类条件校准缓解了被池化校准掩盖的欠覆盖问题。
AI.conclusion: 分类准确率不能替代公式满足度的评估，需用满意度指标衡量STL公式与真实类的一致性。所提两阶段流程结合逐类校准，可改善公式满足度与类条件覆盖，但鲁棒性紧度与满足度之间存在数据依赖的权衡。

title: Contactless gait-derived features as candidate digital biomarkers of depression severity in adolescents
summary: Timely assessment of depression severity in adolescents is essential for guiding clinical care, yet conventional evaluations rely on episodic clinical assessments and symptom rating scales. Contactless gait analysis offers a potentially scalable approach to capturing objective behavioral features associated with depression. Here, we introduce the Long-Distance 3D Adolescent Depression Gait Dataset (LD3D-ADG), comprising depth-sensor gait recordings from 119 adolescents at a single center, including 39 healthy controls, 41 with mild depression, and 39 with moderate-to-severe depression. We developed UMLPA-GCN, a graph convolutional network that models spatiotemporal gait dynamics across three anatomically defined skeletal partitions. In participant-independent five-fold cross-validation, UMLPA-GCN achieved 75.63% classification accuracy, a macro-F1 score of 75.52%, and a macro-area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.839 (95% confidence interval, 0.779--0.899). Class-specific recall was 87.18%, 63.41%, and 76.92% for healthy controls, mild depression, and moderate-to-severe depression, respectively. At the participant level, reduced arm swing, slower pelvic movement, restricted joint range of motion, and greater arm-swing asymmetry were identified as leading potential digital biomarkers contributing to depression severity assessment, associated with higher 17-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale scores. These findings provide proof-of-concept evidence for contactless digital depression severity stratification in adolescents. Further external and prospective validation is needed to establish their utility for longitudinal monitoring and timely clinical assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了基于深度传感器步态数据集的青少年抑郁症严重程度分级方法，提出UMLPA-GCN图卷积网络模型，实现非接触式客观评估。
AI.motivation: 青少年抑郁严重程度的及时评估对临床诊疗至关重要，但传统评估依赖间歇性临床访谈和症状量表，缺乏客观、可规模化、非接触的行为学指标。步态分析提供了捕捉抑郁相关客观行为特征的潜在途径。
AI.method: 构建LD3D-ADG数据集（单中心119名青少年，39名健康对照、41名轻度抑郁、39名中重度抑郁，深度传感器步态记录）；提出UMLPA-GCN图卷积网络，在三个解剖学定义的骨骼分区上建模时空步态动力学；采用被试独立五折交叉验证，并结合17项汉密尔顿抑郁量表评分进行生物标志物分析。
AI.result: UMLPA-GCN分类准确率75.63%，宏F1为75.52%，宏AUC为0.839（95%CI 0.779–0.899）；各类别召回率分别为健康对照87.18%、轻度抑郁63.41%、中重度抑郁76.92%。识别出摆臂幅度减小、骨盆运动减慢、关节活动范围受限、摆臂不对称性增大等主要潜在数字生物标志物，并与更高的HAMD-17评分相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究为青少年非接触式数字抑郁严重程度分层提供了概念验证证据；尚需外部验证与前瞻性验证以确立其用于纵向监测和及时临床评估的实用价值。

title: In-Place Indic Tokenizer Expansion and Continual Pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone. Continual pretraining then progressed through broad training, high-quality annealing, and long-context training over approximately 1.27 trillion tokens. The annealed checkpoint gained 12.9 points on the Indic MILU benchmark but lost 3.4 on English MMLU. We also report practical negative results. Direct token addition underperformed continued byte-pair encoding. AdamW weight decay changed rows intended to stay fixed. Perplexity on an Indic-heavy holdout did not select the learning rate that best preserved English performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究在保持Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B骨干架构不变的情况下，将词表从131,072扩展至163,072以适配8种印度语言，并通过持续预训练提升多语言能力，同时报告了若干负结果。
AI.motivation: 使现有大模型高效适配多种印度语言，同时尽量保持原有（英语）能力，并总结实践中的有效策略与失败教训。
AI.method: 采用继续BPE与AdaptMix再平衡原地扩展词表；用原始组成行均值初始化新输入/输出行，先以90%印度语+10%英语数据训练新行再更新骨干；持续预训练含广泛训练、高质量退火与长上下文训练，共约1.27万亿token。
AI.result: 每词token数减少38.6%；退火检查点在Indic MILU上提升12.9分，但英语MMLU下降3.4分。负结果：直接添加token劣于继续BPE；AdamW权重衰减改变了本应固定的行；以印度语为主的留出集困惑度未能选出最能保持英语性能的学习率。
AI.conclusion: 词表扩展结合分阶段持续预训练可显著提升印度语性能，但存在英语能力回退；初始化、优化器设置与学习率选择需谨慎，困惑度并非理想的跨语言性能选择指标。

title: Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction
summary: Set-based variational autoencoders (VecSet VAEs) represent 3D shapes as compact sets of latent tokens. Although each token originates from a query at a sampled surface location, whether these latents truly align with geometry remains unclear. We investigate this alignment and identify four issues: (i) attention-sink-like tokens that attract queries from across the shape; (ii) spatially periodic repetitions in decoder attention responses; (iii) mismatched normal information in encoder and decoder query features; and (iv) missing supervision of the intrinsic relation between signed distance fields and surface normals. To address these issues, we introduce Align-VAE with four corresponding modifications: (i) a shared bank of learnable decoder tokens provides a workspace for global computation; (ii) distance-biased cross-attention guides retrieval toward nearby predicted spatial anchors; (iii) normal-free encoder queries align the two stages' access to normal information while retaining normals in the encoder keys and values; and (iv) a screened Poisson-inspired regularizer supervises surface values and normal-direction derivatives. These changes align latent retrieval and field prediction with geometry without enlarging the per-shape code. On the ABO dataset, Align-VAE reduces Chamfer distance by 26.6% compared to the standard VecSet VAE.

AI.tldr: 针对VecSet VAE中潜变量与几何对齐不佳的问题，提出Align-VAE，通过四项改进在ABO数据集上将Chamfer距离降低26.6%。
AI.motivation: VecSet VAE用紧凑的潜token集合表示3D形状，每个token源于采样表面位置的查询，但这些潜变量是否真正与几何对齐尚不明确，论文旨在研究并解决该对齐问题。
AI.method: 首先识别四个问题：注意力汇聚式token、解码器注意力响应的空间周期重复、编解码器查询特征中法向信息不匹配、SDF与表面法向内在关系缺乏监督。相应地提出四项修改：(i)共享可学习解码器token库提供全局计算工作区；(ii)距离偏置交叉注意力引导向附近预测空间锚点的检索；(iii)无归一化编码器查询，统一两阶段对法向信息的访问，同时在编码器键和值中保留法向；(iv)受筛选泊松启发的正则化器监督表面值与法向方向导数。
AI.result: 在ABO数据集上，Align-VAE相比标准VecSet VAE将Chamfer距离降低26.6%，且未增大的每形状编码大小。
AI.conclusion: 通过使潜变量检索和场预测与几何对齐，Align-VAE在不增大形状编码的前提下显著提升3D形状重建精度。

title: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProgAgent，一个完整的程序化工具调用（PTC）训练栈，包含可验证长时程任务合成流水线、轻量级 PTC 运行时与两阶段训练方案，用极少任务量在多个基准上取得优于同规模基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体多采用直接工具调用（DTC），即顺序调用工具并将响应累积到模型上下文中，这会导致上下文腐化和编排崩溃。程序化工具调用（PTC）通过可执行代码调用工具、将中间结果存入运行时变量而非上下文，但此前研究主要将其视为推理时优化，其在智能体训练中的价值尚不明确，且缺乏合适的可验证训练任务。
AI.method: 提出 ProgAgent 完整 PTC 训练栈，由三部分组成：1）可验证长时程任务合成流水线；2）轻量级 PTC 运行时；3）两阶段训练配方。仅使用 215 个任务，并在四种环境规模下实例化。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，ProgAgent 的通过率均高于同规模对比基线。在 LOCA-bench 上，当环境状态为 64k token 时，ProgAgent-14B 达到 30.7% 通过率，而基线得分为零。跨执行框架（cross-harness）实验表明，PTC 训练的模型在两种评测接口下均优于 DTC 训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: PTC 训练带来的收益不仅限于接口层面，具有超越具体调用界面的泛化优势，为智能体长时程工具编排训练提供了有效且数据高效的方案。

title: The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration with an ERM Oracle
summary: A predictor is multicalibrated with respect to a class of subpopulations (formally, of functions on the inputs, called auditors) if, for every subpopulation in the class and every value the predictor outputs, the average outcome among the members of that subpopulation who receive that value is close to the value itself. For finite classes, about $\varepsilon^{-3}$ samples are necessary and sufficient to learn a predictor with multicalibration error $\varepsilon$, but the algorithms that attain this rate enumerate the class, which is impossible for the large classes of interest. We ask how many samples suffice when the learner accesses the class only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples and polynomially many ERM calls, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the class. Its dependence on $\varepsilon$ is optimal for all learners. When $d$ is at least about $1/\varepsilon$, every learner that can only access the class through polynomially many ERM calls needs $\tildeΩ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples. Learners with unlimited computation need only $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-3}+d\varepsilon^{-2})$ samples, so the extra factor $1/\varepsilon$ on the dimension term is the price of oracle efficiency. For swap multicalibration, which allows a different function from the class for each predicted value, $\tildeΘ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient. For estimating the error of a given predictor, the ordinary notion is the harder one: the swap error can be estimated with an ERM oracle, whereas the ordinary error is NP-hard to approximate even for classes with linear-time ERM. Consequently, there are classes for which it is computationally easier to learn a multicalibrated predictor than to compute the multicalibration error of a given predictor.

AI.tldr: 研究仅通过 ERM oracle 访问审计函数类时，多校准学习的样本复杂度，给出上界 Õ(d/ε³)、下界 Õ(d/ε³)，并分析 swap 多校准与误差估计。
AI.motivation: 有限类多校准的最优算法需要枚举类，无法用于大规模类；因此需研究学习者只能通过 ERM oracle 访问类时的样本量，并厘清 oracle 效率带来的额外代价。
AI.method: 给出一个仅使用多项式次 ERM 调用的算法，达到 Õ(d/ε³) 样本量，其中 d 为类 VC 维；并证明当 d≳1/ε 时任何多项式 ERM 调用学习者需 Õ(d/ε³) 样本；同时分析无计算限制学习者、swap 多校准与给定预测器误差估计。
AI.result: 算法用 Õ(d/ε³) 样本和多项式 ERM 调用实现多校准；ε 依赖对所有学习者最优；d≳1/ε 时多项式 ERM 调用下界为 Õ(d/ε³)；无计算限制需 Õ(ε⁻³+dε⁻²)，维度项多出 1/ε 为 oracle 效率代价；swap 多校准为 Θ̃(d/ε³)；普通多校准误差估计 NP-hard。
AI.conclusion: ERM oracle 效率的代价是维度项额外 1/ε；swap 多校准样本复杂度紧；存在类使学习多校准预测器比计算给定预测器多校准误差更容易。

title: RetinaSC: Retinal Semantic Communication Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection
summary: This paper presents a lightweight semantic com- munication framework for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading from fundus images pertaining specifically to the APTOS2019 dataset. The framework includes semantic encoder designed using ResNet34, U-Net, MobileNetV2, and EfficientNet-B0 architectures. Further, the trained models are used to train the same framework for IDRiD dataset using transfer learning approach. Such a framework will enable the telemedicine sector in the early detection of DR and prevent total blindness. The results reveal that for APTOS, task-oriented semantic systems can achieve satisfactory robust performance (more than 0.8 weighted F1 score for ResNet34 and EfficientNet-B0) across different channels. In particular, considering the trade-off between complexity, latency, throughput, and F1 score, MobileNetV2 is the best model with weighted F1 score of 0.76-0.78 for both task and reconstruction- oriented modules and end-to-end latency of only 8.162 ms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级语义通信框架，用于基于眼底图像进行糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级，主要面向APTOS2019数据集，并通过迁移学习适配IDRiD数据集。
AI.motivation: 辅助远程医疗实现DR早期检测、预防完全失明，并探索任务导向语义通信在医学影像分级中的可行性。
AI.method: 以ResNet34、U-Net、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B0构建语义编码器，先在APTOS2019上训练，再用迁移学习训练同一框架用于IDRiD数据集。
AI.result: APTOS上任务导向语义系统表现稳健，ResNet34与EfficientNet-B0加权F1超过0.8；综合复杂度、时延、吞吐与F1，MobileNetV2最优，任务与重构模块加权F1为0.76–0.78，端到端时延仅8.162 ms。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级语义通信框架在DR分级中具备良好性能与低时延，MobileNetV2在性能-效率权衡上最佳，适合远程医疗部署。

title: From Candidate Tokens to Final Outcomes: Decoding Relative Long-Horizon Candidate Value from Reasoning Model Representations
summary: Large reasoning models generate reasoning trajectories token by token. At a given prefix, multiple next-token candidates may be plausible, yet shape subsequent reasoning and differ in their chances of leading to the correct answer. Whether these differences are reflected in internal representations remains unclear. To study this question, we define relative long-horizon candidate value to quantify within-prefix differences and construct the Reasoning Candidate-Token Value (RCTV) dataset, pairing mathematical reasoning prefixes with plausible next-token candidates and their empirical long-horizon candidate values. Using RCTV, we examine hidden states, multilayer perceptron outputs, and attention outputs at candidate positions with sparse linear probes. Experimental results provide evidence that relative long-horizon candidate value is linearly decodable from these representations at multiple layers. Candidate-value probes can also outperform probability- and embedding-based baselines. Furthermore, a controlled online intervention experiment shows that using the decoded signals to guide token selection during generation can improve the chances of eventual success. Our findings provide evidence that internal representations encode information about relative long-horizon candidate value, offering insights into how local candidate-level representations relate to long-horizon reasoning outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"相对长时程候选值"概念并构建RCTV数据集，用稀疏线性探针证明该值可从隐藏状态、MLP输出与注意力输出的内部表征中线性解码，且解码信号可在线干预以提升推理成功率。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型逐token生成推理轨迹，同一前缀下多个候选token看似合理，但会塑造不同的后续推理路径并影响最终正确率。这些候选之间的差异是否反映在模型内部表征中尚不清楚，本文旨在探究内部表征是否编码候选的相对长时程价值。
AI.method: 定义"相对长时程候选值"以量化同一前缀内候选token的差异，构建RCTV数据集（将数学推理前缀与合理候选token及其经验长时程候选值配对）。基于RCTV，使用稀疏线性探针在候选位置考察隐藏状态、多层感知机输出与注意力输出。
AI.result: 实验表明，相对长时程候选值可在多个层从上述表征中线性解码；候选值探针优于基于概率和基于嵌入的基线；受控在线干预实验显示，用解码信号指导生成时的token选择能提高最终成功的概率。
AI.conclusion: 内部表征编码了相对长时程候选值的信息，揭示了局部候选级表征与长时程推理结果之间的联系。

title: Japanese Handwriting Generation Based on Human Preference Feedback Using Direct Preference Optimization
summary: We propose a Japanese handwriting generation framework that integrates human preference feedback using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align generative models with human cognitive and stylistic preferences. While font generation technologies leveraging Generative Adversarial Networks and diffusion models have advanced significantly, applying these approaches to handwriting generation presents unique challenges. Font generation is a deterministic process yielding consistent styles. Handwriting generation, on the other hand, is inherently non-deterministic. In handwriting, glyph shapes never match exactly even when the same writer writes the same character. We define this shape difference as handwriting variability. Although this variability is essential for conveying the natural quality of human writing, it complicates model training and substantially increases data collection costs to capture diverse distribution patterns. To address these limitations, we incorporate human perceptual feedback into the training loop of handwriting generation. While collecting extensive handwritten data is costly, evaluating pairwise preferences between two generated samples remains very easy for humans. Applying DPO, an efficient RL-free preference optimization method, to our generation model enables high-quality handwriting generation without relying on large-scale dataset collection. Experimental results across four distinct Japanese handwriting styles demonstrate that DPO-based training enhances overall structural accuracy. However, in highly complex styles with significant variability, such as brush pen writing, the model fails to capture style-specific features. These findings highlight a critical challenge in extending DPO to complex handwriting styles.

AI.tldr: 提出融合人类偏好反馈的日文手写生成框架，采用DPO对齐生成模型，无需大规模数据采集即可提升手写生成质量，但在复杂笔刷风格上仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 字体生成（GAN、扩散模型）已较成熟，但手写生成具有非确定性：同一书写者写同一字符的字形也不完全相同，这种"手写可变性"是自然书写质感的关键，却使模型训练复杂化，并大幅提高采集多样分布数据集的成本。因此需要一种不依赖大规模数据采集的替代方案。
AI.method: 将人类感知反馈引入手写生成的训练循环。核心洞察是：大规模手写数据采集代价高，但人类对两个生成样本进行成对偏好比较非常容易。据此将DPO（Direct Preference Optimization，一种无强化学习的高效偏好优化方法）应用于手写生成模型。
AI.result: 在四种不同的日文手写风格上实验，DPO 训练提升了整体结构准确性；但在可变性显著的高复杂度风格（如毛笔书写）中，模型无法捕捉风格特有特征。
AI.conclusion: DPO 可在无需大规模数据采集的情况下实现高质量手写生成并改善结构准确性，但将其扩展到复杂手写风格仍面临关键挑战。

title: LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement
summary: LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

AI.tldr: LYNX 是一个多智能体框架，将 LLM 驱动的数据分析重构为受模式与知识约束的分析问题，通过规划、生成、验证、精炼的闭环工作流提升 NL-to-SQL 的准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法或将 LLM 视为意图到代码的翻译器，或将其作为独立分析引擎，难以将领域语义与复杂模式及异构元数据可靠对齐，导致真实工作负载中执行脆弱、分析输出语义不一致。
AI.method: LYNX 采用三个角色专精智能体，将分析合成组织为规划、生成、验证、精炼的闭环工作流，协同强化模式接地、语义一致性与执行正确性；并集成语义-结构蒸馏与阶段感知分配（SSD-SAA）以缓解领域歧义和模式错位，同时通过增量引导的迭代修订持续诊断与修复语义及执行层面的失败。
AI.result: 在 BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev 与更具挑战性的 Spider 2.0-Lite 两个 NL-to-SQL 基准上，执行准确率达到 10.66% 至 59.54%（覆盖轻量级与商用模型），相比此前最高效方法减少 70.53% 的 token 消耗，并在不同骨干模型上表现出高度泛化性。
AI.conclusion: LYNX 在量化金融分析与复杂多关系 SQL 工作负载的案例研究中进一步展现了稳健性、可扩展性与实际适用性，验证了其作为真实分析场景通用框架的潜力。

title: ConformalGuard: False-Positive-Controlled Action Gating for LM Classifiers
summary: Language model classifiers are increasingly deployed for high-stakes decisions such as phishing screening, content moderation, and fraud triage, yet validation-set thresholds provide no finite-sample control of deployment-time false positives. We present ConformalGuard, a model-agnostic calibration layer that wraps a fixed scoring function with finite-sample control over the rate at which legitimate inputs trigger an intervention tier. Our contribution is empirical and operational, not a new conformal theorem: zero-shot LM API scores can be coarse enough (10--11 unique values here) to make temperature scaling and isotonic regression operationally identical to raw thresholding for low-FPR action gating. We compare these methods with conformal calibration for fine-tuned BERT, Claude Sonnet 4, and GPT-4o on public email corpora. For Claude, conformal calibration reduces FPR from 0.040 to 0.008 while recall falls from 0.938 to 0.875. For deterministic GPT-4o scores, the 1% operating point is too conservative to deploy (recall 0.564); three-run stochastic averaging raises recall to 0.732 at FPR 0.005. At 2% prevalence with BERT, conformal calibration removes 25 false-positive reviews per 10,000 emails (95% CI [10, 43]). The guarantee is legitimate-event-rate control under exchangeability; discrimination, workload effects, and robustness to shift remain empirical.

AI.tldr: ConformalGuard 是一个模型无关的校准层，通过有限样本控制合法输入触发干预率的阈值方法；实证比较发现零样本 LM API 分数粒度粗，在低 FPR 门控中温度缩放与等渗回归等同于原始阈值，而共形校准可显著降低 FPR。
AI.motivation: 高风险场景（钓鱼筛查、内容审核、欺诈分流）中，语言模型分类器的验证集阈值无法对部署时假阳性提供有限样本控制，亟需一种能控制合法输入触发干预率的校准方法。
AI.method: 提出 ConformalGuard——模型无关的校准层，包裹固定评分函数，对合法输入触发干预层的比率提供有限样本控制；在公开邮件语料上，将温度缩放、等渗回归与共形校准在微调 BERT、Claude Sonnet 4 和 GPT-4o 上进行比较。
AI.result: Claude 上共形校准将 FPR 从 0.040 降至 0.008，召回从 0.938 降至 0.875；GPT-4o 确定性分数下 1% 操作点召回仅 0.564，三次随机平均将召回提升至 0.732（FPR 0.005）；BERT 在 2% 患病率下每万封邮件减少 25 个假阳性（95% CI [10, 43]）。
AI.conclusion: 该保证是在可交换性下的合法事件率控制；判别力、工作量影响及对分布偏移的稳健性仍是经验性的，需要进一步评估。

title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Thermal Human Perception from Dataset to Deployment
summary: Indoor human perception is the foundation for smart homes and healthcare. However, RGB cameras raise privacy concerns in private indoor environments, while low-resolution thermal cameras provide limited spatial and semantic information. Large-scale indoor thermal datasets and real-world deployments remain limited. Here, we introduce Indoor RGB-T, a large-scale paired RGB--thermal dataset for indoor human perception. The dataset covers 20 indoor rooms and contains 90,576 80x62 thermal frames, 87,016 temporally matched RGB--thermal pairs, and 115,557 annotated human bounding boxes. We establish benchmarks for robust thermal occupant-state detection with 0.75 mAP and occupancy estimation with an accuracy of 0.847 in unseen rooms. We further evaluate RGB-to-thermal and thermal-to-RGB translation, achieving a temperature MAE of 0.654 C and an R2 of 0.923. Finally, we deploy the thermal perception model on a commercial sleep-monitoring system in the real world. Field testing with 100 participants and deployment of approximately 1,000 devices further demonstrate its practical feasibility. We identify practical challenges that motivate future research directions, including environmental thermal interference, sensing range and multi-person occlusion. The code, trained models and partial dataset are available at https://github.com/kailaisun/RGBT and https://huggingface.co/skl24/RGBT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模室内配对RGB-热红外数据集Indoor RGB-T，并建立人体感知基准与真实部署验证。
AI.motivation: 室内人体感知是智能家居与医疗健康的基础，但RGB相机存在隐私问题，低分辨率热红外相机空间与语义信息有限，且大规模室内热红外数据集与真实部署仍十分匮乏。
AI.method: 构建Indoor RGB-T数据集，覆盖20个室内房间，包含90,576帧80x62热红外帧、87,016对时间对齐的RGB-热红外图像对及115,557个人体边界框标注；建立鲁棒热红外占用状态检测与占用估计基准，并评估RGB到热红外、热红外到RGB的跨模态转换；最后将热红外感知模型部署到商用睡眠监测系统开展实地测试。
AI.result: 在未见房间中占用状态检测达到0.75 mAP，占用估计准确率0.847；跨模态转换温度MAE为0.654°C、R2为0.923；100名参与者实地测试及约1,000台设备部署验证了实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为室内热红外人体感知提供了大规模数据与基准，并通过真实部署验证可行性，同时指出环境热干扰、传感范围与多人遮挡等实际挑战以指引未来研究。

title: Sensitivity or Criterion? Measuring and Moving When Language Models Act
summary: Before an agent acts, it must decide whether action is warranted. A single accuracy cannot distinguish failure to recognize a warranted action from reluctance to act. Signal-detection theory separates sensitivity from criterion, but criteria estimated from authored binary labels depend on each benchmark's example mix. We introduce FlipAct, a diagnostic of tool use in physical states. A rule over annotated tool properties computes each answer and a graded evidence score, fixing the Yes/No boundary at zero across models. Questions form 2-by-2 quads that hold required knowledge fixed while the state flips. The slope of the fitted Yes-rate curve measures sensitivity; its crossing at one half measures criterion. Across 44 open models, sensitivity rises with size within a family, and its ranking agrees with three of four external when-to-act benchmarks. Models respond to evidence sign rather than magnitude, accepting actions that leave the state no better about as often as helpful ones. When Yes means act, most models are conservative across rephrasings; in some, this partly reflects a preference for No. Criterion is not determined by size. Activation steering shifts criterion with weights fixed; distillation from a model's own steered copy puts the shift into its weights without a significant sensitivity change. The distilled shift transfers to six external benchmarks, including two without Yes/No answers, while criterion-free AUC is preserved on the five benchmarks where it is available. Accuracy improves where models start conservative and declines or remains within error where they start permissive. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/flipact

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlipAct，一种基于信号检测论的工具使用诊断方法，通过翻转状态的 2×2 问题组将“是否识别到行动合理性”（敏感度）与“是否倾向于行动”（判定标准）分离，并在 44 个开源模型上验证二者的可分离性、可操控性与可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 单一准确率无法区分两类失败：未识别出合理的行动，与识别到了但不愿行动。尽管信号检测论可分离敏感度与判定标准，但从人工二元标签估计的标准会受各基准样本构成（正负例比例）影响，导致跨模型、跨基准不可比。
AI.method: 提出 FlipAct 诊断：对标注的工具属性施加规则计算答案，并给出分级证据分数，使 Yes/No 边界在零处固定、跨模型一致。题目组织为 2×2 四元组，在保持所需知识不变的前提下翻转物理状态。以拟合的 Yes 率曲线斜率衡量敏感度，其在 0.5 处的交点衡量判定标准。进一步用激活引导改变标准、再通过自蒸馏把偏移写入权重。
AI.result: 在 44 个开源模型上，敏感度随同家族规模上升，其排序与四个外部“何时行动”基准中的三个一致。模型主要响应证据的符号而非幅度，接受无益行动与接受有益行动的频率相当。当 Yes 表示行动时，多数模型在多种改写下偏保守，部分模型部分源于对 No 的偏好。判定标准与模型规模无关。激活引导可在权重不变时移动标准；自蒸馏能把该偏移固化进权重且敏感度无显著变化。蒸馏后的偏移可迁移到六个外部基准（含两个无 Yes/No 答案的基准），且在五个可得基准上保持无标准的 AUC。准确率在模型原本保守时提升，在原本宽松时下降或保持在误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: FlipAct 提供了一个将敏感度与判定标准解耦、且不受基准样本构成干扰的工具使用诊断框架，表明判定标准既非由规模决定，也可通过引导与蒸馏被独立调控并跨基准迁移，从而为“该不该行动”的评估与对齐提供可操作的度量与干预路径。

title: YOUDrive: Driving Style as a Composable Direction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies can achieve strong task performance while offering limited control over their driving style. Driving style describes how a vehicle accelerates, brakes, and maintains distance. Policies trained without explicit preference conditioning lack a direct mechanism for adjusting these behaviors at inference. We propose YOUDrive, a vision--language--action planner for continuous and composable driving-style control. Each teacher's behavior is distilled into a task vector, a learned parameter update that induces a style direction in the planner's representation. These directions can be scaled and combined at inference without retraining the backbone. Conditioned on these directions, a flow-matching decoder models a multimodal trajectory distribution and generates kinematically feasible motion alternatives. We introduce the Style Alignment Score (SAS) to describe human-referenced kinematic behavior after safety and task gating. On NAVSIM navtest, a single coefficient monotonically controls assertiveness across six teacher-derived personas, while PDMS remains above 0.90 across the tested individual and blended configurations, reaching 0.954. Further analyses reveal systematic policy-specific kinematics after controlling for scene context, whereas the evaluated discrete style labels provide limited additional explanatory power. Code, checkpoints, and the metric will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 YOUDrive——一种视觉-语言-动作规划器，通过将各教师驾驶行为蒸馏为任务向量，在推理阶段对驾驶风格进行连续、可组合的控制，无需重训主干网络；并引入风格对齐分数（SAS）评估安全与任务门控后的类人运动学行为。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略任务表现强，但对驾驶风格（加速、制动、保持距离）缺乏控制；无显式偏好条件的策略在推理时缺少直接调整这些行为的手段。
AI.method: 将每位教师的行为蒸馏为任务向量（一种学习到的参数更新，在规划器表征中诱导出风格方向）；这些方向可在推理时缩放与组合，无需重训主干。以这些方向为条件，流匹配解码器建模多模态轨迹分布并生成运动学可行的运动备选。引入风格对齐分数（SAS）刻画安全与任务门控后的类人参考运动学行为。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 上，单一系数可单调控制六种教师衍生人格的激进程度，在测试的单独与混合配置中 PDMS 均保持 0.90 以上，最高达 0.954。进一步分析表明，在控制场景上下文后，风格体现出系统性的策略特定运动学差异，而评估所用的离散风格标签提供的额外解释力有限。
AI.conclusion: 任务向量式风格方向为端到端驾驶提供了连续、可组合、推理可控的风格调节能力，并在保持高安全任务指标的同时实现可解释的运动学差异；代码、检查点与指标将公开。

title: Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees
summary: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

AI.tldr: 本文为反思型语言智能体（不更新模型权重、依赖反馈与记忆）建立从局部反思到长期性能的理论保证：给出由局部生成与部署保证推导次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并形式化验证全部13项理论结果。
AI.motivation: 现有关于策略选择与动作生成的保证，本身无法说明在资源约束下局部反思何时能为完整智能体带来长期性能保证，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 保留原生控制器，推导由局部生成与部署保证推出次线性反事实后悔的充分条件；建立资源敏感的迁移界，限定实际执行路径上的全状态部署偏差，并保持学习器与比较器的自身历史规律；局部生成可靠性给出累积生成机会界，通过质量、覆盖与硬预算的显式权衡将策略获取与长期性能相连；用Lean形式化全部13个编号理论结果的证明链，含带重复策略增长与不完美验证的原生实例。
AI.result: 建立了资源敏感迁移界与累积生成机会界，得到从局部保证到次线性反事实后悔的充分条件，并在Lean中完成13项理论结果的证明链形式化及原生实例验证。
AI.conclusion: 局部生成与部署保证可在资源约束下转化为完整智能体的长期性能保证，且该理论链条具备机器可检验的形式化支撑。

title: History, Adaptation, and Hidden Gain: Two Prospective Tests of Learned Predictive Control in a Synthetic Neural Population
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Synthetic closed-loop neural rate-control study; code, frozen protocols and results at https://github.com/lonewolf15116/NeuroLight-AI (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23263620)
summary: We study learned one-step predictive control of a synthetic population of 64 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons whose light sensitivity is scaled by a hidden factor s, using two prospective confirmations on plants simulated only after the analysis was frozen. In the first (50 plants, 11 conditions), removing the 200-ms input-output history substantially worsened a parameter-count-matched neural predictor at low and moderate gain (s = 0.6, 0.8; RMSE rose by 2.47 Hz at s = 0.6, 97.5% CI 2.43-2.51). In secondary comparisons, recursively adapted ARX had the lowest mean error of the deployable controllers in 10 of 11 conditions, tuned PI with anti-windup matched or beat the network for s >= 0.7, and training for 10,000 rather than 900 epochs lowered prediction error but worsened control. Development work suggested the network's learned action sensitivity did not track the hidden gain. A second protocol (50 new plants, 9 sensitivities, 2 noise levels) confirmed three pre-specified predictions at the primary noise level. Re-estimating a single multiplicative input gain recovered 87% (95% CI 86-88%) of the benefit of full adaptive ARX. Supplying that online estimate to the network as an extra input reduced high-gain tracking error by 1.84 Hz [1.81, 1.88]. Longer training worsened the plain network by 1.09 Hz but improved the gain-input network by 1.07 Hz, a differential of 2.16 Hz [2.13, 2.20]. Under high process noise (sigma = 2.0) the effects shrank to about 0.04 Hz or less and gain-only adaptation recovered only 24% of the adaptive-ARX benefit. In this synthetic plant, at the primary noise level, one-parameter online gain estimation accounts for most of the gap between a history-based network and full adaptive ARX, and for its prediction-control mismatch.

AI.tldr: 在合成LIF神经元群体的一步预测控制中,单参数在线增益估计可解释基于历史的网络与全自适应ARX之间的大部分差距,并解释其"预测-控制"错配;高过程噪声下效应显著衰减。
AI.motivation: 作者关注学习式一步预测控制器中"预测性能提升未必带来控制性能提升"的错配问题,以及网络所学动作敏感度是否真正追踪隐藏的被控对象增益。为此设计两个前瞻性确认实验(仅在分析冻结后仿真植物),检验输入输出历史、在线增益估计与训练时长对预测和控制的影响。
AI.method: 被控对象为64个漏泄积分-发放(LIF)神经元组成的合成群体,其光敏感度由隐藏增益s缩放。实验一:50株植物、11种条件,对比参数数量匹配的神经网络预测器在有/无200 ms输入输出历史下的表现,并作次级比较(递归自适应ARX、带抗积分饱和的整定PI、900 vs 10000轮训练)。实验二:50株新植物、9种敏感度、2个噪声水平,预注册3项预测;通过重新估计单一乘性输入增益、并将其作为额外输入馈入网络,考察高增益跟踪误差与长训练的差分效应;并检验高过程噪声(sigma=2.0)下的稳健性。
AI.result: 实验一:移除200 ms历史在中低增益(s=0.6, 0.8)显著恶化匹配网络预测器,s=0.6时RMSE上升2.47 Hz(97.5% CI 2.43-2.51);11种条件中10种自适应ARX平均误差最低,抗饱和PI在s>=0.7时追平或优于网络;10000轮训练降低预测误差但恶化控制。实验二:主干噪声水平下三项预注册预测均被确认;单乘性输入增益估计恢复全自适应ARX收益的87%(95% CI 86-88%);将该在线估计作为额外输入使高增益跟踪误差降低1.84 Hz[1.81, 1.88];长训练使普通网络恶化1.09 Hz却使增益输入网络改善1.07 Hz,差分2.16 Hz[2.13, 2.20]。高过程噪声下效应缩小至约0.04 Hz或更低,仅增益自适应仅恢复24%的ARX收益。
AI.conclusion: 在该合成植物与主干噪声水平下,单参数在线增益估计可解释基于历史的网络与全自适应ARX之间的大部分性能差距,并解释其预测-控制错配;该结论依赖于低噪声设定,高过程噪声下增益自适应的解释力大幅削弱。

title: Harnessing SPAD Noise: Test-Time Gated Attention for Indoor Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has emerged as a cost-effective alternative to hardware-dependent 3D sensing modalities, yet predicting precise metric depth remains a persistent challenge due to intrinsic scale ambiguity, edge bleeding, and limited zero-shot generalization in unseen environments. Recent multi-modal approaches incorporate 1D/3D Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) data to resolve these ambiguities, but they mainly treat SPAD noise as a harmful artifact required for denoising or leave the noise ignored. In this paper, we present an essentially different insight: native SPAD noise is an informative prior that implicitly encodes deterministic environmental characteristics. Driven by this paradigm shift, we introduce a novel, lightweight Test-Time Gated Attention framework by Harnessing SPAD Noise, therefore dubbed HSN. Tailored for indoor scenarios, HSN leverages the synergistic combination of 1D SPAD histograms and Gate Adapters (GAs). Through three complementary optimization phases, it generates channel-wise gated attention vectors to dynamically adjust encoder feature maps at inference time, effectively resolving ambiguous scale and boundary challenges without the heavy computational overhead or dense 3D modalities that other TTA methods suffer from. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world indoor benchmarks show that HSN achieves state-of-the-art metric depth accuracy in in-domain settings, while exhibiting even greater potential under zero-shot generalization to unfamiliar environments. Furthermore, interpretability analysis reveals that the proposed gated attention mechanism adaptively shifts attention toward deeper semantic layers under intensifying SPAD noise. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSN框架，将SPAD原生噪声视为蕴含确定性环境特征的先验信息，结合1D SPAD直方图与Gate Adapters，通过测试时门控注意力机制实现轻量级单目深度估计，在室内基准上达到SOTA并具备更强的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计（MDE）成本低但存在尺度模糊、边缘渗漏和零样本泛化差的问题；现有多模态方法引入SPAD数据，却主要将SPAD噪声当作需去除的有害伪影或直接忽略，未挖掘其潜在价值。
AI.method: 提出HSN（Harnessing SPAD Noise）框架，将SPAD原生噪声视为编码环境确定性特征的先验；面向室内场景，融合1D SPAD直方图与Gate Adapters（GAs），通过三个互补优化阶段在推理时生成通道级门控注意力向量，动态调整编码器特征图。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的真实室内基准上，HSN在域内设置下取得SOTA的度量深度精度，在零样本泛化到陌生环境时潜力更大；可解释性分析表明，门控注意力机制会随SPAD噪声增强自适应地将注意力转向更深的语义层。
AI.conclusion: SPAD原生噪声可作为一种有益的确定性先验而非单纯干扰，配合测试时门控注意力机制，能够以轻量方式解决尺度与边界模糊问题，提升室内单目深度估计的域内精度与零样本泛化能力。

title: AlphaPilot: Multi-Turn Tool-Using LLM Agents for Adaptive Alpha Mining with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks interpretable expressions that rank assets by future returns. The task is challenging because it demands simultaneous processing of unstructured market descriptions, historical data, and quantitative evaluation of candidate factors, yet most existing methods exploit only a subset of these signals. We introduce AlphaPilot, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains multi-turn tool-using LLM agents for adaptive alpha mining. The agent conditions on market descriptions, proposes factor expressions, queries real-data evaluator feedback, and updates a retained factor pool across turns. This design jointly leverages market text, LLM financial knowledge, real data, and evaluation feedback. At inference time, AlphaPilot performs day-by-day search and pool updates to adapt to shifting market regimes. Across three independent runs in out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, AlphaPilot achieves mean total returns of 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86, respectively. It attains the highest mean total return, Sharpe, and RankIC among the evaluated methods on both universes.

AI.tldr: AlphaPilot 是一个强化学习框架，训练多轮工具使用的 LLM 智能体进行自适应 alpha 挖掘，在 CSI300 与 CSI500 上取得最高总收益、Sharpe 与 RankIC。
AI.motivation: 公式化 alpha 挖掘需要同时处理非结构化市场描述、历史数据与候选因子的量化评估，但现有方法通常只利用其中部分信号。
AI.method: AlphaPilot 训练多轮工具使用的 LLM 智能体：以市场描述为条件，提出因子表达式，查询真实数据评估器反馈，并在多轮中更新保留因子池；推理时逐日搜索并更新因子池以适应市场状态变化。
AI.result: 在 CSI300 与 CSI500 的样本外滚动回测中，三次独立运行平均总收益分别为 42.93% 和 54.19%，平均 Sharpe 分别为 2.46 和 2.86；在两个股票池上均取得最高平均总收益、Sharpe 与 RankIC。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用市场文本、LLM 金融知识、真实数据与评估反馈，并通过多轮自适应搜索，可有效提升可解释公式化 alpha 挖掘的表现。

title: [Re] Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning
summary: This paper presents a reproducibility study of ``Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning'', published at ICLR 2025, which proposes an unsupervised adversarial fine-tuning (AFT) method with norm regularisation to enhance the visual interpretability of CLIP's image encoder. We attempt to reproduce the key claims regarding improved saliency map quality, increased concept alignment, transferability to out-of-distribution datasets, and the trade-off with zero-shot accuracy. Beyond reproduction, we propose a saliency-guided regularisation extension that introduces an Energy Pointing Game loss, directly supervising the spatial alignment of Simple Gradient saliency maps with target objects. We evaluate our extension across a range of saliency-loss weights and show that explicit saliency supervision \rev{substantially} improves localisation metrics at a modest cost: the reduction in zero-shot accuracy and adversarial robustness is small at the lowest saliency-loss weight ($w_s=0.2$) and moderate at the strongest setting ($w_s=0.6$). We restructure the codebase for configurable, systematic experimentation.

AI.tldr: 本文复现了ICLR 2025论文"Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning"，并扩展了一个显著性引导正则化（能量指向博弈损失）以进一步提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 验证AFT方法在显著图质量、概念对齐、分布外迁移及零样本精度权衡等关键主张的可复现性，并通过引入显式显著性监督探索进一步改进CLIP视觉可解释性的可能性。
AI.method: 复现无监督对抗微调（AFT）与范数正则化；提出显著性引导正则化扩展，引入Energy Pointing Game损失，直接监督Simple Gradient显著图与目标物体的空间对齐；重构代码库以支持可配置的系统化实验；在不同显著性损失权重下评估扩展方法。
AI.result: 显式显著性监督显著提升定位指标；在最低权重(w_s=0.2)下零样本精度与对抗鲁棒性下降较小，在最强设置(w_s=0.6)下下降中等。
AI.conclusion: AFT方法的关键主张得到验证，所提出的显著性引导正则化扩展能以适度代价显著改善定位性能，且代码库重构支持系统化实验。

title: GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions
summary: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GREAT-ESDD 动态定价与路径规划框架，结合基于 GREAT 的神经 CVRP 求解器与 Thompson 采样偏好学习，在在线当日配送中权衡配送费与路径成本并引导客户选择 OOH 交付，利润较传统求解器提升约 11%。
AI.motivation: 在线当日配送需持续更新路径，且路径成本随客户数量上升；OOH（非上门）交付可缓解成本压力。但有效引导客户选择 OOH 需要动态定价并了解客户偏好，传统路径求解器难以在有限的定价决策时间预算内快速完成多方案评估。
AI.method: 1）基于 Graph-Edge-Attention-Network（GREAT）构建 CVRP 神经求解器，训练其处理不同实例规模与起始条件，支持在条件变化下对部分已执行路径重优化；2）批量并行求解客户选择上门或 OOH 后产生的候选路径问题，估计各选项的配送成本增量以设定动态价格，并在客户决策后直接给出更新路径；3）用带拉普拉斯近似后验的 Thompson 采样在线学习客户偏好。
AI.result: 与动机传统路径求解器相比，在相近的定价决策时间预算下利润提升约 11%；模拟运营仅 5 天后即可成功估计客户偏好，效果优于静态定价策略。
AI.conclusion: 将快速神经 CVRP 求解与在线偏好学习相结合，可在控制路径成本的同时有效引导客户选择 OOH 交付，显著提升在线当日配送的利润与决策效率。

title: When More Memory Fails: Hidden Feasibility Holes in Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Simulator study. Code and execution records: https://github.com/lonewolf15116/dtr-stability
summary: Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization (DTR) trains neural networks under a memory budget by evicting tensors and recomputing them on demand. A natural expectation is that a budget large enough to complete training stays sufficient when it is increased. Using DTR's reference simulator, simrd, to replay the public DTR training traces, we show that this expectation fails. We call the exceptions feasibility holes: memory budgets at which an eviction policy runs out of memory although both a smaller and a larger budget complete, a form of non-monotone feasibility. Under a written sweep protocol with dated amendments, a 0.01-step budget grid shows no such hole for DTR on any of six confirmatory traces, although unresolved timeouts prevent it from establishing monotonicity. Finer sampling finds holes on InceptionV4 (three regions) and U-Net (two regions), in addition to one on the ResNet-32 development trace. Every hole is reproduced by three repeats and by unmodified simrd. For one InceptionV4 pair (0.2343 versus 0.235 of peak memory) we trace the failure to individual allocations. The larger budget avoids one eviction at an operator where the smaller budget was 173,479 bytes short. The extra data it carries forward forces a later eviction of a tensor needed three operators afterwards, and rebuilding that tensor triggers a recomputation cascade that cannot fit. Keeping that one tensor resident under the same budget prevents the failure. The two simple score changes we tested do not remove holes across traces; both add failing budgets on some traces. All results are from simulation, with no allocator model; behaviour on GPU hardware is untested.

AI.tldr: 论文通过DTR参考模拟器重放训练轨迹，发现内存预算充足性并非单调：存在"可行性空洞"（较小与较大预算都能完成训练，中间某预算却OOM）。在0.01步长预算网格下六条确认轨迹未出现空洞（但超时导致无法确证单调性），更细采样在InceptionV4、U-Net及ResNet-32上找到空洞，并定位其中一例为算子级驱逐与重计算级联所致。
AI.motivation: DTR在内存预算下通过驱逐与按需重计算训练网络，直觉上"预算足够即可"，且增大预算应保持可行。作者旨在检验这一单调性预期是否成立，即内存预算与训练可行性之间是否存在非单调行为。
AI.method: 使用DTR的参考模拟器simrd重放公开的DTR训练轨迹；在书面的扫描协议（含带日期的修订）下采用0.01步长预算网格，并对确认轨迹进行更细采样；对每个空洞做三次重复并用未修改的simrd复现；针对一对InceptionV4预算（峰值内存0.2343与0.235）进行逐分配（allocation-level）追踪；另测试两种简单的评分函数改动。
AI.result: 0.01步长网格下六条确认轨迹未发现空洞，但未解决的超时使其无法确立单调性；更细采样在InceptionV4（3个区域）、U-Net（2个区域）以及ResNet-32开发轨迹（1个）上发现空洞，均经三次重复和未修改simrd复现。InceptionV4一例中，较大预算在某算子处避免了小预算差173,479字节的一次驱逐，但额外携带的数据迫使后续驱逐一个三算子之后才需要的张量，重建该张量触发无法容纳的重计算级联；在同一预算下令该张量常驻即可避免失败。两种简化评分改动均不能跨轨迹消除空洞，且在某些轨迹上新增失败预算。
AI.conclusion: DTR的内存预算可行性不具单调性，存在可行性空洞，且该现象可由驱逐决策的级联效应在算子级解释；简单的评分函数调整无法普遍消除空洞。所有结论均来自模拟、未建模分配器，GPU硬件行为尚未验证。

title: When Does Compensating Inherited Quantization Error Help? Mean-Square Guarantees for Layer-Wise Quantization and Their Limits
summary: Layer-wise post-training quantization methods let each layer compensate for the quantization error inherited from earlier layers. We ask under what assumptions such compensation guarantees a network output error no larger than without it. For linear networks of any depth, with the required calibration Gram matrices invertible, if the rounding error of each layer has zero conditional mean and a deterministic second-moment map common to both schemes, as under subtractive dither on an unbounded grid, then compensation with strengths in $[0,1]$ fixed in advance gives a mean-square output error no larger than no compensation, each scheme being followed along its own trajectory. The exact gain separates error removed directly from reduced excitation of later rounding noise. Outside this setting the comparison can fail. With rectified linear activations it fails for two independent reasons: noise changes activation states, and, even when no state changes, the correction moves error from samples on which a unit is inactive to samples on which it is active. With stable activations, commutators between the calibration projection and the activation patterns bound the excess. With a bounded codebook, even unique exact layer-wise minimizers with no overload can give a larger output error. For fixed rounding errors it already fails for two scalar linear layers, refuting a published universal guarantee. An exact residual identity gives the necessary and sufficient condition on a common layer input. All these comparisons hold the calibration input fixed. On two 8B models at 4 bits, fixed half-strength compensation beat uncompensated rounding in every model, text and draw tested, yet no rule for choosing the strength beat a layer-wise rule consistently, and lowering the full-network loss on the data used to choose did not reliably lower it on new text.

AI.tldr: 本文研究逐层训练后量化中"补偿"是否必然降低网络输出误差，给出线性网络在特定假设下的理论保证及其失效条件，并在8B模型上做实证验证。
AI.motivation: 逐层量化方法让每层补偿前层遗留的量化误差，但这一补偿是否真能保证输出误差不劣于不补偿，缺乏严格的假设与反例分析。
AI.method: 对任意深度线性网络，在标定Gram矩阵可逆、各层舍入误差条件均值为零且两种方案共享确定二阶矩映射（如无界网格上的减法抖动）时，分析强度在[0,1]内预先固定的补偿；并给出残差恒等式与充要条件；在ReLU激活、有限码本、固定舍入误差等情形构造反例；在两个8B模型4比特量化上做实验。
AI.result: 在线性网络设定下，补偿的均方输出误差不大于不补偿，增益可分解为直接去除的误差与后期舍入噪声激励降低两部分；该设定之外比较可能失败：ReLU下因激活状态改变及误差从非激活样本转移到激活样本而失败；有限码本下即使唯一精确逐层最优解且无过载也会失败；固定舍入误差下两层标量线性网络即失败，反驳了已发表的普适性保证。实验上固定半强度补偿在所有测试中优于不补偿，但没有选择强度的规则能稳定胜过逐层规则，且降低选择数据上的全网络损失不能可靠降低新文本上的损失。
AI.conclusion: 逐层补偿的误差不增保证仅在严格假设下成立，实际中可能失效；强度选择缺乏稳健规则，需谨慎对待逐层补偿的普适性主张。

title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Quantifying Sharedness and Idiosyncrasy of Meaning
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Preprint under review at Open Mind: Discoveries in Cognitive Science. Data, code and pre-registration: https://osf.io/dc6an
summary: Concepts are the basic units through which we navigate the world and communicate meaning. But do you and I really mean the same thing when we think or speak about a concept? The present study develops a measurement framework for modeling and analyzing interindividual variation in concept representations through sentence embeddings, dense vector representations mapping entire utterances into a shared geometric space. The framework is developed in a theoretical argument and validated, demonstrated, and subjected to robustness checks in a pre-registered study. Short personal definitions, elicited from $N = 125$ participants, are encoded as sentence embeddings and submitted pairwise to a crossed random effects model yielding two concept-level quantities: sharedness ($S_b$), the expected dissimilarity between two randomly drawn individuals, and idiosyncrasy ($I_b$), the person-specific share of total dyadic variance. Two validity tests support the approach: the embedding space fully recovers concept and domain organization from participant definitions even with the target word excluded, and a parameter-free classifier achieves 0.630 accuracy in a within-participant extensional prediction task against a chance baseline of 0.500 and a consistency ceiling of 0.893. The framework finds theoretically interpretable variation in $S_b$ and establishes $I_b$ as a reliable source of dyadic variance across concepts. Results replicate across three encoders varying in architecture and capacity, providing a reproducible and scalable instrument for the empirical study of meaning variation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个基于句嵌入的测量框架，用于建模和分析概念表征的个体间差异，并给出共享度（$S_b$）与特异性（$I_b$）两个概念层面的量化指标。
AI.motivation: 概念是认知与交流的基本单位，但不同个体对同一概念的理解可能存在差异；现有研究缺乏可扩展、可复现的量化工具来刻画概念表征的个体间变异。
AI.method: 通过理论论证构建框架，并在预注册研究中验证：采集 $N=125$ 名被试的简短个人定义，将其编码为句嵌入，成对输入交叉随机效应模型，得到共享度 $S_b$（随机两个体间期望不相似度）和特异性 $I_b$（个体特异的二元方差占比）。
AI.result: 两项效度检验支持该方法：即使排除目标词，嵌入空间仍能恢复概念与领域结构；无参数分类器在被试内扩展性预测任务中达到 0.630 准确率（随机基线 0.500，一致性上限 0.893）。框架发现 $S_b$ 具有理论可解释的变异，并确认 $I_b$ 是跨概念可靠的二元方差来源。
AI.conclusion: 结果在三种不同架构与容量的编码器上均可复现，为意义变异的实证研究提供了可复现、可扩展的测量工具。

title: CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection
summary: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. The dataset provides a definitive longitudinal benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in both operational management and security monitoring. We demonstrate that annual seasonality is the dominant periodic component. Moreover, we show that a forecasting model can exploit the annual component only when its training window covers at least one complete annual cycle, which no sub-year dataset provides.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了CESNET-TimeSeries26数据集，包含995天连续网络流量时间序列及一个约4.5年的子网数据，为长周期网络流量预测提供纵向基准，并验证了年度季节性是最主要周期成分。
AI.motivation: 现有公开网络流量数据集时长过短，无法支撑需覆盖年度季节性与行为漂移的长期预测评估。作者希望解决长期评估缺乏多年度数据的问题。
AI.method: 构建CESNET-TimeSeries26数据集，采集自CESNET3网络，包含995天连续流量时间序列，以及一个约4.5年的单一子网数据；覆盖278,466个IP地址、285个机构、566个机构子网，并提供三种聚合间隔。基于该数据集评估年度季节性及预测模型对年度成分的利用能力。
AI.result: 年度季节性是主导周期成分；预测模型只有在训练窗口覆盖至少一个完整年度周期时才能利用年度成分，而现有不足一年的数据集无法提供这一条件。
AI.conclusion: CESNET-TimeSeries26为运营管理与安全监控中的预测模型评估提供了权威的纵向基准，并强调了长周期、跨年度数据对网络流量预测研究的重要性。

title: DPAL: A Test-Time Adaptation Loss for Financial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables time series forecasters to update after deployment as new observations become available. However, adaptation objectives that focus primarily on prediction errors at individual time steps do not fully address the needs of financial time series forecasting. In addition to pointwise return fitting, return direction and the price trajectories reconstructed from sequences of returns are also important. To better account for these properties, we introduce Direction- and Price-Aware Adaptation Loss (DPAL), which combines pointwise return fitting with directional and price-calibration terms. We apply DPAL within existing TSF-TTA frameworks without modifying the source forecaster or the adapter architecture. Across a diverse collection of financial datasets, DPAL reduces reconstructed-price mean squared error in most evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 提出DPAL损失，将逐点收益拟合与方向项、价格校准项结合用于金融时序TTA，在多数数据集上降低重构价格MSE。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA目标主要关注单时间步预测误差，未充分满足金融时序需求：除逐点收益拟合外，收益方向与由收益序列重构的价格轨迹同样重要。
AI.method: 设计Direction- and Price-Aware Adaptation Loss（DPAL），融合逐点收益拟合、方向项与价格校准项；将其嵌入现有TSF-TTA框架，不改动源预测器与适配器结构。
AI.result: 在多样化金融数据集上，DPAL在多数评测设置下降低重构价格均方误差（MSE）。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入方向与价格感知的适配目标，可在不改变模型架构的前提下提升金融时序TTA效果。

title: Making Tensor Decoupling More Robust and Less Parametric
summary: Tensor decoupling algorithms recover compact representations of multivariate functions by combining linear factor matrices with univariate internal nonlinearities. We identify two limitations of recent methods. First, their performance is not invariant to mismatched output or gradient magnitudes, and second, their spline internals require manual tuning of their degrees of freedom. We propose two lightweight fixes. The first is a preprocessing step that rescales the input Jacobian tensor, removing both the bias towards larger magnitude outputs and the ill-conditioning of certain factor updates caused by such a mismatch. The second replaces B-spline internals by penalized splines coupled with generalized cross-validation, making the method less dependent on the user selecting the right number of control points. Finally, we release an efficient open-source JAX implementation of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文针对张量解耦算法的两个局限（对输出/梯度尺度不匹配不具不变性、样条内部需人工调参），提出两项轻量级改进：输入Jacobian张量重缩放预处理，以及用带广义交叉验证的惩罚样条替代B样条，并开源JAX实现。
AI.motivation: 现有张量解耦方法存在两个问题：一是性能对输出或梯度幅度的不匹配不具有不变性，二是其样条内部结构需要人工调节自由度。这限制了方法的鲁棒性与易用性。
AI.method: 提出两个轻量级修正。其一为预处理步骤：对输入Jacobian张量进行重缩放，消除对大数值输出的偏置，以及由此类不匹配导致的某些因子更新的病态问题。其二将B样条内部替换为惩罚样条并结合广义交叉验证（GCV），降低对用户选择控制点数量的依赖。此外发布基于JAX的高效开源实现。
AI.result: 重缩放预处理消除了对大数值输出的偏好及因子更新病态；惩罚样条加GCV使方法对控制点数选择更不敏感。作者同时提供了高效的JAX开源实现。
AI.conclusion: 通过Jacobian重缩放与惩罚样条/GCV两项轻量修改，可在不增加重度计算负担的情况下提升张量解耦算法对幅度不匹配的鲁棒性与样条超参数的自动化程度，并提供开源实现以促进应用。

title: REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary:
Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis.
  We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

AI.tldr: REPRO是一个纯黑盒的进化式对抗提示优化框架，仅用单张消费级GPU上的7B开源反思模型驱动，通过语义交叉与Thompson Sampling策略选择，在36个目标模型上单轮实现100%攻击成功率（中位24次查询），但该数值受评判器同为优化器、搜索接受即停止等协议条件限定。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队方法存在三类局限：需要生产环境中不可得的高权限访问、依赖按模型人工设计的模板、或仅优化单一目标而缺乏群体层面的多样性。因此需要一种无需特权、无需逐模型模板、且具备多样性的黑盒对抗提示生成方法。
AI.method: REPRO采用纯黑盒进化优化：由压缩的7B开源反思模型在单张消费级GPU上全程驱动。引入两个此前缺失的机制，并通过组件消融实验单独验证：(1) 语义交叉——LLM引导的多父代重组算子；(2) 基于Thompson Sampling的贝叶斯策略选择，由结构化失败分析提供信息。
AI.result: 在AdvBench、JailbreakBench和HarmBench上，覆盖11个家族共36个目标模型（含GPT-5-nano、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Grok-4.1），协议下每个被评估目标均在单轮达到100% ASR，每行为中位24次目标查询。所有基线数据转录自原始论文，其评判器、预算与模型版本各不相同，故本文定位为单一协议下的模型覆盖目录而非直接排名。
AI.conclusion: REPRO在统一协议下实现了对所有评估目标单轮100% ASR，但该结果受两项协议性质限定：优化中为候选打分的评判器同时产生所报告的ASR，且搜索一旦接受即停止，因此ASR反映的是迭代预算内搜索是否成功，而非固定预算下的成功率。论文将这两点限定作为核心讨论内容。

title: Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for spatial text-to-image generation, but existing work largely focuses on policy optimization, assuming accurate rewards and effective online rollouts. We observe in-domain gains with out-of-domain degradation, exposing two limitations: unreliable spatial rewards in open-world settings and rollouts lacking basic-to-complex progression. We propose a curriculum-guided RL framework. First, we introduce SpatialCritic, an agentic reward model equipped with a spatial perception harness that combines reusable verification guidance with specialized vision tools. We then construct spatial preference datasets through targeted counterfactual perturbations and perform agent-harness alignment to improve tool selection and evidence integration efficiently. Second, curriculum learning organizes shared foundational capabilities and their compositional dependencies in a capability graph for mastery-guided rollouts, periodic review, and targeted remediation. On SpaRW-Eval, SpatialCritic achieves 95.1% verification accuracy, outperforming 320B GLM-5.3-Flash with a 40x smaller 8B backbone and raising average baseline scores from 78.4 to 83.9 on SD3.5-Medium and 83.2 to 86.5 on BAGEL. Project page: https://xiaofeng-tan.github.io/projects/spatialcritic/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出课程引导的强化学习框架，通过构建空间感知奖励模型 SpatialCritic 并引入课程学习机制，解决开放世界中空间奖励不可靠与 rollout 缺乏由简到繁进阶的问题，在空间文本到图像生成任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有面向空间文本到图像生成的强化学习工作主要聚焦于策略优化，默认奖励准确且在线 rollout 有效。然而作者观察到域内收益伴随域外性能退化，暴露出两个关键局限：开放世界场景下空间奖励不可靠，以及 rollout 过程缺乏从基础到复杂的渐进性。
AI.method: 提出课程引导的强化学习框架。其一，设计 SpatialCritic，即配备空间感知 harness 的智能体式奖励模型，将可复用的验证指南与专用视觉工具相结合；通过定向反事实扰动构建空间偏好数据集，并进行 agent-harness 对齐，以高效提升工具选择与证据整合能力。其二，引入课程学习，在能力图中组织共享基础能力及其组合依赖关系，实现掌握度引导的 rollout、周期性复习与针对性补救。
AI.result: 在 SpaRW-Eval 上，SpatialCritic 达到 95.1% 的验证准确率，以小 40 倍的 8B 骨干超越 320B 的 GLM-5.3-Flash；在 SD3.5-Medium 上将基线平均分从 78.4 提升至 83.9，在 BAGEL 上从 83.2 提升至 86.5。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过构建可靠的空间感知奖励模型并结合课程引导的 rollout 策略，可有效缓解开放世界奖励不可靠与训练渐进性不足的问题，从而显著提升空间文本到图像生成的强化学习效果，且以更小模型实现更强验证性能。

title: ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Project website: https://asigameworld.github.io/
summary: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

AI.tldr: 提出ASIWorld生存沙盒环境，用于评估自主智能体在持续交互中能否将目标转化为连贯行动。
AI.motivation: 评估自主智能体需考察其能否在长时交互中将目标转化为连贯行动；在持久化环境中，这要求在不完全观测下协调相互依赖的行动、处理延迟效应，并随早期决策改变后续机会而动态适应，现有评估对此覆盖不足。
AI.method: 构建ASIWorld生存沙盒：结合持久化的世界与角色状态、以角色为范围的观测，以及可编程的异步接口；智能体通过直接动作或模型调用间隙持续运行的智能体自编程序，完成相互依赖的生产与探索任务。评估指标包括任务成功率、发展成就达成度、生存代价，并辅以执行行为分析。
AI.result: 在统一测试框架下探索性研究九种智能体配置：八种完成生产任务，六种同时完成两项任务。执行轨迹与不同难度下的表现分析显示，任务结果相近的配置在准备、战斗和恢复行为上存在差异；准备不充分与进度停滞相关，而完成任务的配置在生存代价与额外成就标准达成上各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 研究说明，应从任务结果与达成任务所伴随的行为和代价两方面综合评估持续目标执行能力。

title: Clinical value claims in multimodal AI outpace supporting evidence
summary: Multimodal prediction models add a data source, such as imaging or an assay, to clinical information, and health systems must decide whether that added test is worth acquiring. We audited 177 studies comparing multimodal with unimodal models: 81 from a systematic review and 96 from a probability sample of 2025-2026 PubMed records. Gains in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) were smaller when a study fitted a separate model for every data source (adjusted difference, -0.030; 95% CI, -0.056 to -0.005). Within 78 such studies, leaving out the strongest source's model would have raised the average gain from 0.046 to 0.108. This complete benchmarking fell from 69.1% of review studies to an estimated 46.0% of recent ones. An estimated 22% assessed decision utility and none evaluated a model prospectively, yet most claimed potential clinical usefulness or improved care (84.0% and an estimated 87.7%).

AI.tldr: 审计177项多模态与单模态预测模型对比研究，发现"完整基准比较"（为每个数据源单独建模）的报告比例从69.1%降至约46.0%，且该做法与更小的AUROC增益相关。
AI.motivation: 多模态预测模型引入影像、检测等额外数据源，卫生系统需判断新增检测是否值得获取；因此需要评估多模态相对单模态的实际增益是否被合理、公平地估计。
AI.method: 审计177项研究：81项来自系统综述，96项来自2025—2026年PubMed记录的概率抽样。比较各研究的建模方式，重点考察是否对每个数据源分别拟合独立模型（完整基准比较），并进行校正后的差异分析。
AI.result: 对每个数据源单独建模的研究，AUROC增益更小（校正后差异-0.030；95% CI：-0.056~-0.005）。在78项此类研究中，若剔除最强数据源的模型，平均增益由0.046升至0.108。完整基准比较的比例从综述研究的69.1%降至近期研究的估计46.0%。约22%评估了决策效用，无一开展前瞻性验证，但多数声称具有潜在临床价值或可改善诊疗（84.0%及估计87.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 多模态模型增益常被高估：缺乏对每个数据源的独立基准比较会夸大增益。多数研究证据等级有限（无前瞻性验证、少评估决策效用），却普遍作出临床价值声明，建议研究规范化并加强完整基准报告。

title: FedLoRD: Personalized Federated Learning based on Low-Rank Structures of Model Parameter Differences
summary: We propose FedLoRD, a personalized federated learning (PFL) method based on the low-rank structure of the differences between the global and personalized model parameters. PFL is a branch of federated learning that aims to learn models tailored to the local data of each client under biased local data distributions. In its local training, each client learns a personalized model by regularizing the difference between its model parameters and the global ones sent from the server. The regularization function needs to be designed with priors on the model parameter difference; however, the existing PFL methods rely on empirical choices (e.g., $\ell_1$- and $\ell_2$-norms), which do not take into account the actual characteristics of the difference. The resulting mismatch of priors can lead to suboptimal personalized models. To address this issue, we propose a PFL method whose regularizer is built on an observed characteristic of the model parameter differences: they are approximately low-rank at every layer. In our method, we first formulate a local training problem with nuclear norm regularization on the layer-wise differences. We further rewrite this problem via the factorized representation of the nuclear norm so that it can be efficiently solved by a plain stochastic gradient descent method. Image classification experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that FedLoRD outperforms several existing PFL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FedLoRD，利用全局与个性化模型参数差异的近似低秩特性，用核范数正则化实现个性化联邦学习，在三个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 个性化联邦学习（PFL）需学习适配各客户端本地数据的模型以应对偏斜的本地数据分布。客户端本地训练时通过对个性化模型与服务器下发的全局模型参数之差进行正则化来实现个性化。正则化函数的设计依赖于对参数差异的先验假设，但现有PFL方法多采用经验性选择（如ℓ1、ℓ2范数），未考虑差异的真实特征，先验与实际的失配会导致个性化模型次优。
AI.method: 观察到模型参数差异在每一层上近似低秩，据此设计正则项。首先构造对逐层差异施加核范数正则化的本地训练问题；再利用核范数的因子分解表示对该问题进行改写，使其可由普通随机梯度下降（SGD）高效求解。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的图像分类实验表明，FedLoRD优于若干现有PFL方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于参数差异低秩特性的正则化能够更贴合实际先验，缓解先验失配问题；配合核范数因子分解可保持训练效率，为个性化联邦学习提供了一种有效方案。

title: A Step in the Right Place: Understanding and Optimizing Timestep Placement in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models represent an emerging paradigm for language modeling. They generate text in parallel by iteratively refining continuous representations and mapping them back to tokens through a decoder. However, realizing the efficiency advantage of parallel generation requires maintaining generation quality with only a few denoising steps. Even when the number of steps is fixed, their placement along the denoising trajectory remains flexible. In this paper, we demonstrate that changing timestep placement alone can substantially alter the final latent representations and thereby affect the decoded token distributions. Building on these findings, we introduce StepTune, an algorithm that searches for timestep placements that improve generation quality. The search is conducted on a small calibration set and guided by a language-aware objective, with the model and sampling budget fixed. Once calibrated, the timestep placement is fixed and reused across inputs. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in unconditional generation perplexity and conditional task metrics across all evaluated sampling budgets. In particular, StepTune enables 16-step sampling with a frozen model to outperform its native 64-step baseline on both XSum summarization and WMT14 translation and reduces end-to-end latency by approximately $3.8\times$. These results establish timestep placement as a practical means of improving the quality-efficiency trade-off in continuous diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: 提出 StepTune，通过在小型校准集上搜索最优时间步放置，在固定采样预算下提升连续扩散语言模型的生成质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型通过迭代精炼连续表示并解码为 token 实现并行生成，但要发挥并行生成的效率优势，需在极少去噪步数下保持生成质量。步数固定时，时间步在去噪轨迹上的放置方式仍具灵活性，此前未被充分利用。
AI.method: 论文首先证明仅改变时间步放置即可显著改变最终隐表示，进而影响解码后的 token 分布。基于此提出 StepTune：在小型校准集上，以语言感知目标函数为引导，在模型与采样预算固定的前提下搜索能提升生成质量的时间步放置；校准后该放置固定并在不同输入间复用。
AI.result: 在评估的所有采样预算下，无条件生成困惑度与条件任务指标均有稳定提升。尤其 StepTune 使冻结模型以 16 步采样在 XSum 摘要和 WMT14 翻译上超过其原生 64 步基线，端到端延迟降低约 3.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 时间步放置可作为改善连续扩散语言模型质量—效率权衡的实用手段。

title: CAST: Real-Time Motion Capture for Any Skeleton Topology
summary: This paper studies the problem of recovering motion from monocular video, even when the target skeleton topology differs from the subject observed in the video. Although previous methods have made efforts to resolve this problem, they remain vulnerable to joint-rotation errors that are coupled across the skeleton and can propagate along its kinematic hierarchy. To mitigate these errors, we present CAST, a topology-aware motion capture framework that combines learned local rotations with geometric correction guided by predicted global bone directions. Our observability analysis characterizes which rotational components can be constrained by outgoing bone directions. Guided by this analysis, GRACE uses reliability-gated alignment to correct composed orientations in parent-to-child order, leaving unconstrained components to the learned rotation predictor. The motion predictor and correction module are trained jointly with motion-derived supervision, using a frozen image encoder. Experiments under the TopoCap evaluation protocol show that the proposed framework improves motion recovery across different target topologies, including unseen structures. Reference-based cross-skeleton evaluation on a curated Mixamo benchmark and a user preference study further assess transfer to different target structures. A causal CAST-B variant achieves over 51 FPS on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, with timing covering image encoding and motion prediction. Code repository: https://github.com/fankewen/CAST.

AI.tldr: 提出CAST拓扑感知动作捕捉框架，通过预测全局骨骼方向进行几何校正，缓解跨骨架关节旋转误差耦合与传播问题。
AI.motivation: 单目视频恢复运动时，目标骨架拓扑可能与视频中主体不一致，已有方法易产生跨骨架耦合并沿运动学层级传播的关节旋转误差。
