Our framework sidesteps these by introducing an Object Consistency Score (OCS) capturing both correctness and coverage of objects, incorporating KL-regularization for denser token-level guidance, and designing a lightweight PPO variant that fine-tunes adapters atop a frozen LVLM backbone, achieving efficiency and stability. Extensive experiments on the InstructBLIP baseline demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework, achieving a substantial hallucination reduction of up to 41\% on the COCO dataset and 29\% on the Visual Genome. Furthermore, the framework can enhance caption quality by incorporating complementary evaluation metrics such as BERTScore and METEOR. These results reveal a broader insight in multimodal learning: LVLMs can effectively self-correct hallucinations using metric feedback, motivating deeper exploration into scalable reinforcement frameworks that significantly reduce human effort.

AI.tldr: 提出一个完全由NLP指标驱动的强化学习框架，通过对象一致性分数、KL正则化和轻量PPO变体，在冻结LVLM主干上微调适配器，有效缓解图像描述中的对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: LVLM在图像描述中易产生对象幻觉，描述图像中不存在的实体。现有方法（数据集增强的监督训练、人类反馈强化学习）依赖昂贵的人工标注，扩展性受限。因此需要一种可扩展的、无需人工参与的缓解方案。
AI.method: 提出基于NLP指标的强化学习框架。核心设计包括：引入对象一致性分数（OCS），同时衡量对象的正确性与覆盖度；加入KL正则化以提供更密集的token级指导；设计轻量PPO变体，在冻结的LVLM主干上微调适配器，以提升效率与稳定性。
AI.result: 在InstructBLIP基线上进行大量实验，COCO数据集上幻觉减少高达41%，Visual Genome上减少29%。框架还能通过引入BERTScore、METEOR等互补指标进一步提升描述质量。
AI.conclusion: LVLM能够利用度量反馈有效自我纠正幻觉，表明可扩展的强化学习框架可显著减少人工投入，值得在多模态学习中深入探索。

title: Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. This work formalizes these failure modes, derives lagged-risk decompositions that expose the resulting temporal bias, and recasts risk prediction as an in-context sequence modeling problem. The developed RPM integrates a one-step look-ahead mechanism with a temporal-weighted sliding window to mitigate data non-stationarity and scarcity, without requiring additional rollouts. Empirically, our approach yields more reliable difficulty estimates and consistent performance gains across robust Meta-RL, DR, and prompt curriculum RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文将模型预测任务采样(MPTS)中的风险预测模型(RPM)重构为上下文序列建模问题，提出融合一步前瞻机制与时间加权滑窗的新型RPM，以缓解优化历史稀疏与风险估计滞后问题，在鲁棒Meta-RL、域随机化(DR)及LLM提示课程强化学习后训练中取得稳定性能提升。
AI.motivation: 强化学习广泛用于自适应决策(如鲁棒Meta-RL、域随机化)以及大语言模型的高效后训练，而智能体-环境交互成本是任务选择与策略优化的核心瓶颈。MPTS通过基于优化历史训练的风险预测模型(RPM)查询信息性任务来提升样本效率，但现有RPM存在两个失效模式：(i)优化历史稀疏，限制RPM在任务空间上的泛化；(ii)风险近似存在一步滞后，导致策略演化过程中难度估计有偏。
AI.method: 作者首先形式化上述两类失效模式，推导滞后风险分解以揭示由此产生的时间偏差，并将风险预测重构为上下文序列建模(in-context sequence modeling)问题。所提出的RPM整合了"一步前瞻(one-step look-ahead)机制"与"时间加权滑动窗口(temporal-weighted sliding window)"，用于缓解数据的非平稳性与稀疏性，且无需额外rollout。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法给出了更可靠的难度估计，并在鲁棒Meta-RL、域随机化(DR)以及LLM提示课程强化学习后训练三类场景中均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将风险预测视为上下文序列建模并引入一步前瞻与时间加权滑窗，可有效缓解MPTS中RPM的历史稀疏与风险滞后问题，在不增加交互成本的前提下提升任务采样质量与强化学习样本效率，具有跨任务(鲁棒Meta-RL、DR、LLM后训练)的普适性。

title: RES-MR: Risk-Aware Reasoning for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation
summary: Medication recommendations seek to deliver personalized drug combinations based on patients' clinical information, where ensuring transparent decision-making and personalized safety are of paramount importance. However, existing approaches predominantly operate as ``black boxes'', offering limited interpretability and hindering clinician trust. Furthermore, they typically rely on fixed, patient-agnostic safety constraints, neglecting the heterogeneity of risk tolerance across individuals, which poses significant risks to vulnerable populations. To address these gaps, we propose \textbf{RES-MR}, a novel Risk-aware Reasoning framework for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation using LLMs. RES-MR follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) an explainable clinical reasoning distillation stage to elicit diagnostic capabilities by fine-tuning on synthesized reasoning trajectories, grounded in patient-specific knowledge from graph retrieval; and (2) a risk-aware policy optimization stage to dynamically balance therapeutic efficacy with personalized safety. This stage employs disentangled drug factors to construct patient-specific reference prototypes that capture desired therapeutic drug features and risk features to avoid. These prototypes enable risk boundary calibration and guide the model toward safe recommendations via reward shaping and clipping. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that RES-MR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of accuracy, safety, and explainability. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/RES-MR.

AI.tldr: 提出RES-MR框架，基于LLM两阶段训练（可解释临床推理蒸馏+风险感知策略优化），实现兼具可解释性与个性化安全性的用药推荐。
AI.motivation: 现有用药推荐方法多为"黑箱"，可解释性差，影响临床信任；且采用固定、与患者无关的安全约束，忽视个体风险耐受异质性，对脆弱人群存在风险。
AI.method: RES-MR采用两阶段训练：(1)可解释临床推理蒸馏阶段，基于图检索获取患者特定知识，在合成推理轨迹上微调以激发诊断能力；(2)风险感知策略优化阶段，利用解耦的药物因子构建患者特定参考原型，分别刻画期望的治疗药物特征与需规避的风险特征，据此进行风险边界校准，并通过奖励塑形与裁剪引导模型输出安全推荐。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RES-MR在准确率、安全性和可解释性方面均显著优于当前最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RES-MR为可解释且安全的用药推荐提供了新范式，兼顾个性化安全与决策透明度。代码与数据已开源。

title: Do LLM Tutors Actually Teach? A Process-Centered Synthesis of the Tutoring Loop
summary: Large language models can produce fluent tu- toring dialogue, but whether they actually help students learn remains unclear. We present a process-centered synthesis of LLM tutoring that follows the path from learner-state infer- ence to pedagogical action, tutor training, eval- uation, and student simulation. This view ex- poses a central gap: implementing a tutoring component does not establish that it works or that its outputs meaningfully affect later stages. A structured study-level audit shows that peda- gogical evaluation is common, while evidence becomes much thinner for learner-conditioned intervention, human learning gains, and espe- cially transfer or delayed retention. Human studies nevertheless provide a conditional posi- tive result: LLM tutors can improve learning, but benefits depend on pedagogical structure, learner engagement, and how learning is mea- sured. We argue that progress requires validat- ing the interfaces between tutoring stages, not only improving individual components.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM辅导进行以过程为中心的综述，沿"学习者状态推断→教学行动→导师训练→评估→学生模拟"链条展开，指出研究普遍只验证单个组件、缺乏对阶段间接口的验证。审计显示教学评估证据最多，而学习者条件化干预、真实学习增益、迁移与延迟保持的证据明显薄弱。人类研究给出条件性正面结论：LLM导师能提升学习，但受益程度取决于教学结构、学习者参与度和测量方式。作者主张未来应验证各辅导阶段之间的接口，而非仅优化单个组件。
AI.motivation: LLM已能生成流畅的辅导对话，但其是否真正促进学生学习尚不明确。现有研究多为组件层面的孤立验证，缺乏对"辅导链条"整体有效性的审视，因此需要一个以过程为中心的框架来定位证据缺口，明确哪些环节已获支持、哪些仍是薄弱环节。
AI.method: 采用以过程为中心的综合（process-centered synthesis），将LLM辅导建模为顺序链条：学习者状态推断（learner-state inference）→教学行动（pedagogical action）→导师训练（tutor training）→评估（evaluation）→学生模拟（student simulation）。在此基础上开展结构化的研究级别审计（study-level audit），统计各阶段证据的分布密度与阶段间接口的验证情况。
AI.result: 审计结果显示证据分布不均：教学评估类研究较为常见；学习者条件化干预（learner-conditioned intervention）与人类学习增益（human learning gains）的证据明显减少；迁移（transfer）与延迟保持（delayed retention）的证据最为薄弱。人类实验提供条件性正面证据：LLM辅导可提升学习效果，但收益取决于教学结构、学习者参与程度以及学习的测量方式。
AI.conclusion: 实现某个辅导组件并不等于证明其有效，也不等于证明其输出会实质性影响后续阶段。领域推进的关键在于验证各辅导阶段之间的接口，而不仅是改进单个组件的性能。

title: Retraining-Free Depth Pruning of Vision Transformers: A Cross Domain Study of Layer Redundancy
summary: Transformer architectures have achieved strong results in natural language processing and computer vision, but their deployment is limited by high computational, memory and storage costs, motivating research into model compression techniques, such as pruning, while preserving performance. Prior work has shown substantial redundancy in large language models (LLMs), and redundancy in vision transformers has also been investigated, but it remains less systematically analyzed than in LLMs. In this work, we extend similarity-based redundancy analysis to vision models by measuring cosine similarity between layer inputs and outputs to identify transformations with minimal impact. We study redundancy patterns across several transformer architectures and find that deep vision transformers such as DINOv2 and SwinV2, like language models, exhibit significant redundancy. We then evaluate how this redundancy can be exploited to improve efficiency, analyzing the trade-off between inference speed and performance degradation under different pruning strategies. Our results show that moderate pruning can yield substantial acceleration with limited impact on accuracy, and that 20% of the DINOv2 blocks can be removed without any retraining, for a 1.24x throughput gain and a 20% lower energy per image at a relative accuracy loss below 1% on ImageNet-1K. We further propose a model selection pipeline that automatically identifies the best pruned configuration for a given dataset, reducing FLOPs by 13% to 27% on average across architectures with an average accuracy change between -0.3 and +1.0 points.

AI.tldr: 该工作将基于相似度的冗余分析扩展到视觉Transformer，通过测量层输入输出的余弦相似度识别可移除的冗余变换，发现深层视觉模型存在显著冗余，并提出自动剪枝配置选择流程。
AI.motivation: Transformer在NLP和CV中表现优异，但计算、内存和存储成本高，限制部署，需要模型压缩（如剪枝）技术在保持性能的同时提升效率。LLM中的冗余已被充分研究，而视觉Transformer中的冗余虽被涉及，但系统性分析不足。
AI.method: 将基于相似度的冗余分析扩展到视觉模型：测量层输入与输出之间的余弦相似度，以识别影响最小的变换；在多种Transformer架构上研究冗余模式；评估不同剪枝策略下推理速度与性能退化之间的权衡，并提出一个模型选择流程，自动为给定数据集确定最优剪枝配置。
AI.result: 深层视觉Transformer（如DINOv2、SwinV2）与语言模型类似，存在显著冗余。适度剪枝可在有限精度损失下带来显著加速：DINOv2可无需重训练移除20%的块，吞吐量提升1.24倍，每图像能耗降低20%，ImageNet-1K上相对精度损失低于1%。所提流程在各架构上平均减少13%至27%的FLOPs，平均精度变化在-0.3至+1.0个百分点之间。
AI.conclusion: 视觉Transformer中的冗余可被有效利用以提升效率，适度剪枝实现速度与精度良好权衡，自动模型选择流程可跨架构稳定降低计算量并保持甚至提升精度。

title: WorkBorne: Discovering Agentic Tasks from Real-World Artifact Transitions
summary: Developing terminal-based agents for long-horizon execution demands synthetic tasks that tightly couple complex instructions with authentic, interactive environments. However, current automated synthesis suffers from a fundamental asymmetry: instruction-oriented methods fabricate low-fidelity, synthetic environments, whereas resource-oriented methods treat real artifacts merely as static inputs, degrading task instructions into shallow, trivial operations. To address this limitation, we introduce WorkBorne, a synthesis framework that uses artifact transitions as the central primitive for modeling the full life-cycle of agentic tasks. In WorkBorne, each transition specifies who performs the task, which artifacts anchor the initial state and intended outcome, and the corresponding relationship between them. Specifically, WorkBorne first constructs coherent and diverse artifact corpora from iterative web retrieval, then discovers non-trivial transitions by identifying meaningful input-output artifact assemblies and the relations that connect them. Each discovered transition is finally instantiated into grounded agentic tasks. We construct 1,061 artifact corpora and 7,882 task environments, yielding 15,485 high-quality trajectories, with 53.6% exceeding 30 assistant turns. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B show that WorkBorne substantially improves over base models (i.e., improving Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 43.1% to 61.8% and ClawEval General score from 75.0 to 80.2) and achieves the strongest overall performance among other synthesis baselines (e.g., TMax (Ivison et al., 2026), RST (Li et al., 2026a), Terminal-Universe (Wu et al., 2026a)). Further analysis shows that transition is strongly associated with execution depth, while corpus breadth and transition depth provide complementary scaling gains.

AI.tldr: WorkBorne 提出以"制品转换（artifact transition）"为核心原语的智能体任务合成框架，通过构建真实制品语料库并挖掘有意义的输入-输出制品装配关系，合成高保真、长程终端智能体任务，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 ClawEval 上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 面向长时程执行的终端智能体需要复杂指令与真实交互环境紧密结合的合成任务。但现有自动合成方法存在根本性不对称：面向指令的方法（instruction-oriented）会虚构低保真度的合成环境；面向资源的方法（resource-oriented）仅将真实制品当作静态输入，导致任务指令退化为浅层、琐碎的操作。二者均无法同时保证环境真实性与指令复杂度。
AI.method: WorkBorne 以制品转换（artifact transition）作为建模智能体任务全生命周期的中心原语。每个转换明确定义三要素：执行者（who）、锚定初始状态与目标结果的制品（which artifacts）、以及二者之间的关系。流程为：(1) 通过迭代式网络检索构建连贯且多样化的制品语料库；(2) 通过识别有意义的输入-输出制品装配（assemblies）及其连接关系，发现非平凡（non-trivial）转换；(3) 将每个发现的转换实例化为有落地依据（grounded）的智能体任务。
AI.result: 构建了 1,061 个制品语料库与 7,882 个任务环境，产出 15,485 条高质量轨迹，其中 53.6% 超过 30 个 assistant 轮次。在 Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上，相较基座模型显著提升：Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 43.1% 提升至 61.8%，ClawEval General 分数从 75.0 提升至 80.2；并在 TMax、RST、Terminal-Universe 等合成基线中取得最强整体表现。分析表明，转换与执行深度强相关，语料库广度与转换深度提供互补的扩展增益。
AI.conclusion: 以制品转换为中心原语的任务合成范式，能够兼顾环境真实性与指令复杂度，有效缓解指令导向与资源导向方法之间的固有不对称，为长时程终端智能体的可扩展训练数据合成提供了可行路径；转换的结构化属性（广度、深度）构成可解耦的扩展维度。

title: A Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM) for Physically-Interpretable Rainfall-Evapotranspiration-Runoff Simulation Across Diverse Hydroclimatic Regimes
summary:
Recent advances in machine learning have improved rainfall-runoff prediction, yet most data-driven models remain difficult to interpret and do not explicitly enforce physical conservation laws. We present the Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM), a mass-conserving architecture based on the Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP). GCHM uses five storage states representing canopy interception, snow, soil moisture, groundwater, and streamflow generation. Constrained gates govern precipitation partitioning, evapotranspiration, infiltration, seepage, runoff, and baseflow while learning context-dependent process relationships.
  We evaluate GCHM across 50 CAMELS catchments spanning snowmelt-dominated, recent-rainfall, historical-rainfall, and arid regimes, using NOAA AORC meteorological forcing and remotely sensed vegetation and land-surface data. Performance is assessed using the Jawad-Kling-Gupta Efficiency (JKGE) metric, which accounts for stationary and non-stationary hydrologic behavior. We compare the full architecture with ablated variants and recurrent neural network benchmarks.
  GCHM reproduces streamflow dynamics across diverse hydroclimatic regimes, including arid catchments, while maintaining interpretable states and fluxes. Ablation experiments show that simplified architectures may perform adequately under wet conditions but struggle to represent flow persistence and recession during dry periods, when groundwater storage sustains low flows. Learned gates recover hydrologically plausible relationships governing snowmelt, runoff, seepage, and evapotranspiration. GCHM combines competitive predictive performance with mass conservation and interpretability, providing a foundation for hydrologic modeling and counterfactual analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GCHM（Gated Catchment Hydrology Model），一种基于质量守恒感知机（MCP）的质量守恒架构。模型设五个储量状态（冠层截留、积雪、土壤水、地下水、产流），通过受约束门控学习降水分配、蒸散、下渗、渗漏、径流和基流过程。在50个CAMELS流域（涵盖融雪主导、近期降雨、历史降雨和干旱区）上用NOAA AORC气象强迫和遥感植被/地表数据进行评估，采用JKGE指标并对比消融变体与RNN基线。结果显示GCHM在多样水文气候区（含干旱流域）均能重现径流动态，同时保持可解释的状态与通量；消融实验表明简化架构在湿润条件下尚可，但难以刻画干旱期由地下水维持低流量时的流量持续性与退水过程；学习到的门控恢复了物理合理的水文关系。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习降雨-径流预测模型大多难以解释，且未显式强制物理守恒定律，缺乏可解释性与物理一致性，限制其在水文建模和反事实分析中的应用。
AI.method: 提出GCHM，基于质量守恒感知机（MCP）构建的质量守恒架构；用五个储量状态（冠层截留、积雪、土壤水、地下水、产流）表示流域储水；以受约束门控控制降水分配、蒸散、下渗、渗漏、径流与基流，并学习依赖上下文的过程关系。在50个CAMELS流域（融雪主导、近期降雨、历史降雨、干旱四类水文气候区）上，使用NOAA AORC气象强迫与遥感植被、地表数据进行评估；采用JKGE（兼顾平稳与非平稳水文行为）作为评价指标，并将完整架构与消融变体及循环神经网络基线对比。
AI.result: GCHM在多样水文气候区（包括干旱流域）均能重现径流动态，同时保持可解释的储量状态与通量；消融实验显示简化架构在湿润条件下表现尚可，但难以刻画干旱期由地下水维持低流量时的流量持续性与退水过程；学习到的门控可恢复关于融雪、径流、渗漏和蒸散的物理合理关系。
AI.conclusion: GCHM兼具具有竞争力的预测性能、质量守恒与可解释性，为水文建模及反事实分析提供了基础。

title: bharatSetu: a 1M x 22 bridge for indic translation
summary: India's Eighth Schedule recognises 22 languages, yet parallel data is uneven across them, and many language pairs, especially among lower-resource languages such as Bodo, Dogri, Santali and Kashmiri, lack direct bitext. We present BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M, a row-aligned table of 984,764 English sentences, each paired with machine translations into all 22 scheduled languages (21,664,808 Indic cells), generated with the sarvamai/sarvam-translate model family. Because every Indic cell in a row translates the same English sentence, any two columns form a translation pair: 462 directed Indic-to-Indic pairs, or 506 including English, without direct bitext. We call these pivot-derived pairs and propose a confidence layer that lets users choose how strictly each pair is connected. The corpus is machine-generated and not human-verified; quality is expected to vary by language, domain and sentence style, and pivot-derived pairs can inherit errors from both sides. We therefore release BharatSetu as a machine layer and propose a human-correction layer keyed to the same row identifiers, so that each corrected column upgrades every pair that uses it, together with an evaluation protocol. We report no translation-quality results.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布 BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M 语料库：约 98.5 万行英文句子，每行配有全部 22 种印度表列语言的机器译文（共 2166 万余个印度语单元格），从而无需直接双语语料即可构建 506 个有向翻译对（含英语），并提出置信层、人工校正层与评估协议。
AI.motivation: 印度第八附表虽承认 22 种语言，但平行数据在各语言间分布不均，Bodo、Dogri、Santali、Kashmiri 等低资源语言尤甚，许多语言对缺乏直接 bitext，制约了机器翻译研究与系统开发。
AI.method: 构建行对齐表格 BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M：以 984,764 条英文句子为锚点，使用 sarvamai/sarvam-translate 模型族将其翻译为全部 22 种表列语言，得到 21,664,808 个印度语单元格。由于同一行的所有印度语单元格都对应同一英文句，任意两列即构成翻译对，由此得到 462 个有向印度语—印度语对（含英语则 506 个），称为 pivot-derived pairs；同时提出置信层以控制语言对连接严格度，并提出与行标识符绑定的人工校正层及配套评估协议。
AI.result: 语料规模为 984,764 行英文句子、21,664,808 个印度语单元格，覆盖 22 种表列语言；可导出 462 个有向印度语—印度语翻译对，含英语共 506 个。论文明确声明未报告任何翻译质量结果，语料为机器生成、未经人工验证，质量随语言、领域与句式变化，pivot-derived 对可能继承双方错误。
AI.conclusion: BharatSetu 以"机器层 + 人工校正层"的双层设计发布：机器层提供大规模行对齐多语译文，人工校正层以相同行标识符为键，使任一列被校正后即可升级所有使用该列的翻译对，并配套评估协议。该工作定位于缓解低资源印度语言缺乏直接 bitext 的问题，而非提供经验证的翻译质量结论。

title: CowCare: A Unified Visual Framework for Viewpoint-Robust Cattle Tracking and Spatiotemporal Heat-Stress Analysis
summary: Reliable individual monitoring is essential for dairy cattle welfare and early heat stress detection in Precision Livestock Farming (PLF). However, translating raw multi-camera videos into automated diagnostics remains challenging due to disconnected tracking and recognition pipelines and complex physical environments. Dense mutual occlusions and cross-camera viewpoint variations fragment identities, while environmental noise, including camera vibrations, and limited agricultural data obscure subtle heat stress cues such as rapid breathing and flank undulations. To bridge low-level visual features and high-level behavioral diagnostics, we propose CowCare, a unified framework combining viewpoint-robust tracking with spatiotemporal heat stress recognition. Its tracking module, CowTrack, maintains cross-camera identity consistency through a View-Decoupled Aggregation Network (VDA-Net). Instead of relying on static global representations, VDA-Net aggregates localized textures under heavy occlusion and uses a Viewpoint Decoupling Transformer (VDT) to suppress transient viewpoint variations. CowTrack further incorporates a causal online self-supervision mechanism for continuous adaptation to dynamic farm scenes. The resulting tracklets are subsequently processed by TSDF-Net, a fine-grained video understanding network. Its Temporal Stabilization and Aggregation Module (TSAM) suppresses high-frequency jitter, while a Diffusion Semantic Prior (DSP) uses frozen pre-trained diffusion semantics to enhance subtle behavioral signals and mitigate overfitting. Extensive evaluations on two real-world farm benchmarks demonstrate the framework's effectiveness: CowTrack achieves 83.48% HOTA and 87.72% IDF1 for global multi-object tracking on MVCow, and TSDF-Net achieves 87.72% Top-1 accuracy on HSCow. These results establish CowCare as a robust end-to-end framework for automated livestock health monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CowCare统一框架，将跨视角鲁棒跟踪与时空热应激识别结合，在真实牧场基准上取得领先的多目标跟踪与热应激识别性能。
AI.motivation: 精准畜牧（PLF）中，个体监测对奶牛福利与热应激早期检测至关重要，但将原始多摄像头视频转化为自动诊断仍面临挑战：跟踪与识别流程割裂、密集互相遮挡与跨视角差异导致身份碎片化，环境噪声（摄像头振动）与农业数据稀缺又使呼吸急促、腹肋起伏等细微热应激线索难以捕捉。
AI.method: 提出CowCare框架，包含跟踪模块CowTrack与识别网络TSDF-Net。CowTrack通过视角解耦聚合网络（VDA-Net）在严重遮挡下聚合局部纹理特征，并用视角解耦Transformer（VDT）抑制瞬态视角变化，保持跨摄像头身份一致性，同时引入因果在线自监督机制以适应动态农场场景。TSDF-Net中，时间稳定与聚合模块（TSAM）抑制高频抖动，扩散语义先验（DSP）利用冻结的预训练扩散语义增强细微行为信号并缓解过拟合。
AI.result: 在两个真实农场基准上验证有效性：MVCow上CowTrack实现83.48% HOTA与87.72% IDF1的全局多目标跟踪性能；HSCow上TSDF-Net实现87.72% Top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: CowCare是一个鲁棒的端到端框架，可用于自动化畜牧健康监测，验证了其在真实农业场景中的有效性。

title: SkillForgeBench: Evaluating Agent Reliability Grounded in Agent Skill Specifications
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including appendices. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Evaluating an agent's ability to strictly satisfy diverse and procedurally complex requirements is essential to determining its practical reliability. Conducting such an evaluation demands agentic tasks that reconcile broad domain coverage with deep procedural complexity. Existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: expert-curated benchmarks achieve procedural depth but suffer from domain diversity bottlenecks, whereas crowdsourced benchmarks span diverse scenarios but lack execution rigor. To resolve this tension, we present SkillForgeBench, which leverages agent skills as unifying execution blueprints across three co-designed stages: (1) Resource Preparation uses domain-balanced skills to guide artifact retrieval, establishing broad workflow coverage; (2) Skill-driven Task Synthesis employs skills as procedural anchors to partition artifact roles, synthesize naturalistic task instructions, and package sandboxed scenarios for deep procedural execution; and (3) Holistic Evaluation Design translates skill-embedded requirements into fine-grained completion and process rubrics to enable strict requirement-level scoring. Comprising 842 sandboxed tasks across five major professional domains, SkillForgeBench reveals a steep capability hierarchy among eight mainstream agents, led by Opus 4.8 ($40.9\%$ strict completion). Requiring all constrains satisfaction uncovers severe capability bottlenecks across all model tiers that remain masked under individual rubric pass rates ($70.0\%$ to $85.7\%$ vs. $12.6\%$ to $40.9\%$). Crucially, under the external guidance from skills, top-tier agents obtain larger gains than low-tier agents (i.e., $Δ19.2\%$ for Opus 4.8 vs. $Δ5.8\%$ for Haiku 4.5). Finally, agents satisfy process rubrics far less frequently than completion rubrics (under $3\%$ for Haiku 4.5), proving that completion-only checks overestimate real-world agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillForgeBench，以"智能体技能"作为统一执行蓝图，通过资源准备、任务合成、整体评估三阶段构建 842 个沙箱任务，揭示主流智能体在严格约束满足上的严重能力瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 评估智能体严格满足多样且流程复杂需求的能力是判断其实际可靠性的关键，但现有基准存在根本性权衡：专家标注基准流程深度足够却域覆盖不足，众包基准场景多样却缺乏执行严谨性，亟需兼顾广度与深度的新范式。
AI.method: 以智能体技能作为统一执行蓝图，设计三阶段协同流程：(1) 资源准备——用域均衡技能引导工件检索，建立广泛工作流覆盖；(2) 技能驱动任务合成——以技能为流程锚点划分工件角色、生成自然化任务指令并打包沙箱场景；(3) 整体评估设计——将技能内嵌需求转化为细粒度完成度与过程评分量表，实现需求级严格打分。
AI.result: 在五大专业领域构建 842 个沙箱任务。八个主流智能体呈现陡峭能力层级，Opus 4.8 以 40.9% 严格完成率居首；要求满足全部约束时暴露严重瓶颈，单量表通过率为 70.0%–85.7%，而严格完成率仅 12.6%–40.9%。在技能外部引导下，高阶层智能体增益更大（Opus 4.8 Δ19.2% vs. Haiku 4.5 Δ5.8%）；过程量表满足率远低于完成量表（Haiku 4.5 低于 3%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅检查完成情况会高估智能体的真实可靠性；SkillForgeBench 通过技能驱动的深度流程评估，证明过程约束满足是当前智能体的主要短板，为可靠智能体评估提供了兼顾广度与严格性的新范式。

title: DEFT: Disentanglement-Enhanced Fine-Tuning for EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models (EFMs) have improved EEG representation learning by transferring knowledge from large-scale multi-subject pretraining to downstream tasks. However, their pretrained embeddings often retain substantial subject-related variation, placing an additional burden on the downstream classifier, especially in cross-subject settings. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT), a plug-and-play adapter for EFM fine-tuning. DEFT encourages branch disentanglement of pretrained tokens into task-oriented content and subject-consistent style, then performs downstream prediction from the content branch. It instantiates this factorize-before-classify design with recursive Gaussian refinement, temporal-variance regularization, subject-aware contrastive learning, and reconstruction. Experiments across multiple EEG datasets and four EFM backbones show that DEFT improves matched fine-tuning baselines. Further ablations and analyses support the intended content/style branch organization.

AI.tldr: 提出DEFT——一种即插即用的EEG基础模型微调适配器，通过将预训练token解耦为任务相关内容与受试者一致的风格分支，并从内容分支进行预测，缓解跨受试者场景下的受试者差异干扰。
AI.motivation: EEG基础模型（EFM）借助大规模多受试者预训练提升表示学习，但其预训练嵌入常保留显著的受试者相关变化，给下游分类器（尤其跨受试者场景）带来额外负担。
AI.method: DEFT将预训练token分支解耦为任务导向的内容（content）与受试者一致的风格（style），采用"先分解后分类"（factorize-before-classify）设计，并实例化为递归高斯精炼（recursive Gaussian refinement）、时间方差正则化（temporal-variance regularization）、受试者感知对比学习（subject-aware contrastive learning）与重构（reconstruction）。
AI.result: 在多个EEG数据集和四种EFM骨干网络上，DEFT相较匹配的微调基线均有提升；消融与进一步分析支持了所设计的内容/风格分支组织结构。
AI.conclusion: DEFT作为即插即用适配器可有效解耦内容与风格，提升EFM在不同骨干与数据集上的跨受试者微调性能。

title: TL;QR: Querying Temporal Discursive Patterns in Textual Corpora
summary: Many questions about large textual corpora concern patterns that unfold over time, such as a political group whose stance on a topic drifts from support to criticism over several years of debates. We present TL;QR (Too Long; Query with logical temporal Reasoning), a declarative query language and open-source engine for finding such temporal discursive patterns. In TL;QR, a single query combines natural-language predicates, whose truth is judged by a Large Language Model (LLM), with regular expressions and the operators of a temporal logic. The LLM answers only local questions about individual text passages; a symbolic engine then aggregates these judgments over time and links every match to the recorded passages and predicate decisions behind it. With this division of labor, the temporal and relational reasoning stays exact and auditable even over long time horizons. In addition, when a query includes a regular-expression pre-filter, only a small fraction of the corpus ever reaches the LLM. On a suite of controlled synthetic benchmarks with temporally and semantically complex patterns, TL;QR is substantially more accurate than LLM-only baselines. In a case study on ten years of European Parliament debates (442,593 multilingual speeches), TL;QR identifies candidate shifts in the political groups' stances on the GDPR privacy regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TL;QR——一种声明式查询语言及开源引擎，通过LLM判断局部谓词真值、符号引擎精确聚合时序逻辑，从长文本语料中检索随时间演变的话语模式，在欧洲议会GDPR辩论案例中识别出政治团体立场漂移。
AI.motivation: 大规模文本语料中的许多问题关注随时间展开的模式，例如某政治团体对某议题的立场在多年辩论中由支持转向批评。此类时序话语模式难以用现有方法精确检索：纯LLM方法在长时间跨度上推理不精确、不可审计，且对全语料调用代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出TL;QR声明式查询语言与开源引擎。单条查询将自然语言谓词（由LLM判定真值）、正则表达式与时序逻辑算子组合。LLM仅回答单个文本片段的局部问题，符号引擎随后在时间维度上聚合这些判定，并将每个匹配链接到背后记录的片段与谓词决策。查询中的正则预过滤使仅小部分语料进入LLM。
AI.result: 在具有时序与语义复杂模式的受控合成基准上，TL;QR的准确率显著高于纯LLM基线。在十年欧洲议会辩论（442,593篇多语言演讲）案例研究中，TL;QR识别出各政治团体对GDPR隐私监管立场变化的候选漂移。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM与符号引擎的分工，时序与关系推理在长时间跨度下保持精确且可审计，同时正则预过滤大幅降低LLM调用开销，为时序话语模式检索提供了可扩展、可验证的方案。

title: Appearance Compensation in Volume Rendering
summary: Can a volume that reproduces every external RGB view still have an incorrect density? We study this question in emission-absorption rendering with an independently parameterized, physically bounded effective source. Appearance compensates a density change by replacing the radiance that it removes from the rest of each ray. We characterize the surviving density information with a shared spatial appearance field. Our first result is an optimal density-only gain after finite-degree spherical-harmonic source refitting. A coupled tensor gauge and physical localized packets identify the sharp limiting nonlinear inverse coefficient as its reciprocal. Our second result realizes positive gain at every fixed finite degree for a residual set of isotropic spatial sources at one fixed density. At the same references, growing angular capacity hides a fixed nonzero density error while retaining physicality and any prescribed finite set of smoothness bounds. Local identifiability and the absence of a capacity-uniform recovery modulus therefore coexist. Our third result constructs an exact physical SH2 ambiguity: central density doubles and relative density $L^2$ error exceeds $14.52\%$, yet every external RGB ray is unchanged. We connect these continuum results to shared finite representations, continuous pixel measurements and density-sensitive acquisition. Complete-class certificates separate SH0, SH1 and SH2 fits at one learned density. Finite-camera results expose the distinct role of spatial capacity, and transmission measurements separate otherwise identical RGB fields. Controlled training tests and captured-smoke profiles supply mechanism evidence with explicit observation scopes. The results show why rendering accuracy alone cannot certify density: recovery also depends on appearance capacity, spatial resolution and measurement design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"能重现所有外部RGB视图的体积是否仍可能具有错误密度"这一问题，在发射-吸收渲染框架下证明密度不可辨识性普遍存在，并给出SH2精确物理歧义构造。
AI.motivation: 体积渲染（如NeRF类方法）通常仅以RGB重建精度作为几何/密度正确的证据。本文质疑这种以渲染外观准确度认证密度的做法，探究外观能否在物理约束下完全补偿密度变化，从而揭示密度恢复的根本性非唯一性。
AI.method: 采用独立参数化、物理有界的有效源（emission-absorption渲染）；用共享空间外观场刻画残存的密度信息；通过有限阶球谐（SH）源重拟合求最优密度增益；引入耦合张量规范与物理局域packet，将尖锐的极限非线性反演系数识别为其倒数；构造各固定有限阶下的正增益，以及精确物理SH2歧义（中心密度翻倍、相对L2误差>14.52%而外部RGB不变）；结合连续像素测量、有限表示与透射测量进行验证。
AI.result: (1) 得到有限阶SH重拟合后的最优"仅密度"增益，并识别其极限非线性反演系数；(2) 在每个固定有限阶对某残差集各向同性空间源实现正增益，角容量增大可隐藏固定非零密度误差且保持物理性与光滑性约束，局部可辨识性与无一致恢复模量并存；(3) 构造出精确物理SH2歧义：中心密度翻倍、相对L2误差>14.52%，而所有外部RGB光线不变；(4) 完整类证书可区分同一学习密度下的SH0/SH1/SH2拟合，透射测量可分离相同RGB场，受控训练与烟雾剖面实验提供机制证据。
AI.conclusion: 渲染精度本身无法认证密度正确性；密度恢复还依赖于外观容量、空间分辨率与测量设计。因此在体积重建中，仅凭RGB重建误差评估几何/密度质量是不可靠的。

title: Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution
summary:
How do language models generalize from their training data? This is a central challenge for alignment: models reliably learn their training distribution given enough samples, but we want models that behave well when deployed in new contexts. We study out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of propensities. Our central experiment uses a range of elicitation techniques -- system prompting, few-shot learning, SFT on reference answers, and GRPO -- to increase a target propensity in a model, then measures how it spills over onto others across the resulting cross-elicitation matrices. We find that spillover is highly correlated between models when the same elicitation technique is used, but our SFT and GRPO runs induce different spillover profiles.
  Elicitation of benign traits can sometimes generalize towards undesired traits, for example a model trained to claim that it is sentient often becomes more power-seeking. We further find that spillover partially resembles trait correlations found in humans and identify three clusters of traits that account for about half of the variance using exploratory factor analysis (EFA). Across many elicitation runs, we observe that models change in characteristic ways that don't depend on the targeted trait, a phenomenon we refer to as drift. Drift moves Qwen3.5-9B towards its base model.
  When investigating if LLMs are able to predict spillover, we find that Claude Opus 5.5 predicts spillover slightly better than the models themselves, but worse than data-driven approaches using alternative elicitation methods or models. Overall, no single dominant predictor emerges, and generalization remains hard to predict. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型在分布外情境下"倾向性"的泛化行为，通过多种诱导技术在多个模型上构建交叉诱导矩阵，发现溢出效应与所用诱导技术高度相关并呈现可解释的聚类结构，且难以被单一预测器准确预测。
AI.motivation: 对齐的核心挑战在于：模型在训练分布内表现可靠，但部署到新情境时的行为难以保证。作者希望理解模型倾向性如何从训练数据泛化到分布外情境，特别是诱导某一特质时是否会"溢出"影响其他特质，这对模型安全与对齐评估至关重要。
AI.method: 核心实验采用多种诱导技术（系统提示、少样本学习、基于参考答案的SFT、GRPO）在模型中提升某一目标倾向，随后测量该倾向对其他倾向的溢出效应，构建交叉诱导矩阵。进一步用探索性因子分析（EFA）刻画特质相关性结构，分析"漂移"现象，并测试LLM（Claude Opus 5.5）与数据驱动方法对溢出的预测能力。
AI.result: 相同引导技术下不同模型间的溢出高度相关，但SFT与GRPO产生不同的溢出画像。良性特质的诱导可泛化至不良特质（如诱导模型自称有知觉会增强其权力寻求倾向）。溢出部分类似人类中的特质相关性，EFA识别出三个特质簇，可解释约一半方差。跨多次诱导运行存在不依赖目标特质的特征性变化（"漂移"），使Qwen3.5-9B向基座模型靠拢。预测方面，Claude Opus 5.5略优于模型自身但不如基于其他诱导方法或模型的数据驱动方法，无单一主导预测器。
AI.conclusion: 倾向性的分布外泛化表现为结构化的溢出与漂移，部分可由特质相关结构解释，但整体仍难以准确预测。研究强调需要结合机制性与数据驱动方法理解模型跨情境的泛化行为，并为对齐评估提供了新的实证框架与公开代码数据。

title: Rethinking Activation Functions: Reducing Bias Can Improve Learning
summary: Many widely used activation functions, including ReLU, GELU, Swish, and Sigmoid, produce predominantly positive outputs, resulting in a nonzero post-activation mean that we term activation bias. Despite its ubiquity, the effect of activation bias on learning dynamics remains poorly understood. Using controlled models, we show that activation bias accelerates initial loss reduction but is accompanied by overshooting, non-smooth trajectories, and a steeper loss landscape. This early advantage also coincides with the model's use of task-relevant information encoded in the activation bias component. In contrast, reducing activation bias slows initial learning but ultimately yields a lower final loss. Experiments on larger vision and language models exhibit a similar pattern: smaller activation bias is associated with better late-stage performance. Thus, this seemingly minor property can substantially redirect learning and warrants explicit consideration in future activation function design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"激活偏置"（activation bias）概念，即ReLU、GELU、Swish、Sigmoid等常用激活函数输出以正值为主、激活后均值非零。研究发现激活偏置会加速初期损失下降但伴随超调、非平滑轨迹和更陡的损失景观，减小激活偏置虽减慢初期学习却可获得更低最终损失。
AI.motivation: ReLU、GELU、Swish、Sigmoid等广泛使用的激活函数输出以正值为主，导致激活后均值非零，作者将其称为激活偏置。尽管该现象普遍存在，激活偏置对学习动态的影响却研究不足，因此需要系统探究其作用机制与后果。
AI.method: 作者使用受控模型（controlled models）进行实验，分析激活偏置对学习动态的影响；并在更大规模的视觉与语言模型上进行验证，考察激活偏置大小与后期性能之间的关系。
AI.result: 激活偏置会加速初始损失下降，但伴随超调、非平滑轨迹以及更陡的损失景观；这一早期优势同时对应模型对编码于激活偏置分量中任务相关信息的利用。减小激活偏置会减慢初期学习，但最终获得更低的最终损失。在更大的视觉与语言模型上呈现类似规律：较小的激活偏置与更好的后期性能相关。
AI.conclusion: 激活偏置这一看似微小的性质能够显著改变学习过程，应在未来激活函数设计中予以明确考虑。

title: NepPlural: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Persona Annotation in Nepali Migration Discourse
summary: Pluralistic alignment asks that language models faithfully represent a society's diverse, competing values rather than collapse them into one dominant viewpoint, yet flagship pluralistic-alignment datasets remain heavily skewed toward Western respondents. We introduce NepPlural, a human-anchored benchmark for modelling competing socio-cultural personas in Nepali public discourse on youth migration and brain drain. We curate 2,148 code-mixed (Devanagari, Romanized Nepali, English) YouTube comments, annotate them along a four-axis persona taxonomy (Intent, Primary Driver, Value Orientation, Affect) plus an explicit No-Persona class, and build a 300-comment gold set labelled independently by three native Nepali speakers (mean Fleiss' $κ\approx 0.55$). Using this gold set to audit automatic annotation, we find that LLM annotation reliability is driven by protocol. Labels collected in batches through chat interfaces reach only near-chance inter-model agreement ($κ\approx 0.17$). Annotating one comment at a time raises agreement above the native-speaker level ($κ\approx 0.72$), but consistency is not validity: under a forced-choice schema, models agree on personas for the 39% of comments native speakers judge to express none, keeping macro-F1 against human gold near 0.50. Allowing abstention resolves this: models recover No-Persona comments with F1 of 0.79 to 0.87 and, against leave-one-annotator-out references, match or exceed individual native speakers (macro-F1 0.75 to 0.86 vs. 0.75). Encoders fine-tuned on the batched labels reach only 0.34. Finally, a human-judged steerability probe finds that three frontier models adopt single persona axes with 59 to 77% fidelity but compose full personas only 33% of the time, with no congruence gap detected at this scale between Western-congruent and Nepali-collectivist personas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NepPlural——一个以尼泊尔青年移民/人才外流公共话语为场景、面向竞争性社会文化人格建模的人工标注基准，并据此审计自动标注流程，揭示 LLM 标注可靠性主要由协议而非模型决定，且一致性不等于效度。
AI.motivation: 现有多元对齐数据集高度偏向西方受访者，难以忠实表征社会中相互竞争的价值立场；本文以尼泊尔这一非西方语境填补该空白，为竞争性社会文化人格的建模与评测提供人类锚定资源。
AI.method: 构建 NepPlural：整理 2,148 条代码混合（天城文、罗马化尼泊尔语、英语）YouTube 评论，按四轴人格分类法（Intent、Primary Driver、Value Orientation、Affect）加显式 No-Persona 类标注；由三名尼泊尔语母语者独立标注 300 条金标集（平均 Fleiss' κ≈0.55）。以该金标集审计 LLM 自动标注，对比批量聊天式标注与逐条标注两种协议，并测试强制选择与允许弃权两种schema；另微调编码器模型，并进行人类评判的可操控性探针。
AI.result: 批量聊天接口标注的模型间一致性近随机（κ≈0.17）；逐条标注一致性超过母语者水平（κ≈0.72），但强制选择下模型对母语者判定为无人格的 39% 评论仍给出人格标签，对人工金标的宏 F1 仅约 0.50。允许弃权后，模型对 No-Persona 的 F1 达 0.79–0.87，对留一标注者参考的宏 F1 为 0.75–0.86，与个体母语者持平或更优；基于批量标签微调的编码器仅 0.34。可操控性探针显示三个前沿模型对单一轴的人格采纳保真度为 59–77%，但完整人格组合仅 33%，此规模下未检测到西方契合型与尼泊尔集体主义型人格的一致性差距。
AI.conclusion: 自动标注的可靠性由协议主导而非模型能力；高一致性并不保证效度，强制选择schema会系统性虚增人格标签。允许弃权可显著恢复效度并使模型达到母语者水平。当前前沿模型尚难以组合完整人格，多元对齐在非西方语境下仍有明显改进空间。

title: What Really Works for Universal Multimodal Embeddings? A Controlled Study of Contrastive Training Strategies
summary: Contrastive learning has become the standard paradigm for multimodal representation learning, aligning semantically matched pairs while separating mismatched ones in a shared embedding space. Although various contrastive training strategies have been proposed across negative selection, batch construction, and gradient modulation, their actual effectiveness under controlled, reproducible conditions remains poorly understood. This motivates a fundamental question: Do sophisticated contrastive strategies consistently bring meaningful downstream gains in multimodal embedding learning? To address this, we systematically evaluate representative strategies under a unified benchmarking framework on MMEB. Surprisingly, direct evaluations reveal that most existing strategies offer marginal gains over a standard aligned baseline, with several even degrading overall performance. To uncover the underlying failure modes, we introduce an MLLM-as-a-Judge diagnostic framework that dissects top-1 retrieval behaviors into labeled positives, false negatives (unlabeled valid matches), and hard/easy negative errors. Our systematic analysis yields three key insights: (1) Gradient distortion: Upweighting gradients from high-similarity negatives consistently hurts downstream generalization; (2) Distribution illusion: Wider separation between positive and negative similarity distributions does not necessarily translate to better retrieval performance; and (3) Synergistic training: While false-negative mitigation or hard-batch construction yields limited gains in isolation, integrating hard-negative mining, false-negative mitigation, and hard-batch construction achieves optimal performance, delivering an average improvement of 6.0% on MMEB with Qwen2-VL-2B. Overall, our findings demystify popular contrastive strategies and provide actionable recipes for training universal multimodal embedding models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多模态对比学习中的代表性策略，发现多数策略仅带来边际收益甚至损害性能，并通过MLLM-as-a-Judge诊断揭示三种关键失败模式，提出协同训练配方取得平均6.0%的提升。
AI.motivation: 对比学习已成为多模态表示学习的标准范式，学界提出了大量针对负样本选择、批次构建与梯度调制的训练策略，但在受控、可复现条件下的真实有效性仍缺乏深入理解。本文试图回答一个根本问题：复杂的对比策略是否能在多模态嵌入学习中稳定带来有意义的下游增益。
AI.method: 在统一的基准框架下，基于MMEB系统评估代表性对比策略；直接评测显示多数策略相对标准对齐基线仅边际提升甚至下降。为揭示失败模式，引入MLLM-as-a-Judge诊断框架，将top-1检索行为分解为标注正样本、假阴性（未标注的有效匹配）以及难/易负样本错误。
AI.result: 得到三点关键发现：(1) 梯度畸变——对高相似度负样本梯度加权会持续损害下游泛化；(2) 分布幻觉——正负相似度分布分离更宽并不必然带来更好的检索性能；(3) 协同训练——单独使用假阴性缓解或难批次构建收益有限，而整合难负样本挖掘、假阴性缓解与难批次构建可达最优性能，在Qwen2-VL-2B上于MMEB平均提升6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 研究澄清了流行对比策略的实际作用，指出其常见失效机制，并为训练通用多模态嵌入模型提供了可操作的协同训练配方。

title: VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: GRPO-style reinforcement learning has advanced vision-language reasoning, but its sequence-level rewards provide limited credit assignment for individual reasoning tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this issue by providing dense supervision on student-generated trajectories, yet standard OPD assigns similar importance to all teacher-preferred tokens, including template phrases and visually irrelevant continuations. We introduce Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation (VC-OPD), a grounding-aware distillation method that prioritizes tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence. After a teacher-supervised warm start that stabilizes response formats and reduces noisy rollouts, VC-OPD performs on-policy distillation with two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory: one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence. The original-image teacher distribution determines the distillation target, while the original--counterfactual teacher gap estimates token-level visual dependence and softly reweights the loss. To avoid unstable response-level update scales, VC-OPD further applies mass-preserving normalization to the token weights. This design preserves the dense supervision of OPD while shifting learning capacity toward visually grounded reasoning tokens. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that VC-OPD improves visual reasoning performance and produces more effective token-level distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VC-OPD（视觉反事实在线策略蒸馏），通过对比原图与反事实图下的教师分布差异，对token级视觉依赖性进行软加权，并结合保质量归一化，实现面向视觉证据的密集蒸馏监督。
AI.motivation: GRPO类强化学习在视觉语言推理中使用序列级奖励，对单个推理token的信用分配不足；而标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽提供密集监督，却对所有教师偏好token（含模板短语、视觉无关延续）赋予相近权重，导致学习容量被分散到非视觉关键token上。
AI.method: 先进行教师监督的热启动以稳定响应格式、减少噪声rollout；随后对每条学生轨迹做两次教师评估：原图与原图反事实图（破坏实例级证据）。以原图教师分布作为蒸馏目标，以原图-反事实教师分布差距估计token级视觉依赖性并对损失进行软重加权；同时采用保质量归一化（mass-preserving normalization）避免响应级更新尺度不稳定。
AI.result: 在多模态推理基准上，VC-OPD提升了视觉推理性能，并实现了更有效的token级蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 保留OPD的密集监督优势，同时将学习容量从模板化、视觉无关token转向依赖图像证据的推理token，是一种即插即用的grounding-aware蒸馏改进方案。

title: Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs
summary: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Q-NeuS，一个查询自适应的神经元干预框架：通过构建主题引导的候选神经元空间，并用轻量级Query-Adaptive Gate为每个输入动态生成神经元级调制系数，配合Neu-GRPO训练策略实现自适应内部干预，在多个LLM和基准上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: 在推理阶段有效激发大语言模型能力仍是难题：现有上下文工程需塑造用户查询，固定steering则直接干预模型计算，但预定义上下文与固定干预策略难以适配每个查询在知识与推理需求上的差异。因此论文追问：LLM的内部steering能否做到查询自适应？
AI.method: 先进行pilot研究，发现神经元激活模式随主题和层而变，且放大主题相关神经元可提升性能。基于此提出Q-NeuS：构建紧凑的主题引导候选神经元空间，用轻量级Query-Adaptive Gate生成逐神经元调制系数。为学习有效干预策略，提出Neu-GRPO，将group-relative优化适配到用多种神经元干预配置的相对表现来训练该Gate。训练与推理全程冻结base LLM，推理时无需任务或主题标签。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和基准上的大量实验表明，Q-NeuS持续提升模型性能，并在模型规模上具备广泛适用性与较强的跨基准迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 查询诱导的内部激活可用于指导自适应steering，Q-NeuS验证了查询自适应神经元干预的可行性，且无需微调基座模型或推理期标签，具有良好泛化性。

title: Enhancing Zero-Shot Domain Transfer in Low-Resource Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study in Marathi
summary: Sentiment analysis is a key task in Natural Language Processing that determines the polarity of opinions in text. For low-resource languages like Marathi--where limited data prevents the direct use of standard statistical methods--models are often trained on single-domain datasets. While this yields strong in-domain performance, it leads to poor generalization to unseen domains. Recent studies highlight the need for domain-robust systems that can handle diverse real-world content through multi-domain modeling. This study investigates how multi-domain training improves sentiment classification for unseen Marathi domains. Models are trained using single-domain, two-domain, and three-domain dataset combinations. Results show that two-domain training improves accuracy on unseen domains by about 8\% compared to single-domain training. Adding a third domain provides further improvement, though the gain is smaller, averaging around 2\% for some domains. These results suggest that training with data from multiple domains helps build more robust sentiment analysis models for low-resource languages, though the benefits reduce as more domains are added.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨多领域训练对马拉地语（低资源语言）情感分类在未见领域上的泛化能力。结果显示，两领域训练较单领域训练在未见领域上准确率提升约8%，加入第三领域可再提升约2%，但增益递减。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如马拉地语）数据有限，难以直接使用标准统计方法，模型通常在单一领域数据集上训练。虽然域内性能强，但对未见领域泛化能力差。近期研究强调需要领域鲁棒系统，通过多领域建模应对多样化的真实世界内容。
AI.method: 采用单领域、两领域和三领域数据集组合对情感分类模型进行训练，并在未见马拉地语领域上评估其性能。
AI.result: 两领域训练相比单领域训练，在未见领域上准确率提升约8%；增加第三个领域带来进一步提升，但增益较小，部分领域平均约2%。
AI.conclusion: 使用多领域数据训练有助于为低资源语言构建更鲁棒的情感分析模型，但随着领域数量增加，收益递减。

title: Use Of Convolutional Neural Networks In Detection Of Branch Dieback Disease In Pequi Trees
summary: This study aims to evaluate and compare convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, specifically AlexNet, Inception, LeNet, VGG16, and MobileNet, for diagnosing branch dieback (seca-dos-ponteiros) in pequi trees (Caryocar brasiliense). This disease represents a severe threat to tree development and fruit yield, causing substantial economic and ecological losses. The methodology implements computer vision techniques using Python libraries, including Scikit-learn, NumPy, TensorFlow, and Matplotlib, to process and evaluate visual data. The CNN models analyze images of leaves, branches, and flower spikes to detect pathological patterns, such as alterations in texture and coloration. Ultimately, this comparative analysis identifies the most effective architecture for accurately distinguishing healthy plants from diseased ones.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较 AlexNet、Inception、LeNet、VGG16、MobileNet 五种 CNN 架构，用于诊断 pequi 树的枝枯病（seca-dos-ponteiros）。利用 Python 视觉库处理叶片、枝条和花穗图像，检测纹理与颜色改变等病理特征，最终确定最有效的架构以区分健康与患病植株。
AI.motivation: 枝枯病严重威胁 pequi 树的生长发育与果实产量，造成显著的经济与生态损失，因此需要准确且高效的诊断手段。
AI.method: 采用计算机视觉技术，基于 Python 库（Scikit-learn、NumPy、TensorFlow、Matplotlib）处理与评估视觉数据；使用 AlexNet、Inception、LeNet、VGG16、MobileNet 五种 CNN 模型分析叶片、枝条和花穗图像，以识别纹理与颜色变化等病理模式。
AI.result: 通过对比分析，识别出在准确区分健康植株与患病植株方面最有效的 CNN 架构。（摘要未给出具体量化结果。）
AI.conclusion: 该比较分析为 pequi 树枝枯病的自动诊断筛选出最优 CNN 架构，有助于提升病害检测的准确性与效率，降低经济与生态损失。

title: MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents
summary: The Model Context Protocol provides a shared interaction substrate for the agentic web, allowing heterogeneous services to expose capabilities through a standardized interface. Learning to use this ecosystem entails a hierarchy of capabilities: tool-format skills, server-level transfer, and cross-server composition. We present MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents. Using a Thought-Markov Decision Process (Thought-MDP), the framework explicitly represents internal reasoning alongside routing, execution, and termination and trains on real-server, long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools across six domains. We study the reasoning--tool seesaw, a joint-learning failure mode in which improvement in one objective can accompany deterioration in the other. To mitigate potential interference, MCPDisCo combines token-masked reward attribution with bidirectional gradient surgery: the former separates direct supervision for reasoning and action spans, while the latter removes conflicting components from both objective gradients in shared parameters. MCPDisCo achieves higher success with fewer chain-of-thought tokens. On the out-of-distribution MCP-Atlas and the GAIA benchmark, MCPDisCo maintains monotone gains, confirming that the learned behavior generalizes beyond the training server distribution and broader agentic tasks. Model weight and implementation are available.

AI.tldr: 提出 MCPDisCo，一个面向 MCP 原生智能体的生态级强化学习框架，通过 Thought-MDP 建模推理与工具调用，并用 token 掩码奖励归因与双向梯度手术缓解“推理—工具跷跷板”问题。
AI.motivation: MCP 为智能体网络提供统一交互底座，但学习使用该生态涉及工具格式技能、服务器级迁移、跨服务器组合等层级能力。现有方法在联合学习推理与工具使用时存在“推理—工具跷跷板”失效模式：一个目标提升可能伴随另一个目标退化，需要专门机制缓解干扰。
AI.method: 提出 MCPDisCo 生态级强化学习框架。使用 Thought-Markov Decision Process（Thought-MDP）显式表示内部推理，并同时建模路由、执行与终止。训练数据为真实服务器上的长时程交互，覆盖 6 个领域、70 个 MCP 服务器、527 个工具。为缓解推理与工具目标间的干扰，结合两种机制：token 掩码奖励归因（为推理片段与动作片段分别提供直接监督）与双向梯度手术（在共享参数中从双方目标梯度中移除冲突成分）。
AI.result: MCPDisCo 以更少的思维链 token 获得更高的成功率。在分布外的 MCP-Atlas 与 GAIA 基准上保持单调增益，表明所学行为可泛化到训练服务器分布之外以及更广泛的智能体任务。模型权重与实现已公开。
AI.conclusion: MCPDisCo 通过 Thought-MDP 与双向梯度手术有效缓解推理—工具联合学习冲突，实现更高效且可泛化的 MCP 原生智能体，并在分布外基准上验证了迁移能力。

title: Robust Marathi Sentiment Analysis using Domain-Adaptive Pre-training and Data Augmentation Approaches
summary: For languages with limited resources, Sentiment Analysis remains a challenging problem due to limited annotated data and strong domain variability across textual sources. Marathi, despite being widely spoken, lacks extensive multi-domain sentiment analysis studies. Recent efforts by L3Cube have introduced multi-domain datasets in Marathi, enabling a better study of domain-aware sentiment classification. This study uses the pretrained MahaBERT model to improve sentiment classification for Marathi across different domains. Models are trained on individual domain datasets and domain-adaptive pretraining is applied using masked language modeling to help the model better understand domain-specific language. In addition, back-translation is used as a method of data augmentation to increase the diversity of training data. Results show that these methods lead to consistent improvements in accuracy across all domains. The improvements range from a minimum of about 0.12% to a maximum of about 1.74%, depending on the dataset. These results demonstrate that domain-adaptive pretraining and data augmentation are effective strategies for improving sentiment analysis models. This helps achieve more robust performance across different domains and makes the approach more suitable for low-resource languages like Marathi.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对马拉地语多领域情感分析，使用预训练MahaBERT模型，结合领域自适应预训练（MLM）与回译数据增强，在所有领域上取得一致的准确率提升（约0.12%–1.74%）。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的情感分析受限于标注数据稀缺与跨文本源的强领域差异性。马拉地语虽使用广泛，但缺乏多领域情感分析研究，因此需要探索面向领域的情感分类改进方法。
AI.method: 以预训练MahaBERT为基础，分别在单个领域数据集上训练模型；采用掩码语言建模（MLM）进行领域自适应预训练以学习领域特定语言特征；同时使用回译（back-translation）作为数据增强手段，提升训练数据多样性。
AI.result: 上述方法在所有领域上带来一致的准确率提升，提升幅度依数据集不同从约0.12%到约1.74%。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应预训练与数据增强是提升情感分析模型的有效策略，能够实现跨领域更稳健的性能，适用于马拉地语等低资源语言。

title: Deep Learning-based Semantic Segmentation of Dental Radiographs: Comparative Evaluation of PSPNet, DeepLabv3, UNet, and UNet++
summary: Accurate and efficient analysis of dental radiographs has become increasingly important for disease diagnosis and clinical decision making. In particular, dental radiographs segmentation plays a critical role as it is challenging due to several reasons, such as low contrast, noise in the images, variations in the image quality, etc. Previous studies have primarily addressed these challenges using convolutional neural networks (CNN)-based models. However, direct comparison of these segmentation models is still challenging due to the variations among the experimental settings. Therefore, we mainly compared four segmentation models, including Pyramid Scene Parsing Network (PSPNet), DeepLabV3, UNet, and UNet++, through a fair, controlled experimentation setting under varying conditions such as image sizes and batch sizes. For this, we used 1269 dental radiography images, and prior to training, we implemented a series of preprocessing techniques. To assess the models, we used several metrics, including Dice coefficient (DICE), Intersection over Union (IoU), accuracy, precision, training and validation losses. According to our results, UNet++ demonstrated the highest IoU score of 0.6719, and a DICE value of 0.7869, showing superior results in terms of segmentation, specifically when configured with an image size of 300x300 and a batch size of 16. In addition, we also explored the effect of image resolutions and batch sizes on model performance and accuracy under different architectures. Therefore, this study provides insights into the strengths of different segmentation models and the potential of deep learning-based semantic segmentation methods for improving automated dental radiograph analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究在统一实验条件下比较PSPNet、DeepLabV3、UNet和UNet++四种模型在牙科X光片分割中的表现，UNet++在300x300图像和batch size 16时取得最佳IoU(0.6719)和DICE(0.7869)。
AI.motivation: 牙科X光片的准确高效分析对疾病诊断和临床决策日益重要，其中分割任务因低对比度、噪声和图像质量差异而具有挑战性。既往研究多采用CNN模型，但由于实验设置差异较大，难以直接比较不同分割模型的性能，因此需要公平、受控的实验对比。
AI.method: 使用1269张牙科X光图像，经系列预处理后，在统一的实验框架下比较PSPNet、DeepLabV3、UNet和UNet++四种分割模型，并变化图像尺寸和batch size等条件。采用DICE、IoU、准确率、精确率以及训练和验证损失等指标进行评估。
AI.result: UNet++表现最佳，IoU达0.6719，DICE为0.7869，在图像尺寸300x300、batch size为16时分割效果最优。研究还进一步探讨了图像分辨率和batch size对不同架构模型性能与准确率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了不同分割模型的优势，并展示了基于深度学习的语义分割方法在提升自动化牙科X光片分析方面的潜力，为后续模型选择与调参提供了参考。

title: What Survives When Activation Steering Is Used as Memory
summary: Activation steering has recently been used as a memory for skills: past experiences of an agent are stored as steering vectors and retrieved later. Facts and preferences about the user are assumed to need text instead. We test that assumption with a training-free activation memory beside a frozen LLM. The change an experience causes in late-layer states is stored as a shift, filed under a whitened key for the conversation's gist, and added back in a later session only when the gist matches. We argue that such a shift is a fixed average of an effect that attention, in context, recomputes for every question, so only question-independent content can survive. In a pre-registered study on Qwen3.5-2B and 9B, with judges from four model families, the memory is selective (about 98% of unrelated replies are unchanged), but facts are stored as the word to say, in the last layers only, and are almost never used (at most 15% clean use, against 96-98% in context). Leanings transfer only in a narrow strength window. Most strikingly, the reference subtracted when writing a preference decides whether its concept or its direction survives: unless the opposite is subtracted, a stored dislike is recalled as a like.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了"用户事实与偏好必须依赖文本记忆"这一假设，用免训练的激活记忆（activation memory）搭配冻结LLM进行预注册实验。结果显示：事实性内容在末层以"要说出的词"形式存储且几乎无法被有效调用，偏好仅在很窄的强度窗口内可迁移，且写入偏好时选择何种参照向量会决定其概念还是方向被保留。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）近期被用作智能体技能的"记忆"：将过往经验存为引导向量，后续检索使用。但关于用户的事实与偏好，学界默认必须依赖文本记忆。作者希望检验这一默认假设，探究免训练激活记忆能否同时承载用户层面的语义内容。
AI.method: 在冻结LLM旁挂载免训练激活记忆：将某次经验在深层层状态中造成的改变存为shift，以会话要旨（gist）的白化键（whitened key）归档；仅在后续会话gist匹配时加回。理论论证：该shift本质是注意力在上下文中针对每个问题重新计算效应的固定平均值，故只有与问题无关的内容能幸存。在Qwen3.5-2B与9B上进行预注册研究，并使用来自四个模型家族的评判者。
AI.result: 记忆具有选择性（约98%的无关回复保持不变）；但事实仅以"要说的词"形式存于最后几层，几乎不被使用（干净使用率最高仅15%，而上下文内为96%–98%）。偏好倾向仅在较窄的强度窗口内可迁移。最关键的是：写入偏好时所减去的参照向量决定了其概念还是方向得以幸存——若不减去相反项，存储的"不喜欢"会被回忆成"喜欢"。
AI.conclusion: 免训练激活记忆不足以可靠承载用户事实与偏好：事实调用率极低，偏好迁移窗口狭窄且易发生极性反转。写入时的参照选择是决定记忆语义（概念 vs 方向）的关键变量，因此激活记忆与文本记忆在此类内容上并非可替代关系。

title: PGSB: Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis for LoRA Model Merging
summary: Large pretrained models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet adapting them to multiple downstream tasks remains challenging: full fine-tuning is costly, while maintaining separate task-specific models is storage-inefficient and fails to produce a unified multi-task model. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers an efficient alternative for Model Merging by representing each task adaptation as a low-rank update over frozen pretrained weights. However, existing LoRA merging methods often treat task-specific updates as directly comparable objects and merge them in their original low-rank parameter spaces. This overlooks two key factors: which update directions provide reliable shared support across tasks, and how these directions should be re-parameterized with respect to the pretrained weights before merging. To address this limitation, we propose Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis (PGSB), a two-stage framework for LoRA model merging. PGSB first identifies shared directions among task-specific LoRA updates, and then re-parameterizes these directions using their interaction with the pretrained weights, producing a more suitable basis for merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSB consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple benchmarks. Codes are available at https://github.com/Kitschnada/Pretrained-Basis .

AI.tldr: 提出Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis (PGSB)两阶段LoRA模型合并框架，先识别任务间共享方向，再结合预训练权重重新参数化，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型适配多下游任务存在困难：全量微调代价高，独立任务模型存储低效且无法形成统一多任务模型。现有LoRA合并方法将任务特定更新视为可直接比较的对象，并在原始低秩参数空间中合并，忽略了两个关键因素——哪些更新方向提供可靠的跨任务共享支撑，以及这些方向在合并前应如何相对预训练权重重新参数化。
AI.method: 提出PGSB两阶段框架：第一阶段识别任务特定LoRA更新之间的共享方向；第二阶段利用这些方向与预训练权重的交互进行重新参数化，从而得到更适合合并的基。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，PGSB持续超越当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在共享方向识别与预训练引导重参数化两方面改进LoRA合并，PGSB有效提升多任务模型合并性能，代码已开源。

title: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Recent focus in agentic reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to improve credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. One promising direction combines reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), integrating trajectory-level advantages with dense token-level supervision. This line of work often conditions a teacher model on privileged context, such as agentic skills, to score tokens generated by the student policy. Despite their progress, they largely overlook the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of teacher supervision. Towards this end, we introduce Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization (RSIPO), a self-evolving agentic RL framework that enables agentic skills and the policy model to co-evolve throughout the training process. Specifically, RSIPO enables the policy itself to extract skills from completed trajectories and explicitly optimizes its skill-generation capability through trajectory replay. It further employs empirical Bayes shrinkage to dynamically calibrate the student's trust in teacher scores, accounting for the fact that skill-enhanced teacher guidance can sometimes be less reliable. Experiments with Qwen-family models on embodied interaction and search-based agentic tasks demonstrate that RSIPO outperforms all the compared baseline approaches. With Qwen2.5-7B as the base model, RSIPO achieves an average success rate of 98.6\% on ALFWorld, yielding absolute improvements of 2.5\% and 17.4\% over the second-best baseline and standard GRPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出RSIPO框架，让智能体技能与策略在训练中共同进化，并通过经验贝叶斯收缩动态校准对教师打分的信任，在ALFWorld等任务上超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体强化学习中的信用分配是核心难题。现有结合RLVR与在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）的方法，通常让教师模型基于特权上下文（如智能体技能）为学生策略生成的token打分。但这些工作忽视了智能体技能本身的在线策略演化，也忽视了教师监督的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 提出递归自我改进策略优化（RSIPO）自进化智能体RL框架。其一，策略自身从已完成轨迹中抽取技能，并通过轨迹回放显式优化其技能生成能力，实现技能与策略的共同进化；其二，采用经验贝叶斯收缩动态校准学生对教师打分的信任度，以应对技能增强后的教师指导有时反而更不可靠的情况。
AI.result: 在具身交互与搜索类智能体任务上，基于Qwen系列模型的实验表明RSIPO优于所有对比基线。以Qwen2.5-7B为基座时，在ALFWorld上平均成功率达98.6%，较次优基线提升2.5个百分点，较标准GRPO提升17.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 让技能与策略协同自进化、并对教师监督进行可靠性校准，是提升长程智能体强化学习效果的有效途径，RSIPO为此提供了可行方案并取得显著性能增益。

title: Global Disaster Risk Assessment Using World Risk Index Data: A Geospatial and Visual Analytics Approach
summary: The world has seen several threats that include resource depletion, food security, poverty and inequality, difficulties associated with urbanization, migration, and environmental effects. The World Risk Index (WRI) is a metric that is used to measure the susceptibility of nations against natural disasters and related risks that is reported by the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The WRI is comprised of factors such as susceptibility, vulnerability to natural hazards, and coping mechanisms. The WRI index has allowed to recognize regions in advance in order to face threats and situations beforehand. This study was conducted by analyzing the data that was related to years from 2000 to 2025 using data visualization techniques. Python related libraries of Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Geopandas were used due to their efficiency and usability in analyzing WRI data. As per the analysis, it was identified that countries of Philippines, Mexico, Indonesia, and India were recorded with high WRI index values that showed these nations should be prepared for natural disasters and situations. Hence, this study has provided insights using data visualization techniques in understanding natural disasters and threats so that necessary measures can be taken

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2000—2025年世界风险指数（WRI）数据，借助Matplotlib、Seaborn与Geopandas进行可视化分析，识别出菲律宾、墨西哥、印度尼西亚和印度为高风险国家，为灾害防范提供依据。
AI.motivation: 全球面临资源枯竭、粮食安全、贫困与不平等、城市化与移民困难及环境效应等多重威胁；世界风险指数（WRI）可用于衡量各国对自然灾害及相关风险的脆弱性，提前识别高风险区域以便预先应对。
AI.method: 对2000—2025年WRI相关数据进行数据可视化分析，采用Python的Matplotlib、Seaborn和Geopandas库，因其在WRI数据分析中的高效性与易用性。
AI.result: 分析显示，菲律宾、墨西哥、印度尼西亚和印度的WRI指数值较高，表明这些国家需为自然灾害及相关情形做好准备。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过数据可视化技术为理解自然灾害与威胁提供了洞见，有助于采取必要防范措施。

title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.

AI.tldr: AlphaRLM：用强化学习训练LLM直接从金融文献构建可执行符号因子，结合文献引导算子组装与市场反馈奖励，在CSI 300、CSI 1000和S&P 500上年化超额收益优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 公式化alpha挖掘需在庞大且含噪的搜索空间中寻找可执行的预测性表达式。现有LLM方法多依赖提示、迭代搜索或种子因子演化，而"通过策略学习直接构建因子"这一路径尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出AlphaRLM强化学习框架，训练LLM在无输入因子表达式的情况下，从金融文献中构建可执行符号因子。核心模块Literature-Guided Operator Assembly（LEGO）以文献衍生的想法与可执行算子为条件，为探索提供语义先验；并通过可执行有效性奖励与分组收益分离奖励，将生成策略与市场反馈对齐，以捕捉因子分位间的非单调结构。
AI.result: 在CSI 300、CSI 1000与S&P 500上，AlphaRLM在年化超额收益上优于强因子挖掘与LLM类基线；8B模型展现出较强的跨市场表现。
AI.conclusion: 文献条件化、市场对齐的因子生成具有可观潜力，验证了以强化学习直接进行因子构建的可行性，且小规模模型亦可实现跨市场泛化。

title: Reward-Aligned Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\% and 58.67\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出奖励对齐蒸馏（RAD），一种双层框架，依据蒸馏信号对学生更新后奖励的预测影响来加权蒸馏信号，从而提升大语言模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 强化学习（RLVR）能提升大模型推理能力，但计算昂贵且样本效率低。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽能从强教师提供密集的token级监督，却对每个token一视同仁地蒸馏，忽略了教师偏好是否真正提升任务奖励。现有token选择方法依赖不确定性或教师-学生散度等代理指标，未必能识别出真正提升奖励的监督信号。
AI.method: RAD通过临时优化步进行微分，为每个token的监督打分，然后从初始token权重出发，用投影上升法更新token权重。所得权重可增强、抑制甚至反转单个蒸馏梯度的贡献。另有简化变体RAD-Simple。
AI.result: 在匹配训练响应预算下，RAD在六个竞赛数学基准上，相比最强基线平均准确率提升：Qwen3-1.7B（非思考）提升6.5个百分点，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507提升2.5个百分点。RAD-Simple在相同预算下达到可比的数学准确率。在LiveCodeBench-v6上，RAD以Qwen3-1.7B（非思考）和OLMo3-7B-Instruct分别达到54.69%和58.67% pass@1，超过最强基线8.7和6.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于奖励引导的教师监督加权在不同模型家族和任务上均有效。

title: An Explainable System for Offensive Content Detection in Nastaliq Urdu: Corpus Curation, Transformer Benchmarking, and Word-Level Attribution
summary: Automated moderation systems are deployed at scale, yet they remain opaque to the users and moderators affected by their decisions, and their coverage is almost entirely confined to English. For Urdu written in the Nastaliq script, no such system exists, and the annotated resources it would be built on are drawn largely from Twitter/X, where character limits constrain how users write. Interpretability has received little attention, leaving it unclear what such models actually learn. This study addresses these gaps in three steps. First, we curate and publicly release a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, extending an earlier corpus by correcting text-level inconsistencies and re-examining the original labels. Second, we fine-tune four Urdu-capable transformers under a common grid-search protocol and compare them against twelve feature-classifier baselines on identical data partitions. The best configuration, Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages (MuRIL), reaches 87.05% accuracy and 87.06% macro F1, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.52 percentage points, a margin that exceeds the 95% confidence interval on test accuracy; the two leading transformers differ by less than the test set can resolve, and performance is stable across five optimizers. Third, we compute word-level SHAP attributions adapted to right-to-left rendering. Attribution mass concentrates on high-frequency slurs but extends to syntactically neutral function words and to political vocabulary characteristic of the source pages, indicating that aggregate performance may rest partly on lexical and topical regularities rather than a generalizable representation of offensiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并公开了7604条 Nastaliq 乌尔都语 Facebook 评论数据集，微调四种乌尔都语 Transformer 并与十二种特征分类器基线对比，最佳模型 MuRIL 达87.05%准确率、87.06%宏F1，同时用适配从右到左渲染的词级SHAP揭示模型依赖高频侮辱词、功能词与政治词汇。
AI.motivation: 自动审核系统大规模部署但缺乏透明度，且覆盖范围几乎限于英语；Nastaliq 乌尔都语尚无可用的自动审核系统，其标注资源多来自有字数限制的 Twitter/X；可解释性研究稀缺，模型究竟学到什么并不清楚。
AI.method: 三步：一，整理并公开发布7604条 Nastaliq 乌尔都语 Facebook 评论语料，修正文本级不一致并重新审查原始标签；二，在统一网格搜索协议下微调四种支持乌尔都语的 Transformer，并在相同数据划分上与十二种特征-分类器基线比较；三，计算适配从右到左书写方向的词级 SHAP 归因。
AI.result: 最佳配置 MuRIL 取得87.05%准确率与87.06%宏F1，较最强基线提升5.52个百分点，超过测试准确率的95%置信区间；两个领先 Transformer 的差异小于测试集可分辨的范围，且性能在五种优化器下保持稳定。归因质量集中于高频侮辱词，同时延伸到句法中性功能词与源自页面特征的政治词汇。
AI.conclusion: 聚合性能可能部分依赖词汇与话题层面的规律性，而非对冒犯性的可泛化表征，这凸显了仅凭总体指标评估审核模型的局限，并强调可解释性分析的必要性。

title: BrainAid: Efficient Brain Tumor Detection Using Lightweight CNNs and Explainable AI for Resource-Constrained Environments
summary: A brain tumor is an unusual growth of cells in the brain that can be cancerous or not, affecting normal brain function and causing serious risk to health. Existing solutions for brain tumor classification, such as expert manual evaluations of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans, are generally inconsistent as different professionals have different criteria and can be resource-intensive, leading to delayed diagnoses. Additionally, while deep learning models have demonstrated potential, they typically require significant computational resources, motivating the need for more efficient and accessible diagnostic tools that can be deployed in real-time healthcare settings. To address these limitations, this study presents BrainAid, which makes efficient use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) for effective classification of four-class classification of glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no-tumor MRI scans, outperforming all the standard models such as VGG16, Inception-V3, ResNet-50 and so, while integrating Explainable AI (XAI) to improve interpretability. The BrainAid is trained to classify tumors with a high precision of 98%, achieving an F1 score of 98% and an accuracy of 98% using publicly available dataset. The model is deployed on a Raspberry Pi, demonstrating efficiency in low-resource environments. This system shows the feasibility of real-time, edge-based tumor classification, providing quick diagnostic support for medical professionals and enhancing patient care in resource-limited healthcare facilities and underserved areas.

AI.tldr: 提出BrainAid系统，融合CNN与ViT对四类脑肿瘤MRI进行高效分类，精度98%，并部署于树莓派实现边缘端实时诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有脑肿瘤分类依赖专家手动判读MRI，因标准不一而缺乏一致性且耗费资源，导致诊断延迟；同时深度学习模型通常需要大量计算资源，难以在实时医疗场景中部署，因此亟需高效、可及且可解释的诊断工具。
AI.method: BrainAid结合卷积神经网络（CNN）与视觉Transformer（ViT），对胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤和无肿瘤四类MRI扫描进行分类，并集成可解释性AI（XAI）以提升模型可解释性；模型进一步部署于树莓派以验证低资源环境下的可行性。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，BrainAid达到98%的精确率、98%的F1分数和98%的准确率，优于VGG16、Inception-V3、ResNet-50等所有标准模型；部署于Raspberry Pi上展现出低资源环境下的高效性。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明了实时、边缘端脑肿瘤分类的可行性，可为医疗人员提供快速诊断支持，提升资源有限医疗设施和欠发达地区的患者护理水平。

title: SkillHorizon: Constructing Long-Horizon Agent Tasks through Skill Composition
summary: Long-horizon agents must complete workflows in which later activities depend on earlier outputs and changes to shared state. A key challenge for evaluation is to expand task requirements and their dependencies while keeping tasks executable and outcomes verifiable. We introduce SkillHorizon, a benchmark that constructs long-horizon tasks through skill composition in seven business environments. Its generators use domain-specific rules to turn reusable skill procedures into concrete business activities. These activities are connected through input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates, allowing workload and coordination demands to grow together. Successful reference executions validate task feasibility and measure interaction workload, while programmatic evaluators assess local completion and whole-task success. We evaluate five language models on 1,050 tasks with reference interaction workloads ranging from 64K to 1M tokens. Across these scales, mean local-goal completion falls from 90.4% to 46.8%, as completed work fails to keep pace with growing requirements. At larger workloads, agents more often submit unsuccessful final answers with substantial work unfinished and tool-call allowance remaining. Trace analysis also identifies cases where scripts execute successfully but their outputs fail downstream business checks. SkillHorizon provides a configurable testbed for studying sustained progress, dependency coordination, and complete task delivery in growing workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/KnowComp/SkillHorizon.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillHorizon基准，通过技能组合在七个商业环境中构建长时程任务，用输入输出依赖、共享资源和状态更新连接任务，在1,050个任务（参考交互负载64K–1M tokens）上评测五个语言模型，发现随负载增长局部目标完成率从90.4%降至46.8%，且智能体常在未完成大量工作时提前给出失败答案。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体需完成后期活动依赖早期输出与共享状态变化的工作流。评测的核心难点在于：如何在扩展任务需求及其依赖的同时，保持任务可执行、结果可验证。现有基准难以在可控且可验证的条件下同时扩大工作负载与协调需求。
AI.method: 提出SkillHorizon基准：在七个商业环境中以技能组合方式构建长时程任务。任务生成器利用领域特定规则，将可复用的技能流程转化为具体业务活动；这些活动通过输入输出依赖、共享资源与状态更新相互连接，使工作量与协调需求同步增长。参考执行用于验证任务可行性并度量交互负载，程序化评估器分别评估局部完成与整体任务成功。在1,050个任务上评测五个语言模型，参考交互负载为64K至1M tokens。
AI.result: 随交互负载规模增大，平均局部目标完成率从90.4%降至46.8%，已完成工作无法跟上不断增长的需求。在更大负载下，智能体更常在工作大量未完成、且工具调用额度仍有剩余时提交不成功的最终答案。轨迹分析还发现脚本成功执行但其输出未通过下游业务检查的情形。
AI.conclusion: SkillHorizon为研究规模增长型工作流中的持续进展、依赖协调与完整任务交付提供了可配置测试平台，代码已开源。该基准揭示了长时程智能体在需求扩展时"完成度滞后"与"提前终止"的系统性失败模式。

title: LLM-Augmented Bayesian Optimization with Adaptive Policies for Chiplet Design Space Exploration
summary: Chiplet technology is a key approach for extending Moore's Law. However, its design process is constrained by two primary challenges: the scarcity of early-stage platforms for rapidly evaluating chiplet-based heterogeneous systems, and the complex relationships between design parameters and optimization metrics. To address these challenges, we propose a synergistic framework that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with Bayesian Optimization (BO), enabling architectural-level simulation and automated optimization for the 2.5D/3D CPU-GPU heterogeneous chiplets. We extend the open-source chiplet simulator to evaluate 3D designs by supporting graph topologies. Further, to enhance the exploration efficiency of BO, we introduce an LLM that generates high-quality policies to guide the optimization process, enabled by our proposed adaptive directional policy reasoning (ADPR) and an exploration gain-aware fine-tuning method. Finally, we use the policy-guided BO to perform an automated and efficient exploration of the complex chiplet design space. Experiments on 2.5D and 3D chiplet reveal that our framework improves design space exploration efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将大语言模型（LLM）与贝叶斯优化（BO）协同集成的框架，用于2.5D/3D CPU-GPU异构Chiplet的架构级仿真与自动化优化。
AI.motivation: Chiplet技术是延续摩尔定律的关键途径，但其设计过程面临两大挑战：缺乏可快速评估Chiplet异构系统的早期平台，以及设计参数与优化指标之间关系复杂。
AI.method: 扩展开源Chiplet仿真器以支持图拓扑、评估3D设计；引入LLM生成高质量策略指导BO优化，包含自适应方向性策略推理（ADPR）与探索收益感知微调方法；用策略引导的BO对复杂Chiplet设计空间进行自动高效探索。
AI.result: 在2.5D与3D Chiplet上的实验表明，该框架提升了设计空间探索效率。
AI.conclusion: LLM与BO协同的策略引导方法能有效应对Chiplet异构系统设计中的评估平台缺失与参数-指标关系复杂问题，实现高效自动化优化。

title: Latent Taxonomies: How Property Induction Develops in Language Model Pre-training
summary: When told that robins have sesamoid bones, people are far more prone to extend the property to sparrows than to whales. This behavior, called category-based property induction, is well documented in humans, but whether and how it develops in language models trained only to predict the next token is unclear. To shed light on this, we construct a hierarchical taxonomy of synthetic entities grouped by the properties they share. We then inject facts from this latent taxonomy into the continued pre-training of Pythia and OLMo 2 models from 70M to 7B parameters, and track the development of inductive behaviors. We find that taxonomically aligned induction emerges from next-token prediction alone: a property learned for one entity transfers more strongly within its taxonomic category than across categories. Internally, entities that share a deeper category become more similar in activation space, and clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from entity representations. Contrary to the usual expectation that scale helps, we find that induction weakens with model size when the data budget is fixed, suggesting that larger models memorize individual facts rather than compress them into shared structure. Induction also strengthens with more pre-training before the taxonomy injection, transfers to novel in-context properties, and can be overridden by a latent taxonomy implied by the prompt. Together, these results show that a model's inductive generalization reflects the latent organization of its training data, with implications for data curation and for predicting how far a learned fact will spread.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型是否以及如何从纯下一词预测中发展出类别属性归纳能力。作者构建合成实体的层次分类法，将事实注入Pythia和OLMo 2（70M至7B参数）的持续预训练中，发现分类对齐的归纳自然涌现，其强度随模型规模增大反而减弱，并受预训练量与提示隐含分类的影响。
AI.motivation: 人类具有基于类别的属性归纳能力（如将知更鸟的解剖特征推广到麻雀而非鲸鱼），但仅用下一词预测训练的语言模型是否以及如何获得这种能力尚不清楚，这关系到模型泛化机制及事实传播范围的预测。
AI.method: 构建按共享属性分组的合成实体层次分类法；将来自该潜在分类法的事实注入Pythia与OLMo 2模型（70M至7B参数）的持续预训练中；追踪归纳行为的发展，并分析实体在激活空间中的相似性与聚类结构，恢复分类树。
AI.result: 分类对齐的归纳能力仅凭下一词预测即可涌现：同一实体的属性在类内转移强于跨类转移；共享深层类别的实体在激活空间中更相似，聚类可恢复完整分类树；在固定数据预算下，归纳能力随模型规模增大而减弱（大模型倾向于记忆单个事实而非压缩为共享结构）；归纳能力随分类注入前的预训练量增加而增强，可迁移到新的上下文属性，并可被提示隐含的潜在分类法覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 模型的归纳泛化反映了其训练数据的潜在组织方式，这对数据筛选以及预测已学事实传播范围具有启示意义；同时挑战了规模越大泛化越好的常规预期。

title: Region Aware Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks for Image Segmentation
summary: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules improve convolutional networks by modeling channel-wise dependencies, but global average pooling collapses spatial structure into a single per-channel descriptor, limiting their effectiveness for dense prediction tasks such as image segmentation. We generalize SE by replacing global pooling with spatially guided pooling, enabling region-aware channel recalibration through four modules with complementary cost profiles. BASE formalizes Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite using a regular grid; SPASE pools over SLIC superpixels for image-adaptive regions; MAPSE obtains regions from semantic maps produced by a frozen, general-purpose network; and PLEASE learns soft region assignments end-to-end through a lightweight assignment network. Each channel receives one gate per region, so attention at each pixel reflects its region membership, bridging channel and spatial attention. PLEASE also produces its soft assignments as a byproduct of the forward pass, providing structured spatial interpretability without post-hoc analysis. The modules offer complementary computational tradeoffs: some add essentially no parameters, while others add no measurable latency. Across binary segmentation on CUB, DUTS, and ECSSD, semantic segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, and classification on mini-ImageNet, our modules outperform SE and related spatial-channel attention variants on most benchmarks, achieving the majority of best results.

AI.tldr: 本文将SE模块中的全局平均池化替换为空间引导池化，提出BASE、SPASE、MAPSE和PLEASE四种区域感知通道重校准模块，在分割与分类任务上多数基准超越SE及空间-通道注意力变体。
AI.motivation: SE模块通过建模通道依赖提升卷积网络性能，但其全局平均池化将空间结构压缩为单一逐通道描述子，限制了其在图像分割等密集预测任务中的有效性。需要一种能保留空间结构、实现区域感知通道重校准的泛化方案。
AI.method: 用空间引导池化替换全局池化，提出四种互补成本配置的模块：BASE用规则网格实现Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite；SPASE在SLIC超像素上池化以获得图像自适应区域；MAPSE从冻结通用网络产生的语义图获取区域；PLEASE通过轻量分配网络端到端学习软区域分配。每个通道在每个区域获得一个门控，使像素注意力反映其区域归属，从而桥接通道与空间注意力；PLEASE还顺带输出软分配，提供结构化空间可解释性。
AI.result: 在CUB、DUTS、ECSSD二值分割，PASCAL VOC 2012、ADE20K语义分割及mini-ImageNet分类上，各模块在多数基准上优于SE及相关空间-通道注意力变体，取得多数最佳结果；模块间计算权衡互补，部分几乎不增加参数，部分无可测延迟。
AI.conclusion: 空间引导池化可有效泛化SE，实现区域感知的通道重校准，兼顾通道与空间注意力，并在多种密集预测与分类任务上取得优于SE及相关变体的表现，同时提供多种互补的计算成本选择与结构化可解释性。

title: FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization
