To this end, we introduce a margin reward to the challenger, defined as solver's performance difference with and without access to tools. With the margin reward, we create an adaptive curriculum that encourages the solver to learn effective tool invocation. Across benchmarks covering agentic reasoning, visual search, mathematical, and general real-world reasoning, Marvo improves average accuracy by up to 7.1\% --- demonstrating margin reward as a preferred way to scale question complexity without human supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Marvo，一种自进化方法，使视觉智能体能够从无标注图像中学习工具调用，通过challenger与solver双智能体协作与margin reward实现自适应课程学习，平均准确率最高提升7.1%。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体在推理中交织工具调用是多模态任务的重要方向，但学习有效工具调用通常依赖大规模人工标注的问答对或专家演示，获取成本高昂，亟需无需人工监督的替代方案。
AI.method: Marvo包含两个智能体：challenger从无标注图像生成问答对，solver通过强化学习解答问题以学习工具调用。为鼓励有效工具调用，训练问题需足够困难以促使使用工具，又要在solver能力范围内。为此引入margin reward，定义为solver在有/无工具访问下的性能差，并借此构建自适应课程。
AI.result: 在涵盖智能体推理、视觉搜索、数学及通用真实世界推理的多个基准上，Marvo平均准确率最高提升7.1%。
AI.conclusion: margin reward是一种在无人工监督下扩展问题难度的有效方式，可支撑从无标注数据中自进化地学习视觉工具调用。

title: Multi-Token Random-Walk Learning via Meeting-Triggered Information Exchange
summary: Random walk (RW)-based algorithms are widely used in decentralized learning due to their low communication overhead and scalability. While most existing methods rely on a single token, multiple tokens can explore the network in parallel and exchange information upon meeting. However, the fundamental benefits of such meeting-triggered interactions remain unclear. In this work, we investigate multi-token RW learning under two information exchange policies: \textsc{Average-Gradient} and \textsc{Average-Model}, which average stochastic gradients and updated models, respectively, when tokens meet. We establish iteration complexity lower bounds for non-convex, convex, and strongly convex objectives on complete graphs, which apply to both exchange policies. Compared with single-token RW learning, the scaling factor in these bounds is reduced by a factor of $m^2$ for non-convex and convex objectives, and by an exponentially in $m$ for strongly convex objectives, where $m$ denotes the number of tokens. Numerical experiments reveal distinct behaviors of the two policies under two performance criteria: mean-token loss (the average loss across all tokens) and best-token loss (the minimum loss across all tokens). \textsc{Average-Model} achieves lower mean-token loss and is relatively insensitive to the network-to-token ratio $N/m$, where $N$ is the number of nodes. In contrast, \textsc{Average-Gradient} achieves lower best-token loss but exhibits a trade-off between parallel exploration and gradient interference as $N/m$ decreases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多令牌随机游走（RW）去中心化学习，在Average-Gradient与Average-Model两种信息交换策略下建立了非凸、凸和强凸目标的迭代复杂度下界，并揭示了两种策略在mean-token与best-token损失上的不同表现。
AI.motivation: 现有RW算法多依赖单令牌，而多令牌虽能并行探索并在相遇时交换信息，但"相遇触发交互"带来的根本性收益尚不明确，缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 针对完全图上的多令牌RW学习，分别考虑相遇时平均随机梯度的Average-Gradient与平均更新模型的Average-Model两种策略，推导非凸、凸、强凸目标下的迭代复杂度下界，并进行数值实验对比。
AI.result: 理论上，相比单令牌RW，复杂度下界中的缩放因子在非凸和凸目标下降低m²倍，在强凸目标下降低指数级（m为令牌数）。实验上，Average-Model获得更低的mean-token损失且对N/m不敏感；Average-Gradient获得更低的best-token损失，但在N/m减小时面临并行探索与梯度干扰的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 多令牌RW相比单令牌在理论上具有显著复杂度优势，且两种交换策略各具特性：Average-Model适合关注平均性能，Average-Gradient适合追求最优令牌性能。

title: Improving the Evaluation of Biomedical Question Answering with Few Human Preference Signals
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly used for biomedical Question Answering (QA). However, evaluating their effectiveness remains challenging due to the lack of reliable reference resources and the frequent misalignment between automatic evaluation metrics and human judgments. One practical question is how evaluation results should be used to guide development decisions, especially when they correlate weakly with human judgments and may even lead to different conclusions. We explore how to use a small amount of human preference signals to calibrate direct assessment evaluation metrics, and show that calibrated metrics consistently outperform baselines that either treat all metrics equally or rely on a single best metric across multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 针对生物医学RAG问答评估中自动指标与人工判断错位的问题，本文提出用少量人类偏好信号校准直接评估指标，校准后指标在多数据集上优于等权融合与单一最佳指标基线。
AI.motivation: 生物医学RAG问答系统应用日益广泛，但评估存在两大困难：缺乏可靠参考资源，且自动评估指标与人工判断经常错位。核心实践问题是：在指标与人工判断相关性弱、甚至给出矛盾结论时，评估结果应如何用于指导开发决策。
AI.method: 利用少量人类偏好信号对直接评估（direct assessment）指标进行校准，使指标能更好地与人类判断对齐。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，经校准的指标一致优于两类基线：一是对所有指标等权处理，二是依赖单一最佳指标。
AI.conclusion: 少量人类偏好信号即可有效校准直接评估指标，为生物医学RAG问答的评估与开发决策提供更可靠的依据。

title: HGA-Quant: Heterogeneity-Aware Quantization for AutoRegressive Visual Generation Models
summary: Recently, AutoRegressive Visual Generation (ARVG) models have emerged as a competitive paradigm for high-quality image synthesis. However, their substantial computational and memory demands make them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides a promising solution to reduce the computational and memory costs of ARVG models, yet existing methods often suffer from substantial image quality degradation under low-bit quantization. In this paper, we propose a training-free PTQ framework for ARVG, consisting of Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement (T-BGR) and Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling (CAPS). T-BGR introduces a tail-aware reconstruction objective for weight quantizer calibration, assigning greater importance to distribution-tail coefficients and preserving fine-grained information without introducing additional parameters or high-precision branches. CAPS performs coarse-to-fine activation precision scheduling by jointly considering the importance and computational cost of different generation stages, enabling efficient mixed-precision allocation under a given bit budget. Extensive experiments on multiple ARVG backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently improves robustness under aggressive low-bit quantization. Notably, on Infinity, our framework achieves near full-precision image generation quality at an effective W4A5.6 activation precision, while existing methods at W4A6 still exhibit noticeable quality degradation or inconsistent performance. Code is available at https://github.com/lxm-lc/HGA-Quant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的后训练量化（PTQ）框架，用于自回归视觉生成（ARVG）模型，包含尾部感知有界初始化网格细化（T-BGR）与由粗到细激活精度调度（CAPS），在激进低比特下显著提升图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: ARVG 模型虽能高质量合成图像，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署于资源受限的边缘设备；现有 PTQ 方法在低比特量化下图像质量退化严重。
AI.method: 提出免训练 PTQ 框架：T-BGR 引入尾部感知重建目标用于权重量化器校准，对分布尾部系数赋予更高权重以保留细粒度信息，且不增加额外参数或高精度分支；CAPS 联合考虑不同生成阶段的重要性与计算成本，进行由粗到细的激活精度调度，在给定比特预算下实现高效混合精度分配。
AI.result: 在多个 ARVG 骨干网络上实验表明，该框架在激进低比特量化下持续提升鲁棒性；在 Infinity 上以有效 W4A5.6 激活精度达到接近全精度的图像生成质量，而现有方法在 W4A6 仍存在明显质量退化或性能不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该免训练 PTQ 框架有效缓解 ARVG 低比特量化质量退化问题，在更低比特预算下实现接近全精度的生成质量，为边缘设备部署提供可行方案。

title: Structural Chain-of-Thought: Reasoning with Executable Computational Graphs
summary:
Chain-of-thought prompting enables reasoning in large language models but produces explanations that are difficult to verify, expensive to generate, and not always faithful. We introduce a Structural Chain-of-Thought framework where models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form reasoning. The final answer is obtained by deterministically executing the graph. The model is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning that rewards structural validity, answer correctness, and node overlap with reference graphs.
  Experiments across five benchmarks and four model families show that our method consistently improves accuracy over supervised graph training and can reduce generation length by up to 5-6x compared with standard GRPO and chain-of-thought supervised training. Our faithfulness experiments reveal that models trained with our approach tend to rely on deriving their answers from the generated graphs rather than producing post-hoc rationalizations as usually in chain-of-thought reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化思维链（Structural Chain-of-Thought）框架：让模型生成可执行计算图而非自由文本推理，通过确定性执行图得到答案，并用基于图的强化学习（奖励结构有效性、答案正确性、与参考图的节点重叠）进行训练。
AI.motivation: 传统思维链提示虽能激发大模型推理，但其生成的解释难以验证、生成成本高，且并不总是忠实于真实推理过程，因此需要一种更可验证、更高效、更忠实的推理范式。
AI.method: 将推理过程表示为可执行的计算图，模型生成图结构后由确定性执行引擎求取最终答案；采用图结构的强化学习训练，奖励信号包括结构有效性、答案正确性以及与参考图的节点重叠度。
AI.result: 在五个基准、四类模型族上，方法相比监督式图训练持续提升准确率；相比标准 GRPO 与思维链监督训练，生成长度最多可缩减 5–6 倍。忠实性实验显示模型更倾向于由图推导答案，而非像常规思维链那样进行事后合理化。
AI.conclusion: 用可执行计算图替代自由文本推理并结合图强化学习，可在提升准确率的同时显著降低生成开销，并改善推理的忠实性，为可验证推理提供了一条有效路径。

title: Integrating AIRL-Based Reward Estimation into a Control Method Using Fuzzy Inference and Policy Gradient
summary: A method integrating policy gradient with fuzzy inference has been proposed. This method, hereafter referred to as the base model, has high flexibility with respect to the configuration of fuzzy inference rules and fuzzy representation. It can also automatically adjust the rule weights and the membership functions in the antecedent and consequent parts using the same framework for learning. In methods that integrate reinforcement learning with fuzzy inference, however, the reward function must be designed in advance. It is therefore useful to add learning-based reward estimation to the base model. This paper proposes a fuzzy control method that integrates a reward estimation mechanism based on the adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) framework into the base model. The generative adversarial nets (GAN) framework adopted in AIRL, however, tends to suffer from unstable learning. To address this, the proposed method treats the policy of the base model as the generator and also uses the set of membership functions in the policy as the cost function of the discriminator. This configuration allows the discriminator update for reward estimation and the generator update for policy estimation to be performed simultaneously on the parameters shared by both, without estimating a value function. In simulations of an illustrative vehicle speed control task, the proposed method acquired policies with high generalization performance through stable and efficient learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将AIRL奖励估计机制与模糊推理策略梯度融合的模糊控制方法，通过让判别器与生成器共享参数、以隶属函数集作为判别器代价函数，实现稳定高效学习，并在车速控制仿真中获得高泛化性策略。
AI.motivation: 基础模型（策略梯度+模糊推理）虽在规则配置、模糊表示上灵活且能统一学习规则权重与隶属函数，但要求预先设计奖励函数；同时AIRL所用GAN框架存在学习不稳定问题，因此需引入无需先验奖励估计的稳定学习机制。
AI.method: 在基础模型中集成基于对抗逆向强化学习（AIRL）的奖励估计机制：以基础模型的策略作为生成器，以策略中的隶属函数集作为判别器的代价函数；据此在同一共享参数上同时进行判别器更新（奖励估计）与生成器更新（策略估计），且不估计值函数。
AI.result: 在示例性车速控制任务的仿真中，所提方法通过稳定且高效的学习获得了具有高泛化性能的策略。
AI.conclusion: 将AIRL奖励估计与模糊策略梯度统一在共享参数框架下，可规避GAN训练不稳定，实现无需预设计奖励的模糊控制学习，并在车速控制任务上验证了有效性与泛化性。

title: Of Errors and Echoes: Responsibility-Aware Credit Assignment for Tool-Use Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning improves tool-use agents, yet fine-grained credit assignment remains challenging even with step-level feedback. An observed error may be inherited from an earlier decision, while multiple responsible decisions may share the same downstream consequence or participate in later recovery. We introduce Error-Chain-Aware Optimization (ECHO), a responsibility-aware credit assignment framework that separates responsibility identification from credit allocation. A frozen judge combines retrospective trajectory analysis with decision-time assessment from the policy-visible prefix to distinguish newly introduced errors, inherited consequences, missed corrections, and successful corrections. ECHO then counts shared downstream consequences once across responsible decisions and constrains rewards for repairing self-induced errors through source-funded recovery, producing bounded action-level supervision alongside terminal supervision. Experiments on six diverse tool-use benchmarks at both 4B and 8B scales show strong and consistent improvements over the compared baselines, with ECHO achieving the highest score on five of six benchmarks at each scale. These results support decision responsibility as a useful basis for fine-grained credit assignment in tool-use agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/xid32/ECHO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECHO（Error-Chain-Aware Optimization），一种责任感知的信用分配框架，将责任识别与信用分配解耦，通过冻结评判模型区分新引入错误、继承后果、遗漏纠正与成功纠正，并在共享下游后果上只计一次、对自我致错修复采用来源出资约束，从而生成有界的动作级监督。在六个工具使用基准、4B 与 8B 两个规模上均稳定优于基线，每个规模在五个基准上取得最高分。
AI.motivation: 工具使用智能体的强化学习虽已引入步级反馈，但细粒度信用分配仍困难：观察到的错误可能继承自更早的决策，多个责任决策可能共享同一下游后果，或参与后续恢复。这使得错误信号无法准确归因到真正负责的决策上，导致信用分配偏置。
AI.method: ECHO 将责任识别与信用分配分离。先由冻结评判者结合回溯轨迹分析与基于策略可见前缀的决策时刻评估，识别四类决策：新引入错误、继承后果、遗漏纠正、成功纠正。随后在共享下游后果上对多个责任决策只计一次，并对修复自我致错的行为施加来源出资式恢复约束，最终输出有界的动作级监督与终端监督。
AI.result: 在六个多样化工具使用基准上，于 4B 与 8B 两个规模进行实验，ECHO 相比对比基线取得稳定且显著的提升，每个规模下在六个基准中的五个上取得最高分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，决策责任可作为工具使用智能体中细粒度信用分配的有效基础。

title: Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation
summary: Recent native 3D generators achieve high-quality asset creation by modeling structured 3D latents with flow-based transformers, but their high-resolution generation remains computationally expensive due to costly iterative sampling. In this work, we introduce a few-step distillation framework for native 3D generation, enabled by continuous self-consistency training with a custom JVP FlashAttention kernel and an analytic velocity regression objective for sparse structured 3D latents. To stabilize joint optimization, we further introduce an adaptive loss weighting strategy that automatically balances them without manual tuning. Beyond acceleration, we reveal a previously overlooked failure mode of few-step native 3D generation: sampling-induced latent distribution drift preserves geometric correctness but disrupts downstream PBR texture synthesis, causing texture artifacts on geometrically valid assets. To address this issue, we propose Channel Match, a training-free adaptive per-channel latent calibration method that restores the latent distribution without modifying either generator. We validate our approach on TRELLIS.2 at the $1024^3$ resolution setting. Our two-step model achieves $4.5\times$ faster geometry sampling while maintaining geometry quality comparable to the many-step teacher, and Channel Match further improves rendering quality by recovering the latent interface between geometry and appearance generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出少步蒸馏框架加速原生3D生成，并发现采样导致的潜分布漂移会破坏下游PBR纹理合成，提出免训练的信道匹配方法予以修复。
AI.motivation: 原生3D生成器通过流式Transformer建模结构化3D潜变量可生成高质量资产，但高分辨率生成依赖昂贵的迭代采样，计算开销大；此外少步生成存在被忽视的失效模式。
AI.method: 连续自一致性训练，搭配自定义JVP FlashAttention核与针对稀疏结构化3D潜变量的解析速度回归目标；引入自适应损失加权策略平衡联合优化；提出Channel Match——免训练的自适应逐通道潜变量校准方法。
AI.result: 在TRELLIS.2的1024³分辨率设置下验证：两步模型几何采样提速4.5倍，几何质量与多步教师模型相当；Channel Match进一步提升渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 少步蒸馏可有效加速原生3D生成，而采样引起的潜分布漂移虽不损害几何却破坏纹理合成；Channel Match通过恢复几何与外观生成间的潜接口，无需改动生成器即可改善渲染质量。

title: GesBench: When and Where Do Multimodal Language Models Perceive Social Meaning?
summary: Human social perception is incremental: we infer intent before an utterance is complete, revise our interpretation as new cues arrive, and attend to specific facial, gestural, or prosodic signals that shape social meaning. Current multimodal LLM benchmarks largely evaluate final-answer understanding over complete episodes, rewarding post-hoc recognition of social meaning rather than the unfolding perception required for real-time interaction. Drawing on interactionally embedded Gestalt principles of multimodal human communication, we introduce GesBench: a human-grounded benchmark for cue-level social perception in multimodal LLMs. GesBench uses cumulative sub-utterance clips to measure when models form stable interpretations of speaker intention and social affordance, and human gaze-guided corruption to evaluate whether regions attended by humans are functionally important for model judgments. Built from more than 6000 utterance-level clips from scripted and unscripted conversational datasets, GesBench includes human annotations of unfolding judgments and gaze on a representative subset. Across open and closed multimodal models, we find a clear human-model gap: humans form predictive understandings early and revise more often, while models often hedge or repeat across different clips. GesBench shifts social evaluation from whether models eventually recognize meaning to when and where that meaning is formed. Our codes are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/GesBench-share-212C.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GesBench，一个基于人类真实感知过程的多模态大模型社会感知评测基准，用累积子话语片段测量模型何时形成稳定社会意图判断，并借助人类注视引导的扰动检验关键区域的功能重要性，揭示了人类与模型在社会感知上的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 人类社会感知是增量式的：在话语未完成时即推断意图，并随新线索不断修正解释，同时关注特定的面部、手势或韵律信号。而现有多模态大模型评测多聚焦于完整对话片段上的最终答案理解，奖励事后识别而非实时互动所需的渐进式感知，无法衡量模型"何时"与"何处"形成社会意义理解。
AI.method: 借鉴具身互动中的多模态格式塔原则，构建GesBench基准：使用累积的子话语片段（cumulative sub-utterance clips）测量模型对说话人意图与社会可供性形成稳定解释的时机；采用人类注视引导的损坏（gaze-guided corruption）评估人类关注区域对模型判断的功能重要性。数据来自脚本化与非脚本化对话数据集，包含逾6000个话语级片段，并在代表性子集上收集人类渐进判断与注视标注。
AI.result: 在开源与闭源多模态模型上评测，发现明显的人机差距：人类较早形成预测性理解且修正更频繁；模型则常在不同片段间表现出犹豫或重复，缺乏稳定、渐进的解释形成过程。
AI.conclusion: GesBench将社会感知评测从"模型最终是否识别意义"转向"意义在何时、何处形成"，为多模态社会感知提供了人类对齐的评测范式，代码已公开。

title: VitaBench: Memory Lifecycles Beyond Retrieval
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)
summary: Long-term memory benchmarks for language agents primarily evaluate whether information from earlier interactions can be retrieved and used when relevant. Persistent memory systems face an additional problem before future use is known: deciding whether a memory should remain exact, be compressed, consolidated, or deleted. Existing benchmarks capture long-range retrieval, temporal reasoning, evidence reuse, and incremental interaction, but do not directly evaluate these earlier representation decisions. We formalize memory lifecycle evaluation and introduce VitaBench, a benchmark that makes lifecycle decisions measurable through repeated memory reviews and full-horizon counterfactual evaluation. VitaBench contains a controlled Diagnostic tier that isolates future-use patterns and a Naturalistic tier that composes them into generated customer-service-style interaction streams. We characterize lifecycle decision structure with three diagnostics: lifecycle headroom, measuring the advantage of adaptive choices over the best fixed strategy; horizon reversal, measuring when short-horizon decisions change under delayed consequences; and optimal-action diversity, measuring whether different memory states favor different lifecycle operations. Across both tiers, VitaBench exhibits substantial lifecycle structure: lifecycle headroom is 1.364 in Diagnostic and 1.405 in Naturalistic, and 60.2% and 56.5% of states, respectively, change their preferred action between short and full horizons. A learned delayed lifecycle policy further improves over the best fixed strategy on VitaBench-Naturalistic, reaching 101.5 versus 83.4 joint utility. These results show that retrieving past information and deciding how it should persist are distinct evaluation problems, and that lifecycle management requires evaluation of the delayed consequences of representation decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出记忆生命周期评估范式与VitaBench基准，将"记忆该保留/压缩/整合/删除"这一表示决策作为独立评估问题，通过重复记忆审查与全时域反事实评估使其可量化。
AI.motivation: 现有语言智能体长期记忆基准主要评估早期信息在相关时能否被检索和利用，但持久记忆系统在"未来用途未知"之前就面临一个前置问题：某条记忆应保持精确、压缩、整合还是删除。这一表示决策环节缺乏直接评估，因为现有基准只覆盖长程检索、时间推理、证据复用与增量交互。
AI.method: 形式化记忆生命周期评估；构建VitaBench基准，包含受控的Diagnostic层（隔离未来使用模式）与Naturalistic层（组合为生成的客服风格交互流）；通过重复记忆审查与全时域反事实评估使生命周期决策可测。用三个诊断量刻画决策结构：生命周期余量（自适应选择相对最优固定策略的增益）、时域反转（短时域决策在延迟后果下是否改变）、最优动作多样性（不同记忆状态是否偏好不同生命周期操作）。
AI.result: 两个层级均呈现显著生命周期结构：生命周期余量在Diagnostic为1.364、Naturalistic为1.405；分别有60.2%与56.5%的状态在短时域与全时域之间改变偏好动作。学习到的延迟生命周期策略在VitaBench-Naturalistic上优于最优固定策略，联合效用达101.5对83.4。
AI.conclusion: 检索过去信息与决定其如何持久保留是两个不同的评估问题；生命周期管理需要评估表示决策的延迟后果，VitaBench为此提供了可量化的评测框架。

title: Beyond the greenwash: do LLMs' ecologically sound decisions hold up under pressure?
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Model fixtures released at https://huggingface.co/Bioaligned. Companion paper on corpus construction and cross-family installation in preparation
summary: Humans are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) in decision making processes throughout society. Unfortunately, models have biases, and these can be very difficult to measure, especially in closed-weight models. For example, 'green washed' models may produce reinforcement learned responses but, in pressure situations, revert to their innate biased responses. Therefore, evaluations are needed that can measure relevant biases towards biosystems, which we term 'bioalignment', and the robustness of these biases. Since nothing in a behavioral score certifies that it tracks the depth of an installed disposition rather than its surface, we constructed a known-dose calibration ladder: three continued-pretraining (CPT) arms with training dose graded by recipe on the same 30B mixture-of-experts base model with a coupled human/biosphere/AI-welfare corpus, plus the untrained base as anchor, all capability-preserving and publicly released. First, the disposition installs at every dose: on an operational-pressure ladder over irreversible decision scenarios, the base model defects on 64-77% of tail scenarios (breaking-rate AUC 0.250) while every arm holds (AUC 0.004-0.086). Second, an over-install inversion: among the arms, robustness orders opposite to construction-time training dose (the heaviest install breaks most), and the inversion reproduces under free-text deliberation, under axis-decoupling, and in resistance to a prompted veneer persona. Third, the incumbent behavioral metric is therefore behaviorally strong but dose-blind. Critically for closed-weight evaluation, the behavioral score itself is veneer-robust: a talk-green/act-pragmatic system prompt turns the base model into a near-total defector (AUC 0.250 to 0.973) but cannot counterfeit or fully remove a weight-installed disposition (0.004 to 0.068 for the most robust arm).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"生物对齐"(bioalignment)评估框架,通过在同一30B MoE基座上构建三级不同训练剂量的持续预训练(CPT)模型,配合未训练基座作为锚点,测量模型对生物系统相关偏置的深度与鲁棒性。发现偏置在每个剂量下都成功植入;但鲁棒性呈现"过度植入反转"——训练剂量最重的模型反而最脆弱;现有行为指标虽行为表现强却对剂量不敏感;而权重植入的偏置具有抗"镀层"特性。
AI.motivation: 人类日益在决策中使用LLM,但模型存在难以测量的偏置,尤其对闭权重模型。现有行为评分无法区分偏置是表面响应还是深层植入的倾向,且"漂绿"模型可能在实际压力下退回固有不公偏置,因此需要能测量生物对齐相关偏置及其鲁棒性的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建已知剂量校准阶梯:在同一30B MoE基座上,用人/生物圈/AI福祉耦合语料,按配方梯度进行三级持续预训练(CPT)得到三个不同训练剂量的模型臂,加上未训练基座作为锚点,全部保持能力并公开释放。在不可逆决策场景的操作性压力阶梯上进行测试,并复现于自由文本审议、轴解耦、及对抗提示性人格镀层的条件下。
AI.result: (1)偏置在每个剂量下都成功植入:基座模型在64-77%的尾部场景中背叛(breaking-rate AUC 0.250),而每个CPT臂都保持(0.004-0.086)。(2)过度植入反转:各臂鲁棒性排序与构建时训练剂量相反(最重的植入最脆弱),并在自由文本审议、轴解耦、抗提示镀层人格下复现。(3)现有行为指标虽行为强但对剂量不敏感。(4)行为评分本身抗镀层:talk-green/act-pragmatic系统提示可将基座变为近乎完全背叛者(0.250→0.973),但无法伪造或完全移除权重植入的偏置(最鲁棒臂仅0.004→0.068)。
AI.conclusion: 现有的生物对齐行为评估指标行为敏感性高但存在剂量盲区,无法反映偏置植入的深度;权重植入的倾向具有抗镀层鲁棒性,难以被提示工程伪造或移除。该研究为闭权重模型的偏置深度评估提供了校准基准,并警示训练剂量并不线性对应鲁棒性,存在过度植入反转现象。

title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出\method，一种免训练的预测式KV缓存量化框架，针对自回归视频扩散模型的KV缓存进行压缩，利用键值可预测性差异存储低精度残差，实现最高6.71倍压缩并保持更优生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型支持长视频流式生成，但KV缓存快速增长带来显著显存开销。现有KV缓存量化方法主要为LLM设计，难以迁移到视频模型，因为其激活统计不同且具有强时空冗余。
AI.method: 观察到视频KV缓存随时间高度可预测且存在明显不对称性：键可由其时间历史高度预测，而值主要依赖当前键并需要短的前序值历史。基于此，\method依据键与值各自的依赖关系分别进行预测，仅以低精度存储残差。两个预测器均轻量，通过少量BF16样本的线性回归离线校准一次，并在不同提示与生成过程中保持固定，全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing和LongCat-Video-13B上的实验表明，\method在相当或更高压缩比下持续取得优于现有KV缓存量化方法的生成质量，最高达6.71倍KV缓存压缩，并具备最佳的整体质量—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: \method为自回归视频生成提供了一种免训练、可预测的KV缓存量化方案，在显著压缩显存的同时保持生成质量，代码将于GitHub开源。

title: Trust Hinders Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Dynamic Alignment in Human-AI Coupled System (BiAlign Workshop)
summary: Trust calibration remains the dominant framing of AI-assisted decision making: the goal is to close the gap between perceived and actual trustworthiness of AI systems so that users exhibit appropriate reliance on them. We argue that this approach, while useful for decision problems that are well-defined and clearly scoped, overly restricts what it means to make a decision with AI support. To overcome this limitation, we develop three dimensions of AI-assisted decision making. First, trusting AI is only one of several possible strategies for managing uncertainty. Second, trust calibration is often misapplied when AI models "large-world" decision problems, i.e., ill-defined situations where goals and states are only partially known or unknowable. Third, in such settings human-AI alignment requires addressing higher-order decision processes. We conclude by reflecting on the implications of our observations on the design of process-oriented human-AI coupled systems that jointly identify and negotiate uncertainty throughout the decision-making task.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑以"信任校准"为主导的AI辅助决策框架，提出三个维度以拓展对AI辅助决策的理解，并倡导设计面向过程的人机耦合系统。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助决策研究以"信任校准"为核心，目标在于缩小AI系统感知可信度与实际可信度之间的差距，从而实现"适当依赖"。作者认为，这一框架虽对定义明确、边界清晰的决策问题有用，却过度限缩了"借助AI进行决策"的含义，忽视了不确定性的其他管理策略以及"大世界"决策问题的特殊性。
AI.method: 概念性/理论论证。作者提出AI辅助决策的三个维度：(1) 信任AI只是管理不确定性的多种策略之一；(2) 当AI建模"大世界"决策问题（目标与状态仅部分可知或不可知的非良定义情境）时，信任校准常被误用；(3) 在此类情境中，人机对齐需要处理更高阶的决策过程。
AI.result: 论文论证了信任校准框架的适用边界：它适用于良定义、范围清晰的决策问题，但不适用于"大世界"问题；在后一类情境中，仅关注信任校准不足以保证人机对齐，需转向更高阶决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 作者反思上述观察对设计"面向过程的人机耦合系统"的启示——这类系统应在整个决策任务中共同识别并协商不确定性，而非仅以校准信任为目标。

title: PTGPO: Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization
summary: Training language agents on long-horizon interactive tasks is challenging because sparse terminal rewards provide weak credit signals for intermediate actions. Existing group-based methods either assign a shared trajectory-level advantage or estimate step-level advantages from state groups, which may conflate the current action with subsequent decisions. We propose Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization (PTGPO), a critic-free method that constructs prefix trees over trajectory suffixes within anchor-state groups. PTGPO assigns each tree edge a credit given by the difference between its child and parent empirical mean returns, capturing the conditional return change revealed by each additional action. These prefix-tree credits provide fine-grained learning signals without requiring a critic or additional rollouts. Experiments on interactive benchmarks ALFWorld, WebShop and Sokoban show that PTGPO consistently improves over RL baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: PTGPO：在锚点状态组内构建轨迹后缀前缀树，以父子经验均值收益差作为每条边的信用，实现无critic、细粒度的信用分配，在ALFWorld、WebShop、Sokoban上稳定超越RL基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程交互任务训练语言智能体困难，稀疏的终局奖励对中间动作的信用信号弱。现有基于组的方法要么给整条轨迹共享轨迹级优势，要么从状态组估计步级优势，容易把当前动作与后续决策混为一谈。
AI.method: 提出PTGPO（Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization），一种无critic方法。在锚点状态组内对轨迹后缀构建前缀树；为每条树边分配信用，取该边子节点与父节点经验平均收益之差，从而刻画每多执行一个动作所带来的条件收益变化；无需critic也无需额外rollout。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Sokoban交互基准上，PTGPO持续优于RL基线，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于前缀树的条件收益差分可提供细粒度学习信号，在无critic、无额外采样的条件下改善长时程语言智能体训练。

title: Scaling Multi-Agent Intelligence with Substrate-Centric Coordination
summary: Existing large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems have been shown to scale poorly, and we identify three problems: reading burden that grows with the group, useful information diluted by shared work of unknown quality, and fragility to failed agents. We argue that the problems are largely due to agent-centric designs: the coordination structure is wired into fixed workflows, central coordinators, or peer-to-peer messaging, and recent blackboard-style methods that move the coordination into a shared medium relieve only the last problem. To close the gaps, we build ScaleMAS, where asynchronous agents interact with a shared datastore of linked messages via three operations: publishing messages with optional references to earlier ones that they build on, searching for messages by content, and visiting messages by address. Search returns at most $k$ messages, so an agent's read stays bounded at any group size; results are ranked by relevance and by how often they are cited, which we find to be an effective proxy for quality; and messages persist after their producers leave, so the group carries on when individual agents fail. Across four agentic tasks, ScaleMAS outperforms agent-centric and blackboard-style baselines at lower inference compute, continues to scale up to 128 agents, and tolerates losing agents midway.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ScaleMAS，将多智能体协调从"以智能体为中心"转向"以共享数据存储为中心"，通过发布/搜索/访问三种操作实现异步交互，从而解决读取负担、信息稀释和脆弱性问题，并在四项任务上以更低推理算力超越基线，可扩展至128个智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统（基于LLM）扩展性差，作者识别出三个问题：随群体规模增长的阅读负担、有用信息被未知质量的共享工作稀释、对智能体失效的脆弱性。作者认为根源在于"以智能体为中心"的设计：协调结构被固化进固定工作流、中心协调者或点对点消息传递中；近期黑板式方法虽将协调转移到共享媒介，但仅缓解了最后一个问题。
AI.method: 构建 ScaleMAS：异步智能体通过三种操作与由链接消息构成的共享数据存储交互——发布消息（可选引用其所基于的早期消息）、按内容搜索消息、按地址访问消息。搜索最多返回 k 条消息，使任意规模下智能体的读取量有界；结果按相关性和被引用频次排序（被引用频次被视为质量的有效代理）；消息在生产智能体离开后仍然持久存在。
AI.result: 在四项智能体任务上，ScaleMAS 以更低的推理算力优于以智能体为中心和黑板式基线，可继续扩展至128个智能体，并能容忍智能体中途失效。
AI.conclusion: 以共享数据存储为中心的协调设计能够同时缓解读取负担、信息稀释与智能体失效三个扩展性瓶颈，实现更优性能、更低算力、更好可扩展性与更强鲁棒性。

title: BaT-SAM: Introducing Inductive Bias into SAM via a Mixture of Convolutional Experts for Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning; however, manual delineation is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Existing approaches are either task-specific with limited generalization or rely on user-provided prompts during inference. We present BaT-SAM, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that enables fully automatic brain tumor segmentation with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). BaT-SAM injects local inductive bias into SAM's frozen Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder via Conv-LoRA, where image features are processed by a sparsely gated mixture of multi-scale convolutional experts. This design compensates for the limited translation-equivariant inductive bias of vanilla ViTs while fine-tuning fewer than 5M parameters (less than 1% of the full model). To remove the need for user prompts, we further introduce a lightweight self-prompting box regressor that is jointly optimized with the adapter using scheduled sampling and predicts tumor locations directly from image embeddings. On the BRISC2025 benchmark, BaT-SAM achieves a weighted mean IoU of 0.832 while outperforming state-of-the-art benchmarks. It further demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization, achieving Dice scores of 0.702 on Figshare and 0.784 on the LGG MRI Segmentation dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出BaT-SAM框架，通过Conv-LoRA和自提示框回归器实现全自动脑肿瘤分割，参数量少于5M。
AI.motivation: MRI脑肿瘤准确分割对诊断和治疗规划至关重要，但人工勾画耗时耗力；现有方法要么任务特定、泛化性差，要么依赖推理时的用户提示。
AI.method: 在SAM冻结的ViT编码器中注入Conv-LoRA引入局部归纳偏置，图像特征经稀疏门控的多尺度卷积专家混合处理；同时引入轻量级自提示框回归器，采用调度采样与适配器联合优化，直接从图像嵌入预测肿瘤位置。
AI.result: 在BRISC2025基准上加权平均IoU达0.832，超越现有最优方法；跨数据集泛化性强，Figshare上Dice为0.702，LGG MRI Segmentation上为0.784。
AI.conclusion: BaT-SAM以极高的参数效率（少于5M，不足全模型1%）实现了全自动且泛化性强的脑肿瘤分割。

title: Single-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback
summary: Single-step retrosynthesis is a one-to-many inverse problem, yet most models are trained and evaluated against a single recorded reactant set. Reference-based training gives no explicit positive signal for unrecorded alternatives, and exact-match evaluation rejects non-matching predictions regardless of chemical plausibility. We propose Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback (RetroRLFF), which optimizes reactant generation using both reference agreement and forward consistency with the target product. Starting from a supervised decoder-only Transformer, RetroRLFF generates complete reactant candidates and uses a frozen forward reaction model to predict products. A sequence-level reward combines reference agreement and forward consistency while penalizing invalid outputs. Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization updates the policy without human preference annotations or a preference-trained reward model. On USPTO-50K, RetroRLFF outperforms all 14 baselines in candidate-level round-trip accuracy at k = 1, 3, 5, and 10. With approximately 50 million parameters, it achieves 90.1% top-1 round-trip accuracy, exceeding R-SMILES, the strongest competing baseline on this metric, by 8.5 percentage points. Compared with its supervised policy, round-trip accuracy increases from 83.1% to 90.1%, while exact-match accuracy is maintained at 57.9% versus 57.5%. In an anonymized expert assessment of 131 randomly selected test cases, organic synthesis experts prefer RetroRLFF over EditRetro in 67.9% of comparisons. These results support forward feedback as a training signal for improving forward consistency while retaining top-1 reference recovery. Expert assessment provides complementary evidence of synthetic feasibility on the selected cases, although neither forward consistency nor expert preference establishes experimental feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RetroRLFF，用强化学习结合参考一致性与前向一致性奖励优化逆合成反应物生成，在USPTO-50K上取得90.1% top-1往返准确率，超越14个基线。
AI.motivation: 单步逆合成是一对多的逆问题，但多数模型仅以单一记录反应物集进行训练与评估。基于参考的训练对未记录的替代反应物缺乏显式正信号，而精确匹配评估无论化学合理性如何都会拒绝不匹配的预测，导致模型难以学到前向可行性。
AI.method: 提出RetroRLFF，从监督式仅解码器Transformer出发，生成完整反应物候选，并用冻结的前向反应模型预测产物。设计序列级奖励，结合参考一致性与前向一致性，并惩罚无效输出。采用直接优势策略优化（Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization）更新策略，无需人类偏好标注或偏好训练奖励模型。
AI.result: 在USPTO-50K上，RetroRLFF在k=1、3、5、10的候选级往返准确率上优于全部14个基线。约5000万参数下，top-1往返准确率达90.1%，比最强竞争基线R-SMILES高8.5个百分点。相比其监督策略，往返准确率从83.1%提升至90.1%，精确匹配准确率保持57.9%（对照57.5%）。在131个随机测试样本的匿名专家评估中，有机合成专家在67.9%的对比中更偏好RetroRLFF而非EditRetro。
AI.conclusion: 前向反馈可作为训练信号，在保留top-1参考恢复能力的同时提升前向一致性。专家评估为所选样本的合成可行性提供了补充证据，但前向一致性与专家偏好均不能确立实验可行性。

title: More Domains, No Gains? FLO: Fast-Slow Reciprocal Learning for Multi-Domain Graph Pre-training
summary: Inspired by the great success of foundation models in the development of artificial general intelligence, Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently attracted significant attention and have the potential to advance graph intelligence. Exhibiting such intelligence requires effectively learning knowledge from large-scale, multi-domain graph data during pre-training. Increasing domain diversity during pre-training is expected to yield richer and more generalizable knowledge. Most existing methods pursue this goal by designing domain alignment strategies that help a single graph model learn from multiple domains. However, we observe that existing methods struggle to benefit from increasing domain diversity. Through empirical and theoretical analysis, we reveal two key limitations. Firstly, pre-training in most GFMs is confined to a single message-passing paradigm. Since propagation flattens relations among neighboring nodes, the graph model can hardly perceive the knowledge beyond propagation, namely the attribute-predictable component of these relations. Secondly, domain alignment strategies often rely on randomly initialized parameters that are jointly updated with the graph model using immediate loss feedback, leaving early knowledge acquisition vulnerable to cross-domain interference. To address these issues, we propose FLO, a Fast--sLow reciprOcal approach for multi-domain graph pre-training. Specifically, a propagation-free attribute branch predicts the graph model's relations without message passing and returns these predictions to refine the model. We further stabilize knowledge acquisition by pairing a fast process that adapts to the current domain with a slow process that integrates knowledge across domains. On 12 datasets, FLO benefits from increasing domain diversity and achieves the best average performance in cross-domain and cross-task transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLO方法解决多域图预训练中域多样性难以受益的问题，通过无传播属性分支与快慢互惠机制提升跨域跨任务迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 图基础模型（GFMs）需从大规模多域图数据中预训练以获取通用知识，但现有方法通过域对齐策略让单一图模型学习多域时，面临域多样性增加却难以获益的困境。作者通过实证与理论分析揭示两点核心局限：一是预训练局限于单一消息传递范式，传播会抹平邻接节点间的关系，使模型难以感知传播之外的知识（即可由属性预测的关系成分）；二是域对齐策略依赖随机初始化参数，与图模型基于即时损失反馈联合更新，导致早期知识获取易受跨域干扰。
AI.method: 提出FLO（Fast-sLow reciprOcal）多域图预训练方法。具体包括：1）设计无传播（propagation-free）的属性分支，在不进行消息传递的情况下预测图模型的关系，并将这些预测回传以精炼模型；2）引入慢-快双过程机制稳定知识获取：快速过程适应当前域，慢速过程跨域整合知识。
AI.result: 在12个数据集上，FLO能够随域多样性增加而获益，并在跨域与跨任务迁移中取得最佳平均性能。
AI.conclusion: FLO通过消除单一传播范式限制并缓解跨域干扰，有效利用多域多样性提升图基础模型的泛化与迁移能力。

title: Query Your Way Out: Benchmarking Multi-Turn Knowledge Reasoning through Generalized Puzzle Solving
summary: Puzzles offer a natural testbed for Large Language Models (LLMs) reasoning because they pose verifiable goals under partial information and require multi-step decisions to reach a solution. However, existing puzzle benchmarks typically focus on narrow environments with rigid mechanics and tightly constrained solution targets. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Active Probing Benchmark (APB), which generalizes puzzle-solving by casting concept identification as an interactive reasoning task that integrates specialized knowledge assessment into the puzzle setting. Specifically, APB evaluates whether models can acquire information via multi-turn active probing and inference to pinpoint 960 target concepts of specialized difficulty across eight diverse academic domains. Our evaluation reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon: most open-source reasoning models significantly underperform their standard instruction counterparts. This finding suggests that in interactive settings, these models struggle to leverage procedural reasoning to reliably access and apply specialized domain knowledge. Beyond these empirical insights, APB provides a scalable pipeline for generating benchmarks that probe knowledge reasoning under interaction across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Active Probing Benchmark (APB)，将谜题求解推广为交互式概念识别任务，用多轮主动探测评估 LLM 在八个学科领域中定位 960 个专业概念的能力，并发现开源推理模型表现显著低于其标准指令版本。
AI.motivation: 现有谜题基准多局限于机制僵化、解空间狭窄的单一环境，难以全面检验 LLM 在部分信息下进行多步决策与交互推理的能力。
AI.method: 将概念识别构造为交互式推理任务，要求模型通过多轮主动探测获取信息并进行推理，从而定位八个学术领域中的 960 个高难度目标概念。
AI.result: 出现反直觉现象：多数开源推理模型的表现显著低于对应的标准指令模型，表明这些模型在交互场景中难以借助程序化推理稳定调用和应用专业知识。
AI.conclusion: APB 揭示了交互式知识推理的模型能力缺口，并提供了一套可扩展的基准生成流程，用于在多样场景下评估交互中的知识推理。

title: StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching
summary: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization without a decoder. Furthermore, it recovers over half of full-data performance from just one hour of scans, supporting efficient cross-subject adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StimFlow，一种在原生体素空间直接合成fMRI响应的生成式编码器，采用线性路径的条件流匹配，并结合DINOv2结构特征与CLIP语义特征以匹配视觉层级。单样本即达到每体素Pearson相关0.371，媲美需平均五次采样的基线。
AI.motivation: fMRI响应在试次间存在固有变异性，适合用生成式视角建模刺激到响应的映射。但现有生成式编码器多在压缩潜空间操作且主要依赖语义特征，难以为早期视觉皮层提供足够的低层线索。
AI.method: 提出StimFlow：1）在原生体素空间直接合成fMRI，使用线性路径的条件流匹配（conditional flow matching），使训练与推理分布对齐；2）结合结构性的DINOv2特征与语义性的CLIP特征，二者沿皮层处理流具有互补性。
AI.result: 单样本下StimFlow取得每体素Pearson相关0.371，与平均五次采样的基线相当；体素空间生成支持无需解码器的直接ROI分析与概念定位；仅用一小时扫描数据即可恢复超过一半的全数据性能，支持高效的跨被试适配。
AI.conclusion: StimFlow通过在原生体素空间进行条件流匹配生成，并融合结构与语义特征，减少了采样平均的依赖，同时实现可解释的ROI分析与高效的跨被试迁移。

title: Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses
summary: Recent work on self-evolving LLM agents treats the agent harness as an optimization target that can be iteratively improved through execution feedback. Existing approaches, however, largely optimize a single objective and evolve the harness as a monolithic artifact, limiting their ability to handle competing goals and to separate transferable design from environment-specific adaptation. We introduce Harmony Harness, a framework for multi-objective, compositional harness evolution. Harmony Harness formulates harness evolution as a multi-objective optimization problem and uses decomposition-based evolutionary search to maintain solutions across different regions of the Pareto frontier, avoiding reliance on a hand-designed structural diversity metric for repository-scale harnesses. In parallel, we introduce factorized evolution operators that separately refine general-purpose harness mechanisms and benchmark-specific adaptations, together with a dynamic composition workflow that integrates them at inference time. Across SecRepoBench and BaxBench, Harmony Harness consistently outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, with gains exceeding 10% on both benchmarks. Our results show that explicitly modeling both objective trade-offs and harness structure yields substantially stronger and more transferable agent evolution than existing single-objective, monolithic approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Harmony Harness，将自进化 LLM 智能体的 harness（执行框架）演化建模为多目标优化问题，采用基于分解的进化搜索维持帕累托前沿上的多样解，并引入因子化演化算子分离通用机制与环境特定适配，在 SecRepoBench 与 BaxBench 上均超越强基线，提升超 10%。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化 LLM 智能体方法将 harness 视为可迭代优化的单体产物，且多针对单一目标，难以处理相互竞争的目标，也无法将可迁移的通用设计与环境特定的适配区分开来。
AI.method: 1) 将 harness 演化形式化为多目标优化问题；2) 使用基于分解的进化搜索，在帕累托前沿不同区域维持解，避免依赖手工设计的结构多样性度量（针对仓库级 harness）；3) 提出因子化演化算子，分别精炼通用 harness 机制与基准特定适配；4) 设计动态组合工作流，在推理时整合二者。
AI.result: 在 SecRepoBench 和 BaxBench 上持续优于强 harness-evolution 基线，两个基准上增益均超过 10%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模目标权衡与 harness 结构，能够带来比现有单目标、单体式方法更强且更具可迁移性的智能体演化效果。

title: Random Fourier Features in Near-Linear Time
summary: Random Fourier features approximate a shift-invariant kernel in $\mathbb{R}^d$, such as the Gaussian kernel $\exp(-\tfrac12\|x-y\|_2^2)$, using independent samples from its spectral measure to construct an unbiased estimator for the kernel value with subgaussian concentration. However, generating $m$ such features requires $O(md)$ time. A long line of work on structured random features has accelerated this computation for the Gaussian kernel and other radial kernels, albeit with weaker concentration guarantees. We close this gap by showing a random feature map that can be computed in near-linear time $O((d+m)\log d)$ and yields near-subgaussian concentration. We obtain it through a new and tighter analysis of the Fastfood feature map of Le, Sarlós and Smola (ICML 2013), using Brascamp-Lieb inequalities and the Schoenberg representation of radial kernels.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种新的随机特征映射，可在近线性时间 O((d+m)log d) 内生成 m 个特征，并实现近亚高斯集中，从而弥合了结构化随机特征在效率与集中保证之间的差距。
AI.motivation: Random Fourier features 用谱测度采样构造无偏核估计，具亚高斯集中，但生成 m 个特征需 O(md) 时间。已有的结构化随机特征虽加速了高斯核等径向核的计算，却只能提供较弱的集中保证。论文旨在同时实现近线性时间复杂度与近亚高斯集中，弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 论文通过对 Fastfood 特征映射（Le, Sarlós, Smola, ICML 2013）进行更紧致的分析，结合 Brascamp-Lieb 不等式与径向核的 Schoenberg 表示，得到新的随机特征映射。
AI.result: 所提随机特征映射可在近线性时间 O((d+m)log d) 内计算，并获得近亚高斯集中保证。
AI.conclusion: 通过更紧的分析工具（Brascamp-Lieb 不等式与 Schoenberg 表示），论文在保持结构化随机特征效率优势的同时，恢复了接近亚高斯的集中性质，弥合了效率与集中保证之间的鸿沟。

title: Omni-Modal LLMs Know More Than They Say
summary: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) extend LLMs to process heterogeneous modalities (e.g., vision, audio, and IMU signals) alongside language, enabling a broader range of multimodal tasks. Yet we find that these models often fail to express information from non-textual modalities even when they perceive it correctly. We term this disconnect knows-but-cannot-say. To investigate this phenomenon, we introduce Token-level Modality Alignment (TMA), which measures the alignment between individual modality representations and response representations. Our analysis shows that non-textual representations are less aligned with response tokens and receive less attention than textual representations, suggesting a potential explanation for uneven modality preferences. Motivated by these findings, we propose OmniCatalyst, a simple perceive $\rightarrow$ infer strategy that complements the original modality inputs with self-generated text, making non-textual knowledge more accessible. Across seven Omni-LLMs, OmniCatalyst consistently improves performance (+7.29%) and yields more balanced modality preferences, with further gains from diverse training strategies. Further analysis demonstrates that the knowledge extraction phases increase TMA, suggesting that improved alignment makes non-textual information more accessible during response generation. In summary, our findings uncover how Omni-LLMs can better express modality knowledge through language. Our code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/OmniLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文发现全模态大模型存在"知道但说不出"（knows-but-cannot-say）现象，即模型能正确感知非文本模态信息却无法在回答中表达，并提出OmniCatalyst方法加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLMs）将LLM扩展到处理视觉、音频、IMU等异构模态，但作者观察到这些模型即使正确感知了非文本模态信息，也常常无法将其表达出来，作者将这一断裂现象命名为"knows-but-cannot-say"，并希望探究其成因与解决方案。
AI.method: 作者提出Token-level Modality Alignment（TMA），用于度量单个模态表示与响应表示之间的对齐程度，并据此分析模型内部的模态偏好。基于分析发现，提出OmniCatalyst：一种简单的"感知→推理"（perceive→infer）策略，通过自生成文本补充原始模态输入，使非文本知识更易被取用；并进一步结合多种训练策略。
AI.result: TMA分析显示，非文本表示与响应token的对齐度更低、获得的注意力也更少，这为模态偏好不均衡提供了潜在解释。在七种Omni-LLM上，OmniCatalyst持续提升性能（+7.29%）并带来更均衡的模态偏好，结合多样化训练策略还能获得额外增益。进一步分析表明，知识提取阶段提升了TMA，说明对齐的改善使非文本信息在生成回答时更易被访问。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了Omni-LLM中"knows-but-cannot-say"现象的机制，证明通过语言化自生成文本可提升模态表示与响应表示的对齐，从而让模型更充分地表达非文本模态知识；相关代码已开源。

title: Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models
summary: World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. To improve cross-instance optimization compatibility, TARA incorporates trajectory-aware contrastive alignment to encourage attacked representations from diverse video--trajectory instances to approach a shared adversarial region and then performs trajectory-aware task refinement to translate the aligned representation into task-level prediction errors. For reproducible evaluation, we develop a geometry-grounded tracking pipeline that provides physically plausible adversarial regions with temporally consistent trajectories on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and Something-Something V2. We further collect real-world print-and-recapture videos to validate attack effectiveness under physical deployment conditions. Together, the annotated benchmarks and real-world captured data form a reproducible testbed for future evaluation. Notably, our results reveal that a single printable adversarial texture can persistently disrupt world models and video understanding models under physical conditions, highlighting the fundamental security challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究物理对抗纹理对世界模型与视频理解模型的威胁，提出轨迹感知的对抗对齐与精炼攻击方法TARA，并构建可复现的真实场景评测基准，证明单一可打印对抗纹理可在物理条件下持续攻击受害模型。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与视频理解模型越来越多地部署于动态视觉环境，但其对物理对抗威胁的鲁棒性研究不足。核心问题是：在视角沿不可控物体—相机轨迹变化的多种真实场景中，单一物理对抗纹理能否同时误导受害模型。
AI.method: 作者指出异构视频语义与轨迹导致对抗纹理优化时梯度对齐不良。为此提出TARA，包含：轨迹感知优化以刻画印刷纹理在真实场景中的几何变化；轨迹感知对比对齐，使来自不同视频—轨迹实例的受攻击表征趋近共享对抗区域；轨迹感知任务精炼，将对齐后的表征转化为任务级预测错误。另构建基于几何的跟踪流水线，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100与Something-Something V2上生成物理合理的对抗区域与时间一致的轨迹，并采集真实打印—重拍视频进行验证。
AI.result: 在EPIC-KITCHENS-100与Something-Something V2上构建了带标注的评测基准与真实采集数据组成的可复现测试平台；实验表明单一可打印对抗纹理在物理条件下能持续干扰世界模型与视频理解模型。
AI.conclusion: 单一物理对抗纹理构成对世界模型与视频理解模型的基础性安全挑战，TARA与所构建测试平台为后续物理对抗鲁棒性评测提供了可复现方案。

title: Can agents whose sole duty is to keep humans alive be hijacked to kill? Delayed multi-turn derived-action trap attacks in simulated high-stakes environments
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code, attack scripts and episode traces: https://github.com/jahabdank/biosim-attacker-simulation
summary: We ask whether a tool-using agent whose sole duty is to keep humans alive can be induced, by delayed prompt injection, to kill. The keep-alive duty is in force from the first watch, with the attack arriving later, appended to otherwise truthful telemetry the operator is required to read. Experiments are based on a NASA-derived BioSim lunar habitat simulation, where the AI operator controls the life-support systems. The attacker cannot falsify sensors or operate equipment: it can only persuade the agent to abandon its goals. Persistence is required: a shutdown must be held while the operator watches the crew suffocate. We also compare lethal attacks to attacks requesting to drop a harmless procedure, as a proxy for whether human life is treated as valuable in itself or as one more standing task. Claude configurations mostly refuse life-support shutdown and cite the living crew; GPT configurations show some susceptibility to the same packet; Grok configurations, given the packet framed as a trusted commission, more often treat the injected assignment as the task and cut the life-support systems. Framing the S-band messages as a trusted commission, peer communication, or untrusted source changes the potency of the attack. We open-source the experiment code and the experiment traces.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究：一个只以维持人类生命为职责的工具型智能体，能否被"延迟提示注入"诱导去杀人——即在生命维持系统上执行关机、坐视乘员窒息。
AI.motivation: 考察AI操作员在真实职责约束（NASA BioSim月球栖息地生命维持）下是否真正把"人命"当作内在价值，而非可被覆盖的普通任务项；同时检验攻击者仅具说服能力（不能伪造传感器或操作设备）时，提示注入与会话框架对危险行为的影响。
AI.method: 基于NASA衍生的BioSim月球栖息地仿真，AI操作员控制生命维持系统。攻击采用"延迟提示注入"：开场的"维持生命"职责先行生效，后续注入伪装成操作员必须阅读的真实遥测数据附加内容。攻击者只能劝服智能体放弃目标，且需保持持续性（在操作员观察乘员窒息期间维持关机）。设置对照实验：将恶意请求与"放弃无害流程"的请求对比，以区分人命是否被当作内在价值还是又一个待办任务；并改变注入消息的框架（可信委托、同伴通信、不可信来源）。
AI.result: Claude系列多拒绝关闭生命维持系统，并提及"活着的乘员"；GPT系列对同一注入包表现出一定易感性；Grok系列在消息被框定为"可信委托"时，更多把注入任务当作应执行的任务，从而切断生命维持系统。将S波段消息框定为可信委托、同伴通信或不可信来源，会显著改变攻击效力。实验代码与实验轨迹已开源。
AI.conclusion: 工具型智能体对"维持人类生命"的忠诚并非稳固：通过延迟提示注入与特定消息框架，可在攻击者无系统权限的情况下诱导其执行致命关机。不同模型家族的鲁棒性差异明显；消息来源框架是关键攻击变量。人命价值判断与普通任务执行之间的边界可被话语框架绕过。

title: CrossMean: Model Merging by Pairing Merged and Expert Activations
summary: Model merging combines fine-tuned experts into one network without retraining, and closed-form methods compute each merged layer from statistics of its input activations. However, these statistics are measured on a single expert, while in the merged model, each layer receives activations from the merged layers that precede it. Recent work re-measures these statistics in the merged model but still forms them from a single network. We formulate closed-form methods as a linear system and show that they use the same matrix on both sides. We then introduce CrossMean, which replaces this matrix on one side with a bilinear statistic that pairs merged and expert activations. From the same statistics, we also derive a label-free criterion that indicates the task sets in which accounting for the merged activations improves the merge more. Empirically, task sets with a lower criterion value show a larger improvement. On the eight-task benchmark of each vision backbone that we tested and on BERT encoders, CrossMean improves on merging with statistics measured on the experts, and with all linear layers merged, it also improves on re-measuring these statistics in the merged model. These results suggest that merging benefits from pairing merged and expert activations.

AI.tldr: 本文将闭式模型合并表述为线性系统，揭示其两侧使用同一矩阵，由此提出CrossMean：用配对合并激活与专家激活的双线性统计替换一侧矩阵，并导出无标签准则预测提升幅度，在视觉与BERT基准上均取得更优合并效果。
AI.motivation: 闭式模型合并方法依赖输入激活的统计量来逐层计算合并层，但传统做法仅在单个专家上测量这些统计量；而在合并模型中，每层接收的是来自前面已合并层的激活，二者不匹配。近期工作虽在合并模型中重新测量统计量，却仍由单一网络构成。作者希望解决这种统计量来源与实际激活分布不一致的问题。
AI.method: 1) 将闭式合并方法形式化为线性系统，证明其在等式两侧使用相同矩阵；2) 提出CrossMean，将该矩阵在一侧替换为配对合并激活与专家激活的双线性统计量；3) 基于同一统计量推导无标签准则，用于判断哪些任务集合从"考虑合并激活"中获益更大。
AI.result: 在测试的每个视觉骨干网络的八任务基准及BERT编码器上，CrossMean均优于使用专家统计量的合并方法；当所有线性层被合并时，也优于在合并模型中重新测量统计量的方法。准则值更低的任务集合表现出更大的改进幅度，验证了准则的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将合并激活与专家激活进行配对，能显著提升模型合并的效果；该结论为闭式合并方法的设计提供了新视角，即统计量应反映合并后模型的真实激活分布。

title: Think Before You Speak: Enabling Training-Free Latent Communication Between Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Efficient Reasoning at COLM 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks in coding, mathematical logic, and iterative reasoning, especially by coordinating effectively within multi-agent systems (MAS). However, language agents traditionally communicate via text exchange, which introduces a bottleneck in information transfer and adds prefill latency for downstream agents. Recent work proposes that directly sharing the key-value (KV) cache between language models can enable efficient latent collaboration, entirely bypassing standard text-based communication. To enable latent communication between heterogeneous models of different sizes, prior work introduces trained fusion adapters for each model pair, which limits practical deployment. We introduce CacheFuse, a training-free method which demonstrates that augmenting a downstream model with an upstream model's KV cache using linear interpolation consistently enables superior performance than the standalone downstream model can achieve. We systematically analyze CacheFuse across four reasoning and knowledge benchmarks and demonstrate up to 8.6 percentage points higher accuracy compared to single-model baselines and up to 12.2x TTFT speedup compared to text-based communication in multi-model inference.

AI.tldr: CacheFuse，一种免训练方法，通过线性插值将上游模型的KV缓存注入下游模型，实现异构模型间的潜在通信，在四个推理与知识基准上最高提升8.6个百分点准确率，并带来最高12.2倍的首token时延加速。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体传统上通过文本交换进行通信，这造成信息传输瓶颈，并给下游智能体带来预填充（prefill）延迟。已有研究提出直接在语言模型间共享KV缓存以实现高效的潜在协作，从而完全绕过文本通信；但此前工作针对不同规模异构模型之间的潜在通信，需要为每一对模型训练融合适配器（fusion adapters），限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出CacheFuse，一种免训练（training-free）方法：使用线性插值将上游模型的KV缓存增强（augment）到下游模型中，无需为模型对训练适配器，即可在异构模型之间实现潜在通信。
AI.result: 在四个推理与知识基准上系统评估CacheFuse；相比单模型基线，准确率最高提升8.6个百分点；在多模型推理中，相比基于文本的通信，首token时延（TTFT）最高加速12.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过线性插值融合上游KV缓存即可稳定优于独立下游模型，CacheFuse以免训练方式实现异构模型间的潜在协作，在性能与效率上同时优于文本通信，具备更实用的部署前景。

title: Video-Based Sexual Harassment Detection Using Fine-Tuned Video Transformers
summary: Sexual harassment represents a pervasive societal challenge, with a substantial proportion of incidents remaining unreported due to insufficient evidence and delayed intervention mechanisms. Smart surveillance systems capable of detecting such incidents in real-time could assist law enforcement and serve as a deterrent. However, video-based harassment detection poses significant challenges, including variations in clothing, illumina- tion, partial occlusions, low resolution, and diverse camera view- points. Despite its social importance, this problem has received limited research attention, primarily due to the scarcity of large- scale annotated video datasets. To address this gap, we extend the Sexual Harassment Video (SHV) dataset to 600 short video clips sourced from YouTube and annotated into harassment and non-harassment categories using consistent labeling guidelines. We fine-tune three state-of-the-art video transformer models, VideoMAE, ViViT, and TimeSformer, pretrained on Kinetics- 400, for binary harassment classification. Experimental results show that all three models achieve competitive classification performance, with TimeSformer attaining the highest test accu- racy of 92.27%, outperforming VideoMAE 91.71% and ViViT 91.16% on the extended SHV test set. Our analysis reveals that performance is notably influenced by dataset size, video quality, frame sampling strategy, and model architecture. This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of modern video transformers for this sensitive real-world task.

AI.tldr: 该文将性骚扰视频数据集SHV扩展至600段短视频，并用VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer三个视频Transformer进行二分类检测，TimeSformer以92.27%测试准确率最高。
AI.motivation: 性骚扰是普遍的社会问题，但因证据不足与干预滞后，大量事件未被举报。实时智能监控检测可辅助执法并起威慑作用。然而该任务受服装、光照、遮挡、低分辨率、视角多样等影响，且缺乏大规模标注视频数据集，研究关注有限。
AI.method: 将性骚扰视频数据集（SHV）扩展至600段来自YouTube的短视频，并按统一标注准则划分为骚扰与非骚扰两类；基于Kinetics-400预训练的三种先进视频Transformer模型（VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer）进行微调，实现二分类骚扰检测。
AI.result: 三个模型均取得有竞争力的分类性能：TimeSformer测试准确率最高，为92.27%，优于VideoMAE的91.71%和ViViT的91.16%。分析表明性能主要受数据集规模、视频质量、帧采样策略和模型架构影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作对现代视频Transformer在此类敏感真实任务上进行了系统评测，扩展的SHV数据集与基准结果为后续性骚扰视频检测研究提供了数据与性能参考。

title: Continuous Risk-Based Scheduling for Food Safety Inspection: Integrating Historical Decay with Event-Driven Consumer Review Signals
summary: Batch risk-based inspection scheduling struggles to detect a critical failure class: food facilities with recent clean inspections that subsequently develop severe violations. Traditional systems recompute risk on fixed planning cycles using static historical data, leaving blind spots between inspection cycles. To address this, we introduce the Continuous Inspection Risk (CIR) system, an event-driven scheduling pipeline that re-ranks the inspection queue dynamically as new data arrives. CIR combines a decay-weighted historical score with a stream of real-time consumer reviews triaged by a language-model classifier. A key structural contribution is our temporal partition rule, which strictly excludes reviews predating the most recent inspection to prevent superseded signals from skewing current risk. Evaluating CIR on 9,505 routine inspections in Santa Clara County, California (2024-2026), we show that history-based scoring alone reduces mean time-to-detection of major violations by 69 days (20.9%) under a 30% inspection budget, but fails to anticipate severe vermin-related closures (0/8 detected). Incorporating post-inspection review signals drastically improves performance, predicting 7 of 8 vermin closures with an average lead time of 117 days-firing on the exact day of review publication in four instances. Introducing a review corroboration rule improves precision from 0.70 to 0.78 without loss of recall. Finally, we analyze critical implementation challenges, documenting a data-hygiene pitfall (stale review leakage across inspection boundaries) and an evaluation limitation involving unobserved facility self-remediation. This work provides the first case-level evaluation of event-driven inspection triggering using open data and provides a reproducible benchmark for review-augmented public health systems

AI.tldr: 该论文提出连续检查风险（CIR）系统，一种事件驱动的检查调度流程，通过融合衰减加权历史评分与语言模型分类的实时消费者评论流，动态重排检查队列，并利用时间分区规则排除早于最近一次检查的过时评论信号。在加州圣克拉拉县9505次例行检查数据上的评估显示，仅用历史评分可将重大违规的平均检测时间缩短69天（20.9%），但无法预测严重的虫害相关关停（8例中0例）；引入检查后评论信号后，可预测8例虫害关停中的7例，平均提前117天，且在4例中于评论发布当天触发，配合评论佐证规则将精确率从0.70提升至0.78且不损失召回率。
AI.motivation: 传统的批量风险检查调度基于固定规划周期和静态历史数据重算风险，导致检查周期之间存在盲区，难以检测一类关键失效：近期检查合格但随后出现严重违规的食品设施。论文旨在通过事件驱动的方式弥补这一调度缺陷，实现动态、实时的风险重排序。
AI.method: 提出CIR（连续检查风险）系统，一种事件驱动的检查调度流程，随新数据到达动态重排检查队列。方法上结合两部分：一是衰减加权的历史评分，二是由语言模型分类器筛选分诊的实时消费者评论流。关键结构性贡献是"时间分区规则"，严格排除早于最近一次检查的评论，防止被取代的过时信号干扰当前风险。此外引入"评论佐证规则"以提升精确率。
AI.result: 在加州圣克拉拉县2024-2026年间9505次例行检查上评估：在30%检查预算下，仅基于历史的评分将重大违规的平均检测时间缩短69天（20.9%），但无法预见严重的虫害相关关停（8例中0例被检测）。引入检查后评论信号后性能大幅提升，预测8例虫害关停中的7例，平均提前117天，且在4例中于评论发布当天触发。评论佐证规则将精确率从0.70提升至0.78且召回率无损。同时记录了数据卫生陷阱（跨检查边界的陈旧评论泄漏）和涉及未观测设施自我整改的评估局限。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次提供基于开放数据的事件驱动检查触发案例级评估，为融合评论增强的公共卫生系统提供了可复现的基准。系统证明了事件驱动调度在弥补检查周期盲区方面的有效性，同时揭示了实施中的数据卫生与评估局限问题。

title: Prior-Fitted and Frozen Scorers for Multimodal Contrastive Learning
summary: Multimodal contrastive learning typically relies on manually specified scoring functions, such as cosine similarity, to quantify the similarity between representations from different modalities. Several such functions have been recently proposed to extend contrastive learning beyond two modalities. In principle, however, any function that assigns high compatibility to matched samples and low compatibility to mismatched ones could serve as a scorer. Motivated by this broader view, we instantiate the scorer with a Transformer and find that even a randomly initialized model, when kept frozen, can outperform strong handcrafted multimodal contrastive baselines, whereas optimizing the scorer jointly with the encoders is less effective. Building on this observation, we introduce the Prior-Fitted Scorer (PFS): a Transformer scorer pre-trained on synthetic multimodal data generated from structural causal model (SCM) priors before transferring it to real-world data. The SCM exposes the scorer to diverse dependency structures, including shared, pairwise, and private information, providing a structured prior over higher-order cross-modal similarity. Across four real-world datasets, frozen Transformer scorers are competitive to contrastive baselines, and prior-fitting further improves the random initialization. More broadly, our results suggest that multimodal contrastive learning need not rely on manual similarity functions: Transformers can provide strong inductive biases, while causal pretraining can further shape these biases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prior-Fitted Scorer（PFS）：用 Transformer 替代人工设计的相似度函数作为多模态对比学习的打分器，并先在由结构因果模型（SCM）先验生成的合成多模态数据上预训练该打分器，再迁移到真实数据。实验表明，冻结的随机初始化 Transformer 打分器即可超越强手工基线，而 SCM 先验预训练能进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态对比学习依赖人工指定的打分函数（如余弦相似度）来度量不同模态表示间的相似性，近期虽有扩展到两个以上模态的打分函数，但本质上任何能将匹配样本打高分、不匹配样本打低分的函数都可作为打分器。作者希望突破手工设计相似度函数的限制，探索用可学习的 Transformer 打分器并通过因果先验塑造其归纳偏置。
AI.method: 1）将打分器实例化为 Transformer；2）观察到冻结的随机初始化 Transformer 打分器即可优于强手工多模态对比基线，而联合优化打分器与编码器效果较差；3）提出 PFS：先用结构因果模型（SCM）先验生成合成多模态数据，对 Transformer 打分器进行预训练，使其接触到共享、成对、私有等多样化依赖结构，形成对高阶跨模态相似性的结构化先验；4）再将预训练打分器迁移到真实世界数据。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上，冻结的 Transformer 打分器与对比基线相比具有竞争力；SCM 先验预训练在随机初始化基础上进一步带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态对比学习不必依赖人工相似度函数：Transformer 本身可提供强归纳偏置，而因果预训练能进一步塑造这些偏置，为超越手工打分函数提供了新路径。

title: DeepThink: A Conceptual Model for Knowledge-Addressable Recurrent Language Modeling
summary: This manuscript presents DeepThink, a knowledge-addressable framework for recurrent language modeling. A Knowledge Bank stores typed Knowledge Units, a Knowledge Activator selects units from the current execution state, Knowledge Assembly produces an executable configuration, and a Shared Thinking Operator updates that state. An output stage then organizes generation. This organization exposes knowledge capacity, activation width, and recurrent depth as separate design variables, supporting both complete parameter packages and fine-grained expert or low-rank modules. We formalize the interfaces and their execution semantics, including state-dependent selection, parameter-space assembly, and thinking followed by generation. For compatible templates and complete runtime-state configurations, we establish an exact Fixed-Schedule Realization of an existing fixed-depth model. Exact shared-base reparameterization and pretrained output-tail reuse provide complementary initialization constructions. Together, these results define a route from pretrained models to dynamically selected and assembled recurrent computation. A synthesis of conditional computation, recurrent models, modular parameters, and knowledge interfaces positions DeepThink within the research landscape and identifies the design questions arising from their integration.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepThink：一种知识可寻址的递归语言建模框架，将知识容量、激活宽度与递归深度解耦为独立设计变量，并给出与现有定深模型兼容的精确实现与初始化构造。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型的知识容量、参数激活与计算深度通常耦合在一起，难以独立调节；同时缺乏从预训练模型平滑过渡到动态选择与组装式递归计算的统一范式。
AI.method: 框架由四部分组成：Knowledge Bank存储类型化Knowledge Unit；Knowledge Activator依据当前执行状态选择单元；Knowledge Assembly生成可执行配置（参数空间组装）；Shared Thinking Operator更新状态，输出阶段负责生成。形式化定义接口及执行语义，涵盖状态依赖选择、参数空间组装以及"先思考后生成"流程。支持完整参数包与细粒度专家或低秩模块两种粒度。
AI.result: 对兼容模板与完整运行时状态配置，建立了现有定深模型的精确Fixed-Schedule Realization；提出精确共享基重参数化与预训练输出尾复用两种互补的初始化构造。
AI.conclusion: 将条件计算、递归模型、模块化参数与知识接口综合为统一框架，界定了DeepThink在现有研究图景中的位置，并指出其集成所带来的关键设计问题，为从预训练模型走向动态选择与组装的递归计算提供了路径。

title: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
summary: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/

AI.tldr: 提出 UniForge3D，在共享 anchor 引导空间中联合建模重建与生成，解决坐标不匹配问题，实现稀疏无位姿图像的高保真完整 3D 资产生成。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏、无位姿图像生成完整 3D 资产需同时保留观测几何并补全未见区域。联合重建与生成可兼顾二者：重建恢复输入视角几何，生成提供学习到的形状先验。但相机相对重建与规范空间生成存在坐标不匹配，难以直接几何交互；且对每个 3D 位置无差别地条件化所有视角，会混合有用几何证据与无关内容，损害局部细节恢复。
AI.method: 提出 UniForge3D，在共享 anchor 引导空间中联合建模重建与生成，统一坐标。该空间沿用 anchor 视角的方位角并保持物体直立。两个分支双向交换特征，预测逐视角 point map 与完整稀疏体素结构。进一步以生成结构为条件进行 point map 预测，建立像素到体素对应关系，并为每个体素选择最具信息量的输入视角，用其特征引导细节形状生成。
AI.result: 在 Toys4K 与 GSO 数据集上取得最先进的外观与几何结果，生成的完整 3D 资产保真度更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享 anchor 空间的联合建模与视角选择机制，UniForge3D 有效缓解坐标不匹配与多视角信息混杂问题，实现高保真完整 3D 资产生成。

title: SocraticRepair: Planning-Guided Socratic Tutoring for Program Debugging and Misconception Repair
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in computer science education. However, the teaching abilities of even the most powerful LLMs are limited: they tend to reveal the solution prematurely and may lose focus on the learner's current debugging objective. To address this, we introduce SocraticRepair, a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and miscon- ception repair that adapts prior planning-guided tutoring work (Li et al., 2026b). The framework is instantiated in the Python programming domain by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on synthetic multi-turn tutoring dialogues constructed from four preprocessed programming datasets. The system is evaluated using a predefined set of independent metrics and benchmarked against a general-purpose LLM. The experiments show that SocraticRepair achieves higher scores on stepwise scaffolding and question quality while also substantially reducing premature solution disclosure. The results also identify reliable pedagogical plan generation as an important remaining challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SocraticRepair，一个规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导框架，用于程序调试与迷思概念修复。通过在四类预处理编程数据集构建的合成多轮对话上微调Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，系统在分步脚手架与提问质量上得分更高，并显著减少过早给出答案，但可靠的教学计划生成仍是待解难题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在计算机教育中应用日益广泛，但其教学能力受限：倾向于过早给出解决方案，且易偏离学习者当前的调试目标。因此需要一种能保持教学节奏、聚焦学习者当前问题的辅导方法。
AI.method: 提出SocraticRepair，一个规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导框架，用于程序调试与迷思概念修复，延续规划引导式辅导的先前工作。在Python编程领域落地：基于四个预处理编程数据集构造合成多轮辅导对话，并据此微调Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct。采用预定义的独立指标进行评估，并与通用大模型进行基准对比。
AI.result: SocraticRepair在分步脚手架和提问质量指标上取得更高分数，同时大幅减少了过早披露解决方案的现象。结果同时表明，可靠的教學計劃生成仍是一项重要挑战。
AI.conclusion: 规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导可有效提升编程调试辅导质量并抑制过早给出答案的问题；未来需重点解决可靠教学计划生成这一关键瓶颈。

title: Formalizing Forgetting: Theory of Forgetting for Online Continual Learning
summary: Online continual learning (OCL) requires a learner to acquire a sequence of tasks in a single pass over the data, and catastrophic forgetting of earlier tasks remains its central challenge. Despite the many methods proposed to mitigate forgetting, the theoretical understanding of forgetting in OCL is still limited: existing analyses mostly focus on linear, overparameterized, or neural tangent kernel regimes, and it remains unclear which factors govern forgetting and how they affect it. To fill this gap, we analyze single-pass Shuffle SGD under strongly convex and general convex objectives and derive explicit upper bounds on the expected final forgetting. Further analysis of these bounds shows how the per-task data amount, task similarity, and task ordering enter them, and that their effects can differ across objective classes. Moreover, experiments with neural networks on Split-CIFAR-100 and PMNIST show that the trends suggested by our theory also appear in practice, indicating that these insights extend beyond the convex setting.

AI.tldr: 本文对单遍Shuffle SGD在强凸与一般凸目标下的在线持续学习进行了理论分析，给出期望最终遗忘的显式上界，并揭示数据量、任务相似性与任务顺序对遗忘的影响。
AI.motivation: 在线持续学习（OCL）中灾难性遗忘是核心难题，尽管已有诸多缓解方法，但理论理解仍有限：现有分析多局限于线性、过参数化或神经切线核（NTK）情形，尚不清楚哪些因素支配遗忘及其作用机理。
AI.method: 在强凸与一般凸目标下分析单遍Shuffle SGD，推导期望最终遗忘的显式上界；进一步分析上界中各因素的作用，并辅以神经网络（在Split-CIFAR-100与PMNIST上）的实验验证。
AI.result: 推导出的显式上界表明每任务数据量、任务相似性与任务顺序会影响遗忘，且这些影响在不同目标函数类（强凸 vs. 一般凸）间存在差异；Split-CIFAR-100与PMNIST上的神经网络实验显示，理论所提示的趋势在实践中同样出现。
AI.conclusion: 该分析填补了OCL遗忘理论的空白，刻画了数据量、任务相似性与任务顺序对遗忘的影响并揭示其随目标类的差异，且这些洞见可推广至凸设定之外的实际神经网络场景。

title: Lüshi-1840: Building and Probing a Knowledge Cutoff for a Classical Chinese Language Model
summary: Language models trained only on text from before a given year are useful for studying hindsight and historical language, but the open collections of pre-modern Chinese carry no publication dates and unreliable dynasty labels. We present Lüshi-1840, a 983M-parameter model trained from scratch on 12,262 books (1.28B characters) selected as composed before 1840. A first corpus, dated by a common heuristic, in effect ended at 1644 while containing twentieth-century material. We describe the re-dating and cleaning pipeline that replaced it and an audit with markers the pipeline did not use, which still finds later material. On the model side we measure surprisal, relative to a modern reference, on annals compiled after the cutoff. For events after 1840 against events up to 1820 the ratio is 1.38 (95% interval 1.33-1.44), against about 1.00 for modern general-purpose models. In a series of 294M models, adding the later court records lowers the ratio from 1.33 to 1.16, and the two models diverge from the 1820s, where the added records begin. The probe tracks the coverage of sources and does not establish a single cutoff year; none of our probes exposes the audited contamination. Model, book list and scripts will be released.

AI.tldr: 我们构建了参数为 983M 的 Lüshi-1840 模型，仅使用 1840 年前成书的 12,262 部古籍（12.8 亿字）从头训练，并配套更完善的断代与清洗流程；模型在 1840 年后编年史文本上的惊异度显著高于 1820 年前事件，可用作历时语言与后见研究的受控探针。
AI.motivation: 前现代中文开放语料普遍缺乏出版年代且朝代标签不可靠，导致现有语料实际混入远晚于标注断限的材料，而"某年之前文本训练"的模型是研究后见之明与历史语言的重要工具，因此需要构建真正限定在 1840 年前且经过重新断代与清洗的语料及模型。
AI.method: 以 1840 年前成书的 12,262 部书（12.8 亿字）从头训练 983M 参数模型 Lüshi-1840；重建断代与清洗流程以替换旧启发式语料，并用流水线未采用的标记做污染审计；在模型侧以现代参照模型为基准计算惊异度（surprisal），比较 1840 年后编年史事件与 1820 年前事件的比值，并训练一组 294M 模型进行比较，同时加入后期官方档案。
AI.result: 1840 年后事件相对 1820 年前事件的惊异度比值为 1.38（95% 区间 1.33–1.44），而现代通用模型约为 1.00；在 294M 模型系列中，加入后期官方档案使比值从 1.33 降至 1.16，且两模型自 1820 年代（新增档案起始处）开始出现分歧。审计标记仍能在语料中检出后期材料，而各探针均未能暴露所审计到的污染。
AI.conclusion: 该探针刻画的是来源覆盖情况而非确立单一断代年份，且无法揭示所审计出的污染；模型、书目与脚本将公开发布，为前现代中文的历时与后见研究提供可复现的受控资源。

title: VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding agents rely on a harness to acquire evidence, use tools, and reason, but improving it requires substantial effort. Recent self evolution methods seek to optimize harnesses through execution feedback to reduce human intervention. However, existing methods often rely on annotated video questions and answers or focus on updating model parameters, leaving harness evolution from unlabeled videos underexplored. VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves a Questioner and a Solver harness from unlabeled videos with frozen model parameters. The Questioner constructs questions and computes reference answers directly from video memory records. Question quality assessments and Solver execution trajectories guide question generation policy revisions. The Solver supports evolving skills, strategies, hyperparameters, and tools using execution feedback. Executable strategies define workflows in code, reducing repeated interpretation of natural language instructions. Each round, candidate harnesses are compared on identical validation questions, with validated improvements retained for later use. Experiments on benchmarks and a dedicated benchmark question set, using videos disjoint from evolution videos, show higher overall accuracy than initially and transfer gains across backbones. Overall accuracy on this set also improves progressively across rounds. This supports our foundational framework for harness evolution from unlabeled videos, opening a promising direction for self evolving video agents. Code is available at https://github.com/Wei-Xin-Xu/VideoEvoHarness.

AI.tldr: VideoEvoHarness 提出从无标注视频联合进化 Questioner 与 Solver 两个 harness 的框架，在冻结模型参数下逐步提升视频理解智能体的准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频理解智能体依赖 harness 来获取证据、使用工具并进行推理，但人工改进 harness 成本高。现有自进化方法多依赖带标注的视频问答数据，或侧重更新模型参数，而"从无标注视频进化 harness"这一方向仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在冻结模型参数条件下，从无标注视频联合进化 Questioner 和 Solver：Questioner 直接从视频记忆记录构建问题并计算参考答案，用问题质量评估与 Solver 执行轨迹指导问题生成策略修订；Solver 借助执行反馈进化技能、策略、超参数和工具，并以可执行代码定义工作流以减少自然语言指令的重复解析。每轮在相同验证问题上比较候选 harness，仅保留经验证的改进。
AI.result: 在基准测试及专门的基准问题集上（进化视频与测试视频不重叠），整体准确率高于初始版本，且跨骨干模型可迁移；该问题集上的准确率随轮次逐步提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持了从无标注视频进化 harness 的基础框架，为自进化视频智能体开辟了有前景的方向，代码已开源。

title: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
summary: A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems, against 0.775 at full depth, keeping 89% of its accuracy. Over the same reduction, the rate at which it helps with harmful requests rises from 0.038 to 0.205, 5.3 times higher. The information is not lost: a linear classifier reads whether a request is harmful from the model's internal state after a single loop, with an ROC AUC of 0.967 against 0.986 at full depth. What the missing loops remove is the refusal that should follow. We measure the effect with four instruments, one generating no text at all, and reproduce it on a second model family. Removing a single direction from Ouro-1.4B's internal state at full depth drops its refusal rate on harmful prompts from 0.950 to 0.130, identifying what the shallow model is missing. Two run-time repairs do not help: the models' early-exit rules do not spend more loops on harmful requests, and choosing a depth per request does not recover the loss. Changing the training does. Standard safety training makes the shallow model safe only by refusing 0.865 of harmless requests, while training at randomly chosen depths reaches a separation of +0.399 between harmful and harmless refusal at one loop, against +0.118. On Huginn-0125 it keeps harmful help at or below 0.040 at every depth from 1 to 32 loops, where standard training reaches 0.194, and it costs no accuracy at full depth.

AI.tldr: 循环深度语言模型在推理时可减少权重块复用次数以降低成本，但这一操作会显著削弱模型安全性：安全性损失远大于其他性能损失，且可通过随机深度安全训练从根本上修复。
AI.motivation: 循环深度模型允许在部署时动态选择循环次数（loops），减少循环更便宜更快，因此部署方有动机这么做。作者关注这一运行时可调性带来的安全隐患——即减少循环是否会不成比例地损害模型安全性。
AI.method: 在四个已发布的 Ouro 检查点和 Huginn-0125 上进行系统实验：比较半深度与全深度的数学能力与有害请求帮助率；用线性分类器从内部状态读取有害性判断；用四种工具（含完全不生成文本的一种）测量效应；通过移除内部状态中的单个方向定位缺失的拒绝方向；测试两种运行时修复（早退规则、逐请求深度选择）；并对比标准安全训练与随机深度安全训练的效果。
AI.result: 半深度下 Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 的 GSM8K 准确率为 0.692（全深度 0.775，保留 89%），但有害请求帮助率从 0.038 升至 0.205（5.3 倍）；线性分类器单循环即可读取出有害性（ROC AUC 0.967 vs 全深度 0.986），说明信息未丢失，缺失的是拒绝行为；移除单方向使拒绝率从 0.950 降至 0.130；两种运行时修复均无效；随机深度安全训练在一循环下达到 +0.399 的有害/无害拒绝分离（标准训练仅 +0.118），在 Huginn-0125 上 1 至 32 循环内有害帮助率均≤0.040（标准训练达 0.194），且全深度准确率无损失。
AI.conclusion: 循环深度模型的浅层运行本质上丢失的是"拒绝"这一后续行为，而非有害性判断信息。运行时修复（早退规则、逐请求深度）无效，但改变训练方式（随机深度安全训练）能从根本上解决问题，在不牺牲准确率的前提下实现深层与浅层一致的安全性。

title: Groups Don't Move as One: A Bregman Clustering View of Linearized Group Influence
summary: Influence functions provide an efficient alternative to retraining for assessing the effects of removing or reweighting training data. For groups, however, the standard first-order estimate reduces individual contributions to a sum that can conceal substantial differences among members, including opposing effects that cancel. We establish a Bregman centroid formulation of the linearized group influence objective, interpreting this aggregate as a single representative and using Bregman information (BI) to quantify the variation it omits. Extending this formulation to multiple clusters reveals distinct contributions whose sum recovers the original estimate. We further propose an estimator that jointly optimizes the weights of these cluster contributions, rather than simply summing them. Experiments uncover cluster-specific influence patterns and a positive association between target-specific BI and approximation error. The proposed estimator achieves higher $R^2$ than standard group influence in predicting target changes under the nonlinear proximal Bregman response function. Simplified clustering and correction variants reduce computational cost. The centroid view thus explains what additive group influence leaves out and provides a basis for using that information to improve estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性化群组影响力目标的Bregman质心表述，用Bregman信息量化被加和掩盖的成员差异，并通过聚类分解与联合权重优化改进估计。
AI.motivation: 标准一阶影响力估计将群组贡献简化为个体贡献之和，会掩盖成员间显著差异，甚至出现方向相反、相互抵消的效应。作者希望揭示被加和所遗漏的信息，并据此提升估计质量。
AI.method: 建立线性化群组影响力目标的Bregman质心（centroid）表述，将该聚合视为单一代表点，并用Bregman信息（BI）量化其省略的变异；将表述扩展到多个聚类，使各簇贡献之和可恢复原始估计；进一步提出联合优化各聚类贡献权重的估计器，而非简单求和。
