AI.tldr: 语言模型预测能力评估需超越关联准确率，考察隐藏状态推断与干预预测。作者提出基于多智能体策略游戏引擎的 CivWorldBench（1900个决策点、475个世界、三级任务），并通过区分度评估、过程验证与智能体博弈实验，揭示了隐藏状态推断、中间状态预测与效应校准是当前世界模型训练的关键短板。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益被用于预测，因此对其"世界模型"能力的评估需要扩展。现有真实世界预测基准难以获取隐藏状态的真值，也难以实施受控实验与干预，导致只能评估关联预测精度，无法考察隐藏状态推断与干预预测等更核心的能力。
AI.method: 构建 CivWorldBench：基于多智能体策略游戏引擎，具备可记录的内部状态、受控观测与成对干预 rollout。含475个世界、1900个决策点，设三级任务——关联预测、信念推断、干预预测。配备参考预测器以归因能力差距，专家 harness 与经验上限估计用于分数语境化；存储轨迹使中间预测可验证；通过智能体博弈实验检验世界模型能力是否支撑决策。主评测面板为11个前沿语言模型。
AI.result: 复合基准分数在匹配模型面板上与真实世界预测排行榜的相关性高于与通用能力指数的相关性，支持其作为真实预测能力的代理指标。强关联预测能力未能一致地迁移到信念推断或干预预测；方向预测虽有信息量，但效应量级校准差。过程验证揭示了最终答案评估遗漏的错误；在过程研究中，结构化推理提升了最强模型的干预预测；智能体博弈实验识别出有用的辅助方案。
AI.conclusion: CivWorldBench 可作为真实世界预测能力的代理评测，并表明需要评估超越关联预测的决策相关能力。隐藏状态推断、中间状态预测与效应校准应作为世界模型训练的重点方向。

title: A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?
summary: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalCascade，一个基于模拟器的视频生成基准，用于评估模型能否忠实生成完整因果级联。基准包含50个Blender事件场景、结构化事件图、图grounded诊断VQA、三级未来事件指定及2,832个反事实变体，并评测9个图生视频模型。结果显示模型运动定位能力优于时空演化实现，反事实选择性响应弱，多数失败发生在场景一致性或事件发生层面。作者据此将因果级联生成定位为世界模型的过程级测试。
AI.motivation: 大规模视频生成模型被视为通往世界模型的有前景路径，但其是否真能捕捉因果连贯的物理动态仍不清楚。现有评估多聚焦视觉质量、提示遵循或宽泛物理合理性，无法判断模型能否忠实实现一个"起始事件经因果依赖互动传播至终端结果"的完整因果级联，因此需要过程级的因果级联评测。
AI.method: 提出 CausalCascade 基准：以50个事件丰富的 Blender 场景为核心，配套结构化事件图、基于事件图的诊断式 VQA、三个层次的未来事件指定，以及2,832个受控反事实变体；并据此对9个图像到视频模型进行评测，在运动层、事件层和反事实层提供互补诊断。
AI.result: 生成运动在空间定位上比在正确的时空演化上更可靠；更丰富的未来事件指定能提升事件恢复率，但物理实现仍受限；反事实评估显示模型对物理干预的选择性响应较弱；多数被审计的失败是基础性的，出现在场景一致性或事件发生阶段。
AI.conclusion: 因果级联生成可作为世界模型的过程级测试，要求模型同时做到：恢复预期未来、忠实实现其物理演化、对物理干预作出选择性响应，并在时间上维持一致的物理世界。代码与数据集已开源。

title: SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models
summary: Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. Specifically, we first extract task-relevant representations from the source models and the host model using shared anchor samples, and apply principal component analysis (PCA) to construct low-dimensional functional subspaces with the same dimensionality. Next, we use orthogonal Procrustes mappings to align the source and host coordinate systems, establishing cross-model correspondences while preserving the internal geometry of each source subspace. Finally, we train a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with joint supervision on task outputs and source-model increments, learning input-dependent residual increments that are injected into the host model for multi-model capability fusion. Experiments on three host models across 15 capability domains show that SuperAI achieves higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture fusion methods and better preserves general capabilities as the number of source models increases. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of orthogonal alignment, nonlinear residual mapping, and joint supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出SuperAI跨架构多模型融合框架，通过低维任务表征的正交对齐，将多个源模型能力注入宿主模型，在3个宿主模型、15个能力域上优于现有融合方法且更好保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: 实现跨基础模型的知识与能力复用和组合是构建可扩展AI系统的重要一步，但架构差异与表示不兼容导致难以通过统一跨模型接口迁移和整合能力。
AI.method: 先用共享锚样本提取源模型与宿主模型的任务相关表征，并以PCA构建同维低维功能子空间；再用正交Procrustes映射对齐源与宿主坐标系，在保持各源子空间内部几何结构的同时建立跨模型对应；最后训练轻量残差MLP，以任务输出和源模型增量联合监督，学习输入相关的残差增量并注入宿主模型完成多模型能力融合。
AI.result: 在3个宿主模型、15个能力域上，SuperAI的平均域得分高于所评估的跨架构融合方法，且随源模型数量增加更好地保留通用能力；消融实验支持正交对齐、非线性残差映射与联合监督的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SuperAI提供了一种统一的跨架构多模型能力融合方案，验证了正交对齐与残差映射在能力注入与通用能力保持上的作用。

title: Representation Drift in Continual Learning: LoRA versus N-gram Memory
summary: A language model that keeps learning online must not slowly erode its own base capabilities. We ask which part of a modern LLM should absorb continual updates, by measuring how each choice changes the model's internal representations. On a 48-layer mixture-of-experts model with a native pretrained N-gram memory, we train a seven-task chain under three update mechanisms with identical data and budgets: updating only the N-gram memory table, continually training one shared LoRA adapter, and training a fresh LoRA per task that is merged into the backbone. We capture fixed-context representations at every layer and task boundary. Updating only the N-gram memory changes the base model's representations of general math and code inputs by 26%/15% (relative RMS), against 64%/35% for merged and 97%/39% for shared LoRA. This drift does not grow with the number of tasks: it reaches 25% after the first task and stays there for all seven, while both LoRA variants keep accumulating. Its generic behaviour is essentially unchanged (no code problem lost, math NLL -0.01), and every change is confined to inspectable, reversible table rows. The cost appears elsewhere: N-gram memory acquires new tasks more weakly and its stored tasks interfere with one another, losing as much old-task NLL as shared LoRA. We show that this forgetting is governed by drift on the learned tasks' own inputs, measured from the checkpoint at which each was learned, not by generic drift (Spearman rho=0.85; rho=0.71 on Llama-3-8B), and we derive the exact relations behind it: with a frozen head, every pairwise logit margin changes by the projection of drift onto a head-difference direction. These results support a design principle for long-running online learning: write new knowledge only into the memory table and keep the backbone fixed; the remaining problem, interference between stored tasks, then lies inside the memory.

AI.tldr: 在48层MoE（含原生预训练N-gram记忆）上对比三种持续更新机制（仅更新N-gram记忆表、共享LoRA、逐任务LoRA合并回主干），通过逐层固定上下文表征的漂移度量发现：仅更新记忆表对基座模型表征的漂移最小（26%/15%相对RMS，对比64%/35%与97%/39%），且不随任务数累积；但其代价是任务获取能力弱、存储任务间相互干扰。遗忘由已学任务自身输入上的漂移支配（Spearman rho=0.85，Llama-3-8B上0.71），并给出冻结头下成对logit margin随漂移投影变化的精确关系。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在线持续学习时不应缓慢侵蚀自身基座能力。核心问题是：现代LLM中哪一部分应当承载持续更新？回答该问题需要从模型内部表征的角度量化不同更新选择带来的影响，而非仅看下游指标。
AI.method: 在一个48层混合专家（MoE）模型上（带原生预训练N-gram记忆），以相同数据与预算训练七任务链，比较三种机制：（1）仅更新N-gram记忆表；（2）持续训练一个共享LoRA适配器；（3）每任务训练新LoRA并合并进主干。在每个层与任务边界捕获固定上下文表征，用相对RMS度量基座表征漂移；并结合冻结头下的logit margin分析，推导漂移与成对logit margin变化的精确关系。
AI.result: 仅更新N-gram记忆使基座模型对通用数学/代码输入的表征漂移为26%/15%（相对RMS），而合并LoRA为64%/35%、共享LoRA为97%/39%；该漂移不随任务数增长（首个任务后达25%并保持7个任务不变），而两种LoRA持续累积。其通用行为基本不变（无代码题失效，数学NLL -0.01），且所有改动局限于可检查、可逆的表行。代价在于：N-gram记忆获取新任务较弱，存储任务间相互干扰，旧任务NLL损失与共享LoRA相当。遗忘由已学任务自身输入上的漂移支配（从其学习时的checkpoint度量），而非通用漂移（Spearman rho=0.85；Llama-3-8B上rho=0.71）。
AI.conclusion: 支持一条长期在线学习的设计原则：仅将新知识写入记忆表并保持主干冻结；此时剩余问题即存储任务间的干扰，位于记忆内部。漂移而非任务数量决定遗忘，且冻结头下logit margin变化可由漂移在头差方向上的投影精确刻画。

title: The interpreter as developer: An autoethnographic design study of building a computer-assisted interpreting tool through human-LLM co-creation
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. The CAI tool is openly available at https://github.com/omnigx/whisper_interpreter and archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22255011
summary: Real-time AI captioning now serves audiences at multilingual events, yet computer-assisted interpreting (CAI) tools are still built for interpreters, rarely by them. This article reports an autoethnographic design study in which a professional interpreter with no programming training built a local-first CAI system through expert-led 'vibe coding', co-creating with an LLM architect and a coding agent. Analysis of the complete development dialogues shows how tacit professional knowledge, from segmentation to booth infrastructure, was externalized into design after generic defaults failed in use. In a demanding public scientific event, three mechanisms of in-booth appropriation emerge under a firmly human-led division of labor; telemetry from a first fully instrumented assignment shows a fully local chain sustaining a median translation latency of 0.94 s across 971 utterances. The case is read as lead-user innovation newly enabled by generative AI, with implications for the technological literacy of interpreters and the future of interpreter training.

AI.tldr: 一名无编程背景的职业口译员通过"氛围编程"，与LLM架构师和编码代理协作，自建了一套本地优先的CAI系统，并在真实科学活动中以人类主导的分工完成三种现场化用机制；遥测显示在971条语句上实现0.94秒中位翻译延迟。
AI.motivation: 实时AI字幕已服务多语言活动受众，但计算机辅助口译（CAI）工具仍由技术人员为口译员设计，而非由口译员参与创造，导致工具与实际口译工作流和现场需求脱节。
AI.method: 采用自我民族志设计研究：一名无编程训练的职业口译员在专家引导的"氛围编程"下，与LLM架构师和编码代理共同构建本地优先CAI系统；分析完整开发对话，考察隐性专业知识（从切分到同传箱基础设施）在通用默认方案失效后如何被外化为设计。
AI.result: 在一场高要求的公开科学活动中，于严格人类主导的分工下浮现出三种同传箱内化用机制；首次全量仪表化任务的遥测显示，全本地链路在971条语句上维持0.94秒的中位翻译延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该案例可被解读为生成式AI新近赋能的领先用户创新，对口译员的技术素养及口译训练的未来具有启示意义。

title: Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models achieve promising results on visual reasoning tasks, approaching human-level performance on existing STEM benchmarks. However, these capabilities degrade under complex real-world scenes. We identify that chain-of-thought reasoning remains largely confined to the linguistic space, rarely anchoring each step in visual evidence. The main cause is the absence of such data during training. In this work, we introduce a training data augmentation pipeline, \textbf{Visual Augmentation Primitives} (VAP), which leverages state-of-the-art vision generative models to synthesize diverse photorealistic training samples and corresponding reasoning text. VAP introduces some basic operators and applies them to a seed image and gets a variant. It also constructs coherent multimodal reasoning chains throughout the generation process. Such training data force models to perceive visual content and perform logical reasoning according to them at every step. We further introduce multimodal chain-of-thought rubric-based reinforcement learning to enhance this. It rewards not only text reasoning but also visual reasoning by scoring intermediate reasoning steps for logical validity, completeness, and consistency. Moreover, we construct the UNREAL benchmark to systematically evaluate visual reasoning on hyperrealistic scenes across controllable difficulty levels. Experiments show that a 4B model built on this framework surpasses 8B baselines, with performance improving consistently as the model scales to 32B, validating the scaling law for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大模型在复杂真实场景中推理能力退化的问题，提出训练数据增强流水线VAP、多模态思维链评分强化学习及UNREAL基准，使4B模型超越8B基线并验证视觉推理的缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在STEM基准上接近人类水平，但在复杂真实场景中能力明显下降。作者指出根本原因在于思维链推理大多局限于语言空间，各推理步骤很少锚定视觉证据，而这一问题的根源是训练数据中缺乏此类视觉锚定的推理样本。
AI.method: 1) 提出Visual Augmentation Primitives（VAP）数据增强流水线，利用先进视觉生成模型合成多样化逼真训练样本及对应推理文本；通过基本算子作用于种子图像生成变体，并在生成过程中构建连贯的多模态推理链，迫使模型每步都感知视觉内容并据此推理。2) 引入基于评分（rubric）的多模态思维链强化学习，不仅奖励文本推理，还通过对中间推理步骤的逻辑有效性、完整性和一致性打分来奖励视觉推理。3) 构建UNREAL基准，在可控难度层级上系统评估高逼真场景下的视觉推理。
AI.result: 基于该框架构建的4B模型超越了8B基线模型；当模型规模扩展至32B时性能持续提升，验证了视觉推理的缩放规律。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉锚定的训练数据增强与多模态思维链评分强化学习，可有效提升模型在复杂真实场景中的视觉推理能力，且该能力随模型规模呈稳定缩放趋势，为视觉推理研究提供了数据、方法与评测基准三方面的支撑。

title: MultiFlow: Vision-Driven Multimodal fMRI Encoding via Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Current fMRI encoding models frame prediction as deterministic regression, yet identical stimuli evoke a distribution of neural responses (arising from physiological noise, hemodynamic variability, and cognitive fluctuations) that a single point estimate cannot capture. This work introduces MultiFlow, a generative fMRI encoding framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and a formulation termed Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching (SISFM). SISFM generalises CFM by conditioning the source distribution on the stimulus: a learnable temporal convolution shapes the source mean with an HRF-length receptive field, while a variance head shrinks its scale, shortening the expected transport path. SISFM is instantiated with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT-X) decoder parameterising the velocity field, with sub-layer Attention Residuals, heterogeneous fusion of ten frozen vision, audio, language, and audiovisual backbones, and per-subject Yeo-network heads. On the Algonauts 2025 dataset, a single MultiFlow checkpoint recovers most of the benefit of large deterministic ensembles: it trails the 1000-model TRIBE ensemble in-distribution by 0.003 PCC (0.3163 vs. 0.3195), and the strongest in- and out-of-distribution ensembles (VIBE-20, MedARC-50) by 0.010 and 0.009 PCC, using a single trained model rather than an ensemble of 20-1000. The same checkpoint also provides stimulus-conditioned uncertainty estimates and sample-based diversity.

AI.tldr: MultiFlow 将 fMRI 编码从确定性回归重构为条件生成任务，提出 SISFM 公式与 DiT-X 解码器，用单个模型逼近 20–1000 模型集成效果，并额外给出不确定性与样本多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有 fMRI 编码模型把预测建模为确定性回归，但相同刺激会引发神经响应的分布（来自生理噪声、血流动力学变异与认知波动），单点估计无法刻画这种分布；而弥合该差距的常见做法是训练大规模确定性集成，成本极高。
AI.method: 提出生成式 fMRI 编码框架 MultiFlow，基于条件流匹配（CFM）并定义 Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching（SISFM）：将源分布以刺激为条件，用可学习时间卷积以 HRF 长度感受野塑造源均值，并用方差头收缩源尺度以缩短期望传输路径。以 Diffusion Transformer（DiT-X）参数化速度场，含子层 Attention Residuals、十个冻结视觉/音频/语言/视听骨干的异构融合，以及按被试的 Yeo 网络头。
AI.result: 在 Algonauts 2025 数据集上，单个 MultiFlow 检查点即可恢复大规模确定性集成的大部分收益：分布内仅落后 1000 模型 TRIBE 集成 0.003 PCC（0.3163 vs. 0.3195），落后最强分布内/外集成（VIBE-20、MedARC-50）分别为 0.010 和 0.009 PCC，而仅使用单一训练模型而非 20–1000 个模型的集成。
AI.conclusion: MultiFlow 用生成式建模范式在单模型条件下逼近大规模集成性能，并额外提供刺激条件化的不确定性估计与基于采样的多样性，为 fMRI 编码提供统一且高效的替代方案。

title: TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents
summary: The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols. This popularity is despite its two significant limitations for software verification: Firstly, TLA+ offers no way to detect drift between software implementation and mathematical specification; secondly, TLC and TLAPS cannot provide satisfactory proofs of arbitrary temporal logic properties. We take a step towards addressing these shortcomings by translating TLA+ specifications into Verus, an auto-active verifier built for Rust, via both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic translator. We demonstrate that our LLM-based pipeline is able to generate proof obligations from TLA+ specifications at scale, and to produce fully machine checkable proofs of both safety and liveness properties. Since temporal logic reasoning in Verus is a largely new task for LLMs, our work yields a valuable evaluation dataset, which we use to map out current generation model capabilities in Verus theorem proving.

AI.tldr: 该文针对TLA+在实际软件验证中的两大局限（实现与规范漂移无法检测、TLC/TLAPS对任意时序逻辑性质证明能力不足），提出将TLA+规范翻译为面向Rust的自动活跃验证器Verus，采用确定性转译器与基于LLM的智能体翻译器两条路径，实现从TLA+规范大规模生成证明义务，并产出可机器检查的安全性（safety）与活性（liveness）证明。
AI.motivation: TLA+虽在数据库、存储系统、账本与协调协议等现代分布式系统的建模中被广泛采用，但存在两个明显短板：一是无法检测软件实现与数学规范之间的漂移（drift）；二是TLC与TLAPS难以对任意时序逻辑性质给出令人满意的证明。作者希望朝弥补这些不足迈出一步。
AI.method: 将TLA+规范翻译为Verus（面向Rust构建的自动活跃验证器），采用两种翻译途径：确定性转译器（deterministic transpiler）和基于LLM的智能体翻译器（agentic translator）；借助该LLM流水线从TLA+规范中大规模生成证明义务（proof obligations）。
AI.result: 作者展示了其基于LLM的流水线能够从TLA+规范中规模化生成证明义务，并能产出安全性与活性性质的、完全可机器检查的证明。由于在Verus中进行时序逻辑推理对LLM而言基本是全新任务，该工作还构建了一个有价值的评测数据集，并据此刻画了当前一代模型在Verus定理证明上的能力边界。
AI.conclusion: 将TLA+规范翻译到Verus是缓解TLA+实现—规范漂移与任意时序性质证明困难的一条可行路径；基于LLM的翻译流水线可规模化生成证明义务并给出可机器检查的安全性与活性证明，同时所构建的数据集为评估LLM在Verus定理证明方面的能力提供了有价值的基准。

title: PATMT2: Two-stage domain adaptation for multilingual patent translation
summary: We present PatMT2 (Patent Machine Translation, v2), a two-stage LoRA pipeline that adapts the Hy-MT2-7B dedicated translation model to four-language (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) patent translation. On six translation directions, the Stage-2 checkpoint reaches a macro-average BLEU of 43.39 (BF16) to 43.57 (AWQ INT4), improving over the Hy-MT2-7B base by up to +8.8 BLEU and also exceeding Qwen3-32B and several external systems on the same average. We then measure the cost of adaptation: probing 38 languages absent from the fine-tuning data, the model still produces correct, fluent output on 34, while four low-resource languages collapse into distinct, reproducible failure modes. We treat these as diagnostic cases rather than retention rates, and report their mechanisms without attributing them to a single cause. Paired bootstrap tests confirm the translation gains over all baselines (p < 0.001).

AI.tldr: PatMT2：两阶段LoRA将Hy-MT2-7B适配于中英日韩专利翻译，六方向宏平均BLEU达43.39（BF16）/43.57（AWQ INT4），较基线最高提升+8.8，并超过Qwen3-32B；同时探查38种未参与微调的语言，34种仍输出正确流畅译文，4种低资源语言出现可复现的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 针对专利领域多语言翻译需求，需在专用翻译模型上以低代价（LoRA）实现中英日韩四语方向的高质量适配，并量化微调对未见语言的"适配代价"，而非仅报告平均收益。
AI.method: 采用两阶段LoRA流水线，将Hy-MT2-7B专用翻译模型适配至中英日韩六个翻译方向；在BF16与AWQ INT4两种精度下评测宏平均BLEU，并用配对bootstrap检验对比Hy-MT2-7B基线、Qwen3-32B及若干外部系统；另对38种微调数据未覆盖的语言进行探针评测，对失效案例作机制层面的诊断分析。
AI.result: Stage-2检查点六方向宏平均BLEU为43.39（BF16）至43.57（AWQ INT4），较Hy-MT2-7B基线的宏平均提升最高达+8.8 BLEU，且高于Qwen3-32B及若干外部系统；38种未见语言中34种仍能产出正确、流畅译文，4种低资源语言出现清晰的、可复现的失效模式。配对bootstrap检验显示相对所有基线的翻译增益显著（p < 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段LoRA可在低参数量适配下显著提升专利多语言翻译质量并超越更大基线模型，量化（AWQ INT4）不损反而略优于BF16；但领域微调存在代价——少数低资源语言出现可复现失效，作者将其作为诊断案例并描述机制，而不归因于单一原因，提示适配收益与语言覆盖风险需权衡评估。

title: Ellipsoids from Tangents
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Written in 2016; posted in 2026 with revised exposition. Results unchanged
summary: This paper presents an algorithm for detecting and fitting multiple ellipsoids in 2D, 3D and higher-dimensional data. The representation is based on tangents to the ellipsoid together with their contact points, rather than on points alone. A tangent contributes d independent equations where a point contributes one, so each hypothesis needs fewer samples, which in turn reduces the number of iterations required to recover every ellipsoid. The problem is posed as sets of linear equations whose solutions -- the ellipsoid parameters -- are recovered robustly by clustering in parameter space. The algorithm works in all dimensions and outperforms the state of the art in 2D. The approach applies in general to the robust solution of linear equations, and so has utility beyond ellipsoid fitting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于切线与切点表示的多椭球检测与拟合算法，可在2D/3D及更高维数据中鲁棒恢复多个椭球参数，2D性能超越现有最好方法，并可推广至线性方程的鲁棒求解。
AI.motivation: 传统椭球拟合多基于点表示，每个点仅提供一个约束，导致假设所需样本多、迭代次数高，难以在噪声与多模型共存情形下高效鲁棒地恢复多个椭球。
AI.method: 用椭球切线与切点替代单纯的点表示；每条切线贡献d个独立方程，使每个假设所需样本更少，从而减少恢复全部椭球所需迭代次数。将问题建模为线性方程组集合，通过在参数空间中聚类来鲁棒求解椭球参数。
AI.result: 算法适用于任意维度，在2D数据上性能优于现有最好方法；因其本质是线性方程的鲁棒求解，方法在椭球拟合之外也具有通用价值。
AI.conclusion: 切线-切点表示可有效降低样本与迭代需求，参数空间聚类实现多椭球鲁棒拟合；该框架可推广为一般线性方程的鲁棒求解方法。

title: TRACE: Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing for Safer Language Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce harmful content while generating a response. A useful safeguard should not only detect this risk during generation but also intervene while leaving safe responses largely unchanged and provide an auditable record of the internal patterns supporting its decisions. We propose TRACE (Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing), a framework that tracks harmful-response risk during generation, selectively edits token activations, and leaves an auditable trace of its detection and steering decisions. TRACE learns a codebook of recurring activation patterns, with each codebook vector representing a latent concept. At inference time, it assigns each token activation to the nearest codebook vector to obtain the corresponding concept. A gated recurrent unit (GRU) processes the activations and their assigned concept features to predict completed-response harmfulness and a monotone cumulative streaming risk. During steering, activations assigned to harmful concepts are steered along directions defined by nearby benign targets. An external LLM labels the learned concepts post hoc, making detection sequences and harmful-to-benign edit records interpretable. Experiments across three generators and the WildGuard and S-Eval benchmarks show that TRACE improves streaming F1 over Kelp in five of six comparisons while remaining competitive on completed-response detection. TRACE's selective steering reduces Harmbench attack success with little change in refusal on originally safe responses. The post-hoc audit reveals recurring semantic structure in the learned concepts and distinct traces associated with harmful detection, safe generation, and activation edits.

AI.tldr: TRACE：生成过程中追踪有害风险、选择性编辑激活、并留下可审计痕迹的框架。
AI.motivation: LLM生成回复时可能产生有害内容；理想的安全防护需在生成中干预、尽量不改变安全回复、并提供可审计的内部决策记录。现有方法难以同时满足这三点。
AI.method: 学习激活模式的码本，每个码本向量表示一个潜在概念；推理时将token激活分配给最近码本向量得到概念；用GRU处理激活及概念特征，预测完整回复有害性与单调累积流式风险；对有害概念相关激活，沿邻近良性目标方向进行引导；外部LLM事后标注概念，使检测序列与有害到良性的编辑记录可解释。
AI.result: 在三种生成器及WildGuard、S-Eval基准上，六项比较中五项流式F1优于Kelp，完整回复检测具竞争力；选择性引导降低Harmbench攻击成功率，且对原本安全回复的拒答率影响很小；事后审计揭示学习概念中反复出现的语义结构，以及有害检测、安全生成、激活编辑的不同痕迹。
AI.conclusion: TRACE实现了流式风险追踪、选择性激活编辑与可审计记录的统一，在提升流式检测性能的同时保持安全回复基本不变，并提供概念级可解释性。

title: BSIPipe: Bidirectional Sequence-Level Interleaved Pipeline Parallelism for Long-Sequence Large Language Model Training
summary: Pipeline parallelism has become a critical technique for training large language models. To address the throughput limitation of existing sequence-level methods that schedule subsequences unidirectionally, we propose bidirectional sequence-level interleaved pipeline parallelism (BSIPipe), which co-schedules two opposing V-shaped interleaved pipelines at the subsequence level. To bound the activation accumulation from subsequence scaling, BSIPipe introduces a basic-unit concatenation mechanism that keeps activation memory invariant to the subsequence count. To eliminate communication deadlock risk from bidirectional scheduling, BSIPipe employs a communication optimization strategy that combines topology-aware device mapping with communication-computation overlap. In addition, BSIPipe composes with tensor parallelism to overcome the memory limitation of single-dimensional parallelism, neutralizing its bidirectional memory overhead while maintaining throughput. Experiments on GPT and LLaMA3 demonstrate that BSIPipe achieves average speedups of 1.11$\times$ to 1.13$\times$ in long-sequence training over SOTA sequence-level baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向序列级交错流水线并行方法 BSIPipe，通过协同调度两条反向 V 型交错流水线，缓解序列级方法的吞吐瓶颈，同时控制激活内存并消除通信死锁。GPT 与 LLaMA3 实验表明，长序列训练相比 SOTA 序列级基线平均加速 1.11×–1.13×。
AI.motivation: 现有序列级流水线方法以单向方式调度子序列，导致吞吐受限。作者希望突破这一瓶颈，同时解决由此引入的激活内存随子序列数量增长、以及双向调度带来的通信死锁风险。
AI.method: BSIPipe 在子序列级别协同调度两条方向相反的 V 型交错流水线；引入基本单元拼接机制，使激活内存不随子序列数量变化；采用拓扑感知设备映射与通信—计算重叠相结合的通信优化策略，以消除双向调度的通信死锁风险；并与张量并行组合，突破单维并行的内存限制，在保持吞吐的同时中和双向内存开销。
AI.result: 在 GPT 和 LLaMA3 上的实验表明，长序列训练相比 SOTA 序列级基线平均加速 1.11× 至 1.13×。
AI.conclusion: BSIPipe 通过双向子序列级交错调度及配套的内存与通信优化，在保证激活内存可控、避免通信死锁的前提下提升长序列训练吞吐，并可扩展至与张量并行的组合使用。

title: Ontology-Based Post-Coordinated Expression Assembly: from Clinical Narrative to Queryable Knowledge Graphs
summary: Clinical oncology documentation records decisive information in free text, where it remains readable but not retrievable at scale, leaving cohort identification dependent on incomplete diagnostic codes or manual review. The current standard, coding individual terms, captures what a document mentions, not what it asserts: meaning lies in how those terms relate to one another. We present a method for deriving queryable knowledge graphs from clinical narratives, conforming to the Extended Grammar of SNOMED CT across multiple ontologies. The method specifies how entities should be annotated and related. It defines five relation classes, each bound to a construction rule that assembles the entities and relations into post-coordinated expressions. A deterministic implementation, UNIGRAPHE, applies those rules to construct knowledge graphs from annotated text. Applied to expert-annotated real-world oncology documentation, UNIGRAPHE reconstructed 5,299 annotations into 2,196 post-coordinated expressions and shows that relation structure is the missing piece to make clinical narrative formally queryable.

AI.tldr: 提出从临床肿瘤叙述文本中构建可查询知识图谱的方法，规范五类关系及其构造规则，并以确定性实现UNIGRAPHE将专家标注重构为SNOMED CT后组配表达式。
AI.motivation: 临床肿瘤学文档以自由文本记录关键信息，可读但难以规模化检索；依赖不完整的诊断编码或人工复核来识别队列。现有以单词术语编码的做法只能捕捉文档"提到了什么"，而非"断定了什么"，语义实存于术语之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出从临床叙述导出可查询知识图谱的方法，遵循SNOMED CT扩展语法并跨多个本体；规范实体的标注与关联方式，定义五类关系，每类绑定一条构造规则，将实体与关系组装为后组配表达式；实现确定性系统UNIGRAPHE，对标注文本应用这些规则构建知识图谱。
AI.result: 在专家标注的真实世界肿瘤学文档上，UNIGRAPHE将5,299条标注重构为2,196个后组配表达式，显示关系结构是使临床叙述可被形式化查询的关键缺失环节。
AI.conclusion: 关系结构是使临床叙述具备形式化可查询性的核心，所提方法可将肿瘤学自由文本转化为可规模化检索的知识图谱。

title: FireNav: Decision-Oriented Reconstruction Evidence Routing for Vision-Language Navigation in Indoor Fire Environments
summary: In real-world indoor fire environments, visual degradation severely impairs instruction grounding, waypoint prediction, and long-horizon exploration in vision-language navigation (VLN). Although image restoration offers a natural means to mitigate such visual degradation, existing methods primarily optimize reconstruction fidelity, which does not necessarily translate into better navigation decisions and may even corrupt task-critical cues when applied indiscriminately. In this paper, we present FireNav, a decision-oriented reconstruction evidence routing framework that aligns visual restoration with navigation utility in VLN. To advance this task, we first contribute FireVLN-Bench, a paired indoor fire navigation benchmark with clean references preserving task semantics, safety supervision, and matched settings for continuous navigation and robot execution with simulated dynamics. Our FireNav retains native visual tokens and treats latent reconstruction features as auxiliary evidence, where a lightweight router leverages visual features, task context, and prior execution states to determine whether such evidence should be admitted and how strongly it should contribute to the visual tokens. To learn when reconstruction is beneficial, we further introduce decision utility calibration, which compares action prediction losses with and without candidate evidence under the same state, thereby supervising evidence selection according to its contribution to waypoint, heading, and arrival prediction. Experiments demonstrate that FireNav consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both navigation success and path efficiency across evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 FireNav：以决策为导向的重建证据路由框架，将视觉恢复与导航效用对齐；并构建 FireVLN-Bench 室内火灾 VLN 基准。
AI.motivation: 真实室内火灾环境中视觉退化严重损害视觉语言导航（VLN）的指令接地、航点预测与长程探索。图像恢复虽可缓解退化，但现有方法主要优化重建保真度，未必提升导航决策，甚至可能无差别地破坏任务关键线索。
AI.method: 贡献 FireVLN-Bench：配对型室内火灾导航基准，含保留任务语义的干净参考、安全监督，以及连续导航与仿真动力学机器人执行的匹配设置。FireNav 保留原生视觉 token，将潜在重建特征作为辅助证据；由轻量路由器结合视觉特征、任务上下文与先验执行状态，决定证据是否被采纳及其对视觉 token 的贡献强度。引入决策效用校准：在同一状态下比较有无候选证据时的动作预测损失，据此监督证据选择对航点、航向与到达预测的贡献。
AI.result: 实验表明，FireNav 在各评估设置下的导航成功率与路径效率均持续优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 视觉恢复应以导航决策效用而非重建保真度为优化目标；通过证据路由与决策效用校准，可有效提升火灾场景 VLN 性能。

title: Fewer Bits, More Tries: Recovering Capability Under Memory Constraints
summary: Large language models are generally more capable than smaller ones, but their memory requirements can make local deployment difficult. We ask whether part of this capability gap can instead be recovered by running a smaller or more compressed model multiple times and selecting among its outputs using public or model-generated tests. Single-user local inference can leave hardware underutilized, allowing parallel candidate generation to trade additional test-time computation for accuracy at modest latency cost. Across four code-generation benchmarks, verified retry recovers substantial accuracy lost to model size or compression. A 7B Qwen model with eight parallel attempts essentially matches a 32B model on MBPP+ and exceeds it on the other three benchmarks, while using about $4\times$ less model memory, running up to $6\times$ faster, and using less energy, as measured on Nvidia GPU. We observe similar tradeoff across model sizes, compression levels and hardware choices, although exact benefit depends on the hardware profile and problem setting. These results show that model capacity can be traded for verified test-time computation when correct solutions remain reachable within a modest retry budget.

AI.tldr: 通过"验证式重试"（并行生成多个候选再用测试筛选），小模型可在代码生成任务上追平甚至超越大模型，同时显著降低内存、延迟与能耗。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能力更强但内存需求大，本地部署困难；单用户本地推理时硬件利用率低，存在用测试时计算换取精度的空间。
AI.method: 让更小或压缩后的模型并行生成多个候选输出（如8次并行尝试），利用公开测试或模型自生成的测试进行验证与选择，以额外的测试时计算替代模型容量。
AI.result: 在四个代码生成基准上，验证式重试显著弥补了模型规模或压缩带来的精度损失。7B Qwen 八次并行尝试在 MBPP+ 上基本追平 32B 模型，并在其余三个基准上超越；内存约为其 1/4，速度最高快 6 倍，能耗更低（Nvidia GPU 实测）。在多种模型规模、压缩程度和硬件配置下呈现类似权衡，具体收益取决于硬件条件与问题设定。
AI.conclusion: 当正确解在适度的重试预算内可达时，模型容量可用于换取验证式测试时计算，为本地高效部署提供可行路径。

title: Compositional Average Velocity Modeling for Efficient Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for offline reinforcement learning, but their reliance on multi-step denoising introduces substantial computational overhead and requires backpropagation through time during training, limiting scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we propose \textbf{Instant Flow Q-Learning (InsQL)}, a single-step generative policy learning framework that retains the expressive capacity of diffusion models while eliminating iterative sampling and BPTT. InsQL builds on the flow-matching perspective of diffusion policies, but replaces marginal velocity parameterization with \emph{average-velocity} modeling and introduces a principled compositional mechanism, yielding a theoretically grounded objective that learns average velocity consistently across scales. This formulation provides a direct noise-to-action mapping and enables single-step action generation. InsQL further unifies compositional average-velocity modeling with behavior-regularized actor--critic optimization in a single framework, requiring only a single policy network and avoiding distillation, multi-stage procedures, and Jacobian computations during training. At inference time, actions are generated in a single forward pass and can be refined via value-guided candidate selection to improve performance. Extensive experiments on standard offline RL benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that InsQL matches or surpasses state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods while substantially reducing both training and inference time. Overall, these results establish compositional average-velocity modeling as an efficient and scalable alternative to multi-step generative policies for offline RL.

AI.tldr: 提出 InsQL，一种单步生成式策略学习框架，通过平均速度建模替代扩散策略的迭代去噪与BPTT，在离线强化学习中兼顾表达力与效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略虽表达力强，但多步去噪带来巨大计算开销，训练时需沿时间反向传播（BPTT），限制可扩展性与实际部署。
AI.method: 基于 flow matching 视角，用平均速度建模取代边际速度参数化，引入有原则的组合机制，构建跨尺度一致学习平均速度的目标，实现直接噪声到动作映射与单步生成；将组合式平均速度建模与行为正则化的 actor-critic 优化统一到单一框架，仅需单个策略网络，避免蒸馏、多阶段流程及训练中的雅可比计算；推理时单次前向生成动作，并可用价值引导的候选选择进行精炼。
AI.result: 在标准离线 RL 基准及真实机器人操作任务上，InsQL 匹配或超越当前最先进的扩散类方法，同时显著降低训练与推理时间。
AI.conclusion: 组合式平均速度建模可作为离线 RL 中多步生成式策略的高效、可扩展替代方案。

title: Communication, Vocalisation, and Language
comment: A written version of my argument with with Roger, with input from Bruce. 6 pages and one (Venn) diagram
summary: The contention is that the current batch of Large Language Models don't *understand* language, but they *do* it. Rather than LLMs forming some kind of ``distributed representation'' of symbols, the claim is that LLMs are capturing ``Cultural Intelligence'' and grounding symbols in what the sociologists call practices.

AI.tldr: 本文主张当前的大语言模型并不"理解"语言，而是"践行"语言。与"分布式符号表征"假说不同，作者认为LLM捕捉的是"文化智能"，并将符号扎根于社会学意义上的"实践"之中。
AI.motivation: 针对大语言模型是否真正"理解"语言的争论，本文试图提出一种不同于符号分布式表征的解释框架，以重新定位LLM的能力本质。
AI.method: 理论论证（概念分析）：引入社会学"实践"（practices）概念与"文化智能"（Cultural Intelligence）概念，对LLM的符号处理机制进行替代性阐释，区别于分布式表征假说。
AI.result: 论证得出：LLM并未形成对符号的分布式表征，其能力可被解释为对文化实践模式的习得与再现，即符号在实践语境中获得扎根。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型不"理解"语言而"践行"语言；其符号处理应被理解为对文化智能的捕捉与对实践的扎根，而非内在语义表征。

title: Squeeze-Aware-YOLO: Early Channel Recalibration and Multi-Scale Fusion for Real-Time Traffic Sign Detection
comment: Accepted at DICTA 2026 (International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications, Sydney, Australia). 8 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
summary: Traffic sign detection plays a vital role in intelligent transportation systems, supporting the safe operation of advanced driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles. Despite significant progress in real-time object detection, accurately identifying traffic signs under challenging conditions remains difficult. Variations in lighting, adverse weather, motion blur, and partial occlusion often reduce detection performance, especially for small or visually degraded signs where important spatial information can be lost. To address these challenges, we propose Squeeze-Aware-YOLO, a lightweight traffic sign detection framework that introduces a multi-branch bottleneck module combining convolutional kernels of different sizes with a Squeeze-and-Excitation mechanism to improve feature extraction and adaptive channel weighting. In addition, we integrate the Multi-Branch Auxiliary Feature Pyramid Network and Re-parameterized Heterogeneous Multi-Scale modules to strengthen multi-scale feature representation and feature fusion while preserving real-time inference efficiency for practical deployment. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Bangladeshi Traffic Sign Detection Dataset, the CSUST Chinese Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark 2021, and the German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark, achieving mAP@0.5 scores of 74.7%, 79.4%, and 84.0%, respectively, while consistently outperforming recent state-of-the-art YOLO-based traffic sign detectors. These findings demonstrate that combining multi-scale receptive fields, channel attention, and enhanced feature fusion enables more accurate and robust traffic sign detection while maintaining the computational efficiency required for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级交通标志检测框架Squeeze-Aware-YOLO，通过多分支瓶颈模块、SE注意力、多分支辅助特征金字塔与重参数化异构多尺度模块，在三个数据集上取得优于现有YOLO方法的mAP@0.5。
AI.motivation: 交通标志检测对智能交通系统、高级驾驶辅助和自动驾驶安全至关重要。但光照变化、恶劣天气、运动模糊和部分遮挡等挑战性条件会降低检测性能，尤其是小尺度或视觉退化标志易丢失关键空间信息，现有实时检测方法仍难以准确识别。
AI.method: 提出Squeeze-Aware-YOLO轻量级框架：1）多分支瓶颈模块，结合不同尺寸卷积核与Squeeze-and-Excitation机制，提升特征提取并实现自适应通道加权；2）集成多分支辅助特征金字塔网络（Multi-Branch Auxiliary Feature Pyramid Network）；3）重参数化异构多尺度模块（Re-parameterized Heterogeneous Multi-Scale），增强多尺度特征表达与融合，同时保持实时推理效率。
AI.result: 在孟加拉国交通标志检测数据集、CSUST中国交通标志检测基准2021和德国交通标志检测基准上评估，mAP@0.5分别达74.7%、79.4%和84.0%，持续优于近期最先进的基于YOLO的交通标志检测器。
AI.conclusion: 结合多尺度感受野、通道注意力与增强特征融合，可实现更准确、鲁棒的交通标志检测，同时保持实际部署所需的计算效率。

title: Analyzing the Dynamics of WSBM-based Echo State Networks using InputDSA
comment: 9 pages excluding refs and appendices, 9 figures
summary: Bridging the structural gap between biological brains and artificial neural networks presents a pathway to altered computational dynamics. This paper introduces a Reservoir Computing framework that replaces random networks with biologically realistic modularity by applying the Weighted Stochastic Block Model (WSBM) to Echo State Networks (ESNs). This topological parameterization constructs reservoirs reflecting latent functional sub-circuits. Furthermore, the integration of Input Dynamical Similarity Analysis (InputDSA) provides a mechanism to isolate and compare how structural priors modulate intrinsic recurrent dynamics versus external inputs. By evaluating these architectures, we establish that structural diversity does not necessarily predicts behavioral diversity across the selected network subset. Furthermore, our demixed analysis confirms Anna Karenina principle of dynamics, demonstrating that environmental constraints enforce dynamical convergence in successful agents, while failing networks degenerate into idiosyncratic trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于加权随机块模型（WSBM）的模块化储备池计算框架，并结合输入动力学相似性分析（InputDSA），研究结构先验对回声状态网络（ESN）内在递归动力学与外部输入的影响。
AI.motivation: 生物大脑与人工神经网络之间存在结构鸿沟，随机网络难以体现生物脑的模块化特征；同时需要一种机制区分结构先验如何分别调制内在递归动力学与外部输入驱动的动力学。
AI.method: 将加权随机块模型（WSBM）应用于回声状态网络（ESN），以拓扑参数化的方式构建反映潜在功能子回路的模块化储备池；并引入输入动力学相似性分析（InputDSA），用于隔离并比较结构先验对内在递归动力学与外部输入的影响，进而对相应架构进行评估。
AI.result: 在所选取的网络子集上，结构多样性并不必然预测行为多样性；解混分析结果验证了动力学中的"安娜·卡列尼娜原则"，即环境约束促使成功智能体实现动力学收敛，而失败网络则退化为特异化的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 结构多样性与行为多样性之间并非简单对应关系；环境约束是驱动成功智能体动力学收敛的关键因素，而失败系统表现出高度的个体化动力学，体现了安娜·卡列尼娜原则在动力学层面的适用性。

title: Probabilistic Multi-Source Data Selection via Learnable Categorical Priors: Variance Reduction and Guaranteed Derandomization
summary: Bilevel data selection is a fundamental task with numerous applications in machine learning and statistics. A common strategy for tackling this problem is to relax the original bilevel combinatorial optimization into a continuous one. However, existing methods, including 0-1 relaxation and probabilistic relaxation, still suffer from several limitations, such as unstable gradient estimation and infeasible rounding. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new probabilistic relaxation for the multi-source bilevel data selection problem. Our key idea is to introduce multiple learnable categorical priors to parameterize a probability distribution supported only on feasible data subsets, thus naturally yielding a lossless rounding scheme. We further show that our proposed relaxation admits an effective two-point gradient estimator, which can simultaneously avoid the inverse-Hessian computation required by existing 0-1 relaxation and the unbounded score term appearing in prior probabilistic relaxation. Furthermore, we develop a reducible representation of this estimator, which substantially reduces the number of lower-level retrainings required for gradient computation. Built upon this reducible two-point estimator, we then design a novel stochastic gradient algorithm, termed ReSGD, for multi-source bilevel data selection problem, and establish a rigorous approximation guarantee for the subset returned by ReSGD under weak submodularity. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of our proposed ReSGD.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多源双层数据选择问题，提出一种新的概率松弛方法：引入多个可学习类别先验，将分布支撑限制在可行数据子集上，从而天然获得无损舍入；并给出可约化的两点梯度估计器，设计ReSGD算法，在弱子模性下建立近似保证，实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 双层数据选择是机器学习与统计中的基础任务。常见做法是将原双层组合优化松弛为连续优化，但现有方法（0-1松弛与概率松弛）仍存在梯度估计不稳定、舍入不可行等局限，因此需要新的松弛与求解方案。
AI.method: 提出面向多源双层数据选择的新型概率松弛：引入多个可学习类别先验，参数化仅支撑于可行数据子集的概率分布，从而实现无损舍入。证明该松弛具备有效的两点梯度估计器，既避免0-1松弛所需的逆Hessian计算，又避免既有概率松弛中无界得分项。进一步给出该估计器的可约化表示，显著减少梯度计算所需的下层重训练次数。基于可约化两点估计器设计随机梯度算法ReSGD。
AI.result: 在弱子模性条件下，为ReSGD返回的子集建立了严格的近似保证；大量实验验证了ReSGD的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提概率松弛与可约化两点梯度估计器克服了现有方法的不稳定梯度估计与不可行舍入问题，ReSGD在多源双层数据选择上兼具理论保证与实验效果。

title: Intent-Triggered Anchoring for Multi-Token Format Units in Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models
summary: In parallel decoding, diffusion language models commit several tokens per forward pass, so co-committed tokens cannot see each other, breaking multi-token format units that parsers need. On ECHO, an open-weight one-step chest X-ray (CXR) report generator, 32.7-36.7% of evaluation reports lack a parseable Impression heading and score as empty. We propose intent-triggered anchoring, a training-free decoding rule that completes a format unit once the model commits its first token, inserting only units with a unique, content-free completion; fallbacks write the unit when the model stops or loops without starting it. On three CXR evaluation sets, the rule raises readable rates from 63.3-67.3% to 100.0% with no regressions and a 95th-percentile latency ratio of 0.68-1.28 against official decoding. Broken headings state findings absent from the reference; adding the heading at the end leaves them in 15.5-31.0% of reports, our rule in at most 0.6%. For math answer markers, the rule raises accuracy in the most parallel setting of five diffusion language models by 5.8-20.8 points on GSM8K and 5.1-17.1 on GSM-Symbolic, held out from tuning. With lenient answer extraction, gains are 3.3-12.5 and 2.7-6.3 points; the rule adds 1.4-8.6 points over a stop-only fallback for four of the five models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的"意图触发锚定"解码规则:模型一旦提交某格式单元的首个token,就立即补全该单元(仅插入唯一且无内容歧义的补全),并在模型迟迟不启动该单元时以回退机制写入。该方法修复了并行解码中共同提交的token彼此不可见、破坏多token格式单元的问题,在胸片报告生成与数学答题标记两类任务上显著提升可解析率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 并行(扩散)语言模型每次前向可提交多个token,但这些共同提交的token之间无法互相条件化,导致解析器所需的多token格式单元被破坏。其典型后果是输出缺少可被解析的格式标题(如CXR报告的"Impression"标题),使含有效内容的报告被计为空。作者希望在不重新训练模型的前提下,保证下游解析所需的格式结构完整性。
AI.method: 提出意图触发锚定(intent-triggered anchoring):一种免训练的解码期规则。核心机制是"一旦模型提交某格式单元的首个token,即刻补全整个单元",且仅插入具有唯一、无内容歧义的补全;当模型停止或陷入循环却尚未启动该单元时,由回退机制写入该单元。规则作用于格式单元层面而非单token,可用于标题结构与答案标记等场景。
AI.result: 在ECHO(开放权重的一步式胸片报告生成器)上,原本32.7%–36.7%的评测报告缺少可解析的Impression标题而被判为空;应用该规则后,三个CXR评测集的可读率由63.3%–67.3%提升至100.0%,无性能退化,相对官方解码的第95百分位延迟比为0.68–1.28。破损标题会声称参考报告中不存在的发现,末尾补标题的方式仍有15.5%–31.0%的报告存在该问题,而本规则至多0.6%。在数学答案标记上,五个扩散语言模型在最并行设置下,GSM8K准确率提升5.8–20.8个百分点,GSM-Symbolic提升5.1–17.1个百分点(该集合未参与调参);采用宽松答案抽取时增益为3.3–12.5和2.7–6.3个百分点;相比仅含回退停止机制的方法,五个模型中有四个额外提升1.4–8.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明,并行解码中格式单元的破坏可通过解码期、免训练的意图触发锚定规则有效修复:在胸片报告生成上实现100%可读率且几乎零延迟代价,在数学推理答案标记上跨多个扩散模型取得一致的准确率提升。方法仅插入唯一且内容无关的补全,避免了引入不实内容,为并行解码的结构化输出可靠性提供了通用且低成本的解决方案。

title: Lesion-Aware Attention for Mammography Segmentation with Heterogeneous Supervision
summary: Accurate lesion segmentation in mammography is important for computer-aided breast cancer diagnosis, but dense pixel-level annotations remain costly and limited. Existing public segmentation datasets usually cover only a small set of lesion types with manually delineated masks, whereas larger mammography datasets often provide only image-level diagnostic labels. This annotation mismatch makes it difficult to train segmentation models that can generalize to rare or weakly annotated lesion categories. To address this problem, we study open-vocabulary mammographic lesion segmentation under a mixed-supervision setting, where pixel-level masks are available for base lesion categories and image-level labels are available for a broader set of categories. We propose a two-branch framework that jointly learns from segmentation data and classification data. The segmentation branch learns lesion boundaries from annotated masks, while the classification branch introduces additional image-level semantic supervision. To better transfer image-level supervision to lesion-relevant regions, we further introduce a Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier that maintains category-specific feature prototypes and generates lesion-aware attention maps for foreground feature pooling. This design reduces the influence of background tissue and encourages more compact lesion representations. Experiments on multiple mammography datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation baselines on both base and novel lesion categories, while reducing the gap to fully supervised models that require dense target-domain masks. Qualitative results further indicate that our method produces more complete lesion localization for small, low-contrast, and visually subtle mammographic findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合监督下的开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割，提出双分支框架与病灶级注意力分类器，用图像级标签补充像素级掩码，提升基类与新类病灶的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 乳腺X线病灶分割对计算机辅助乳腺癌诊断重要，但像素级标注成本高、数量有限。现有公开分割数据集仅覆盖少量病灶类型且带人工掩码，而大型乳腺X线数据集通常只有图像级诊断标签，这种标注不匹配使模型难以泛化到罕见或弱标注病灶类别。
AI.method: 在混合监督设定下研究开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割：基类病灶有像素级掩码，更广类别仅有图像级标签。提出双分支框架联合学习分割数据与分类数据：分割分支从标注掩码学习病灶边界，分类分支引入额外图像级语义监督；并设计病灶级注意力分类器（Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier），维护类别特定特征原型并生成病灶感知注意力图以进行前景特征池化，从而抑制背景组织干扰、获得更紧凑的病灶表征。
AI.result: 在多个乳腺X线数据集上，所提方法在基类和新类病灶上均持续优于开放词汇分割基线，并缩小了与需要密集目标域掩码的全监督模型的差距。定性结果显示，对小尺寸、低对比度和视觉上不明显的乳腺X线病灶可产生更完整的病灶定位。
AI.conclusion: 通过双分支混合监督学习与病灶级注意力分类器，可有效利用图像级标签弥补像素级标注不足，提升开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割的泛化能力与定位完整性。

title: A Decade of PhotoMappers: A Longitudinal Study of Crowdsourced Disaster Photos Geolocalization with Vision-Language Models and Geospatial Reasoning
summary: Crowdsourced disaster imagery provides timely, ground-level observations when conventional disaster mapping is delayed or incomplete, yet its geographic value depends on where observations are produced, how they are interpreted, and whether they can be reliably located as actionable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT). Using more than a decade of PhotoMappers, a crowdsourced disaster-mapping initiative, this study examines the changing geography of disaster information and asks how emerging GeoAI models compare with human geographic interpretation. We combine longitudinal spatial analysis with cross-view geolocalization using street view imagery (SVI) and remote sensing imagery (RSI), and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) reasoning through 30 indicators spanning geographic cues and reasoning evidence. The results reveal a geographically and temporally uneven archive shaped by changing disaster types, Community Lifelines, and operational priorities. Integrating VGI, SVI, and RSI with Sinkhorn re-ranking achieves 40.90% R@1, 61.10% R@5, and 69.45% R@10, while yearly R@1 varies markedly from 25.00% to 65.07%. Geographic reasoning is similarly uneven: Qwen3.6-27B achieves an overall agreement of 67% compared with 51% for InternVL3-8B, with both models showing greater difficulty with localized and place-specific evidence than broad spatial configurations. We argue that the value of GeoAI lies less in replacing volunteered geographic interpretation than in complementing it, scaling candidate retrieval while retaining human judgment for ambiguous and consequential cases. This provides a pathway toward more human-centered and responsible GeoAI for disaster mapping. All data and code are openly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/PhotoMappers-VLM.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于PhotoMappers十余年众包灾害影像，结合纵向空间分析与跨视角地理定位（VGI+SVI+RSI），并评估视觉语言模型的地理推理能力，主张GeoAI应补充而非替代人类地理判读。
AI.motivation: 众包灾害影像可提供及时的地面观测，但在传统灾害制图延迟或不完整时，其地理价值取决于观测产生的地点、解读方式以及能否可靠定位为可操作的地理空间情报（GEOINT）。因此需要考察灾害信息地理格局的演变，并厘清新兴GeoAI模型与人类地理判读的关系。
AI.method: 使用PhotoMappers十余年的众包灾害制图数据开展纵向空间分析；结合街景影像（SVI）与遥感影像（RSI）进行跨视角地理定位，并采用Sinkhorn重排序；通过涵盖地理线索与推理证据的30项指标评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的推理表现。
AI.result: 档案在地理与时间上分布不均，受灾害类型、社区生命线（Community Lifelines）与运营优先级变化影响。融合VGI、SVI与RSI并采用Sinkhorn重排序达到40.90% R@1、61.10% R@5、69.45% R@10，年度R@1在25.00%至65.07%间波动。地理推理同样不均衡：Qwen3.6-27B总体一致率67%，InternVL3-8B为51%；两模型对本地化、地点特定证据的处理均难于宏观空间格局。
AI.conclusion: GeoAI的价值不在于替代志愿地理判读，而在于补充它：扩展候选检索规模，同时在模糊且影响重大的案例中保留人类判断，从而迈向更以人为中心、负责任的灾害制图GeoAI。数据与代码已在GitHub公开。

title: Exact Phase-Type Point Processes for Certified Measurement and Prediction of Event Streams
summary: Temporal point processes are used both to measure market mechanisms, for example how fast prices absorb news and how much of the reaction is the market responding to itself, and to predict the next event. We show that one algebraic object, the phase-type (Erlang-chain) state space, serves both purposes with exact likelihoods. For measurement, we build a multiscale phase-type Hawkes process whose parameters all enter linearly. Its log-likelihood is concave, and we compute the global maximum together with a Fenchel duality-gap certificate. A Markov embedding gives the response to an exogenous shock, echoes included, in closed form, and this response is stable if and only if the spectral radius of the branching matrix is below one. Applied to six markets around 670 scheduled macroeconomic releases (2022-2026) with a built-in placebo test, the model shows that the direct reaction to CPI, payrolls, PPI and the FOMC statement is absorbed in about a second, while the market's own echoes stretch half of the response to 16-137 s. For prediction, we introduce EPT-X, a neural point process that adds a history-dependent mixture-of-Erlang renewal channel to a linear Hawkes backbone. Its intensity and compensator remain in closed form, its states follow an affine recursion that trains with a parallel scan, and it can start from the certified fit of the measurement model. EPT-X has the best test likelihood on all five LOBSTER order-book streams and on Retweet and Taobao, and is level with the best published model on StackOverflow. We also find that the EasyTPP implementation of IntensityFree clamps short inter-event times before scoring, and that the gaps of the EasyTPP Amazon data are uniform on two fixed intervals.

AI.tldr: 本文用一个统一代数结构——phase-type（Erlang链）状态空间——同时解决时序点过程的测量与预测问题：测量端构建多尺度phase-type Hawkes过程，具有线性参数、凹对数似然与全局最优的Fenchel对偶间隙证书；预测端提出EPT-X神经点过程，将历史依赖的Erlang混合更新通道加入线性Hawkes主干，在多个数据集上取得最优或并列最优的测试似然。
AI.motivation: 时序点过程既用于度量市场机制（如价格吸收新闻的速度、市场自身反应占比），也用于预测下一事件。作者希望找到一种统一的代数工具，同时满足这两个目标，并能提供精确似然，避免以往模型在可解释性与预测性能之间的取舍。
AI.method: 测量方面，构建多尺度phase-type Hawkes过程，所有参数线性进入，对数似然为凹函数，可在求出全局最大值的同时给出Fenchel对偶间隙证书；通过马尔可夫嵌入得到含回声的外生冲击响应闭式解，并证明响应稳定性等价于分支矩阵谱半径小于1。预测方面，提出EPT-X：在线性Hawkes主干上增加历史依赖的Erlang混合更新通道，强度与补偿器保持闭式，状态遵循仿射递推，可用并行扫描训练，并能以测量模型的认证拟合作为起点。
AI.result: 在2022-2026年约670次预定宏观数据发布、覆盖六个市场的实证中（含内置安慰剂检验），对CPI、非农就业、PPI和FOMC声明的直接反应约在1秒内被吸收，而市场自身回声将一半的反应拉长至16-137秒。预测方面，EPT-X在全部五个LOBSTER订单簿流及Retweet、Taobao上取得最佳测试似然，在StackOverflow上与已发表最佳模型持平。此外发现EasyTPP中IntensityFree实现在打分前对短事件间隔进行截断，且EasyTPP的Amazon数据缺口在两个固定区间上均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: phase-type状态空间可作为统一工具，同时为时序点过程的市场机制测量与下一事件预测提供精确似然。测量模型具备凹似然、全局最优证书与稳定性判据；预测模型EPT-X在多数据集上达到领先性能，并可从测量模型获得认证初始化。研究还揭示了EasyTPP实现与数据中的若干问题。

title: Support or Magnitude? Characterizing Neuron Relevance for Instruction Data Selection
summary: Model-internal signals, such as neuron activations and gradients, have been used for instruction data selection, yet how neuron relevance should be characterized remains underexplored. In particular, should selection prioritize the magnitude of relevance or how broadly it is distributed across neurons? To investigate this question, we construct sample-level relevance profiles using AttnLRP-guided attribution and introduce two complementary criteria: Effective Relevance Support (ERS), which measures the effective support of positive relevance, and Positive Relevance Magnitude (PRM), which captures its average strength. Our analyses reveal that these characterizations produce distinct sample rankings and selection preferences despite sharing the same underlying relevance profiles. On Qwen2 models, PRM exhibits stronger associations with activation-based selection, whereas ERS produces substantially different rankings. These differences extend to task composition, within-task sample preferences, and semantic selection patterns, with varying degrees of agreement across backbones. Experiments across three language models and five downstream benchmarks demonstrate the practical value of relevance-guided selection, with ERS achieving the best overall average performance rank among the evaluated methods. Our findings highlight that how neuron relevance is distributed and characterized, rather than its magnitude alone, matters for instruction data selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经元相关性在指令数据选择中应以"强度"还是"分布广度"来刻画，提出ERS（有效正相关支持度）与PRM（正相关平均强度）两种互补准则，发现二者产生不同的样本排序与选择偏好，其中ERS在三个模型、五个基准上取得最佳平均排名。
AI.motivation: 神经元激活、梯度等模型内部信号已用于指令数据选择，但"神经元相关性应如何刻画"仍缺乏探索：选择应优先考虑相关性的大小，还是其在神经元间分布的广度？
AI.method: 基于AttnLRP引导的归因构建样本级相关性剖面，并据此提出两个互补准则：ERS（衡量正相关性的有效支持度，即分布广度）与PRM（衡量其平均强度）。在Qwen2等模型上对比二者产生的样本排序、选择偏好、任务构成、任务内样本偏好及语义选择模式，并在三个语言模型和五个下游基准上进行实验验证。
AI.result: ERS与PRM虽共享同一相关性剖面，却产生显著不同的样本排序与选择偏好；在Qwen2上PRM与基于激活的选择关联更强，而ERS给出差异明显的排序，这些差异延伸至任务构成、任务内偏好和语义模式，且各骨干网络间一致程度不同。实验中三类模型、五个基准下相关性引导的选择均有实用价值，ERS取得最佳整体平均性能排名。
AI.conclusion: 神经元相关性的分布方式与刻画方式（而非仅其强度）对指令数据选择至关重要，ERS这类分布导向的准则优于单纯强度导向的准则。

title: 1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) unify visual world modeling and action generation, yet their real-world deployment is heavily bottlenecked by iterative action denoising and the sequential execution of visual prefilling and action prediction. We demonstrate that the action-denoising trajectories in WAMs are approximately straight, rendering the first-step velocity a strong estimate of the final action direction. Building on this observation, we introduce 1Step-WAM, a framework that transforms multi-step action denoising into one single forward. Specifically, we employ a lightweight calibrator to directly correct the first step velocity, and use bandwidth-constrained action decoding to further reduce errors in the calibrated one-step actions. Compressing action generation into a single step enables it to execute in parallel with visual prefilling, completely breaking the sequential bottleneck of the traditional imagination-then-action paradigm. Evaluations on RoboTwin and LIBERO show that 1Step-WAM largely preserves multi-step task success with only about 13.4M trainable parameters, while achieving inference speedups of $7.44\times$, $5.98\times$, and $24.84\times$ for FastWAM, ImageWAM and Kairos, respectively. Furthermore, real-world robotic deployments using the FastWAM backbone confirm a consistent 7.44$\times$ speedup while maintaining close success rate to the multi-step baseline. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/changdong1687/1Step-WAM.

AI.tldr: 1Step-WAM通过将World Action Models的多步动作去噪压缩为单步前向，实现了动作生成与视觉预填充的并行执行，在保持任务成功率的同时大幅提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: WAMs统一了视觉世界建模与动作生成，但实际部署受限于迭代式动作去噪以及视觉预填充与动作预测的顺序执行，形成串行瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者观察到WAMs的动作去噪轨迹近似为直线，因此首步速度可较好地估计最终动作方向。基于此，1Step-WAM采用轻量校准器直接校正首步速度，并使用带宽受限的动作解码进一步降低校准后单步动作的误差，从而将多步去噪转为单次前向，并使动作生成与视觉预填充并行。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin和LIBERO上，1Step-WAM仅用约13.4M可训练参数即基本保持多步任务成功率，对FastWAM、ImageWAM、Kairos分别实现7.44×、5.98×、24.84×的推理加速。基于FastWAM骨干的真实机器人部署也确认了7.44×的稳定加速，且成功率接近多步基线。
AI.conclusion: 将动作生成压缩为单步可打破传统"先想象后动作"范式的串行瓶颈，在显著加速的同时维持任务性能，为WAMs的实际部署提供了高效方案。

title: State Representation Shapes Long-Horizon Agent Learning and Transfer: An Empirical Study
summary: An end-to-end success rate alone cannot distinguish failure to learn an action from failure to apply it as task state changes. We study this distinction in deterministic tool workflows that provide the current artifact state and candidate action recipes. Using 1.7B, 8B, and 27B Qwen models, we compare supervised learning across workflow horizons and cross the state representation used for training with the one used at evaluation. Horizon-matched supervision yields high completion, but an H4-trained 1.7B model transfers poorly to longer workflows under full-state observations. In an H16 crossover, compact-trained 1.7B adapters complete 50/50 held-out tasks in compact view and 0/50 in full view for each of three paired training seeds; full-trained outcomes vary across seeds. A separate 8B adapter pair shows a similar asymmetry. The view dependence also appears in paired-choice tasks where both candidate calls are executable and the correct choice depends on table contents; here, the compact mask does not consult the target action. An explicit relevance cue improves full-view execution but does not close the gap for the tested checkpoint. In a separate 27B ScienceWorld study, compact-state training improves local accuracy under both views, indicating that the transfer pattern depends on the task and observation construction. Together, these experiments identify representation-sensitive transfer as a bottleneck in the controlled workflows, without isolating content reduction from other changes to the observation.

AI.tldr: 论文通过解耦"学习动作"与"应用动作"两类失败，在确定性工具工作流中用1.7B/8B/27B Qwen模型系统探究了状态表示对监督学习迁移的影响。发现紧凑状态训练在紧凑视图下表现优异但迁移到全状态视图时严重失效，表现出强烈的表示敏感性，且该模式依任务与观测构造而异。
AI.motivation: 仅用端到端成功率无法区分"未能学会动作"与"任务状态变化后未能正确应用动作"两种失败。作者希望厘清模型能力究竟是动作学习问题还是状态应用问题，并考察训练与评估时状态表示不一致所带来的迁移瓶颈。
AI.method: 在提供当前工件状态与候选动作配方（candidate action recipes）的确定性工具工作流上，使用1.7B、8B、27B三种规模的Qwen模型，在多种工作流长度（horizon）上做监督学习；并将训练所用状态表示与评估所用状态表示交叉组合进行测试。此外进行配对选择任务（两个候选调用均可执行，正确性取决于表格内容）实验，以及一项独立的27B ScienceWorld研究作为对照。
AI.result: 长度匹配的监督可获得高完成率，但H4训练的1.7B模型在全状态观测下迁移到更长工作流时表现很差。在H16交叉实验中，紧凑训练的1.7B适配器在紧凑视图下完成50/50留出任务，而在全视图下为0/50（三个配对训练种子均如此）；全状态训练结果随种子波动较大。另一组8B适配器呈现类似不对称性。配对选择任务中紧凑掩码不参考目标动作。显式相关性提示能改善全视图执行，但未能弥合差距。27B ScienceWorld研究中，紧凑状态训练在两种视图下均提升了局部准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验表明，表示敏感的迁移（representation-sensitive transfer）是受控工作流中的关键瓶颈；但研究尚未将内容削减（content reduction）的影响与观测的其他改动分离开来，因此具体归因仍有待进一步厘清。

title: Counterfactual Rollouts for Offline Contrastive Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) learns goal-conditioned values by associating state--action pairs with the states subsequently reached, assuming that no unobserved variable jointly affects the recorded action and its outcome. When offline demonstrations come from a demonstrator with information hidden from the learner, this assumption fails and the critic absorbs spurious action--outcome associations. We formalize this setting with confounded Markov decision processes and introduce counterfactual transitions that separate what the data identify from what they do not; minimizing over all compatible transitions yields a worst-case occupancy that lower-bounds the true one. Causal Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CauCRL) learns a pessimistic counterfactual transition from positive and negative offline demonstrations and trains the critic on counterfactual rollouts, substantially improving success rates over standard CRL on confounded goal-reaching tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CauCRL，用反事实转移刻画离线对比强化学习中的混淆问题，并通过对反事实轨迹的悲观训练提升目标到达任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 离线示范可能来自学习者无法观测其信息的示范者，此时未观测变量会同时影响记录动作与结果，使对比强化学习的"动作-后续状态关联"假设失效，critic会吸收虚假的动作-结果关联。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为混淆马尔可夫决策过程，引入反事实转移以区分数据可识别与不可识别的部分；对所有兼容转移取最小化得到最坏情况占用度，作为真实占用度的下界；CauCRL从正、负离线示范中学习悲观的反事实转移，并在反事实轨迹上训练critic。
AI.result: 在混淆的目标到达任务上，CauCRL的成功率显著优于标准对比强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实转移与悲观训练，CauCRL能有效缓解离线示范中隐藏示范者信息带来的混淆，提升离线目标条件强化学习的稳健性与性能。

title: Spectral-Driven Adaptive-Rank Optimizer for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. Working in progress
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is reshaping how large language models (LLMs) acquire reasoning capabilities, yet the optimizers used remain largely inherited from teacher-forcing training. This raises a fundamental question: does RLVR induce a distinct optimization geometry that calls for a different optimizer? We investigate this question through the spectral structure of LLM gradients and find that gradient energy progressively concentrates into a shrinking effective subspace, which is characteristic of RLVR, as it is absent under supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and is largely removed when the verifiable reward is replaced by a random one. Moreover, the rank required to capture a fixed fraction of gradient energy steadily decreases over training, revealing that the effective dimensionality of useful updates itself evolves with training. These findings motivate a new optimization principle: rather than prescribing the update rank externally, an optimizer should adapt its rank to the evolving spectral structure of the gradient. We introduce Ares (Adaptive Rank-Effective Spectral Optimization), which estimates the effective update rank from the gradient's spectral energy distribution, tracks its evolution, and confines the gradient signal driving each update to the resulting low-rank subspace. Across LLMs of different scales, Ares improves accuracy over widely used optimizers and generalizes across RLVR algorithms and tasks. Results suggest that effective optimization may require optimizers to be designed around the geometry and dynamics of the training process. We release the code and data at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Ares.

AI.tldr: 本文发现RLVR训练的LLM梯度能量逐渐集中到缩小的有效子空间，导致有效更新维度随训练动态变化，据此提出自适应秩优化的Ares优化器。
AI.motivation: 当前RLVR的优化器基本沿用教师强制（teacher-forcing）训练（如SFT）的优化器，但RLVR是否具有不同的优化几何、从而需要不同优化器这一问题尚不明确。作者希望从梯度谱结构角度回答该根本问题。
AI.method: 通过分析LLM梯度的谱结构，考察梯度能量分布与有效秩随训练的演变；对比SFT、RLVR以及将可验证奖励替换为随机奖励的情形。基于发现提出优化原则：优化器应根据梯度不断演化的谱结构自适应调整更新秩。据此设计Ares，从梯度的谱能量分布估计有效更新秩，跟踪其演化，并将驱动每次更新的梯度信号限制在所得低秩子空间内。
AI.result: RLVR的存在梯度能量向缩小有效子空间集中的特征，SFT中不存在，且随机奖励替换后该特征基本消失；捕捉固定梯度能量比例所需的秩随训练持续下降，表明有效更新维度随训练演化。在不同规模的LLM上，Ares相对常用优化器提升了准确率，并在多种RLVR算法和任务上具备泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 有效优化可能需要围绕训练过程的几何与动态来设计优化器，而非直接沿用教师强制训练的优化器。作者开源代码与数据于 https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Ares。

title: Robust Detection of Directional Adversarial Attacks in Deep Neural Networks for Radiological Imaging
comment: Published in CVPR 2026 Workshops (SAIAD); open access: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026W/SAIAD/html/Malatynski_Robust_Detection_of_Directional_Adversarial_Attacks_in_Deep_Neural_Networks_CVPRW_2026_paper.html
summary: Deep learning is now central to radiology, helping detect changes on X-rays, CTs, and MRIs. However, these systems are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks - small, crafted perturbations that mislead models while appearing unchanged to humans. Such errors risk missed cancers or false positives. Studies show over 90% attack success on medical scans. Almost 30% of US hospitals use AI in imaging in 2023. Thus, an effective method of detecting such attacks and their directionality is crucial to ensure the credibility and reliability of medical systems based on DNNs. We propose a novel detection framework that leverages subsequent attacks using random noise to identify adversarial perturbations. Our approach uses the analysis of variations in the Sigmoid function to distinguish genuine medical images from adversarially manipulated ones. Specifically, we compare prediction differences between clean and attacked images, as well as between different adversarially altered versions, to improve detection accuracy. We evaluated our method on three popular medical datasets including 'Chest X-Ray Images for Classification', 'Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset' and 'Brain Tumor Dataset' under various attack scenarios, including random noise. Our framework achieved up to 99.8% ACC in identifying adversarial directional attacks, significantly outperforming existing defense mechanisms. It consistently identified adversarial samples across varying attack strengths while keeping false positives low, showing strong reliability and potential for clinical use. Furthermore, our proposal highlights its potential for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于随机噪声后续攻击与Sigmoid函数变化分析的对抗样本检测框架，在三个医学影像数据集上对方向性对抗攻击检测准确率达99.8%，优于现有防御方法。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在放射影像（X光、CT、MRI）诊断中广泛应用，但模型极易受对抗攻击影响——微小扰动即可误导模型且人眼难以察觉，可能导致漏诊癌症或假阳性。研究显示医学影像上攻击成功率超过90%，且2023年美国近30%医院在影像中使用AI，因此检测对抗攻击及其方向性对保障基于DNN的医疗系统可信度与可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出一种新型检测框架，利用随机噪声引发的后续攻击来识别对抗扰动；通过分析Sigmoid函数的变化来区分真实医学图像与对抗操纵图像；具体比较干净图像与受攻击图像之间、以及不同对抗版本之间的预测差异，以提升检测准确率。
AI.result: 在'Chest X-Ray Images for Classification'、'Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset'和'Brain Tumor Dataset'三个医学数据集上，于包括随机噪声在内的多种攻击场景下评估。框架在识别对抗方向性攻击上达到最高99.8%的准确率，显著优于现有防御机制；在不同攻击强度下均能稳定识别对抗样本，同时保持较低假阳性率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展现出较强的可靠性与临床应用潜力，并具备实际部署的前景。

title: CoverSynth: Coverage-Guided Generation of Retrieval Evaluation Sets
summary: Enterprise agents need retrieval evaluation sets that expose domain-specific failures and guide developers towards efficient deployment tradeoffs. Neither expert-human-authored sets nor current synthetic generation methods provide a methodology for achieving the necessary coverage, reliability, efficiency, and discriminability required for such decision-making. Simultaneously, the field does not have an assessment framework for determining when an evaluation set has satisfied these properties. We introduce an evaluation set assessment framework for these criteria and CoverSynth -- a generator specifically designed to satisfy these criteria without incurring the high cost of human expert labeling. Starting from an unannotated corpus, CoverSynth targets coverage across retrieval demands and system capabilities. Deterministic checks locate evidence quotes in their sources, while model-based checks assess semantic validity to guarantee reliable ground truth. Across five public enterprise-style corpora, our method provides informative variation in difficulty, revealing unseen failure modes such as an inability of agents to handle underspecified or ambiguous requests. On the RepLiQA corpus, 91\% of human-generated queries can be answered by all members on a panel of 12 retrieval systems, compared to only 12\% of CoverSynth-generated queries. Finally, in a repeated TechQA/RepLiQA study, 12 of 12 within-harness model contrasts have positive nominal 95\% intervals on generated sets, compared with 4 of 12 on human sets. CoverSynth makes coverage and evidence quality explicit construction objectives, producing corpus-grounded evaluations that reveal retrieval headroom and differences between agent configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估集评估框架与生成器 CoverSynth，通过显式的覆盖度和证据质量目标，从无标注语料构建企业级检索评测集，揭示未被发现的检索失败模式与系统差异。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体需要能暴露领域特定失败并指导部署权衡的检索评测集。然而，专家人工撰写的数据集与现有合成生成方法都无法提供兼顾覆盖度、可靠性、效率与区分度的方法论；同时领域内也缺乏判断评测集是否满足这些属性的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出针对上述标准的评估集评估框架，并设计生成器 CoverSynth。该方法从无标注语料出发，以检索需求和系统能力两个维度为覆盖目标；采用确定性检查在来源中定位证据引文，并辅以基于模型的检查评估语义有效性，以保证真值可靠。整个流程无需高成本的人工专家标注。
AI.result: 在五个公开企业风格语料上，方法产生具有信息量的难度变化，揭示出智能体无法处理欠规范或歧义请求等未见失败模式。在 RepLiQA 语料上，12 个检索系统面板中，人工生成查询有 91% 可被所有系统回答，而 CoverSynth 生成查询仅 12%。在重复的 TechQA/RepLiQA 研究中，生成的集合上 12/12 的模型对比具有正的 95% 名义置信区间，人工集合上仅 4/12。
AI.conclusion: CoverSynth 将覆盖度与证据质量作为显式构建目标，生成的语料接地评测能够揭示检索余量与智能体配置之间的差异，为评测集构建提供了可操作的方法论与评估标准。

title: HiPAD: A Unified Gait, Audio-Visual, and Personality Fusion Network for Depression Detection, with a Hierarchical Personality Ablation and the Calibration Limits of Domain-Adapted LLMs
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), Rio de Janeiro, Grand Challenge track. Authors' extended version: the appendices restore the extended related work, figures, tables and discussion omitted from the conference version for length
summary: We present HiPAD, a single fusion network submitted to all six sub-tracks of the MPDD-AVG 2026 depression-detection challenge, covering the Elder and Young cohorts and three modality sets (gait, audio-visual, and both), each combined with personality descriptions. The network encodes each available modality with a shared BiLSTM, zero-pads absent modalities, and applies cross-modal attention only when at least two of gait, audio and video are present. Personality, which dominates our results, is kept out of the attention and fused by concatenation. Because the architecture is identical in every sub-track, differences between them reflect the data rather than the model, and we use this to study three questions. Our main finding is that the personality description, roughly 150 tokens about who the subject is, carries more depression signal than audio, video, and gait combined: gait plus personality alone (TLS 0.647) beats every configuration that includes audio and video. First, a four-level ablation of the personality description (L0-L3) quantifies this: removing every personality-derived feature, including the Big Five scores that earlier MPDD ablations keep, lowers the Track-Level Score by 0.499 to 0.507 and leaves the model at chance. Second, domain-adapting the personality encoder with LoRA (7B) or QLoRA (72B) on PHQ-8/9 data raises binary Cohen's $κ$ by 0.13 but lowers the overall score by distorting the PHQ-9 regression; a frozen RoBERTa-large encoder does better at this sample size. Third, at fixed architecture, handcrafted clinical features (eGeMAPS, OpenFace action units) outperform generic deep features (wav2vec2, DenseNet) on the audio-visual tracks. The unified system reaches a cross-track G-Score of 0.482; with under 100 subjects per cohort, the limiting factors are the size of the representation and the calibration of the outputs, not the choice of architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出统一单融合网络HiPAD参赛MPDD-AVG 2026全部六个子赛道，发现人格描述携带的抑郁信号超过音频、视频与步态之和，并指出小样本下限制性能的是表征规模与输出校准而非架构选择。
AI.motivation: MPDD-AVG 2026挑战赛含六个子赛道（老/青年队列×三种模态组合），各赛道数据差异大。作者希望以完全相同的架构参赛，使子赛道间差异归因于数据而非模型，从而系统研究人格描述、领域自适应与特征类型对抑郁检测的影响。
AI.method: HiPAD为单融合网络：每种可用模态用共享BiLSTM编码，缺失模态零填充；仅当步态、音频、视频中至少两种存在时才施加跨模态注意力；人格描述不参与注意力，通过拼接融合。研究三方面：(1) 人格描述的四级消融(L0–L3)；(2) 用LoRA(7B)/QLoRA(72B)在PHQ-8/9数据上领域自适应人格编码器，并与冻结RoBERTa-large对比；(3) 固定架构比较手工临床特征(eGeMAPS、OpenFace动作单元)与通用深度特征(wav2vec2、DenseNet)。
AI.result: 人格描述（约150 token）所携带的抑郁信号强于音频、视频与步态之和；仅步态+人格(TLS 0.647)即优于任何含音视频的配置。移除全部人格特征（含此前MPDD消融保留的大五人格分数）使Track-Level Score下降0.499–0.507，模型退化为随机水平。LoRA/QLoRA领域自适应使二分类Cohen's κ提升0.13，但因扭曲PHQ-9回归而降低总分；该样本量下冻结RoBERTa-large更优。手工临床特征在音视频赛道优于通用深度特征。统一系统跨赛道G-Score为0.482。
AI.conclusion: 在每队列不足100名受试者的小样本条件下，制约性能的是表征规模与输出校准，而非架构选择；人格文本是当前最强的抑郁信号来源。

title: PatTransBench: an ipc-stratified, multi-dimensional benchmark for patent machine translation evaluation
summary: We present PatTransBench, a 12,000-item Chinese-English/Japanese/Korean patent machine translation (PatMT) benchmark with a four-dimensional evaluation protocol. The benchmark comprises 6,000 short-text (sentence/claim) and 6,000 long-text (paragraph) pairs, evenly split across three language pairs and both translation directions, built via IPC-section-stratified sampling and dualthreshold quality gating from upstream patent-family parallel corpora. The evaluation protocol spans literal n-gram overlap (BLEU, ROUGE-L, chrF), cross-lingual semantic textual similarity (CLSTS), 38-probe-language consistency testing, and serving performance under concurrency. A case study on PatMT2-7B and its fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit variants reveals direction-dependent quantization effects masked by aggregate scores and non-monotonic language-failure patterns across quantization schemes that are invisible to single-metric evaluation. We plan to release the benchmark, protocol, and case-study results upon publication to support reproducible PatMT evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PatTransBench：一个含 12,000 条中英/日/韩专利机器翻译（PatMT）基准，配合四维评测协议，涵盖字面 n-gram 重叠、跨语言语义相似度、38 项探测的语言一致性以及并发服务性能。案例研究揭示量化效应具有方向依赖性，且聚合分数会掩盖语言失效的非单调模式。
AI.motivation: 专利机器翻译缺乏覆盖多语言对、双向翻译与多维评测的标准化基准，现有单一指标评测易掩盖量化效应与语言失效模式，难以支撑可复现的 PatMT 评测。
AI.method: 构建 PatTransBench：基于上游专利族平行语料，采用 IPC 分节分层采样与双阈值质量过滤，形成 6,000 条短文本（句子/权利要求）与 6,000 条长文本（段落）对，均匀分布于三个语言对及双向翻译。评测协议包含四维：字面 n-gram 重叠（BLEU、ROUGE-L、chrF）、跨语言语义文本相似度（CLSTS）、38 项探测的语言一致性测试、并发下的服务性能。并以 PatMT2-7B 及其 fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit 变体进行案例研究。
AI.result: 案例研究表明：量化效应具有方向依赖性，被聚合分数所掩盖；不同量化方案下语言失效呈现非单调模式，且这些现象在单指标评测中不可见。
AI.conclusion: PatTransBench 提供了多维、可复现的 PatMT 评测框架；作者计划在论文发表后公开基准、评测协议与案例研究结果，以推动专利机器翻译评测的可复现研究。

title: SurgCast: Action-Conditioned Future Skeletons for Controllable Surgical World Models
summary: Surgical world models must turn prospective robot actions into visually faithful, structurally consistent instrument motion. We introduce SurgCast, which predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses the forecast to control video generation. Dual-path injection combines skeleton geometry with derived, instrument-specific motion descriptors through geometric residuals and conditioning modulation. Both paths complement native action conditioning and are retained in a four-step causal student. On SutureBot and SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, the teacher and student improve all seven reported quality and instrument-consistency metrics over their respective direct-action baselines; teacher FVD decreases by 37.6% and 67.3%. Ablations show that future actions improve skeleton prediction and that combining both injection paths performs best across all six metrics under predicted skeletons. These results support using predicted articulated structure and its motion semantics as a control interface for surgical video prediction. Project videos and examples are available at https://surgcast.netlify.app/.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgCast，用预测的未来器械骨架作为控制接口来生成手术视频，通过双路径注入显著提升视觉质量与器械一致性。
AI.motivation: 手术世界模型需把机器人未来动作转化为视觉真实且结构一致的器械运动，直接以动作条件生成视频难以保证结构一致性。
AI.method: 先由当前结构、机器人状态和未来动作预测未来器械骨架，再以该预测控制视频生成；采用双路径注入，几何残差注入骨架几何，条件调制注入器械特定运动描述符，二者与原生动作条件互补，并蒸馏至四步因果学生模型。
AI.result: 在SutureBot与SRTH-Porcine-Cholei上，教师与学生模型在全部七项质量与器械一致性指标上均优于直接动作基线，教师FVD分别下降37.6%和67.3%；消融显示未来动作有助于骨架预测，且在预测骨架下双路径组合在六项指标上最优。
AI.conclusion: 预测的关节化结构及其运动语义可作为手术视频预测的有效控制接口。

title: SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

AI.tldr: SpecFit：在MoE模型推测解码中，以预测吞吐量而非接受长度来选择验证的草稿子树，从而决定验证哪些草稿token以及何时停止草稿。
AI.motivation: MoE模型将专家权重卸载到主机内存时，H2D专家传输进入解码关键路径。推测解码一次前向验证多个草稿token，但每个被验证token都会激活各自的专家，草稿树越大传输的专家越多，导致H2D开销使得推测解码有时比自回归解码还慢。
AI.method: SpecFit：从草稿路径概率估计期望提交token数；从子树节点数和逐层激活专家并集预测周期时间；该并集是单调子模覆盖函数，每个节点只为其新增专家付费；对祖先封闭子树做精确搜索，返回预测吞吐量最高的子树；每层草稿后运行同一搜索以决定何时停止草稿；未修改的目标模型负责验证。
AI.result: 在CNN/DailyMail摘要和GSM8K子集上，使用Qwen3-30B-A3B：SpecFit比相同专家缓存的EAGLE-3分别快21.6%和7.0%，比原始EAGLE-3快1.97倍和1.72倍。
AI.conclusion: 以吞吐量为优化目标选择草稿子树可有效缓解MoE卸载场景下推测解码的H2D专家传输开销，SpecFit在保持目标模型验证不变的前提下取得显著加速。

title: Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport
summary: Cross-material magnetic core loss prediction requires adapting to new material responses with limited measurements. Global feature alignment overlooks differences in source and target excitation coverage. This motivates selecting comparable samples and controlling each source measurement's alignment contribution. This paper proposes T-PCOT, a Transformer transfer method based on condition-supported partial optimal transport. Frequency, flux excursion, temperature, and waveform descriptors define a sparse graph of comparable operating conditions. A capacity-constrained transport plan distributes alignment across source measurements and leaves costly target mass unmatched. The plan is constructed from measured inputs before training and guides local waveform-feature consistency. An importance-weighted sampling scheme preserves both uniform source regression and the transport objective during minibatch optimization. Experiments on three material pairs and three target label budgets show that T-PCOT reduces mean relative error (MRE) and 95th-percentile error (P95) relative to Transformer-based multiple-kernel maximum mean discrepancy (T-MKMMD) in all nine comparisons. Macro MRE decreases from 12.60% to 9.65%, and macro P95 from 30.94% to 25.06%, corresponding to relative reductions of 23.41% and 19.01%. Controlled comparisons and ablations examine the roles of input processing, condition correspondence, and source capacity. The results demonstrate the predictive advantage of organizing cross-material alignment through operating-condition support over the compared global alignment method. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance in magnetic core loss transfer learning.

AI.tldr: 提出T-PCOT——基于条件支撑部分最优传输的Transformer迁移方法，用于跨材料磁芯损耗预测，在有限测量下通过筛选可比样本并控制各源样本对齐贡献，显著降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 跨材料磁芯损耗预测需在有限测量下适应新材料的响应。现有全局特征对齐方法忽略了源域与目标域在激励覆盖范围上的差异，导致源测量中对齐贡献分配不合理，因此需要选择可比样本并控制每个源测量的对齐贡献。
AI.method: T-PCOT：以频率、磁通偏移、温度和波形描述子构建可比工况的稀疏图；设计带容量约束的部分最优传输计划，在各源测量间分配对齐权重，并允许代价高昂的目标质量不被匹配；该计划由测量输入在训练前构建，用于指导局部波形特征一致性；结合重要性加权采样，在小批量优化中兼顾均匀源回归与传输目标。
AI.result: 在三种材料对与三种目标标签预算共九组对比中，T-PCOT相对T-MKMMD（基于Transformer的多核最大均值差异）均降低MRE与P95。宏观MRE由12.60%降至9.65%，宏观P95由30.94%降至25.06%，相对下降23.41%与19.01%。
AI.conclusion: 通过工况支撑组织跨材料对齐优于全局对齐方法，T-PCOT在磁芯损耗迁移学习中达到当前最优预测性能；输入处理、条件对应与源容量的作用经对照实验与消融得到验证。

title: Know Yourself and Know Your Neighbour: A Syntactically Informed Self-Supervised Compositional Sentence Representation Learning Framework using a Recursive Hypernetwork
summary: Sentence representation learning is still an open challenge in Natural Language Processing. In this work, we propose a new self-supervised framework for learning sentence representations, using a special type of neural network called a recursive hypernetwork. Our proposed model composes the representation of a sentence from representations of words by applying a recursive composition through the parse tree. We maintain a separate syntactic and semantic representation, and the semantic composition is guided by the information from the syntactic representation. To train this model, we introduce a novel set of six self-supervised tasks. By analysing the performance on 7 probing tasks, we validate that the generated sentence representation encodes richer linguistic information than both averaging baselines and state-of-the-art alternatives. Furthermore, we assess the impact of the six proposed self-supervised training tasks through ablation studies. We also demonstrate that the representations generated by our model are stable for sentences of varying length and that the semantic composition operators adapt to different syntactic categories\footnote{Code available: https://github.com/vasudev2020/codi/tree/main}.

AI.tldr: 提出递归超网络自监督框架学习句子表示，分离句法与语义表示并设计六项自监督任务，在7项探针任务上优于基线及SOTA。
AI.motivation: 句子表示学习仍是NLP的开放挑战，现有方法（如平均基线）编码的语言学信息有限，需更丰富的句法与语义表示。
AI.method: 使用递归超网络（recursive hypernetwork），通过句法树递归组合词表示以生成句子表示；维护独立的句法表示与语义表示，语义组合由句法表示信息引导；引入六项新型自监督训练任务进行训练。
AI.result: 在7项探针任务（probing tasks）上，所生成表示编码的语言学信息多于平均基线与当前最优替代方法；通过消融实验评估六项自监督任务各自影响；表示对不同长度句子稳定，语义组合算子能适应不同句法类别。
AI.conclusion: 该递归超网络自监督框架能生成语言学信息更丰富、长度稳健且句法自适应的句子表示，验证了句法引导语义组合与多自监督任务的有效性。
